item.desc: The parameter is used to identify a cell. There are 504 unique physical-layer cell identities. The physical-layer cell identities are grouped into 168 unique physical-layer cell-identity groups, each group containing three unique identities. The grouping is such that each physical-layer cell identity is part of one and only one physical-layer cell-identity group. And the physical cell identities are space multiplexing and programmed by network programming people.
item.name: pci

item.desc: This parameter sets a list of candidate Physical Cell Identities (PCIs) that can be allocated to the serving cell. It is an array parameter consisting of 12 elements. Each element indicates a PCI that can be allocated to the serving cell. This parameter is valid if the sonResolveManner (Resolve Manner when PCI is Conflict or Confusion) parameter is set to 1 (Resolved by Distributed).
item.name: pciList

item.desc: For each UE, the ratio of PDSCH EPRE to cell-specific RS EPRE among PDSCH REs in all the OFDM symbols containing cell-specific RS is equal and is denoted by Rho_B. The cell-specific ratio Rho_B / Rho_A is according to cell-specific parameter P_B signalled by higher layers and the number of configured eNB cell specific antenna ports.
item.name: pb

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink E-UTRA Absolute Radio Frequency Channel Number (EARFCN) used in a cell. A center carrier frequency is calculated as follows: F_DL = F_DL_low + 0.1 x (N_DL - N_Offs-Dl), where F_DL is the center carrier frequency, F_DL_low is the lowest downlink carrier frequency, N_DL is the DlEARFCN, and N_Offs-Dl is the offset corresponding to the frequency band indicator.
item.name: earfcnDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink E-UTRA Absolute Radio Frequency Channel Number (EARFCN) used in a cell. A center carrier frequency is calculated as follows: F_UL = F_UL_low + 0.1 x (N_UL - N_Offs-Ul), where F_UL is the center carrier frequency, F_UL_low is the lowest uplink carrier frequency, N_UL is the UlEARFCN, and N_Offs-Ul is the offset corresponding to the frequency band indicator.
item.name: earfcnUl

item.desc: This parameter indicates the attribute of the MBSFN in a cell. If it indicates an MBSFN-dedicated cell, only the MBMS service is provided in the cell and UEs can combine the MBMS services in multiple cells. If it indicates a non-MBSFN cell, only non-MBMS services are provided in the cell. If it indicates a non-MBSFN and MBSFN multiplex cell, both non-MBMS services and MBMS services are provided in the cell.
item.name: cellResvInfo

item.name: cnAbilCallProSrvcc

item.desc: This parameter sets the list of bands requested for CA. It is an array parameter consisting of 16 elements. If the caRequestBandSwch (Requested Band Switch for CA) parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB sends a UE a Capability Enquiry message carrying the requestedFrequencyBands-r11 IE that contains all the bands configured by this parameter when inquiring about the UE capabilities. After receiving the Capability Enquiry message, the UE reports the CA capabilities that include only the frequency bands contained in the requestedFrequencyBands-r11 IE.
item.name: caReqBandSet

item.desc: This parameter indicates the maximum number of UEs for the guaranteed migration during system software upgrade.
item.name: maxReliaUeNum

item.desc: This parameter indicates whether abnormal FGI configurations take effect on the eNB.
item.name: fgiFilterFuncSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets a list of coordination network IDs for staggering configuration in automatic CA configuration. It is an array parameter consisting of six elements. Each element indicates a coordination network ID. In the current version, only one coordination network is supported, that is, only the coordination network ID corresponding to the first element is valid and the rest elements are invalid. The current coordination network ID is the ID of the S9100 device connected to the eNodeB.
item.name: coperNetID

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of the NB process and LTE process sharing the same SCTP association for X2. If the switch is turned off (namely the parameter value is Open), the NB process and LTE process share the same SCTP association for X2.
item.name: x2SharedForNbLteSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the LBT channel access priority. The RRU uses different LBT parameters to execute CCA in accordance with different channel access priorities.
item.name: lbtChannelAccessPriority

item.desc: This parameter sets the energy detection threshold of the LBT process for LAA cells. If the energy of a timeslot duration detected by the eNB is smaller than the threshold, the timeslot duration is considered to be idle; otherwise, the timeslot duration is considered to be busy.
item.name: energyDetectionThrsh

item.desc: This parameter sets the period of pRRU's reporting the LBT detection result.
item.name: rrbtReportPeriodUl

item.desc: This parameter sets the LBT-based DCS trigger threshold. If the probability of channels being busy is larger than the parameter value, the DCS process will be triggered.
item.name: lbtTrigDcsThrsh

item.desc: If the delay in initial E-RAB setup is longer that this parameter value, the automatic log is reported. This parameter indicates the threshold of the delay in initial E-RAB setup. If the delay in initial E-RAB setup is longer than this parameter value, the automatic log is reported to analyze the reason for the long delay in E-RAB setup for the baseband. This parameter can be used to troubleshoot the long delay in initial E-RAB setup for the baseband.
item.name: initErabSetUpTimeDelayThres

item.desc: Definition: If the setup delay of a newly added E-RAB is longer than this parameter value, the automatic log is reported. Background: The delay in the setup of newly added E-RABs for the baseband is too long. Purpose: Through the adjustment of the threshold of the delay in the setup of newly added E-RABs, the automatic log can be reported when the actual delay exceeds this threshold.
item.name: addErabSetUpTimeDelayThres

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum channel occupation duration in LBT. A larger parameter value indicates a longer duration for which the channel is occupied in the LBT process.
item.name: lbtMcot

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of uplink carriers for CA band combinations. If the Switch for Specifying the Maximum Number of Carriers for CA Band Combinations parameter is set to Open, only the CA capability with the number of uplink carriers being less than or equal to this parameter value can be reported when a UE reports its radio capability.
item.name: caMaxUlCcNumInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of downlink carriers for CA band combinations. If the Switch for Specifying the Maximum Number of Carriers for CA Band Combinations parameter is set to Open, only the CA capability with the number of downlink carriers being less than or equal to this parameter value can be reported when a UE reports its radio capability.
item.name: caMaxDlCcNumInd

item.desc: This parameter specifies the set of the LTE bands requested for 4G-5G dual connectivity. It contains all the bands where the LTE cells that can be configured as PCells or SCells in 4G-5G dual connectivity are located. If 4G-5G dual connectivity is enabled, the UE Capability Enquiry message carries the requestedFreqBandsNR-MRDC-r15 IE and the IE contains all the bands configured by this parameter. This parameter cannot be null.
item.name: mrdcRequestLteBandSet

item.desc: This parameter indicates the band set requested by nsa for the nr band set function, and it contains the band of all NR ps cells and NR scells; If the Requested Band set is used for nsa function, the msg of UECapabilityEnquiry carry requestedFreqBandsNR-MRDC-r15, and requestedFreqBandsNR-MRDC-r15 contains all band set about this parameter. If this parameter can not be null.
item.name: mrdcRequestNrBandSet

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for collecting statistics on power sharing load between LTE carriers. When the power sharing between LTE carriers is enabled, this timer is started and statistics on cell load start to be collected. When the timer times out, cell load data collection stops and power is allocated among cells.
item.name: lLPwrShareStatTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the update period of the general overlapping coverage degree. At the end of each period, the eNodeB updates the calculated overlapping coverage degree to the neighbor cell list on the EMS.
item.name: overlapRateUpdatePeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the component of the number of licensed RRC-Connected UEs on the eNodeB in FDD. The operator can configure the parameter value under license. If the actual number of RRC-Connected UEs in FDD exceeds the current parameter value, the eNodeB rejects new FDD RRC connection establishment requests.
item.name: enbRrcLicPartitionFdd

item.desc: This parameter sets the component of the number of licensed RRC-Connected UEs on the eNodeB in TDD. The operator can configure the parameter value under license. If the actual number of RRC-Connected UEs in TDD exceeds the current parameter value, the eNodeB rejects new TDD RRC connection establishment requests.
item.name: enbRrcLicPartitionTdd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the self-configuration of neighbor cell coverage relations. If it is set to Open, the neighbor cell coverage relations are updated based on the attributes of the serving cell and neighbor cells.
item.name: shareCoverUpdateSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates whether to determine the coverage relation of neighbor cells by using a special policy. If it is set to Open, special policies are used to update the coverage relation of neighbor cells.
item.name: shareCoveSpcStgySwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the distance difference used in neighbor cell coverage relation self-configuration. If the distance difference between the serving cell and a neighbor cell exceeds this threshold, the coverage relation is considered to be a neighbor relation.
item.name: sCDistanceThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the azimuth difference used in neighbor cell coverage relation self-configuration. If the azimuth difference between the serving cell and a neighbor cell exceeds this threshold, the coverage relation is considered to be a neighbor relation.
item.name: sCAzimuthDiffThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the beam width difference used in neighbor cell coverage relation self-configuration. If the beam width difference between the serving cell and a neighbor cell exceeds this threshold, the coverage relation is considered to be a neighbor relation.
item.name: sCBeamWidthDiffThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the update period that is used when the neighbor-cell coverage relation update function is enabled. When the period expires, the coverage relation of neighbor cells is checked and incorrect coverage relations are updated.
item.name: shareCoverUpdatePeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the range of allowable low-priority frequencies. If the Switch for Automatic Detection of Allowable Frequencies parameter is set to Open, the eNodeB automatically detects whether the UEs support the configured range of allowable low-priority frequencies. If the eNodeB determines that a frequency range is not supported, it does not trigger measurement or handover procedures for the frequencies within the frequency range. Note: If the eNodeB determines that a UE supports a range of allowable high-priority frequencies, it also supports a range of allowable low-priority frequencies.
item.name: lPrioAllowLTEFreqRange

item.desc: This parameter sets the range of allowable high-priority frequencies. If the Switch for Automatic Detection of Allowable Frequencies parameter is set to Open, the eNodeB automatically detects whether the UEs support the configured range of allowable high-priority frequencies. If the eNodeB determines that a frequency range is not supported, it does not trigger measurement or handover procedures for the frequencies within the frequency range. Note: If the eNodeB determines that a UE supports a range of allowable high-priority frequencies, it also supports a range of allowable low-priority frequencies.
item.name: hPrioAllowLTEFreqRange

item.desc: If the 5G capability of UEs supports only SA scenarios, this parameter determines whether the LTE side carries the specified NR bands when querying the NR capability. If it is set to Open, the NR bands configured by the GlobalConfigLTE. MrdcRequestNrBandSet parameter are carried when the LTE side queries the NR capability of UEs. If it is set to Close, no NR band is carried when the LTE side queries the NR capability of UEs.
item.name: saBandEnquirySwch

item.desc: This parameter sets a frequency list of basic-coverage cells of energy-saving cells. It is an array parameter and can be configured with a maximum of five frequencies. If the eSSelfConfigSwch (Switch for Automatic Configuration of the Energy-Saving Coverage Relation) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the frequency of a selected neighbor cell is included in the frequency list, the neighbor cell can be used as a basic-coverage cell of the energy-saving cells. Otherwise, the neighbor cell cannot be used as a basic-coverage cell of the energy-saving cells.
item.name: eSCoverCellFreqList

item.desc: This parameter sets whether a UE can trigger an SRVCC-based handover when the eNodeB receives a ringing message. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB stops the running timer for forbidding SRVCC when receiving a ringing message, so that the UE can trigger an SRVCC-based handover. If it is set to Close, the eNodeB forbids a UE from triggering an SRVCC-based handover no matter whether the eNodeB receives a ringing message or not during the running period of the timer for forbidding SRVCC-based handover.
item.name: allow180RingSRVCCSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the eNodeB inquires the 5G capabilities of UEs again. If it is set to Handover Scenario, it indicates that the target eNodeB inquires the 5G capability of a UE again if the frequency band information in the 5G capability carried by the source base station does not completely contain the values of the mrdcRequestLteBandSet (LTE Band Set Requested for 4G-5G DC) parameter or the values of the mrdcRequestNrBandSet (Request NR Band Set for MR-DC) parameter configured on the target eNodeB. If it is set to Attach Scenario, it indicates that the target eNodeB inquires the 5G capability of a UE again if the frequency band information in the 5G capability carried in the context setup request in an access scenario does not completely contain the values of the mrdcRequestLteBandSet (LTE Band Set Requested for 4G-5G DC) parameter or the values of the mrdcRequestNrBandSet (Request NR Band Set for MR-DC) parameter configured on the target eNodeB. If this parameter is set to Handover and Attach Scenario, it indicates that the scenarios corresponding to both the Handover Scenario and Attach Scenario values are supported.
item.name: hodNsaCapEnquirySwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to crop E-UTRAN capability on the source side during a 4G-to-3G handover of a UE with data services. If it is set to Open, during a 4G-to-3G handover of a UE with data services, no E-UTRAN capability information is carried in the handover request. If it is set to Close, during a 4G-to-3G handover of a UE with data services, E-UTRAN capability information is carried in the handover request.
item.name: ltoUHoEutranCapDelSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to optimize ping-pong handover prevention measurement for the UEs that are handed over to the 4G network due to poor channel quality. If it is set to Open, the ping-pong handover prevention policy is implemented for the UEs that are handed over to the 4G network due to poor channel quality based on the RSRP threshold and the RSRP Offset for Channel Quality-Based Ping-Pong Handover Prevention value that are carried during the channel quality-based handover to the 4G network. If this parameter is set to Close, the general functional ping-pong handover prevention policy is used.
item.name: dataQualPrePPMeasOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRP offset for preventing ping-pong handover caused by poor channel quality. For the UEs that are handed over to the 4G network due to poor channel quality, the eNodeB delivers the RSRP threshold of the target cell for directional SA migration measurement based on the sum of the RSRP value carried during the handover and this parameter value to prevent ping-pong handover when the UEs return to the 5G network.
item.name: dataQualPrePPRsrpOffset

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration processing uplink primary services. It is used to determine the type of the UEs that are handed over to the 4G network due to poor channel quality. If a UE that is handed over to the 4G network due to poor channel quality carries an uplink primary service ID, this timer is started by the 4G network. During the operation of this timer, the UE is that with uplink primary services. When this timer expires, the UE is changed to that with other services. If this parameter is set to 65535, it indicates that the UE are always that with uplink primary services.
item.name: serviceDurationTimerUl

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to count an SN release as a normal release when the eNodeB releases the SN after receiving an SCG Failure Information NR message for UE power saving. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB counts the SN release as a normal release. If it is set to Close, the eNodeB counts the SN release as an abnormal release. The SCG Failure Information NR message can be sent due to UE power saving only when all the following conditions are met:1) The value of the failureType-r15 IE is t310-Expiry. 2) The value of the first ARFCN-ValueNR-r15 element in the measResultFreqListNR IE is 0.3) The value of the first pci-r15 element in the measResultFreqListNR IE is 0.
item.name: uePowSvTrigSnRelOptSw

item.desc: This parameter sets bearer ID allocation mode. To allocate bearer IDs in ascending order, set this parameter to Type1. To allow re-allocating the ID of a bearer to another bearer after the bearer is released, set this parameter to Type2.
item.name: bearerIdAllocPolicy

item.desc: This parameter sets a spectrum efficiency optimization policy for far-point UEs in uplink CoMP scheduling. To use a larger MCS value and a smaller number of RBs for far-point UEs in uplink CoMP scheduling in the case that the number of UEs in a cell is greater than 50, set this parameter to 0 (Spectrum Efficiency preferred). In this case, the optimal spectrum efficiency can be achieved. To use the maximum TB size in uplink CoMP scheduling for far-point UEs, set this parameter to 1 (Rate preferred) to achieve the optimal rate of the far-point UEs. To use the maximum TB size in uplink CoMP scheduling for far-point UEs of a QoS type in the case that the number of UEs in a cell is greater than 50, set this parameter to 2 (Uplink Type User Rate preferred). In this case, the optimal uplink rate of the far-point UEs of the QoS type can be achieved. To use the maximum TB size in uplink CoMP scheduling for far-point UEs with guaranteed services in the case that the number of UEs in a cell is greater than 50, set this parameter to 3 (Guaranteed User Rate preferred). In this case, the optimal uplink rate of the far-point UEs with guaranteed services can be achieved.
item.name: uLCoMPFarPointSEOptSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the type of general QoS service that triggers inter-frequency migration of the UEs in a serving cell or its intra-frequency neighbor cells. It is an array parameter consisting of six elements. The elements in the array indicate whether the services of QoS type1 through QoS type6 in turn trigger inter-frequency migration of the UEs in the serving cell or its intra-frequency neighbor cells. If an element is set to 1, it indicates that if there is a UE with a service of the corresponding general QoS type in a serving cell, the eNodeB performs inter-frequency migration on other UEs in the serving cell or its intra-frequency neighbor cells, so that the UE with a service of the corresponding general QoS type can be allocated with sufficient time-frequency resources in the serving cell and is not interfered by other UEs. If an element is set to 0, it indicates that a UE with a service of the corresponding general QoS type in a serving cell cannot trigger inter-frequency migration of other UEs in the serving cell or its intra-frequency neighbor cells.
item.name: trigInterFMigQosType

item.desc: This parameter sets the MCC of the PLMN broadcasted by the NR neighbor cells of LTE cells in RAN sharing scenarios. If the Switch of PLMN Replacement for NR Neighbor Cells in RAN Sharing Scenarios (rplcNrPLMNInRanSharSwch) parameter is set to Open and the PLMN of the NR neighbor cells reported on the air interface consists of this parameter value and the value of the MNC of the PLMN Broadcasted by the NR Neighbor Cells in a RAN Sharing Area (ranSharNrMNC) parameter, the MCC of the PLMN of the NR neighbor cells reported on the air interface is set to the value of the MCC of the PLMN Broadcasted by the NR Neighbor Cells in a RAN Sharing Area (ranSharNrMCC) parameter.
item.name: ranSharNrMCC

item.desc: This parameter sets the MNC of the PLMN broadcasted by the NR neighbor cells of LTE cells in RAN sharing scenarios. If the Switch of PLMN Replacement for NR Neighbor Cells in RAN Sharing Scenarios (rplcNrPLMNInRanSharSwch) parameter is set to Open and the PLMN of the NR neighbor cells reported on the air interface consists of this parameter value and the value of the MCC of the PLMN Broadcasted by the NR Neighbor Cells in a RAN Sharing Area (ranSharNrMCC) parameter, the MNC of the PLMN of the NR neighbor cells reported on the air interface is set to the value of the MNC of the PLMN Broadcasted by the NR Neighbor Cells in a RAN Sharing Area (ranSharNrMNC) parameter.
item.name: ranSharNrMNC

item.desc: This parameter sets the MCC of the primary PLMN of the NR neighbor cells corresponding to the LTE cells in RAN sharing scenarios. If the Switch of PLMN Replacement for NR Neighbor Cells in RAN Sharing Scenarios (rplcNrPLMNInRanSharSwch) parameter is set to Open and the PLMN of the NR neighbor cells reported on the air interface consists of the value of the MCC of the PLMN Broadcasted by the NR Neighbor Cells in a RAN Sharing Area (ranSharNrMCC) parameter and the value of the MNC of the PLMN Broadcasted by the NR Neighbor Cells in a RAN Sharing Area (ranSharNrMNC) parameter, the MCC of the PLMN of the NR neighbor cells reported on the air interface is set to the value of this parameter.

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum length of the Source to Target Transparent Container stream sent by the eNodeB to the core network during the S1 handover procedure. If a UE capability stream is too long, the receiver may fail to decode the stream, causing an S1-based handover failure. If this parameter is set to 0, it indicates that the whole UE capability stream is sent to the core network. If this parameter is set to n (a number larger than 0) and the length of the Source to Target Transparent Container stream is longer than n bytes, only the E-UTRAN capability streams of UEs are sent to the core network to avoid S1-based handover failures caused by too long UE capability streams.
item.name: ueCapTransLimit

item.desc: This parameter sets the Mobile Country Code (MCC) of the eNodeB-level PLMN of the operator. A PLMN is jointly determined by a Mobile Network Code (MNC) and an MCC. When an eNodeB of a PLMN transmits UE capability streams to an external NE, the length of the UE capability streams can be controlled by the awUeCapTransLimit (Maximum Transmission Length of UE Capability Streams) parameter, avoiding a decoding failure on the receiver caused by too long UE capability streams transmitted by the eNodeB.
item.name: mcc

item.desc: This parameter sets the Mobile Network Code (MNC) of the eNodeB-level PLMN of the operator. A PLMN is jointly determined by a Mobile Network Code (MNC) and an MCC. When an eNodeB of a PLMN transmits UE capability streams to an external NE, the length of the UE capability streams can be controlled by the awUeCapTransLimit (Maximum Transmission Length of UE Capability Streams) parameter, avoiding a decoding failure on the receiver caused by too long UE capability streams transmitted by the eNodeB.

If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB inquires about the 5G capability information of UEs if it receives no 5G capability information from the UEs.

item.desc: Switch of load control algorithm in load management, which determine whether load control algorithm is valid or not.
item.name: lcSwch

item.desc: This switch determine whether output cell load log.
item.name: cellLoadLogSwitch

item.desc: Load control switch based on GBR compression, which determine whether the function is valid or not in load control algorithm
item.name: gbrCompressLCSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of frequencies used for configuring UE-specific cell reselection priorities during inter-frequency/inter-RAT camping load balancing.
item.name: clbFreqNum

item.desc: This parameter is used to judge load leveling of RAT neighbor cells in uplink. When the load value of a RAT neighbor cell in uplink exceeds this parameter, this cell can't be used as candidate target cell in uplink for RAT load balancing.
item.name: interNeighborLoadThrdUl

item.desc: This parameter is used to judge load leveling of RAT neighbor cells in Downlink. When the load value of a RAT neighbor cell in Downlink exceeds this parameter, this cell can't be used as candidate target cell in Downlink for RAT load balancing.
item.name: interNeighborLoadThrdDl

item.desc: This parameter is used to judge whether the cell is PRB overload or not in this direction.
item.name: prbDlovldThrd

item.desc: This parameter is used to judge whether the cell is PRB overload or not in this direction.
item.name: prbUlovldThrd

item.desc: This parameter is used to judge whether the cell is PRB recovery or not in this direction.
item.name: prbDlrecoveryThrd

item.desc: This parameter is used to judge whether the cell is PRB recovery or not in this direction.
item.name: prbUlrecoveryThrd

item.desc: The Number of service, which is selected to drop to reduce the load of present cell.
item.name: numDrpSvc

item.desc: This switch determine whether only voice user can be load off from EUTRAN to GREAN, Open stands for only voice user.
item.name: onlyVoiceUserSwch

item.desc: If the total GBR traffic doesn't exceed this parameter, the user can be load off from EUTRAN to GERAN.
item.name: greanGBRTrafThrd

item.desc: If the total GBR traffic doesn't exceed this parameter, the user can be load off from EUTRAN to UTRAN.
item.name: utranGBRTrafThrd

item.desc: Each element of array indicates this QCI type of traffic can be selected as candidate or not. The value 0 of array member means be forbidden. The value 1 of array member means be allowed. From the first array member, each denotes QCI = 1, QCI = 2, QCI = 3, QCI = 4.
item.name: lcTraffTypeInd

item.desc: This switch determine whether redirection based on load is valid or not.
item.name: redirectionSwch

item.desc: This switch determine whether HW Load is valid or not for camp Load Balance.
item.name: hwCLBSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates that the neighbor cell is not a candidate target cell for load balancing when its overlap coverage degree is less than the threshold.
item.name: lbOverlapCoverageThrd

item.desc: Switch based on RRC User Access for Load balancing, which determine whether load balancing algorithm is valid or not. Scheme of blind handover or scheme based on measurement of event can be selected.
item.name: ueAccessLBSwch

item.desc: Switch based on RRC User Access for Load balancing, which determine whether load balancing algorithm is valid or not. Scheme of blind handover or scheme based on measurement of event can be selected.
item.name: ueAccessLBExeThrd

item.desc: Switch based on RRC User Access for Load balancing, which determine whether load balancing algorithm is valid or not. Scheme of blind handover or scheme based on measurement of event can be selected.
item.name: ueAccessLBRelaThrd

item.desc: The parameter represents the eNB flow control allowed setup QCI list. If the parameter 'the switch for eNB flow control reject setup specified ERABs ' set to 'Open', the eNB shall only allowd setup dedicated ERABs according to the parameter.Value 0 presents an invalid QCI,value 1 corresponds to QCI1, 2 to QCI2, and so on.
item.name: enbFlowCtrlAllowQCI

item.desc: This parameter adjusts the PRB usage of NGBR services, so that load balancing can be triggered easily.
item.name: ngbrPRBFactor

item.desc: The parameter is A2 scheme switch for Ping-Pong. This switch determine whether A2 scheme for ping-pong between LB and HO is valid or not. Close stands for NOT valid, Open stands for valid.
item.name: pingPongA2Swch

item.desc: The parameter is A2 scheme timer for Ping-Pong. ucPingPongA2Offset is valid during this timer. The parameter is valid when ucPingPongA2Swch is open.
item.name: pingPongA2Tmr

item.desc: The parameter is A2 scheme offset for Ping-Pong. ucPingPongA2Offset is configured for UE which offload from other cell, preventing this user to handover to last visited cell again because of RSRP/RSRQ. The parameter is valid when ucPingPongA2Swch is open.
item.name: pingPongA2Offset

item.desc: For this parameter and Hardware hysteresis of CC board for the adjustment of AC barring parameter,once the CC hardware load is greater than the sum of two, the launch of the downward adjustment of ac-BarringFactor begins and contiues untill the CC hardwared load is less than or equal to this parameter, or the ac-BarringFactor reaches its low limit. While ,once the CC hardware load is lower than their difference,the launch of the upward adjustment of ac-BarringFactor begins and contiues untill the CC hardwared load is greater than or equal to this parameter,or the ac-BarringFactor reaches the upper limit of 1.
item.name: acbCpuThrsh

item.desc: For this parameter and Hardware trigger threshold of CC board for the adjustment of AC barring parameter,once the CC hardware load is greater than the sum of two, the launch of the downward adjustment of ac-BarringFactor begins and contiues untill the CC hardwared load is less than or equal to the later, or the ac-BarringFactor reaches its low limit. While ,once the CC hardware load is lower than their difference,the launch of the upward adjustment of ac-BarringFactor begins and contiues untill the CC hardwared load is greater than or equal to the later,or the ac-BarringFactor reaches the upper limit of 1.
item.name: acbCpuHys

item.desc: Hardware load estimation window of CC board for the adjustment of AC barring parameter.
item.name: acbCpuLoadWin

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the transferring of PDCCH CCE load information through the X2 interface. If it is set to Open, PDCCH CCE load information can be transferred through the X2 interface. If it is set to Close, PDCCH CCE load information cannot be transferred through the X2 interface.
item.name: x2TransPDCCHCCESwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the period of load exchange between the UTRAN system and the LTE system. It is a self-adaptive SON UL adjustment parameter.
item.name: utraLteLdExchPeriod

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables NSA UE load information exchanging on the X2 interface This parameter determines whether to exchange the information about the number of NSA UEs on the X2 interface. If it is set to Open, the information about the number of NSA UEs can be exchanged on the X2 interface. If it is set to Close, the information about the number of NSA UEs cannot be exchanged on the X2 interface.
item.name: x2TransNsaUeNumLoadSwch

item.desc: Upon detecting radio link problems, the UE shall start T310_UE. Upon receiving N311 _UE consecutive in-sync indications from lower layers, upon triggering the handover procedure and upon initiating the connection re-establishment procedure. If security is not activated: go to RRC_IDLE else: initiate the connection re-establishment procedure
item.name: t310_Ue

item.desc: The parameter indicates the time length for UE switch to idle upon initiating the RRC connection re-establishment procedure. Upon initiating the RRC connection re-establishment procedure, UE starts this timer. When selection of a suitable E-UTRA cell or a cell using another RAT, UE stops this timer. When timer is expired, UE switches to IDLE.
item.name: t311_Ue

item.desc: The parameter indicates Timer for UE to wait for RRC connection response. UE will start T300 after sending RRC CONNECTION REQUEST message. The T300 will be stopped before it expires if :1. UE received RRCConnectionSetup or RRCConnectionReject;2. cell re-selection occurred; 3. UE NAS layer terminated RRC connection establishment procedure;When T300 expires, UE will:1.reset MAC2.release the MAC configuration 3.re-establish RLC for all RBs that are established, and inform upper layers about the failure of establish the RRC connection.
item.name: t300

item.desc: The parameter indicates the time length for UE to wait for RRC connection request retry after reception of RRC connection reject. When UE receives RRC connection reject, UE will start Timer (T302). When T302 expires, UE will retry RRC connection request
item.name: t302

item.desc: The parameter indicates Timer for UE to wait for RRC connection re-establishment response. UE shall start T301 after RRCConnectionReestabilshmentRequest message is transmitted.When UE receives the RRCConnectionReestablishment or RRCConnectionReestablishmentReject message,UE shall stop this timer.When Timer is expired, UE switches to IDLE.
item.name: t301Fdd

item.desc: The parameter indicates Timer for UE to wait for RRC connection re-establishment response. UE shall start T301 after RRCConnectionReestabilshmentRequest message is transmitted.When UE receives the RRCConnectionReestablishment or RRCConnectionReestablishmentReject message,UE shall stop this timer.When Timer is expired, UE switches to IDLE.
item.name: t301Tdd

item.desc: During the intra LTE handover, when UE receives handover command, UE will start T304. If handover is successful, UE will stop T304. If T304 expired, UE will start T311 and perform re-establishment on the 'best cell'.
item.name: t304Fdd

item.desc: During the intra LTE handover, when UE receives handover command, UE will start T304. If handover is successful, UE will stop T304. If T304 expired, UE will start T311 and perform re-establishment on the 'best cell'.
item.name: t304Tdd

item.desc: During the handover from LTE to GERAN via CCO, when UE receives handover command, UE will start T304. If handover is successful, UE will stop T304. If T304 expired, UE will start T311 and perform re-establishment on the 'best cell'.
item.name: t304_Cco

item.desc: Upon receiving Cell re-selection priority expiry timer, UE will start T320. When T320 is running , the Cell re-selection priority provided by the idleModeMobilityControlInfo or inherited from another RAT is valid. When T320 expires, the Cell re-selection priority provided by the idleModeMobilityControlInfo or inherited from another RAT is invalid, ue should apply the cell reselection priority information broadcast in the system information. The parameter is the mobility parameter in idle.
item.name: t320

item.desc: The parameter indicates maximum number of consecutive out-of-sync indications received from lower layers.
item.name: n310

item.desc: The parameter indicates maximum number of consecutive in-sync indications received from lower layers.
item.name: n311

item.desc: This timer defines the interval during which UE is in inactivity state
item.name: tUserInac

item.desc: This parameter indicates User-inactivity timer for Mobile.
item.name: tUserInacforMobile

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for delaying the release of voice calls. It is used to delay the transition of the calling party and the called party to Idle state during a voice call or on-hook procedure. It is started when a voice call is initiated. When a voice call is hung up, this timer is also started if the GlobalVolteLTE. DelayUserInacSwch parameter is set to Open. After the timer expires, the calling party and the called party enter the User Inactive decision procedure.
item.name: tUserInacVoLTE

item.desc: Upon receiving a cell reselection priority message, the UE starts T320. When T320 is running, the cell reselection priority carried in the dedicated message is valid. When T320 expires, the cell reselection priority carried in the dedicated message is invalid. This parameter is a mobility control parameter for the UEs in Idle state.
item.name: endcAnchorImmciT320

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for dedicated reselection of an SA UE. Upon receiving a cell reselection priority message, the UE starts T320. When T320 is running, the cell reselection priority carried in the dedicated message is valid. When T320 expires, the cell reselection priority carried in the dedicated message is invalid. This parameter is a mobility control parameter for the UEs in idle state.
item.name: sADirectIMMCIT320

item.desc: This parameter is used to configure the User-inactivity timer duration of the special QCI terminal. For the terminal identified through the Identify QCI for Special Terminal parameter, this parameter is valid. The parameter value indicates the timer duration. If there is no data within this duration, the base station will initiate UE context release. The default duration is 5 s, while 16777215 indicates infinity (over 30 days).
item.name: tUserInacForSpecUe

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration (in minutes) of the timer T320 for the UEs that do not support VoNR. It is used to indicate the period of validity of the IMMCI delivered when the IMMCI function based on the UEs that do not support VoNR is enabled. During the operation of this timer, the UE performs cell reselection based on the dedicated-reselection priority delivered by the eNodeB. After the timer expires, the UE performs cell reselection based on the frequency priority carried in the broadcast message. If this parameter is set to 255, the timer will never expire.
item.name: nonSptVoNRIMMCIT320

item.desc: This timer will be started after eNB sends Initial UE message to the core network, it will be stopped if initial context setup message or DL direct message is received, else, an abnormal processing will be triggered.
item.name: initialUETimer

item.desc: This timer will be started after eNB sends path switch request to the core network, it will be stopped if path switch response message is received, and else, an abnormal processing will be triggered.
item.name: pathSwitchTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets a timer to wait for RRC connection completion of ordinary UEs. This timer is started when the eNodeB sends an RRC Connection Reconfiguration message to a UE. It is stopped when the eNodeB receives an RRC Connection Reconfiguration Complete message or an RRC Connection Re-establishment message from the UE. When the timer expires, the eNodeB releases the UE.
item.name: rrcReCfgTimer

item.desc: This timer will be started after eNB sends RRC connection re-establish message to UE; it will be stopped if RRC connections re-establish message is received, if Timer is expired, an abnormal processing will be triggered.
item.name: rrcReEstTimer

item.desc: This timer will be started after eNB sends RRC connection setup message to UE, it will be stopped if RRC connection setup complete message is received, and else, an abnormal processing will be triggered.
item.name: rrcSetupTimer

item.desc: This timer will be started after eNB sends RRC connection release message to UE in order to ensure RRC connection release message is successfully sent to UE, the local instance of eNB will not be released until Timer is expired.
item.name: rrcConnRelTimer

item.desc: This timer will be started after the source of hand over sends hand over required message to the core network when hand over starts on S1, it will be stopped if hand over message from the core network is received, else, an abnormal processing will be triggered.
item.name: s1HoPrepareTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets a timer to wait for a release command from the MME during an S1-based handover of an ordinary UE. During the S1-based handover, this timer is started after the source eNodeB receives a handover command from the core network. The timer is stopped when the eNodeB receives a release command from the core network. If the eNodeB receives no release command from the core network when the timer expires, it indicates that the handover fails.
item.name: s1HoOverAllTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for S1 release requests. After the eNodeB sends a UE Context Release Request message to the core network, the timer is started. After a UE Context Release message is received from the core network, this timer is stopped. If this timer has expired, the UE instance is released.
item.name: ueCtxRelReqTimer

item.desc: This timer will be started after the source of hand over sends hand over request message to the destination when hand over starts on X2, it will be stopped if hand over message from the destination is received, if Timer is expired, an abnormal processing will be triggered.
item.name: x2HoPrePareTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets a timer to wait for a release message during an X2-based handover of an ordinary UE. During the X2-based handover, this timer is started after the source eNodeB receives a Handover Request Acknowledge message. The timer is stopped when the eNodeB receives a release message from the target side. If the eNodeB receives no context release message from the target side when the timer expires, it indicates that the handover fails.
item.name: x2HoRelTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for the response to UE capability enquiry. After sending a UE capability enquiry message to a UE, the eNodeB starts this timer. When receiving a UE capability response message from the UE, the eNodeB stops this timer. If the timer expires, the exception handling procedure is triggered and the UE is released.
item.name: ueCapaTimer

item.desc: If an abnormal processing is triggered in eNB when UE context is initialing, this timer will be started after eNB sends initial UE context failure message to the core network, it will be stopped when release UE context message from the core network is received, if this timer is expired, eNB will release the UE.
item.name: ueSetupFailTimer

item.desc: This timer will be started after eNB sends MobilityFromEUTRACommand message to UE when CCO is triggered, it will be stopped when release message or RRC connection re-establish message from the core network is received, if this timer is expired, eNB will release the instance of UE.
item.name: ccoRelTimer

item.desc: The parameter is used to wait for initial report message in RIM procedure
item.name: rimInitRptTmr

item.desc: This parameter indicates the duration for resending requests after the peer cell expires in the RIM procedure.
item.name: rimResndReqTmr

item.desc: The parameter is used to wait for resending request message after END indication message is received in RIM procedure.
item.name: rimEndResndTmr

item.desc: The parameter is used to wait for stop acknowledge message in RIM procedure.
item.name: rimStopAckTmr

item.desc: In CSFB scene, Timer is opened when eNB sends the measurement Configuration and is closed when measurement report is received.
item.name: csfbMeasTimer

item.desc: The parameter is Timer which is used to wait for ANR reports from UEs. When it expires,the base station check if PCI conflict or confusion exists from the information.
item.name: anrReportTimer

item.desc: The timer starts when the UPLINK S1 CDMA2000 TUNNELING message(RAT: 1XRTT, CDMA2000 HO Required Indication=true) is sent ,and closes When the DOWNLINK S1 CDMA2000 TUNNELING message(RAT: 1XRTT, CDMA2000 HO Status IE included) is received.
item.name: cdmaHoPrepareTimer

item.desc: The parameter is Ping-Pong timer. The parameter indicates the penalty timer used for preventing repeated handover. When a UE is handover from cell A to cell B , the preventing repeated handover Timer will be started in cell B, If Timer does not expired, it is not allowed to handover back to the cell A. The parameter is valid when switch for Ping-Pong is open.
item.name: pingPongTmr

item.desc: This parameter is the timer in which Handover target eNB needs to store UE context, the UE waits for the re-establishment of the RRC message in order to detect the handover fault.
item.name: storeUEcntxtTimer

item.desc: This parameter is the Handover punish timer .If eNodeb receive S1 or X2 Handover prepare failure with cause of No Radio Resources Available in Target Cell,then eNodeb can't handover to this target cell within Handover punish Time.
item.name: handOverPunishTmr

item.desc: This parameter indicates the timer for waiting iCS DCE RNC CELL STATUS IND.
item.name: waitDCEstatusIndTmr

item.desc: If the value of ucUEAccessLBSwch in LoadManagement equals 2, When RRC Access Load balancing is applied, eNodeB will start this timer. When this timer times out, eNodeB will try to delete the A4.
item.name: rrcAccessLBMeasTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the cell-level service-based measurement waiting timer. After delivering a service-based inter-frequency handover measurement configuration, the eNodeB starts this timer and waits for a measurement report. Before this timer expires, the eNodeB attempts to trigger a handover to the target frequency if it receives the measurement report. After this timer expires, the eNodeB redirects the UE to the target frequency if the hoBaseServiceMeasExpiRedSwch parameter is set to Open. Otherwise, the delivered service-based handover measurement configuration is deleted. The parameter value 65535 indicates that the timer duration is infinite, that is, the eNodeB does not redirect any UE to the target frequency or delete the delivered service-based handover measurement configuration.
item.name: measTimerBasedService

item.desc: The parameter indicates the Intra-RAT Ping-Pong last prevent timer, when the CIO adjustment to achieve the maximum number of times, if continue to occur Intra-RAT Ping-Pong within the test time, eNB need to recover the CIO and start this timer to prevent the handover for Ping-Pong cell.
item.name: intraRATPiPoLaPrTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for handover based on ECGI-based measurement. This timer is started when the eNodeB initiates a handover to a specified neighbor cell based on ECGI-based measurement. If the eNodeB receives a report of the ECGI-based measurement during the operation of the timer, the handover is performed properly. When the timer expires, the eNodeB executes a measurement-based redirection procedure if the eNodeB is configured with redirection execution.
item.name: waitECGITimer

item.desc: This parameter is the timer of Event Measurement for CA SelfConfiguration. Upon event measurement for Overlap calculation configurate, eNodeb will start this timer. If it time out, eNodeb will delete all event measurement.
item.name: eventMeTim4CASelfCfg

item.desc: This parameter is the timer of eMBMS mobility measurement. When the eNodeB delivers the eMBMS mobility measurement configuration, the timer is started. When the UE reports an eMBMS measurement report, the timer is stopped. When the timer expires, the eNodeB deletes the delivered eMBMS mobility measurement configuration.
item.name: measTimerBasedeMBMS

item.desc: This parameter is the timer for PSCell addition punishment. If the eNodeB receives an X2 SgNB Addition Reject message, it cannot add the target NR cell as a PSCell within the time specified by this timer.
item.name: pSCellAddPunishTmr

item.desc: This parameter sets the period from the time when the eNodeB sends an E-RAB modification indication message to the time when the eNodeB receives a modification acknowledgment message. If no response is received after the timer times out, the eNodeB performs a fault handling procedure.
item.name: erabModConfirmTimer

item.desc: This parameter indicates the timer for waiting the measurement report after a user location-based migration measurement configuration is delivered. If the user fails to be handed over after the timer expires, the eNodeB deletes the user location-based migration measurement.
item.name: migBaseUEPosiMeasTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer that is used to delete the measurement A4 for SCell addition for the fixed terminals that do not move when there is no coverage. When the measurement A4 for SCell addition is delivered, the timer starts. When the timer expires, the remaining measurement A4 is deleted.
item.name: caNoCovDelMeaTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets a timer to wait for an Addition ACK, Modification ACK, and Release ACK message from the SN in the SN addition, SN modification, and SN release procedures respectively. If no response is received before the timer expires, it indicates that an error occurs in the corresponding procedure. The timer is used in NSA scenarios to monitor the time and status of message processing between LTE and NR sites.
item.name: dCPrepTimer

item.desc: After sending a UE capability request message to an eMTC UE, the eNodeB starts this timer. When receiving a UE capability response message from the eMTC UE, the eNodeB stops this timer. If the timer expires, the exception handling procedure is triggered.
item.name: emtcUeCapaTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for waiting the measurement report after a measurement configuration for EN-DC anchor-based handover is sent. If the measurement report fails to be received after the timer expires, the eNodeB deletes the measurement configuration for EN-DC anchor-based handover.
item.name: measTimer4EnDcAnchor

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for waiting for the measurement report after a B1 measurement configuration for EN-DC SN addition is sent. If the measurement report fails to be received after the timer expires, the eNodeB deletes the measurement configuration for EN-DC SN addition.
item.name: enDcSnAddMeasTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the ping-pong handover penalty timer for SRVCC. If the number of times that an SRVCC handover fails within the detection duration reaches the upper limit, this timer needs to be started to disable SRVCC handover. Note: If this parameter is set to 65535, the penalty timer is infinity.
item.name: sRVCCPingPongPunishTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the period before a UE fast returns to the 5G cell after its measurement-based EPS fallback service ends in the 4G cell. Before the timer times out, the eNodeB provides only the measurement configuration for fast return for the UE to prevent the UE from triggering other actions when other measurement configuration conditions are met, so that the UE can fast return to the 5G cell. This timer is started when the UE hangs up a call in the 4G cell. This timer is stopped when the UE sends a measurement report for fast return. After the timer times out, the eNodeB deletes the measurement configuration for fast return of the UE.
item.name: epsFBEndFRMeasTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the delay start timer of the directional migration of SA UEs relative to EN-DC anchoring. If the Hybrid-Mode NSA and SA User Strategy Configuration parameter is set to SA Priority, the eNodeB preferentially triggers directional migration of SA UEs. EN-DC anchoring is started after the period specified by this parameter.
item.name: nSA4SADelayTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the delay start timer for CA anchoring relative to EN-DC anchoring. For NSA UEs, the eNodeB preferentially triggers EN-DC anchoring and CA anchoring is started after the period of time specified by this parameter.
item.name: cA4ENDCAnchorDelayTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the delay start timer for CA anchoring relative to SN addition. For NSA UEs, the eNodeB preferentially triggers SN addition and CA anchoring is started after the period of time specified by this parameter.
item.name: cA4SNAddDelayTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for waiting for the measurement report after a directional migration measurement configuration is sent to an SA UE. If the user fails to be migrated after the timer expires, the eNodeB deletes the directional migration measurement.
item.name: sADirectMigMeasTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for waiting the measurement report after a measurement configuration for voice quality-based handover is sent. If the UE fails to be handed over after the timer expires, the eNodeB deletes the measurement configuration or attempts to perform a redirection operation.
item.name: voLTEQualHOMeasTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the measurement timer for monitoring the NR coverage related to the local cell in an EN-DC anchor-based handover.
item.name: endcAnchHoMonNRCovTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the punishment timer for handover failures caused by the barring of incoming handover to the target cell when the punishment of handover failures caused by the barring of incoming handover to the target cell is enabled.
item.name: cellBarHoFailPunishTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for reverse data transmission during an NR-to-LTE handover. It is used to ensure that UE data can be reversely transmitted from the source side to the destination side when a UE is handed over from an NR cell to an LTE cell. During the handover of a UE from an NR cell to an LTE cell, the timer is started on the destination side when the handover procedure starts to be executed. In the subsequent handover procedure, the destination side receives the data reversely transmitted from the source side. When the destination side receives an End Maker indication from the user plane, this timer is stopped. The eNodeB does not process the subsequent messages until the timer is stopped or expires.
item.name: ntoLHoDataGuardTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for retrying SCell addition in a CA scenario. It is used for the eNodeB to add SCells for UEs based on user perception of uplink services. This timer is started when the eNodeB completes SCell configuration for a UE with uplink services based on the estimation of user perception. When the timer expires, the eNodeB re-evaluates and reconfigures SCells for the UE based on the user perception of uplink services. If this parameter is set to 3600, the retry mechanism does not take effect.
item.name: caSCellAddRetryTimer

item.desc: The parameter is the number of ARP segment. By The parameter, eNB can map ARP and QCI to other priority
item.name: arpSegNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the thresholds for ARP segmentation. It is an array parameter consisting of N (N is the value of the arpSegNum (ARP Segment Number) parameter minus 1) elements. The first element indicates the critical value for the UEs with the first and second priorities; the second element represents the critical value for the UEs with the second and third priorities; the third element represents the critical value for the UEs with the third and fourth priorities; and so on. If the ARP value of a service is smaller than the threshold corresponding to an element, the ARP segment of the service belongs to a segment with a higher priority. ARP segmentation can map bearers to different basic priorities.
item.name: arpThresh

item.desc: The number of GBR service PDB segment, For GBR bearer, the PDB is segmented according to ucGBRDelaySegNum and awGBRDelayTh.

item.desc: This parameter sets the delay thresholds for GBR services. It is an array parameter consisting of N (N is the value of the gbrDelaySegNum (The Number of Threshold for GBR Traffic Delay) parameter minus 1) elements. The first element indicates the critical value for the delay segments with the first and second priorities; the second element represents the critical value for the delay segments with the second and third priorities; the third element represents the critical value for the delay segments with the third and fourth priorities; and so on. If the delay of a GBR service is shorter than the threshold corresponding to an element, the delay segment of the GBR service belongs to a segment with a higher priority. GBR service delay segmentation can map bearers to different basic priorities.
item.name: gbrDelayTh

item.desc: The number of NGBR service PDB's segment, The number of NGBR service PDB segment, For NGBR bearer, the PDB is segmented according to ucNGBRDelaySegNum and awNGBRDelayTh.
item.name: ngbrDelaySegNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the delay thresholds for NGBR services. It is an array parameter consisting of N (N is the value of the ngbrDelaySegNum (The Segment Number of Threshold for NGBR Service Delay) parameter minus 1) elements. The first element indicates the critical value for the delay segments with the first and second priorities; the second element represents the critical value for the delay segments with the second and third priorities; the third element represents the critical value for the delay segments with the third and fourth priorities; and so on. If the delay of a NGBR service is shorter than the threshold corresponding to an element, the delay segment of the NGBR service belongs to a segment with a higher priority. NGBR service delay segmentation can map bearers to different basic priorities.
item.name: ngbrDelayTh

item.desc: This parameter sets blacklisted IP addresses. It is an array parameter consisting of 20 elements. Each element indicates the IP address of a server. The eNodeB strategically discards the packets of the uplink services on the servers corresponding to the IP addresses specified by this array parameter.
item.name: blackListIP

item.desc: This parameter sets the mask of the blacklisted IP addresses that are used to identify IP addresses. During the identification of an IP address, this parameter can be used to determine the correlation between the IP address and the blacklisted IP addresses specified by blackListIP (IP Blacklist) array parameter.
item.name: blackListMask

item.desc: This parameter indicates the ratio of saved RB resources for Type1 allocation.
item.name: type1RBSaveRatioDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the scheduling weight of a VIP user. It can be used for calculating the priority of the same EMLP.
item.name: fFVIP

From the first member of the one-dimensional array, each member respectively denotes the corresponding EMLP index in the following sequence: QCI1, QCI2, QCI3, QCI4, QCI5, QCI6, QCI7, QCI8, and QCI9. The value of each integer array member ranges from 1 to 16.
item.name: qCIeMLP4VIP

item.desc: This parameter sets the ratio of uplink PDCCH for FDD.
item.name: pDCCHUsedRatioFDDUl

item.desc: The parameter sets the downlink PDCCH usage ratio in non-simultaneous subframes. It indicates the downlink PDCCH usage ratio in the subframes of downlink transmission.
item.name: pdcchUsedRatioNonSimulDl

item.desc: The parameter sets the downlink PDCCH usage ratio for TDD.
item.name: pDCCHUsedRatioTDDDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink PDCCH usage ratio for TDD.
item.name: pDCCHUsedRatioTDDUl

item.desc: This parameter sets the ratio of downlink PDCCH for FDD.
item.name: pDCCHUsedRatioFDDDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the SINR threshold for delayed scheduling of uplink small packets. This parameter is used to control the range of UEs for which delayed scheduling of uplink small packets can be performed.
item.name: sINR4SmallPacketAccumUl

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of delayed scheduling of uplink small packets. If the switch is turned on, uplink small packets will be delayed to be scheduled.
item.name: smallPackAccumSwch4Ul

item.desc: This parameter sets the ARP values of emergency calls. It can be configured by the operator. It is used for the eNodeB to determine which bearers are used for emergency calls. If the ARP value of the service established by a UE matches either of the elements of this array parameter, it indicates that the service is an emergency call. This parameter is an array consisting of two elements. A bearer is used for emergency calls as long as the value of either of the array element is the same as the ARP value of the bearer.
item.name: arpCfgforEMC

item.desc: This parameter indicates the ratio of PDCCH power sharing. The actually available shared PDCCH power is calculated based on the shared RRU power obtained from the CCM multiplied by this parameter. The shared PDCCH power (in dB) is transmitted to the baseband.
item.name: pdcchDeltaPowerRadio

item.desc: This parameter sets the prefix length of an IPv6 address on the blacklist. If the IP address of the server matches this IP address and meets the IPv6 prefix length requirement, the packets of the concerned service are discarded according to the rules configured by the IP blacklist.
item.name: blackListIpv6PrefixLen

item.desc: This parameter sets the type of the blacklisted packets to be discarded. The packets whose IP addresses are on the blacklist are discarded by discard type.
item.name: blackListDiscardIpMode

item.desc: This parameter sets the ratio of the blacklisted packets to be discarded. The packets whose IP addresses are on the blacklist are randomly discarded by this ratio. For example, if this parameter is set to x, one packet out of x packets is discarded.
item.name: blackListDiscardRate

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum length of the blacklisted packet to be discarded. The packets whose IP addresses are on the blacklist are discarded by packet length.
item.name: blackListDiscardPktMinLen

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum length of the blacklisted packet to be discarded. The packets whose IP addresses are on the blacklist are discarded by packet length.
item.name: blackListDiscardPktMaxLen

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables pre-scheduling and determines the target users of pre-scheduling. Where, 0: disables pre-scheduling for all the users. 1: enables pre-scheduling only for SPID users. 2: enables pre-scheduling for all the users.
item.name: preSchd4SPID

item.desc: This parameter indicates that when the extended QCI of the NGBR is not configured on the UME, the extended QCI will be processed according to the configured standard QCI.
item.name: extQCIMapOfNGBR

item.desc: This parameter indicates that when the extended QCI of the GBR bearer is not configured on the UME, the extended QCI will be processed according to the configured standard QCI.
item.name: extQCIMapOfGBR

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables smart optimization pre-scheduling. It is used to control the pre-scheduling of the Type6 UEs with the general QoS. If this parameter is set to Open, the user perception can be improved. If it is set to Close, it does not work on the user perception.
item.name: preScheSwitch4SMT

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval of smart optimization pre-scheduling. It determines how often a Type6 UE with the general QoS is scheduled. If this parameter is set to a smaller value, the requirements of this type of UE can be met in a more timely manner. If it is not necessary to meet the requirements of this type of UE immediately, this parameter can be set to a larger value.
item.name: preScheIntval4SMT

item.desc: This parameter sets the size of smart optimization pre-scheduling. It is used to control the size of BSR resources configured for the pre-scheduling of the Type6 UEs with the general QoS. If it is not necessary to allocate more virtual BSR resources to this type of UE, this parameter is set to a smaller value. If it is necessary to allocate more virtual BSR resources to this type of UE, this parameter is set to a larger value. In this case, however, less BSR resources can be allocated to the UEs of other types.
item.name: preScheBSR4SMT

item.desc: This parameters enables or disables DRX offloading optimization. To enable DRX offloading optimization, set this parameter to 1 or 2.0 indicates that DRX offloading optimization is disabled.It does not bring any impact on the system. 1 indicates that the virtual BSR configured for DRX offloading optimization is a special type of BSR. This function is restricted by the number of UEs in RRC-connected state. After this function is enabled, if the number of UEs in RRC-connected state does not exceed the threshold, DRX offloading optimization is implemented. The gNodeB sends a DCI0 to a cell that is about to enter sleeping state and makes UEs send UL data, so that the UEs do not enter sleeping state. (1) It increase UL scheduling opportunities, thus improving the PDCCH utilization, UL AMC convergence accuracy, and neighbor cell NI. (2) It reduces the time during which UEs are in DRX sleeping state, thus increasing the power consumption of UEs. (3) It may increase the number of active UEs in the cell. 2 indicates that the virtual BSR configured for DRX offloading optimization is a real type of BSR. This function is not restricted by the number of UEs in RRC-connected state. After this function is enabled, the gNodeB sends a DCI0 to a cell that is about to enter sleeping state and makes UEs send UL data, so that the UEs do not enter sleeping state. (1) It increase UL scheduling opportunities, thus improving the PDCCH utilization, UL AMC convergence accuracy, and neighbor cell NI. (2) It reduces the time during which UEs are in DRX sleeping state, thus increasing the power consumption of UEs. (3) It may increase the number of active UEs in the cell.
item.name: preScheSwitch4DRX

item.desc: This parameter sets the byte size of the virtual BSR set for DRX offloading optimization. To make UEs report a packet of PUSCH data, set this parameter to 9. If there are special requirements and more resources need to be allocated to UEs, you can set this parameter to a greater value.
item.name: preScheBSR4DRX

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables counter check reporting. It is used to control whether the eNodeB reports count value differences to the EMS. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB reports count value differences to the EMS, informing whether there are external packet attacks. If it is set to Close, the notifications of count value differences are not reported.
item.name: counterCheckRptSwch

item.desc: Both packet attack and network delay cause the difference between count values. This parameter sets the threshold for the counter check function to report the count value differences to the EMS. If the network delay is longer, a higher threshold can prevent the difference between the count values that are falsely reported. If the network delay is shorter, a lower threshold can prevent packet attacks from not being reporting.
item.name: counterCheckRptThrd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables service continuity enhancement. If this parameter is set to Open, QoS guarantee can be performed for the UEs that move fast in the network, thus improving the user experience.
item.name: serviceContinuitySwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of cells for service continuity identification. This parameter takes effect if the serviceContinuitySwch parameter is set to Open. If a UE moves fast and the number of times that the cell to which the UE belongs is changed is larger than or equal to the threshold, QoS guarantee is implemented for the UE to improve user experience.
item.name: serviceContinuityThresh

item.desc: This parameter sets the general-QoS type for service continuity. The values 1 through 5 correspond to general-QoS type 1 through general-QoS type 5. If the serviceContinuitySwch (Service Continuity Enhancement) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the number of times that the cells where a UE camps on change is larger than or equal to the value specified by the serviceContinuityThresh (Threshold of Service Continuity Identification) parameter, the eNodeB guarantees the continuity of the services of the general-QoS types configured by this parameter for the UE to improve user experience.
item.name: serviceContinuityQoSType

item.desc: This parameter sets the general-QoS types of the UEs that have SPIDs and whose QoS services need to be guaranteed. A maximum of ten elements can be configured. The elements of this array parameter correspond to those of the SPIDs for Service Guarantee array parameter in turn. The element values range from 1 to 5, indicating that the eNodeB guarantees the general-QoS services of type1 through type5 for the UEs with the corresponding SPIDs to improve the user experience of the UEs.
item.name: spidGuarantQosTypeList

item.desc: This parameter sets the SPIDs of the UEs whose services need to be guaranteed. A maximum of ten SPIDs can be configured. This parameter is valid if the Switch of SPID-Based Service Guarantee parameter is set to 1 (Open). If the SPID of a UE is in the list, the services of the UE are guaranteed to improve the user perception of the UE.
item.name: spidGuarantList

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to guarantee the services of UEs based on SPIDs. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), QoS guarantee can be performed for the UEs with SPIDs to improve the user experience.
item.name: spidServGuarantSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval of simplified pre-scheduling. It determines how often a UE with simplified pre-scheduling guaranteed is scheduled.
item.name: simplifyPreschdInterval

item.desc: This parameter sets the mode of simplified pre-scheduling. It is used to either disable simplified pre-scheduling or enable simplified pre-scheduling and set the BSR type for pre-scheduling. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close Preschedule), simplified pre-scheduling is not performed for a guaranteed UE. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open Preschedule and Take BSR as Special BSR), simplified pre-scheduling is performed for a guaranteed UE and the corresponding BSR is distinguished from a real BSR. If this parameter to 2 (Open Preschedule and Take BSR as Real BSR), simplified pre-scheduling is performed for a guaranteed UE and the corresponding BSR is used as a real BSR.
item.name: simplifyPreschdMode

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum guaranteed number of simplified pre-scheduling operations. The actual value is the parameter value multiplied by 10. (For example, if this parameter is set to 1, the actually guaranteed number of simplified pre-scheduling operations is 10. ) If this parameter is set to 255, the guaranteed number of simplified pre-scheduling operations is not limited.
item.name: simplifyPreschdMaxTimes

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of UEs with simplified pre-scheduling guaranteed.
item.name: simplifyPreschdMaxUeNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the size of the virtual BSRs configured for UEs with simplified pre-scheduling guaranteed.
item.name: simplifyPreschdBsr

item.desc: This parameter is an array with seven elements and used to set the types of type-based pre-scheduling. It is used for ITRAN NEs only. If an element is set to 1, it indicates that the type of the corresponding type-based pre-scheduling is TYPE1; if an element is set to 2, it indicates that the type of the corresponding type-based pre-scheduling is TYPE2; if an element is set to 3, it indicates that the type of the corresponding type-based pre-scheduling is TYPE3, and so on. In the current version, the type-based pre-scheduling function is valid for TYPE1 to TYPE7 only.
item.name: typeIdx

item.desc: This parameter sets the type-based pre-scheduling modes. It is an array consisting of seven elements. Elements 1 through 7 indicate the pre-scheduling modes of type1 to type7 in turn. If an element is set to 0 (Close Preschedule), the pre-scheduling of the corresponding type is disabled. If an element is set to 1 (Open Preschedule and Take BSR as Special BSR), the pre-scheduling of the corresponding type is enabled, and the corresponding virtual BSR is used as a special BSR. If a UE of the corresponding type needs to use the pre-scheduling function, the pre-scheduling priority is configurable. This option is used in high-load scenarios. If an element is set to 2 (Open Preschedule and Take BSR as Real BSR), the pre-scheduling of the corresponding type is enabled, and the corresponding virtual BSR is used as a real BSR. If a UE of the corresponding type needs to use the pre-scheduling function, the pre-scheduling priority is the same as that of the real services. This option is used in high-load scenarios.
item.name: preScheduleMode4Type

item.desc: This parameter indicates how to merge the configured BSRs and the remaining BSRs of the UE when the pre-scheduling of a type is triggered. 0:{Max}: For the configured BSRs and the remaining BSRs, the larger one is used. 1:{Sum}: The result of the configured BSRs plus the remaining BSRs is used.
item.name: preScheBSRMerge4Type

If the packet scheduling delay of a UE is shorter than or equal to this threshold, the packets are scheduled with a delay. If the packet scheduling delay of a UE is longer than this threshold, the packets are scheduled immediately. If this parameter is set to -1, the configuration does not take effect.

item.desc: This parameter sets the QCI corresponding to a service type. The eNodeB can detect service QoS parameters and application parameters through QCIs. The standard QoS Classification Identifiers (QCIs) represent QoS attributes, such as packet scheduling, the delay, and the packet loss rate. The transmission of standard QCI parameters among different NEs in an EPS helps the interconnection of the equipment from different vendors and flexible configuration by operators.
item.name: qCI

item.desc: This parameter sets the packet QoS delay (in ms) that is defined by the 3GPP TS23 protocols. It is used only for reference and cannot be modified.
item.name: srvPacketDelay

item.desc: This parameter sets the QoS Packet Loss Rate (PLR); that is the upper limit of the SDU PLR if there is no network congestion. It reflects the performance of correct transmission on the sender and correct demodulation and receiving on the receiver.
item.name: srvPacketLoss

item.desc: This parameter sets the name of a service type. It corresponds to the QCI of the example service.
item.name: srvClassName

item.desc: This parameter sets the service priority. Each QCI (for GBR and non-GBR bearers) is associated with a priority level. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. A priority can be used to differentiate SDF aggregates of the same UE or different UEs based on the QCI and SDF aggregates associated with the priority and PDB.
item.name: srvPrior

item.desc: This parameter sets the type of service bearer (including GBR bearers and non-GBR bearers) corresponding to a QCI.
item.name: srvBearerType

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval for periodically sending PHRs. When the timer expires, a PHR is sent.
item.name: prdPhrTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval for prohibiting PHR sending. When the prohibitPHR-Timer timer expires, and the change in the path loss is more than dl-PathlossChange (in dB) since the last sending of a PHR when there are uplink resources available for a UE for a new transmission, a PHR is sent.
item.name: phtPhrTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink path loss change threshold for PHR sending. When the prohibitPHR-Timer timer expires, and the change in the path loss is more than dl-PathlossChange (in dB) since the last sending of a PHR when there are uplink resources available for a UE for a new transmission, a PHR is sent.
item.name: dlPathlossChgTh

item.desc: This parameter sets the RLC bearer type: Acknowledged Mode (AM) and Unacknowledged Mode (UM).
item.name: rlcMode

item.desc: This parameter indicates the service QCI factor for priority calculation of QoS sorting.
item.name: factorForQCI
