item.desc: This parameter sets the application IDs of bearers. It is used to configure the parameters of different bearers. An odd value corresponds to a downlink application, and an even value corresponds to an uplink application. The values 0 to 31 are used for SRB signaling applications and correspond to QCInone. The values 32 to 127 are used for other signaling applications (for example, SIP) and correspond to QCI5. The values 128 to 1023 are used for GBR applications. The values 1024 to 3071 are used for NGBR applications. The values 3072 to 4095 are used for extended applications to meet the customized requirements of operators. Other values are reserved. The mapping relations between the typical values and the bearer applications are as follows:0: uplink SRB signaling applications;1: downlink SRB signaling applications;32: uplink bearer applications of QCI5 and QCI69 services. 33: downlink bearer applications of QCI5 and QCI69 services. 130: uplink GBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate lower than or equal to 28 kBps;131: downlink GBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate lower than or equal to 28 kBps;132: uplink GBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate lower than or equal to 40 kBps;133: downlink GBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate lower than or equal to 40 kBps;134: uplink GBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate lower than or equal to 17 kBps;135: downlink GBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate lower than or equal to 17 kBps;136: uplink GBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate lower than or equal to 39 kBps;137: downlink GBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate lower than or equal to 39 kBps;138: uplink GBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate lower than or equal to 18 kBps;139: downlink GBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate lower than or equal to 18 kBps;146: uplink GBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate lower than or equal to 1250 kBps;147: downlink GBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate lower than or equal to 1250 kBps;148: uplink GBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate lower than or equal to 12500 kBps;149: downlink GBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate lower than or equal to 12500 kBps;150: uplink GBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate higher than 12500 kBps;151: downlink GBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate higher than 12500 kBps;1024: uplink NGBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate lower than or equal to 1250 kBps;1025: downlink NGBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate lower than or equal to 1250 kBps;1026: uplink NGBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate lower than or equal to 12500 kBps;1027: downlink NGBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate lower than or equal to 12500 kBps;1028: uplink NGBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate lower than or equal to 125000 kBps;1029: downlink NGBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate lower than or equal to 125000 kBps;1030: uplink NGBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate higher than 125000 kBps;1031: downlink NGBR applications, corresponding to the services with the rate higher than 125000 kBps.

If the services of a UE satisfy the requirements corresponding to the index, the UE can be identified to support a certain function. For example, an SN can be added for the UE.
item.name: pdcpStatusIdentifyIndex

item.desc: This parameter sets the QCI corresponding to a service type. It is configured in the UME system. It can be used find the corresponding QoS parameter based on the QCI information in the SAE setup message. A standard QoS Classification Identifier (QCI) indicates QoS attributes, such as packet scheduling, the processing delay, and the packet loss rate. The transmission of standard QCI parameters among different NEs on an EPS helps the interconnection of the equipment from different vendors and the flexible configuration by operators.
item.name: qCI

item.desc: This parameter sets the upper threshold of the downlink traffic speed of UEs to add SNs based on the speed. If the speed-based SN addition is enabled and the downlink speed of a UE is higher than the parameter value, the eNodeB considers the UE as a downlink high-speed UE.
item.name: dlTrafficSpeedHighThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the upper threshold of the uplink traffic speed of UEs to add SNs based on the speed. If speed-based SN addition is enabled and the uplink speed of a UE is higher than the parameter value, the eNodeB considers the UE as an uplink high-speed UE.
item.name: ulTrafficSpeedHighThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the lower threshold of the uplink speed of a UE and is used for speed-based SN addition. If speed-based SN addition is enabled and the uplink speed of a UE is lower than this threshold, the eNodeB identifies the UE as an uplink low-speed UE.
item.name: ulTrafficSpeedLowThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the lower threshold of the downlink speed of a UE and is used for speed-based SN addition. If speed-based SN addition is enabled and the downlink speed of a UE is lower than this threshold, the eNodeB identifies the UE as a downlink low-speed UE.
item.name: dlTrafficSpeedLowThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times that the speed of a UE configured with speed-based SN addition is consecutively detected to be high. The detection is performed once in every determination period. When speed-based SN addition is enabled, the eNodeB uses this parameter to detect whether the speed of a UE is high in the uplink and downlink. If the number of times that the speed of a UE configured with speed-based SN addition is consecutively detected to be high reaches the parameter value, the eNodeB sends a high-load indication to the control plane, delivers a B1 measurement result, and triggers the SN addition procedure.
item.name: highTrafficSpeedDesTime

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times that the speed of a UE configured with speed-based SN addition is consecutively detected to be low. The detection is performed once in every determination period. If speed-based SN addition is enabled, the eNodeB uses this parameter to detect whether the speed of a UE is low in the uplink and downlink. After a UE is consecutively determined as a low-speed UE, its low-speed status is reported to the upper layer, and the SN addition procedure is not triggered later.
item.name: lowTrafficSpeedDesTime

item.desc: This parameter sets the PDCP delay threshold for determining whether congestion occurs. When the PDCP delay exceeds the threshold, it is considered that congestion occurs.
item.name: congestDelayThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the PDCP delay threshold for triggering decongestion. If the PDCP delay is shorter than the threshold, it is considered that no congestion occurs.
item.name: uncongestDelayThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the PDCP cache occupancy ratio threshold for determining whether congestion occurs. If the PDCP cache occupancy ratio exceeds the threshold, it is considered that congestion occurs.
item.name: congestCacheThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the PDCP cache occupancy ratio threshold for triggering decongestion. If the PDCP cache occupancy ratio is lower than the threshold, it is considered that no congestion occurs.
item.name: uncongestCacheThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times that the system consecutively determines whether the PDCP waiting time of a packet exceeds the PDCP delay threshold for congestion occurrence or PDCP delay threshold for triggering decongestion. When the eNodeB determines whether congestion occurs based on the PDCP delay, the eNodeB uses this parameter value, the PDCP delay threshold for congestion occurrence, and the PDCP delay threshold for triggering decongestion to determine whether congestion or decongestion occurs.
item.name: pktCongestDecisionTimes

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times that the system consecutively determines whether the PDCP cache occupancy ratio exceeds the PDCP cache occupancy ratio threshold for determining whether congestion occurs or the PDCP cache occupancy ratio threshold for triggering decongestion. When the eNodeB determines whether congestion occurs based on the PDCP cache occupancy ratio, the eNodeB uses this parameter value, the PDCP cache occupancy ratio threshold for congestion occurrence, and the PDCP cache occupancy ratio threshold for triggering decongestion to determine whether congestion or decongestion occurs.
item.name: cacheRatioCongesTimes

When parameter is Support, eNB calculate the secret key of X2 handover according to mutiBandList first, and then according to freqBandInd;When parameter is Not Support, eNB calculate the secret key of X2 handover according to freqBandInd first,and then according to mutiBandList.

item.name: emtcSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRP thresholds of the PRACH resource set of the UEs at each Coverage Enhancement (CE) level in the cell. It is an array parameter consisting of three elements. Elements 0 through 2 divide the RSRP values into four intervals in descending order. The intervals correspond to different CE levels. If the measured RSRP value of a UE is larger than or equal to the value of element 0, the UE selects the random-access resources corresponding to CE level 0 to access the cell. If the measured RSRP value of a UE is larger than or equal to the value of element 1 and smaller than the value of element 0, and the UE supports CE level 1, the UE selects the random-access resources corresponding to CE level 1 to access the cell. If the measured RSRP value of a UE is larger than or equal to the value of element 2 and smaller than the value of element 1, and the UE supports CE level 2, the UE selects the random-access resources corresponding to CE level 2 to access the cell. If the measured RSRP value of a UE is smaller than the value of element 2 and the UE supports CE level 3, the UE selects the random-access resources corresponding to CE level 3 to access the cell.
item.name: rsrpThrPrachInfoList

item.desc: This parameter indicates the attribute indication of an FDD neighbor cell. If the parameter is set to 0 (non MBSFN cell), it indicates that only the UEs with unicast services can be handed over to the cell and the UEs with multicast services cannot be handed over to the target cell. If the parameter is set to 1 (non MBSFN and MBSFN multiplex cell), it indicates that both the UEs with unicast services and the UEs with multicast services can be handed over to the target cell. If the parameter is set to 2 (MBSFN-dedicated cell), it indicates that only the UEs with multicast services can be handed over to the target cell and the UEs with unicast services cannot be handed over to the target cell.
item.name: cellMbsfnAtt

item.desc: This parameter is the indication of an FDD MM neighbor cell. If it is set to No, neighbor cells are not massive MIMO cells; otherwise, neighbor cells are massive MIMO cells.
item.name: massiveMIMOInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the indicator of EN-DC anchors for neighbor cells. If EN-DC is supported by neighbor cells, this parameter is set to Yes; otherwise, it is set to No.
item.name: nbrEnDcAnchorInd

item.name: alias

item.desc: This parameter sets the latitude of an external neighbor cell. The distance between the serving cell and an external neighbor cell can be obtained based on the longitude and latitude of the serving cell and those of the external cell. item.desc: This parameter sets the index of an intra-LTE measurement configuration.
item.name: measCfgIdx

item.desc: This parameter sets the measurement configurations for different application functions of an LTE system. One measurement configuration item corresponds to a set of measurement configurations.
item.name: measCfgFunc

item.desc: This parameter sets the trigger quantity to evaluate event-triggering conditions. If the UE detects that the trigger quantity satisfies the event-triggering threshold, a cell measurement event is triggered. If this parameter is set to rsrp, a UE determines event reporting conditions based on the measured RSRP value. If this parameter is set to rsrq, a UE determines event reporting conditions based on the measured RSRQ value.
item.name: triggerQuantity

item.desc: This parameter determines whether either of the RSRP or RSRQ value or both the RSRP and RSRQ values are reported by a UE. If it is set to sameAsTriggerQuantity, the measurement quantity reported by the UE is RSRP if the event-triggering quantity is RSRP and the measurement quantity reported by the UE is RSRQ if the event-triggering quantity is RSRQ. If it is set to both, the measurement quantity reported by the UE is both RSRP and RSRQ.
item.name: reportQuantity

item.desc: This parameter sets the rule to report measurement results. If it is set to Event triggered reporting, the measurement results are reported when the event-triggering conditions are met. If it is set to Periodical reporting, the measurement results are periodically reported at the configured interval.
item.name: reportCriteria

item.desc: This parameter sets the ID of the event triggered by measurement, which is related to the measured quantity. A1: The signal quality level of the serving cell is higher than the absolute threshold. This event is used to disable inter-frequency and inter-RAT measurement and activate the gap. A2: The signal quality level of the serving cell is lower than the absolute threshold. This event is used to enable inter-frequency and inter-RAT measurement and activate the gap. A3: The signal quality level of a neighbor cell is one relative threshold higher than that of the serving cell. This event is used for coverage-based handover event measurement. A4: The signal quality level of a neighbor cell is higher than the absolute threshold. This event is used for handover event measurement. A5: The signal quality level of the serving cell is lower than the absolute threshold while that of a neighbor cell is higher than the absolute threshold. This event is used for handover event measurement. A6: The signal quality level of a neighbor cell is one relative threshold higher than that of the secondary cell.
item.name: eventId

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute RSRP threshold for event decision in the serving cell or neighbor cells. The events include A1, A2, A4, and A5. For events A2 and A5, a UE reports the measurement result only when the RSRP of the serving cell is smaller than this threshold. For event A1, a UE reports the measurement result only when the RSRP of the serving cell is larger than this threshold. For event A4, a UE reports the measurement result only when the RSRP of a neighbor cell is larger than this threshold.
item.name: thresholdOfRSRP

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute RSRQ threshold for event decision in the serving cell or neighbor cells. The events include A1, A2, A4, and A5. For events A2 and A5, a UE reports the measurement result only when the RSRQ of the serving cell is smaller than this threshold. For event A1, a UE reports the measurement result only when the RSRQ of the serving cell is larger than this threshold. For event A4, a UE reports the measurement result only when the RSRQ of a neighbor cell is larger than this threshold.
item.name: thresholdOfRSRQ

item.desc: This parameter sets absolute RSRP threshold 2 for neighbor-cell decision during event A5 measurement. A UE reports the measurement result only when the RSRP of a neighbor cell is larger than this threshold.
item.name: a5Threshold2OfRSRP

item.desc: This parameter sets absolute RSRQ threshold 2 for neighbor-cell decision during event A5 measurement. A UE reports the measurement result only when the RSRQ of a neighbor cell is larger than this threshold.
item.name: a5Threshold2OfRSRQ

item.desc: This parameter sets the hysteresis range in event decision. A smaller parameter value indicates that it is easier to meet the event-triggering conditions. A greater parameter value indicates that it is more difficult to meet the event-triggering conditions.
item.name: hysteresis

item.desc: This parameter sets the time difference between the time when an event occurs and the time when the event is reported. A detected event is triggered and reported only when the event always satisfies the event-triggering conditions within this period of time. A larger parameter value indicates stricter event-triggering decision conditions.
item.name: timeToTrigger

item.desc: This parameter sets the time interval for a UE to periodically trigger measurement reporting when an event is triggered. For a UE, when an event is triggered, the UE reports measurement results at the interval specified by this parameter.
item.name: reportInterval

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of times that a UE reports measurement results after an event is triggered. When an event is triggered and the number of times that the measurement results reported by a UE exceeds this parameter value, the UE stops reporting the measurement results.
item.name: reportAmount

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval at which measurement results are periodically reported. It is specified in the periodical-reporting rule. For a UE, when measurement reporting is triggered, the UE reports measurement results at the interval specified by this parameter.
item.name: prdReportInterval

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times that measurement results are periodically reported. In a reporting period of a UE, if the UE detects that the number of times that measurement results are reported exceeds this parameter value, the UE stops reporting the measurement results.
item.name: prdReportAmount

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of reported cells, not including the serving cell.
item.name: maxReportCellNum

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to support event A3 exit reporting, that is, whether to initialize the measurement reporting procedure when the event exit condition is satisfied. The exit condition defined in the protocol is: Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys less than Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off, that is, the RSRP/RSRQ value of a neighbor cell is lower than that of the serving cell. Note: The word exit does not mean that the UE leaves the serving cell; instead, it just indicates a condition.
item.name: reportOnLeave

item.desc: This parameter sets the event-triggering condition for reporting the RSRP. When the RSRP difference between a neighbor cell and the local cell is larger than the parameter value (the actual value in dB), RSRP reporting is triggered.
item.name: a3Offset

item.desc: This parameter sets the offset of event A6. It indicates the difference between a neighbor cell and an SCell. It is used for SCell replacement in a CA scenario. A larger parameter value indicates that it is more difficult to meet the SCell replacement conditions. A smaller parameter value indicates that it is easier to meet the SCell replacement conditions.
item.name: a6Offset

item.desc: This parameter sets the purpose for periodic measurement. If it is set to 0, it indicates that the best cell is reported. If it is set to 1, it indicates that the CGI value is reported.
item.name: prdRptRurpose

item.desc: This parameter sets whether UEs support event A6 exit reporting, that is, whether a UE initializes the measurement reporting procedure when the event exit condition is satisfied. The exit condition defined in the protocol is: Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys less than Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off, that is, the RSRP/RSRQ of a neighbor cell is lower than that of the serving cell. Note: The word exit does not mean that the UE leaves the serving cell; instead, it just indicates a condition.
item.name: reportOnLeaveA6Swch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the addition of the best neighbor cell of the serving frequency to the measurement report. If it is set to Open, the reportAddNeighMeas-r10 IE can be carried in all the measurement reports. If it is set to Close, the reportAddNeighMeas-r10 IE cannot be carried in any measurement report.
item.name: reportAddNeighMeasSwch

RSRP refers to the Reference Signal Received Power, while RSRQ refers to the Reference Signal Received Quality.

item.desc: This parameter sets the rule (event-triggered or periodically reported) for reporting inter-RAT measurement results.
item.name: reportCriteria

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of reported cells, not including the serving cell. The number is notified to the UE in the measurement configuration. If the measurement purpose is set to reportStrongestCellsForSON, the maximum number of reported cells can be set to 1 only.
item.name: maxReportCellNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the ID of the event triggered by inter-RAT measurement, which is related to the measured quantity.
item.name: eventId

item.desc: This parameter sets RSRP threshold 1 for event B2.
item.name: rsrpSrvTrd

item.desc: This parameter sets RSRQ threshold 1 for event B2.
item.name: rsrqSrvTrd

item.desc: When the CPICH_RSCP value of a UTRA FDD neighbor cell measured by the UE is larger than the threshold, a handover towards the UTRA FDD cell is triggered.
item.name: rscpSysNbrTrd

item.desc: When a UE detects that the CPICH_Ec/No value of a UTRA FDD neighbor cell is larger than this threshold, a handover to the UTRA FDD cell is triggered.
item.name: ecNoSysNbrTrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the hysteresis range in event decision.
item.name: hysterisis

item.desc: This parameter sets the period from the time when an event occurs to the time when the event is reported. A detected event is triggered and reported only when the event always satisfies the event-triggering condition within this period of time. The larger the parameter value is, the stricter it is to determine whether an event can be triggered. This parameter is configured as required. If the parameter value is too large, communication quality may be affected sometimes.
item.name: trigTime

item.desc: This parameter indicates the time interval to report the measurement results after an event is triggered; that is, the UE reports the measurement results of the triggered event within every periodical reporting interval.
item.name: evtReportInterval

item.desc: This parameter indicates the maximum number of times that the measurement results are reported after an event is triggered. For a UE, after an event is triggered, the UE reports the measurement results periodically. If the number of times that the UE reports the measurement results is more than the parameter value, the UE stops reporting the measurement results.
item.name: evtReportAmount

item.desc: This parameter sets the reporting interval in the periodical reporting rule; that is, the UE reports the measurement results at the interval configured by this parameter.
item.name: prdReportInterval

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times that measurement results are periodically reported. It is used for a UE periodically reporting measurement results to determine whether it still needs to report the measurement results. If the UE detects that the number of times that measurement results are reported exceeds this parameter value, the UE stops reporting the measurement results.
item.name: prdReportAmount

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute decision threshold for GERAN system measurement. The threshold is related to event B1 or event B2. For event B1, when the UE detects that the signal quality of a GERAN neighbor cell is better than the threshold (Mn + Ofn - Hys greater than Thresh), the UE determines that event (B1-1) is valid. For event B2, when the UE detects that the signal quality of a GERAN neighbor cell is better than the threshold (Mn + Ofn - Hys greater than Thresh2), the UE determines that event (B2-2) is valid.
item.name: geranNbrTrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute decision threshold for CDMA system measurement. The threshold is related to event B1 or event B2. For event B1, when the UE detects that the signal quality of a CDMA neighbor cell is better than the threshold (Mn + Ofn - Hys greater than Thresh), the UE determines that event (B1-1) is valid. For event B2, when the UE detects that the signal quality of a CDMA neighbor cell is better than the threshold (Mn + Ofn - Hys greater than Thresh2), the UE determines that event (B2-2) is valid.
item.name: cdmaSysNbrTrd

item.desc: If the parameter is set to 0, the reported UTRAN-FDD measurement quantity of the UE is the same as the triggered quantity. If the parameter is set to 1, the reported UTRAN-FDD measurement quantity of the UE includes RSCP and EC/No. This parameter is valid for UTRAN-FDD neighbor cells only.
item.name: utraFddReportQuan

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSSI threshold for event W1 and event W3 in WLAN measurement.
item.name: wlanRssiTrd

item.name: rsrpSrvTrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute threshold of the measured RSRQ value for event NR B2 of the serving cell. A UE reports the measurement result only when the RSRQ of the serving cell is lower than this threshold.

item.desc: This parameter sets the time difference between the time when an event occurs and the time when the event is reported. A detected event is triggered and reported only when the event always satisfies the event-triggering condition within this period of time. A larger parameter value indicates stricter event-triggering decision conditions. If this parameter is set too large, the communication quality of users may be affected.
item.name: trigTime

item.desc: This parameter sets the time interval to report the measurement results after an event is triggered; that is, the UE reports the measurement results of the triggered event within every periodical reporting interval.
item.name: evtRptInterval

For a UE, after an event is triggered, the UE reports the measurement results periodically. If the number of times that the UE reports the measurement results is larger than the parameter value, the UE stops reporting the measurement results.
item.name: evtRptAmount

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute threshold for the RSRP decision of NR neighbor cells when the measurement result of an event B1 or B2 of an NR cell is reported. item.name: rSRPNRTrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute threshold for the RSRQ decision of NR neighbor cells when the measurement result of an event B1 or B2 of an NR cell is reported. If the RSRQ value of an NR neighbor cell is smaller than or equal to this threshold, the UE cannot report the measurement result.
item.name: rSRQNRTrd

If the SINR value of an NR neighbor cell is smaller than or equal to this threshold, the UE cannot report the measurement result.
item.name: sINRNRTrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the measurement reporting quantity with which a UE reports measured values during NR cell measurement. It is a three-dimensional array. The first element represents the RSRP measurement reporting quantity, the second element represents the RSRQ measurement reporting quantity, and the third element represents the SINR measurement reporting quantity. If an element value is set to 1, it indicates that the UE needs to report the measured values. If an element value is set to 0, it indicates that the UE does not need to report the measured values.
item.name: rpQuantityNRbitmap

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to carry RS-index results in NR measurement reports. If it is set to Open, the measurement reports need to carry RS-index results. If it is set to Close, the measurement reports do not carry RS-index results.

item.name: maxReportRSIndex

It is used for a UE periodically reporting measurement results to determine whether it still needs to report the measurement results. If the UE detects that the number of times that measurement results are reported exceeds this parameter value, the UE stops reporting the measurement results.
item.name: prdRptAmount

item.desc: This parameter sets the measurement quantity used by UEs during NR system measurement, 0 for RSRP, 1 for RSRQ, and 2 for SINR.
item.name: quantityNR

item.desc: This parameter sets the measurement reporting quantity with which a UE reports SSB measurement values during NR cell measurement. It is a three-dimensional array. The first element represents the RSRP measurement reporting quantity, the second element represents the RSRQ measurement reporting quantity, and the third element represents the SINR measurement reporting quantity. If an element value is set to 1, it indicates that the UE needs to report the SSB measurement values. If an element value is set to 0, it indicates that the UE does not need to report the SSB measurement values.
item.name: sSBRpQuantityNRbitmap

item.desc: This parameter sets the event that is triggered by a measurement report for each QCI service in the system. If this parameter is set to None, the event triggered by measurement for coverage-based handover of a UE with the corresponding QCI service is the same as that indicated by the default bearer configuration. In the coverage-based handover of a UE with the corresponding QCI service, if this parameter is set to A3, the target cell should be an intra-RAT neighbor cell with a measured indicator that is at least the relative threshold larger than this indicator of the serving cell; if this parameter is set to A4, the target cell should be an intra-RAT neighbor cell with a measured indicator that is larger than the absolute threshold of the serving cell; if this parameter is set to A5, the target can be selected only if a measured indicator of the serving cell is smaller than the corresponding absolute threshold, and the target cell should be an intra-RAT neighbor cell with a measured indicator that is larger than the corresponding absolute threshold. This parameter is valid only if the perQCIMeasCfgStrategy parameter is set to Priority Strategy.

It corresponds to a set of records (measurement configuration numbers) of NR inter-RAT event A2 in the intra-RAT measurement parameter configuration table. The first element corresponds to RSRP and the second to RSRQ. In the case of non-dual-measurement, only the first set of array elements is valid.
item.name: sAOpeNRMeasCfg

item.desc: This parameter sets the two-dimensional array indexes to disable NR intra-RAT A1 measurement for SA UEs. It corresponds to a set of records (measurement configuration numbers) of NR inter-RAT event A1 in the intra-RAT measurement parameter configuration table. The first element corresponds to RSRP and the second to RSRQ. In the case of non-dual-measurement, only the first set of array elements is valid.
item.name: sAClsNRMeasCfg

item.desc: This parameter indicates the unique index of a measurement configuration for directional migration measurement of SA UEs.
item.name: sADirectMigMeasCfg

item.desc: This parameter sets the two-dimensional array indexes to enable redirection measurement based on voice services. It corresponds to a set of records of the redirection event A2 for voice services in the intra-system measurement parameter configuration table. One element corresponds to RSRP and the other to RSRQ. In the case of non-dual-measurement, only the first element is valid.
item.name: openRdVoiceMeasCfg

item.desc: This parameter sets the measurement configuration index of handover based on optimal CA band combinations. The eNodeB delivers measurement configurations to the optimal frequency combinations for CA UEs based on this parameter value.

item.desc: This parameter sets a measurement configuration index. It is associated with a dedicated measurement configuration that is used to monitor neighbor cell-related NR coverage in an EN-DC anchor-based handover.
item.name: endcAnchNbrNrCovMeasCfg

item.desc: This parameter sets a measurement configuration index. It is associated with a dedicated measurement configuration that is used to monitor local cell-related NR coverage in an EN-DC anchor-based handover.
item.name: endcAnchSrvNrCovMeasCfg

item.desc: This parameter sets the measurement configuration index for migrating the poor-quality data UEs that are in the cells with atmospheric ducting interference. If this parameter is configured, the poor-quality data UEs that are in the cells with atmospheric ducting interference are migrated to a cell without atmospheric ducting interference.
item.name: atmosWorseDataMigMeaCfg

item.desc: This parameter indicates the unique index of a measurement configuration for UE migration when MM IN coordination is enabled.
item.name: tmmINCMeasCfg

item.desc: This parameter indicates the unique index of a measurement configuration for the LTE detection of the UEs that are interfered at the DSS boundary.
item.name: dSSBIFLTEDetMeasCfg

item.desc: This parameter indicates the unique index of a measurement configuration for the inter-frequency migration of the UEs that are interfered at the DSS boundary.
item.name: dSSBIFInterFMigMeasCfg

item.desc: This parameter indicates a measurement configuration index. It is uniquely associated with a measurement configuration that is used for the dedicated measurement of the cells with the best ANR in an NR system.
item.name: nrAnrRptStrongCellMeasCfg

item.desc: This parameter sets the frequency-level measurement configuration index for the directional migration of SA UEs. An index corresponds to an NR frequency and is uniquely associated with a measurement configuration.
item.name: sADirectMigFMeasCfg

item.desc: This parameter indicates a measurement configuration index. It is uniquely associated with a set of measurement configurations for load-based DSS UE migration.
item.name: loadBasedSpecOrchMeasCfg

item.desc: This parameter sets the measurement configuration index of traffic guidance for energy saving. It is uniquely associated with a set of measurement configurations in the Measurement Parameter table.
item.name: eCGuidMigMeasCfg

item.desc: This parameter indicates the unique index of an NR frequency measurement configuration for aggregation mode selection.
item.name: aggModeSelectNrMeasCfg

item.desc: This parameter indicates the unique index of an inter-frequency measurement configuration for aggregation mode selection.
item.name: aggModeSelectIFMeasCfg

item.desc: This parameter sets the intra-frequency measurement configuration index for data quality-based migration. It is uniquely associated with a set of intra-frequency measurement configurations.
item.name: dataQualMigIntraFMeasCfg

item.desc: This parameter sets the inter-frequency measurement configuration index for data quality-based migration. It is uniquely associated with a set of inter-frequency measurement configurations.
item.name: dataQualMigInterFMeasCfg

item.desc: This parameter sets the measurement configuration for inter-frequency migration triggered by UEs with general-QoS services. The parameter value is obtained from the measCfgIdx (Measurement Configuration Index) parameter and indicates a set of measurement parameters. If inter-frequency migration triggered by UEs with general-QoS services takes effect, the eNodeB delivers measurement information to the UEs to be migrated by using the measurement configuration specified by this parameter and performs migration in accordance with the measurement results reported by the UEs.

item.desc: This parameter sets the period from the time when an event occurs to the time when the event is reported. A detected event is triggered and reported only when the event always satisfies the event-triggering condition within this period of time. A larger parameter value indicates that it is stricter to determine whether an event can be triggered. This parameter is configured as required. If the parameter value is too large, communication quality may be affected sometimes.

A larger parameter value indicates that it is stricter to determine whether an event can be triggered. This parameter is configured as required. item.desc: This parameter is an array with 48 elements, corresponding to a group of energy-saving priorities of LTE frequencies. The LTE frequencies are jointly determined by the E-UTRAN Carrier Frequency and E-UTRAN Frequency Band Indicator parameters. A larger parameter value indicates that the energy-saving priority of the corresponding frequency is higher, it is easier for the cells on this frequency to enter energy-saving mode, and it is more difficult for the cells to exit energy-saving mode.

item.desc: This parameter is an array with 48 elements. This parameter together with the E-UTRAN Carrier Frequency parameter determines a group of LTE frequencies. Each element value in this parameter indicates the frequency band indicator corresponding to an LTE frequency. The Energy-Saving Priorities of LTE Frequencies parameter can set the energy-saving priorities of the LTE frequencies.
