item.desc: When the rsrp of serving cell that reported in unknown PCI measurement result exceeds this threshold, ANR perform ECGI measurement for the unknown PCI.
item.name: ltePciSrvRsrpThrd

item.desc: This parameter indicates the maximum number of times that the eNodeB performs CGI measurement on each unknown neighbor cell after a failed attempt during ANR neighbor self-addition. This parameter is valid for all the neighbor cells, including intra-RAT and inter-RAT neighbor cells.
item.name: sonMeasObjChoiceCounter

item.desc: This parameter indicates the maximum number of Ues choosed in each ECGI measurement.
item.name: anrMeasUeCnt

item.desc: This parameter sets the time granularity for collecting ANR statistics.
item.name: staticTimerGrade

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of neighbor cells that can be added or deleted at a time. If the number of neighbor cells meeting the cell addition conditions is larger than the threshold, the neighbor cells with more handover successes are added first. If the number of neighbor cells meeting the cell deletion conditions is larger than the threshold, the neighbor cells with fewer handover successes are deleted first.
item.name: nbrAddCnt

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable the ANR timed reporting function. If it is set to Open, the function is enabled; otherwise, the function is disabled.
item.name: anrAppointRptSwch

item.desc: The parameter is the start time of ANR Report at appointed time function configured by operator.ANR nbr Add and Del Process will execute after start time.
item.name: anrAppointRptStartTime

item.desc: The parameter is the end time of ANR Report at appointed time function configured by operator. After end time arrive,ANR Report at appointed time function will execute reset and start next process period.
item.name: anrAppointRptEndTime

item.desc: The process of the scene that the handover results between adjacent cells are continuously failed is determined by this switch.
item.name: handoverFailDetectSwch

item.desc: There has further treatment when the continuously failed times of handover is equal or more than the value of this parameter.
item.name: handoverFailNumThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum duration of the timer for enabling long-period neighbor relation detection at different times. Long-period neighbor relation detection tasks in different serving cells do not start to be executed until this timer times out. When the eNodeB enables the detection of long-period neighbor relations, the timer is started. When the eNodeB disables the detection of long-period neighbor relations, the timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the eNodeB starts to execute long-period neighbor relation detection tasks and starts the long-period neighbor relation detection timer.
item.name: longPerDetShiftTimLen

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the intra-LTE ANR function is supported or not. Disable: not supported; Enable: supported.
item.name: sonEnableANR

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to support the RLF-based neighbor cell detection function. Close: not supported; Open: supported.
item.name: rlfDectANRSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the RSRP threshold of RLF cell based on missing neighbor cell detection. When the re-established cell and RLF cell are not neighbor cell,if the RSRP of the RLF cell is higher than or equal to this threshold and the RSRP of the re-established cell is higher than or equal to The RSRP threshold of Re-established cell based on missing neighbor cell detection,it can be considered as missing neighbor cell.
item.name: rlfCellRsrpThd

item.desc: This parameter indicates the RSRP threshold of re-established cell based on missing neighbor cell detection. When the re-established cell and RLF cell are not neighbor cell,if the RSRP of the RLF cell is higher than or equal to The RSRP threshold of RLF cell based on missing neighbor cell detection and the RSRP of the re-established cell is higher than or equal to The RSRP threshold of Re-established cell based on missing neighbor cell detection,it can be considered as missing neighbor cell.
item.name: reestabRsrpThd

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to filter out specific neighbor cells during ANR neighbor addition. If this parameter is set to Open and the eNodeB where a neighbor cell is located is in the special-eNodeB list, the neighbor cell is not added.
item.name: specialNbrSwch

item.desc: Control ANR Switch by Self-healing
item.name: enableShAnr

item.desc: This parameter sets the support type of candidate neighbor cells selected during the addition of intra-system ANR neighbor cells. If the intra-system ANR does not support candidate neighbor cells, this parameter is set to Close. If the intra-system ANR supports candidate neighbor cells and a candidate neighbor cell can be used as a target neighbor cell for handover after it is converted into a temporary neighbor cell, this parameter is set to Allow HO when Chaged to Temporary Neighbor. If the intra-system ANR supports candidate neighbor cells and a candidate neighbor cell cannot be used as a target neighbor cell for handover after it is converted into a temporary neighbor cell, this parameter is set to Forbid HO when Chaged to Temporary Neighbor.
item.name: candiNbrModeSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for collecting MR statistics on intra-RAT candidate neighbor relations. It is used to set the period of the MR indicator tasks for collecting statistics on intra-RAT candidate neighbor relations. The unit of this parameter is the same as that of the Time Granularity for Collecting ANR Statistics parameter. When the eNodeB starts the intra-RAT candidate neighbor relation mode, the timer is started. When the eNodeB stops the intra-RAT candidate neighbor relation mode, the timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the eNodeB executes the filtering algorithm for intra-RAT candidate neighbor relations.
item.name: candiNbrMrStatTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRP threshold for valid measurement reports of candidate neighbor cells. If the RSRP of a candidate neighbor cell is greater than or equal to this threshold, the measurement report is regarded as valid.
item.name: candiNbrRsrpThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRQ threshold for valid measurement reports of candidate neighbor cells. If there are only RSRQ values but no RSRQ value in the measurement report of a candidate neighbor cell and the RSRQ is greater than or equal to this threshold, the measurement report is regarded as valid.
item.name: candiNbrRsrqThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the number of times that a candidate neighbor cell is measured. Within a statistical period of candidate neighbor measurement, it can be determined whether a candidate neighbor cell can be converted into a temporary neighbor cell only when the total number of times that the candidate neighbor cell is measured is larger than or equal to this threshold.
item.name: candiNbrMrNumThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the proportion of valid measurement reports of candidate neighbor cells. Within a statistical period of candidate neighbor measurement, only the candidate neighbor cells that meet the following conditions can be converted into temporary neighbor cells: The proportion of valid measurement reports is larger than or equal to this threshold and the total number of measurement reports is larger than or equal to the Threshold for the Number of Times That a Candidate Neighbor Cell Is Measured parameter.
item.name: candiNbrMrRatioThrd

item.desc: When the rsrp of LTE unknown PCI exceeds this threshold, ANR perform ECGI measurement for the unknown PCI.
item.name: ltePciRsrpThrd

item.desc: When only RSRQ information exists in the measurement report of LTE unknown PCI, if the RSRQ is larger than or equal to the threshold, ECGI measurement will be performed for the unknown PCI by the ANR function.
item.name: ltePciRsrqThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for collecting statistics in intra-RAT neighbor relation addition/deletion. It is used to control the period during which the tasks for collecting statistics on handover and MR indicators of intra-RAT neighbor relations are executed. The unit of this parameter is the same as that of the Grade of ANR Statistic Timer Length parameter. When the eNodeB enables intra-RAT neighbor relation addition/deletion based on data collection, the timer is started. When the eNodeB disables intra-RAT neighbor relation addition/deletion based on data collection, the timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the eNodeB executes the filtering algorithm for intra-RAT neighbor relation addition/deletion.
item.name: statisticTimer

item.desc: When the ANR temporary cell is added, the numbers of measurements and successful handovers will be collected in the statistical period. After the statistic timer is timeout,if the MR times less than this value,the temporary neighbor cell cannot be added to the formal neighbor cell list.
item.name: sonNbrReportThreshold

item.desc: When the ANR temporary cell is added,the numbers of measurements and successful handovers will be collected in the statistical period. After the statistic timer is timeout,if the HO success times less than this value,the temporary neighbor cell cannot be added to the formal neighbor cell list.
item.name: sonHoSuccThreshold

item.desc: This parameter indicates the offset of the number of measurement reports during LTE neighbor cell replacement. In the data collection and optimization of LTE neighbor cells, the number of measurement reports of neighbor cells is used for data sorting. The number of measurement reports of neighbor cells can be used for data sorting only after subtracting this parameter value.
item.name: lteTmpNbrMrNumOffset

item.desc: This parameter indicates the offset of the number of successful handovers during LTE neighbor cell replacement. In the data collection and optimization of LTE neighbor cells, the number of successful handovers of neighbor cells is used for data sorting. The number of successful handovers of neighbor cells can be used for data sorting only after subtracting this parameter value.
item.name: lteNbrHys

item.desc: This parameter indicates handover success rate threshold for intra-frquency neighbor cell additoin. Only the neighbor cell whose handover success rate is higher than or equal to this threshold can be added to formal neighbor cell list.
item.name: intraFreqHoSuccRateThrd

item.desc: This parameter indicates handover success rate threshold for inter-frquency neighbor cell additoin. Only the neighbor cell whose handover success rate is higher than or equal to this threshold can be added to formal neighbor cell list.
item.name: interFreqHoSuccRateThrd

item.desc: If the intra-RAT LTE ANR function is enabled, the number of formal intra-frequency neighbor cells cannot exceed the upper limit.
item.name: maxIntraFNbrNum

item.desc: If the intra-RAT LTE ANR function is enabled, the number of formal inter-frequency neighbor cells cannot exceed the upper limit.
item.name: maxInterFNbrNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the lower limit of the number of intra-frequency neighbor cells of the cells in a single PLMN during intra-frequency ANR replacement. Neighbor cell replacement is not triggered if the number of intra-frequency neighbor cells in a single PLMN is less than this parameter value.
item.name: intraFLowPlmnNbrNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the lower limit of the number of inter-frequency neighbor cells of the cells in a single PLMN during inter-frequency ANR replacement. Neighbor cell replacement is not triggered if the number of inter-frequency neighbor cells in a single PLMN is less than this parameter value.
item.name: interFLowPlmnNbrNum

item.desc: This parameter indicates whether the intra-LTE centralize neighbor cell relation bidirectional configuration function is supported or not.Close:not supported;Open:supported;
item.name: centralizeTwoWayFlg

item.desc: This parameter indicates whether the intra-LTE Inter-Frequency centralize neighbor cell relation bidirectional configuration function is supported or not.Close:not supported;Open:supported;
item.name: centralizeInterFTwoWayFlg

item.desc: The switch controls whether intra-eNB NBR can be deleted.
item.name: intraEnbNBRDelSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of the function that a neighbor cell is deleted if no handover is performed to it in a long period of time. If it is set to Open, the function is enabled. If it is set to Close, the function is disabled.
item.name: longPeriodHoDetectSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for detecting the intra-RAT regular neighbor relations where no handover occurs within a long period. It is used to control the period during which the tasks for collecting statistics on handover indicators of intra-RAT regular neighbor relations are executed. The unit of this parameter is the same as that of the Grade of ANR Statistic Timer Length parameter. When the eNodeB enables the detection of the intra-RAT neighbor relations where no handover occurs within a long period, the timer is started. When the eNodeB disables the detection of the intra-RAT neighbor relations where no handover occurs within a long period, the timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the eNodeB deletes the intra-RAT regular neighbor relations where no handover occurs within a long period.
item.name: longPeriodHoDetectPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of handovers for the detection of no handover within a long period. In the detection period, if the number of handovers of a neighbor cell is smaller than the threshold, the neighbor cell will be deleted from the formal NBR list.
item.name: longPeriodHoNumThrd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables temporary-neighbor-cell deletion if no measurement report is generated in a long period of time. If it is set to Open, the temporary neighbor cells where no measurement report is generated in a long period of time are deleted. If it is set to Close, the temporary neighbor cells where no measurement report is generated in a long period of time are not deleted.
item.name: longPerMRTmpDeltSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for detecting the intra-RAT temporary neighbor relations where no measurement result is reported within a long period. It is used to control the period during which the tasks for collecting statistics on MR indicators of intra-RAT temporary neighbor relations are executed. The unit of this parameter is the same as that of the Grade of ANR Statistic Timer Length parameter. When the eNodeB enables the detection of the intra-RAT neighbor relations where no measurement result is reported within a long period, the timer is started. When the eNodeB disables the detection of the intra-RAT neighbor relations where no measurement result is reported within a long period, the timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the eNodeB deletes the intra-RAT temporary neighbor relations where no measurement result is reported within a long period.
item.name: longPerMRDetectPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable the no-handover-success temporary neighbor cell detection function. If the switch is turned on (namely the parameter value is 1), the no-handover-success temporary neighbor cell detection function is enabled; otherwise, the function is disabled.
item.name: tmpNoSuccHoDetectSwch

item.desc: The process of the scene that the success rate of handover results between adjacent cells is in low level is determined by this switch.
item.name: lowHoSuccRateDetectSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether an anchor cell is put on the neighbor cell blacklist if it is identified as a cell with a low handover success rate. If this parameter is set to Open, a neighbor cell is not put on the blacklist even if it is identified as a cell with a low handover success rate.
item.name: anchorCellNoBlackSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the detection algorithm used for the detection of the LTE neighbor cells with a low handover success rate. In the scenario with a small number of handovers and a low handover success rate, it is recommended that this parameter be set to Based on the number of handover failures and handover success rate, meaning that the detection is based on the number of failed handovers and the handover success rate. In other scenarios, it is recommended that this parameter be set to Based on the number of handover requests and handover success rate, meaning that the detection is based on the number of handover requests and the handover success rate.
item.name: lowHoSuccRateAlg

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to allow UEs to be handed over to the intra-site LTE neighbor cells with a low handover success rate. If it is set to No support HO, it indicates that UEs are prohibited from being handed over to the intra-site LTE neighbor cells with a low handover success rate. If it is set to Support HO, it indicates that UEs are allowed to be handed over to the intra-site LTE neighbor cells with a low handover success rate.
item.name: intraEnbLowHoNBRNoHo

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the penalty timer for the intra-RAT neighbor relations with a low handover success rate. It is used to control the penalty period during which UEs cannot be handed over to the intra-RAT neighbor relations with a low handover success rate. The unit of this parameter is the same as that of the Grade of ANR Statistic Timer Length parameter. When an intra-RAT neighbor relation is detected as a neighbor relation with a low handover success rate and the number of penalties is smaller than the threshold, this timer is started. When the eNodeB disables the detection of the intra-RAT neighbor relations with a low handover success rate, this timer is stopped. After the timer times out, UEs can be handed over to the punished intra-RAT neighbor relations.
item.name: noHoPunishTimer

item.desc: When the number of times that a neighbor cell is detected as a neighbor cell with a low handover success rate reaches the threshold, the neighbor relation cannot be automatically recovered from the list of neighbor cells with a low handover success rate.
item.name: noHoPunishNumThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for detecting the intra-RAT regular neighbor relations with a low handover success rate. It is used to control the period during which the tasks for collecting statistics on handover indicators of intra-RAT regular neighbor relations are executed. The unit of this parameter is the same as that of the Grade of ANR Statistic Timer Length parameter. When the eNodeB enables the detection of the intra-RAT neighbor relations with a low handover success rate, the timer is started. When the eNodeB disables the detection of the intra-RAT neighbor relations with a low handover success rate, the timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the eNodeB executes the algorithm for detecting the intra-RAT regular neighbor relations with a low handover success rate.
item.name: lowHoSuccRateDetectPeriod

item.desc: A formal NBR will be detected as low handover success rate NBR if the handover times is larger than or equal to this parameter and the handover success rate is lower than or equal to the Handover Success Rate Threshold of Low Handover Success Rate NBR Detection.
item.name: hoNumThrdForLowHORate

item.desc: If the number of failed handovers of a formal neighbor cell reaches or exceeds this threshold and the handover success rate is lower than the handover success rate detection threshold of formal neighbor cells with a low intra-RAT handover success rate, this neighbor cell is a neighbor cell with a low handover success rate.
item.name: hoFailNumTdForLowHoRate

item.desc: The neighbor cell will be detected as low handover success rate formal NBR if the handover times is larger than or equal to Handover Times Threshold of Low Handover Success Rate Formal NBR Detection and the handover success rate is lower than or equal to this parameter.
item.name: lowHoSuccRateDetectThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets whether handover is allowed for intra-system normal neighbor cells with low handover success rates. If this parameter is set to No support HO, handover is not allowed for normal neighbor cells with low handover success rates. If this parameter is set to Support HO, handover is allowed for normal neighbor cells with low handover success rates.
item.name: lowHoSuccRateNBRNoHo

item.desc: The low handover success rate formal neighbor cell will be recovered if the handover times is larger than or equal to Handover Times Threshold of Low Handover Success Rate Formal NBR Detection and the handover success ratr is higher than this parameter.
item.name: lowHoSuccRateRecoverThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for detecting the intra-RAT temporary neighbor relations with a low handover success rate. It is used to control the period during which the tasks for collecting statistics on handover indicators of intra-RAT temporary neighbor relations are executed. The unit of this parameter is the same as that of the Grade of ANR Statistic Timer Length parameter. When the eNodeB enables the detection of the intra-RAT neighbor relations with a low handover success rate, the timer is started. When the eNodeB disables the detection of the intra-RAT neighbor relations with a low handover success rate, the timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the eNodeB executes the algorithm for detecting the intra-RAT temporary neighbor relations with a low handover success rate.
item.name: tmpLowHoSuccRateDetPeriod

item.desc: A temporary NBR will be detected as low handover success rate NBR if the handover times is larger than or equal to this parameter and the handover success rate is lower than the Handover Success Rate Threshold of Low Handover Success Rate NBR Detection.
item.name: tmpHoNumThrdForLowHORate

item.desc: If the number of failed handovers of a temporary neighbor cell reaches or exceeds this threshold and the handover success rate is lower than the threshold of the total number of handovers of a temporary neighbor cell for low-handover success rate detection, this neighbor cell is a neighbor cell with a low handover success rate.
item.name: tmpHoFailNumTdLowHoRate

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the low handover success rate of temporary neighbors. If the total number of handover attempts of a temporary neighbor cell reaches or exceeds the corresponding threshold and the handover success rate is lower than or equal to this threshold, this temporary neighbor cell is a neighbor cell with a low handover success rate.
item.name: tmpLowHoSuccRateDetectThrd

item.desc: This parameter indicates handover success rate threshold of low handover success rate Temporary Neighbor Cell recovery. The low handover success rate temporary neighbor cell will be recovered if the handover times is larger than or equal to Handover Times Threshold of Low Handover Success Rate Neighbor Cell Detection and the handover success rate is higher than this parameter.
item.name: tmpLowHoSuccRateRecoverThrd

item.desc: Neighbor Cell Relation Share Cover Self-Configuration Switch
item.name: shareCoverSCSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the gNodeB performs detection of neighbor cells whose coverage area reaches the local cell. If the parameter is set to 1 (On), when adding a new neighbor cell, the system will detect whether the new neighbor cell is overshoot. The distance and the number of cells between the serving cell and a neighbor cell are detected to determine whether the neighbor cell is overshoot. For an overshoot neighbor cell, you can delete it or prohibit handover towards it.
item.name: overCovDetectSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the angle scope of searching neighbor cells. The scope takes the line from the neighbor cell to the serving cell as the center line, plus and minus the angle specified by this parameter. The overshoot detection is applicable to the cells within the angle scope only.
item.name: srchCellAngle

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute distance threshold when the overshoot distance detection mode is set to absolute distance mode. If the distance between the serving cell and a neighbor cell is larger than the absolute distance threshold, it indicates that the distance between the serving cell and the neighbor cell meets the overshoot condition.
item.name: overCovDistTh

item.desc: The parameter indicates the switch of ANR for PICO Neighbor Cell Relation.When the switch is open, The eNB can handle pico neighbor cell relation self-add and self-organization.
item.name: picoNbrANRSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the inter-RAT NR ANR function is supported. If it is set to Close, the inter-RAT NR ANR function is not supported. If it is set to Open, the inter-RAT NR ANR function is supported.
item.name: enableENDCANR

item.desc: The ANR performs NCGI measurement on an unknown NR PCI only when the RSRP value of the PCI is larger than this threshold.
item.name: nRPciRsrpThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRQ threshold for measuring unknown PCI of NR cells. If there are only RSRQ values in an unknown-PCI measurement report of NR cells, the measurement report is regarded as valid if the RSRQ value is larger than or equal to this threshold.
item.name: nrPciRsrqThrd

item.desc: This parameter determines how to obtain the NCGI of an NR neighbor cell. If it is set to Uu, it indicates that the NCGI is measured on the Uu interface. If it is set to OMC, it indicates that the NCGI is estimated based on the project parameters provided by the UME. If it is set to Self-Adaptive, it indicates that Uu-based measurement is preferentially selected if the NCGI is estimated based on the project parameters provided by the UME because the NCGI of the NR neighbor cell fails to be obtained through Uu-based measurement.
item.name: nRNbrMeasType

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for collecting statistics on unknown PCIs of inter-RAT NR neighbor cells. It is used to control the period during which the tasks for collecting statistics on the number of unknown PCIs of inter-RAT NR neighbor cells are executed. The unit of this parameter is the same as that of the Grade of ANR Statistic Timer Length parameter. When the eNodeB enables inter-RAT NR neighbor cell discovery based on EMS engineering parameter estimation, the timer is started. When the eNodeB disables inter-RAT NR neighbor cell discovery based on EMS engineering parameter estimation, the timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the eNodeB executes the algorithm for estimating the NCGIs of inter-RAT NR neighbor cells based on EMS engineering parameter estimation.
item.name: nRUnknowPciMrStatPrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of unknown NR PCIs reported by a single serving cell to the EMS within the period specified by the Statistical Period for Measuring Unknown NR PCIs parameter.
item.name: maxNrUnknowPciRptNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for collecting statistics in inter-RAT NR neighbor relation addition/deletion. It is used to control the period during which the tasks for collecting statistics on handover, MR, and EN-DC indicators of inter-RAT NR neighbor relations are executed. The unit of this parameter is the same as that of the Grade of ANR Statistic Timer Length parameter. When the eNodeB enables inter-RAT NR neighbor relation addition/deletion based on data collection, the timer is started. When the eNodeB disables inter-RAT NR neighbor relation addition/deletion based on data collection, the timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the eNodeB executes the filtering algorithm for inter-RAT NR neighbor relation addition/deletion.
item.name: nrStatisticTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of measurement reports for NR neighbor cells. An NR neighbor cell can be added as a regular neighbor cell only when the number of measurement reports for an NR neighbor cell is equal to or larger than this threshold.
item.name: nRMrNumThrd

item.desc: If the number of successful handover and EN-DC attempts for NR neighbor cells reaches or exceeds this threshold, the neighbor cells are sorted based on the number of successful handover and EN-DC attempts during neighbor cell replacement; otherwise, the neighbor cells are sorted based on the number of measurement reports.
item.name: sNAddSuccThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the offset of the number of measurement reports for a temporary NR neighbor cell. During the data collection and optimization of NR neighbor cells, a temporary NR neighbor cell can be involved in sorting only after this parameter is subtracted from the number of measurement reports for the temporary NR neighbor cell.
item.name: tempSNAddRptNumHys

item.desc: This parameter sets the offset of the number of successful handover and EN-DC attempts for a temporary NR neighbor cell. During the data collection and optimization of NR neighbor cells, a temporary NR neighbor cell can be involved in sorting only after this parameter is subtracted from the number of successful EN-DC and handover attempts for the temporary NR neighbor cell.
item.name: tempSNAddSuccNumHys

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the success rates of handover and EN-DC between inter-RAT NR neighbor cells. A neighbor cell can be added as a regular neighbor cell only when the success rate of handover and EN-DC between inter-RAT NR neighbor cells is equal to or higher than this threshold.
item.name: sNAddSuccRateThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of NR neighbor cells allowed during NR neighbor cell sorting.
item.name: maxNRNbrNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the lower limit of the number of NR neighbor cells in a single PLMN during ANR NR neighbor cell replacement. Neighbor cell replacement is not triggered if the number of neighbor cells in a single PLMN is less than this parameter value.
item.name: nRLowPlmnNbrNum

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the deletion of regular neighbor cells if no handover or EN-DC occurs within a long period. If it is set to Open, the deletion of regular neighbor cells takes effect if no handover or EN-DC occurs within a long period. Within a statistical period, if there are no EN-DC and handover statistics of a neighbor cell, the neighbor cell can be deleted.
item.name: longPeriodSNDetectSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for detecting the inter-RAT regular NR neighbor relations where no handover or EN-DC occurs within a long period. It is used to control the period during which the tasks for collecting statistics on handover and EN-DC indicators of inter-RAT regular NR neighbor relations are executed. The unit of this parameter is the same as that of the Grade of ANR Statistic Timer Length parameter. When the eNodeB enables the detection of the inter-RAT NR neighbor relations where no handover or EN-DC occurs within a long period, the timer is started. When the eNodeB disables the detection of the inter-RAT NR neighbor relations where no handover or EN-DC occurs within a long period, the timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the eNodeB deletes the inter-RAT regular NR neighbor relations where no handover or EN-DC occurs within a long period.
item.name: longPeriodSNDetectPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of times to detect that no handover or EN-DC occurs in a regular NR neighbor cell within a long period. If the number of handover and EN-DC attempts for a regular NR neighbor cell within the period specified by the Period for Detecting No Handover or EN-DC in Regular NR Neighbor Cells for a Long Period parameter is smaller than this threshold, the regular NR neighbor cell is considered to meet the condition of no handover and EN-DC for a long period.
item.name: longPeriodSNNumThrd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the deletion of temporary NR neighbor cells if no measurement reporting occurs within a long period. If it is set to Open, the deletion of temporary NR neighbor cells takes effect if no measurement reporting occurs within a long period. Within a statistical period, if there are no measurement reporting statistics of a neighbor cell, the neighbor cell can be deleted.
item.name: nrLongPrdNoMRDetectSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for detecting the inter-RAT temporary NR neighbor relations where no measurement result is reported within a long period. It is used to control the period during which the tasks for collecting statistics on MR indicators of inter-RAT temporary NR neighbor relations are executed. The unit of this parameter is the same as that of the Grade of ANR Statistic Timer Length parameter. When the eNodeB enables the detection of the inter-RAT NR neighbor relations where no measurement result is reported within a long period, the timer is started. When the eNodeB disables the detection of the inter-RAT NR neighbor relations where no measurement result is reported within a long period, the timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the eNodeB deletes the inter-RAT temporary NR neighbor relations where no measurement result is reported within a long period.
item.name: nRLongPeriodMRDetectPrd

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to detect the NR neighbor cells with a low handover or EN-DC success rate. If an NR neighbor cell is determined as a neighbor cell with a low handover or EN-DC success rate, it is added to the NR neighbor cell blacklist. In this case, the NR neighbor cell cannot be used as a target neighbor cell for handover or no EN-DC can occur in the NR neighbor cell.
item.name: nRLowHoDetectSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for detecting the inter-RAT regular NR neighbor relations with a low handover success rate. It is used to control the period during which the tasks for collecting statistics on handover and EN-DC indicators of inter-RAT regular NR neighbor relations are executed. The unit of this parameter is the same as that of the Grade of ANR Statistic Timer Length parameter. When the eNodeB enables the detection of the inter-RAT NR neighbor relations with a low handover success rate, the timer is started. When the eNodeB disables the detection of the inter-RAT NR neighbor relations with a low handover success rate, the timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the eNodeB executes the algorithm for detecting the inter-RAT regular NR neighbor relations with a low handover success rate.
item.name: nRLowHoDetectPeriod

item.desc: If the number of failed handovers in a regular NR neighbor cell reaches or exceeds this threshold and the handover success rate is lower than the Threshold of the Handover Success Rate in Regular NR Neighbor Cells for Low Handover Success Rate Detection parameter, this regular NR neighbor cell is determined as a neighbor cell with a low handover success rate. If an NR neighbor cell is determined as a neighbor cell with a low handover or EN-DC success rate, it is added to the NR neighbor cell blacklist. In this case, the NR neighbor cell cannot be used as a target neighbor cell for handover or no EN-DC can occur in the NR neighbor cell.
item.name: nRLowHoFailNumThrd

item.desc: If the number of failed EN-DC attempts in a regular NR neighbor cell reaches or exceeds this threshold and the EN-DC success rate is lower than the Threshold of the EN-DC Success Rate in Regular NR Neighbor Cells for Low EN-DC Success Rate Detection parameter, this regular NR neighbor cell is determined as a neighbor cell with a low EN-DC success rate. If an NR neighbor cell is determined as a neighbor cell with a low handover or EN-DC success rate, it is added to the NR neighbor cell blacklist. In this case, the NR neighbor cell cannot be used as a target neighbor cell for handover or no EN-DC can occur in the NR neighbor cell.
item.name: nRLowHoEndcFailNumThrd

item.desc: If the success rate of handover in a regular NR neighbor cell is lower than this threshold and the number of failed handovers in the regular NR neighbor cell is equal to or larger than the Number of Failed Handovers in Regular NR Neighbor Cells for Low Handover Success Rate Detection parameter, this regular NR neighbor cell is determined as a neighbor cell with a low handover success rate. If an NR neighbor cell is determined as a neighbor cell with a low handover or EN-DC success rate, it is added to the NR neighbor cell blacklist. In this case, the NR neighbor cell cannot be used as a target neighbor cell for handover or no EN-DC can occur in the NR neighbor cell.
item.name: nRLowHoSuccRateThrd

item.desc: If the success rate of EN-DC in a regular NR neighbor cell is lower than this threshold and the number of failed EN-DC attempts in the regular NR neighbor cell is equal to or larger than the Threshold Number of Failed EN-DC Attempts in Regular NR Neighbor Cells for Low EN-DC Success Rate Detection parameter, this regular NR neighbor cell is determined as a neighbor cell with a low EN-DC success rate. If an NR neighbor cell is determined as a neighbor cell with a low handover or EN-DC success rate, it is added to the NR neighbor cell blacklist. In this case, the NR neighbor cell cannot be used as a target neighbor cell for handover or no EN-DC can occur in the NR neighbor cell.
item.name: nRLowHoEndcSuccRateThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for detecting the inter-RAT temporary NR neighbor relations with a low handover success rate. It is used to control the period during which the tasks for collecting statistics on handover indicators of inter-RAT temporary NR neighbor relations are executed. The unit of this parameter is the same as that of the Grade of ANR Statistic Timer Length parameter. When the eNodeB enables the detection of the inter-RAT NR neighbor relations with a low handover success rate, the timer is started. When the eNodeB disables the detection of the inter-RAT NR neighbor relations with a low handover success rate, the timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the eNodeB executes the algorithm for detecting the inter-RAT temporary NR neighbor relations with a low handover success rate.
item.name: tmpNRLowHoDetectPeriod

item.desc: If the number of failed handovers in a temporary NR neighbor cell reaches or exceeds this threshold and the handover success rate is lower than the Threshold of the Handover Success Rate in Temporary NR Neighbor Cells for Low Handover Success Rate Detection parameter, this temporary NR neighbor cell is determined as a neighbor cell with a low handover success rate. If an NR neighbor cell is determined as a neighbor cell with a low handover or EN-DC success rate, it is added to the NR neighbor cell blacklist. In this case, the NR neighbor cell cannot be used as a target neighbor cell for handover or no EN-DC can occur in the NR neighbor cell.
item.name: tmpNRLowHoFailNumThrd

item.desc: If the number of failed EN-DC attempts in a temporary NR neighbor cell reaches or exceeds this threshold and the EN-DC success rate is lower than the Threshold of the EN-DC Success Rate in Temporary NR Neighbor Cells for Low EN-DC Success Rate Detection parameter, this temporary NR neighbor cell is determined as a neighbor cell with a low EN-DC success rate. If an NR neighbor cell is determined as a neighbor cell with a low handover or EN-DC success rate, it is added to the NR neighbor cell blacklist. In this case, the NR neighbor cell cannot be used as a target neighbor cell for handover or no EN-DC can occur in the NR neighbor cell.
item.name: tmpNRLowHoEndcFailNumThr

item.desc: If the success rate of handover in a temporary NR neighbor cell is lower than this threshold and the number of failed handovers in the temporary NR neighbor cell is equal to or larger than the Threshold Number of Failed Handovers in Temporary NR Neighbor Cells for Low Handover Success Rate Detection parameter, this temporary NR neighbor cell is determined as a neighbor cell with a low handover success rate. If an NR neighbor cell is determined as a neighbor cell with a low handover or EN-DC success rate, it is added to the NR neighbor cell blacklist. In this case, the NR neighbor cell cannot be used as a target neighbor cell for handover or no EN-DC can occur in the NR neighbor cell.
item.name: tmpNRLowHoSuccRateThrd

item.desc: If the success rate of EN-DC in a temporary NR neighbor cell is lower than this threshold and the number of failed EN-DC attempts in the temporary NR neighbor cell is equal to or larger than the Threshold Number of Failed EN-DC Attempts in Temporary NR Neighbor Cells for Low EN-DC Success Rate Detection parameter, this temporary NR neighbor cell is determined as a neighbor cell with a low EN-DC success rate. If an NR neighbor cell is determined as a neighbor cell with a low handover or EN-DC success rate, it is added to the NR neighbor cell blacklist. In this case, the NR neighbor cell cannot be used as a target neighbor cell for handover or no EN-DC can occur in the NR neighbor cell.
item.name: tmpNRLowHoEndcSucRateThr

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to identify ultra-long-distance NR neighbor cells. If it is set to Open, an NR neighbor cell is identified as an ultra-long-distance neighbor cell if the distance between the NR neighbor cell and the serving cell is longer than the distance threshold for ultra-long-distance NR neighbor cells.
item.name: nrOverDistantSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the distance threshold for identifying ultra-long-distance NR neighbor cells. If the distance between an NR neighbor cell and the serving cell is longer than this threshold, the NR neighbor cell is identified as an ultra-long-distance neighbor cell.
item.name: nrOverDistNbrThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the inter-system GERAN ANR function is supported. Close: not supported; Open: supported.
item.name: sonEnableGsmANR

item.desc: When the rsrp of GERAN unknown PCI exceeds this threshold, ANR perform ECGI measurement for the unknown PCI.
item.name: geranPciRssiThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for collecting statistics in inter-RAT GERAN neighbor relation addition/deletion. It is used to control the period during which the tasks for collecting statistics on handover and MR indicators of inter-RAT GERAN neighbor relations are executed. The unit of this parameter is the same as that of the Grade of ANR Statistic Timer Length parameter. When the eNodeB enables inter-RAT GERAN neighbor relation addition/deletion based on data collection, the timer is started. When the eNodeB disables inter-RAT GERAN neighbor relation addition/deletion based on data collection, the timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the eNodeB executes the filtering algorithm for inter-RAT GERAN neighbor relation addition/deletion.
item.name: gsmStatisticTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of times that the measurement reports of GERAN neighbor cells are reported. A GERAN temporary neighbor cell can be added to the formal neighbor cell list only when the number of times that the measurement reports are reported is larger than this threshold.
item.name: gsmNbrRptThrd

item.desc: This parameter indicates the GERAN handover request times threshold. The neighbor cell will be sorted by the number of handover success when its handover request number is higher than or equal to this threshold and handover success rate is higher than Handover Success Rate Threshold for GERAN Neighbor Cell Addition. Otherwise, it will be sorted by the number of measurement report.
item.name: gsmHoRequestThrd

item.desc: If the number of successful handovers to temporary neighbor cells reaches or exceeds the threshold, the neighbor cells are sorted in accordance with the number of successful handovers. Otherwise, the neighbor cells are sorted in accordance with the number of measurement reports.
item.name: gsmHoSuccThrd

item.desc: This parameter indicates the offset of the number of measurement reports during GERAN neighbor cell replacement. In the data collection and optimization of GERAN neighbor cells, the number of measurement reports of neighbor cells is used for data sorting. The number of measurement reports of neighbor cells can be used for data sorting only after subtracting this parameter value.
item.name: gsmTmpNbrMrNumOffset

item.desc: This parameter indicates the offset of the number of successful handovers during GERAN neighbor cell replacement. In the data collection and optimization of GERAN neighbor cells, the number of successful handovers of neighbor cells is used for data sorting. The number of successful handovers of neighbor cells can be used for data sorting only after subtracting this parameter value.
item.name: gsmNbrHys

item.desc: This parameter indicates handover success rate threshold for GERAN neighbor cell additoin. Only the neighbor cell whose handover success rate is higher than or equal to this threshold can be added to formal neighbor cell list.
item.name: geranHoSuccRateThrd

item.desc: If the inter-RAT GERAN ANR function is enabled, the number of formal neighbor cells cannot exceed the upper limit.
item.name: maxGsmNbrNum

item.desc: This parameter indicates The Number Threshold of GERAN Neighbor Cell Added Failure. When the continuous adding failure number is equal to or higher than this threshold, the eNodeB will not try to report this neighbor to OMC.
item.name: gsmNbrAddFailNumThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the GERAN fast ANR function is supported or not. Close: not supported; Open: supported.
item.name: gsmFastANRSwch

item.desc: The list of days for launching GSM fast ANR tasks in each month, where the value of each item (1-31) represents the day of task launching.
item.name: gsmFastAnrActDay

item.desc: Start time of GERAN fast ANR in one day.
item.name: gsmFastAnrStartTime

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for fast inter-RAT GERAN neighbor detection. It is used to configure the period during which a UE performs a fast GERAN neighbor measurement task. When the eNodeB delivers a fast inter-RAT GERAN neighbor measurement task, the timer is started. When the eNodeB stops fast inter-RAT GERAN neighbor discovery, the timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the eNodeB stops the fast inter-RAT GERAN neighbor measurement task.
item.name: gsmFastAnrCheckPeriod

item.desc: This parameter indicates the maximum number of frequencies in GERAN fast ANR measurement.
item.name: gsmFastAnrMeasFreqNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of polling measurements of GERAN ANR frequencies. When the numbers of polling measurements of all GERAN ANR frequencies reach the parameter value, GERAN fast ANR measurement will be stopped.
item.name: gsmFastAnrFreqMeasTimes

item.desc: The maximum number of UE measurement within GERAN Fast ANR detection period.
item.name: gsmFastAnrMeasUeNum

item.desc: The threshold of measurement report number to stop GERAN fast ANR measurement. In one GERAN fast ANR detection period, if there is no new unknown Arfcn have been found in continuous ucGsmFastAnrStopMeasUeNum measurement reports, GERAN fast ANR measurements will be stoped.
item.name: gsmFastAnrStopMeasUeNum

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to support the GERAN frequency update function. Close: not supported; Open: supported.
item.name: gsmFreqUpdateSwch

item.desc: This parameter select the frequency of first N neighbor cell sorted by the number of mesurementreport to update, the N is The Threshold of CSFB Frequency Update.
item.name: csfbFreqUpdateNum

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to support the modification of reselected GERAN frequencies when GERAN frequency update is enabled.
item.name: isUpdateGsmRslFreq

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable the no-handover-success GERAN neighbor relation detection function. If it is set to Open, the no-handover-success GERAN neighbor relation detection function is enabled; otherwise, the no-handover-success GERAN neighbor relation detection function is disabled.
item.name: gsmNoSuccHoDetectSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable the continuous handover failure detection function for GERAN neighbor cells. If it is set to Open, it indicates that the continuous handover failure detection function is enabled for GERAN neighbor cells. If it is set to Close, it indicates that the continuous handover failure detection function is disabled for GERAN neighbor cells.
item.name: gsmHoFailDetectSwch

item.desc: When the number of continuous handover failures on a formal GERAN neighbor cell or a temporary GERAN neighbor cell is larger than or equal to the threshold, further processing will be performed.
item.name: gsmHoFailNumThrd

item.desc: This parameter indicates whether to enable low handover rate GERAN NBR detection function.
item.name: gsmLowHoSuccRateDetectSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the detection algorithm used for the detection of the GERAN neighbor cells with a low handover success rate. In the scenario with a small number of handovers and a low handover success rate, it is recommended that this parameter be set to Based on the number of handover failures and handover success rate, meaning that the detection is based on the number of failed handovers and the handover success rate. In other scenarios, it is recommended that this parameter be set to Based on the number of handover requests and handover success rate, meaning that the detection is based on the number of handover requests and the handover success rate.
item.name: gsmLowHoSuccRateAlg

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for detecting the inter-RAT GERAN neighbor relations with a low handover success rate. It is used to control the period during which the tasks for collecting statistics on handover indicators of inter-RAT regular and temporary GERAN neighbor relations are executed. The unit of this parameter is the same as that of the Grade of ANR Statistic Timer Length parameter. When the eNodeB enables the detection of the inter-RAT GERAN neighbor relations with a low handover success rate, the timer is started. When the eNodeB disables the detection of the inter-RAT GERAN neighbor relations with a low handover success rate, the timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the eNodeB executes the algorithm for detecting the inter-RAT GERAN neighbor relations with a low handover success rate.
item.name: gsmLowHoSuccRateDetectPeriod

item.desc: A GERAN NBR will be detected as low handover success rate NBR if the handover times is larger than or equal to this parameter and the handover success rate is lower than or equal to the Handover Success Rate Threshold of Low Handover Success Rate GERAN NBR Detection.
item.name: gsmHoNumThrdForLowHORate

item.desc: If the number of failed handovers of a GERAN neighbor cell reaches or exceeds this threshold and the handover success rate is lower than the handover success rate detection threshold of GERAN neighbor cells with a low handover success rate, this neighbor cell is a neighbor cell with a low handover success rate.
item.name: gsmHoFailNumTdLowHoRate

item.desc: This parameter indicates handover success rate threshold of low handover success rate GERAN neighbour cell detection. The neighbor cell will be detected as low handover success rate neighbour cell if the handover times is larger than or equal to Handover Times Threshold of Low Handover Success Rate GERAN Neighbor Cell Detection and the handover success rate is lower than or equal to this parameter.
item.name: gsmLowHoSuccRateDetectThrd

item.desc: This parameter indicates handover success rate threshold of low handover success rate GERAN neighbour cell recovery. The low handover success rate neighbor cell will be recovered if the handover times is larger than or equal to Handover Times Threshold of Low Handover Success Rate GERAN Neighbor Cell Detection and the handover success rate is higher than this parameter.
item.name: gsmLowHoSuccRateRecoverThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets whether handover is allowed for normal GERAN neighbor cells with low handover success rates. If this parameter is set to No support HO, handover is not allowed for normal neighbor cells with low handover success rates. If this parameter is set to Support HO, handover is allowed for normal neighbor cells with low handover success rates.
item.name: gsmLowHoSuccRateNBRNoHo

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the penalty timer for the inter-RAT GERAN neighbor relations with a low handover success rate. It is used to control the penalty period during which UEs cannot be handed over to the inter-RAT GERAN neighbor relations with a low handover success rate. The unit of this parameter is the same as that of the Grade of ANR Statistic Timer Length parameter. When an inter-RAT GERAN neighbor relation is detected as a neighbor relation with a low handover success rate and the number of penalties is smaller than the threshold, this timer is started. When the eNodeB disables the detection of the inter-RAT GERAN neighbor relations with a low handover success rate, this timer is stopped. After the timer times out, UEs can be handed over to the punished inter-RAT GERAN neighbor relations.
item.name: gsmNoHoPunishTimer

item.desc: When the number of times that a GERAN neighbor cell is detected as a neighbor cell with a low handover success rate reaches the threshold, the neighbor relation cannot be automatically recovered from the list of neighbor cells with a low handover success rate.
item.name: gsmNoHoPunishNumThrd

item.desc: This parameter indicates The Switch of GERAN Neighbor Cell Adding Filter. When the switch is set to Open, the OMC will not add the neighbor which is over distance; eNodeB will not report the neighbor to OMC which the failure number of adding to OMC reached the The Threshold of GERAN Neighbor Cell Add Failure Times.
item.name: gsmNbrAddCtrlSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the distance between the serving cell and a GERAN cell to be added as a neighbor cell of the serving cell. If the distance is larger than this threshold, the GERAN cell cannot be added to the neighbor cell list of the serving cell.
item.name: gsmNbrAddDistThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the Inter-RAT UTRAN ANR function is supported. Close: not supported; Open: supported.
item.name: sonEnableUtraANR

item.desc: In the UTRAN unknown PCI measurement result, when the RSRP of the serving cell exceeds the threshold, ANR performs ECGI measurement for the unknown PCI.
item.name: lteUtranPciSrvRsrpThrd

item.desc: The ANR performs ECGI measurement on an unknown UTRAN PCI only when the RSCP value of the PCI is larger than this threshold.
item.name: utranPciRscpThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for collecting statistics in inter-RAT UTRAN neighbor relation addition/deletion. It is used to control the period during which the tasks for collecting statistics on handover and MR indicators of inter-RAT UTRAN neighbor relations are executed. The unit of this parameter is the same as that of the Grade of ANR Statistic Timer Length parameter. When the eNodeB enables inter-RAT UTRAN neighbor relation addition/deletion based on data collection, the timer is started. When the eNodeB disables inter-RAT UTRAN neighbor relation addition/deletion based on data collection, the timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the eNodeB executes the filtering algorithm for inter-RAT UTRAN neighbor relation addition/deletion.
item.name: utranStatisticTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of times that the measurement reports of UTRAN neighbor cells are reported. If the number of times that handover to a temporary neighbor cell succeeds is smaller than the The Threshold of UTRAN Handover Success Number, the temporary neighbor cell can be added to the formal neighbor cell list only when the number of times that the measurement reports are reported is larger than or equal to this threshold.
item.name: utranNbrRptThrd

item.desc: This parameter indicates the UTRAN handover request times threshold. The neighbor cell will be sorted by the number of handover success when its handover request number is higher than or equal to this threshold and handover success rate is higher than Handover Success Rate Threshold for UTRAN Neighbor Cell Addition. Otherwise, it will be sorted by the number of measurement report.
item.name: utranHoRequestThrd

item.desc: If the number of successful handovers to temporary neighbor cells is larger than or equal to the threshold, the neighbor cells are sorted in accordance with the number of successful handovers. Otherwise, the neighbor cells are sorted in accordance with the number of measurement reports.
item.name: utranHoSuccThrd

item.desc: This parameter indicates the offset of the number of measurement reports during UTRAN neighbor cell replacement. In the data collection and optimization of UTRAN neighbor cells, the number of measurement reports of neighbor cells is used for data sorting. The number of measurement reports of neighbor cells can be used for data sorting only after subtracting this parameter value.
item.name: utranTmpNbrMrNumOffset

item.desc: This parameter indicates the offset of the number of successful handovers during UTRAN neighbor cell replacement. In the data collection and optimization of UTRAN neighbor cells, the number of successful handovers of neighbor cells is used for data sorting. The number of successful handovers of neighbor cells can be used for data sorting only after subtracting this parameter value.
item.name: utraNbrHys

item.desc: This parameter indicates handover success rate threshold for UTRAN neighbor cell additoin. Only the neighbor cell whose handover success rate is higher than or equal to this threshold can be added to formal neighbor cell list.
item.name: utranHoSuccRateThrd

item.desc: If the inter-RAT UTRAN ANR function is enabled, the number of formal neighbor cells cannot exceed the upper limit.
item.name: maxUtranNbrNum

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the replacement of inter-RAT UTRAN ANR neighbor cells by frequency. If it is set to Open and the UTRAN ANR feature takes effect, the UTRAN ANR function sorts and replaces neighbor cells by frequency. If it is set to Close, the UTRAN ANR function can replace neighbor cells only by cell.
item.name: utraANRFreqRepSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets how to generate a user label of a neighbor relation when an LTE neighbor relation or an NR neighbor relation is added. If it is set to 0 (Serving cell information), it indicates that the user labels of neighbor relations need to be configured in accordance with the user labels of the serving cell. If it is set to 1 (Serving cell and neighbor cell information), it indicates that the user labels of neighbor relations need to be configured in accordance with the user labels of the serving cell and its neighbor cells.
item.name: nbrUserLabelGenMode

item.desc: This parameter sets the UTRAN neighbor cell supported PS HO attribute of the UTRAN neighbor cells added by the ANR function. If it is set to 1 (Yes), the UTRAN neighbor cell supported PS HO attribute of the UTRAN neighbor cells added by the ANR function is set to 1 (Yes), and the UTRAN neighbor cells support the PS handover capability. If it is set to 0 (No), the UTRAN neighbor cell supported PS HO attribute of the UTRAN neighbor cells added by the ANR function is set to 0 (No), and the UTRAN neighbor cells do not support the PS handover capability. In this case, no PS handover can be performed on the UEs to UTRAN neighbor cells.
item.name: utranNbrPSHOFlag

item.desc: This parameter sets the HSUPA and HSDPA supported attribute of the UTRAN neighbor cells added by the ANR function. The value of the HSUPA and HSDPA supported attribute of a UTRAN neighbor cell to be added by the ANR function must be the same as this parameter value.
item.name: utranNbrHSPAInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of handovers to trigger information update of GERAN neighbor cells. If GERAN neighbor cells are updated based on handover indicators (the GsmNbrUpdateMode parameter is set to 1 (Update based on handover indicators)), the number of times that UEs are handed over to a GERAN neighbor cell is larger than or equal to this threshold, and the handover failure rate is higher than or equal to the value of the GSMUpdateHoFailRateThrd (Handover Failure Rate Threshold to Trigger GERAN Neighbor Cell Information Update) parameter, information update of the GERAN neighbor cell can be triggered.
item.name: gsmNbrUpdateHoThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the information update type of GERAN neighbor cells. If this parameter is set to 0 (Update Immediately), it indicates that the information about GERAN neighbor cells is updated immediately. If this parameter is set to 1 (Update based on handover indicators), it indicates that the information about GERAN neighbor cells is updated based on handover indicators.
item.name: gsmNbrUpdateMode

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the handover failure rate to trigger information update of GERAN neighbor cells. If GERAN neighbor cells are updated based on handover indicators (the GsmNbrUpdateMode parameter is set to 1 (Update based on handover indicators)), the handover failure rate of a GERAN neighbor cell is higher than or equal to this threshold, and the number of times that UEs are handed over to a GERAN neighbor cell is larger than or equal to the value of the gsmNbrUpdateHoThrd (Threshold Number of Handovers to Trigger GERAN Neighbor Cell Information Update) parameter, information update of the GERAN neighbor cell can be triggered.
item.name: gSMUpdateHoFailRateThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable temporary-neighbor addition by using the ECGI measurement results in intra-LTE coverage-based handover enhancement scenarios. If it is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB adds the neighbor cells that are detected by using the ECGI measurement results to the neighbor relation.
item.name: eCGIMeasHoNbrAddSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of measurement reports of intra-RAT unknown PCIs. Within the measurement period of intra-RAT unknown PCIs, if the number of valid measurement reports is larger than or equal to this parameter value, the system determines whether to deliver ECGI measurement information based on the signal strength of the serving cell and unknown neighbor cells.
item.name: unknowPciMrStatNumThrd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables measurement data collection of intra-RAT unknown PCIs. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the number of valid measurement reports is counted within the measurement period of intra-RAT unknown PCIs. If the number of valid measurement reports is larger than or equal to the threshold specified by the unknowPciMrStatNumThrd (Threshold Number of Measurement Reports of Intra-RAT Unknown PCIs) parameter, the system determines whether to deliver ECGI measurement information based on the signal strength of the serving cell and unknown neighbor cells. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the system determines whether to deliver ECGI measurement information based on the signal strength of the serving cell and unknown neighbor cells.
item.name: unknowPciMrStatSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRP threshold for the measurement of intra-RAT unknown PCIs. If the RSRP of a neighbor cell with an unknown PCI is larger than or equal to this threshold, the measurement report is regarded to be valid.
item.name: unknowPciMrStatRsrpThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the measurement data collection period of intra-RAT unknown PCIs. The unit of this parameter is the same as that of the statisticTimerGrade parameter.
item.name: unknowPciMrStatPrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration for the SON policy to wait for a manual response to a breakpoint. When a breakpoint is hit, the timer is started to wait for a manual response. If the SON function is enabled and the SON policy is set to Controlled Mode, this timer is started. If the SON function is disabled and the SON policy is set to Free Mode, this timer is stopped. Before the timer times our, if a manual response is received or the SON function stops, the timer is stopped. After the timer times out, the follow-up actions of the procedure depend on the breakpoint timeout policy.

item.desc: This parameter sets the service type, 21 for PnP, 26 for SH, 43 for CS, 46 for ANR, 47 for PCI, 48 for X2, 49 for MRO, 50 for CCO, 51 for RO, 52 for MLB, 57 for ES, and 58 for MAGICRADIO.

item.desc: Run Mode
item.name: sonRunMode

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for deleting redundant neighbor cells. When the eNodeB enables the deletion of redundant neighbor cells, the timer is started. When the eNodeB disables the deletion of redundant neighbor cells, the timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the eNodeB executes the redundant-neighbor deletion algorithm.
item.name: redNclDelPrd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the deletion of the redundant neighbor cells in intra-LTE.
item.name: lteRedNrDelSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the deletion of redundant inter-RAT NR neighbor cells.
item.name: nRRedNrDelSwch

item.desc: The process of the deletion of redundancy adjacent cells in Inter-system GERAN is determined by this switch.
item.name: gsmRedNrDelSwch

item.desc: The process of the deletion of redundancy adjacent cells in Inter-system UTRAN is determined by this switch.
item.name: utranRedNrDelSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the duration of the timer for reporting the OMC to query neighbor cell attributes. It is used to set the interval for querying intra-RAT and inter-RAT NR neighbor cell attributes. The unit should be consistent with the The Grade of ANR Statistic Timer Length parameter. When the eNodeB enables the OMC-based neighbor cell attribute update function, this timer is started. When the eNodeB disables the OMC-based neighbor cell attribute update function, this timer is stopped. After the timer expires, the eNodeB report the query of neighbor cell attributes to the OMC.
item.name: nbrAttrQueryPrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the time granularity for collecting ANR statistics.
item.name: staticTimerGrade

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of neighbor cells that is queried within a neighbor-cell attribute query period. It is used to control the maximum number of neighbor cells that is queried on the UME and reported by an NE during neighbor-cell attribute query.
item.name: maxNbrRptNum

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the update of intra-RAT neighbor cell attributes. If it is set to Open, the attributes of LTE neighbor cells are obtained through information query on the UME and are updated.
item.name: lteNbrUpdateSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the update of inter-RAT NR neighbor cell attributes. If it is set to Open, the attributes of NR neighbor cells are obtained through information query on the UME and are updated.
item.name: nrNbrUpdateSwch
