item.name: sonPolicyId

item.desc: This parameter sets the service type, 21 for PnP, 26 for SH, 43 for CS, 46 for ANR, 47 for PCI, 48 for X2, 49 for MRO, 50 for CCO, 51 for RO, 52 for MLB, 57 for ES, and 58 for MAGICRADIO.
item.name: sonFuncId

item.desc: Run Mode
item.name: sonRunMode

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables PCI detection. By default, it is set to Close. If it is set to Open, the PCI detection of the corresponding serving cell is enabled and PCI conflict and confusion detection is allowed in the serving cell. PCI conflict and confusion detection is used to detect whether there is PCI conflict between the serving cell and its neighbors and whether there is PCI confusion between the neighbor cells of the serving cell. To detect PCI conflict and confusion, this parameter is set to Open.
item.name: pciDetectSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to resolve a PCI conflict when the PCI conflict is detected by the PCI function.
item.name: sonEnablePCI

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to resolve PCI confusion. If the parameter is set to Open, PCI confusion will be resolved by the system. If the parameter is set to Close, PCI confusion will not be resolved by the system.
item.name: confusionSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the way for resolve the PCI conflict or PCI confusion.
item.name: sonResolveManner

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of PCI timing detection by UE. If the switch is open, the PCI detection by UE will be performed according to the configuration of the related parameters.
item.name: enablePeriodicDetect

item.desc: The list of months for executing PCI air interface confusion detection, where the value of each item (1-12) represents the month of task detection executing.
item.name: pciConfusionActMonth

item.desc: The list of days for executing PCI air interface confusion detection in a month, where the value of each item (1-31) represents the day of detection executing.
item.name: pciConfusionActDay

item.desc: If scheduled PCI detection on radio links is enabled, the eNodeB performs PCI conflict detection on radio links at the time specified by this parameter.
item.name: timerForDetectECGI

item.desc: This parameter sets the end time for ECGI detection on neighbor cells by PCI (hour:minute). If the end time is equal to or earlier than the start time, it indicates the end time of the detection on the next day.
item.name: endTimeForDetectECGI

item.desc: This parameter is a period interval for detecting ECGI for the known neighbor cell. If the value of this parameter is the figure in 1-23, which means the period interval is the figure and the unit is hour, when the value is 0, the period interval will be configured 20 minutes.
item.name: periodicDetectInterval

item.desc: This parameter is a period number for detecting ECGI for the known neighbor cell.
item.name: periodicDetectCounter

item.desc: This parameter indicates the maximum number of UEs choosed in each ECGI measurement for PCI detection.
item.name: pciMeasUeCnt

item.desc: When detect PCI confusion, eNodeB will select some UEs to measure the neighbor cell's ECGI.This parameter indicates the maximum times of allowed measurements for each detected neighbor cell.
item.name: pciMeasObjChoiceCnt

item.desc: The switch of resovling PCI conflict or confusion, if this switch is open, the PCI conflict or confusion will be resolved at the appointed time.
item.name: enableReslvPCIByTimer

item.desc: This parameter indicates the earliest time for PCI appointed resolve, when the switch of resovling PCI conflict or confusion is open.
item.name: timerForReslvPCI

item.desc: This parameter indicates the latest time for PCI appointed resolve, when the switch of resovling PCI conflict or confusion is open.
item.name: endTimerForReslvPCI

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the NR PCI confusion detection based on configurations. If it is set to Open, an LTE cell can detect whether the PCIs of two NR neighbor cells that are configured with the NR neighbor relation are confused. If it is set to Close, PCI confusion detection is disabled.
item.name: eNDCConfusionDetectSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the NR PCI confusion detection based on the air interface. If it is set to Open, it indicates that an LTE cell can detect whether PCI confusion exists on the air interface of the NR cell that is configured with an NR neighbor relation. If it is set to Close, PCI confusion detection is disabled.
item.name: nrConfusionDetectByAir

item.desc: This parameter sets the month when air-interface NR PCI neighbor cell confusion detection is enabled. If air-interface-based NR PCI confusion detection is enabled, the nrPCIConfusionActDay parameter determines the specific date when air-interface-based NR PCI confusion detection is enabled in a year. Each Bit indicates a month. When the bit is set to 1, it indicates that air-interface NR PCI confusion detection is enabled in the month. Otherwise, air-interface PCI confusion detection is disabled in this month. For example, Bit0 indicates whether the function is enabled in January. Bit1 indicates whether the function is enabled in February. By analogy, Bit12 indicates whether the function is enabled in December.
item.name: nrPCIConfusionActMonth

item.desc: This parameter sets the dates of each month on which an air-interface-based PCI confusion detection task of NR neighbor cells is enabled. It is a 31-bit switch parameter. Bit 0: Whether PCI confusion detection is enabled on the first day. Bit 1: Whether PCI confusion detection is enabled on the second day. Bit 2: Whether PCI confusion detection is enabled on the third day, and so on. Bit 30: Whether PCI confusion detection is enabled on the thirty-first day.
item.name: nrPCIConfusionActDay

item.desc: This parameter sets the time at which the NR PCI confusion detection based on the air interface starts. If air-interface-based NR PCI confusion detection is enabled, the system starts air-interface-based NR PCI confusion detection at the time configured by this parameter on the specified date.
item.name: timerForDetectNrNCGI

item.desc: This parameter sets the time at which the NR PCI confusion detection based on the air interface stops. If air-interface-based NR PCI confusion detection is enabled, the system stops air-interface-based NR PCI confusion detection at the time configured by this parameter on the specified date.
item.name: endTimeForDetectNrNCGI

item.desc: This parameter sets the time for performing one-time NR PCI confusion detection on all the to-be-detected neighbor cells of the serving cell within the air-interface PCI confusion detection time. Within the period from the start time to the end time of air-interface-based NR PCI confusion detection, when the air-interface-based NR PCI confusion detection period set by this parameter ends, the next air-interface-based NR PCI confusion detection period starts immediately. When the end time of air-interface-based NR PCI confusion detection expires, the air-interface-based NR PCI confusion detection ends.
item.name: periodicDetectNrInterval

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of times that air-interface (PCI+ frequency) confusion detection is performed for the NR neighbor cells to be detected. If the number of NCGI measurements of each neighbor cell (PCI+ frequency) to be detected on the air interface reaches the parameter value, the air-interface confusion detection of the neighbor cell (PCI+ frequency) is stopped within the air-interface NR PCI confusion detection period.
item.name: nrPCIMeasObjChoiceCnt

item.desc: This parameter sets the upper limit of the number of UEs that are simultaneously used for NR PCI confusion detection within an air interface NR PCI confusion detection period. When the number of selected UEs reaches the parameter value, the gNodeB does not deliver measurement tasks related to PCI confusion detection to the UEs that newly access or are handed over into the cell.
item.name: nrPCIMeasUeCnt

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRP condition to trigger PCI confusion detection in the neighbor cells that report periodical NR measurement results. If the PCI reported by periodical NR measurement is the PCI of the neighbor cell to be detected for PCI confusion and the RSRP corresponding to the PCI is larger than or equal to this parameter value, the RSRP corresponding to the PCI meets the condition for triggering PCI confusion detection.
item.name: nrPciNbrRsrpFilterThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the type to select low-performance neighbor cells for NR PCI confusion detection. If this parameter is set to None, all the NR neighbor cells can be selected as the target neighbor cells for PCI confusion detection. If this parameter is set to NR PCI Low-performance Statistics Neighbor Cell, only the NR neighbor cells collected by the NR PCI function can be selected as the low-performance neighbor cells for NR PCI confusion detection. If this parameter is set to NR Neighbor Cell in ANR Black List, only the NR neighbor cells with a low handover success rate in the ANR blacklist can be selected as the low-performance neighbor cells for NR PCI confusion detection. If this parameter is set to All, the NR neighbor cells that meet the preceding two conditions can be selected as the low-performance neighbor cells for NR PCI confusion detection.
item.name: nrPciLowPerformNbrType

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the handover success rate of the neighbor cells to be detected in NR PCI confusion detection. It is one of the conditions for an NR neighbor cell to be selected as the target neighbor cell for PCI confusion detection. If the success rate where UEs are handed over from an LTE cell to an NR neighbor cell and the success rate of DC addition are less than or equal to the threshold set by this parameter, the neighbor cell may be selected as the target neighbor cell for PCI confusion detection; otherwise, the neighbor cell cannot be selected as the target neighbor cell for PCI confusion detection.
item.name: hoSuccRateThrdForNrPci

item.desc: This parameter sets the update period of the low-performance neighbor cell list for NR PCI confusion detection. At the end of each statistical period, the low-performance neighbor cell list for NR PCI confusion detection is updated based on the statistical result.
item.name: nrPciListUpdatePrd

item.desc: This parameter sets one of the conditions for an NR neighbor cell to be selected as the target neighbor cell for PCI confusion detection. If the number of times that UEs fail to be handed over from an LTE cell to an NR neighbor cell and the number of DC addition failures reaches the threshold set by this parameter, the neighbor cell may be selected as the target neighbor cell for PCI confusion detection; otherwise, the neighbor cell cannot be selected as the target neighbor cell for PCI confusion detection.
item.name: hoFailNumThrdForNrPci

item.desc: Threshold of Distance for PCI Reallocation(m)
item.name: pciDistThrd

item.desc: This parameter indicates the threshold of handover attempt for PCI reallocation.
item.name: pciHoThrd

item.desc: This parameter indicates the threshold of handover success rate for PCI reallocation.
item.name: pciHoSuccRateThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to perform PCI conflict and confusion detection for NEs. To avoid network faults caused by conflict or confusion of NE PCIs, you can set this parameter to 1 (Open). For NEs on which the detection is enabled, the UME system periodically detects whether there is any PCI conflict or confusion.
item.name: centralizedPciDetectSwitch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables LTE PCI conflict and confusion detection based on formal neighbor cells and temporary neighbor cells. If it is set to Open, it indicates that an LTE cell can detect whether PCI conflicts and confusion exist in formal LTE neighbor cells and temporary LTE neighbor cells. If it is set to Close, it indicates that an LTE cell can detect whether PCI conflicts and confusion exist in formal LTE neighbor cells.
item.name: pciLteEnhanceDetect

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables NR PCI confusion detection based on formal neighbor cells and temporary neighbor cells. If it is set to Open, it indicates that an LTE cell can detect whether PCI confusion exists in formal NR neighbor cells and temporary NR neighbor cells. If it is set to Close, it indicates that an LTE cell can detect whether PCI confusion exists in formal NR neighbor cells.
item.name: pciNrEnhanceDetect

item.desc: This parameter sets the service type, 21 for PnP, 26 for SH, 43 for CS, 46 for ANR, 47 for PCI, 48 for X2, 49 for MRO, 50 for CCO, 51 for RO, 52 for MLB, 57 for ES, and 58 for MAGICRADIO.

item.desc: This parameter sets the time granularity of the MRO statistics period.
item.name: statisticTimerGrade

item.desc: This is a parameter for MRO switch
item.name: sonEnableMro

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for the eNodeB to collect statistics on handover failures in a cell. During this period, the eNodeB counts the number of times that the same handover failure occurs in a cell. When MRO optimization is enabled, this timer is started. When MRO optimization is disabled, this timer is stopped. After the timer times out, data collection on MRO self-optimization starts.
item.name: sonStatisticTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of optimized neighbor cells for the serving cell. It is used for MRO optimization, indicating the threshold of the number of neighbor cells that can be optimized for the serving cell in a fault detection period.
item.name: maxOptCellNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the lower limit of the parameter scope accumulatively adjusted by MRO. The parameters adjusted by MRO can not exceed the lower limit.
item.name: mroTotalAdjustLow

item.desc: This parameter sets the upper limit of the parameter scope accumulatively adjusted by MRO. The parameters adjusted by MRO cannot exceed the upper limit.
item.name: mroTotalAdjustHigh

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the total number of handover out. It is used for the MRO function, indicating that MRO optimization is performed when the number of handover out from the serving cell to neighbor cell reaches the threshold.
item.name: hoNumThrd

item.desc: If the difference between the fault rate of Too Early Handover and the fault rate of Too Late Handover is larger than or equal to the threshold, MRO optimization can be started. The MRO alarm subtype depends on the parameter.
item.name: mroAbnmOptThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for triggering ping-pong handover parameter optimization. When the ratio of ping-pong handover is larger than or equal to the threshold, the MRO ping-pong handover parameter optimization is triggered.
item.name: pingPongOptThrd

item.desc: This parameter works with the HO Fault Ratio Threshold to Trigger MRO Warning parameter. If the total number of handovers from the serving cell to neighbor cell is larger than the threshold and the MRO handover fault ratio from the serving cell to neighbor cell is larger than HO Fault Ratio Threshold to Trigger MRO Warning, the eNodeB will report an MRO alarm.
item.name: warnHONumThrd

item.desc: This parameter is used together with the Total Handover Out Number Threshold to Trigger MRO Warning parameter. If the number of times that handover is performed from the serving cell to neighbor cells is larger than or equal to the value of Total Handover Out Number Threshold to Trigger MRO Warning and the MRO handover fault rate from the serving cell to neighbor cells is larger than or equal to the threshold, the eNB will report an MRO alarm.
item.name: mroWarnPPHoFaultThrd

item.desc: This parameter is used together with the Total Handover Out Number Threshold to Trigger MRO Warning parameter. If the number of times that handover is performed from the serving cell to neighbor cells is larger than the value of Total Handover Out Number Threshold to Trigger MRO Warning and the MRO handover fault rate from the serving cell to neighbor cells is higher than the threshold, the eNB will report an MRO alarm.
item.name: mroWarnAbnmHoFaultThrd

item.desc: Whether to Switch on MRO Function According to KPI
item.name: enableMROByKPI

item.desc: Period of OAM Statistics KPI
item.name: kpiStatPeriod

item.desc: RRC Re-Establishment Threshold to Trigger MRO
item.name: mroReestTimeThrd

item.desc: Handover Out Number Threshold to Trigger MRO
item.name: mrohoOutTimeThrd

item.desc: Handover Success Ratio Threshold to Trigger MRO
item.name: mrohoSucRatio

item.desc: Call Drop Rate to Trigger MRO
item.name: mroDropCallRatio

item.desc: This parameter is the Inter-RAT UTRAN MRO function switch. If the parameter sets as Open the Inter-RAT MRO function becomes valid. If the parameter sets as Close, the Inter-RAT MRO function becomes invalid.
item.name: utraMROEnable

item.desc: This parameter sets the period during which the eNodeB counts Inter-RAT cell handover failures. During the period, the eNodeB counts the number of times that the same handover fault occurs in cell.
item.name: iRatStatisticTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for MRO parameter self-optimization. It is used to control the minimum interval between the self-optimization of MRO parameters. In most cases, it should be twice the statistical period. When MRO optimization is enabled, this timer is started. When MRO optimization is disabled, this timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the next parameter optimization start.
item.name: iRatIntervalTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the ratio of too-early handover neighbor cells. If the proportion between the number of too-early inter-RAT handovers and the total number of unnecessary handovers on the same carrier frequency is less than the parameter value, the OFN parameter of the carrier frequency cannot be optimized.
item.name: iRatOfnRatioThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of too-early handovers. If the number of too-early handovers for one neighbor cell is larger than the threshold, it is considered that the neighbor cell has the too-early handover fault.
item.name: iRatWarnThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the ratio of too-early handover neighbor cells. If the proportion between the number of neighbor cells of too-early inter-RAT handover and the total number of neighbor cells on the same carrier frequency is less than the parameter value, the OFN parameter of the carrier frequency cannot be optimized.
item.name: nbrWarnRatioThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the coefficient of converting unnecessary Inter-RAT handover to too-late Intra-RAT handover on the premise that there are Inter-RAT handover scenarios.
item.name: iRatConvCoeff

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum cumulative adjustment value made by Inter-RAT MRO OFN parameter optimization. The cumulative adjustment value can not exceed the threshold.
item.name: interRatOfnTotalAdjust

item.desc: This parameter is a threshold of serving cell's result of rsrp measurement ue camped recently. If serving cell's rsrp is less than threshold, there may be some problems of cover on serving cell. The serving cell's rsrp ue camped recently, can be obtained from ue information response msg or ue's measurement reporting.
item.name: ccoLastServRsrpThd

item.desc: This parameter sets the measured RSRP threshold for the neighbor cells of UEs. If the measured RSRP value of a neighbor cell of a UE is less than the threshold, the coverage of the neighbor cell is considered to be faulty. The measured RSRP values of a neighbor cell of a UE can be obtained from the UE Information Response message or the UE's measurement reports.
item.name: ccoNbrRsrpThd

item.desc: This parameter sets the counter for monitoring RO resource data. When the RACH information collection timer is started, the counter starts. The eNodeB collects statistics on the related information until the timer expires.
item.name: sonROResCounter

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for RACH Optimization (RO) resource allocation and monitoring. When the timer is started, the eNodeB collects statistics on RACH information until the timer times out. When RO is enabled, this timer is started. When RO is disabled, this timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the eNodeB stops collecting statistics on PRACH information.

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of RO logic root sequence optimization, which can be used to control whether to optimize the logic root sequence.

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to reserve SCTP. If this parameter is set to Not Reserved, SCTP is not reserved. If this parameter is set to Reserved, SCTP is reserved.
item.name: reserveSctpSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the number of reserved SCTP associations in the scenario where the maximum number of SCTPs (288) is not applicable. The reserved SCTP associations cannot be used for X2 self-configuration.
item.name: s1SctpNum

item.desc: This parameter indicates the number of reserved SCTP associations only in the scenario where the maximum number of SCTPs (288) is applicable. The reserved SCTP associations cannot be used for X2 self-configuration.
item.name: s1SctpNumExpanded

item.desc: This parameter is used to set the grade of X2 Statistic Timer Length.
item.name: statisticTimerGrade

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum delay in enabling X2 self-setup. It is used to control the delay in enabling immediate X2 addition and X2 data collection optimization, in minutes. When immediate X2 addition or X2 data collection optimization is enabled, this timer is started. Before the timer times out, the immediate X2 addition or X2 data collection optimization function does not take any action. When immediate X2 addition or X2 data collection optimization is disabled, the timer is stopped. After the timer times out, an X2 link starts to be added through immediate X2 addition and the number of handovers starts to be counted through X2 data collection optimization.
item.name: startDelayTimerLen

item.desc: When the time lenth of X2 invalid state meet this parameter, trigger X2 deleted.
item.name: x2InvalidDelTimerLen

item.desc: If this parameter is set to Direct Delete, invalid X2 links are deleted immediately. If this parameter is set to Delay Delete, invalid X2 links are deleted after a delay.
item.name: invalidX2DelMode

item.desc: This parameter sets the DSCP value for SCTP link addition through X2 self-configuration.
item.name: dscp

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables immediate X2 addition based on neighbor relations. If it is set to Open, an X2 association is added immediately if there are inter-site neighbor relations but no X2 association is operating properly.
item.name: x2DirectAddSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables immediate X2 deletion. If it is set to Open, an X2 association is deleted immediately if there are inter-site X2 associations that are operating properly but there is no neighbor relation.
item.name: x2DirectDelSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables automatic invalid-association deletion. If this parameter is set to Open, invalid X2 associations are deleted automatically.
item.name: x2InvalidDelSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables X2 association optimization based on data collection. If this parameter is set to Open, X2 associations are optimized after a statistical period expires.
item.name: x2StatisticOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the data collection timer when the optimization for X2 data collection is enabled. The unit of this parameter is determined by the Grade of X2 Statistic Timer Length parameter. When X2 data collection optimization is enabled, this timer is started. When X2 data collection optimization is disabled, this timer is stopped. Before the timer times out, the X2 data collection optimization function counts the number of successful handovers between the current eNodeB and eNodeBs. After the timer times out, the X2 data collection optimization function adds or deletes X2 associations based on the counted number of handovers.
item.name: statisticTimer

item.desc: This parameter is the difference threshold between the two value. One is the HO number between the adding eNB and this eNB, the other is the HO number between the replacing eNB and this eNB.
item.name: hoNumThrdOfX2Opt

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of X2 connections allowed to added or deleted in each statistics period.
item.name: numOfX2AddDelCnt

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables neighbor sorting on the passive eNodeB with X2 links based on the number of handovers. If it is set to Open, the passive eNodeB receives an X2 addition request when the number of X2 links reaches the maximum value configured for the passive eNodeB. If the active eNodeB is in the top N ranking queue of the passive eNodeB, the passive eNodeB replaces the X2 link with that with the minimum number of handovers or with an invalid X2 link. If the active eNodeB is not in the top N ranking queue of the passive eNodeB, it refuses to add the X2 link. The value N is the maximum number of X2 links that can be configured for the current eNodeB.
item.name: psvSortOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to establish IPSec channels between LTE systems in the X2 self-setup procedure. If it is set to Not Use IPSec, no IPSec tunnel is established in the X2 self-setup procedure. If it is set to Use IPSec, IPSec tunnels are established in the X2 self-setup procedure.
item.name: x2IPSecSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to delete repeated X2 links of neighbor cells.
item.name: dupliNbrEnbDelSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the detection timer for the deletion of duplicated X2 associations of neighbor sites. Its unit is determined by the Grade of X2 Statistic Timer Length parameter. This timer is started when the Deletion of Repeated X2 Links parameter is set to Open and it is stopped when the Deletion of Repeated X2 Links parameter is set to Close. When this timer expires, the system detects whether there are duplicated X2 associations between the current eNodeB and all its neighbor sites. If yes, only one X2 association is kept, the remaining X2 associations are deleted, and then the timer is started again.
item.name: dupliNbrEnbDelPrd

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of the EN-DC X2 direct self-setup function. If the parameter is set to Open, the function is enabled. If the parameter is set to Close, the function is disabled.
item.name: enDcX2DirectAddSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of the EN-DC X2 direct deletion function. If the parameter is set to Open, the EN-DC X2 direct deletion function is enabled. In this case, any EN-DC X2 satisfying the deletion condition can be deleted. If the parameter is set to Close, the function is disabled.
item.name: enDcX2DirectDelSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to delete invalid EN-DC X2 links. If it is set to Open, invalid EN-DC X2 links are deleted through X2 self-configuration to add valid X2 links.
item.name: endcX2InvalidDelSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the IP address update of EN-DC X2 associations. If it is set to Open and an EN-DC X2 association is disconnected, the eNodeB automatically obtains the peer IP address and updates the local configuration of this address to attempt to restore the EN-DC X2 association.
item.name: enDcX2IPUpdateSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of the EN-DC X2 statistics optimization function. If the parameter is set to Open, the EN-DC X2 statistics optimization function is enabled. In this case, EN-DC X2 optimization is implemented when the statistics period expires. If the parameter is set to Close, the function is disabled.
item.name: enDcX2StatOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for EN-DC X2 data collection. It is used to count the number times that SNs are added to the current eNodeB and all the neighbor gNodeBs and the number of times that measurement results are reported on the current eNodeB and all the neighbor gNodeBs. The unit of this parameter depends on the Grade of X2 Statistic Timer Length parameter. When EN-DC X2 data collection optimization is enabled, this timer is started. When EN-DC X2 data collection optimization is disabled, this timer is stopped. Before the timer times out, the eNodeB counts the number of times that SNs are added to the current eNodeB and all the neighbor gNodeBs and the number of times that measurement results are reported on the current eNodeB and all the neighbor gNodeBs. If EN-DC X2 data collection optimization is disabled before the timer times out, the timer is stopped. After the timer times out, EN-DC X2 associations are added or deleted based on the number of times that SNs are added and the number of times that measurement results are reported.
item.name: enDcX2StatTimer

item.desc: In EN-DC X2 data collection optimization, this parameter sets the threshold of the number of times that SNs are successfully added to a neighbor gNodeB. If the number of times that SNs are added to a neighbor gNodeB is larger than or equal to this threshold, the gNodeB can be added with X2s.
item.name: thdNumAddSN

item.desc: This parameter sets the offset of the number of times that EN-DC X2 SN measurement results are reported. In EN-DC X2 data collection scenarios, to perform data collection on the measurement reports of a neighbor gNodeB without X2 links, the offset should be subtracted before the gNB is sorted.
item.name: enDcX2MrNumHys

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of EN-DC X2 connections allowed to be added or deleted in each statistics period.
item.name: enDcX2AddDelCnt

item.desc: This parameter indicates the maximum number of X2 links preempted by EN-DC X2.
item.name: enDcX2TotalNum

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to establish IPSec channels between the LTE and NR systems in the X2 self-setup procedure. If it is set to Not Use IPSec, no IPSec tunnel is established in the X2 self-setup procedure. If it is set to Use IPSec, IPSec tunnels are established in the X2 self-setup procedure.
item.name: x2IPSecLteNrSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables Xe auto-configuration at the passive end. If it is set to Open, the Xe auto-configuration function at the passive end is enabled for the eNodeB.
item.name: xePassiveSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the method for initiating periodic statistics-based X2 addition and passively responding to transport address query requests. If this parameter is set to Directly add, periodic statistics-based X2 addition can be initiated and transport address query requests can be passively responded to regardless of the isX2HOAllowed attribute value of LTE neighbor relations. If this parameter is set to Completely depend on neighbor cell X2-based handover and there are LTE neighbor relations, periodic statistics-based X2 addition can be initiated and transport address query requests can be passively responded to if the isX2HOAllowed attribute value of any neighbor relation is set to Yes. If there is no LTE neighbor relation, transport address query requests cannot be passively responded to. If this parameter is set to Partially depend on neighbor cell X2-based handover and there are LTE neighbor relations, periodic statistics-based X2 addition can be initiated and transport address query requests can be passively responded to if the isX2HOAllowed attribute value of any neighbor relation is set to Yes. If there is no LTE neighbor relation, transport address query requests can be passively responded to.
item.name: x2AddMode

item.desc: This parameter sets the response delay in SCTP association establishment if X2 self-configuration is enabled in an EN-DC scenario. It indicates the maximum delay in the eNodeB's sending a response message after receiving an SCTP message from the peer end.
item.name: enDcX2DelayAckTime

item.desc: This parameter sets the response delay in SCTP association establishment if X2 self-configuration is enabled. It indicates the maximum delay in the eNodeB's sending a response message after receiving an SCTP message from the peer end.
item.name: x2DelayAckTime

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of times that an SCTP association establishment request is retransmitted if X2 self-configuration is enabled in an EN-DC scenario. After the duration for SCTP association establishment times out, the number of times that INIT packets can be retransmitted cannot exceed the parameter value.
item.name: enDcX2MaxInitRetran

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of times that an SCTP association establishment request is retransmitted if X2 self-configuration is enabled. After the duration for SCTP association establishment times out, the number of times that INIT packets can be retransmitted cannot exceed the parameter value.
item.name: x2MaxInitRetran

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable the X2 self-configuration for multiple logical base stations. It is valid only if the ranSharSwch (RAN Sharing Switch) parameter is set to 2 (RAN Dedicated Carrier Mode) or 3 (RAN Mixed Carrier Mode) and the dedctRANSharingSwch (Switch of Co-Building and Sharing) parameter is set to 1 (Open). If this parameter is set to Open, the X2 self-configuration function initiates X2 self-setup and self-deletion for the logical base stations corresponding to each PLMN.
item.name: x2MultiEnbSwch
