item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the punishment for SN configuration failures. For the cells where an SN configuration failure is detected, if this parameter is set to Open, a punishment strategy is triggered based on the failure cause value.
item.name: sNConfigFailPunishSwch

item.desc: This parameter defines a one-dimensional array with the size of 32 to indicate the punishment strategies for special cause values of SN configuration failures. The first array element represents the cause value No Radio Resources Available, the second represents Not supported QCI value, the third represents unspecified, the fourth represents No Radio Resources Available in Target Cell, the fifth represents Cell not available, the sixth represents Transport resource unavailable, the seventh represents Not enough User Plane Processing Resources, and the eighth represents Control Processing Overload. The ninth to thirty-second array elements are reserved. There are three punishment strategies available for the failure cause value corresponding to one array element.
item.name: specCauseSNPunishStgy

item.desc: This parameter sets the punishment strategy for the ordinary cause values of SN configuration failures. Two punishment strategies are available.
item.name: normCauseSNPunishStgy

item.desc: This parameter sets the level-1 punishment timer for SN configuration failures. The timer is enabled when the SN configuration failure punishment switch is set to Open.
item.name: level1SNPunishTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the level-2 detection timer for SN configuration failures. The timer is enabled when the SN configuration failure punishment switch is set to Open.
item.name: level2SNDetectTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the level-2 punishment timer for SN configuration failures. The timer is enabled when the SN configuration failure punishment switch is set to Open.
item.name: level2SNPunishTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the level-3 detection timer for SN configuration failures. The timer is enabled when the SN configuration failure punishment switch is set to Open.
item.name: level3SNDetectTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the level-3 punishment timer for SN configuration failures. The timer is enabled when the SN configuration failure punishment switch is set to Open.
item.name: level3SNPunishTimer

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the punishment for handover preparation failures. This function is applicable only to NR systems. For the target NR cell where a handover preparation failure is detected, if this parameter is set to Open, a punishment strategy is triggered based on the failure cause value.
item.name: hoPrepFailPunishSwch

item.desc: This parameter defines a one-dimensional array with the size of 32 to indicate the punishment strategies for special cause values of handover preparation failures. The first array element represents the cause value Handover Cancelled, the second represents Handover Failure In Target EPC/eNB Or Target System, the third represents Not supported QCI value, the fourth represents unspecified, the fifth represents Unknown Target ID, the sixth represents No Radio Resources Available in Target Cell, the seventh represents Cell not available, the eighth represents Transport resource unavailable, the ninth represents Not enough User Plane Processing Resources, the tenth represents Radio resources not available, the eleventh represents Control Processing Overload, the twelfth represents No Radio Resources Available, and the thirteenth represents Handover Target not Allowed. The fourteenth to thirty-second array elements are reserved. There are two punishment strategies available for the failure cause value corresponding to one array element.
item.name: specCauseHoPunishStgy

item.desc: This parameter sets the punishment strategy for ordinary cause values of handover preparation failures. Two punishment strategies are available.
item.name: normCauseHoPunishStgy

item.desc: This parameter sets the level-1 punishment timer for handover preparation failures. The timer is enabled when the punishment switch for handover preparation failures is set to Open.
item.name: level1HoPunishTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the level-2 detection timer for handover preparation failures. The timer is enabled when the punishment switch for handover preparation failures is set to Open.
item.name: level2HoDetectTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the level-2 punishment timer for handover preparation failures. The timer is enabled when the punishment switch for handover preparation failures is set to Open.
item.name: level2HoPunishTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the level-3 detection timer for handover preparation failures. The timer is enabled when the punishment switch for handover preparation failures is set to Open.
item.name: level3HoDetectTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the level-3 punishment timer for handover preparation failures. The timer is enabled when the punishment switch for handover preparation failures is set to Open.
item.name: level3HoPunishTimer

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the penalty for inter-RAT NR neighbor handover execution failures. If it is set to Open and the number of execution failures in the handover of the UEs to an inter-RAT NR neighbor cell within a period of time reaches the number of times that inter-RAT NR handover execution failures are detected, the UEs cannot be handed over to the corresponding target neighbor cell within a period of time.
item.name: nRHoExeFailPunishSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of punished cells where inter-RAT NR handover execution failures occur. It is used to control the maximum number of neighbor cells that can be punished when the punishment for inter-RAT NR neighbor handover execution failures is enabled.
item.name: nRHoExeFailPunishCelNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for detecting inter-RAT NR neighbor handover execution failures. If the value of the Number of Times That Inter-RAT NR Handover Execution Failures Are Detected parameter is larger than 1 and the eNodeB detects that a UE fails to be handed over to an inter-RAT NR neighbor cell, the eNodeB starts this detection timer to count the number execution failures in the handover to an inter-RAT NR neighbor cell during the operation of the timer. If the number of failures counted by the eNodeB reaches the value of the Number of Times That Inter-RAT NR Handover Execution Failures Are Detected parameter, the eNodeB stops this detection timer and starts the penalty timer. When the detection timer expires and the number of failures counted by the eNodeB does not reach the value of the Number of Times That Inter-RAT NR Handover Execution Failures Are Detected parameter, the eNodeB stops the detection procedure.
item.name: nRHoExeFailDetectTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times that inter-RAT NR handover execution failures are detected. If the number of execution failures in the handover of a UE to an inter-RAT NR neighbor cell reaches this parameter value, the eNodeB starts the penalty timer for inter-RAT NR handover execution failures and forbids the UE from being handed over to inter-RAT NR neighbor cells during the operation of the penalty timer.
item.name: nRHoExeFailDetectNumber

item.desc: This parameter sets the penalty timer for inter-RAT NR neighbor handover execution failures. If the number of execution failures in the handover of a UE to an inter-RAT NR neighbor cell meets the penalty condition, the eNodeB starts the penalty timer based on this parameter value and forbids the UE from being handed over to the corresponding target neighbor cell during the operation of the timer. If this parameter is set to 65535, the timer will never expire.
item.name: nRHoExeFailPunishTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the penalty timer for inter-RAT PS handover execution failures. If the number of execution failures in the PS handover of a UE to an inter-RAT neighbor cell meets the penalty condition, the eNodeB starts the penalty timer. During the operation of the timer, the eNodeB does not trigger PS handover of the UE to the inter-RAT neighbor cell. If this parameter is set to 65535, the timer will never expire.
item.name: iRATHoExeFailPuniTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for detecting inter-RAT PS handover execution failures. If the value of the ucNRHoExeFailDetectNumber (Number of Times That Inter-RAT PS Handover Execution Failures Are Detected) parameter is larger than 1 and the eNodeB detects that a PS handover of a UE to an inter-RAT neighbor cell fails, the eNodeB starts this detection timer and counts the number execution failures in the PS handover to the inter-RAT neighbor cell during the operation of the timer. If the number of failures detected by the eNodeB reaches the value of the ucNRHoExeFailDetectNumber parameter, the eNodeB stops this detection timer and starts the penalty timer. During the operation of the penalty timer, handover to the neighbor cell cannot be triggered. When the detection timer expires and the number of failures counted by the eNodeB does not reach the value of the ucNRHoExeFailDetectNumber parameter, the eNodeB stops the detection procedure.
item.name: iRATHoExeFailDetectTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of punished cells where inter-RAT PS handover execution failures occur. If the penalty for inter-RAT PS handover execution failures is enabled, the number of punished cells does not exceed the parameter value.
item.name: iRATHoExeFailPuniCellNum

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the penalty for inter-RAT PS handover execution failures. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. Element 0 enables or disables the penalty for LTE-to-UTRAN PS handover execution failures. If it is set to 1 (Open) and the number of execution failures in the PS handover of the UEs to an inter-RAT neighbor cell within a period of time reaches the number of times that inter-RAT NR handover execution failures are detected, no PS handover of the UEs to the corresponding target neighbor cell can be triggered within a period of time. Element 1 is reserved.
item.name: iRATHoExeFailPuniSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times that inter-RAT PS handover execution failures are detected. When the number of execution failures in the PS handover of a UE to an inter-RAT neighbor cell reaches this parameter value, the eNodeB starts the penalty timer specified by the wIRATHoExeFailPuniTimer (Penalty Timer for Inter-RAT PS Handover Execution Failures) parameter. During the operation of the penalty timer, the eNodeB does not trigger PS handover of the UE to the inter-RAT neighbor cell.
item.name: iRATHoExeFailDetectNumber

This may be implemented in the access network by the QCI referencing node specific parameters that control packet forwarding treatment (e.g. scheduling weights, admission thresholds, queue management thresholds, link layer protocol configuration, etc.), that have been pre-configured by the operator at a specific node(s) (e.g. eNodeB);Non-standard identification for some special functions ANR, TTI bundling.

Otherwise this parameter choice for False configuration.

item.desc: A long DRX cycle is the periodic repetition of the On Duration period and the following period when inactivity may occur.
item.name: longDrxCyc

item.desc: Short DRX cycle Specifies the periodic repetition of the On Duration followed by a possible period of inactivity,
item.name: shortDrxCyc

item.desc: Specifies the number of consecutive subframe(s) the UE shall follow the Short DRX cycle
item.name: shortDrxCycT

item.desc: This parameter indicates the number of consecutive PDCCH sub-frames at the beginning of a DRX cycle, during which the UE monitors the PDCCH in PDCCH sub-frames.
item.name: onDuratTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for inactive DRX. It is used to control the number of subframes for a UE to continuously detect DCI after the UE successfully decodes the DCI indicating a new transmission procedure of uplink or downlink data. This timer is started after a UE successfully decodes the DCI indicating a new transmission procedure of uplink or downlink data. When the UE receives the DCI that instructs the UE to stop the timer, the timer is stopped. When this timer is stopped or expires, the UE does not receive DCI.
item.name: drxInactTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for HARQ retransmission. It is used to control the number of subframes before a UE receives retransmission DCI. This timer is started when the loopback timer of a HARQ process of the UE expires. This timer is stopped when the UE receives DCI indicating a new transmission or retransmission procedure in the HARQ process. When this timer is stopped or expires, the UE performs a DRX procedure properly.
item.name: drxRetranTimer

item.name: srvPriLv4DRX

item.desc: The primary key and identity of the DRX parameter configuration contain standard QCIs and nonstandard IDs for specific functions. The standard QCIs (QoS Classification Identifiers) represent QoS attributes, such as packet scheduling, delays, and packet loss rate. The transmission of standard QCI parameters among different NEs in an EPS helps the interconnection of the equipment from different vendors and flexible operator configuration. Nonstandard IDs are used for some special functions, such as ANR and TTI bundling.

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for inactive DRX. It is used to control the number of subframes for a UE to continuously detect DCI after the UE successfully decodes the DCI indicating a new transmission procedure of uplink or downlink data. This timer is started after a UE successfully decodes the DCI indicating a new transmission procedure of uplink or downlink data. When the UE receives the DCI that instructs the UE to stop the timer, the timer is stopped. When this timer is stopped or expires, the UE does not receive DCI.

This timer is stopped when the UE receives DCI indicating a new transmission or retransmission procedure in the HARQ process. When this timer is stopped or expires, the UE performs a DRX procedure properly.

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the identification of downlink large-BSR services. If it is set to 1, downlink large-BSR services are identified. If it is set to 0, downlink large-BSR services are not identified.
item.name: bigBsrSwitchDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval for detecting the services with a large BSR. It indicates the maximum time difference between the transmission of two data packets. If the time difference between the transmission of two data packets is longer than this parameter value, it is considered that the service is not a large-BSR service. In this case, the large-BSR status and the related statistics are cleared and a new detection procedure starts.
item.name: bigBsrPeriodDl

item.desc: This parameter indicates the threshold for identifying large-BSR services. During the detection interval, a service is identified as a large-BSR service if the data volume reaches this threshold.
item.name: bigBsrFlowThrDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the type of downlink service, such as the large-BSR and video services. The value of this parameter can be configured on the OMMB/EMS.
item.name: bigBsrTypeDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the validity check time of the candidate large-BSR users. In this period of time, the users that meet the specific conditions can be recognized as large-BSR users. A larger parameter value indicates a lower service rate that large-BSR users can reach.
item.name: bigBsrValidationTimeDl

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables downlink packet identification. If it is set to 1, downlink packets are identified. If it is set to 0, downlink packets are not identified.
item.name: sPISwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the timer length for traffic guarantee after a traffic type is successfully identified. When the timer expires, the guarantee stops.
item.name: sPIDurationTimerLen

item.desc: This parameter indicates the threshold of the number of times that an RLC packet is retransmitted, ranging from 0 to 255. For example, if it is set to 20, after task CDT5054 is delivered, the RNLU detects that the RLC packet is retransmitted 20 times and sends a video frame hysteresis report to the tool. This parameter must be less than R_USERCAREA4ENB. UcWebpageNotOpen.
item.name: videoKartun

item.desc: This parameter indicates the threshold of the number of times that an RLC packet is retransmitted, ranging from 0 to 255. For example, if it is set to 32, after task CDT5054 is delivered, the RNLU detects that the RLC packet is retransmitted 32 times and reports to the tool that the Web page cannot be opened. This parameter must be larger than R_USERCAREA4ENB. UcVideoKartun.
item.name: webpageNotOpen

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the reporting of video statistics to the big-data platform. If it is set to 1 (Open), video statistics are reported to the big-data platform. If it is set to 0 (Close), video statistics are not reported to the big-data platform.
item.name: mediaVideoStatSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the aging time of the video link list. It is used to clear the aged internal statistics. It is set to 30 minutes by default.
item.name: mediaVideoLinkAgingTime

item.desc: This parameter indicates the aging time of media videos. It is set to 60 seconds by default. If there is no data transmitted in 60 seconds, the video ends.
item.name: mediaVideoAgingTime

item.desc: This parameter indicates the maximum number of uplink TCP proxies per session. If the number of proxies exceeds this threshold, uplink TCP proxy is stopped.
item.name: ulTcpProxyMaxNum4Flow

item.desc: This parameter indicates the maximum number of uplink TCP proxies per UE. If the number of proxies exceeds this threshold, uplink TCP proxy is stopped.
item.name: ulTcpProxyMaxNum4Ue

item.desc: This parameter indicates the high threshold of memory load of TCP proxy. If the memory usage exceeds this threshold, TCP proxy is stopped.
item.name: tcpProxyMemLoadHigh

item.desc: This parameter indicates the low threshold of memory load of TCP proxy. If the memory usage is lower than this threshold, TCP proxy is resumed.
item.name: tcpProxyMemLoadLow

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables uplink TCP proxy. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB does the proxy for the uplink TCP services and sends the TCP ACK message to the UEs more quickly after receiving uplink TCP data. In this way, the uplink TCP traffic increases, but the memory load also rises.
item.name: ulTcpProxySwitch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables uplink TCP proxy based on server IP address. If it is set to 1, the eNodeB identifies the sessions for uplink TCP proxy based on the configured server IP addresses. If it is set to 0, the eNodeB does not identify the sessions for uplink TCP proxy based on the configured server IP addresses.
item.name: ulTcpProxyServerIPSwitch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the IP address that is used in the Simple Service Identification (SPI) function and resolved by the DNS can replace the manually configured IP address. By default, it is set to 0, indicating that the function is disabled.
item.name: dNSIpOverrideMIpSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the type of the protocols of the social speech services to be recognized. If it is set to 1, only UDP services can be recognized. If it is set to 2, only TCP services can be recognized. If it is set to 3, both TCP and UDP services can be recognized.
item.name: voiceIdentifyProtocolType

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables social speech recognition. It is used to recognize the types of social speech (non-VoLTE speech) services. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the eNodeB validates the parameter sets corresponding to the bits (1) of the binary numbers converted from this parameter value for social speech recognition. If this parameter is set to 0, it indicates that the social speech recognition function is disabled. If it is set to a value in the range of 1 to 63, the decimal number is converted to a binary number and the parameter sets corresponding to the bits (1) take effect. For example, if this parameter is set to 1, the decimal number 1 is converted to the binary number 000001, which indicates that the first parameter set corresponding to the first bit 1 takes effect. If this parameter is set to 5, the decimal number 5 is converted to the binary number 000101, which indicates that both the first and third parameter sets corresponding to the first and third bits 1 take effect.
item.name: voiceIdentifySwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum number of times that the keyword in social speech recognition configuration 1 is matched. Within a certain period, a service can be recognized as a speech service only when the number of packets containing the matched keyword reaches this parameter value.
item.name: voiceCfg1NumLowThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum number of times that the keyword in social speech recognition configuration 2 is matched. Within a certain period, a service can be recognized as a speech service only when the number of packets containing the matched keyword reaches this parameter value.
item.name: voiceCfg2NumLowThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum number of times that the packets in the third parameter set for social speech recognition are matched. Within the period specified by the voiceValidTime4Cfg3 (Validity Check Time of Social Speech Recognition Configuration 3) parameter, a service can be recognized as a speech service only when the number of times that the packets in the third parameter set are matched reaches this parameter value.
item.name: voiceCfg3NumLowThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum number of times that the packets in the fourth parameter set for social speech recognition are matched. Within the period specified by the voiceValidTime4Cfg4 (Validity Check Time of Social Speech Recognition Configuration 4) parameter, a service can be recognized as a speech service only when the number of times that the packets in the fourth parameter set are matched reaches this parameter value.
item.name: voiceCfg4NumLowThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum number of times that the packets in the fifth parameter set for social speech recognition are matched. Within the period specified by the voiceValidTime4Cfg5 (Validity Check Time of Social Speech Recognition Configuration 5) parameter, a service can be recognized as a speech service only when the number of times that the packets in the fifth parameter set are matched reaches this parameter value.
item.name: voiceCfg5NumLowThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum number of times that the packets in the sixth parameter set for social speech recognition are matched. Within the period specified by the voiceValidTime4Cfg6 (Validity Check Time of Social Speech Recognition Configuration 6) parameter, a service can be recognized as a speech service only when the number of times that the packets in the sixth parameter set are matched reaches this parameter value.
item.name: voiceCfg6NumLowThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the validity check time of social speech recognition configuration 1. Within this period, if a certain number (UserCAREA4ENBLTE. VoiceCfg1NumLowThr) of packets are successfully matched, the service is recognized as a social speech service. A larger parameter value indicates a larger number of times that packets are successfully matched and a higher success rate of social speech recognition.
item.name: voiceValidTime4Cfg1

item.desc: This parameter sets the validity check time of social speech recognition configuration 2. Within this period, if a certain number (UserCAREA4ENBLTE. VoiceCfg2NumLowThr) of packets are successfully matched, the service is recognized as a social speech service. A larger parameter value indicates a larger number of times that packets are successfully matched and a higher success rate of social speech recognition.
item.name: voiceValidTime4Cfg2

item.desc: This parameter sets the validity check time of social speech recognition configuration 3. Within this period, if a certain number (UserCAREA4ENBLTE. VoiceCfg3NumLowThr) of packets are successfully matched, the service is recognized as a social speech service. A larger parameter value indicates a larger number of times that packets are successfully matched and a higher success rate of social speech recognition.
item.name: voiceValidTime4Cfg3

item.desc: This parameter sets the validity check time of social speech recognition configuration 4. Within this period, if a certain number (UserCAREA4ENBLTE. VoiceCfg4NumLowThr) of packets are successfully matched, the service is recognized as a social speech service. A larger parameter value indicates a larger number of times that packets are successfully matched and a higher success rate of social speech recognition.
item.name: voiceValidTime4Cfg4

item.desc: This parameter sets the validity check time of social speech recognition configuration 5. Within this period, if a certain number (UserCAREA4ENBLTE. VoiceCfg5NumLowThr) of packets are successfully matched, the service is recognized as a social speech service. A larger parameter value indicates a larger number of times that packets are successfully matched and a higher success rate of social speech recognition.
item.name: voiceValidTime4Cfg5

item.desc: This parameter sets the validity check time of social speech recognition configuration 6. Within this period, if a certain number (UserCAREA4ENBLTE. VoiceCfg6NumLowThr) of packets are successfully matched, the service is recognized as a social speech service. A larger parameter value indicates a larger number of times that packets are successfully matched and a higher success rate of social speech recognition.
item.name: voiceValidTime4Cfg6

item.desc: This parameter sets the generalized QoS type corresponding to social speech recognition configuration 1. It should be configured based on the level of the social speech services that need to be guaranteed. The same service type means the same service level.
item.name: voiceCfg1Type

item.desc: This parameter sets the generalized QoS type corresponding to social speech recognition configuration 2. It should be configured based on the level of the social speech services that need to be guaranteed. The same service type means the same service level.
item.name: voiceCfg2Type

item.desc: This parameter sets the generalized QoS type corresponding to social speech recognition configuration 3. It is configured based on the level of the social speech services that need to be guaranteed. The same service type indicates the same service level.
item.name: voiceCfg3Type

item.desc: This parameter sets the generalized QoS type corresponding to social speech recognition configuration 4. It is configured based on the level of the social speech services that need to be guaranteed. The same service type indicates the same service level.
item.name: voiceCfg4Type

item.desc: This parameter sets the generalized QoS type corresponding to social speech recognition configuration 5. It is configured based on the level of the social speech services that need to be guaranteed. The same service type indicates the same service level.
item.name: voiceCfg5Type

item.desc: This parameter sets the generalized QoS type corresponding to social speech recognition configuration 6. It is configured based on the level of the social speech services that need to be guaranteed. The same service type indicates the same service level.
item.name: voiceCfg6Type

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables service shunting for Type6 UEs based on load. If it is set to Open, the NSA shunting services used by Type6 UEs in a high-load LTE cell are stopped.
item.name: type6SplitBasedLoadSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables domain name identification. If it is set to Open, domain names can be identified.
item.name: domainNameIndentifySwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables Deep Recognition and Analysis (DRA). If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB identifies and compares UE packets to determine the application (for example, Tencent and TikTok) to which the current packets belong, and returns the application ID.
item.name: dRAIdentifySwitch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables general-QoS optimization for the applications identified through DRA. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB compares the IDs of the applications identified through DRA with those specified by the appID (Application ID List) parameter. For the applications whose IDs are in the application list, the eNodeB performs general-QoS optimization of the type specified by the gQoSType (General QoS Type) parameter, improving the user experience of the corresponding applications.
item.name: dRAGQoSSwitch

item.desc: If the core network sends an E-RAB release message to the eNodeB, carrying the release cause E-UTRAN Generated Reason, it indicates that active E-RABs are abnormally released. This parameter enables or disables the optimization for the connection loss ratio of active E-RABs that are released for this reason. When the eNodeB receives an E-RAB release message from the core network, carrying the release cause E-UTRAN Generated Reason, the eNodeB determines that inactive E-RABs are released if this parameter is set to Open and the following condition is met: The difference between the time when the eNodeB receives the last newly transmitted packet and the time when the E-RABs of the UE are released is larger than the ActErabDropTimeLen parameter. If the difference between the time when the eNodeB receives the last newly transmitted packet and the time when the E-RABs of the UE are released is smaller than or equal to the ActErabDropTimeLen parameter, the eNodeB determines that active E-RABs are released abnormally.
item.name: actErabDropOptSwch

item.desc: If the core network sends an E-RAB release message to the eNodeB, carrying the release cause E-UTRAN Generated Reason, it indicates that active E-RABs are abnormally released. This parameter sets the duration based on which the eNodeB checks whether active E-RABs are released for this reason. When the eNodeB receives an E-RAB release message from the core network, carrying the release cause E-UTRAN Generated Reason, the eNodeB determines an inactive E-RAB is released if the ActErabDropOptSwch (Switch for Optimizing the Connection Loss Ratio of Active E-RABs) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the following condition is met: The difference between the time when the current E-RAB receives the last newly transmitted packet and the time when the E-RAB of the UE is released is larger than the parameter value. If the difference between the time when the current E-RAB receives the last newly transmitted packet and the time when the E-RAB of the UE is released is smaller than or equal to the parameter value, the eNodeB determines that an active E-RAB is released abnormally.
item.name: actErabDropTimeLen

item.desc: This parameter sets the scaling ratio of the threshold for identifying downlink large-BSR services. It is used to identify downlink large-BSR services at different granularities. If it is set to a non-zero value, the actual value of the bigBsrFlowThrDl parameter is the configured value of the bigBsrFlowThrDl parameter multiplied by this parameter value and then divided by 100.
item.name: dLBigBsrThrScaleRatio

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of times that an RRCRelease message can be re-sent at the RLC layer. After the eNodeB sends an RRCRelease message to a UE, if the eNodeB receives no ACK message from the UE at the RLC layer within a specified period, the eNodeB re-sends the RRCRelease message. This parameter sets the maximum number of times that the eNodeB can re-send an RRCRelease message in the case that the eNodeB receives no ACK message from the UE. If the maximum number of retransmissions is reached, the eNodeB does not re-send the RRCRelease message, but instructs the control plane to re-establish the connection, thus preventing useless occupation of air interface resources.
item.name: maxRetxThrdForRel

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables dominated-service direction detection. If it is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB calculates the uplink traffic and the downlink traffic of UEs and determines the larger one. If the uplink traffic of a UE is higher than the downlink traffic, it indicates that the UE is an uplink-dominated UE. If the downlink traffic of a UE is higher than the uplink traffic, it indicates that the UE is a downlink-dominated UE. Suppose that the ucSerDirDeciContiNumThrd (Threshold of the Consecutive Number of Uplink-Dominated or Downlink-Dominated UE Identifications) parameter is n. If the uplink traffic of a UE is higher than or equal to the first element of the adwSerDirDeciTraAbsThrd[2] (Absolute Traffic Threshold for Dominated-Service-Direction Identification) parameter consecutive n times and the ratio of the uplink traffic to the downlink traffic is larger than the first element of the aucSerDirDeciTraPropoThrd[2] (Traffic Ratio Threshold for Dominated-Service-Direction Identification) parameter, the UE is identified as an uplink-dominated UE. If the downlink traffic of a UE is higher than or equal to the second element of the adwSerDirDeciTraAbsThrd[2] (Absolute Traffic Threshold for Dominated-Service-Direction Identification) parameter consecutive n times and the ratio of the downlink traffic to the uplink traffic is larger than the second element of the aucSerDirDeciTraPropoThrd[2] (Traffic Ratio Threshold for Dominated-Service-Direction Identification) parameter, the UE is identified as a downlink-dominated UE. If a UE does not meet the conditions for uplink-dominated or downlink-dominated UE identification consecutive n times, it is identified as other UEs. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB does not detect the dominated-service direction.
item.name: serDirDeciSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the general QoS supports joint identification of the domain name of a server. If it is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB detects the DNS addresses contained in the DNS request packets. For the packets that meet the specified conditions, the eNodeB provides the specified type of QoS guarantee for the corresponding service flows.
item.name: dNSCombineIdentifySwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the validity check time for joint DNS identification. If the ucDNSCombineIdentifySwch (Switch for Joint DNS Identification) parameter is set to 1 (Open), and the number of DNS addresses that are contained in the DNS request packet and match the UserCAREA4ENBLTE. DNSAddr (DNS Address for Joint DNS Identification) array parameter reaches the value of the UserCAREA4ENBLTE. DNSCombineNumThresh (Threshold Number of Domain Names for Joint DNS Identification) parameter within the period specified by this parameter, it indicates that the joint DNS identification succeeds and the eNodeB can provide QoS guarantee for the current service flow.
item.name: dNSCombineValidTime

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of matched DNSs if joint DNS identification is enabled (the UserCAREA4ENBLTE. DNSCombineIdentifySwch parameter is set to 1 (Open)). If the number of domain names that are contained in the DNS request packet and match the UserCAREA4ENBLTE. DNSAddr (DNS Address for Joint DNS Identification) array parameter reaches the value of this parameter within the period specified by the wDNSCombineValidTime (UserCAREA4ENBLTE. DNSCombineValidTime) parameter, it indicates that the joint DNS identification succeeds and the eNodeB can provide QoS guarantee for the current service flow.
item.name: dNSCombineNumThresh

item.desc: This parameter sets the type of guaranteed service flows that are successfully identified through joint DNS identification. The values 1 to 6 correspond to Type1 to Type6.
item.name: dNSCombineType

item.desc: This array parameter sets the DNS address set for joint DNS identification. A maximum of 10 valid DNS addresses can be configured to specify the DNS requests whose QoS service flows can be guaranteed. Each array element represents a DNS address. This parameter takes effect when joint DNS identification is enabled.
item.name: dNSAddr

item.desc: This parameter sets a list of QCIs to prevent UEs with these QCI services from large-BSR identification. It is an array parameter consisting of a maximum of five elements. The element value 0 indicates no QCI service, 1 indicates QCI1, 2 indicates QCI2, and so on. With a list of QCIs set by this parameter, the eNodeB does not perform large-BSR identification on the UEs with these QCI services so that other UEs without these services can obtain better scheduling resources, thereby increasing the overall traffic of the eNodeB.
item.name: bigBsrShieldQCI

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables Global Direct Memory Access (GDMA) copy for the master core of the user plane. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), Unit Block (UB) memory copy can be performed on the Digital Signal Processor (DSP) through GDMA. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), no UB memory copy can be performed on the DSP through GDMA.
item.name: masterGdmaCopySwitch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables packet loss detection on F1-U links in NSA scenarios. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the LTE DU detects the packet loss on the F1-U links to analyze the transmission performance of the F1-U links based on the obtained packet loss information. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the LTE DU does not detect packet loss on the F1-U links.
item.name: nsaF1LostDetectSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable UB memory self-healing. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the baseband processing board attempts to recover itself in the case of UB memory leak. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the baseband processing board fails to recover itself from UB memory leak.
item.name: uBSelfHealingSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables CPU load control enhancement. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB restricts some specific functions based on its CPU load to ensure proper operation. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB does not restrict specific functions.
item.name: loadMngOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to optimize re-establishment message surge prevention (re-establishment message surge means that there are a large number of re-establishment messages present on the eNodeB). If this parameter is set to 0 (Close) and the CPU load of the main processing unit of the eNodeB is low or medium, the baseband processing board sends a re-establishment message to the main processing unit after receiving the message. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the CPU load of the main processing unit of the eNodeB is low or medium: If the number of re-establishment messages received by the baseband processing board does not reach a certain value, the baseband processing board sends a re-establishment message to the main processing unit after receiving the message; if the number of re-establishment messages received by the baseband processing board reaches a certain value, the baseband processing board discards a new re-establishment messages after receiving it and sends a re-establishment rejection message to the UE.
item.name: reestabCtrlOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for Server Hello packet pre-guarantee. In normal cases, for a TCP service flow, the number of Client Hello packets should be the same as the number of Server Hello packets. After the pre-guarantee function takes effect, this timer is started or restarted when the bearer receives a Client Hello packet from a TCP service flow. After the timer expires, if the number of Server Hello packets received by the bearer from the TCP service flows is smaller than that of Client Hello packets, the pre-guarantee function is disabled. If this parameter is set to an odd value, only downlink Server Hello packets are pre-guaranteed. If this parameter is set to an even value, all the downlink packets are pre-guaranteed.
item.name: serHelloPreGnteeTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable pre-guarantee for Server Hello packets. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the eNodeB detects a Client Hello packet in a TCP service flow, the eNodeB performs pre-guarantee processing for the Server Hello packet of the service flow.
item.name: serHelloPreGnteeSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to guarantee the services on the servers whose domain names are carried in the Client Hello packets. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the eNodeB successfully identifies a domain name carried in the Client Hello packet of the TLS protocol, the eNodeB enables scheduling guarantee for the current bearer.
item.name: clientHelloSerGnteeSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the period of NSA F1-U packet loss detection. When the LTE DU detects downlink F1-U packet loss, if the number of F1-U packets received by the LTE from NR reaches the parameter value, it is determined that packet loss occurs once.
item.name: nsaF1LostDetectPeriod

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables session expansion. If this parameter is set to Close, a maximum of 4096 session instances can be created. If this parameter is Open and 4096 session instances are created, the system dynamically applies for more memory for creating session instances.
item.name: appConnExpansionSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the identification of the UEs with level-15 user experience. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB detects the current service models of a UE within a certain period of time. If the number of times that the following services are identified reaches a specified value, the UE is identified as a UE with level-15 user experience: ICMP, uplink or downlink large-BSR, YouTube domain name access, and HTTP domain name access. If a UE is identified as a UE with level-15 user experience, the eNodeB provides general-QoS service guarantee for the UE to improve user experience.
item.name: level15ExpeSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the type of general-QoS service for decreasing the TCP delay of such services. If the tcpDelayDecSwch (TCP Delay Decrease Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the type of general-QoS services of a UE is the same as the parameter value, the eNodeB optimizes the delay in the service flows of the UE to improve user experience.
item.name: tcpDelayDecType

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables TCP delay decrease optimization. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB optimizes the delay of the services of the types specified by the tcpDelayDecType (General-QoS Type for TCP Delay Decrease) parameter for the UEs with the corresponding guaranteed services to improve user experience. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), TCP delay decrease does not take effect.
item.name: tcpDelayDecSwch

item.desc: This parameter is an array parameter consisting of 10 elements. Each element corresponds to the IP address of a server, enabling the eNodeB to collect metrics data related to the services of the server.
item.name: metricsIP

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of collecting metrics data. To disable collecting metrics data, set this parameter to 0. To enable the eNodeB to collect logs from UEs performing the TCP service, set this parameter to a non-zero value. When the specified collection duration defined by this parameter is reached, the eNodeB terminates the log collection process. If this parameter is set to 0 when the collection is ongoing, the eNodeB immediately stops collecting logs. If this parameter is changed from a non-zero value to another non-zero value during a log collection process, the updated value will not take effect until the next collection cycle initiates.
item.name: metricsTimeLen

item.desc: This parameter sets a Key Quality Index (KQI) perception evaluation list. It is an array parameter consisting of 100 elements. Elements 0 through 9 set the IDs of mobile game perception evaluation applications respectively. Elements 10 through 19 set the IDs of web browsing service perception evaluation applications respectively. The remaining elements are reserved.
item.name: kqiEvaluationList

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink RTT threshold for TCP video streams. The eNodeB calculates the proportion of long RTT of the TCP video services by counting the number of times that the RTT of TCP video streams exceeds this threshold.
item.name: videoDlTcpRttThr

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the eNodeB collects and analyzes statistics on KQIs of services. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB collects statistics on the KQIs of services (for example, videos and games) after identifying such services.
item.name: serviceKqiSwch

The parameter values 1 to 7 indicate the QoS type1 to QoS type7 guarantee policies.

item.desc: This parameter sets the IP learning policy for identifying a domain name for downlink packets. It is an array parameter consisting of a maximum of 20 elements. Each element indicates the IP address learning policy for one DNS in the SPIDnsAddrCfgLTE configuration. If an element is set to 0, IP addresses are not learned through the corresponding DNS; that is, after the DNS is identified successfully, the eNodeB does not identify the IP addresses corresponding to the DNS. If this parameter is set to 1, the eNodeB learns IP addresses through the corresponding DNS; that is, after the eNodeB successfully identifies a DNS, the eNodeB identifies the IP addresses corresponding to the DNS.
item.name: sPINeedLearnIP

item.name: appID

item.desc: This parameter sets the initial buffering time of video apps. Before the app specified by the AppIdBuffCfgLTE. AppID (APPID) parameter plays a video, the video data is buffered within the initial buffering time specified by this parameter. The video is not played until the initial buffering time expires.
item.name: appIDInitBuffTime

item.desc: This parameter sets the freezing buffering time of video apps. If video freezing occurs when the app specified by the AppIdBuffCfgLTE. AppID (APPID) parameter is playing a video, the video data is buffered within the freezing buffering time specified by this parameter. When the freezing buffering time expires, the video continues to be played.

item.name: guaranteeType

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of RBs guaranteed by general QoS.
item.name: guaranteeRbNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the time for assuring general-QoS services. It depends on the service assurance types.
item.name: guaranteeDurationTimerLen

item.desc: This parameter sets the priorities of the services of general-QoS types. It is an array parameter consisting of five elements. Element 0 through element 4 set the priorities for guaranteeing the services of general-QoS type1 through general-QoS type5 for UEs respectively, and each element is in the range from 1 through 5. A larger element value indicates a higher guarantee priority of the UEs with the services of the corresponding general-QoS type. If the general-QoS type of the services of a UE changes and the priority of the new general-QoS type is higher than or equal to that of the original general-QoS type, the eNodeB guarantees the services of the new general-QoS type for the UE. If the priority of the new general-QoS type is lower than that of the original general-QoS type, the eNodeB still guarantees the services of the original general-QoS type for the UE.
item.name: guaranteePriority

item.desc: This parameter sets the domain name of the server where UEs access some services (such as video and web services). The eNodeB identifies the services on the server with this domain name and guarantees the QoS of the services of the UEs that access the server. The guarantee policy is determined by the domainNameTypeForOpt (Optimization Type of Domain Names) parameter.
item.name: domainName

item.desc: This parameter sets the optimization type of some services (such as video and web services) of the UEs that access the server whose domain name is specified by the DnsOptLTE. DomainName (Domain Name) parameter. The parameter values 1 to 7 indicate the QoS type1 to QoS type7 optimization policies.

item.desc: This parameter sets the type of general-QoS optimization for the applications identified through DRA. The values 1 through 7 correspond to general-QoS optimization type1 to type7, and each type corresponds to a set of optimization policies. In the case that the dRAGQoSSwitch (Switch of General-QoS Optimization for the Applications Identified Through DRA) parameter is set to 1 (Open), if the IDs of the applications identified through DRA are in the list specified by the appID (Application ID List) parameter, the eNodeB implements the general-QoS optimization scheme corresponding to the QoS optimization type specified by this parameter for these applications, improving the user experience of these applications.
item.name: gQoSType

item.desc: This parameter sets the ID list of the applications that are identified through DRA and on which general-QoS optimization needs to be performed. It is an array parameter consisting of 64 elements. Each element of the array parameter corresponds to an application ID. The value 0 indicates that there is no application ID. If the dRAGQoSSwitch (Switch of General-QoS Optimization for the Applications Identified Through DRA) parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB performs general-QoS optimization of the type specified by the gQoSType (General QoS Type) parameter on all the applications in this list to improve the user experience of these applications.
item.name: appID

item.desc: This parameter sets a list of domain names of the servers whose domain names are carried in the Client Hello packets. It consists of a maximum of 30 elements and each element corresponds to a domain name. If the domain name carried in the Client Hello packet of the current service is in the list specified by this parameter, the eNodeB enables scheduling guarantee for the bearer carrying the current service.
item.name: clientHelloSerDomainName

item.desc: This parameter sets the type of service guarantee optimization for the servers whose domain names are carried in the Client Hello packets. The parameter values 1 through 7 indicate the QoS type1 through QoS type7 optimization policies.

item.name: moId

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables TCP optimization by assistance of wireless. If it is set to 1, TCP optimization by assistance of wireless is enabled. If it is set to 0, TCP optimization by assistance of wireless is disabled.
item.name: tcpOptSwitch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the report interval for TCP optimization by assistance of wireless. The eNodeB reports wireless information to the server only once within the interval. The interval should be a multiple of 10 ms.
item.name: tcpOptPeriod

item.desc: This parameter indicates the unique test scene ID of TCP optimization by assistance of wireless.
item.name: tcpOptSceneId

item.desc: This parameter sets the IP address to be identified if radio information-based TCP optimization is enabled (that is, the tcpOptSwitch (Switch for TCP Optimization By Assistance of Wireless) parameter is set to 1 (Open)). The configuration of this parameter can improve the radio bandwidth usage of the servers that cannot maximize the use of the radio bandwidth.
item.name: tcpOptIP

item.desc: This parameter sets the fixed window size for uplink TCP acceleration, that is, the constant volume of data received by the eNodeB. If the ucUlTcpAccelerationFixWndSwch (Fixed-Window Mode Switch for Uplink TCP Acceleration) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the window size for SYN-ACK packets in the three-way handshake phase is smaller than this parameter value, ACK packets are constructed based on the value of the dwUlFlowCtrlWndThresh (Fixed Window Size for Uplink Acceleration) parameter, so that the slow-start duration can be effectively shortened.
item.name: ulFlowCtrlWndThresh

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum window size for uplink TCP acceleration. It indicates the maximum data volume of TCP acceleration streams that can be received by the eNodeB. During TCP acceleration, the number of data bytes sent by a UE to the eNodeB after the UE receives an ACK message cannot exceed the parameter value.
item.name: ulFlowMaxWndSizeThresh

item.desc: This parameter sets the general-QoS type that supports uplink TCP acceleration. The binary value converted from this parameter value consists of 32 bits. From the lowest bit to the highest bit, the 32 bits indicate whether the general-QoS services of type 1 through type 32 can be accelerated in the full process respectively. In the current version, if bit 0 to bit 6 are set to 1, it indicates that the general-QoS services of type 1 through type 7 can be accelerated in the full process. The remaining 25 bits are reserved. If the value of a bit is set to 0, it indicates that the services of the corresponding general-QoS type do not support uplink TCP acceleration. If the value of a bit is set to 1, it indicates that the services of the corresponding general-QoS type support uplink TCP acceleration. If this parameter is set to 0, full-process TCP acceleration is performed for all the UEs.
item.name: ulTcpAccQoSBitmap

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the conservative window size. If it is set to 1 (Open), the window size for the eNodeB to send ACK packets cannot exceed the receiving window size of the server during uplink TCP acceleration.
item.name: ulTcpAccCalWndSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum interval (in seconds) between two consecutive uplink TCP packets during uplink TCP acceleration. If the interval between two consecutive uplink TCP packets received by the eNodeB exceeds the parameter value, the data streams on which TCP acceleration is being performed exit uplink TCP acceleration.
item.name: ulTcpAccDataGapThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of packets and is used to determine the current dominated-service direction and then to determine whether to stop uplink TCP acceleration. The system starts to count the number of data packets from SYN packets. If the accumulated number of uplink service packets is larger than the parameter value and then that of downlink service packets is larger than the parameter value, uplink TCP acceleration continues. If the accumulated number of downlink service packets is larger than the parameter value and then that of uplink service packets is larger than the parameter value, uplink TCP acceleration stops.
item.name: ulTcpAccDirDataThr

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to delete the data packets that are received and acknowledged by the eNodeB and then sent to the eNodeB again during uplink TCP acceleration. During uplink TCP acceleration, if this parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the data packets that are received and acknowledged by the eNodeB are sent to the eNodeB again, the data packets are deleted.
item.name: ulTcpAccDupDataRelSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable the fixed-window mode for uplink TCP acceleration. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the fixed-TCP-window mode is enabled for uplink TCP acceleration. If the window size for SYN-ACK packets in the three-way handshake phase is smaller than the value specified by the dwUlFlowCtrlWndThresh (Fixed Window Size for Uplink Acceleration) parameter, ACK packets are constructed based on the dwUlFlowCtrlWndThresh value, so that the slow-start duration can be effectively shortened. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the fixed-TCP-window mode is disabled.
item.name: ulTcpAccFixWndSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable uplink TCP acceleration. If the wired transmission is in poor condition and this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB implements the TCP acceleration function. In this case, the uplink TCP packets are confirmed sooner, improving the transmission rate.
item.name: ulTcpAccSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration (in milliseconds) for detecting the dominated-service direction in uplink TCP acceleration. The eNodeB counts the accumulated number of packets in the dominated-service direction within the period specified by this parameter, and then determines whether to stop TCP acceleration.
item.name: ulTcpAccDirTimerLen

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum duration (in 100 milliseconds) for uplink TCP acceleration. When uplink TCP acceleration lasts for a duration equal to the duration specified by this parameter, uplink TCP acceleration stops.
item.name: ulTcpAccMaxTimeLen

item.desc: This parameter sets an optimization type for HTTP pre-caching. If this parameter is set to 1 (Application Level Optimization), only the applications identified through DRA can be optimized. If this parameter is set to 2 (Service Category-Level Optimization), the service categories identified and matched by using URLs can be optimized. If this parameter is set to 3 (Application and service categories take effect at the same time), both the applications identified through DRA and the service categories identified and matched by using URLs can be optimized.
item.name: preCachingSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the lower RTT threshold for packet pre-caching optimization. If the RTT on the Uu interface in the last second is larger than the threshold, the pre-cached packets of HTTP service flows are optimized by using the K-times optimization method. If the RTT on the Uu interface in the last second is smaller than or equal to the threshold, the pre-cached packets of HTTP service flows are optimized by using the blank-based optimization method.
item.name: rttLowThresh

item.desc: This parameter sets the higher RTT threshold for packet pre-caching optimization. If the RTT on the Uu interface in the last second is smaller than or equal to the threshold and larger than the rttLowThresh (Lower RTT Threshold) parameter, the pre-cached packets of HTTP service flows are optimized by using the K-times optimization method. If the RTT on the Uu interface in the last second is larger than the threshold, the pre-cached packets of HTTP service flows are not optimized.
item.name: rttHighThresh

item.desc: This parameter sets HTTP port 4. If the preCachingSwch (HTTP Pre-Caching Optimization Type) parameter is set to a non-zero value, the eNodeB optimizes the pre-cached HTTP packets whose port number matches this parameter value.
item.name: httpPort4

item.desc: This parameter sets HTTP port 3. If the preCachingSwch (HTTP Pre-Caching Optimization Type) parameter is set to a non-zero value, the eNodeB optimizes the pre-cached HTTP packets whose port number matches this parameter value.
item.name: httpPort3

item.desc: This parameter sets HTTP port 2. If the preCachingSwch (HTTP Pre-Caching Optimization Type) parameter is set to a non-zero value, the eNodeB optimizes the pre-cached HTTP packets whose port number matches this parameter value.
item.name: httpPort2

item.desc: This parameter sets HTTP port 1. If the preCachingSwch (HTTP Pre-Caching Optimization Type) parameter is set to a non-zero value, the eNodeB optimizes the pre-cached HTTP packets whose port number matches this parameter value.
item.name: httpPort1

item.desc: This parameter sets the optimization proportion of pre-cached packets. If this parameter is set to n, for every 100 pre-buffered packets, only the first n packets are optimized.
item.name: preCacheOptRatio

item.desc: This parameter sets the phase for optimizing pre-cached packets. If this parameter is set to 0 (Initial Phase), only the HTTP Range0 packets are optimized. If this parameter is set to 1 (All Phase), all the HTTP Range packets are optimized.
item.name: preCacheOptPhase

item.desc: This parameter sets how much the pre-cached packets are optimized (that is, the optimization degree of the pre-cached packets). If the parameter value is in the range from 1 through 100, a larger parameter value indicates a higher optimization degree and a larger number of pre-cached HTTP service flows. If this parameter is set to 0, it indicates that there is no upper limit for packet pre-caching optimization.
item.name: preCacheOptDegree

item.desc: This parameter sets URL string 1 for packet pre-caching optimization. If the preCachingSwch (HTTP Pre-Caching Optimization Type) parameter is set to 2 (Service Category-Level Optimization) or 3 (Application and service categories take effect at the same time), the eNodeB optimizes the pre-cached HTTP packets whose URL matches this parameter value.
item.name: preCacheOptUrlStr1

item.desc: This parameter sets URL string 1 for packet pre-caching optimization. If the preCachingSwch (HTTP Pre-Caching Optimization Type) parameter is set to 2 (Service Category-Level Optimization) or 3 (Application and service categories take effect at the same time), the eNodeB optimizes the pre-cached HTTP packets whose URL matches this parameter value.
item.name: preCacheOptUrlStr2

item.desc: This parameter sets URL string 3 for packet pre-caching optimization. If the keyword of a service packet matches this parameter value, the pre-caching of the packet can be optimized.
item.name: preCacheOptUrlStr3

item.desc: This parameter sets URL string 4 for packet pre-caching optimization. If the keyword of a service packet matches this parameter value, the pre-caching of the packet can be optimized.
item.name: preCacheOptUrlStr4

item.desc: This parameter is a list of IDs of the applications for which pre-caching is optimized. It is an array parameter consisting of 64 elements. Each element of the array parameter corresponds to an application ID. The value 0 indicates that the application ID is null. If the preCachingSwch (HTTP Pre-Caching Optimization Type) parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB performs pre-caching optimization on all the applications with the IDs in this list to improve the user experience of these applications.
item.name: preCacheOptAppId

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times that the eNodeB resends a PS paging message to a UE. After receiving a PS paging message from the core network, the eNodeB sends the PS paging message to the UE. To avoid failures in sending PS paging messages due to poor quality of the Uu interface, the number of times that the eNodeB resends a PS paging message to a UE can be configured by using this parameter.
item.name: pagingRepeatTime

item.desc: This parameter sets a multiple of the BCCH update period. It determines the BCCH update period so that all the idle UEs can receive new SIB messages. The BCCH update period is the product of the defaultPagingCycle (DRX Cycle for Paging) parameter and this parameter.
item.name: modificationPeriodCoeff

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval for paging idle UEs with DRX enabled. It is valid when the drxSwitch (DRX Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open). The actual paging interval of a UE with DRX enabled is the smaller of this parameter and the DRX interval configured by the UE. At the interval specified by this parameter, an idle UE receives paging messages once a paging occasion arrives.
item.name: defaultPagingCycle

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times that the eNodeB resends a CS paging message to a UE. After receiving a CS paging message from the core network, the eNodeB sends the CS paging message to the UE. To avoid failures in sending CS paging messages due to poor quality of the Uu interface, the number of times that the eNodeB resends a PS paging message to a UE can be configured by using this parameter.
item.name: cSPagRepeatTime

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables paging parameter self-adaption. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB automatically adjusts the paging capacity of cells based on the number of S1 paging messages received.
item.name: pagingAdaptiveSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the time window for obtaining the number of paging messages. It is used for paging parameter self-adaptation.
item.name: pagingNumStaPrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for paging capacity adjustment. If paging parameter self-adaption is enabled in a cell, the cell adjusts the paging capacity based on the number of paging messages received and the product of this threshold and the cell paging capacity.
item.name: pagingCapacityPercent

item.desc: This parameter sets the period of time for adjusting parameters when paging parameter self-adaption is enabled. At the end of the period, the paging timing factor is adjusted based on the collected number of paging messages.
item.name: pagingAdaptivePrd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables paging capacity optimization based on paging storms. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB automatically detects paging storms and adjusts the paging capacity.
item.name: pagingCapacityOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration for paging storm detection. If paging storm-based paging capacity optimization is enabled in a cell and the number of paging messages received by the cell within this period is larger than the threshold, the paging capacity is automatically adjusted to the maximum value.
item.name: pagingStormDetectPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of periods to end paging storm detection. If the number of paging messages received by a cell within consecutive N (this parameter value) periods is smaller than the threshold, it is considered that a paging storm ends.
item.name: pagingStormEndPeriodNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for discarding paging messages upon paging timeout. It is used to discard paging messages when the duration of paging message accumulation exceeds a certain threshold to prevent invalid paging messages from occupying resources and affecting the reception of new paging messages. If this parameter is set to 0, it indicates that paging message discarding upon paging timeout is disabled. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, it indicates that paging message discarding upon paging timeout is enabled and the parameter value is the duration (in seconds) of the paging message discarding timer. A larger parameter value indicates that it takes a longer time to discard a paging message from the queue.
item.name: pagingDiscardTimerLen

item.desc: This parameter sets the system time sending method in SIB8. If it is set to Close, only the reselection and blind redirection from LTE to CDMA can be performed on UEs. If it is set to SynchronousSystemTime, the handover from LTE to CDMA, measurement-based redirection, or enhanced 1xRTT CSFB from LTE to CDMA can be performed on UEs if there is no time deviation between the E-UTRAN system and the CDMA2000 system. If it is set to AsynchronousSystemTime, the handover from LTE to CDMA, measurement-based redirection, or enhanced 1xRTT CSFB from LTE to CDMA can be performed on UEs even if there is a time deviation between the E-UTRAN system and the CDMA2000 system.

item.desc: This parameter sets a KPI reporting policy in the case of Radio Link Failures (RLFs) in different scenarios. It is an array parameter consisting of 10 elements. The first element corresponds to SRS card removal. If this element is set to 1 (SRS Remove Card), the call drops triggered by SRS card removal are counted as abnormal call drops. The second element corresponds to uplink HARQ failures. If this element is set to 2 (Uplink Harq Fail), the call drops triggered by uplink HARQ failures are counted as abnormal call drops. The third element corresponds to downlink HARQ failures. If this element is set to 4 (Downlink Harq Fail), the call drops triggered by downlink HARQ failures are counted as abnormal call drops. The fourth element corresponds to no response to MSG0. If this element is set to 8 (Msg0 Not Responding), the call drops triggered by no response to MSG0 are counted as abnormal call drops. If an element is set to 0, the call drops triggered in the corresponding scenario are not counted as abnormal call drops. The fifth through tenth elements are reserved.
item.name: rlfKpiReportSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicate the switch for Replacing PLMN in RAN Share In Dedicated Carrier Mode. When the switch is open, if the PLMN of ECGI that reported by UE is included in aucRanSharMCC and aucRanSharMNC, eNB will replace the PLMN of ECGI with the primary PLMN of eNB. The new ECGI is used to identify neighbor cell. When the switch is close, eNB won't replace the PLMN.
item.name: rplcPLMNInRanSharSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates whether support getting load information by UTRAN RIM.
item.name: uRIMGetLBInfoSwch

item.desc: If this switch is opened, CA UE use fair scheduling,else use Differentiation scheduling
item.name: fairSchdSwch

item.desc: SON Reserved Switch1
item.name: tempNBRKpiRptSwch

item.desc: SON Reserved Switch2
item.name: reserved2

item.desc: SON Reserved Switch3
item.name: reserved3

item.desc: SON Reserved Switch4
item.name: reserved4

item.desc: SON Reserved Switch5
item.name: reserved5

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to enable MagicRadio and sets the operation mode of MagicRadio. If it is set to Support MagicRadio DBE Through CSON, GSM and LTE systems share bandwidths through the CSON module. If it is set to Support MagicRadio DBE Through iCS, GSM and LTE systems share bandwidths through the ICS module. If it is set to Support MagicRadio GLCSS, spectrum is shared between GSM and LTE systems. If it is set to Support MagicRadio UL DCE, carrier frequencies are automatically expanded between GSM and LTE systems. If it is set to Support MagicRadio ULCSS, spectrum is shared between UMTS and LTE systems.
item.name: magicRadioModeSwch

item.desc: The download RTP packet may be out of order because the CN, this will cause the MOS decreased, so the eNB can do some reordering function.
item.name: rtpOrderEnable

item.desc: The parameter indicates whether delete the neighbour cell when receives X2 update message including served cell delete
item.name: x2AdjCellDelSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables Uplink Data Compression (UDC) for the eNodeB. It should be configured as required.
item.name: ulDataCompSwch

item.desc: If the switch open, eNodB will consider adjacent cell VOIP capacity when Intra frequency or Inter frequency handover happen.
item.name: interFHOBaseVOIPSwch

item.desc: This parameter is switch for CA between FDD and TDD.
item.name: fddTddCaSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the switch for the inter-band 2-carrier CA function. It needs to be set to Open when it is required to perform 2-carrier CA among different bands.
item.name: interBandCaSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the switch for the intra-band continuous 2-carrier CA function. It needs to be set to Open when it is required to perform continuous 2-carrier CA within the same band.
item.name: inBandContCaSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the switch for the intra-band incontinuous 2-carrier CA function. It needs to be set to Open when it is required to perform incontinuous 2-carrier CA within the same band.
item.name: inBandInContCaSwch

item.desc: This parameter is used to compare the comp performance when comp off
item.name: potentialCOMPUserSwch

item.desc: this parameter is the switch to open or close TCP MSS modify function. Open this switch to avoid to fragment for tcp data sent to SGW by eNodeB
item.name: tcpMssModifySwch

item.desc: The Switch controls the X2 connection rebuild function. If the switch is open, X2 connection will be rebuild after peer eNB IP changed. If the switch is close, X2 connenction rebuild function won't work.
item.name: x2RebuildSwch

item.desc: The parameter represents the switch for S1 transport back pressure flow control. If the parameter set 'Open', then the eNB shall back pressure the Uplink Uu bandwidth when the UL S1 transport bandwidth is limited.
item.name: s1TansBackPressureSwch

item.desc: The parameter represents the switch for eNB flow control reject setup specified ERABs. If the eNB S1 transport bandwidth is very limited (for example, satellite transmission), to guarantee the important service communication, the Operator could set the parameter 'Open', the eNB shall only allowed setup specified dedicated ERABs.
item.name: enbFCErabRejectSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables uplink SDMA in a super cell. If it is set to Open, uplink SDMA is enabled for all the super cells in the eNodeB and SDMA pairing can be performed on the primary and secondary UEs for uplink scheduling. If it is set to Close, uplink SDMA is disabled for all the super cells in the eNodeB and SDMA pairing is not performed on the primary or secondary UEs for uplink scheduling.
item.name: SCSdmaSwchUl

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables downlink PDSCH SDMA in a super cell. If it is set to Open, downlink PDSCH SDMA is enabled for all the super cells in the eNodeB and PDSCH SDMA pairing can be performed on the primary and secondary UEs for downlink scheduling. If it is set to Close, downlink PDSCH SDMA is disabled for all the super cells in the eNodeB and PDSCH SDMA pairing is not performed on the primary or secondary UEs for downlink scheduling.
item.name: SCSdmaSwchDl

item.desc: This parameter indicates the frequency space configuration mode for multiple carriers. The application scenarios are as follows: 0: There is no frequency overlapping on multiple L carriers for the same RRU. 1: The overlapping partial protective band on multiple L carrier spectrum for the same RRU does not affect the peak flow rate of the cell. 2: The overlapping partial protective band on multiple L carrier spectrum for the same RRU affects the theoretical peak flow rate of the cell. 3: There are overlapping effective data bands (non-standard bandwidth) on multiple L carrier spectrum for the same RRU.
item.name: freqSpaceCfgMode

item.desc: The X2 delay between the enodeB is very large , use this switch to control the Comp function.
item.name: compSelMergeSwch

item.desc: The parameter is used when one of the comp related enodeB is Micro and another one is macro, use the switch to control the comp function.
item.name: compMicroAndMacroSwch

item.desc: When this switch is opened, the target cell choose appropriate SCells after received HandoverRequest message, and configurate these SCells to UE; When this switch is closed, all the SCells of source cell are deleted. Scells of target cell will be added Until handover procedure completed.
item.name: caScellHOSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the eNodeB monitors the service status of UEs. If it is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB monitors the service status of the connected UEs and only the UEs that meet the specified conditions can be configured with SCells. If it is set to 2 (Enhance), the eNodeB continuously monitors the service status of the connected UEs and adds or deletes SCells based on the changes in the service status of the UEs. If it is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB configures SCells for the connected UEs without monitoring the service status of the connected UEs.
item.name: caMonitorSwch

item.desc: If this switch is open,CA UE would be removed SCell when number of Ues in the Cell is reach Threshold of CA UE Back Off;If this switch is close,none of the CA UE would be removed Scell when number of UEs in the Cell is reach Threshold of CA UE Back Off.
item.name: caBackOffSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the Switch of CA band priority. When this switch is opened, If UE access a carrier which belongs to different overlapping frequency , it could be to enforce the UE to transform from main Band to compatible band through intra-cell handover before configuring Scell.
item.name: caBandPrioritySwch

item.desc: If it is open, the mainband of SIB1 is filled as the earliest band in the compatible bands, to allow the earliest UE access. If it is close, the mainband of SIB1 is filled according to the cell configuration.
item.name: bandCompSwch

item.desc: The parameter is RN-UE's MME selection judging switch, if it's open,eNB only select Relay-Support MME for RN-UE, otherwise eNB will select MME whether MME support Relay or not, regard RN-UE
item.name: jugeMMERelayIndSwch

item.desc: The parameter is RN-UE's MME selection judging switch, if it's open,eNB only select Relay-Support MME for RN-UE,otherwise eNB will select MME whether MME support Relay or not,regard RN-UE.
item.name: prmtEpcInDenbRnSwch

item.desc: This parameter is CSFB Fasten switch in VoLTE for WCP. If this switch is Open,eNodeb will response to MME a special value if VoLTE measurement havn't report to eNodeb, so that MME will trigger CSFB immediately and CSFB will be fasten.
item.name: csfbFastenInVoLTESwch

item.desc: Whether to choose CA users for CGI measurement. When the parameter is set to no, CA UE can not be used for CGI measurement; When the parameter is set to yes, CA UE can be used for CGI measurement.
item.name: cgiMeasSelectCAUeSwch

item.desc: The parameter indicates whether limit ue report measurement-report time, 0 is no time limit, other value indicate the corresponding time.
item.name: mrMaxOnlineTimeMode

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables adaptive CA configuration based on the number of MIMO layers. If this parameter is set to Add/Del 1 SCell in CA Adaptive at most, the eNodeB selects an SCell for UEs to perform MIMO adaption based on the frequency of neighbor cells and the MIMO capability of UEs. A maximum of one SCell can be added to or deleted from the MIMO adaption procedure. If this parameter is set to Add/Del 2 SCell in CA Adaptive at most, the eNodeB selects an SCell for UEs to perform MIMO adaption based on the frequency of neighbor cells and the MIMO capability of UEs. A maximum of two SCell can be added to/deleted from the MIMO adaption procedure and two inter-frequency neighbor cells with the same coverage can be added as SCells in one measurement.
item.name: caMIMOAdptSwch

item.desc: The parameter is the switch of the X2 link alarm. When it is opened, the alarm will be reported to OMC
item.name: x2AlarmSwch

item.desc: If ucSipIdentifySwch is equal to Open, the eNB will try to identify the SIP signaling of QCI5.
item.name: sipIdentifySwch

item.desc: If this parameter is set to encryption, it indicates that the signaling of QCI5 is encrypted and the eNodeB blindly identifies the signaling of QCI5. If this parameter is set to un-encryption, it indicates that the signaling of QCI5 is non-encrypted and the eNodeB normally identifies the signaling of QCI5. If this parameter is set to adaptive, the eNodeB identifies the SIP encryption status in an adaptive way.
item.name: ipsecStatus

item.desc: When switch is open,the scell of UE is released if the transmission delay between eNBs exceed the value of rossEnbDelayThr.
item.name: relScellOnDelaySwch

item.desc: This parameter is switch for 3CC CA between FDD and TDD.
item.name: fddTdd3ccCaSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the switch for the FDD+TDD 4CC CA function. It needs to be set to Open when it is required to perform FDD+TDD 4CC CA.
item.name: fddTdd4ccCaSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the switch for the FDD+TDD 5CC CA function. It needs to be set to Open when it is required to perform FDD+TDD 5CC CA.
item.name: fddTdd5ccCaSwch
