item.desc: This parameter is switch for inter eNB CA.
item.name: interEnbCaSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates whether to support co-building and sharing mode RAN sharing.
item.name: dedctRANSharingSwch

item.desc: If this switch is open and ucCAMonitorSwch is open,before monitor enabled,CA UE would be configured a Scell;If this switch is close and ucCAMonitorSwch is open,CA UE would be monitored,only if the suitable UE could be configured Scell;If ucCAMonitorSwch is close,this switch would not be open.
item.name: fastCABaseServiceSwch

item.desc: When eNB blind identify SIP signal 100trying which from IMS, need the 100trying signaling size scope,When is within the scope of this blind identification for MO
item.name: sip100tryingSizeHighThr

item.desc: When eNB blind identify SIP signal 100trying which from IMS, need the 100trying signaling size scope,When is within the scope of this blind identification for MO.
item.name: sip100tryingSizeLowThr

item.desc: When eNB blind identify SIP signal invite which from IMS, need the invite signaling size threshold, when is greater than the threshold, blind identification to be MT
item.name: sipInviteSizeThr

item.desc: A switch to control whether enable unidirection detection or not.
item.name: unidireDetectEnableSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the period for detecting unidirection in a session. It belongs to the unidirection detecting function. If RTP packet loss reaches the threshold specified by the algorithm, the eNodeB determines that unidirection occurs and triggers the corresponding counter.
item.name: unidireDetectDura

item.desc: Packet loss rate threshold value for Uplink, if the packet loss rate is more than the value can determine a suspected unidirection.
item.name: unidireThreUl

item.desc: Packet loss rate threshold value for Downlink, if the packet loss rate is more than the value can determine a suspected unidirection.
item.name: unidireThreDl

item.desc: A switch to control whether enable unidire recovery or not.
item.name: unidireRecoverySwch

item.desc: The Switch of Load Control, 1 means open load control and 0 means close the load control. The default value is 0.
item.name: loadControlSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the Magic Radio user migrate strategy. When it is config to 0, eNodeb will migrate the VoLTE user based measurement,and migrate the Data user based blind redirection. When it is config to 1, eNodeb will migrate the VoLTE user based blind handover or blind redirection,and migrate the Data user based blind redirection.
item.name: magicRadioUserMigStrategy

item.desc: Switch for LWA.
item.name: lwaSwch

item.desc: This parameter is used to configurate fullconfig for UE in handover when CA enabled, but the tunnel of data forward creat failed.
item.name: caFullConfigSwch

item.desc: The switch is to control the construction of SnInfo,when the switch is open,the SnInfo is constructed when downlink reestablishment is finished, when the swith is closed, the SnInfo is constructed immediately.
item.name: snTransOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter is used to support 3cc plan,3cc has a high bit rate,so the retransmission queue number should be bigger.
item.name: mccMaxRetranQueNum

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of Load balance to temporary neighbor relation cell.
item.name: tempNBRLBSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether handover measurement results can be reported based on uplink BSRs when only temporary neighbor cells are available for the corresponding frequency.
item.name: tempNbrULSRVHOSwch

item.desc: The threshold of 3CC switch to 4CC.
item.name: threeCC2fourCCthr

item.desc: The threshold of 4CC switch to 3CC.
item.name: fourCC2threeCCthr

item.desc: The threshold of 1CC switch to 2CC.
item.name: oneCC2twoCCthr

item.desc: The threshold of 2CC switch to 1CC.
item.name: twoCC2oneCCthr

item.desc: This parameter is switch for intra band continuous 3cc CA, which is need to be opened when configutate 3CC(the CCs are in the same band and continuous).
item.name: cont3ccCaSwch

item.desc: The parameter is the switch of handover to OSG cells for QCI1 services. If this parameter is set to Open, an OSG cell can be selected as the target cell for handover for OCI1 services. If this parameter is set to Close, no OSG cell can be selected as the target cell for handover for OCI1 services.
item.name: hoToOSGForQCI1Swch

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of handover to open Femto cells. If this parameter is set to Open, handover to open Femto cells is permitted. If this parameter is set to Close, handover to open Femto cells is not permitted.
item.name: hoToOSGSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the requested band function switch. If this parameter is set to Open, when the UE reports radio capability information, it also reports CA capability related to the band set configured for the eNB.
item.name: caRequestBandSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the load balancing mode. If it is set to Independent, load balancing is implemented in independence mode. If it is set to Enhanced, load balancing is implemented in enhancement mode.
item.name: loadBalanceMode

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable signalling-based MDT UTRAN periodic measurement. If it is set to Close, it indicates that the measurement is disabled. If it is set to Open, it indicates that the measurement is enabled.
item.name: sigMdtUtranPrdMeasSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable signalling-based MDT CDMA periodic measurement. If it is set to Close, it indicates that the measurement is disabled. If it is set to Open, it indicates that the measurement is enabled.
item.name: sigMdtCdmaPrdMeasSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable signalling-based MDT GSM periodic measurement. If it is set to Close, it indicates that the measurement is disabled. If it is set to Open, it indicates that the measurement is enabled.
item.name: sigMdtGsmPrdMeasSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable signalling-based MDT inter-frequency periodic measurement. If it is set to Close, it indicates that the measurement is disabled. If it is set to Open, it indicates that the measurement is enabled.
item.name: sigMdtInterPrdMeasSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the Magic Radio data user migration mode, which can be blind-redirection-based mode, blind-based mode, or measurement-based mode.
item.name: magRaDataUserMigMode

item.desc: EMTC UE Handover CE level Determine Strategy Switch. When the Switch is open, the handover source eNB carries the RSRP of handover target cell in the handover request message ,and the handover target eNB determines the CE level of the UE in handover target cell according to this RSRP value when the handover preparation stage;When the Switch is Close, the handover source eNB does not carry the RSRP of handover target cell in the handover request message ,and the handover target eNB determines the CE level of the UE in handover target cell according to InitialCElevel configured on OMC when the handover preparation stage.
item.name: eMTCHOCeLevelSwch

item.desc: The switch of udc protection function. When the switch is open, after the process of sending udc reset signal to ue, if the eNB doesn't receive 101 packet with in 5 seconds, the corresponding erab should be released by eNB.
item.name: udcResetProtestSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to select QCI1 users for ECGI measurement for the ANR function. When the parameter is set to Close, QCI1 UEs can not be selected for ECGI measurement. When the parameter is set to Open, QCI1 UEs can be selected for ECGI measurement.
item.name: cgiMeasSelQCI1UeSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the determination of the neighbor state during handover. When the system processes the coverage-based handover measurement reports:greater than When this parameter is set to Open: If the state of the neighbor cell is unavailable, the UE is redirected to the neighbor cell; if the state of the neighbor cell is available, the UE is handed over to the neighbor cell. greater than When this parameter is set to Close, the UE is handed over to the neighbor cell.
item.name: hOBasedNbrStatSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables strategic migration of online UEs during system software upgrade.
item.name: cloudReliaSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of counting potential DMIMO users when inter-cell DMIMO is disabled.
item.name: potentialDmimoUserSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the switch for gap release during ECGI measurement of open Femto cells. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB releases gaps during ECGI measurement of open Femto cells.
item.name: osgEcgiMeasGapRelSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of requesting to report logged MDT data when there are no logged MDT tasks.
item.name: noLogMdtTkReqLogDataSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the switch for the UL TCP ACK Split function. If the switch is turned on, the UL TCP ACK Split function is enabled. If the switch is turned off, the UL TCP ACK Split function is disabled.
item.name: tcpAckSplitSwchUl

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables massive collaboration. If it is set to Open, more than 16 collaborative neighbor cells are supported. If it is set to Close, at most 16 collaborative neighbor cells are supported.
item.name: massiveCooperationSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the handover control of temporary UTRAN neighbor cells. If it is set to Open, UEs can be handed over to an inter-RAT temporary UTRAN neighbor cell. If it is set to Close, UEs cannot be handed over to an inter-RAT temporary UTRAN neighbor cell.
item.name: utranTempNbrHoSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the handover control of temporary GERAN neighbor cells. If it is set to Open, UEs can be handed over to an inter-RAT temporary GERAN neighbor cell. If it is set to Close, UEs cannot be handed over to an inter-RAT temporary GERAN neighbor cell.
item.name: gsmTempNbrHoSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the DECOR function. If this parameter is set to Close, the eNodeB does not consider the DCN configuration when selecting an MME for the initially accessed UEs and does not support S1 rerouting. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB selects an MME for the initially accessed UEs based on the DCN configuration and supports S1 rerouting. This parameter is immediately effective, which means that it takes effect immediately only on the initially accessed UEs.
item.name: decorSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the MME selection type for an LTE UE when the DECOR function is enabled. If it is set to Only Non-DCN, the eNodeB selects only the MME from the non-DCNs for an initially accessed LTE UE. If it is set to Only Default DCN, the eNodeB selects only the MME from the default DCN for an initially accessed LTE UE. If it is set to Prior Non-DCN, the eNodeB preferentially selects the MME from the non-DCNs for an initially accessed LTE UE and selects the MME from the default DCN if the selection fails. This parameter is immediately effective, which means that it takes effect immediately only on the initially accessed UEs.
item.name: mMESelec4LteUE

item.desc: This parameter indicates the MME selection type when UE rerouting fails. If the eNodeB fails to reselect an MME for a UE according to the MME information in the REROUTE NAS REQUEST message: If ucMMESelec4RerouteFail is set to Default DCN, the eNodeB selects the MME belonging to the default DCN for the UE. If ucMMESelec4RerouteFail is set to Reroute Request MME, the eNodeB still selects the MME that sends a REROUTE NAS REQUEST message to the eNodeB. This parameter is immediately effective, which means that it takes effect immediately only on the initially accessed UEs.
item.name: mMESelec4RerouteFail

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables CA between macro cells and micro cells.
item.name: macroMicroCaSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables uplink Robust Header Compression (ROHC) of the eNodeB. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the profile6Ul (Whether to Support Profile6 for Uplink Only ROHC) parameter of a bearer is set to 1 (Yes), the eNodeB compresses the headers of the uplink data packets on the bearer to improve the usage of radio bandwidth resources.
item.name: onlyRohcSwchUl

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of whether management-based MDT uses a non-standard MDT PLMN list. If the parameter is set to Open, management-based MDT uses a non-standard MDT PLMN list. If the parameter is set to Close, management-based MDT supports MDT PLMN lists for standard interfaces only.
item.name: mdtPlmnListSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of the Licensed Assisted Access (LAA) LBT function.
item.name: lbtEnableSwch

item.desc: If an FS board is faulty, this parameter is set to Open to disable the configuration of intra-eNodeB inter-board SCells or inter-eNodeB SCells. If an FS board is faulty, this parameter is set to Open to allow to delete intra-eNodeB inter-board SCells or inter-eNodeB SCells.
item.name: sccJudgeOfFSFatSwchUl

item.desc: This parameter controls whether the LTE network reports NR traffic. When the LTE network receives an NR traffic report, it sends the report to the MME if this parameter is set to Open; if this parameter is set to Close, the LTE network does not send the report to the MME. When the core network needs to charge users for 5G traffic, this parameter needs to be set to Open.
item.name: secRatRptSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the configuration of different inter-frequency measurement indications for voice and data users. If it is set to Close, voice and data users can be configured only with the same measurement indication for inter-frequency measurement; otherwise, voice and data users can be configured with different measurement indications for inter-frequency measurement.
item.name: interFMeasIndDif4VTDTSwch

item.desc: This parameter controls RIM routing. If it is set to 1, the eNodeB communicates with the core network of the specified PLMN. Otherwise, it communicates with all the connected core networks.
item.name: plmnRouteSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables indoor QCell positioning according to the China Mobile 4G Edge Computing Platform and eNodeB Data Transmission Interface.
item.name: mecsQcellPosiSwitch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables CA between TDD and FDD carriers when the TDD carrier is the PCell.
item.name: tddFddCaSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables 3CC CA between TDD and FDD carriers when the TDD carrier is the PCell.
item.name: tddFdd3ccCaSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables 4CC CA between TDD and FDD carriers when the TDD carrier is the PCell.
item.name: tddFdd4ccCaSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables 5CC CA between TDD and FDD carriers when the TDD carrier is the PCell.
item.name: tddFdd5ccCaSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables CoMP user optimization. If it is set to Open, CoMP users are optimized to balance user resources and reduce the occupancy of neighbor resources.
item.name: cOMPUserOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables DRX configuration validation for ordinary UEs during handover. If it is set to Close, the DRX configurations of the target cell are transmitted in the handover command. If it is set to Open, the DRX release message is transmitted in the handover command to disable DRX and DRX is closed in the target cell.
item.name: drxConfig4NormalUEHOSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the eNodeB out-of-service alarm is reported when all the cells are out of service. It is customized for Cell C, South Africa. If it is set to Close, the eNodeB out-of-service alarm is not reported when all the cells are out of service. Note: This parameter does not work on the eNodeB out-of-service alarm triggered by the following faults: S1 disconnection, CC faults, and clock out-of-synchronization. It is configured as required.
item.name: enbWarnSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the PS handover between LTE and NR systems.
item.name: nLPsHoSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates reserved mobility switch 6.
item.name: reserved6

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to statically save the blacklisted LTE neighbor cells.
item.name: lteBlackNbrDbsSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval for saving the neighbor relations in the blacklist. It is used to control the execution period of the tasks for saving the neighbor relations in the blacklist. When the eNodeB is powered on, this timer is started. When the eNodeB is powered off, this timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the eNodeB updates the saving records of the neighbor relations in the blacklist and restarts the timer.
item.name: blackNbrSynPrd

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to specify the maximum number of carriers for CA band combinations. If it is set to Open, the UE capability request message sent by the eNodeB carries the requestedMaxCCsDL-r13 and requestedMaxCCsUL-r13 IEs. When a UE reports its radio capability, only the CA band combinations with the number of carriers less than or equal to the specified number of carriers can be reported. If it is set to Close, the UE capability request message sent by the eNodeB does not carry the requestedMaxCCsDL-r13 or requestedMaxCCsUL-r13 IE. When a UE reports its radio capability, all the CA band combinations can be reported without a restriction on the number of carriers.
item.name: caMaxCcNumIndSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables intra-band non-contiguous combination reduction in CA scenarios. If it is set to Open, the UE capability request message sent by the eNodeB carries the requestReducedIntNonContComb-r13 IE. When a UE reports its radio capability, it reduces the CA capability based on intra-band non-contiguous CA band combinations. If it is set to Close, the UE capability request message sent by the eNodeB does not carry the requestReducedIntNonContComb-r13 IE. When a UE reports its radio capability, it does not reduce the CA capability based on intra-band non-contiguous CA band combinations.
item.name: caReduceNonContCombSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to report fallback combinations to the eNodeB in CA scenarios. If it is set to Open, the UE capability request message sent by the eNodeB carries the skipFallbackCombinations-r13 and supportedBandCombinationReduced-r13 IEs. When a UE reports its radio capability, it does not report fallback band combinations to the eNodeB. If it is set to Close, the UE capability request message sent by the eNodeB does not carry the skipFallbackCombinations-r13 and supportedBandCombinationReduced-r13 IEs. When a UE reports its radio capability, it reports fallback band combinations to the eNodeB.
item.name: caSkipFallBackCombSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the reporting of the CA LAA counter is based on eNodeB configurations. If it is set to Open, the counter reports whether the UE has the LAA capability based on the configurations of the eNodeB. If it is set to Close, the counter reports whether the UE has the LAA capability based on only UE capability information without considering the configurations of the eNodeB.
item.name: caLAAKpiOfEnbCfgSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables Deflate-based Uplink Data Compression (UDC) on eNodeBs as required by operators.
item.name: deflateUDCSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables uplink CA between FDD and TDD carriers.
item.name: fddTddCaSwchUL

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to report fallback combinations with radio capability differences to the eNodeB in CA scenarios. When this parameter is set to Open, the Switch for Fallback Combination Reporting Skip in CA Scenarios parameter must be set to Open. When a UE reports radio capability, no fallback band combination except those with different radio capability is reported to the eNodeB.
item.name: caDiffFallBackCombSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether redirection or reselection information is carried. If this parameter is set to Open, during the access procedure of a UE, no redirection or reselection information is carried in the UE release information when the UE is released before security authentication. If this parameter is set to Close, redirection or reselection information is carried.
item.name: redirectwithSecuritySwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables inter-PLMN intra-eNodeB handover.
item.name: intraEnbInterPlmnHOSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the eDECOR function. It is used to optimize the selection of the routes to the DCN for UEs and decrease the load on the default DCN. It can be set to Open if the default DCN is overloaded or the operator wants to optimize the DECOR function.
item.name: eDecorSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the EN-DC enhancement policy for anchor cells. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the non-MCG bearers of NSA UEs are established on the NR PDCP layer during access or inter-eNodeB incoming handover to NSA anchor cells. If this parameter is set to 0 (Open), the non-MCG bearers of NSA UEs are established on the PCE layer.
item.name: eNDCEnhcedAchorpolySwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables NR gap measurement. If it is set to Open, NR gap measurement is enabled. If it is set to Close, NR gap measurement is disabled.
item.name: nrMeasGapSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the report of EN-DC X2 configuration update to the OMC. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB notifies the OMC to update NR neighbor cell information after receiving an EN-DC X2 setup request, an EN-DC X2 setup response, or an EN-DC X2 configuration update message if the NR neighbor cell configured on the OMC is different from that carried in the EN-DC X2 message. If it is set to Close, the eNodeB does not send an NR neighbor cell update message to the OMC.
item.name: eNDCX2UpdateOMCSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the filtering of specific UEs during CGI measurement. If it is set to Open, specific UEs cannot be used to measure the CGI.
item.name: cgiSpecUeSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to migrate UEs after the cell is shut down.
item.name: movUe4CellBlockSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the mode in which UEs are migrated. How a UE is migrated depends on the operator's requirements. If this parameter is set to Measure, UEs are migrated based on the measurement configurations. If it is set to Blind, UEs are migrated based on blind handover or redirection.
item.name: mod4MovingUE

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to enable static spectrum sharing for MagicRadio CSS. If this parameter is set to Open, static CSS spectrum sharing is enabled. If this parameter is set to Close, both dynamic and static MagicRadio CSS spectrum sharing are enabled. In this case, if an LTE cell is not configured with a GSM neighbor cell that supports CSS, CSS can be implemented in full bandwidth.
item.name: cssStaticSharingSwitch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the inter-RAT handover of EN-DC UEs between LTE and GERAN systems. If it is set to Open, EN-DC UEs can be handed over from an LTE system to a GERAN system.
item.name: enDcGlPsHoSwitch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the inter-RAT handover of EN-DC UEs between LTE and UTRAN systems. If it is set to Open, EN-DC UEs can be handed over from an LTE system to a UTRAN system.
item.name: enDcULPsHoSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to consider SCG bearers in PerQCI measurement for EN-DC UEs. If it is set to Yes, SCG bearers need to be considered in PerQCI measurement for EN-DC UEs.
item.name: enDcPerQCIMeasWhrScgBear

item.desc: This parameter sets the period for the eNodeB to report RF fingerprint information to the fingerprint database. RF fingerprint information includes the information about UE measurement reports and handover.
item.name: rFFInfoReportPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the period for the eNodeB to report inter-frequency RF fingerprint information to the fingerprint database. RF fingerprint information includes the information about inter-frequency UE measurement reports and handover.
item.name: rFFInterFInfoReportPeriod

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to report an alarm when SMTC parameters are not correctly configured. If it is set to Open, alarms (if any) are reported.
item.name: sMTCWarnSwch

item.desc: Service Global Reserved Parameter 1
item.name: algGlobalRsved1

item.desc: This parameter sets the sharing mode of 5G networks. If it is set to 0, RAN sharing is disabled. If it is set to 1, RAN sharing is enabled and common carriers are shared. If it is set to 2, RAN sharing is enabled and dedicated carriers are shared.
item.name: nrShareMode

item.desc: This parameter sets reserved mobility switch 7.
item.name: reserved7

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables TCP proxy for NSA UEs in NR PDCP scenarios. If it is set to 1 (Open), the throughput of TCP data of UEs can increase.
item.name: tcpProxyNSASwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables inter-frequency periodic measurement for NSA UEs. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB can send inter-frequency and inter-RAT measurement configurations to NSA UEs and the NSA UEs can perform inter-frequency and inter-RAT measurement. If it is set to Close, the eNodeB does not send inter-frequency or inter-RAT measurement configurations to NSA UEs and the NSA UEs do not perform inter-frequency or inter-RAT measurement.
item.name: nsaInterPeriodMeasSwitch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables forced saving of UE capability. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB forcibly saves the received UE capability if the UE capability is reported by the air interface. If the UE capability is received from the core network and there is no UE capability information on the eNodeB, the eNodeB saves the UE capability. If there is UE capability information on the eNodeB, the eNodeB discards the UE capability.
item.name: ueCapForcedSaveSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether an NR PCI confusion alarm is reported.
item.name: nrPciAlarmSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables anchor attribute update for LTE neighbor cells. If it is set to Open, the anchor attributes are updated based on the information exchanged on the X2 interface. If this parameter is set to Close, the anchor attributes are updated based on the configurations on the EMS.
item.name: eNDCAnchorAttriUpdateSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether only the PLMN and MME code need to be matched in UE routing through the GUMMEI.
item.name: gummeiRouteCompSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to report EN-DC X2 link alarms.
item.name: eNDCX2AlarmSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the type of IPSec certificate for EN-DC X2 links. It is used to configure IPSec channels for EN-DC X2 links between LTE and NR cells. It can be set to the same as that of the S1, to the vendor certificate, to the operator certificate, or to the configuration of the SON IPSec parameter template.
item.name: enDcX2CertType

item.desc: This parameter specifies the IPSec operator certificate used for EN-DC X2 self configuration, which is used to create IPSec when configuring EN-DC X2 between LTE-NR. When IPSec certificates are required to use operator certificates, this parameter is configured as operator certificates; Otherwise, the configuration is empty.
item.name: refOperatorCert

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the QCI DC bearer types based on PLMNs. It is used to determine the dual-connectivity bearer types corresponding to the QCIs configured for different PLMNs. If it is set to Open, the dual-connection bearer type corresponding to the QCI configured for the PLMN where the UE is located is used. If the dual-connection bearer type is not configured for the PLMN where the UE is located, the dual-connection bearer type configured for the primary PLMN of the eNodeB is used. If this parameter is set to Close, all the PLMNs use the dual-connection bearer type corresponding to the QCI configured for the primary PLMN of the eNodeB.
item.name: dCBearerTypePLMNSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the signaling-based MDT M7 period mode, 0 for the period mode defined by a non-3GPP specification and 1 for the period mode defined by the 3GPP. The periods defined by a non-3GPP specification are 1024 ms, 2048 ms, 5120 ms, 10240 ms, and 1 minutes, while the periods defined by the 3GPP are 1 minute to 60 minutes.
item.name: signalMdtM7PeriodMode

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the automatic detection of allowable frequencies. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB automatically detects whether the UEs support the configured range of allowable frequencies with a high/low priority. If the eNodeB determines that a frequency range is not supported, it does not trigger measurement or handover procedures for the frequencies within the frequency range. Note: If the eNodeB determines that a UE supports a range of allowable high-priority frequencies, it also supports a range of allowable low-priority frequencies.
item.name: allowLTEFreqAtuoDetSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to send a PWS Restart Indication message. It is used to handle CMAS messages if a cell is out of service.
item.name: sendPWSRestartIndSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to send a PWS Failure Indication message. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB sends a PWS Failure Indication message to the CN, instructing the MME to stop sending a CMAS message when the cell that satisfies certain conditions becomes out of service.
item.name: sendPWSFailureIndSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the identification of special CMAS number ranges. It is used to identify the CMAS messages related to special number ranges. If it is set to 0, the identification of special CMAS number ranges is disabled. If it is set to 1, the identification of special CMAS number ranges is enabled.
item.name: cmasSpecialRangeSwitch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the construction of ECGI information in a special way. It is used to construct ECGI information based on the PLMNs configured for a cell if the cell is configured with multiple PLMNs.
item.name: specialECGISwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the punishment of handover failures caused by the barring of incoming handover to the target cell. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB triggers the punishment function when a handover failure occurs due to the barring of incoming handover to the target cell, that is, the handover to the target cell is not initiated within a certain period.
item.name: cellBarHoFailPunishSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the automatic configuration of the DSS coordination relation on the LTE side. If it is set to Open, the automatic configuration of the DSS coordination relation on the LTE side takes effect. If it is set to Close, the automatic configuration of the DSS coordination relation on the LTE side does not take effect.
item.name: dssNbrSelfCfgSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets a QCI for the User-Inactivity function to identify special UEs. If the User-Inactivity function is enabled, the UE for which the bearer with the indicated QCI has been established is identified as a UE with a specific QCI. The duration of the inactivity timer is defined by the User-Inactivity Timer for Special QCI UEs parameter.
item.name: specUeIdentityQci

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables PLMN replacement for NR neighbor cells in RAN sharing scenarios. If it is set to Open and the PLMNs of the NR neighbor cells reported on the air interface are the PLMNs broadcasted by the NR neighbor cells in a RAN sharing area, the PLMNs of the NR neighbor cells reported on the air interface are set to the primary PLMN of the NR neighbor cells in the RAN sharing area.
item.name: rplcNrPLMNInRanSharSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to update the configuration information of LTE neighbor cells when the changes in LTE neighbor cell information are detected on the air interface.
item.name: lteUuUpdateAdjCellMode

item.desc: This parameter determines whether NR neighbor cells support NSA by default. It is used in the addition of NR neighbor cells when the ANR function is enabled.
item.name: defaultNsaMode

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the eNodeB to check whether the current scenario is a real emergency call scenario when the integrity protection algorithms received from the core network are all zeros. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB checks whether the current scenario is a real emergency call scenario when the integrity protection algorithms delivered by the core network are all zeros. If not, the eNodeB rejects the request from the core network. If it is set to Close, the eNodeB determines that the current scenario is a real emergency call scenario when the integrity protection algorithms delivered by the core network are all zeros and then processes the call in the same way an emergency call is processed.
item.name: mmeUeCapVerifySwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to allow a UE to be handed over or redirected to the NR cell whose serving PLMN is different from that of the UE. If this parameter is set to Open, the UE can be handed over or redirected to the NR cell whose serving PLMN is different from that of the UE. If this parameter is set to Close, the UE cannot be handed over or redirected to the NR cell whose serving PLMN is different from that of the UE.
item.name: interPlmnHoToNRSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables UE capability security optimization. During a UE access procedure, if no UE capability information is carried in the context setup request from the CN and this parameter is set to Open, the eNodeB performs UE capability enquiry after the AS security mode is activated. If this parameter is set to Close, the eNodeB performs UE capability enquiry before the AS security mode is activated.
item.name: ueCapSecOptSwitch

item.desc: This parameter determines how to obtain the NCGI measurement type of an NR neighbor cell. If it is set to DRX, it indicates that the NCGI is measured based on DRX. If the UE capability does not support DRX, no measurement task is delivered. If it is set to DRX, it indicates that the NCGI is measured based on auto-gap. If the UE capability does not support auto-gap, no measurement task is delivered. If it is set to Self-Adaptive, it indicates that auto-gap-based NCGI measurement is preferentially selected. If the UE capability does not support auto-gap-based NCGI measurement, DRX-based NCGI measurement is selected. If the UE capability does not support DRX-based NCGI measurement, no measurement task is delivered.
item.name: ncgiMeasType

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables context retrieve during inter-site re-establishment of the eNodeB. If it is set to Close, the eNodeB does not support context retrieve during inter-site re-establishment, that is, the UE context stored on the source site can be obtained through the X2 RLF procedure between the destination site and the source site during inter-site re-establishment. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB supports context retrieve during inter-site re-establishment, that is, the UE context stored on the source site can be obtained through the retrieve procedure between the destination site and the source site during inter-site re-establishment.
item.name: interEnbReestRetrvSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to reserve the blacklist-resident intra-LTE neighbor cells in the case of ANR policy parameter modification. In the modification of the ANR policy parameters related to detecting the low handover success rate, to reserve the blacklist-resident intra-LTE neighbor cells, set this parameter to Open. To clear the blacklist-resident intra-LTE neighbor cells, set this parameter to Close. A blacklist-resident intra-LTE neighbor cell is an intra-LTE neighbor cell that is stored in the blacklist of intra-LTE neighbor cells. The information of a blacklist-resident is not lost even if the eNodeB is powered off or upgraded.
item.name: blackNbrReservedSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets a special VoNR strategy for the eNodeB. If it is set to Close, the eNodeB allows to trigger the handover or redirection from VoLTE to VoNR only for the UEs whose capability supports VoNR. If it is set to Black List Strategy, the eNodeB does not trigger the handover or redirection from VoLTE to VoNR for the UEs whose special VoNR strategy is set to Black List. If it is set to White List Strategy, the eNodeB triggers the handover or redirection from VoLTE to VoNR only for the UEs whose special VoNR strategy is set to White List and whose capability supports VoNR.
item.name: voNRSpecStgySwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the reporting of sleeping cell alarms. If a cell is determined as a sleeping cell and this parameter is set to Open, alarms are reported when they are generated. If this parameter is set to Close, no alarms are reported when they are generated.
item.name: enableSleepAlarm

item.desc: This parameter optimizes the UE capability enquiry length. It determines whether the eNodeB inquires about the UE capabilities again to obtain sufficient UE capability information in an NSA scenario. To inquire about the UE capabilities:If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB inquires about the UE capabilities twice. (1) The eNodeB inquires about the E-UTRAN capability of the UE (without carrying the list of filtered frequency bands). (2) The eNodeB inquires about the E-UTRAN capability (carrying the list of filtered frequency bands), NR capability, and E-UTRAN_NR capability of the UE. If this parameter is set to 1 (AttachNrAndMrdcCombination), the eNodeB inquires about the UE capabilities twice in an access procedure. (1) The eNodeB inquires about the E-UTRAN capability of the UE (carrying the list of filtered frequency bands). (2) The eNodeB inquires about the NR capability and E-UTRAN_NR capability of the UE. If this parameter is set to 2 (AttachHoUeCapIndependency), the eNodeB inquires about the UE capabilities three times, E-UTRAN capability (carrying the list of filtered frequency bands), NR capability, and MRDC capability in turn.
item.name: ueCapLenOptSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the strategy for handing over UEs across PLMNs in the LTE system. If inter-PLMN handover takes effect and this parameter is set to System Level Inter-PLMN Handover Strategy, the system-level inter-PLMN handover strategy takes effect and the eNodeB does not determine the service type of a UE during the inter-PLMN handover or redirection of the UE. If this parameter is set to QCI Level Inter-PLMN Handover Strategy, the eNodeB determines whether to perform inter-PLMN handover or redirection based on the service type of a UE during the inter-PLMN handover or redirection of the UE.
item.name: interPlmnHOLTEStgy

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables fault tolerance for measurement report information. In an LTE network, there may be some UEs whose measurement reports show that the RSRP or RSRQ of the serving cell is 0. If this parameter is set to Close, after receiving such measurement reports, the eNodeB blindly redirects the UEs because it falsely determines that the serving cell where the UEs are located is fast fading. If this parameter is set to Open, after receiving such measurement reports, the eNodeB does not blindly redirect the UEs because it does not determine that the serving cell where the UEs are located is fast fading.
item.name: measRptTolerantSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the QCI indications of the services of the UEs that can be handed over or redirected across PLMNs in the LTE system. It determines which UEs can be handed over or redirected across PLMNs in the LTE system. This parameter is an array parameter consisting of sixteen elements. If a UE contains at least one service with the QCI configured by this parameter, the UE can be handed over or redirected across the PLMNs in the LTE system. If an element is set to 0, it indicates that no QCI service is specified.
item.name: interPlmnHOLTEQciInd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the ROHC Profile0x0004 function. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB and UEs compress and decompress the IP headers of the uplink and downlink service (except the QCI1, QCI2, and QCI5 services) packets on data bearers to save Uu bandwidth resources and improve user experience.
item.name: rohcProfile4Switch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables 5G capability enquiry. If it is set to Close, the eNodeB does not inquire the 5G capability of UEs. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB inquires the 5G capability of a UE if it receives no 5G capability information from the UE.
item.name: nrCapEnquirySwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to replace the PLMN carried in the PWS alarm message in a MORAN scenario. If it is set to Open, the PLMN used in the ECGI is the serving PLMN of the current cell. If it is set to Close, the PLMN used in the ECGI is the primary PLMN of the current cell.
item.name: pWSPlmnReplSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables fault tolerance of frequency band capability information of UEs. There may be some special UEs in the LTE network. The UEs report their radio capabilities, indicating that they do not support the frequency band of the current serving cell. If this parameter is set to Open, the eNodeB considers that such UEs support the frequency band of the serving cell, and provides services for the UEs. If this parameter is set to Close, such UEs are allowed to only access the serving cell, but they cannot be handed over to or from the serving cell at the same frequency.
item.name: ueBndCapTolerantSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the eNodeB supports configuring EN-DC links between LTE frequencies and NR frequencies in the same frequency band. If it is set to Open, an LTE carrier and an NR carrier with the same frequency band ID can both be configured as the serving cell of a UE when the eNodeB configures an EN-DC link for the UE. If it is set to Close, for an LTE carrier and an NR carrier with the same frequency band ID, only one of them can be configured as the serving cell of a UE when the eNodeB configures an EN-DC link for the UE.
item.name: intraBandENDCSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to reserve SR, CQI, SRS, and preamble resources for specific advanced users in a cell. Bits 0 and 1 indicate the policy for reserving high-quality SR, CQI, and SRS resources. If they are set to 00, it indicates that the high-quality SR, CQI, and SRS resources are not reserved for advanced users. If they are set to 01, it indicates that the high-quality SR, CQI, and SRS resources are conditionally reserved for advanced users. If they are set to 10, it indicates that the high-quality SR, CQI, and SRS resources are reserved for advanced users. Bits 4 and 5 indicate the policy for reserving high-quality preamble resources. If they are set to 00, it indicates that the high-quality preamble resources are not reserved for advanced users. If they are set to 01, it indicates that the high-quality preamble resources are conditionally reserved for advanced users. If they are set to 10, it indicates that the high-quality preamble resources are reserved for advanced users. The remaining bits are not used in the current version. Reserving resources for advanced users can ensure good experience for such users.
item.name: preambleOptSwitch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables mobility-based handover management. If it is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB can trigger mobility-based handover. If it is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB cannot trigger mobility-based handover. In this case, no handover operation can be performed on the UEs in the coverage of the eNodeB.
item.name: mobiHoManageSwitch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to allow a UE to be handed over or redirected to the LTE cell whose serving PLMN is different from that of the UE. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the UE can be handed over or redirected to the LTE cell whose serving PLMN is different from that of the UE. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the UE cannot be handed over or redirected to the LTE cell whose serving PLMN is different from that of the UE.
item.name: interPlmnHoToLteSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable load prediction for self-updating of the eNodeB. If this parameter is set to Open, based on the historical service load, the eNodeB predicts a system idle period or off-peak period for activating a version within the specified period.
item.name: autoUpBasedLoadPredSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the IDs of special UEs. It is used to guarantee the services of the special UEs. If the specialUserMappingSwitch (Switch of the Special UE-Based Mapping Policy) parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB uses this parameter to identify the special UEs that meet the specified conditions and guarantees the services of such UEs.
item.name: specialUserID

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to adjust procedure conflicts caused by normal UE release triggered by the MME. If it is set to 1 (Open), a UE does not report the KPIs related to E-RAB setup failures and context setup failures during an access procedure when the UE receives a message indicating a normal release triggered by the MME due to a UE fault, improving service indicators.
item.name: procConflict4MmeSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the mapping policy based on special UEs. If it is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB identifies the special UEs that meet the specified conditions by using the specialUserID (Special UE ID) parameter configured on the UME, so that the eNodeB can guarantee the services of these UEs in subsequent processing.
item.name: specialUserMappingSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the eNodeB supports RedCap UEs. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB identifies whether a UE is a RedCap UE. If yes, the eNodeB allows the UE to be handed over to an NR cell/frequency that supports RedCap UEs. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB does not identify whether a UE is a RedCap UE.
item.name: redCapFuncSupSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to optimize one-way fault detection during a UE handover procedure. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the source eNodeB detects one-way faults during handover preparation only. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the source eNodeB detects one-way faults during both handover preparation and execution.
item.name: unidireDetectOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables SCell selection based on uplink frequency priorities. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB preferentially adds a cell on a frequency with a higher priority as an uplink SCell for UEs. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), SCell selection based on uplink frequency priorities does not take effect.
item.name: scellSelBaseUlFreqPriSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to configure 4CC CA or 5CC CA during UE handover. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the target eNodeB configures 4CC CA or 5CC CA for UEs during handover, increasing the traffic of the UEs after the handover. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the target eNodeB configures a maximum of 2CC CA or 3CC CA for UEs during handover.
item.name: cASCellHOSwchfor4CC5CC

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of 32 elements. Each element indicates a general-QoS guarantee type of service of the UEs for which the eNodeB disables periodic inter-frequency and inter-RAT measurement. A maximum of 32 general-QoS guarantee types are supported. If an element value is 255, it indicates that no general-QoS guarantee type is configured. The element value 1 indicates general-QoS guarantee type 1, the element value 2 indicates general-QoS guarantee type 2, the element value 3 indicates general-QoS guarantee type 3, and so forth. If a UE has the services of at least one general-QoS guarantee type specified by this parameter, the eNodeB does not deliver periodic inter-frequency inter-RAT measurement tasks to the UE.
item.name: periodMeasClosedQosType

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable cell 4T/2T adaptation for UEs of the specified general-QoS type. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the RRUs/AAUs of the intra-frequency neighbor cells containing UEs of the specified general-QoS type adaptively adapt from 4T to 2T, thus reducing downlink interference on the cells and improving the downlink traffic of the cells. If the conditions are no longer met, the RRUs/AAUs of these intra-frequency neighbor cells adapt from 2 T to 4T.
item.name: adaptCoordinateSwch2T4T

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of neighbor cells that support 4T-to-2T antenna adaptation. It is an array parameter consisting of 20 elements. Elements 1 through 20 indicate the maximum numbers of neighbor cells of a cell that has UEs with the services of general QoS type1 through general QoS type20 respectively.
item.name: adaptSuppNbrNum4T2T

item.desc: This parameter sets the types of general QoS services that trigger 4T-to-2T antenna adaptation in cells. It is an array parameter consisting of 20 elements. Elements 1 through 20 indicate whether the services of QoS type1 through QoS type20 in turn trigger 4T-to-2T antenna adaptation in the intra-frequency neighbor cells of a cell. If an element is set to 1, it indicates that the cell that has UEs with the services of the corresponding general QoS type instructs its intra-frequency neighbor cells to perform 4T-to-2T antenna adaptation, reducing the downlink interference to the cell and increasing the downlink traffic of the UEs in the cell. If an element is set to 0, it indicates that the cell that has UEs with the services of the corresponding general QoS type does not trigger 4T-to-2T antenna adaptation in its intra-frequency neighbor cells.
item.name: trig4T2TAdaptQosType

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the protection timer for 4T-to-2T antenna adaptation. When a UE with a service of the specified type enters the current cell, this timer is started. When a new UE with a service of the specified type enters the current cell, the timer is restarted. When all the UEs with the services of the specified type leave the cell, the timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the cell instructs the RRUs/AAUs of its intra-frequency neighbor cells that meet specified conditions to switch over from 2T to 4T.
item.name: adaptElapseTimer4T2T

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables procedure compatibility control for the eNodeB. It is an array parameter consisting of eight elements. Element 0 sets whether the EN-DC procedure is compatible with the VoLTE call procedure. If this element is set to 1 (Open), the timer specified by the erabModConfirmTimer (E-RAB Modification Confirmation Timer) parameter expires, and the UE has a VoLTE call, the eNodeB does not initiate a UE release procedure. Element 1 sets whether to enable procedure compatibility control for the scenario where the downlink address change in the EN-DC procedure conflicts with the E-RAB setup, modification, or deletion procedure. If the timer specified by the erabModConfirmTimer (E-RAB Modification Confirmation Timer) parameter expires and there are E-RAB setup, modification, or deletion messages present in the eNodeB buffer, the eNodeB does not initiate a UE release procedure. Element 2 sets whether to enable procedure compatibility control for the scenario where the downlink address change in the EN-DC procedure conflicts with some NAS procedures (for example, TAU). If the timer specified by the erabModConfirmTimer (E-RAB Modification Confirmation Timer) parameter expires and there is no E-RAB setup, modification, or deletion message present in the eNodeB buffer, the eNodeB does not initiate a UE release procedure. The remaining five elements are not defined in this version.
item.name: enbCompbleSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to transfer general-QoS types during inter-RAT handover. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. Element 0 sets whether the carried general-QoS types of UEs are saved on 4G cells when the UEs are handed over from 5G cells to 4G cells. If this element is set to 0 (Close), the carried general-QoS types are not saved on the 4G cells. If this element is set to 1 (Open), the carried general-QoS types are saved on the 4G cells. Element 1 sets whether the general-QoS types of UEs are carried when the UEs are handed over from 5G cells to 4G cells. If this element is set to 0 (Close), the general-QoS types are not carried. If this element is set to 1 (Open), the general-QoS types are carried.
item.name: interRatHoQosTypeSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the optimization for GTPU error indexes. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), it indicates that a GTPU error index is not deleted when a bearer corresponding to the GTPU error index is released. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), it indicates that a GTPU error index is deleted when a bearer corresponding to the GTPU error index is released, reducing the dropped-call rate of VoLTE services.
item.name: gtpuErrIndOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables power negotiation for UEs in NSA scenarios where NR cells are on high frequencies. If it is set to 1 (Open), the LTE cells can negotiate power with the NR cells statically, semi-statically, or dynamically to optimize the uplink power of the NSA UEs.
item.name: nsaFR2PwrCoorSwch

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of 10 elements, and each element enables or disables the internal-counter function of a domain (a type of organizational unit of ZTE). If an element is set to 1 (Open), the system collects the internal-counter data of the corresponding domain. Element 0 enables or disables the internal counter function of the RNLC domain. Element 1 enables or disables the internal counter function of the RNLU domain. Element 2 enables or disables the internal counter function of the CMAC domain. Element 3 enables or disables the internal counter function of the SON domain. Element 4 enables or disables the internal counter function of the IPA domain. Element 5 enables or disables the internal counter function of the PHY domain. Element 6 enables or disables the internal counter function of the LWOS domain. Element 7 enables or disables the internal counter function of the TOOL domain. Elements 8 and 9 are reserved.
item.name: innerMetricsFuncSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the parameters related to downlink TCP proxy. It takes effect only if the tcpProxySwch (Switch for TCP Proxy Function) parameter is set to 1 (Open). It is an array parameter consisting of 20 elements. Element 0 sets the maximum number of packets that can be buffered per downlink TCP service flow. If the number of buffered packets reaches the value of this element during TCP proxy, the TCP proxy procedure stops. The element value ranges from 50 through 10000. Element 1 sets the maximum number of packets that can be buffered for a single UE to support TCP proxy. If the number of packets buffered for a single UE reaches the value of this element during TCP proxy, the TCP proxy procedure stops. The element value ranges from 50 through 20000. Element 2 sets the duration threshold (in milliseconds) of TCP proxy. If the TCP proxy duration exceeds this threshold, the TCP proxy procedure stops. The element value ranges from 50 through 10000000. Element 3 sets the corresponding type of UE whose TCP service flows can be processed through TCP proxy servers. If it is set to 0, it indicates that no UE is supported. After the parameter value is converted to a binary, each bit indicates a general-QoS service type. The least significant bit indicates type1 and the most significant bit indicates type7. The element value ranges from 0 through 127. Element 4 sets the maximum number of retransmitted packets if TCP service flows are processed through TCP proxy servers. When the TCP service expires, the packets are retransmitted N (specified by this element value) times. The element value ranges from 1 through 30. Element 5 sets the threshold for the short handshake delay if TCP service flows are processed through TCP proxy servers. If TCP proxy stop in the case of short handshake delays is enabled and the time difference between two-way handshake and three-way handshake is shorter than this element value, the TCP proxy procedure stops. The element value ranges from 10 through 65535 milliseconds. Element 6 sets the threshold for the short data delay if TCP service flows are processed through TCP proxy servers. If TCP proxy stop in the case of short data delays is enabled and the interval at which feedback packets of data packets are received is shorter than the period specified by this element, the TCP proxy procedure stops. The element value ranges from 10 through 65535 milliseconds. Element 7 sets the minimum number of packets with short data delays if TCP service flows are processed through TCP proxy servers. If TCP proxy stop in the case of short data delays is enabled, the number of intervals at which feedback packets of data packets are received is larger than this element value, and the average interval is short, the TCP proxy procedure stops. The element value ranges from 10 through 65535. Element 8 sets the threshold for the maximum interval if TCP service flows are processed through TCP proxy servers. If TCP proxy stop in the case of long packet intervals is enabled, a data packet is received, and no more packet is received within the duration specified by this element, the TCP proxy procedure stops. The element value ranges from 50 through 65535 milliseconds. Element 9 sets the window size of full-process TCP proxy. It is used to control the maximum TCP window size that the eNodeB can return to the server. The element value ranges from 15000 through 4194304. Element 10 sets the threshold of long delays if TCP service flows are processed through TCP proxy servers. It is used to check whether the TCP proxy procedure stops. When the TCP delay exceeds the value specified by this element, the TCP proxy procedure starts. In other cases, the TCP proxy procedure stops. The element value ranges from 0 through 2000. Element 11 sets the threshold for checking whether the TCP receiving window is a small window. If the window size for SY-NACK packets in the three-way handshake phase is smaller than this element value, ACK packets are constructed based on this element value, so that the slow-start duration can be effectively shortened. The element value ranges from 10000 through 100000. Element 12 sets the full-process proxy policy of TCP service flows. After the parameter value is converted to a binary, each bit indicates a full-process proxy policy of the corresponding general-QoS service type. The least significant bit indicates the full-process proxy policy corresponding to type 1 and the most significant bit indicates the full-process proxy policy corresponding to type 7. The element value ranges from 0 through 127. If a bit of this element is set to 1 and the same bit of element 3 is also set to 1, it indicates that all the TCP service flows of UEs with the general-QoS type corresponding to the bit can be processed through full-process proxy. The default value of this element is 0, indicating that the TCP service flows of all the UEs with general-QoS types can be processed through full-process proxy. The remaining elements are reserved.
item.name: tcpProxyPara2

item.desc: This parameter sets a sub-function set of the TCP proxy function. It is an array parameter consisting of 20 elements, each of which sets whether to enable the corresponding sub-function. Element 0 enables or disables full-process TCP proxy. If this element is set to 1 (Open), TCP service flows are processed through full-process proxy until the flows end. Element 1 enables or disables handover exit control of TCP proxy. If this element is set to 1 (Open), the TCP service flows that are being processed through TCP proxy servers exit the TCP proxy procedure during the inter-cell handover procedure of UEs. Element 2 sets whether to exit the TCP proxy procedure in the case that the TCP proxy expires. If this element is set to 1 (Open) and the eNodeB receives no acknowledgment packet over a long period of time after the TCP proxy procedure starts, the TCP proxy procedure stops. Element 3 enables or disables RTO optimization of TCP proxy. It controls whether the retransmission time after TCP service timeout is dynamically calculated based on the actual RTT over the Uu interface. Element 4 enables or disables the fixed-window policy. If this element is set to 1 (Open), the window size carried in the acknowledgment packet sent by the eNodeB to the server is always 65535 bytes. Element 5 sets whether to prohibit stopping the TCP proxy procedure for uplink services. If this element is set to 1 (Open), the TCP proxy procedure does not stop even if the payload length of uplink TCP packets is equal to the MSS size negotiated by the current TCP service flow and all the packets that are processed by the TCP proxy procedure are acknowledged by the UE. Element 6 sets whether to process TCP SYN packets through the TCP proxy procedure based on the value of the Window Scale field. If this element is set to 1 (Open) and the value of the Window Scale field carried in a TCP SYN packet is zero, the TCP SYN packet is not processed by the TCP proxy procedure. Element 7 sets whether to stop the TCP proxy procedure in the case that the handshake delay is short. If this element is set to 1 (Open) and the time difference between two-way handshake and three-way handshake is shorter than the handshake delay threshold, the TCP proxy procedure stops. Element 8 sets whether to stop the TCP proxy procedure in the case that the data delay is short. If this element is set to 1 (Open) and the data delay is shorter than the data delay threshold, the TCP proxy procedure stops. Element 9 sets whether to stop the TCP proxy procedure in the case that the packet receiving interval is long. If this element is set to 1 (Open) and no data packet is received over a long period of time, the TCP proxy procedure stops. The remaining elements are reserved.
item.name: tcpProxyPara1

item.desc: This parameter sets the whitelisted IP addresses of TCP proxy servers. It is an array parameter consisting of 10 elements, each of which sets an IP address of a TCP proxy server. If the tcpProxyWhiteListSwch (TCP Proxy Whitelist Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the IP address of the server accessed by a TCP service flow is in the list specified by this parameter, the eNodeB processes the current TCP service flow through the TCP proxy server with the corresponding IP address.
item.name: tcpProxyWhiteListIP

item.desc: This parameter sets the whitelisted port numbers of TCP proxy servers. It is an array parameter consisting of 30 elements, each of which sets a port number of a TCP proxy server. If the tcpProxyWhiteListSwch (TCP Proxy Whitelist Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the port number of the server accessed by a TCP service flow is in the list specified by this parameter, the eNodeB processes the current TCP service flow through the TCP proxy server with the corresponding port number.
item.name: tcpPrxoyWhiteListPort

item.desc: This parameter sets the SN threshold for detecting old packets on the target eNodeB where handover or re-establishment with FullCfg occurs. It is used in the scenario where the target eNodeB of handover or re-establishment with FullCfg may receive old packets from the source eNodeB. After receiving a packet, the target eNodeB checks whether the SN of the packet is larger than the threshold. If the packet SN is larger than the threshold, the packet is identified as an old packet. In this case, the PDCP window of the target eNodeB is not updated, avoiding service interruption caused by abnormal window update of the target eNodeB. If this parameter is set to 0, the protection function is disabled.
item.name: fullCfgProtectSnThr

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the eNodeB performs app optimization and enhancement for IPv6 services. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the IP address type of the server accessed by a service is IPv6, app optimization can be implemented for the IPv6 service.
item.name: appIPv6Swch

item.desc: This parameter sets the type of packet-level general-QoS service that needs to be guaranteed. After the parameter value is converted to a binary number, the bits from low to high respectively indicate whether general-QoS service guarantee can be implemented for type1 through type5 UEs. If a bit is set to 1, it indicates that the corresponding general-QoS service guarantee can be implemented for the UEs of the corresponding type. If a bit is set to 0, it indicates that the corresponding general-QoS service guarantee cannot be implemented for the UEs of the corresponding type.
item.name: guaranteeQoSType

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to optimize the maximum power in NSA scenarios. It is used to determine whether to optimize the power configuration of LTE and NR cells during SN addition. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the power of the MN baseband, SN baseband, 4G baseband of UEs, and 5G baseband of UEs is set to 20 dBm. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the power of the MN baseband and the 4G baseband of UEs can be set to 23 dBm (the maximum power supported by the UEs), and the power of the SN baseband and the 5G baseband of UEs can be set to 20 dBm.
item.name: nSAMaxPowerOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables packet-level general-QoS service guarantee. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open) and bearer-level guarantee is enabled, packet-level guarantee is enabled to guarantee the current service flow until the service flow ends.
item.name: packetGeneralQoSSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the PRB usage threshold for packet-level general-QoS service guarantee. It is one of the conditions for determining whether packet-level general-QoS service guarantee can be implemented. The eNodeB can start packet-level multi-queue processing only when the downlink PRB usage in the cell is larger than or equal to the parameter value.
item.name: packetQoSPrbShr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the RLC buffer time. It is used to control the duration for buffering the RLC data in the high-priority and low-priority service queues.
item.name: packetQoSRlcBuffDelay

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of RRC connections for the decision on packet-level general-QoS service guarantee. It is one of the conditions for determining whether packet-level general-QoS service guarantee can be implemented. The eNodeB can start packet-level multi-queue processing only when the number of RRC-connected UEs in the cell is larger than or equal to the parameter value.
item.name: packetQoSRrcShr

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of UEs on which packet-level general-QoS service guarantee can be implemented. It is valid when the packetGeneralQoSSwch (Packet-Level General-QoS Service Guarantee) parameter is set to 1 (Open).
item.name: packetQoSUeMaxNum

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the PDCP-layer packets of the service flows for which packet-level guarantee is enabled are scheduled based on the priority of general-QoS queues. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), at the PDCP layer, no priority is given to the scheduling of the PDCP-layer packets of the service flows for which packet-level guarantee is enabled. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), at the PDCP layer, the packets of the service flows for which packet-level guarantee is enabled are put to the high-priority queue and the packets of the service flows for which packet-level guarantee is disabled are put to the low-priority queue. The eNodeB preferentially sends the packets in the high-priority queue to UEs. The packets in the low-priority queue are scheduled and sent to UEs only if the packets in the high-priority queue are all sent.
item.name: qosMultiQueSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the eNodeB collects statistics on the time differences between two-way handshake and three-way handshake. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB collects statistics on the time differences between two-way handshake and three-way handshake for TCP optimization.
item.name: synackToAckDelayStatSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the eNodeB allows to process only the specified TCP services through TCP proxy servers. If it is set to 1 (Open), only the IP addresses or port numbers of the servers carrying the TCP services in the whitelist can be used as the TCP proxy IP addresses or port numbers.
item.name: tcpProxyWhiteListSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to disable the optimization for downlink TCP packets with timestamps. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open) and downlink TCP packets carry timestamps, the eNodeB does not optimize TCP service flows. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB can optimize TCP service flows.
item.name: timeStampForbidFunsSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables UDP service filtering. It is used for UDP service flow optimization. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB does not optimize UDP service flows. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB can optimize UDP services.
item.name: udpFilterSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables Server Hello packet identification. If it is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB determines whether a received downlink packet is a Server Hello packet. If it is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB does not identify and parse packets.
item.name: serverHelloIdentifySwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the coefficients of the activation status detection thresholds of NSA bearers. It is an array parameter consisting of three elements. Element 0 sets the threshold coefficient for the eNodeB to check whether an NSA bearer is active. The product of the element value and 50 ms is the activation status detection threshold of NSA bearers. The eNodeB calculates the period during which no data of a UE is transmitted over each NSA bearer. If the period during which no data of a UE is transmitted over a bearer is smaller than or equal to the activation status detection threshold of NSA bearers, the eNodeB determines that the bearer is active. If element 0 is set to 0, the eNodeB does not check whether an NSA bearer is active during performance indicator collection. Element 1 and element 2 are reserved.
item.name: nsaDrbActiveThrFactor

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the ratio of dynamically borrowed power. In power sharing, only the cells whose power usage ratio is higher than this threshold can borrow power.
item.name: dynBorrowPowerThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the ratio of the power usage of UEs that use QPSK. It is used to control the ratio of the power usage of such UEs to the power usage of a cell.
item.name: qPSKWeightFactor

item.desc: This parameter sets the ratio of the power usage of UEs that use TM9. It is used to control the ratio of the power usage of such UEs to the power usage of a cell.
item.name: tM9WeightFactor

item.desc: This parameter sets the keep-alive duration of a virtual Xe link. In a network where 4G cells and 5G cells share the same BBU, after the 4G container and the 5G container send a keep-alive request message to each other, they wait for a response message within the period specified by this parameter. If a response message is received from the peer container within the duration specified by this parameter, it is determined that the virtual Xe link is in good condition; otherwise, the virtual Xe link is determined to be disconnected.
item.name: xeKeepAliveDuration

item.desc: This parameter sets a decision strategy for X2-based handover. It is used to specify the conditions for performing X2-based handover. If this parameter is set to 0 (Strict Strategy), X2-based handover can be performed only if the combinations of the PLMNs and group IDs carried in the X2 setup message sent by the target eNodeB contain all the combinations of the PLMNs and group IDs of the LTE network corresponding to the source MME where the UE accesses. If this parameter is set to 1 (Loose Strategy), X2-based handover can be performed as long as the combinations of the PLMNs and group IDs carried in the X2 setup message sent by the target eNodeB contain any combination of the PLMNs and group IDs of the LTE network corresponding to the source MME where the UE accesses.
item.name: x2HOJudgeStrategy

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to deliver measurement information about an SCell in the case that the SCell fails to be blindly added. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), measurement information about an SCell is delivered in the case that the SCell fails to be blindly added. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), no measurement information about an SCell is delivered in the case that the SCell fails to be blindly added.
item.name: scellAddFailNotMeasSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the strategy for reference factors of the number of PRBs used for LTE perception estimation. If this parameter is set to 0 (Reference bandwidth and remaining PRB), the number of uplink PRBs used for perception estimation refers to the maximum number of PRBs corresponding to the value of the SingleRBSINR parameter, the total number of available uplink PRBs in the cell, the number of UEs in the cell, and the uplink PRB usage of the cell; the number of downlink PRBs used for perception estimation refers to the total number of available downlink PRBs in the cell, the number of UEs in the cell, and the downlink PRB usage of the cell. If this parameter is set to 1 (Reference bandwidth), the number of uplink PRBs used for perception estimation refers to the maximum number of PRBs corresponding to the value of the SingleRBSINR parameter and the total number of available uplink PRBs in the cell; the number of downlink PRBs used for perception estimation refers to the total number of available downlink PRBs in the cell.
item.name: percEstPrbRefFactStgy

item.desc: This parameter sets the DNS addresses in the TCP proxy whitelist. It is an array consisting of a maximum of 20 elements that correspond to 20 valid DNS addresses. If both the tcpProxySwch (Switch for TCP Proxy Function) and tcpProxyWhiteListSwch (TCP Proxy Whitelist Switch) parameters are set to 1 (Open), to access a DNS address configured by this parameter, the eNodeB processes the TCP service flow corresponding to the domain name through the TCP proxy server.
item.name: tcpProxyWhiteListDns

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for obtaining the read-write access lock during data storage to the database. When a service attempts to obtain the read-write access lock through the DBS interface, this timer is started. When the service obtains the read-write access lock successfully, the timer is stopped and the service performs read-write operations through the DBS interface properly. If the timer times out, it indicates that the service fails to obtain the read-write access lock through the DBS interface and performs no read-write operation through the DBS interface. In this case, however, other messages belonging to the same task can be processed. After 100 ms, the service attempts to obtain the read-write access lock again and the timer is restarted. The value 65535 indicates that the timer is infinite.
item.name: timerForGetDbsLock

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to adjust the interval at which the eNodeB detects UE inactivity. UE inactivity means that a UE is in RRC-Inactive status and does not send or receive data. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the interval at which the eNodeB detects UE inactivity is 500 ms, improving the accuracy of UE inactivity detection and effectively managing radio resources. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the interval at which the eNodeB detects UE inactivity is 2 seconds.
item.name: userInacPeriodAdjSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables BSR optimization for UE handover. It is used to control the processing of unscheduled data in the source cell during UE handover. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the source cell where UE handover is initiated clears the BSR information about all the unscheduled DRBs after sending a handover reconfiguration message, reducing the number of times that downlink DTX (data transmission suspends because the inactivity timer expires) and uplink DCI0Lost (uplink control information is lost) occur and thus optimizing network resource utilization and communication stability.
item.name: bsrOptSwchInHoState

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables CA compatibility control. It is an array parameter consisting of eight elements. Element 0 sets whether to forbid SCell addition after SN addition. If this element is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB does not add SCells for UEs after an SN is added. Element 1 sets whether to check the E-UTRAN capability or MRDC CA capability of UEs. If this element is set to 1 (Open), both the E-UTRAN CA capability and MRDC CA capability need to be checked in the case of SCell changes after an SN is added. If this element is set to 0 (Close), only the MRDC CA capability needs to be checked in the case of SCell changes after an SN is added. If both element 0 and element 1 are set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB does not add SCells for UEs after an SN is added. The remaining six elements are reserved.
item.name: cACompatibleSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to audit the energy-saving status of the cell during non-energy-saving periods. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB periodically checks whether the cell is still in energy-saving status during non-energy-saving periods. If the eNodeB detects that the cell is still in energy-saving status during a non-energy-saving period, the eNodeB triggers the energy-saving exit mechanism to ensure that the cell can be recovered from the energy-saving status in a timely manner and provide services properly.
item.name: eSAuditSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to delete handover measurement information in service establishment scenarios. It is an array parameter consisting of four elements. Element 0 sets whether to delete UE location-based handover measurement information in service establishment scenarios. Element 1 sets whether to delete load balancing measurement information in service establishment scenarios. Element 2 sets whether to delete uplink big-BSR-based handover measurement information in service establishment scenarios. Element 3 sets whether to delete downlink big-BSR-based handover measurement information in service establishment scenarios. If an element is set to 1 (Open) and the eNodeB determines that the corresponding function does not need to be triggered during UE service establishment, the eNodeB deletes the corresponding handover measurement information. If an element is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB does not delete the corresponding handover measurement information during user service establishment.
item.name: servSetupRemoveHOMeasSwch
