item.name: extendedBSRSwch

item.desc: The parameter determines the mode of UE transmit antenna selection.
item.name: tansAntenSel

item.desc: Uplink PRB Random Bias:Bias 0,Bias 1,Bias 2 and Random Bias
item.name: prbRandNumberUl

item.desc: Downlink PRB Random Bias:Bias 0,Bias 1,Bias 2 and Random Bias
item.name: prbRandNumberDl

item.desc: The parameter indicates whether simultaneous PUCCH and PUSCH transmissions are configured,If UE support simultaneous PUCCH and PUSCH transmission, it is configured Yes, or it is configured No
item.name: pucchPuschSimulTraInd

item.desc: This parameter indicates how a UE and baseband produce and demodulate demodulation reference signals for the PUSCH. If it is set to No, the RNLC does not send this parameter to the baseband and the UE that produce and demodulate demodulation reference signals for the PUSCH in a single layer according to Rel8/9. If it is set to Yes, the RNLC sends this parameter to the baseband and the UE that produce and demodulate demodulation reference signals for the PUSCH in multiple layers according to Rel10.
item.name: dmrsWithOCCActivated

item.desc: This parameter indicates the maximum number of transmit antenna ports on the PUSCH in the uplink. This parameter is used only by eNodeBs instead of UEs.
item.name: ueTransPortNum

item.desc: The parameter provides PL threshold to determine whether UE applies TTI Bundling or not.
item.name: ttiBundPlIn

item.desc: The parameter provides PL threshold to determine whether UE return normal transmission form TTI Bundling or not.
item.name: ttiBundPlOut

item.desc: This parameter sets the SINR threshold for determining whether a UE should enter TTI bundling scheduling or not when the service types of the UE include QCI1. If the SINR at which the UE uses the maximum transmitter power on an RB is less than or equal to this threshold, the UE enters TTI bundling scheduling.
item.name: ttiBundSinrIn4QCI1

item.desc: when UE' service includes QCI1,Use The parameter provides SINR threshold to determine whether UE applies TTI Bundling or not. If UE SINR is more than the threshold, UE will be configured in normal HARQ operation.
item.name: ttiBundSinrOut4QCI1

item.desc: This parameter is the submode of Mode1-1 in TM9 and CSI-RS 8 port, could be submode1 or submode2. See 36213[7.2.2], or 36331[6.3.2, CQI-ReportConfig]
item.name: csiReportMode

item.desc: The parameter indicates the configuration of SRS period for UE normal power. It is one-dimensional vector including three elements.
item.name: srsNormalPeriod

item.desc: The parameter indicates the number of SRS time-division resource for UE normal power. It is one-dimensional vector including three elements.
item.name: srsNormalResource

item.desc: The SRS's period. The period of localized must be bigger or equal to min period supported by srs subframe configuration.
item.name: srsTrP

item.desc: The parameter indicates the configuration of SRS period over the threshold of SRS PL for UE.
item.name: srsLargePowPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of SRS resources configured for the UEs in different PL groups based on the PL threshold (sRSPLThr) in the scenarios with limited power. It is an array parameter consisting of three elements. Element 0 sets the number of SRS frequency-domain resources in PL group 1. Element 1 sets the number of SRS frequency-domain resources in PL group 2. Element 2 sets the number of SRS frequency-domain resources in PL group 3.
item.name: srsLargePowResource

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of channels allocated to the UEs that need to be configured with CQIs in a transmission period in the cell. It is an array parameter consisting of three elements.
item.name: cqiRptChNum

item.desc: If the difference of RRC-connected user number and physical resource capacity is larger than capacityMarginThr(1), the physical resource capacity may be increased. If the difference of physical resource capacity and RRC-connected user number is larger than capacityMarginThr(2), the phsical resource capacity may be decreased.
item.name: capacityMarginThr

item.desc: If RRC-connected user number is not less than the threshold,the cell is in larger capacity state.
item.name: largeCapaUeNum

item.desc: EUTRAN configures this field only when transmission mode is set to tm9. Open means PMI/RI reporting is configured; otherwise the PMI/RI reporting is not configured.
item.name: tm9PmiRIReport

item.desc: If the parameter equals 0, that means the max request RB num is adaptive result. If the parameter is not 0, the parameter is the MAX request RB number(the sum of all UE's) for each DLCoMP neighbour cell.
item.name: maxNhelpRB

item.desc: This parameter sets the PBR satisfaction threshold for UEs to be involved in downlink CoMP. It is one of the conditions for determining whether a UE is involved in downlink CoMP. If the traffic of a UE is smaller than or equal to the product of the parameter value and the PBR, the UE can be involved in downlink CoMP.
item.name: pbrThrforComp

item.desc: This parameter is used to support the PUCCH IRC algorithm. This parameter is set to Open if there is large interference on the PUCCH to improve the demodulation performance of the PUCCH. It is set to Close in other cases.
item.name: pucchIrcSwch

item.desc: When the uplink frequency selection is enabled, if current TTI total arranged RBs for assignment is no greater than the value multiple the left usable RBs, RB assignment is using the best selection, otherwise using the try best selection.
item.name: bstFreSelRatioUl

item.desc: SR period will be allocated with shortest period for QCI, which is not zero in queue.
item.name: srPriPeriodQCI

item.desc: SR period will be allocated with shorter period for QCI, which is not zero in queue.
item.name: srSecPeriodQCI

item.desc: The parameter is used to indicate the Multiple neighbour cell for cooperation .When license is off, choose 0.When license is on, choose 1 to open the mutiple neighbour cooperation
item.name: maxCoopNbrCellNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the method for UEs to report CQIs on the PUSCH periodically.
item.name: periodCqiFbMethd

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times that sub-band CQIs of each BP are reported between two consecutive times of periodic broadband CQI reporting. If the RI/CQI/PMI reporting mode is FS for the PUCCH, the WB reporting period is a multiple (the parameter value x J + 1) of the FS reporting period, where J is the value provided in Table 7.2.2-2 of TS 36.213 and is related to the downlink system bandwidth.If the reporting mode is WB, this parameter is invalid, and the WB reporting period is that for reporting CQI information on the PUCCH.
item.name: cqiK

item.desc: The parameter defines the switch of SR resource allocation optimization in access.
item.name: srAccOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the type of the algorithms for shrinking SR RBs. If it is set to 0 (Shrink Idle Extend SR RB), only idle extended SR RBs are shrunk. If it is set to 1 (Shrink Extend SR RB by Releasing UE), extended SR RBs are shrunk by releasing the UEs on the extended RBs. If it is set to 2 (Shrink Extend SR RB by Reconfiguring UE), extended SR RBs are shrunk by reconfiguring the SR resources of the UEs on the extended RBs.
item.name: srAccafterOptSwch

item.desc: The parameter defines the switch of CQI resource allocation optimization.
item.name: cqiAccafterOptSwch

item.desc: The parameter defines the switch of SR resource reconfiguration based on QCI type.
item.name: sRReconfigSwch

item.desc: The parameter defines the switch of SR resource second allocation.
item.name: sRSecAlloSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the bitmap of RBs that cannot be allocated for PDSCH scheduling. If a bit is set to 0, it indicates that the corresponding RBs can be allocated for scheduling. If a bit is set to 1, it indicates that the corresponding RBs cannot be allocated for scheduling.
item.name: rbForbiddenBitMapDL

item.desc: This parameter is the RB ratio self-adaption switch. If the parameter is set to 2, the number of RBs is allocated by the ratio of MU-UEs to SU-UEs. If the parameter is set to 1, the number of RBs is allocated according to the rule that MU-UEs use 80% of the RBs.
item.name: mmRatioSwch

item.desc: Max RB ratio of Non-Massive MIMO UE.
item.name: maxMMRBRatio

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum RB ratio supported by the MM UEs with a large BSR in each TTI.
item.name: maxMMRBNum

item.desc: Massive MIMO Qos priority switch.
item.name: mmQosPrioritySwch

item.desc: Side number between Massive MIMO UE.
item.name: mmSideNum

item.desc: The parameter is the DL frequency domain forming switch, which is used to adjust the RB frequency allocation when Comp is opened. The function is opened when the RB frequency allocation is not average.
item.name: freqDomformSwchDL

item.desc: The parameter is the switch of ULComp CS, which is applied to the Volte user with Comp CS corporation.
item.name: compCSSwchUL

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables mutual exclusion of TTI bundling and DRX.If it is set to Open, DRX is disabled if the UE enables TTI bundling; DRX is enabled if the UE disables TTI bundling. When TTI bundling is enabled for the UE, DRX is disabled.If it is set to Close, DRX and TTI bundling are not mutually exclusive.
item.name: ttiBMutexDRXSwch

item.desc: This parameter is used to determine whether the correlation is considered in light traffic groups.
item.name: smallBSRCoeffiPairOpt

item.desc: This parameter is the uplink MM MU proportion switch. If the parameter is set to Open, multiple UEs can share the same RB. Otherwise, different UEs cannot share the same RB block.
item.name: mmEnableUL

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable MU on SCC and sets the number of SCC MU flows. If it is set to 0, SCC MU is disabled. If it is set to 1, the number of SCC SDMA flows is 1. If it is set to 2-16, the corresponding number of SCC SDMA flows is 2-16.
item.name: sccMUOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter is a mobility enhancement switch. If the switch is set to Open and there are UEs satisfying the correlation threshold, the reliable UEs will be filtered; otherwise, it is reported in accordance with the spatial multiplexing ratio.
item.name: mobilityEnhanceSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the base station supports TM8 dual layers. When the switch is set to Close, the base station does not use the TM8 dual layer solution. When the switch is set to Open, the base station can use the TM8 dual layer solution in accordance with MS status.
item.name: isSupportDualTM8

item.desc: The parameter is the switch of SR-LTE optimization
item.name: srLteOptEnable

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enter TTI Bundling mode when the UE services include the QCI=1 service. If the switch is turned on, the UE having the QCI=1 service determines whether to enter TTI Bundling mode in accordance with channel quality. If the switch is turned off, the UE having the QCI=1 service does not enter TTI Bundling mode.
item.name: tTIBuningWithQCI1swchDl

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enter TTI Bundling mode when the UE services do not include the QCI=1 service. If the switch is turned on, the UE not having the QCI=1 service determines whether to enter TTI Bundling mode in accordance with channel quality. If the switch is turned off, the UE not having the QCI=1 service does not enter TTI Bundling mode.
item.name: tTIBundWithoutQCI1Swch

item.desc: The parameter is TTI Bundling SINR discard threshold. When the TTI Bundling SINR Discard Window is exceeded, the activation / deactivation judgment is performed if the sample point of the SINR is more than TTI Bundling SINR Discard Threshold;When the TTI Bundling SINR Discard Window is exceeded, no activation / deactivation judgment is performed if the sample point of the SINR is less than or equal to TTI Bundling SINR Discard Threshold.
item.name: tTIBSinrDiscardThre

item.desc: The parameter is TTI Bundling SINR Discard WindowWhen the TTI Bundling SINR Discard Window is not exceeded, the activation / deactivation judgment is performed if the sample point of the SINR is more than TTI Bundling SINR Filter Threshold;When the TTI Bundling SINR Discard Window is exceeded, the activation / deactivation judgment is performed if the sample point of the SINR is more than TTI Bundling SINR Discard Threshold;When the TTI Bundling SINR Discard Window is exceeded, no activation / deactivation judgment is performed if the sample point of the SINR is less than or equal to TTI Bundling SINR Discard Threshold.
item.name: tTIBSinrDiscardWin

item.desc: The parameter is TTI Bundling SINR filter threshold.When the TTI Bundling SINR Discard Window is not exceeded, the activation / deactivation judgment is performed if the sample point of the SINR is more than TTI Bundling SINR Filter Threshold.
item.name: tTIBSinrFilterThre

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of uplink NB-IoT carriers in Inband mode. If the parameter is set to 0, it indicates that no uplink NB-IoT carrier is configured in Inband mode. If the parameter is set to 1, it indicates that one uplink NB-IoT carrier is configured in Inband mode.
item.name: inbandNbNumUl

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink NB-IoT carrier configuration in Inband mode. If the parameter is set to 0, it indicates that the NB-IoT carrier is configured at the lowest frequency of the LTE band and there is no frequency interval between the NB-IoT and LTE PUCCH. If the parameter is set to 1, it indicates that the NB-IoT carrier is configured at the lowest frequency of the LTE band and the interval between the NB-IoT and LTE PUCCH is 1 RB. If the parameter is set to 2, it indicates that the NB-IoT carrier is configured at the highest frequency of the LTE band and there is no frequency interval between the NB-IoT and LTE PUCCH. If the parameter is set to 3, it indicates that the NB-IoT carrier is configured at the highest frequency of the LTE band and the interval between the NB-IoT and LTE PUCCH is 1 RB.
item.name: inbandNbCfg

item.desc: This parameter sets the LTE bandwidth occupied by the NR Supplementary Uplink (SUL).
item.name: nRSAllocRBNumUl

item.desc: This parameter indicates the maximum number of RBs in full scheduling in the uplink. If the number of RBs used in the uplink exceeds this threshold, the equivalent rate value is calculated as a full scheduling value.
item.name: rbHighThrOfFullSchedUl

item.desc: For an MM station, this parameter indicates the maximum number of RBs in full scheduling in the uplink. If the number of RBs used in the uplink exceeds this threshold, the equivalent rate value is calculated as a full scheduling value.
item.name: rbHighThrOfFullSchForMMUl

item.desc: For an MM station, this parameter indicates the minimum number of RBs in non-full scheduling in the uplink. If the number of RBs used in the uplink is larger than this threshold but less than the maximum number of RBs for MM stations in full scheduling in the uplink, the equivalent rate value is calculated as a non-full scheduling value.
item.name: rbLowThrOfNonFullSchForMMUl

item.desc: This parameter indicates the minimum number of RBs in non-full scheduling in the uplink. If the number of RBs used in the uplink is larger than this threshold but less than the maximum number of RBs in full scheduling in the uplink, the equivalent rate value is calculated as a non-full scheduling value.
item.name: rbLowThrOfNonFullSchedUl

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the MRI resource allocation optimization strategy. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the RI reporting period is the same as the CQI reporting period and the MRI value is 1; otherwise, the MRI value is larger than or equal to 1. To reduce the RI reporting period, this parameter can be set to 1 (Open).
item.name: mriCalOptiSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables uplink CoMP for the UEs with specific bearer services. If it is set to Open, uplink CoMP works on only the UEs with specific bearer services. If it is set to Close, uplink CoMP is not restricted.
item.name: bearForCompSwchUL

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables downlink CoMP for the UEs with specific bearer services. If it is set to Open, downlink CoMP works on only the UEs with specific bearer services. If it is set to Close, downlink CoMP is not restricted.
item.name: bearForCompSwchDL

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the Mri value can be configured on the OMC. If it is set to Open, the Mri value can be configured on the OMC; otherwise, it cannot be configured.
item.name: mriConfigSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the Mri value (the RI cycle is a multiple of the CQI cycle and the Mri value is the multiple).
item.name: mri

item.desc: This parameter sets the bitmap of RBs that can be scheduled for the PUSCH. It is an array parameter consisting of 100 elements. The value of each element in the array parameter indicates whether the corresponding RB can be scheduled. The value 0 indicates that the RB can be scheduled, and the value 1 indicates that the RB cannot be scheduled.
item.name: ulRbForbiddenBitMap

item.desc: This parameter indicates the duration in which RB muting occurs once in a muting period on non-standard LTE bandwidths when the switch for periodical RB muting is enabled.
item.name: time4MutingRB

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables periodic RB muting. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the UE access success rate can increase in non-standard LTE bandwidths.
item.name: periodMutingRBSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the pairing of PRBs with unequal lengths. To improve the pairing probability and system capacity, add service types, and increase the number of space-division flows, this parameter is set to Open; otherwise, it is set to Close.
item.name: pRBUnequalPairSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the PBR satisfaction threshold for UEs to exit downlink CoMP. If the PBR satisfaction of CoMP UEs is larger than this threshold, the CoMP UEs need to exit CoMP.
item.name: pbrThrforExitDLComp

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables enhancement in far-point channel estimation. If it is set to Open, dual-pilot joint channel estimation is implemented on the PUSCH receiver. If it is set to Close, the original channel estimation algorithm for the PUSCH receiver remains unchanged.
item.name: dualPilotCeSwch

item.desc: When the switch is open, PUSCH receives Rnn average and improves PUSCH demodulation performance, When the switch is off, it remains unchanged.
item.name: rnnAvgSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the period for RB muting occuring on non-standard LTE bandwidths when the switch for periodical RB muting is enabled.
item.name: prePeriod4MutingRB

item.desc: This parameter determines whether a scheduled UE meets the conditions of far-point channel estimation enhancement. If far-point channel estimation enhancement is enabled and the MCS/RB pair for UE scheduling is lower than or equal to the configured thresholds (FarPointCeOpMcsThr and FarPointCeOpRBThr), far-point channel estimation enhancement takes effect.
item.name: farPointCeOptMcsThr

item.desc: This parameter determines whether a scheduled UE meets the conditions of far-point channel estimation enhancement.
item.name: farPointCeOptRBThr

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables uplink SDMA in high-speed rail scenarios.
item.name: uLHstSdmaSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables hybrid SU/MU pairing. If it is set to 0, dual-stream pairing is not allowed and only single-flow pairing can be involved in pairing. If it is set to 1, both single-stream and dual-stream pairing can be involved in pairing.
item.name: dBFPairSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the number of RBs for LTE downlink bandwidth contraction in CDMA-LTE CSS scenarios. It is used to increase the spectrum resources for LTE systems in CDMA-LTE CSS scenarios.
item.name: cDMALTECutRbNum

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables CDMA-LTE Common Spectrum Scheduling (CSS). If this parameter is set to 1 (UL/DL Support CDMA LTE CSS), the overlapping frequency resources of CDMA cells can be used in both the uplink and downlink. If this parameter is set to 2 (Only UL Support CDMA LTE CSS), the overlapping frequency resources of CDMA cells can be used in the uplink only. If this parameter is set to 3 (Only DL Support CDMA LTE CSS), the overlapping frequency resources of CDMA cells can be used in the downlink only. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), LTE cells can use only the dedicated frequency resources. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the available LTE bandwidth increases, improving spectrum usage and user experience.
item.name: cDMALTECSSSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of coordinated cells involved in SRS resource allocation. For the coordinated cells, the SRS resources of the cells should be allocated in different time domains and frequency domains by increasing the SRS period to decrease intra-frequency SRS interference.
item.name: sRSResDisCellNum

item.desc: This parameter indicates the color of cells. The interfering cells are differentiated from each other by color based on their interference relationships.
item.name: cellColor

item.desc: This parameter sets how SRS resources are configured during SRS resource coordination. If this parameter is set to 0 (Fixed SRS Config), the SRS resources are configured on the OMC; otherwise, the SRS resources are adaptively generated based on the number of coordinated cells.
item.name: sRSResConfigMethod

item.desc: This parameter defines the SRS cooperation method for SRS resource cooperation. PCI-based SRS resource cooperation staggers the SRS resources of the interfering cells with different values N (N = mod(PCI, number of coordinated SRS cells), while cell color-based SRS resource cooperation staggers the SRS resources of the interfering cells with different different colors.
item.name: sRSResDisMethod

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of five elements. The first element through the last element indicate the start muting RB indexes on low frequencies when the bandwidth is 20 MHz, 15 MHz, 10 MHz, 5 MHz, and 3 MHz in turn. The purpose for periodic muting in non-standard bandwidths is to resolve the problem where the UEs with Qualcomm chips fail to search the network in a non-standard bandwidth for the first time. In a non-standard downlink LTE bandwidth, two to eight muting RBs are periodically configured in a period of time (the period is longer than or equal to the muting time) to ensure that the intermediate bandwidth for the muting RBs is approximately a standard LTE bandwidth. In this way, the Qualcomm UEs can detect a standard LTE bandwidth and successfully access the network.
item.name: mutingStartRbLow

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of five elements. The first element through the last element indicate the start muting RB indexes on high frequencies when the bandwidth is 20 MHz, 15 MHz, 10 MHz, 5 MHz, and 3 MHz in turn. The purpose for periodic muting in non-standard bandwidths is to resolve the problem where the UEs with Qualcomm chips fail to search the network in a non-standard bandwidth for the first time. In a non-standard downlink LTE bandwidth, two to eight muting RBs are periodically configured in a period of time (the period is longer than or equal to the muting time) to ensure that the intermediate bandwidth for the muting RBs is approximately a standard LTE bandwidth. In this way, the Qualcomm UEs can detect a standard LTE bandwidth and successfully access the network.
item.name: mutingStartRbHigh

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of five elements. The first element through the last element indicate the numbers of muting RBs on high frequencies when the bandwidth is 20 MHz, 15 MHz, 10 MHz, 5 MHz, and 3 MHz in turn. The purpose for periodic muting in non-standard bandwidths is to resolve the problem where the UEs with Qualcomm chips fail to search the network in a non-standard bandwidth for the first time. In a non-standard downlink LTE bandwidth, two to eight muting RBs are periodically configured in a period of time (the period is longer than or equal to the muting time) to ensure that the intermediate bandwidth for the muting RBs is approximately a standard LTE bandwidth. In this way, the Qualcomm UEs can detect a standard LTE bandwidth and successfully access the network.
item.name: mutingRbNumHigh

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of five elements. The first element through the last element indicate the numbers of muting RBs on low frequencies when the bandwidth is 20 MHz, 15 MHz, 10 MHz, 5 MHz, and 3 MHz in turn. The purpose for periodic muting in non-standard bandwidths is to resolve the problem where the UEs with Qualcomm chips fail to search the network in a non-standard bandwidth for the first time. In a non-standard downlink LTE bandwidth, two to eight muting RBs are periodically configured in a period of time (the period is longer than or equal to the muting time) to ensure that the intermediate bandwidth for the muting RBs is approximately a standard LTE bandwidth. In this way, the Qualcomm UEs can detect a standard LTE bandwidth and successfully access the network.
item.name: mutingRbNumLow

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable the uplink 256QAM capability of UEs in uplink DCI0. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB determines that a UE supports the 256QAM capability, and the radio channel conditions of the UE meet the requirement for triggering the uplink 256QAM capability, the eNodeB sends an RRC connection reconfiguration message to the UE to activate the 256QAM capability.
item.name: ul256QamDemSpInd4DCI0

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of RBs occupied by PUCCH format 5.
item.name: pucch5RB

item.desc: This parameter is the selection of the downlink buffer mode when the MagicRadio co-spectrum scheduling buffer switch is turned on. Configured as Double Side Multiplexing, the buffer of the downlink shared spectrum is bilaterally multiplexed; configured as Low Frequency Multiplexing, the buffer of the downlink shared spectrum is low frequency multiplexed, configured as high frequency multiplex, and the downlink shared spectrum The buffer is multiplexed for high frequency.
item.name: bufferCSSModeDl

item.desc: This parameter is the selection of the upstream buffer mode when the MagicRadio co-spectrum scheduling buffer switch is turned on. Configured as two-side multiplexing, the buffer of the uplink shared spectrum is bilaterally multiplexed; configured as low frequency multiplexing, the buffer of the uplink shared spectrum is low frequency multiplexed, configured as high frequency multiplexing, uplink shared spectrum The buffer is multiplexed for high frequency.
item.name: bufferCSSModeUl

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables CCE/RB data collection for the balancing between VoLTE and data services. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB periodically collects statistics on the CCE/RB utilization, and adjusts the strategy for balancing VoLTE and data services based on the utilization threshold.
item.name: vTDataStatSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the period for collecting CCE/RB statistics for the balancing between VoLTE and data services. The eNodeB periodically collects statistics on the CCE/RB utilization, and adjusts the strategy for balancing VoLTE and data services based on the utilization threshold.
item.name: vTDataStatPrd

item.desc: CCE Threshold of VoLTE and Data Service Balance. ENB will statistic CCE used ratio in period, and adjusts VoLTE and data service balance strategy by threshold.
item.name: vTDataCCEThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the RB load threshold for VoLTE and data service balancing. The first element represents the threshold for high RB load. The second element represents the threshold for RB utilization restriction. The eNodeB periodically collects statistics on the RB utilization, and adjusts the strategy for balancing VoLTE and data services based on the utilization threshold.
item.name: vTDataRBThrd

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to carry the TTIB status value of the source side during a handover.
item.name: hOWithTTIBSwch

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of 100 elements that correspond to 100 uplink PRB positions in an LTE cell. It indicates whether the uplink PRB positions can be occupied by an NB-IoT cell in a spectrum sharing scenario. If an element of this array parameter is set to 1, it indicates that the corresponding uplink PRB position can be occupied by an NB-IoT cell. If an element of this array parameter is set to 0, it indicates that the corresponding uplink PRB position cannot be occupied by an NB-IoT cell.
item.name: sharePrbPositionUL

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of 100 elements that correspond to 100 downlink PRB positions in an LTE cell. It indicates whether the downlink PRB positions can be occupied by an NB-IoT cell in a spectrum sharing scenario. If an element of this array parameter is set to 1, it indicates that the corresponding downlink PRB position can be occupied by the NB-IoT cell. If an element of this array parameter is set to 0, it indicates that the corresponding downlink PRB position cannot be occupied by the NB-IoT cell.
item.name: sharePrbPositionDL

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables aperiodical CQI transmission by remote UEs at SR periods. If it is set to Close, remote UEs can send aperiodical CQIs at SR periods. If it is set to Open, remote UEs cannot send aperiodical CQIs.
item.name: farPointAperiodicCQISwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of UEs that can multiplex the same RB occupied by the PUCCH format 2/2a/2b.
item.name: maxUserPucchfmt2

item.desc: This parameter sets the percentage of the SRS subframe resources reserved by the LTE network. A larger parameter value indicates that less SRS resources can be configured on the LTE network and more SRS resources can be configured on the SRS subframes reserved by the LTE network for the NR network.
item.name: srsReserveRatio

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion of downlink resources reserved for NR cells by LTE cells. A larger parameter value indicates more resources reserved for NR cells.
item.name: lTEDlReserveRBRatioforNR

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink avoidance policy for LTE and NR cells. In a 4G-5G Dynamic Spectrum Sharing (DSS) scenario, this parameter sets how downlink RBs are preferentially allocated between LTE and NR cells. If it is set to 1, downlink LTE indexes can be guaranteed. If it is set to 2, downlink NR indexes can be guaranteed. If it is set to 3, the downlink indexes of LTE and NR cells are equally guaranteed.
item.name: lTEDlAvoidNRMode

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables intermodulation interference. If it is set to 0, it indicates that intermodulation interference is disabled. If it is set to 1, it indicates that intermodulation interference is enabled.
item.name: iMDSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion of uplink resources reserved for NR cells by LTE cells. A larger parameter value indicates more resources reserved for NR cells.
item.name: lTEUlReserveRBRatioforNR

item.desc: This parameter sets the harmonic-interference avoidance type. If it is set to 0, it indicates that harmonic-interference avoidance is disabled. If it is set to 1, it indicates that static harmonic-interference avoidance is enabled and UE location information is not exchanged with the NR side. If it is set to 2, it indicates that semi-static-harmonic interference avoidance is enabled, the location information of the harmonic UEs at both near and far points is considered, and UE location information is exchanged between LTE and NR cells.
item.name: harmInterferAvoidMode

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables harmonic-interference coordination. If it is set to 0, harmonic-interference avoidance is is performed in the downlink of NR cells. This strategy is used to ensure the traffic on the LTE side. If it is set to 1, harmonic-interference avoidance is is performed in the downlink of LTE cells. This strategy is used to ensure the traffic on the NR side.
item.name: harmonicSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink avoidance policy for LTE and NR cells. In a 4G-5G Dynamic Spectrum Sharing (DSS) scenario, this parameter sets how uplink RBs are preferentially allocated between LTE and NR cells. If it is set to 1, uplink LTE indexes can be guaranteed. If it is set to 2, uplink NR indexes can be guaranteed. If it is set to 3, the uplink indexes of LTE and NR cells are equally guaranteed.
item.name: lTEUlAvoidNRMode

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink random forced PRB allocation mode in DSS Scenarios. It is used to control the allocation of downlink RBs in an LTE system in 4G/5G spectrum sharing scenarios. The value 0 indicates the original PRB randomization policy. The value 1 indicates PRB randomization for the forced allocation of high frequencies. In this case, downlink RBs of the LTE system are forcibly allocated from high frequencies to low frequencies (except for special allocation, such as SPS and signaling), so that as consecutive spectrum is reserved for the NR system as possible.
item.name: dlPrbRandForceModeForDss

item.desc: This parameter sets the PUSCH IRC mode, 0 for 4x4 IRC and 1 for 8x8 IRC.
item.name: puschIrcMode

item.desc: This parameter sets the PUCCH IRC mode, 0 for 4x4 IRC and 1 for 8x8 IRC.
item.name: pucchIrcMode

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables FMM/TMM anti-interference optimization. If it is set to 0, FMM/TMM anti-interference optimization is disabled. If it is set to 1, FMM/TMM anti-interference optimization is enabled.
item.name: antiInterOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables downlink SDMA in high-speed rail scenarios. It is configured as required.
item.name: dLHstSdmaSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the uplink PUCCH optimization algorithm. If it is set to 0, the uplink PUCCH optimization algorithm is disabled. If it is set to 1, the uplink PUCCH optimization algorithm is enabled. The purpose for this optimization is to make the PUCCH reservation algorithm of the CMAC the same as that of the RNLC. If the number of uplink PUSCH RBs is insufficient, this parameter can be set to Open.
item.name: pucchOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables location allocation enhancement for special UEs. If it is set to Open, location allocation is enhanced for special UEs. If it is set to Close, location allocation is not enhanced for any UE. This optimization is introduced to ensure the experience of some special users.
item.name: enUlPrbLocAlloc4SpeUeSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the uplink PUCCH optimization algorithm. If it is set to 0, the uplink PUCCH optimization algorithm is disabled. If it is set to 1, the uplink PUCCH optimization algorithm is enabled. This optimization is introduced to ensure the experience of some special users.
item.name: srbAdpRetxOptInFreqSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of special UEs handled in a single TTI. By default, it is set to 2 to balance between good performance and the scheduling of special UEs. This optimization is introduced to ensure the experience of some special users.
item.name: speUeNum4EnPrbLocAlloc

item.desc: This parameter sets the SINR decision threshold for a single RB for special UEs at far points. If the single-RB-SINR value of a UE is smaller than this threshold, the UE is regarded as a far-point UE; otherwise, the UE is regarded as a near-point UE. This optimization is introduced to ensure the experience of some special users.
item.name: sINRThr4SpeEdgeUe

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables false-antenna selection identification. It is valid when the Transmit Antenna Selection Mode parameter is set to any value except Disable. If this parameter is set to Open, the identified UEs are regarded as those that do not support antenna selection.
item.name: falseAntSelIndentifySwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the type of guaranteed UEs. It is effective only when the ucSpeType4EnPrbAllocSwch parameter is set to Open.
item.name: speUeTpyeSel4EnRbAlloc

item.desc: This parameter sets the strategy for allocating uplink shared resources in DSS scenarios. It specifies the setting method of the uplink RB resource proportion of LTE cells. If it is set to 0, the uplink resource proportion of NR cells can be statically configured based on the configurations on the UME. If it is set to 1, the uplink resource proportion of NR cells can be dynamically adjusted based on the service requirements of LTE/NR cells.
item.name: ulRBShareAlgSwitch4NR

item.desc: This parameter sets the strategy for allocating downlink shared resources in DSS scenarios. It specifies the setting method of the downlink RB resource proportion of NR cells. If it is set to 0, the downlink resource proportion of NR cells can be statically configured based on the configurations on the UME. If it is set to 1, the downlink resource proportion of NR cells can be dynamically adjusted based on the service requirements of LTE/NR cells.
item.name: dlRBShareAlgSwitch4NR

item.desc: This parameter determines how to identify the terminals that select the Tx antennas of UEs. If it is set to 0, it indicates that the terminals that select UE Tx antennas are not identified. If it is set to 1, it indicates that the terminals that select UE Tx antennas are identified based on FGI policy 1. If it is set to 2, it indicates that the terminals that select UE Tx antennas are identified based on FGI policy 2. If it is set to 3, it indicates that the terminals that select UE Tx antennas are identified based on FGI policy 3. The parameter values 4 to 7 are reserved.
item.name: ueAntSelIdentifySwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the 20-bit atmospheric-ducting feature sequence. If it is set to 0, the 20-bit atmospheric-ducting feature sequence is disabled. If it is set to 1, the 20-bit atmospheric-ducting feature sequence is enabled and contains the high 2 bits of cell IDs. If it is set to 2, the 20-bit atmospheric-ducting feature sequence is enabled and does not contain any cell ID information.
item.name: atmosChaSeq20BitSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum initial RB offset for uplink PRB randomization. It is used to avoid the overlapping of the RBs used between neighbor cells after an RB offset is used.
item.name: maxRbOffsetOfUlPrbRand

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink resource proportion allocation method. If this parameter is set to 0, the dynamic resource proportion allocation method 1 is used, and resources are allocated in accordance with the proportion configured on the UME. If this parameter is set to 1, the dynamic resource proportion allocation method 2 is used, and resources are dynamically allocated in accordance with the number of LTE users and the number of NR users.
item.name: resourceAllocPolicyUL

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum proportion of guaranteed uplink LTE resources to ensure that these uplink resources cannot be preempted by NR cells. A larger parameter value indicates a higher minimum proportion of guaranteed uplink resources for LTE cells.
item.name: lteMinGuarFactorUL

item.desc: This parameter sets the weight of the number of LTE UEs if the allocation proportion of uplink resources is dynamically calculated. It is used to adjust the capability of LTE UEs to preempt the uplink RB resources. A larger parameter value indicates stronger capability of LTE UEs to preempt uplink RB resources.
item.name: lteWeightFactorUL

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion increase factor of the uplink resources reserved for NR cells. If the RB resources allocated to the NR cells cannot meet the demand, this parameter should be set to a larger value to increase the proportion of the RB resources allocated to the NR cells as needed.
item.name: nrNeedProFactorUL

item.desc: This parameter sets the weight of the number of NR UEs if the allocation proportion of uplink resources is dynamically calculated. It is used to adjust the capability of NR UEs to preempt the uplink RB resources. A larger parameter value indicates stronger capability of NR UEs to preempt uplink RB resources.
item.name: nrWeightFactorUL

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink resource proportion allocation method. If this parameter is set to 0, the dynamic resource proportion allocation method 1 is used, and resources are allocated in accordance with the proportion configured on the UME. If this parameter is set to 1, the dynamic resource proportion allocation method 2 is used, and resources are dynamically allocated in accordance with the number of LTE users and the number of NR users.
item.name: resourceAllocPolicyDL

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum proportion of guaranteed downlink LTE resources to ensure that these downlink resources cannot be preempted by NR cells. A larger parameter value indicates a higher minimum proportion of guaranteed downlink resources for LTE cells.
item.name: lteMinGuarFactorDL

item.desc: This parameter sets the weight of the number of LTE UEs if the allocation proportion of downlink resources is dynamically calculated. It is used to adjust the capability of LTE UEs to preempt the downlink RB resources. A larger parameter value indicates stronger capability of LTE UEs to preempt downlink RB resources.
item.name: lteWeightFactorDL

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion increase factor of the downlink resources reserved for NR cells. If the RB resources allocated to the NR cells cannot meet the demand, this parameter should be set to a larger value to increase the proportion of the RB resources allocated to the NR cells as needed.
item.name: nrNeedProFactorDL

item.desc: This parameter sets the weight of the number of NR UEs if the allocation proportion of downlink resources is dynamically calculated. It is used to adjust the capability of NR UEs to preempt the downlink RB resources. A larger parameter value indicates stronger capability of NR UEs to preempt downlink RB resources.
item.name: nrWeightFactorDL

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the restriction on RB resource allocation to the UEs with poor downlink channel quality when the UEs are in a cell in a smart space-division cell group. If this parameter is set to Open, the priority for allocating downlink RB resources to the UEs with high traffic and good channel quality can be increased. In this way, the allocation of downlink available RB resources to the UEs with poor channel quality can be restricted.
item.name: dLRBLimit4PoorUEEnable

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the optimization for the retransmission of RBs in the downlink to improve downlink spectrum efficiency. If it is set to Close, RB retransmission is not optimized. If it is set to Fixed-compress ratio mode or Self-adaptive enhanced mode, the eNodeB compresses the RBs retransmitted in the downlink whose feedback is NACK. If it is set to Fixed-compress ratio mode, the RBs are retransmitted based on a fixed compression ratio. If it is set to Self-adaptive enhanced mode, the RBs are retransmitted based on an adaptive compression ratio.
item.name: dLRetrRBOptSwtch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables DSS MSG2 scheduling optimization. It is used to improve the success rate of random LTE access in DSS scenarios. If it is set to Open and the scheduling of MSG2 resources of an LTE cell conflicts with that of the CSI-RS, TRS, and CSI-IM resources of an NR cell, the MSG2 resources of the LTE cell are still scheduled. If it is set to Close and the scheduling of MSG2 resources of an LTE cell conflicts with that of the CSI-RS, TRS, and CSI-IM resources of an NR cell, the MSG2 resources of the LTE cell are not scheduled.
item.name: dssMsg2SchdOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion of the number of continuous RBs reserved in a cell to the number of RBs in the whole bandwidth of the cell. It is used to improve the uplink perception of the UEs at far points. The parameter value 0 indicates that no RB is reserved.
item.name: ulRbRsvNumRatio

item.desc: This parameter sets the start position of reserved RB segments. If the perception of the UEs at far points is poor, RB segments need to be reserved to improve the uplink perception of the UEs.
item.name: ulRbRsvStart

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables dynamic spectrum sharing between LTE carriers.
item.name: lteSpecShareSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the ID of the target cell with which the local cell shares spectrum resources if LTE spectrum sharing is enabled.
item.name: lteSpecShareCId

item.desc: This parameter sets the policy for allocating uplink shared resources. It indicates the proportion of the shared spectrum resources occupied by 20 MHz cells. If the Switch of LTE Spectrum Sharing parameter is set to Open, the parameter value Static 100% indicates that the 20 MHz cells use all the shared spectrum resources while the value Static 0% indicates that the 20 MHz cells do not use the shared spectrum resources.
item.name: ulShareResAllocPolicy

item.desc: This parameter sets the policy for allocating downlink shared resources. If the Switch of LTE Spectrum Sharing parameter is set to Open, it indicates the proportion of the shared spectrum resources occupied by 20 MHz cells.
item.name: dlShareResAllocPolicy

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables PDSCH scheduling restriction for the bandwidth of 1.4 MHz.It is used to control whether downlink scheduling needs to be disabled if the downlink scheduling of ACK/NACK feedback is in the PRACH subframe. If this parameter is set to Open and the downlink scheduling of ACK/NACK feedback is in the PRACH subframe, the downlink scheduling is disabled. If this parameter is set to Close and the downlink scheduling of ACK/NACK feedback is in the PRACH subframe, the downlink scheduling can be enabled.
item.name: pdschLimitSchdSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables AMC optimization for the UEs with poor channel quality. If it is set to Open, the MCS convergence of the UEs whose CQI values are 0 can be accelerated, and the downlink traffic and average MCS value of cells can be increased. If it is set to Close, AMC optimization for the UEs with poor channel quality is not implemented.
item.name: lowCQIAMCOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable closed-loop correction in uplink retransmission RB optimization. It is used to determine whether to correct the compression ratio in RB compression for retransmission in accordance with the A/N feedback. If this parameter is not set to Open, the compression ratio is corrected in accordance with the A/N feedback. If this parameter is set to 1, it indicates that the cluster-level compression ratio correction function is enabled. If this parameter is set to 2, it indicates that the UE-level compression ratio correction function is enabled. If this parameter is set to 3, it indicates that both the cluster-level compression ratio correction function and the UE-level compression ratio correction function are enabled.
item.name: uLRBRetrOptOLSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to reduce the number of RBs before uplink packet retransmission. If this parameter is not set to 0 (Close), it indicates that uplink packets are retransmitted after the number of RBs is reduced in the case that the uplink packets fail to be transmitted, improving the uplink spectrum efficiency. If this parameter is set to 1 (The initial value of the compression ratio is a fixed value), it indicates that a fixed compression ratio is used as the initial compression ratio. If this parameter is set to 2 (The initial value of the compression ratio uses the adaptive compression ratio), it indicates that an adaptive compression ratio is used as the initial compression ratio. If this parameter is set to 3 (The initial value of the Opt compression ratio is a fixed value), it indicates that an optimized fixed compression ratio is used as the initial compression ratio. If this parameter is set to 4 (The initial value of the Opt compression ratio uses the adaptive compression ratio), it indicates that an optimized adaptive compression ratio is used as the initial compression ratio. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the number of RBs is not reduced before uplink packet retransmission.
item.name: uLRBRetrOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the initial value of the compression ratio in uplink retransmission. It is an array with three elements. The array elements, from the first element, respectively represent the initial compression ratio in retransmission of far-distance UEs, middle-distance UEs, and near-distance UEs. When the eNodeB retransmits RBs, if it is determined that RB compression is required for retransmission, the number of retransmitted RBs is calculated by multiplying the number of initially transmitted RBs by the parameter value.
item.name: uLComRatioCfg

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink PIM3 interference avoidance strategy when scheduling-based PIM3 interference avoidance is enabled. If the CUEUtranCellFDDLTE. UcPimInterferenceAvoidSwch (PIM Interference Avoidance Switch) parameter is set to a non-zero value and this parameter is set to 0 (Band disable and Channel rank reduction), the eNodeB uses the collaborative interference avoidance scheme of downlink frequency band disabling and channel rank reduction to dynamically adjust the interference avoidance strategy based on downlink services. If this parameter is set to 1, the eNodeB uses the downlink frequency band disabling scheme.
item.name: pimInterfereAvoidMode

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables PIM3 interference avoidance based on scheduling. If it is set to 1 (Adaptive avoidance), the eNodeB uses the scheduling-based uplink/downlink adaptive PIM3 interference avoidance scheme and dynamically adjusts the interference avoidance function based on the uplink/downlink services. If this parameter is set to 2 (Fixing avoidance), the eNodeB uses the scheduling-based PIM3 downlink fixed interference avoidance scheme (without uplink interference avoidance), that is, the eNodeB alleviates interference to only the downlink channels to ensure no PIM3 interference to the uplink channels. If this parameter is set to 3 (Avoidance and rank reduction), the eNodeB uses the comprehensive uplink interference avoidance scheme based on scheduling avoidance and rank reduction. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB disables scheduling-based PIM3 interference avoidance.
item.name: pimInterferenceAvoidSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the policy for guaranteeing uplink NR or LTE resources in dynamic spectrum sharing scenarios.
item.name: specShareUlRbGuaPolicy

item.desc: This parameter sets the usage threshold of reserved uplink RBs. It is used to control whether to determine far-point UEs in a cell. This parameter is an array with two elements. The first element sets the low usage threshold of reserved uplink RBs. If the usage of reserved uplink RBs is lower than this threshold, far-point UE decision needs to be made. The second element sets the high usage threshold of reserved uplink RBs. If the usage of reserved uplink RBs is higher than this threshold, far-point UE decision does not need to be make. If the usage threshold of reserved uplink RBs is between the high threshold and the low threshold, the existing UE position decision status (far-point UE or not) remains unchanged. The second element of the array is larger than the first element.
item.name: ulRbRsvRbLoadThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the SINR threshold of a single RB for an uplink UE at a far point. It is used to determine whether a UE is at a far point. This parameter is an array with two elements. The first element is the low threshold for determining uplink far-point UEs. If the SINR threshold of a single RB for an uplink UE is smaller than this threshold, the UE is identified as a far-point UE, and the eNodeB allocates the resources with better channel quality to the UE. The second element is the high threshold for determining uplink far-point UEs. If the SINR threshold of a single RB for an uplink UE is larger than this threshold, the UE is identified as a non-far-point UE, and the eNodeB does not allocate the resources with better channel quality to the UE. If the SINR threshold of a single RB for an uplink far-point UE is between the high threshold and the low threshold, the existing UE position decision status (far-point UE or not) remains unchanged. The second element of the array is larger than the first element.
item.name: singleRBSinr4WeakUser

item.desc: This parameter sets the policy for dynamically allocating downlink resources in FMM spectrum sharing between LTE and NR systems.
item.name: fMMDssDlRbAllocPolicy

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables pre-scheduling of downlink packet pinging services. If it is set to Open, the downlink packet pinging delay can be reduced.
item.name: dlPingPreSchdSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the guarantee type of downlink continuous pre-scheduling. It is used to configure the guaranteed objects in downlink pre-scheduling. If this parameter is set to 0, it indicates that downlink continuous pre-scheduling is disabled. If this parameter is set to 1, it indicates that the guarantee type of downlink continuous pre-scheduling is general QoS TYPE1. If this parameter is set to 2, it indicates that the guarantee type of downlink continuous pre-scheduling is general QoS TYPE2. If this parameter is set to 3, it indicates that the guarantee type of downlink continuous pre-scheduling is general QoS TYPE3, and so on.
item.name: dlConPreSchdSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to support constructing low-NI areas on the PUSCH in DSS scenarios. If it is set to Open, a reserved-RB segment is configured for the LTE system for only the LTE UEs at far points to reduce the PUSCH interference to the far-point UEs.
item.name: ulRbRsvInDssSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables phase compensation for antenna combination weights in PUCCH compensation. This parameter is valid for the A9732 1719 model only. If it is set to Open, phase compensation is performed on the weights of antenna combination in PUCCH compensation. If it is set to Close, no phase compensation is performed on the weights of antenna combination in PUCCH compensation.
item.name: pucchWgtCompSwitch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables orthogonal projection. It is used to eliminate interference between FMM space-division cells or space-division macrocells and strong interference in radio space. If it is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB can use the orthogonal projection algorithm to eliminate the interference and improve the demodulation capability of the eNodeB.
item.name: orthPrjSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables access optimization for faulty UEs. If this parameter is set to Open, optimization is implemented in the case that an MSG1 measurement error occurs, thus improving the handover success rate.
item.name: stopUlSchdAftMsg3HFSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable the maximum uplink MCS optimization. It is used to control the scheduling policy for the maximum uplink MCS when uplink and downlink scheduling coexist. If uplink and downlink scheduling coexist, if this parameter is set to Open, the maximum uplink MCS is scheduled more than when this parameter is set to Close.
item.name: ulMaxMcsOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the path loss threshold for determining whether a UE is at a far point if uplink CoMP is enabled. If the path loss of a UE is larger than this threshold, the UE is considered as a far-point UE.
item.name: compPLThread

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables downlink scheduling enhancement to control the number of UEs scheduled in the downlink direction. To disable this function, set this parameter to 0. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, it indicates the maximum number of UEs scheduled in the downlink direction.
item.name: dlEnhancedSchdSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable uplink interference optimization. It is an array parameter consisting of three elements. The first element sets whether to enable modifying the cell that a UE accesses. If this element is set to Open, a UE in a cell under serious uplink interference accesses another cell to improve the user experience at the cell edge. The second element sets whether to enable PRACH adjustment. If this element is set to Open, the PRACH position of a UE in a cell under serious uplink interference is adjusted to improve the success rate in accessing the cell. The third element sets whether to enable power adjustment. If this element is set to Open, the transmit power of a UE in a cell under serious uplink interference is adjusted to improve the user experience at the cell edge.
item.name: ulInterferFixSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the guarantee type for downlink PRB utilization optimization. It is used to determine whether to raise the priority of the UEs with a larger BSR in the QoS selection, CCE allocation, and RB allocation phases during the downlink resource allocation procedure, thus improving the PRB utilization. To raise the priority of the UEs with a large BSR only in the QoS selection phase, set this parameter to Only QoS Select. To raise the priority of the UEs with a large BSR only in the CCE allocation phase, set this parameter to Only CCE Alloc. To raise the priority of the UEs with a large BSR in the QoS selection and CCE allocation phases, set this parameter to Both QoS Select and CCE Alloc. To raise the priority of the UEs with a large BSR only in the RB allocation phase, set this parameter to Only RB Alloc. To raise the priority of the UEs with a large BSR in the QoS selection and RB allocation phases, set this parameter to Both QoS Select and RB Alloc. To raise the priority of the UEs with a large BSR in the CCE allocation and RB allocation phases, set this parameter to Both CCE Alloc and RB Alloc. To raise the priority of the UEs with a large BSR in the QoS selection, CCE allocation, and RB allocation phases, set this parameter to All Enabled. To disable raising the priority of the UEs with a large BSR in the QoS selection, CCE allocation, and RB allocation phases, set this parameter to Close.
item.name: dlPrbOptGuaType

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for determining the strength of channel-level low-order PIM interference. It is used to determine whether there is channel-level low-order PIM interference in the current cell. If the strength of channel-level low-order PIM interference in a cell exceeds this threshold, the eNodeB determines there is channel-level low-order PIM interference in the cell. If the ucPimInterferenceAvoidSwch (PIM Interference Avoidance Switch) parameter is set to 3 (Avoidance and rank reduction), the eNodeB implements the PIM interference avoidance policy to improve the experience of the users in the cells where there is channel-level low-order PIM interference.
item.name: pim3DetectBaseChannel

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for determining the strength of channel-level high-order PIM interference. It is used to determine whether there is channel-level high-order PIM interference in the current cell. If the strength of channel-level high-order PIM interference in a cell exceeds this threshold, the eNodeB determines there is channel-level high-order PIM interference in the cell. If the ucPimInterferenceAvoidSwch (PIM Interference Avoidance Switch) parameter is set to 3 (Avoidance and rank reduction), the eNodeB implements the PIM interference avoidance policy to improve the experience of the users in the cells where there is channel-level high-order PIM interference.
item.name: pim5DetectBaseChannel

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for determining the strength of carrier-level low-order PIM interference. It is used to determine whether there is carrier-level low-order PIM interference in the current cell. If the strength of carrier-level low-order PIM interference in a cell exceeds this threshold, the eNodeB determines there is carrier-level low-order PIM interference in the cell. If the ucPimInterferenceAvoidSwch (PIM Interference Avoidance Switch) parameter is set to 3 (Avoidance and rank reduction), the eNodeB implements the PIM interference avoidance policy to improve the experience of the users in the cells where there is carrier-level low-order PIM interference.
item.name: pim3DetectBaseCarrier

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for determining the strength of carrier-level high-order PIM interference. It is used to determine whether there is carrier-level high-order PIM interference in the current cell. If the strength of carrier-level high-order PIM interference in a cell exceeds this threshold, the eNodeB determines there is carrier-level high-order PIM interference in the cell. If the ucPimInterferenceAvoidSwch (PIM Interference Avoidance Switch) parameter is set to 3 (Avoidance and rank reduction), the eNodeB implements the PIM interference avoidance policy to improve the experience of the users in the cells where there is carrier-level high-order PIM interference.
item.name: pim5DetectBaseCarrier

item.desc: This parameter sets a policy for filtering the UEs that are subject to PIM5 or PIM7 interference and for which rank reduction needs to be performed on uplink channels. If the ucPimInterferenceAvoidSwch (PIM Interference Avoidance Switch) parameter is set to 3 (Avoidance and rank reduction), this parameter is used to control the calculation of the range of the interference generated by high-order Passive Intermodulation (PIM) to filter the desired UEs. If this parameter is set to 0 (Rank-reduced UE screening for PIM5), it indicates that the desired UEs are filtered based on the PIM5 interference range. If this parameter is set to 1 (Rank-reduced UE screening for PIM7), it indicates that the desired UEs are filtered based on the PIM7 interference range.
item.name: highPimUeSelectPolicy

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion threshold of the number of RBs for rank reduction of uplink channels. If PIM interference avoidance is enabled for the BBU, this parameter is used to determine whether rank reduction needs to be perform on the uplink channels of the interfered UEs. For a UE, if the proportion of the number of RBs scheduled in the uplink in the interfered area to the total number of RBs scheduled for the UE in the uplink is larger than or equal to this threshold, rank reduction is performed on the uplink channels of the UE.
item.name: pimUlChanCloseRbRatioThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the proportion of the number of RBs for downlink-channel rank reduction. It is used to determine whether to perform channel rank reduction on the full bandwidth or some bandwidths. If the ucPimInterferenceAvoidSwch (PIM Interference Avoidance Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Adaptive avoidance) or 2 (Fixing avoidance), channel rank reduction is enabled, and the proportion of the number of RBs used by UEs in the downlink bandwidth without interference to the number of RBs used in the full bandwidth is larger than the threshold, the rank of some bandwidths in downlink channels is reduced; otherwise, the rank of the full bandwidth of downlink channels is reduced.
item.name: dlChanRankReduceRatio

item.desc: This parameter sets a policy for selecting target UEs for rank reduction of uplink channels. If PIM interference avoidance is enabled, this parameter is used to control the type of UEs for which rank reduction of uplink channels takes effect. If this parameter is set to 0 (Uplink rank reduction without distinguishing the affected UE type), it indicates that the types of interfered UEs are not distinguished during rank reduction of uplink channels. If this parameter is set to 1 (Uplink rank reduction is performed only on the affected UEs in dedicated scheduling), it indicates that rank reduction of uplink channels is performed on only the interfered UEs of dedicated scheduling type.
item.name: pimTargetUeForUlChanClose

item.desc: This parameter sets the start frequencies of downlink non-LTE carrier bands with PIM interference. It is an array consisting of five elements. The array elements represent the start frequencies of five non-LTE carrier bands in turn, and are used to determine the five non-LTE carrier bands together with the five elements of the dwPimDlHighFreqBandConfig[5] (End Frequencies of DL Frequency Bands with PIM Interference) array parameter. If the ucPimInterferenceAvoidSwch (PIM Interference Avoidance Switch) parameter is set to 3 (Avoidance and rank reduction), to calculate the interference of all the carriers, the eNodeB calculates the range of the frequency domain with downlink PIM interference based on the five non-LTE carrier bands that are jointly determined by this array parameter and the dwPimDlHighFreqBandConfig[5] array parameter.
item.name: pimDlLowFreqBandConfig

item.desc: This parameter sets the end frequencies of downlink non-LTE carrier bands with PIM interference. It is an array consisting of five elements. The array elements represent the end frequencies of five non-LTE carrier bands in turn, and are used to determine the five non-LTE carrier bands together with the five elements of the dwPimDlHighFreqBandConfig[5] (End Frequencies of DL Frequency Bands with PIM Interference) array parameter. If the ucPimInterferenceAvoidSwch (PIM Interference Avoidance Switch) parameter is set to 3 (Avoidance and rank reduction), to calculate the interference of all the carriers, the eNodeB calculates the range of the frequency domain with downlink PIM interference based on the five non-LTE carrier bands that are jointly determined by this array parameter and the dwPimDlHighFreqBandConfig[5] array parameter.
item.name: pimDlHighFreqBandConfig

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable rank reduction for downlink channels. If the pimInterferenceAvoidSwch (PIM Interference Avoidance Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Adaptive avoidance) or 2 (Fixing avoidance), this parameter sets whether to reduce the rank of downlink channels. If this parameter is set to Open, the rank of downlink channels is reduced, thereby reducing the PIM interference. If this parameter is set to Close, rank reduction of downlink channels does not take effect.
item.name: dlChanRankReduceSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the expansion factor of available uplink RBs for PIM interference avoidance. If PIM interference avoidance is enabled, this parameter controls the number of uplink RBs that can be scheduled. A larger parameter value indicates a larger number of available uplink RBs that can be scheduled.
item.name: pimUlRbExtenFactor

item.desc: This parameter sets the coverage adjustment range of a cell with serious uplink interference. This parameter is an array parameter consisting of three elements. The first through third elements correspond to the coverage adjustment range of a cell when the interference strength is high, medium, and low. For cells under serious uplink interference, the cell that a UE is accessing is changed in accordance with the interference strength to improve the user experience at the cell edge.
item.name: ulInterfereX

item.desc: This parameter sets the application scenario mode for interference identification. For a cell under serious uplink interference, to improve the identification accuracy, the application scenario mode should be set in accordance with whether the interference comes from outside or is co-channel interference. In this way, the corresponding anti-interference policy can be selected for the cell and the overall performance is improved.
item.name: ulInterferNIMode

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables uplink frequency selection enhancement for high-priority UEs. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the frequency selection function is more likely to take effect for high-priority UEs.
item.name: ulSpecUserFreqSelectSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of downlink channels actually shut down. It is valid if the pimPolicyClass (PIM Interference Mitigation Policy) parameter is set to a non-zero value.
item.name: dlShutChanNum

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of two elements. It sets the range of the RBs subject to uplink PIM interference if low-order PIM interference is produced in a cell. This parameter is valid if the pimPolicyClass (PIM Interference Mitigation Policy) parameter is set to a non-zero value or the PimInterferenceAvoidSwch (PIM Interference Avoidance Switch) parameter is set to 3. The first and second elements respectively indicate the start and end positions of the range of the RBs interfered in the uplink.
item.name: ulLowPimRbRange

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of two elements. It sets the range of the RBs subject to uplink PIM interference if high-order PIM interference is generated in a cell. This parameter is valid when the pimPolicyClass (PIM Interference Mitigation Policy) parameter is set to a non-zero value or the PimInterferenceAvoidSwch (PIM Interference Avoidance Switch) parameter is set to 3. The first and second elements respectively indicate the start and end positions of the range of the RBs interfered in the uplink.
item.name: ulHighPimRbRange

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of two elements. It sets the range of the RBs generating downlink PIM interference if low-order PIM interference is generated in a cell. This parameter is valid when the pimPolicyClass (PIM Interference Mitigation Policy) parameter is set to a non-zero value. The first and second elements respectively indicate the start and end positions of the range of the RBs generating interference in the downlink.
item.name: dlLowPimRbRange

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of two elements. It sets the range of the RBs generating downlink PIM interference if high-order PIM interference is generated in a cell. This parameter is valid when the pimPolicyClass (PIM Interference Mitigation Policy) parameter is set to a non-zero value. The first and second elements respectively indicate the start and end positions of the range of the RBs generating interference in the downlink.
item.name: dlHighPimRbRange

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink RB allocation adjustment policy for PIM interference mitigation. It is used to reduce the impact of PIM interference on cell services and valid if the pimPolicyClass (PIM Interference Mitigation Policy) parameter is set to a non-zero value. If this parameter is set to 0, how to allocate RBs does not vary with cells. If this parameter is set to 1, for FDD macro cells, the RBs with low PIM interference are allocated preferentially and then those with high PIM interference during uplink scheduling. For a soft-split FMM cell, the start position of the RBs scheduled in the uplink is changed every 100 ms, corresponding to the four cells in the space-division cell group in turn separately to prevent a space-division cell from being subject to uplink PIM interference over a long period of time.
item.name: pimRbAllocDirection

item.desc: This parameter sets a MIMO policy for the downlink channels that are shut down. It is used to eliminate the impact of PIM interference on downlink MIMO. If this parameter is set to 1 (Rank reduced to SFBC), the transmission scheme is adjusted to Space-Frequency Block Coding (SFBC). If this parameter is set to 0 (Rank not reduced), the transmission scheme remains unchanged.
item.name: dlChanShutMiMoPolicy

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables downlink frequency selection enhancement for high-priority UEs. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the frequency selection function is more likely to take effect for high-priority UEs. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), no special measure needs to be taken for high-priority UEs in resource allocation.
item.name: dlSpecUserFreqSelectSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets a PIM interference mitigation policy. It is used to mitigate the impact of PIM interference on cell performance. If this parameter is set to 0 (No mitigation policy), no PIM interference mitigation is performed. If this parameter is set to 1 (Downlink channel rank reduction), downlink rank reduction is performed. If this parameter is set to 2 (Uplink channel rank reduction), uplink rank reduction is performed. If this parameter is set to 3 (Uplink and downlink collaborative rank reduction), collaborative uplink and downlink rank reduction is performed. If this parameter is set to 4 (Downlink power derating), downlink power derating is performed.
item.name: pimPolicyClass

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables orthogonal projection optimization. It is valid when the orthPrjSwch (Orthogonal Projection Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open). If this parameter is set to 0, orthogonal projection optimization is disabled. If this parameter is set to 1, orthogonal projection optimization for the PUSCH is enabled. If there is strong interference to the uplink signals of FMM cells and a high correlation between receiving antennas, singular values tend to be generated during orthogonal-projection matrix decomposition, affecting demodulation performance. In this case, enabling orthogonal projection optimization can eliminate the impact of singular values on demodulation performance and further increase the traffic gain of orthogonal projection.
item.name: orthPrjOptFlag

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to support an inter-BBU non-ideal delay (a long inter-BBU delay) in an uplink CoMP scenario.
item.name: nonidealLatencyCoMPSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the low BLER threshold for uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay. It is used to determine whether a UE that is involved in uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay should exit the CoMP. If the BLER gain obtained from the uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay is smaller than or equal to this threshold, the UE exits the CoMP.
item.name: coMPCellBlerLThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the high BLER threshold for uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay. It is one of the conditions for determining whether a UE can be involved in uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay. If the BLER gain obtained from the uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay is larger than this threshold, the condition is met.
item.name: coMPCellBlerHThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the high threshold of the neighbor cell response proportion for uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay. It is one of the conditions for determining whether a UE can be involved in uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay. If the proportion at which the neighbor cells respond to the CoMP requests from the local cell is larger than this threshold, the condition is met.
item.name: coMPCellResponRatioHThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the low threshold of the neighbor cell response proportion for uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay. It is used to determine whether a UE that is involved in uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay should exit the CoMP procedure. If the proportion at which the neighbor cells respond to the CoMP requests from the local cell is smaller than this threshold, the UE exits the CoMP procedure.
item.name: coMPCellResponRatioLThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of times that the UEs involved in uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay are scheduled. A UE can be involved in uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay only if the number of times that the UE is scheduled within a measurement period is larger than this threshold.
item.name: coMPCellSchNumThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the period for determining a CoMP neighbor cell in uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay. At the end of the period, the eNodeB determines whether the UE can be involved in uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay.
item.name: coMPCellPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the conservative SINR value for uplink CoMP coordination with a non-ideal delay. This parameter is used to conservatively adjust the SINR value for a UE at the time when CoMP scheduling is not implemented in the case that the UE is performing uplink CoMP coordination with a non-ideal delay, thus reducing the MCS value and the number of RBs used for scheduling and ensuring that the scheduled data can be decoded properly at this time.
item.name: coMPDeltaSINR

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum offset of the fixed start RB position for downlink PRB randomization. It is used to calculate the position of the start RB if downlink PRB randomization of LTE systems is enabled.
item.name: maxRbOffsetOfDlPrbRand

item.desc: This parameter sets the range of PIM power derating. It is used to adjust the power of cell reference signals to reduce the uplink interference caused by PIM if the pimPolicyClass (PIM Interference Mitigation Policy) parameter is set to 4 (Downlink power derating).
item.name: deltaPim

item.desc: This parameter sets an uplink interference avoidance policy for 8T smart space-division cell groups. If this parameter is set to 0 (Disabled), the interference avoidance policy is disabled. If this parameter is set to 1 (Forced staggered PUSCH PRB positions between cells), the PUSCH PRB positions are forcibly staggered between cells. If this parameter is set to 2 (PUSCH PRB positions are staggered dynamically in accordance with the interference level), the PUSCH PRB positions are dynamically staggered between cells based on the interference level.
item.name: sSCGRbLimitSwitch8T

item.desc: This parameter sets a policy for guaranteeing the rate of NR UEs with high throughput in TDD DSS scenarios. It is used to control how the LTE system reserves resources for NR UEs with high throughput in TDD DSS scenarios. If this parameter is set to 0 (Disabled), no rate guarantee policy is implemented. If this parameter is set to 1 (Weak Guarantee), the weak rate guarantee policy is enabled, that is, the rate of NR UEs is slightly increased while that of LTE UEs is not significantly reduced. If this parameter is set to 2 (Strong Guarantee), the strong rate guarantee policy is enabled, that is, the rate of NR UEs is significantly increased while that of LTE UEs is decreased greatly.
item.name: spectrumSharingPolicy

item.desc: This parameter sets the flag for Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) optimization. If it is set to 1, the SVD optimization function is enabled. If it is set to 0, the SVD optimization function is disabled. If there is an interference correlation between antennas during the calculation of a projection matrix, the number of interference covariance matrix conditions may be large, resulting in an overflow of fixed-point SVD calculation and reducing demodulation performance of the receiver. After SVD optimization is enabled, the errors caused by SVD calculation can be reduced and the demodulation performance of the receiver can be improved.
item.name: svdOptFlag

item.desc: This parameter sets the thresholds (in 3 dB) for orthogonal-projection feature values. It is an array parameter consisting of four elements. The elements represent the feature value thresholds of QPSK, 16QAM, 64QAM, and 256QAM separately in turn.
