For a modulation scheme, if the number of interference covariance matrix conditions is smaller than the threshold, the first and the second interference feature vectors are used for signal projection. Otherwise, only the first interference feature vector is used for signal projection.
item.name: sVDLamdaThr

item.desc: This parameter sets a PIM rank reduction flag. It is used to reduce the impact of PIM interference on the measurement and demodulation for UEs. If there is PIM interference to RRUs, the measurement and demodulation for UEs is affected. If this parameter is set to 1, PIM measurement optimization is enabled to improve the accuracy with which the eNodeB measures the TA and frequency offset values of UEs. If this parameter is set to 2, both PIM measurement optimization and demodulation optimization are enabled to further improve the demodulation capability of the eNodeB. If this parameter is set to 0, PIM optimization is disabled.
item.name: pimRankReduceFlag

item.desc: This parameter sets a power conversion factor to compensate for the UE power loss measured by the eNodeB after orthogonal projection. In the scenarios with high interference, compared with non-orthogonal projection, orthogonal projection causes a certain power loss for UEs. This parameter is used to compensate for the power loss of the UEs. If this parameter is set to 65535, the power loss of UEs is not compensated. If this parameter is set to 0, the power loss of UEs is adaptively compensated.
item.name: manuPwrConvFac

item.desc: This parameter sets a pre-compensated TA value (in Ts) for bandpass filtering. It is valid when the orthPrjSwch (Orthogonal Projection Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open). This parameter is used to compensate the TA value before the filter extracts interfering signals to reduce the impact of the delay on the filtering and improve the accuracy of interference calculation.
item.name: filterTaCompVal

item.desc: This parameter sets the filter coefficient index for noise extraction through orthogonal projection. It is used to extract the noise superimposed on signals. If this parameter is set to 0, it indicates that the bandwidth for 1-stream and 2-stream pilot signals is 180 Ts and that for 3-stream and 4-stream pilot signals is 100 Ts. If this parameter is set to 1, it indicates that the bandwidth for 1-stream and 2-stream pilot signals is 150 Ts and that for 3-stream and 4-stream pilot signals is 120 Ts.
item.name: niCofIndex

item.desc: This parameter sets the orthogonal-projection noise thresholds. It is used to determine whether an RB can be involved in orthogonal projection. It is an array parameter consisting of five elements. The elements represent the Interference over Thermal (IOT) thresholds (in dB) for RBs in QPSK, 16QAM, and 64QAM; middle RBs in 256QAM; and edge RBs in 256QAM separately in turn. In a scenario, if the interference strength of an RB is larger than the corresponding threshold, the RB is involved in orthogonal projection. If the interference strength of an RB is smaller than or equal to the corresponding threshold, the RB is not involved in orthogonal projection.
item.name: niPrjManualThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the power threshold (in dBm) for interference suppression. It is used to determine whether interference characteristics are selected for an RB occupied by a UE. If the power of an RB occupied by a UE is larger than or equal to the threshold, the RB meets one of the conditions for orthogonal projection.
item.name: niEigDbmThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the SINR threshold (in dB) for interference suppression. It is used to determine whether interference characteristics are selected for an RB occupied by a UE. If the SINR of an RB occupied by a UE is smaller than or equal to the threshold, the RB meets one of the conditions for orthogonal projection.
item.name: priSinerThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the NI power threshold (in dBm) for interference suppression. It is used to determine whether interference eigenvalues are selected for an RB occupied by a UE. If the noise power of an RB occupied by a UE is larger than or equal to the threshold, the RB meets one of the conditions for orthogonal projection.
item.name: priNiThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of eigenvalues for interference suppression. When an RB occupied by a UE meets the orthogonal-projection conditions, the number of eigenvalues that can be selected for the RB cannot exceed the parameter value.
item.name: niEigNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for rank reduction of Rx antennas. If the power of the Rx antenna with the minimum power is smaller than or equal to the value of the validPowerThres (Valid Measured Power) parameter and the difference between the power of an Rx antenna and the minimum power is larger than the parameter value, the eNodeB reduces the number of Rx antennas (that is, the eNodeB performs rank reduction on some Rx antennas) to reduce the impact of the interference from neighbor cells on the uplink demodulation performance of the eNodeB.
item.name: rankReduceThres

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for valid measured power. If the power of the Rx antenna with the minimum power is smaller than or equal to this parameter value, the eNodeB reduces the number of Rx antennas (that is, the eNodeB performs rank reduction on some Rx antennas) to reduce the impact of the interference from neighbor cells on the uplink demodulation performance of the eNodeB. The eNodeB filters the Rx antennas on which rank reduction is performed based on the rankReduceThres (Threshold for Antenna Rank Reduction Decision) parameter.
item.name: validPowerThres

item.desc: This parameter sets the conservative MCS index for uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay. It is used to conservatively adjust the MCS scheduled for a UE at the time when CoMP scheduling is not implemented in the case that the UE is involved in uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay, ensuring that the scheduled data can be decoded properly at this time.
item.name: coMPDeltaMCS

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables resource scheduling optimization for the UEs in uplink weak-coverage areas. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB periodically closes the resource scheduling opportunities for the UEs in uplink weak-coverage areas, reducing the proportion at which DCI0Lost occurs in a cell.
item.name: weakUeSchdCtrlSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the period for which UEs in uplink weak-coverage areas are forbidden to schedule resources. It is valid if the WeakUeSchdCtrlSwch (Switch of Scheduling Optimization for UEs in Weak-Coverage Areas) parameter is set to 1 (Open). The UE that is identified to be in a weak-coverage area cannot schedule resources within the period specified by this parameter in some scenarios (excluding high-priority scheduling scenarios, for example, signaling retransmission).
item.name: ulWeakUeNoSchdTime

item.desc: This parameter sets the period for which UEs in uplink weak-coverage areas are allowed to schedule resources. It is valid if the WeakUeSchdCtrlSwch (Switch of Scheduling Optimization for UEs in Weak-Coverage Areas) parameter is set to 1 (Open). The UEs that are identified to be in weak-coverage areas can schedule resources within the period specified by this parameter.
item.name: ulWeakUeNormalSchdTime

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of times that DCI0Lost occurs on a UE in a weak-coverage area. It is used to identify the UEs in uplink weak-coverage areas. If the WeakUeSchdCtrlSwch (Switch of Scheduling Optimization for UEs in Weak-Coverage Areas) parameter is set to 1 (Open), the number of times that a UE schedules resources is larger than or equal to the SchdTimesThr4WeakUe (Threshold Number of Times That a UE in a Weak-Coverage Area Schedules Resources) parameter, and the number of times that DCI0lost occurs on the UE is larger than or equal to the parameter value, the UE is identified to be in an uplink weak-coverage area.
item.name: dci0LostThr4WeakUe

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of times that a UE in a weak-coverage area schedules resources. It is used to identify the UEs in uplink weak-coverage areas. If the WeakUeSchdCtrlSwch (Switch of Scheduling Optimization for UEs in Weak-Coverage Areas) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the number of times that a UE schedules resources is larger than or equal to the parameter value, the eNodeB determines whether the UE is in an uplink weak-coverage area by using the Dci0LostThr4WeakUe (Threshold Number of Times That DCI0Lost Occurs on a UE in a Weak-Coverage Area) parameter.
item.name: schdTimesThr4WeakUe

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for soft bit combination in the scenario where the delay is not ideal. The unit is 0.25 db.This threshold determines whether soft bit combination can be implemented for a UE in coordination in a cross-base station CoMP network where the inter-base station transmission delay is longer than 2 ms. If the absolute value of the difference between the SINRs measured in the two serving cells of a UE in coordination is smaller than the value of this parameter, soft bit combination can be implemented for the UE.
item.name: noIdealSftBitThr

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to support cell-level uplink DMRS group hopping. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), uplink DMRS interference caused by PCI Mod30 conflicts can be avoided, improving the uplink demodulation performance. If it is set to 0 (Close), the cell does not support cell-level uplink DMRS group hopping.
item.name: groupHoppingSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable the optimization of RB reservation for the PUCCH. In fixed-CFI scenarios, if this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the fixed CFI value is 3 and used to determine the number of RBs reserved for the PUCCH. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the number of RBs reserved for the PUCCH is determined by the actual CFI.
item.name: pucchRsvRBOpt4CFI

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable code channel spacing adjustment optimization for static ACK/NACK feedback of the PUCCH format1 series. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB moves the frequency domain positions of the static ACK/NACK feedback of the PUCCH format1 series to the positions before those of dynamic ACK/NACK feedback and the code channel spacing of static ACK/NACK feedback of the PUCCH format1 series is controlled by the PucchDeltaShfsemiAN parameter.
item.name: pUCCHANOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the code channel spacing between static ACK/NACK feedback of the PUCCH format1 series. It takes effect if the ucPUCCHANOptSwch (Switch of Frequency Domain Position and Code Channel Spacing Adjustment Optimization for Static ACK/NACK Feedback of the PUCCH Format1 Series) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the pucchSemiAnNum (Number of PUCCH Channel for ACK/NACK of Downlink SPS Scheduling) or numPucch1b (Number of PUCCH Format 1b) parameter is not set to 0. A larger parameter value indicates larger code channel spacing. In this case, the interference among code channels reduces but the PUCCH overhead may increase. A smaller parameter value indicates smaller code channel spacing. In this case, the PUCCH overhead decreases but the interference among code channels may increase.
item.name: pucchDeltaShfsemiAN

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to compress RBs for the UEs with general-QoS services during uplink retransmission. If the uLRBRetrOptSwch (Switch of Reducing the Number of RBs for UL Retransmission) parameter is not set to 0 (Close) and this parameter is set to 1 (TypeUeRetxOptEnable), the RBs for the UEs with the services of general-QoS type1 through type6 are compressed before being transmitted during uplink retransmission. In this case, the number of RBs used for retransmission scheduling for the UEs with general-QoS services reduces and the number of available RBs used for initial transmission scheduling for the UEs with general-QoS services increases. If this parameter is set to 0 (TypeUeRetxOptDisEnable), the RBs for the UEs with the services of general-QoS type1 through type6 are not compressed during uplink retransmission, improving the retransmission stability of the UEs.
item.name: ulRBRetrOpt4TypeUeSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to compress RBs for the UEs with general-QoS services during downlink retransmission. If the ucDLRetrRBOptSwtch (Switch of Reducing the Number of RBs for DL Retransmission) parameter is not set to 0 (Close) and this parameter is set to 1 (TypeUeRetxOptEnable), the RBs for the UEs with the services of general-QoS type 1 through type 6 are compressed before being transmitted during downlink retransmission. In this case, the number of RBs used for retransmission scheduling for the UEs with general-QoS services reduces and the number of available RBs used for initial transmission scheduling for the UEs with general-QoS services increases. If this parameter is set to 0 (TypeUeRetxOptDisEnable), the RBs for the UEs with the services of general-QoS type 1 through type 6 are not compressed during downlink retransmission, improving the retransmission stability of the UEs.
item.name: dlRBRetrOpt4TypeUeSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for RLC packet reordering for the UEs with non-ideal delays in AM mode in uplink CoMP scenarios in FDD. By default, the parameter value is the same as the tReorderingFdd (Reordering Timer for RLC FDD) parameter. When the nonidealLatencyCoMPSwch (Switch for Supporting Non-Ideal Delays in UL CoMP) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the RLC layer receives a fast retransmission indication from the CMAC, this parameter takes effect. When out-of-order packets are detected on the RLC layer, this timer is started. When no out-of-order packet is detected on the RLC layer, this timer is stopped. If out-of-order packets are detected after the timer expires, a packet status report is generated and sent to the UE.
item.name: coMPTReorderingFdd

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum interval for sending status reports of the UEs with non-ideal delays in uplink CoMP scenarios in FDD. It is used to avoid frequent sending of packet status reports. By default, the parameter value is the same as the tReorderingFdd (Status Prohibit Timer) parameter. When the nonidealLatencyCoMPSwch (Switch for Supporting Non-Ideal Delays in UL CoMP) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the RLC layer receives a fast retransmission indication from the CMAC, this parameter takes effect. The timer is started when the RLC layer sends a status report. The status report can be sent again only when the timer expires.
item.name: coMPTStatusProhibt

item.desc: This parameter sets the intelligent-detection IDs of sleeping cells. It is a binary number consisting of eight bits. The least significant bit of this parameter indicates whether to enable the intelligent MMT accelerator detection function. The value 1 indicates that the function is enabled and the value 0 indicates that the function is disabled. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB detects whether the MMT accelerator operates properly. If the MMT accelerator does not operate properly, the board where the MMT accelerator is located is automatically reset. In this case, the sleeping cells on the board are awakened. The remaining bits of this parameter are reserved.
item.name: sleepCellDetectionBitmap

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to optimize the number of RBs for PUCCH transmission. For the FDD macro eNodeBs for which the cellCapaLeveInd (Cell Capacity Level Indicator) parameter is not set to 0 or 4 and whose bandwidth is 20 MHz or 10 MHz, if this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the parameters related to the number of RBs for PUCCH transmission are the same as those of the existing physical PUCCH resources configured on the UME; if this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the parameters related to the number of RBs for PUCCH transmission are those configured on the eNodeB. If the parameters configured on the eNodeBs are used (that is, the SR period is longer and the number of static ACK/NACK code channels is smaller), the number of resources for PUCCH transmission reduces, the number of resources for PUSCH transmission increases, and therefore the uplink peak rate is higher.
item.name: pucchRbNumOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables symbol-level LLR weighting in PUSCH demodulation. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), optimization measures are taken in interference scenarios to reduce the impact of interference on the uplink demodulation performance.
item.name: lLRWeightSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the valid threshold for symbol-level LLR weight values used in PUSCH demodulation. During PUSCH demodulation, an LLR weight value is calculated for each symbol. If the weight value of a symbol is smaller than or equal to the threshold, it is considered that the current symbol is interfered and LLR weighting is performed on the symbol. If the weight value of a symbol is larger than the threshold, LLR weighting is not performed on the symbol.
item.name: lLRWeightValidThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the MCS index threshold for symbol-level LLR weighting in PUSCH demodulation. It is used to control the maximum MCS index for UEs to support symbol-level LLR weighting in PUSCH demodulation. If the MCS index of a UE is larger than the threshold, symbol-level LLR weighting in PUSCH demodulation is not performed for the UE.
item.name: lLRWeightMcsThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the lower-limit adjustment coefficient of the symbol-level LLR weight values used in PUSCH demodulation. It is used to adjust the lower limit of the symbol-level LLR weight values used in PUSCH demodulation and is valid if the ucLLRWeightSwitch (Switch of Symbol-Level LLR Weighting in PUSCH Demodulation) parameter is set to 1 (Open).
item.name: lLRWeightModFac

item.desc: This parameter sets an NI data collection policy for the frequency bands shared between an LTE cell and an NR cell in a DSS scenario. If this parameter is set to 0, the LTE cell and the NR cell report the measured NI values of the scheduled RBs to each other. If this parameter is set to 1, the LTE cell reports all the measured NI values of the shared frequency bands to the NR cell.
item.name: dssNIStatsPolicy

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to stop retransmission scheduling after handover. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the source eNodeB does not perform retransmission scheduling after UEs are handed over, improving the handover success rate of neighbor cells.
item.name: rexStopSchdSwchInHoState

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum number of downlink RBs allocated to UEs by using the type1 resource allocation method. If the minimum number of RBs scheduled for UEs is larger than 1, the downlink BLER of the UEs decreases.
item.name: replaceRb4Type1onerb

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of times that a UE is consecutively identified as that with small-packet services (a small-packet UE for short). It is used to determine the validation policy of the uplink scheduling optimization function. When the number of times that a UE is consecutively identified as a small-packet UE reaches the threshold, the eNodeB does not detect whether the UE is a small-packet UE within one millisecond. After the interval of one millisecond, the eNodeB continues to detect whether the UE is a small-packet UE.
item.name: ulSchdOptTimesThr

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the uplink scheduling optimization function takes effect when the general-QoS services of a certain type are guaranteed. It is an array parameter consisting of six elements. Element 0 through element 5 set whether the guarantee for general-QoS services of type1 through type6 and uplink scheduling optimization are mutually exclusive. If an element is set to 1, it indicates that uplink scheduling optimization is forcibly disabled if there are guaranteed general-QoS services of a certain type in the cell. If an element is set to 0, it indicates that uplink scheduling optimization can be enabled if there are guaranteed general-QoS services of a certain type in the cell.
item.name: ulSchdOptType

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of RBs used in uplink scheduling optimization for the UEs with small-packet services (small-packet UEs for short). It is used to determine the validation policy of the uplink scheduling optimization function. In a subframe, if the total number of RBs scheduled for small-packet UEs is larger than the parameter value, the small-packet UEs for which the total number of RBs is smaller than the parameter value are scheduled based on their priorities. The low-priority small-packet UEs for which the total number of RBs exceeds the parameter value are scheduled in the next subframe.
item.name: ulSchdOptAvailThr

item.desc: This parameter sets an optimization coefficient for uplink scheduling. It is used to adjust the scheduling priorities of different uplink services. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority for uplink service scheduling.
item.name: ulSchdOptFactor

item.desc: This parameter sets the thresholds for uplink congestion optimization. It is an array parameter consisting of four elements. It is used to enable or disable uplink congestion optimization and control the validation policy of the function. Element 0 sets the time decision threshold. If the element value is larger than 0, uplink congestion optimization takes effect. Element 1 sets the threshold for determining the number of UEs. Element 2 sets the time limit threshold. Element 3 sets the threshold for determining the number times that UEs are scheduled.
item.name: ulJamOptThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of times that a UE is consecutively identified as that with downlink small-packet services (a small-packet UE for short). It is used to determine the validation policy of the downlink scheduling optimization function. When the number of times that a UE is consecutively identified as a small-packet UE reaches the threshold, the eNodeB does not detect whether the UE is a small-packet UE within one millisecond. After the interval of one millisecond, the eNodeB continues to detect whether the UE is a small-packet UE.
item.name: dlSchdOptTimesThr

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the downlink scheduling optimization function takes effect when the general-QoS services of a certain type are guaranteed. It is an array parameter consisting of six elements. Element 0 through element 5 set whether the guarantee for general-QoS services of type1 through type6 and downlink scheduling optimization are mutually exclusive. If an element is set to 1, it indicates that downlink scheduling optimization is forcibly disabled if there are guaranteed general-QoS services of a certain type in the cell. If an element is set to 0, it indicates that downlink scheduling optimization can be enabled if there are guaranteed general-QoS services of a certain type in the cell.
item.name: dlSchdOptType

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of RBs used in downlink scheduling optimization for the UEs with small-packet services (small-packet UEs for short). It is used to determine the validation policy of the uplink scheduling optimization function. In a subframe, if the total number of RBs scheduled for small-packet UEs is larger than the parameter value, the small-packet UEs for which the total number of RBs is smaller than the parameter value are scheduled based on their priorities. The low-priority small-packet UEs for which the total number of RBs exceeds the parameter value are scheduled in the next subframe.
item.name: dlSchdOptAvailThr

item.desc: This parameter sets an optimization coefficient for downlink scheduling. It is used to adjust the scheduling priorities of different downlink services. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority for downlink service scheduling.
item.name: dlSchdOptFactor

item.desc: This parameter sets the thresholds for downlink congestion optimization. It is an array parameter consisting of four elements. It is used to enable or disable downlink congestion optimization and control the validation policy of the function. Element 0 sets the time decision threshold. If the element value is larger than 0, downlink congestion optimization takes effect. Element 1 sets the threshold for determining the number of UEs. Element 2 sets the time limit threshold. Element 3 sets the threshold for determining the number times that UEs are scheduled.
item.name: dlJamOptThr

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables downlink scheduling optimization. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the scheduling priorities of different downlink services are adaptively adjusted.
item.name: dlSchdOptSwitch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables uplink scheduling optimization. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the scheduling priorities of different uplink services are adaptively adjusted.
item.name: ulSchdOptSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of RBs for determining whether to enable downlink scheduling optimization. If the number of RBs corresponding to the remaining BSRs of a UE is smaller than the parameter value, it is considered that downlink scheduling is preferentially performed for the UE.
item.name: dlSchdOptJudgeThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of RBs for determining whether to enable uplink scheduling optimization. If the number of RBs corresponding to the remaining BSRs of a UE is smaller than the parameter value, it is considered that uplink scheduling is preferentially performed for the UE.
item.name: ulSchdOptJudgeThr

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the average speed of UEs is considered for dual-pilot channel estimation. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the dual-pilot estimation can be performed for an uplink baseband channel only if the average speed of target UEs meets certain conditions. In this way, the performance of the dual-pilot channel estimation function can be improved. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the average speed of UEs does not need to be considered for uplink dual-pilot channel estimation on the baseband.
item.name: dualPilotSpeedFlag

item.desc: This parameter sets the policy for demodulating and decoding the uplink baseband channels for UEs. If this parameter is set to 0, it indicates that high-order decoding is implemented for the UEs with a large TB size. If this parameter is set to 1, it indicates that high-order decoding is implemented for the UEs with signaling. If this parameter is set to 2, it indicates that high-order decoding is implemented for the specific UEs selected by the baseband.
item.name: usrDecPolicySelFlag

item.desc: This parameter sets the flag for selecting a symbol-level interference suppression policy. If this parameter is set to 0, it indicates that symbol-level interference suppression is not performed for any UE. If this parameter is set to 1, it indicates that symbol-level interference suppression is performed for non-UCI UEs. If this parameter is set to 2, it indicates that symbol-level interference suppression is performed for non-UCI UEs and UEs that carry ACK/NACK information. If this parameter is set to 3, it indicates that symbol-level interference suppression is performed for all the UEs.
item.name: symInterfModifyFlag

item.desc: This parameter sets the lower-limit adjustment coefficient of symbol-level interference suppression weight values. It is used to adjust the lower limit of symbol-level interference suppression weight values and is valid if the symInterfModifyFlag (Flag for Symbol-Level Interference Suppression Policy Selection) parameter is set to 1, 2, or 3.
item.name: symInterfModifyModFac

item.desc: This parameter sets the valid threshold for symbol-level interference suppression weight values. It is valid if the symInterfModifyFlag (Flag for Symbol-Level Interference Suppression Policy Selection) parameter is set to 1, 2, or 3. During uplink demodulation, an interference suppression weight value is calculated for each symbol. If the weight value of a symbol is smaller than or equal to the threshold, it is considered that the symbol is interfered and the system suppresses the interference to the symbol. If the weight value of a symbol is larger than the threshold, the system does not suppress the interference to the symbol.
item.name: symInterfModifyValidThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the types of effective general-QoS services in Turbo decoding scenarios. It is used if the identification of poor-quality UEs for which the number of times that Turbo decoding is performed increases is enabled. This parameter is an array consisting of six elements, element 0 through element 5 (corresponding to general-QoS type1 through type6). Each element sets whether to enable the determination of the increase of the number of times that Turbo decoding is performed for the UEs with the services of the corresponding type.
item.name: isQoSTypeUsed4Turbo

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables uplink 256QAM adaptation optimization. It is an array parameter consisting of four elements. Element 0 enables or disables scheduling optimization in the case that 256QAM adaptation is enabled. If it is set to 0 (Close), 256QAM scheduling optimization is disabled. If it is set to 1 (Open), 256QAM scheduling optimization is enabled. If it is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB collects statistics on only the scheduling that can reflect real channel quality in the case that 256QAM adaptation is enabled. Element 1 enables or disables 256QAM adaptation optimization in high-load scenarios. If it is set to 0 (Close), UEs that do not use 256QAM can use 256QAM in high-load scenarios. If it is set to 1 (Open), UEs that do not use 256QAM cannot use 256QAM in high-load scenarios. Element 2 enables or disables 256QAM adaptation for VoLTE services. If it is set to 0 (Close), 256QAM adaptation can be enabled for VoLTE services. If it is set to 1 (Open), 256QAM adaptation cannot be enabled for VoLTE services. Element 3 enables or disables scheduling optimization during the fuzzy period of CA reconfiguration. If it is set to 0 (Close), scheduling optimization during the fuzzy period of CA reconfiguration is disabled. If it is set to 1 (Open), scheduling optimization during the fuzzy period of CA reconfiguration is enabled. In this case, retransmission scheduling during the fuzzy period of CA reconfiguration can be accurate.
item.name: ul256QamOptSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the PUSCH can preempt blanking RB resources of the PUCCH. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the PUSCH can preempt blanking RB resources from the PUCCH. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the PUSCH cannot preempt blanking RB resources from the PUCCH.
item.name: reusePucchBlankRbSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to optimize uplink large-packet retransmission for the UEs with general-QoS services. If it is set to 1 (Open) and there are large-packet UEs in the current subframe, the large-packet UEs whose data needs to be retransmitted can be allocated with RBs at both ends of the frequency band to improve the PRB usage of the cell.
item.name: genQoSUlReTransAdpSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of RBs for response to SRs. It is used to prevent a single UE from occupying too many resources in SR-based scheduling. If the srRBNumAuthMode parameter is set to 3 (Based On Cell RB Utilization Rate), the number of RBs allocated for SR-based scheduling of a single UE does not exceed the parameter value.
item.name: maxRB4SR

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables MCS value increase. If it is set to 1 (Open) and a scheduled UE is identified as a poor-quality UE for which the number of times that Turbo decoding is performed increases, the scheduling MCS value can increase.
item.name: mcsUpSwch4Turbo

item.desc: This parameter sets the CCE usage threshold for determining whether uplink 256QAM can be used in high-load scenarios. It is used to determine whether the load of the current cell is high. If the CCE usage of the cell is higher than the threshold, the eNodeB determines that the cell load is high.
item.name: ul256QamCceRateThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the MCS value threshold for deactivating uplink 256QAM. If the scheduled MCS value is smaller than or equal to this threshold, the scheduling is considered to meet 256QAM deactivation conditions.
item.name: ul256QamMcsDisableThre

item.desc: This parameter sets the MCS value threshold for activating uplink 256QAM. If the scheduled MCS value is larger than or equal to this threshold, the scheduling is considered to meet 256QAM activation conditions.
item.name: ul256QamMcsEnableThre

item.desc: This parameter sets the PRB usage threshold for determining whether uplink 256QAM can be used in high-load scenarios. It is used to determine whether the load of the current cell is high. If the PRB usage of the cell is higher than the threshold, the eNodeB determines that the cell load is high.
item.name: ul256QamPrbRateThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the method for identifying uplink large-packet UEs. If this parameter is set to 0 (CMAC identification), it indicates that large-packet UEs are identified by the CMAC scheduler in uplink scheduling. If this parameter to 1 (Upper layer identified), it indicates that large-packet UEs are identified by the 5G user plane and the identification notifications are sent to the CMAC scheduler by the 4G user plane.
item.name: ulFullBufferJudgeMethod

item.desc: This parameter sets the SINR decision threshold of a single RB for determining poor-quality UEs in Turbo scenarios. If the usrDecPolicySelFlag (Decoding Policy for UEs) parameter is not set to 0 and the SINR of a single RB of a UE is smaller than the threshold, the channel quality of the UE is considered to be poor.
item.name: lowSingleRbSinrThr4Turbo

item.desc: This parameter sets the penalty interval for parameter reconfiguration of uplink 256QAM adaptation. It is used to determine the minimum time interval between two parameter reconfiguration procedures of uplink 256QAM adaptation. Another 256QAM adaptation parameter reconfiguration procedure cannot be initiated until the interval set by this parameter expires after a 256QAM adaptation parameter reconfiguration procedure is completed.
item.name: rRCReconPenalTimeThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of times that uplink 256QAM is deactivated. Within the period specified by the ul256QamCountWin (Adaptive Window Length for Activating or Deactivating Uplink 256QAM) parameter, if the number of times that the conditions for deactivating 256QAM are satisfied is larger than or equal to this threshold, uplink 256QAM is deactivated.
item.name: ul256QamCountDisableThre

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of times that uplink 256QAM is activated. Within the period specified by the ul256QamCountWin (Adaptive Window Length for Activating or Deactivating Uplink 256QAM) parameter, if the number of times that the conditions for activating 256QAM are satisfied is larger than or equal to this threshold, uplink 256QAM is activated.
item.name: ul256QamCountEnableThre

item.desc: This parameter sets the adaptive window length for activating or deactivating uplink 256QAM. It is used to count the number of times that 256QAM is activated or deactivated within the specified window length.
item.name: ul256QamCountWin

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of RRC-connected UEs for determining whether uplink 256QAM can be used in high-load scenarios. It is used to determine whether the load of the current cell is high. If the number of RRC-connected UEs in the cell is larger than the threshold, the eNodeB determines that the cell load is high.
item.name: ul256QamRrcConnectNumThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the PRB usage threshold for reusing reserved PUCCH resources in FMM soft-splitting scenarios. It is used to determine whether the cell load meets the resource reuse conditions in FMM soft-splitting scenarios. If the PRB usage is larger than the threshold, the reuse of reserved PUCCH resources can be triggered.
item.name: pucchReUsePrbUsageTh

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of RBs for reusing reserved PUCCH resources in SSCG scenarios. It is used to check whether the remaining RBs meet the resource reuse conditions in SSCG scenarios. If the difference between the number of available RBs for the current PUSCH and the number of estimated RBs for the historical PUSCH is smaller than the threshold, it indicates that the resources in the current cell are limited. It is used to determine whether the resource reuse conditions are met.
item.name: pucchRsvdRbReUseRBThr

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to reuse reserved PUCCH resources in FMM soft-splitting scenarios. If it is set to 1 (Open), the reserved PUCCH resources are reused, increasing the number of available RBs in the cell.
item.name: pucchRsvdRbReUseSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to perform RLC traffic shaping in the case that the nonidealLatencyCoMPSwch parameter is set to Open. If thenonidealLatencyCoMPSwch parameter is set to Open, many packets may be sent in a subframe at the RLC layer, exceeding the maximum network load and thus resulting in packet loss at the network layer. If this parameter is set to Open, the number of packets sent in a subframe at the RLC layer can be limited to avoid packet loss at the network layer.
item.name: rlcTrafficShapingSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the SINR threshold for UEs to exit uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay. A UE that is being involved in uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay can exit CoMP only if the SINR of the UE is larger than this threshold.
item.name: coMPCellSINRHThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the SINR threshold for UEs to be involved in uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay. A UE can be involved in uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay only if the SINR of the UE is smaller than this threshold.
item.name: coMPCellSINRLThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of times that NACK messages are received to trigger a UE to fast exit uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay. For a UE that is involved in uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay, if the consecutive number of times that uplink errors of a UE are corrected through CRCs exceeds this threshold, the UE exits uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay.
item.name: coMPFastExitNACKThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the policy for intelligently using uplink frequency-domain resources. If this parameter is set to 0, this policy is disabled. If this parameter is set to 1, in SSCG scenarios where PUCCH coordination mode is not set to 0, PUSCHs can use the staggered RBs reserved for coordination of PUCCH space-division cells in high-load scenarios. If this parameter is set to 2, the RBs of PUCCHs and PRACHs can be used for TypeN UEs during uplink scheduling. In SSCG scenarios where PUCCH coordination mode is not set to 0, the staggered RBs reserved for coordination of PUCCH space-division cells can also be used.
item.name: uplinkRBSmartUseSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the general-QoS type for which policy 2 for intelligently maximizing the use of uplink frequency-domain resources takes effect. If this parameter is set to a value in the range of 1 through 7, the RBs of PUCCHs and PRACHs can be used for UEs of the corresponding general-QoS type 1 during uplink scheduling.
item.name: uplinkRBSmartUserType

item.desc: This parameter sets the upper limit of the number of times that the RBs of PUCCHs and PRACHs can be preempted per hour in the case that in the case intelligent uplink frequency-domain resources utilization policy 2 is used. In the case that the ucUplinkRBSmartUseSwch parameter is set to 2 (Use PUCCH and PRACH and SSCG rervedRB based typeN), the number of times that the RBs of PUCCHs and PRACHs can be preempted per hour cannot exceed the parameter value. Each preemption lasts a maximum of 15 seconds. The larger the parameter value, the more RBs are available for PUSCHs, but the longer the duration of intra-frequency interference to neighbor cells.
item.name: pucchPrachUseCntThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the channel quality threshold for preempting the RBs of PUCCHs and PRACHs in the case intelligent uplink frequency-domain resources utilization policy 2 is used. In the case that the ucUplinkRBSmartUseSwch parameter is set to 2 (Use PUCCH and PRACH and SSCG rervedRB based typeN), if the channel quality value of UEs with a general-QoS type configured through the ucUplinkRBSmartUserType parameter is greater than this threshold, PUSCHs can preempt the RBs of PUCCHs and PRACHs.
item.name: pucchPrachUseSingleThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of RRC-Connected UEs for preempting the RBs of PUCCHs and PRACHs in the case intelligent uplink frequency-domain resources utilization policy 2 is used. In the case that the ucUplinkRBSmartUseSwch parameter is set to 2 (Use PUCCH and PRACH and SSCG rervedRB based typeN), if the number of RRC-Connected UEs in the cell is smaller than this threshold, PUSCHs can preempt the RBs of PUCCHs and PRACHs.
item.name: pucchPrachUseRrcThr

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables PHR optimization. If this parameter is set to Open, the number of RBs scheduled for small-traffic UEs at far points can be increased in scenarios where power is limited, thus improving the experience of small-traffic UEs at far points.
item.name: phrOptimizeSwitch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the function of using 256QAM fixedly in the uplink direction. If this parameter is set to Open, the uplink traffic of UEs with good channel conditions can be increased.
item.name: ul256QamDemSpInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of uplink scheduling interval in the case that 256QAM is used. It determines whether a UE is in the discrete status in uplink scheduling. If the uplink scheduling interval of a UE exceeds this threshold, the UE is in discrete scheduling status. If the uplink scheduling interval of a UE is smaller than this threshold, the UE is in continuous scheduling status.
item.name: schIntervalTimeThr

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to optimize LTE frequency-domain resource allocation on the PRACH in full-bandwidth DSS scenarios. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), a more flexible policy for frequency-domain resource allocation on the PRACH is used to increase the success rate of frequency-domain resource allocation and increase the usage of uplink frequency-domain resources.
item.name: fbDssPrachOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the low NI threshold for triggering scheduling optimization for a smart space-division cell group. It is used to determine whether a cell is in low-interference state. If the average NI of a cell is lower than this threshold, it indicates that this cell is in low-interference status. If the uplink PRB usage of the cell is limited, the limit should be canceled. If the average NI of a cell is larger than or equal to the threshold, it indicates that the cell is not in low-interference status.
item.name: sSCGCellLowNiThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the high threshold of the NI value for scheduling optimization of Smart Space-Division Cell Groups (SSCGs). It is used to determine whether the current cell is in high-interference state. If the average NI value of a cell is larger than this threshold, it indicates that the current cell is in high-interference status. In this case, the uplink PRB usage of the cell needs to be limited to reduce inter-cell interference. If the average NI value of a cell is smaller than or equal to this threshold, it indicates that the current cell is not in high-interference status.
item.name: sSCGCellHighNiThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to optimize the code rate control of Uplink Control Information (UCI) in CA scenarios. It is used to determine the PUSCH code rate control policy of the PCell and SCells at the time when a UE reports UCI (that is, the UCI time). If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), both the PCell and SCells control the code rate at the UCI time to reduce the BLER.
item.name: cAUCICodeRatioCtrlOpt

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion threshold of high-interference RBs if FMM interference projection is enabled. It is an array parameter consisting of four elements and used to identify the UEs with high interference. Elements 0 through 3 set the thresholds corresponding to the modulation schemes uplink QPSK, 16QAM, 64QAM, and 256QAM respectively. For a modulation scheme, if the proportion of the number of RBs with high interference to the total number of RBs scheduled in the uplink of a UE exceeds the corresponding threshold, the interference to the UE is considered to be high.
item.name: highNIRbRaioThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the PRB usage thresholds for guaranteeing the traffic of the LTE cells in DSS scenarios with high load. It is an array parameter consisting of four elements and used to check whether the load of DSS cells is high. Element 0 sets the uplink PRB usage threshold for guaranteeing the uplink traffic of LTE cells. If the uplink PRB usage of an LTE cell is higher than this threshold, the uplink services of the LTE cell are guaranteed. Element 1 sets the uplink PRB usage threshold for not guaranteeing the uplink traffic of LTE cells. If the uplink PRB usage of an LTE cell is lower than this threshold, the uplink services of the LTE cell are not guaranteed. Element 2 sets the downlink PRB usage threshold for guaranteeing the downlink traffic of LTE cells. If the downlink PRB usage of an LTE cell is higher than this threshold, the downlink services of the LTE cell are guaranteed. Element 3 sets the downlink PRB usage threshold for not guaranteeing the downlink traffic of LTE cells. If the downlink PRB usage of an LTE cell is lower than this threshold, the downlink services of the LTE cell are not guaranteed.
item.name: dssLteGuarantLoadThr

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to guarantee the traffic of LTE cells in DSS scenarios with high load. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the eNodeB determines that the load of LTE cells is high, the eNodeB guarantees the time-frequency resources for the UEs in the LTE cells.
item.name: highLoadLteGuarantSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the Ps threshold of high-interference UEs if FMM interference projection is enabled. It is used to identify the UEs with high interference. The interference to a UE can be identified to be high only when the signal power (Ps) of the UE received by the eNodeB and measured on the PUSCH exceeds this threshold.
item.name: orthPrjHighUEPsThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the RB-level high NI threshold if FMM interference projection is enabled. It is used to identify the RBs with high interference. If the NI value of an RB exceeds this threshold, the interference to the RB is considered to be high.
item.name: orthPrjRbHighNIThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the low proportion threshold for uplink subframe shutdown. It is used to check whether uplink subframe shutdown is triggered for the cell. If the ulForbidSfnSchdSwitch (Uplink Subframe Shutdown Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the uplink PRB usage of the cell is lower than the threshold within the period specified by the ulForbidSfnSchdSwitch (Period for Uplink Subframe Shutdown) parameter, subframe shutdown is triggered for the cell in the next period.
item.name: uLForbidSfnLowRatioThr

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables PIM interference avoidance optimization in non-constant-modulus FMM scenarios. If this parameter is set to 1, PIM interference avoidance optimization takes effect in non-constant-modulus FMM scenarios. In this case, the accuracy of PIM interference detection can improve through the adjustment of the pimFmmOptConvVal (PIM Interference Conversion Value Used in Non-Constant-Modulus FMM Scenarios) parameter.
item.name: pimFmmOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the PIM interference conversion value used in non-constant-modulus FMM scenarios. It is used to adjust the reported PIM interference values in non-constant-modulus FMM scenarios to make them closer to the actual PIM interference values.
item.name: pimFmmOptConvVal

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold numbers of LTE UEs whose services need to be guaranteed in DSS scenarios. It is an array parameter consisting of four elements and used to check whether the cell load in DSS scenarios is high. Element 0 sets the threshold number of RRC-Connected UEs whose uplink services need to be guaranteed in DSS scenarios. If the number of uplink RRC-Connected UEs in the LTE cells is larger than this threshold and the PRB usage is higher than the high-load guarantee threshold for LTE cells in DSS scenarios, the uplink services in the LTE cells are guaranteed. Element 1 sets the threshold number of RRC-Connected UEs whose uplink services do not need to be guaranteed in DSS scenarios. If the number of uplink RRC-Connected UEs in the LTE cells is smaller than this threshold, the uplink services in the LTE cells are not guaranteed. Element 2 sets the threshold number of RRC-Connected UEs whose downlink services need to be guaranteed in DSS scenarios. If the number of downlink RRC-Connected UEs in the LTE cells is larger than this threshold and the PRB usage is higher than the high-load guarantee threshold for LTE cells in DSS scenarios, the downlink services in the LTE cells are guaranteed. Element 3 sets the threshold number of RRC-Connected UEs whose downlink services do not need to be guaranteed in DSS scenarios. If the number of downlink RRC-Connected UEs in the LTE cells is smaller than this threshold, the downlink services in the LTE cells are not guaranteed.
item.name: dssLteGuarantRRCThr

item.desc: This parameter sets threshold 2 for downlink congestion optimization. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. It is used to control the validation policy of congestion optimization. Element 0 sets the downlink congestion hysteresis factor and is used to calculate the exit threshold corresponding to the time decision threshold specified by the dlJamOptThr[4] (Thresholds for Downlink Congestion Optimization) parameter and the decision threshold of the number of UEs specified by the dlJamOptThr[4] parameter. Element 1 sets the threshold number of times that abnormal UEs are scheduled. During the scheduling of a UE, if the BSR size is sufficient for UE scheduling and a CDR meets one of the following conditions, the UE scheduling recorded in the CDR is identified as an abnormal scheduling:(1) The ratio of the sum of the number of times that the UE is not properly scheduled (recorded in the CQI measurement result) and the number of times that downlink scheduling feedback is DTX to the total number of times that the UE is scheduled (recorded in the CDR) is greater than this threshold. (2) The downlink BLER of the UE is larger than this threshold.
item.name: dlJamOptThr2

item.desc: If the pimSimLoadSwch (PIM Loading Simulation Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open), the entire band is divided into multiple sub-bands. This parameter sets the number of RBs on each sub-band.
item.name: pimSubbandRbNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the uplink PIM interference proportion. It is used to check whether to perform uplink PIM interference avoidance. If the PIM interference in the cell is higher than the value of the pimThr (PIM Interference Decision Threshold) parameter and the proportion of the number of uplink interfered RBs to the number of RBs in the full bandwidth exceeds the parameter value, it is considered that the PIM interference has a negative impact on the uplink service performance. In this case, the interference avoidance policy is enabled to improve the user perception of uplink services.
item.name: pimPrbPerThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for PIM interference decision. It is used to check whether PIM interference in the cell affects uplink demodulation performance. If the PIM interference exceeds the threshold, it is considered that the PIM interference has a negative impact on the uplink demodulation performance.
item.name: pimThr

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables PIM loading simulation. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB measures PIM values in the case of loading simulation and implements a PIM mitigation policy based on the measurement results.
item.name: pimSimLoadSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the PIM interference reduction threshold for selecting downlink rank reduction cells and antennas in the case that the downlink rank reduction policy takes effect. If the decrease in PIM interference is higher than this threshold, it indicates that the downlink rank reduction policy can be implemented.
item.name: pimReduceThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration for PIM loading simulation for RB-level Network Interference (NI) measurement of antennas during PIM evaluation.
item.name: pimSimLoadDuration

item.desc: This parameter sets the PRB usage threshold for selecting loading simulation periods if PIM interference avoidance is enabled. If the PRB usage of the cell in a 15-minute period is lower than this threshold, this period can be selected as a loading simulation period. If the PRB usage of the cell within a 15-minute period is higher than this threshold, this period cannot be used as a loading simulation period.
item.name: pimPrbThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the priority decrease factors of NGBR bearers of various types if downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement is enabled. It is an array parameter consisting of eight elements and used to adjust the scheduling priorities of different types of bearers. Elements 0 through 7 set the priority decrease values of the bearers of type 0 through type 7 in turn. This parameter is valid if the dlFirstBagPrirtyDcrs (Switch of Lowering the Scheduling Priority of the First Packet for Perception Improvement-Based Downlink Scheduling Optimization) parameter is set to 1 (Open).
item.name: dlPrirtyDcrsFactor

item.desc: This parameter sets the coefficient of initial historical traffic if downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement is enabled. It is used to adjust the initial historical traffic of the PF factor. If the dlFirstBagPrirtyDcrs (Switch of Lowering the Scheduling Priority of the First Packet for Perception Improvement-Based Downlink Scheduling Optimization) parameter is set to 1 (Open), the initial historical traffic of the PF factor is the product of this parameter value and the full-bandwidth equivalent TB size of UEs.
item.name: dlCoefHstryThp

item.desc: This parameter sets the PBR delay threshold coefficient if downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement is enabled. It is used to adjust the scheduling priority of the bearers whose rate does not reach the priority bit rate. For an NGBR bearer whose rate does not reach that specified by the pbrValue (Prioritised Bit Rate) parameter, if the proportion of the delay to the downlink QoS scheduling window length is smaller than the parameter value, the eNodeB decreases the scheduling priority of the bearer.
item.name: dlPbrTimeDelayCoef

item.desc: This parameter sets the retransmission delay threshold if downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement is enabled. It is used to determine the duration of the retransmission scheduling delay. If element 3 of the dlPrcptnImprvSwch (Switch of Perception Enhancement-Based Downlink Scheduling Optimization) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the duration of the delay in retransmission scheduling is shorter than the threshold, the priority of the retransmission scheduling can be decreased.
item.name: dlRetrTimeThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the method of sorting each type of NGBR bearers by the number of to-be-scheduled packets for perception improvement-based downlink scheduling optimization. It is an array consisting of eight elements, and sets the priority sorting modes for bearers of various types. Elements 0 through 7 respectively set the priority sorting modes for bearers of types 0 through 7. If an element is set to 1, the priorities of the bearers of the corresponding type are sorted in ascending order in accordance with the numbers of packets to be scheduled. If an element is set to 0, the priorities of the bearers of the corresponding type are sorted based on PF factors.
item.name: dlNGBRPrirtyBagFactor

item.desc: This parameter sets the priority factors of AMBR layers if downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement is enabled. It is an array parameter consisting of eight elements and used to adjust the scheduling priorities of different types of bearers. Elements 0 through 7 set the priority weights of the bearers of type 0 through type 7 in turn. A larger element value indicates a higher scheduling priority of the corresponding type of bearer.
item.name: dlNGBRPrirtyFactor

item.desc: This parameter sets whether downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement and the UEs with general-QoS services or ATU UEs are mutually exclusive. It is an array parameter consisting of six elements. It is used to determine the protection policy for general-QoS guarantee services. Elements 0 through 5 set whether downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement and the UEs with the services of general-QoS type 1 through type 5 or ATU UEs are mutually exclusive. If an element is set to 1 (Open), downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement and the UEs with the services of the corresponding general-QoS type are mutually exclusive. If an element is set to 0 (Close), downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement and the UEs with the services of the corresponding general-QoS type are not mutually exclusive If there are UEs with the services of the type corresponding to an element with the value 1 in the cell, downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement does not take effect. If there is no UE with the services of the type corresponding to an element with the value 1 in the cell, downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement can take effect.
item.name: dlTypeMutexSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of single packets scheduled per TTI if downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement is enabled. When the number of single packets scheduled in a TTI reaches the parameter value, the eNodeB preferentially schedules the bearers that carry non-single packets.
item.name: dlMaxAmbrSingleBagNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval of historical-traffic update if downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement is enabled. The eNodeB updates the historical traffic of all the bearers to be scheduled at the interval specified by this parameter to update the PF factor. If this parameter is set to 0, it indicates that the interval is one millisecond.
item.name: dlHstryThpTimePeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the low SE threshold for perception improvement-based downlink scheduling optimization. It is used to determine the types of UEs to be scheduled. If the SE of a UE is lower than this threshold, the UE is determined as a low-SE UE and the scheduling priority of the UE is lowered.
item.name: dlLowSeThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the first-packet delay thresholds for perception improvement-based downlink scheduling. It is an array consisting of three elements, and used to determine the types of bearers that are not scheduled and calculate the scheduling priorities. Element 0 sets the first-packet delay threshold for single-packet bearers, element 1 sets the first-packet delay threshold for small-traffic bearers, and element 2 sets the first-packet delay threshold for large-traffic bearers. If the first-packet delay of a bearer is larger than or equal to the corresponding threshold, the eNodeB increases the scheduling priority of the bearer.
item.name: dlFirstBagTimeThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the delay thresholds of RLC status reports if downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement is enabled. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements and used to calculate the scheduling priority of the bearers that carry RLC status reports. Elements 0 and 1 respectively set the delay thresholds for high-SE UEs and low-SE UEs. If the delay of the bearers of high-SE UEs and low-SE UEs that carry RLC status reports is larger than or equal to the corresponding delay threshold, the eNodeB increases the scheduling priority for the bearers of high-SE UEs and low-SE UEs.
item.name: dlRlcStatRptTimeThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the large traffic thresholds for perception improvement-based downlink scheduling optimization. It is an array consisting of two elements and used to determine the types of bearers to be scheduled. Element 0 sets the low large-traffic threshold and element 1 sets the high large-traffic threshold. If the number of packets to be scheduled on a bearer exceeds the high threshold, the bearer is determined as a large-traffic bearer. If the number of packets to be scheduled on a bearer is lower than the low threshold, the bearer is determined as a small-traffic bearer.
item.name: dlLargeBagThr

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to lower the priority of the first packet for perception improvement-based downlink scheduling optimization. It is used to calculate the scheduling priorities of bearers. If it is set to 1 (Open), the priority weight of the first packet is decreased.
item.name: dlFirstBagPrirtyDcrs

item.desc: This parameter sets the PRB usage thresholds for enabling downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. Element 0 sets the low PRB usage threshold for disabling downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement, and element 1 sets the high PRB usage threshold for enabling downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement. If the downlink PRB usage of the cell is larger than the high threshold, downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement can be enabled. If the downlink PRB usage of the cell is smaller than the lower threshold, downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement is disabled.
item.name: dlPrbRateThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of RRC-Connected UEs for enabling downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. Element 0 sets the low threshold number of RRC-Connected UEs for disabling downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement, and element 1 sets the high threshold number of RRC-Connected UEs for enabling downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement. If the number of RRC-Connected UEs in the cell is larger than the high threshold, downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement can be enabled. If the number of RRC-Connected UEs in the cell is smaller than the lower threshold, downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement is disabled.
item.name: dlRrcUeNumThr

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables downlink scheduling optimization based on perception enhancement. It is an array parameter consisting of four elements that respectively enable or disable downlink scheduling optimization functions based on perception enhancement. Element 0 enables or disables NGBR bearer priority optimization. If it is set to 1 (Open), the downlink IP throughput of the cell can increase through the adjustment of the priority of NGBR bearers. Element 1 enables or disables PBR bearer priority optimization. If it is set to 1 (Open), the downlink IP throughput of the cell can increase through the adjustment of the priority of PBR bearers. Element 2 enables or disables AMBR traffic-based PBR bearer estimation. If it is set to 1 (Open), the downlink IP throughput of the cell can increase through the adjustment of AMBR traffic-based PBR bearer estimation. Element 3 enables or disables retransmission priority decrease. If it is set to 1 (Open), the downlink IP throughput of the cell can increase through the decrease of the retransmission priority.
item.name: dlPrcptnImprvSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets threshold 3 for downlink congestion optimization. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. It is used to control the validation policy of congestion optimization. Element 0 sets whether to enable downlink congestion optimization for PBR services. If this element is set to 1 (Open), the congestion optimization function is enabled for PBR services. If this element is set to 0 (Close), the congestion optimization function is disabled for PBR services. Element 1 sets time limit threshold 2. If the period during which a UE is not scheduled after receiving a BSR is longer than the time specified by this element, the eNodeB can schedule the UE.
item.name: dlJamOptThr3

item.desc: This parameter sets the policy for reporting the number of PRBs occupied at the UE level. If this parameter is set to Based On The Number Of Space-Division Layers, the reported number of PRBs occupied at the UE level is calculated based on the number of space-division layers. If this parameter is set to Based On The Actual Usage, the reported number equals the number of PRBs actually occupied.
item.name: uEPRBReportPolicySwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the type of PIM interference avoidance optimization used in non-constant-modulus FMM scenarios. If this parameter is set to 1 (BBU Conversion), the accuracy of PIM interference detection can improve through the adjustment of the pimFmmOptConvVal (PIM Interference Conversion Value Used in Non-Constant-Modulus FMM Scenarios) parameter for the BBU. If this parameter is set to 0 (RRU Conversion), the accuracy of PIM interference measurement can improve through the adjustment of the weight value used in non-constant-modulus FMM scenarios for the RRU.
item.name: pimFmmOptMode

item.desc: Full Distinguished Name
item.name: FDN

item.desc: Date Time
item.name: DATETIME

item.desc: Collection period of measurement task.
item.name: granularityPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: id

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: moId

item.desc: Switch for queuing based admission control algorithm, which can determine whether the queuing algorithm is valid or not.
item.name: switchForQueuing

item.desc: Switch of PRB based GBR service admission control, which can determine whether the GBR admission control algorithm is valid or not.
item.name: switchForGbr

item.desc: Switch of PRB based GBR service admission control algorithm in downlink, which can determine whether downlink PRB based GBR service admission control algorithm is valid or not.
item.name: switchForGbrDl

item.desc: Switch of PRB based GBR service admission control algorithm in uplink, which can determine whether uplink PRB based GBR service admission control algorithm is valid or not.
item.name: switchForGbrUl

item.desc: Switch of PRB based NGBR service admission control, which can determine whether the NGBR admission control algorithm is valid or not.
item.name: switchForNGBR

item.desc: Switch of PRB based NGBR service admission control algorithm in downlink, which can determine whether downlink PRB based NGBR service admission control algorithm is valid or not.
item.name: switchForNGBRDl

item.desc: Switch of PRB based NGBR service admission control algorithm in uplink, which can determine whether uplink PRB based NGBR service admission control algorithm is valid or not.
item.name: switchForNGBRUl

item.desc: This parameter sets an interval for the MAC to report MAC resource statistics to the RRM. A larger parameter value indicates a longer reporting interval and a smaller parameter value indicates a shorter reporting interval.
item.name: acReport

item.desc: Switch of based admission control for emergency call, which can determine whether the admission judgment for emergency call is valid or not.
item.name: switchforEMC

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the number of users with RRC connections. A Carrier Aggregate (CA) UE is counted as an RRC-connected UE in the admission control on the PCell and an RRC license applies (if the RRC license is available). It is also counted as an RRC-connected UE in the admission control on the SCell but an RRC license does not apply.
item.name: ueNumThrd

item.desc: The maximum number of established E-RAB that the cell can hold and the QoS of all the service can be guaranteed.
item.name: rabThrd

item.desc: User Reserved for Handover
item.name: reservedHO

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the algorithm is valid or not. Admission denied don't trigger congestion process when this switch is close; Admission denied trigger congestion process when this switch is open.
item.name: switchForConCtl

item.desc: This parameter indicates maximum number of GBR Service be preempted
item.name: preemMaxNumOfGBR

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of four elements, each of which corresponds to a rank-1 pre-emptible QCI. If an element is set to 0 (None), it indicates that the value is invalid. If a preemption policy is triggered when a bearer admission failure occurs, the eNodeB preempts the bearers with rank-1 pre-emptible QCIs. If there is no rank-1 pre-emptible QCI available, the eNodeB preempts the bearers with rank-2 pre-emptible QCIs.
item.name: premptQciRank1

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of four elements, each of which corresponds to a rank-2 pre-emptible QCI. If an element is set to 0 (None), it indicates that the value is invalid. If a preemption policy is triggered when a bearer admission failure occurs, the eNodeB preempts the bearers with rank-1 pre-emptible QCIs. If there is no rank-1 pre-emptible QCI available, the eNodeB preempts the bearers with rank-2 pre-emptible QCIs.
item.name: premptQciRank2

item.desc: Admission Control Switch for Probable Rejection: If Admission Control Switch is open in one cell, eNB should perform Probable Rejection Admission for initial Ue accessing in the cell; Otherwise eNB don't perform Probable Rejection Admission in the cell.
item.name: swchProRejAC

item.desc: Uplink Threshold of Probable Rejection Admission: When the Admission Control Switch for Probable Rejection is open in one cell, and the uplink total ratio of used PRB is higher than Uplink Threshold of Probable Rejection Admission, eNB should perform probable rejection admission for initial Ue accessing in the cell; Otherwise eNB don't perform Probable Rejection Admission in the cell.
item.name: proRejThrdUl

item.desc: Downlink Threshold of Probable Rejection Admission: When the Admission Control Switch for Probable Rejection is open in one cell, and the downlink total ratio of used PRB is higher than downlink threshold of probable rejection admission, eNB should perform probable rejection admission for initial Ue accessing in the cell; Otherwise eNB don't perform probable rejection admission in the cell.
item.name: proRejThrdDl

item.desc: Threshold of Probable Rejection Admission: When the Admission Control Switch for Probable Rejection is open, and the uplink total ratio of used PRB is higher than uplink threshold of probable rejection admission, or the downlink total ratio of used PRB is higher than downlink threshold of probable rejection admission, eNB creates a random value in [0, 1) for initial Ue accessing in the cell. If the value is higher than or equals to the Probable Rejection Admission Factor , eNB should reject the UE; Otherwise the UE isn't rejected by Probable Rejection Admission.
item.name: factorProRej

item.desc: Switch of Redirection for admit failure
item.name: swchOfRedi4ACFail

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of admit CSFB High Priority Call with priority
item.name: swtchOfCsfbHPAdmit

item.desc: This parameter is the Switch of CA User Restrict. When this switch is opened, If the number of users in cell reaches threshold of forbid Configured as SCell, the cell cannot be configured as SCell.
item.name: caUserSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the Threshold of forbid Configured as SCell. If the rate of number of users in cell (including the Users connected in cell and the Users is configured with this cell) and max number of users allowed in cell reaches threshold, the cell cannot be configured as SCell.
item.name: forbidSCellThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportions of the numbers of RRC-connected UEs allocated to PLMNs or PLMN groups. If the rRCResourceAllocationMode (Allocation Mode of the Numbers of RRC Users in Network Sharing Scenarios) parameter is set to 0 (PLMN Based RRC User Number Resource Sharing), the elements of this array parameter indicate the proportions of the numbers of RRC-connected UEs allocated to PLMN1 through PLMN6 in turn. If the rRCResourceAllocationMode (Allocation Mode of the Numbers of RRC Users in Network Sharing Scenarios) parameter is set to 1 (PLMN Group Based RRC User Number Resource Sharing), the elements of this array parameter indicate the proportions of the numbers of RRC-connected UEs allocated to PLMN group 1 through PLMN group 6 in turn.
item.name: ratioOperatornOfRrcNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the sliding window length of the number of RRC-connected UEs. If the rrcNum4NetSharSwch (Admission Control Algorithm Switch for RRC User Number of Operator in Network Sharing) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the proportion of the number of remaining UEs in the current cell is smaller than the parameter value, the number of newly connected UEs is limited by the proportion of the number of UEs admitted by an operator to prevent the number of RRC-connected UEs admitted by other operators from being too small.
item.name: rrcNumWindowLength

item.desc: Admission control algorithm switch for RRC User Number of Operator in Network Sharing, When the switch is opened, in accordance with the current ratio of the RRC user number of operators to determine whether to accept the user; When the switch is close, the RRC user number does not distinguish by the operator.
item.name: rrcNum4NetSharSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the Threshold of CA UE Back Off. If number of users in cell(including the Users connected in cell and the Users is configured with this cell) and max number of users allowed in cell reaches threshold, CA Users in this Scell will be chosen to back off.
item.name: caBackOffThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum proportion of the resources that can be allocated for multicast services in a physical cell to total available resources.
item.name: maxRatioMuitTotalOfCell

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the admission control and preemption strategy for privileged users. If it is set to Open, the privileged users need to execute admission control based on the number of users and the PRB resources. If the admission fails, the corresponding preemption procedure is triggered and the privileged users and their services are admitted no matter whether the preemption succeeds or not. If it is set to Close, the privileged users and their services are admitted immediately without the execution of admission control.
item.name: priUserACSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines the number of CA UE chosen to back off when the rate of users in cell reaches threshold of CA UE Back Off.
item.name: numCABackOff

item.desc: The parameter represents the cell preset allocations of network RRC License. When the user purchased the eNB level, or baseband board level, or cell level RRC License, the eNB shall ignore this parameter, and not used into the cell admission control process. When the user purchased the network level RRC License or doesn't need purchase any level RRC License, the eNB shall treat this parameter as the user preset cell allocations of network RRC License and use it into the cell adimission control process. About the CA(Carrier Aggregation) user, in the admission control process of PCell shall be counted as an RRC connection user and consume an RRC License, and in the admission control process of SCell shall be counted as an RRC connection user but not consume RRC License.
item.name: cellPresetNetRRCLic

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables RRC resource preemption. If it is set to Open, some high-priority users (for example, VoLTE users) can preempt the RRC resources of low-priority users in the case of admission failure due to RRC resource restriction.
item.name: userNumPreemptSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables RRC resource preemption redirection. If it is set to Open, the low-priority users whose resources are preempted are redirected. If it is set to Close, the low-priority users whose resources are preempted are released without redirection.
item.name: userNumPreemptRedSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets which QCI UEs are prohibited from being selected for resource preemption based on the number of RRC UEs.
item.name: userNumPreemptTraffTypeInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of eMTC terminals connected to the cell. The larger the parameter value is, the larger the number of eMTC terminals allowed to be connected to the cell is.
item.name: eMTCRRCResourceNumThrd

item.desc: This parameter and the The Number of RRC Resource for eMTC Terminals parameter work together to determine the number of RRC resources reserved for the eMTC handover users.
item.name: eMTCRRCResNumReserved

item.desc: This parameter determines how to allocate the numbers of RRC users in network sharing scenarios. If it is set to PLMN Based RRC User Number Resource Sharing, the numbers of RRC users are allocated by PLMN. If it is set to PLMN Group Based RRC User Number Resource Sharing, the numbers of RRC users are allocated by PLMN group.
item.name: rRCResourceAllocationMode

item.desc: This parameter enables or disable the admission control by the number of eMTC RRC users in network sharing scenarios. If it is set to Open, the system determines whether to admit eMTC users based on the ratio of the number of eMTC RRC users in the current PLMN (or PLMN group). If it is set to Close, the admission of eMTC users is independent of PLMNs (or PLMN groups).
item.name: eMTCRRCAC4NetSharSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportions of the numbers of RRC-connected eMTC UEs allocated to PLMNs or PLMN groups. If the rRCResourceAllocationMode (Allocation Mode of the Numbers of RRC Users in Network Sharing Scenarios) parameter is set to 0 (PLMN Based RRC User Number Resource Sharing), the elements of this array parameter indicate the proportions of the numbers of RRC-connected eMTC UEs allocated to PLMN1 through PLMN6 in turn.
