item.name: pucchMrcIrcSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of PRACH MRC/IRC combination adaption. If the switch is turned on, the UL PRACH adaptively chooses MRC/IRC in accordance with the interference condition. If the switch is turned off, the UL PRACH uses MRC.
item.name: prachMrcIrcSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the heavy-load cell switch. If the switch is turned on, the current cell is a heavy-load cell. If the switch is turned off, the current cell is a light-load cell.
item.name: cellHeavyLoadFlag

item.desc: This parameter is applied in situations where remote atmospheric ducting interference stations have no load. This parameter sets the threshold for determining whether atmospheric ducting interference exists. The larger the parameter value, the larger the interference in which atmospheric ducting interference can be identified.
item.name: atmosphericNoLoadThres

item.desc: This parameter sets the UL noise floor threshold for the PHY in signature sequence detection. The larger the parameter value, the larger the UL noise floor and interference in which signature sequences can be detected.
item.name: atmosphericGrdNiThresUl

item.desc: This parameter sets the signature sequence detection period for the atmospheric ducting interference location function in atmospheric ducting state transition determination.
item.name: atmosphericDetecPerid

item.desc: This parameter sets the first threshold for detecting the number of atmospheric ducting signature sequences. It determines the condition for transmitting signature sequences. The larger the parameter value is, the larger the number of detected signature sequences is required, meaning a stricter condition for transmitting signature sequences.
item.name: atmosphericSeqContThres1

item.desc: This parameter sets the second threshold for detecting the number of atmospheric ducting signature sequences. It determines the condition for symbol rollback. The larger the parameter value is, the larger the number of detected signature sequences is required, meaning a stricter condition for symbol rollback.
item.name: atmosphericSeqContThres2

item.desc: This parameter sets the third threshold for detecting the number of atmospheric ducting signature sequences. It determines the condition for symbol recovery. The larger the parameter value is, the larger the number of detected signature sequences is required, meaning a stricter condition for symbol recovery.
item.name: atmosphericSeqContThres3

item.desc: This parameter sets the UL noise floor threshold of atmospheric ducting interference. It determines the condition for transmitting signature sequences. The larger the parameter value is, the higher the UL noise floor and interference are required, meaning a stricter condition for transmitting signature sequences.
item.name: atmosphericUpNiThres

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for joining atmospheric ducting signature sequences. The larger the parameter value is, the larger the power difference tolerance range for joined signature sequences, meaning a more lenient condition for sequence joining.
item.name: atmosphericSeqJontThres

item.desc: This parameter is the flag of the PRACH MRC/IRC function. If the parameter is set to 0, the PRACH MRC function is enabled. If the parameter is set to 1, the PRACH IRC function is enabled.
item.name: prachMrcIrcEnable

item.desc: If this parameter is set to Open, the related IMEISV strategy is enabled.
item.name: iMEISVStgySwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the MCS threshold for switching from TM3 to TM9 in an 8-antenna cell for the UEs supporting transmit antenna selection. In an 8-antenna cell, this parameter is valid when both the UE transmit antenna selection function and the TM9 open-loop SU-MIMO function are enabled. This parameter is used to determine whether to switch from TM3 to TM9 for the UEs supporting transmit antenna selection. If the MCS value is less than this threshold, the UE can be switched from TM3 to TM9; otherwise, the UE remains in TM3.
item.name: tm39McsThrAntSelct8TX

item.desc: This parameter sets the MCS threshold for switching from TM3 to TM9 in an 4-antenna cell for the UEs supporting transmit antenna selection. In an 4-antenna cell, this parameter is valid when both the UE transmit antenna selection function and the TM9 open-loop SU-MIMO function are enabled. This parameter is used to determine whether to switch from TM3 to TM9 for the UEs supporting transmit antenna selection. If the MCS value is less than this threshold, the UE can be switched from TM3 to TM9; otherwise, the UE remains in TM3.
item.name: tm39McsThrAntSelct4TX

item.desc: This parameter sets the MCS threshold for switching from TM9 to TM3 in an 4-antenna cell for the UEs supporting transmit antenna selection. In an 4-antenna cell, this parameter is valid when both the UE transmit antenna selection function and the TM9 open-loop SU-MIMO function are enabled. This parameter is used to determine whether to switch from TM9 to TM3 for the UEs supporting transmit antenna selection. If the MCS value is larger than this threshold, the UE can be switched from TM9 to TM3; otherwise, the UE remains in TM9.
item.name: tm93TestMcsThrAntSelct4TX

item.desc: This parameter sets the MCS threshold for switching from TM9 to TM3 in an 8-antenna cell for the UEs supporting transmit antenna selection. In an 8-antenna cell, this parameter is valid when both the UE transmit antenna selection function and the TM9 open-loop SU-MIMO function are enabled. This parameter is used to determine whether to switch from TM9 to TM3 for the UEs supporting transmit antenna selection. If the MCS value is larger than this threshold, the UE can be switched from TM9 to TM3; otherwise, the UE remains in TM9.
item.name: tm93TestMcsThrAntSelct8TX

item.desc: This parameter indicates the low estimated RB threshold for priority space division. If the RBs estimated in real time are between the high and low thresholds, the pairing strategy of priority space division is triggered.
item.name: lowPrbEstimForMuMimoUl

item.desc: This parameter indicates the high estimated RB threshold for priority space division. If the RBs estimated in real time are between the high and low thresholds, the pairing strategy of priority space division is triggered.
item.name: highPrbEstimForMuMimoUl

item.desc: This parameter indicates the PRB usage threshold for priority space division. If the PRB usage exceeds this threshold, the pairing strategy of priority space division is triggered.
item.name: prbUsageThrdForMuMimoUl

item.desc: This parameter indicates the statistical period for the PRB usage threshold to trigger priority space division. In this period of time, statistics on the PRB usage is collected. After this period of time, the system determines whether to execute priority space division.
item.name: muPrbUsagePeriodUl

item.desc: Since the eNodeB ID is detected for the first time, if it is not reported within the following feature sequence detection periods specified by this threshold, it is discarded.
item.name: atmosENBIDDropThr

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables prioritized uplink MU MIMO space division. If it is set to Open, prioritized uplink space division is enabled. If it is set to Close, frequency division is enabled.
item.name: muMimoPriorSwchUl

item.desc: To eliminate the ambiguity in TDD multiplexing feedback, the R10 protocol introduces the new feedback table. This parameter enables or disables the new ACK-Multiplexing table.
item.name: aCKMtiPlexingSwchUl

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of MM DL transmission mode adaption based on cell-load. When the switch is on, MM will perform the transmission mode adaptation based on the cell-load status. When the switch is off, cell-load status is not considered in DL transmission mode adaption.
item.name: mmTMAlgCellloadSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the PRB usage threshold for cell load status change from low load to high load. The threshold is considered when the load of a cell changes from low load to medium/high load. The threshold is considered when the cell load status changes from low load to medium/high load. If the PRB usage is larger than or equal to this threshold, the number of potential MU-MIMO users is larger than or equal to the Threshold of the number of potential MU-MIMO UEs for MM cell status change from low-load status to medium/high-load, and the number of users scheduled in each TTI is larger than or equal to the Threshold of the number of scheduled users per TTI for MM cell status change from low-load status to medium-load, the cell load status changes from low load to medium/high load; otherwise, the cell load remains low.
item.name: mmPRBThrLow2MedHighDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the PRB usage threshold for cell status change from medium/high load to low load. The threshold is considered when the cell load status changes from medium/high load to low load. If the PRB usage is smaller than this threshold, or the number of potential MU-MIMO users is smaller than the Threshold of the number of potential MU-MIMO UEs for MM cell status change from medium/high-load status to low-load status, or the number of users scheduled in each TTI is smaller than Threshold of the number of scheduled users per TTI for MM cell status change from medium-load status to low-load status, the cell load status changes from medium/high load to low load; otherwise, the cell load remains medium/high.
item.name: mmPRBThrMedHigh2LowDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of potential MU-MIMO users when the cell load status changes from low load to medium/high load. The threshold is considered when the cell load status changes from low load to medium/high load. If the number of potential MU-MIMO users is larger than or equal to this threshold, the PRB usage is larger than or equal to the Threshold of PRB Usage for MM Cell Load Status Change from Low to Medium/High, and the number of users scheduled in each TTI is larger than or equal to the Threshold of the number of scheduled users per TTI for MM cell status change from low-load status to medium-load, the cell load status changes from low load to medium/high load; otherwise, the cell load remains low.
item.name: mmMuUEThrLow2MedHigh

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of potential MU-MIMO users when the cell load status changes from medium/high load to low load. The threshold is considered when the cell load status changes from medium/high load to low load. If the number of potential MU-MIMO users is smaller than this threshold, or the PRB usage is smaller than the Threshold of PRB Usage for MM Cell Load Status Change from Medium/High to Low, or the number of users scheduled in each TTI is smaller than the Threshold of the number of scheduled users per TTI for MM cell status change from medium-load status to low-load status, the cell load status changes from medium/high load to low load; otherwise, the cell load remains medium/high.
item.name: mmMuUEThrMedHigh2Low

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of users scheduled in each TTI when the cell load status changes from low load to medium load. The threshold is considered when the cell load status changes from low load to medium/high load. If the number of users scheduled in each TTI is larger than or equal to this threshold, the PRB usage is larger than or equal to the Threshold of PRB Usage for MM Cell Load Status Change from Low to Medium/High, and the number of potential MU-MIMO users is larger than or equal to the Threshold of the Number of Potential MU-MIMO UEs for MM Cell Load Status Change from Low to Medium/High, the cell load status changes from low load to medium/high load; otherwise, the cell load remains low.
item.name: mmSchUEThrLow2MedHigh

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of users scheduled in each TTI when the cell load status changes from medium load to low load. The threshold is considered when the cell load status changes from medium load to low load. If the PRB usage is smaller than the Threshold of PRB Usage for MM Cell Load Status Change from Medium/High to Low, or the number of potential MU-MIMO users is smaller than the Threshold of the Number of Potential MU-MIMO UEs for MM Cell Load Status Change from Medium/High to Low, or the number of users scheduled in each TTI is smaller than this threshold, the cell load status changes from medium/high load to low load; otherwise, the cell load remains medium/high.
item.name: mmSchUEThrMedHigh2Low

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the ratio in which the number of MU pairing layers is larger than four when the cell load status changes from medium load to high load. The threshold is considered when the cell load status changes from medium load to high load. If the ratio in which the number of MU pairing layers is larger than four is larger than or equal to this threshold, or the ratio of TM7 users is larger than or equal to the Threshold of the TM7 User Ratio for MM Cell Load Status Change from Medium to High, the cell load status changes from medium load to high load; otherwise, the cell load remains medium.
item.name: mmMayerThrMed2HighUl

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the ratio in which the number of MU pairing layers is larger than four when the cell load status changes from high load to medium load. The threshold is considered when the cell load status changes from high load to medium load. If the ratio in which the number of MU pairing layers is larger than four is smaller than this threshold, or the ratio of TM7 users is smaller than the Threshold of the TM7 User Ratio for MM Cell Load Status Change from High to Medium, the cell load status changes from high load to medium load; otherwise, the cell load remains high.
item.name: mmMayerThrHigh2MedUl

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the ratio of TM7 users when the cell load status changes from high load to medium load. The threshold is considered when the cell load status changes from high load to medium load. If the ratio in which the number of MU pairing layers is larger than four is smaller than the Threshold of MU layers Ratio for MM cell status change from High-load status to Medium-load status, or the ratio of TM7 users is smaller than this threshold, the cell load status changes from high load to medium load; otherwise, the cell load remains high.
item.name: mmTM7UserThrHigh2Med

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the ratio of TM7 users when the cell load status changes from medium load to high load. The threshold is considered when the cell load status changes from medium load to high load. If the ratio in which the number of MU pairing layers is larger than four is larger than or equal to the Threshold of MU layers ratio for MM cell status change from Medium-load status to high-load status, or the ratio of TM7 users is larger than or equal to this threshold, the cell load status changes from medium load to high load; otherwise, the cell load remains medium.
item.name: mmTM7UserThrMed2High

item.desc: This parameter sets the PLMN groups to which the PLMNs specified by the elements of the refPlmn parameter belong. It is an array parameter consisting of a maximum of six elements. The elements in the array respectively set the PLMN groups to which the PLMNs specified by the corresponding elements of the refPlmn parameter belong.
item.name: plmnGroupIndex

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportions of bandwidth resources allocated to PLMN groups in network sharing scenarios. It is an array parameter consisting of six elements. Element 0 through element 5 set the proportions of bandwidth resources allocated to PLMN group 1 through PLMN group 6 in turn.
item.name: ratioOperatorGroupn

item.desc: This switch is used to judge whether the PLMN group is to be proportionally admitted when the cell is congested. When the switch is off,the PLMN group is admitted according to the full bandwidth;When the switch is on,the PLMN group is admitted according to the respective ratios.
item.name: case5RatioACSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the current status of the cell is in a congested state by comparing the current PRB usage with the congestion/recover threshold every cycle.
item.name: case5CongJudPrd

item.desc: This parameter is used to judge whether the Uplink used PRB of the cell is congestion or not.
item.name: case5CongStarThrdUl

item.desc: This parameter is used to judge whether the Uplink used PRB congestion of the cell is relieve or not.
item.name: case5RecoverThrdUl

item.desc: This parameter is used to judge whether the DownLink used PRB of the cell is congestion or not.
item.name: case5CongStarThrdDl

item.desc: This parameter is used to judge whether the DownLink used PRB congestion of the cell is relieve or not.
item.name: case5RecoverThrdDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the GBR services that need to be guaranteed in network sharing scenarios. It is an array parameter consisting of four elements. The eNodeB guarantees the resource allocation for the QCI services configured by this parameter instead of allocating RB resources by PLMN. If an element is set to None, the corresponding type of service is not guaranteed.
item.name: case5GuaranteedGBR

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to send DRSs in LAA cells.
item.name: lAADRSSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables PDCCH SDMA for TMM base stations. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), PDCCH data can be involved in SDMA. In this way, for the same CCE resources, more UEs can be scheduled.
item.name: pdcchSDswch

item.desc: Measures need to be taken on a large number of pseudo UEs on the market for protection. This parameter enables or disables pseudo UE protection. If It is set to Open, the protection weight calculation process is initiated for pseudo UEs.
item.name: pseuAntSeleProtSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the support for two-in-one antenna combination, four-in-one antenna combination, and adaptive combination.
item.name: tmmAntCombTypeUl

item.desc: This parameter indicates whether non-standard bandwidth sharing is supported. If it is set to Not Support Non-standard Bandwidth, the bandwidths of the LTE system can be expanded to standard bandwidths. If it is set to Support Non-standard Bandwidth, the bandwidths of the LTE system can be expanded to non-standard bandwidths. A standard bandwidth is already defined by the protocols, and a non-standard bandwidth is generally customized for operators.
item.name: gLDBENonStdSupport

item.desc: This parameter indicates the conserved MCS quantity for RRC release during the scheduling of the RRC Release message.
item.name: dlDeltaMCS4Release

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the retransmission of the RRC Release message is optimized during polling.
item.name: relRetranOptSwitch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the switch of the priority guaranteed bit rate function for SPID-based NGBR bearers. If it is set to Open, the priority guaranteed bit rate can be configured for the NGBR bearer of an SPID user.
item.name: pGBRSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of users scheduled in each TTI when the cell load status changes from high load to medium load. The threshold is considered when the cell load status changes from high load to medium load.
item.name: mmSchUEThrHigh2Med

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of users scheduled in each TTI when the cell load status changes from medium load to high load. The threshold is considered when the cell load status changes from medium load to high load.
item.name: mmSchUEThrMed2High

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the blanked RBs can be used for the PUSCH when the MagicRadio function is enabled. When this parameter is set to Open, the blanked RBs can be used on low and high frequencies, or reused on either low or high frequencies. The difference between this parameter and the ucReusePucchBlankRbSwch parameter is as follows: When the ucReusePucchBlankRbSwch parameter is set to Open, blanked RBs cannot be used for the PUSCH until non-blanked RBs are used out. When this parameter is set to Open, blanked RBs are directly used for the PUSCH.
item.name: reuseMagicRadioSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the downlink bandwidth contraction type in MagicRadio CSS. If it is set to BothSidesReuse, the number of RBs disabled for downlink bandwidths is twice the number of RBs for downlink bandwidth contraction in CSS. If it is set to LowFreSideReuse, the number of RBs disabled for downlink bandwidths is the number of RBs for downlink bandwidth contraction in CSS for low frequency scenarios. If it is set to HighFreSideReuse, the number of RBs disabled for downlink bandwidths is the number of RBs for downlink bandwidth contraction in CSS for high frequency scenarios.
item.name: cutRbModeDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the transmission scheme that is used after the TM2 transmission mode is configured. It is used to verify performance differences among different transmission schemes in a test scenario. Non-adaptive configurations cannot be used on site.
item.name: ulTranSchemeSet

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables downlink FDD DM SDMA. By default, it is set to Open.
item.name: isFddSDMAEnable4DMDL

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables uplink FDD DM SDMA. If it is set to Open, SDMA pairing is performed among multiple UEs in the uplink. By default, it is set to Close.
item.name: isFddSDMAEnable4DMUL

item.desc: This parameter is used to select 256QAM TBS 33B. If it is set to Open, tbsIndexAlt2-r14 can be set to b33. If it is set to Close, tbsIndexAlt2-r14 is not configured.
item.name: tbs33bAltSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the optimization of DRX sleep decision. It is used to increase the threshold of force sleep of DCI 0 LOST, enhancing the calibration of the AN on the DCI 0 LOST, making the determination of the DRX Sleep status more accurate, reducing scheduling chances, and improving uplink throughput.
item.name: drxSleepJudgeOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables measurement frequency optimization. It can enhance the scheduler's capability of wireless channel tracing and increase uplink throughput by increasing the number of times to perform inner-loop measurement.
item.name: measFreqOptSwitch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the optimization of the throughput of cell-edge UEs.
item.name: edgeUeThroughOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables TMM-SRS reduction noise in the window. If it is set to Open, SRS reduction noise is executed. This parameter is used in the high-noise scenarios to increase measuring accuacy of SRS.
item.name: srsWinFilterSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables uplink antenna selection enhancement. If it is set to Open, antennas are selected based on bands and band groups. If it is set to Close, the selection of antennas are independent of bands and band groups.
item.name: enhancedTransAntSelSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables outer-loop optimization for edge UEs in AMC. It can improves the stability of the uplink BLER by adjusting the lower limit of the outer loop.
item.name: edgeUeAmcOLOptSwitch

item.desc: The Switch of forcing edge UE to multiplex AN,through multiplexing AN in PUSCH, increases schedule counts.
item.name: forceEdgeUeToMultANSwch

item.desc: If this parameter is set to Highest priority and there are back-end DRX parameters that are not configured with the bearer established by the UE, DRX is not configured for the UE based on this bearer. If this parameter is set to Lowest priority and there are back-end DRX parameters that are not configured with the bearer established by the UE, DRX is configured for the UE based on any established bearer.
item.name: withoutQCIDRXMergPrior

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables HARQ feedback mode adaption for TM9 in non-CA scenarios. If it is set to Open, the system determines whether to enable HARQ feedback mode adaption for TM9 in non-CA scenarios based on cell load and the conditions for handover to TM9. If it is set to Close, the system uses the multiplexing mode.
item.name: tM9FeedbackAdaptNonCASwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables RI scheduling optimization in TM9 mode. If it is set to Open, the new optimization algorithm is used. If it is set to Close, the original algorithm applies.
item.name: fixTM9SchSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the sub-band PMI in TM9 mode. If it is set to Open, the aperiodic CSI feedback sub-band PMI is supported in TM9 mode, increasing TM9 performance.
item.name: tM9SubBandPMISwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the expansion of uplink MM retransmission streams. If it is set to Open and both the number of RRC_connected UEs and the PUSCH PRB usage exceed the thresholds, the expansion of uplink MM retransmission streams is enabled. In this case, the number of uplink retransmission space division streams of a UE can be larger than the number of transmission space division streams of this UE but must be smaller than the upper limit of the number of uplink streams.
item.name: reTxExpandStreamSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables PHR precision enhancement for SRS. It is used to normalize the PHR of SRS and PUSCH.
item.name: enSrsPhrPrecisionSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables sub-band remapping based on NIs. If this parameter is set to Open, the filtering gain of the inner ring can be obtained, improving uplink throughput.
item.name: subMcsRectifyByNISwch

item.desc: This parameter represents the default state of cell spectrum sharing.
item.name: defaultSpecShareState

item.desc: This parameter indicates that the offset of cell closing frame when enhanced self-check symbol shutdown effect.
item.name: closeFrameOffset

item.desc: This parameter indicates that the ratio of cell closing frame when enhanced self-check symbol shutdown effect. If the ratio of RBs allocated by DL TTI is less than this threshold, then close subframe.
item.name: closeFrameRatio

item.desc: This parameter is used to distinguish user performance scene,including normal scene,high way scene, high speed scene, interfere scene, capacity scene, according to the scene, import the scene relevant parameter template.
item.name: performanceScene

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of low-frequency RBs for downlink bandwidth contraction in MagicRadio CSS.
item.name: lowFreCutRbNumDL

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of high-frequency RBs for downlink bandwidth contraction in MagicRadio CSS.
item.name: highFreCutRbNumDL

item.desc: This parameter sets the PLMN group congestion threshold in Case5 scenarios. If the downlink PRB utilization of a cell is larger than or equal to this threshold and the downlink PRB utilization of each PLMN group is larger than or equal to this threshold, the cell is determined to be congested.
item.name: case5PlmnGroupCongThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the PLMN group recovery threshold in Case5 scenarios. If the downlink PRB utilization of a cell is less than this threshold or there is a PLMN group where the PRB utilization is less than this threshold, the cell is determined to recover from congestion.
item.name: case5PlmnGroupRecoverThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times to determine the congestion state of a cell in Case5 scenarios. It is used to determine whether a cell can exit congestion state. If this parameter is set to n, a cell can exit congestion state after the system determines that the cell has not been congested consecutive n times after the cell entered congestion state.
item.name: case5CongPunishPeriod

item.desc: This parameter determines whether IMEISV UEs can use allowable frequencies. If it is set to Open, only the IMEISV UEs that are configured with the Allowable Frequency Strategy or Allow and Prohibit Frequency Strategy parameter can use the allowable frequencies in measurement and handover.
item.name: allowFreq4SpecIMEISVSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer to delay the application of DRX in an NSA scenario. In the access and handover scenarios, a larger value indicates that DRX takes effect later and the impact on the delay in SN addition is lower. If this parameter is set to 0, the DRX delay function in NSA scenarios is disabled.
item.name: configDRXTimerForNSA

item.desc: This parameter sets the atmospheric ducting adjustment policy. It indicates whether the eNodeB stops generating atmospheric interference with other eNodeBs when the eNodeB is interfered by atmospheric ducting. It determines whether the downlink subframes before special-subframe sequences send PDSCH data. If PDSCH data is not sent, the interference with the uplink symbols of the special subframes and uplink subframes of the eNodeBs that are affected by atmospheric ducting can be reduced.
item.name: AtmosSubFrameBackSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of downlink SDM streams, namely, the maximum number of SDM streams that can be provided by MM stations. If this parameter is set to 1, it indicates that SDM is not supported.
item.name: dLMMMaxSDMANum

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of uplink SDM streams, namely, the maximum number of SDM streams that can be provided by MM stations.
item.name: uLMMMaxSDMANum

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to disable the uplink PHR procedure. By default, it is set to Close. In a high-load scenario, this parameter can be set to Open to disable the adjustment of RBs and MCSs when the PHR procedure is restricted to improve uplink spectrum efficiency and traffic.
item.name: phrProcessDisablePrbSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables cooperation mode P. If it is set to Open, power can be shared between 4G and 5G cells. If it is set to Close, power cannot be shared between 4G and 5G cells.
item.name: coModePSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables cooperation mode B. If it is set to Open, bandwidth can be shared between 4G and 5G cells. If it is set to Close, bandwidth cannot be shared between 4G and 5G cells.
item.name: coModeBSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables collaboration mode I. If it is set to Open, collaborative interference is enabled between 4G and 5G cells. If it is set to Close, collaborative interference is disabled between 4G and 5G cells.
item.name: coModeISwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the adaptation of the maximum number of UEs in an SDM transmission group. If it is set to Open, the maximum number of UEs in the SDM transmission group is adaptively determined based on the BLER of the SDM transmission group.
item.name: ulMMNewTransNumAdaptSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the adaptation of the maximum number of UEs in an SDM retransmission group. If it is set to Open, the maximum number of UEs in the SDM retransmission group is adaptively determined based on the BLER of the SDM retransmission group.
item.name: ulMMRetransNumAdaptSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to configure differentiated uplink AMC parameters for the UEs with general QoS. If it is set to DiffQos, it indicates that different guarantee policies can be provided for the UEs with Type1 to Type6 general QoS. If it is set to GenQos, it indicates that a unified QoS guarantee policy can be provided for the UEs with any type of general QoS. If it is set to Close, no QoS guarantee policy is provided for UEs.
item.name: amc4GeneralQosSwchUl

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables multi-outer loop AMC for MUs. If it is set to Disabled, the original algorithm is used. If it is set to Fixed Configured, the configurations of multiple MU outer-loops are fixed. If it is set to UE Level Adaptive, the configurations of multiple MU outer-loops are determined based on the UE-level adaptation algorithm. If it is set to Cell Level Adaptive, the configurations of multiple MU outer-loops are determined based on the cell-level adaptation algorithm.
item.name: mMMultiAmcSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the power adjustment value of an LTE cell when cooperative interference is enabled between 4G and 5G cells. A smaller parameter value indicates lower adjusted power.
item.name: coModeIConfig

item.desc: This parameter sets the power adjustment value of an LTE cell when power sharing is enabled between 4G and 5G cells. A smaller parameter value indicates lower adjusted power.
item.name: coModePConfig

item.desc: This parameter sets the power adjustment value of an LTE cell when bandwidth sharing is enabled between 4G and 5G cells. A smaller parameter value indicates lower adjusted power.
item.name: coModeBConfig

item.desc: This parameter sets the mapping bitmap of multiple outer loops. The bits from low to high (from right to left) correspond to the outer loops with 2 to 16 streams respectively. The value 0 indicates that the corresponding MU streams do not maintain outer loops independently and 1 indicates that the corresponding MU streams maintain outer loops independently.
item.name: mMMuAmcBitmap

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables scheduling optimization at far points in open-loop TM9 SU-MIMO. It is valid when the Switch of TM9 OpenLoop for SU-MIMO parameter is set to Open. It does not work when the Switch of TM9 OpenLoop for SU-MIMO parameter is set to Close. If this parameter is set to RANK2 Optimization or RANK2~8 Optimization and the UEs at far points report high RIs, the scheduled RIs are modified.
item.name: tM9OpenloopOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the optimization for transmit antenna selection for UEs. If the Transmit Antenna Selection Mode parameter is set to Open, this parameter is valid. If the Transmit Antenna Selection Mode parameter is set to Close, this parameter is invalid. If this parameter is set to Open, the SVD-based scheme is used for the SU transmission weight. If this parameter is set to Close, the ZF-based scheme is used for the SU transmission weight.
item.name: tansAntenSelOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables TMM SRS confidence. A low SRS SINR affects the accuracy of SRS channel estimation and SRS-related measurement. Therefore, the SRS confidence function is introduced. If this parameter is set to Open, the confidence is determined in SRS-related measurement, that is, if the SRS SINR is low, it is not used for reference in SRS-related measurement. If this parameter is set to Close, the confidence is not determined in SRS-related measurement.
item.name: tmmSrsConfidenceSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the offset of the confidence threshold for TMM SRS detection. The configuration of the parameter value should balance the false alarm probability and the missing alarm probability. By default, the confidence threshold for TMM SRS detection is not adjusted.
item.name: tmmSrsConfidenceDelta

item.desc: Reserved Parameter 1
item.name: reservedPara1

item.desc: Reserved Parameter 2
item.name: reservedPara2

item.desc: Reserved Parameter 3
item.name: reservedPara3

item.desc: Reserved Parameter 4
item.name: reservedPara4

item.desc: Reserved Parameter 5
item.name: reservedPara5

item.desc: Reserved Parameter 6
item.name: reservedPara6

item.desc: Reserved Parameter 7
item.name: reservedPara7

item.desc: Reserved Parameter 8
item.name: reservedPara8

item.desc: Reserved Parameter 9
item.name: reservedPara9

item.desc: Reserved Parameter 10
item.name: reservedPara10

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to migrate SRS resources to uplink sub-frames in an atmospheric ducting interference scenario to prevent atmospheric ducting from affecting the SRSs on special sub-frames.
item.name: atmosphericSRSMovSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the optimization in network sharing scenarios (case 1, case 2, and case 4). If it is set to 1, the configuration of the uplink and downlink GBR and PBR services can be guaranteed. If it is set to 2, only the configuration of the downlink GBR and PBR services can be guaranteed. If it is set to Close, the configuration of GBR and PBR services cannot be guaranteed.
item.name: networkSharingOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the flags that indicate whether the PLMN groups in a network sharing scenario can use the shared resources. It is an array parameter consisting of six elements. The elements indicate whether PLMN group 1 through PLMN group 6 can use the shared resources respectively. If an element is set to 1, it indicates that the corresponding PLMN group can use the shared resources. If an element is set to 0, it indicates that the corresponding PLMN group cannot use the shared resources.
item.name: oprGrpShrAccFlag

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportions of reserved RB resources of the PLMN groups in network sharing scenarios. It is an array parameter consisting of six elements. The elements indicate the proportions of reserved RB resources of PLMN group 1 through PLMN group 6 in turn. If an element is set to 100, all the RBs configured for the corresponding PLMN group are reserved. If an element is larger than 0 and smaller than 100, the PLMN group corresponding to this element can preferentially use the remaining RB resources except the reserved RB resources. The unused RB resources can be preempted by other PLMN groups.
item.name: rBRsvRatio4OprGrp

item.desc: This parameter sets the resource preemption capability levels of the PLMN groups in a network sharing scenario. It is an array parameter consisting of six elements. The elements indicate the resource preemption capability levels of PLMN group 1 through PLMN group 6 in turn. A PLMN group can preempt the resources of a PLMN group whose resource preemption capability level is lower than or equal to that of this PLMN group.
item.name: oprGrpRBGrabLvl

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion of the bandwidth resources that can be shared by multiple PLMN groups in a network sharing scenario. A higher proportion indicates more RB resources that can be used.
item.name: rBShareRatio4OprGrp

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the migration of the uplink poor-quality data UEs that are in the cells with atmospheric ducting interference to the cells without atmospheric ducting interference. If it is set to Open, the uplink poor-quality data UEs that are in the cells with atmospheric ducting interference can be migrated to the cells without atmospheric ducting interference. If it is set to Close, the uplink poor-quality data UEs that are in the cells with atmospheric ducting interference cannot be migrated to the cells without atmospheric ducting interference.
item.name: atmosWorseDataMigSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink SINR sampling period for evaluating the channel quality of data UEs when the migration of the poor-quality data UEs that are in the cells with atmospheric ducting interference is enabled.
item.name: atmosDataQualSampPriod

item.desc: If the uplink SINR values that are sampled consecutive N times for a data UE are unsatisfactory, the UE is marked as a poor-quality UE. This parameter sets the value of N.
item.name: atmosDataQualDetectTimes

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink SINR threshold for poor-quality data UEs. If the uplink SINR of a data UE is lower than or equal to this threshold within a period of time, the UE is considered to be an uplink poor-quality UE.
item.name: atmosDataULWorseSINRTrd

item.desc: During the migration of the poor-quality data UEs that are in the cells with atmospheric ducting interference, measurement configurations need to be delivered. If the uplink channel quality of an UE is too poor, a reconfiguration completion message may fail to be sent, causing UE re-establishment. This parameter sets the threshold for filtering the UEs whose uplink channel quality is too bad. With the configuration of this parameter, this problem can be avoided.
item.name: atmosDataULSINRProtectTrd

item.desc: If the migration of the poor-quality data UEs that are in the cells with atmospheric ducting interference is enabled, UEs are not handed over to a neighbor cell if the uplink PRB usage of the neighbor cell is higher than or equal to this threshold.
item.name: ulPRBTrd4AtmosDataMig

item.desc: If the migration of the poor-quality data UEs that are in the cells with atmospheric ducting interference is enabled, UEs are not handed over to a neighbor cell if the downlink PRB usage of the neighbor cell is higher than or equal to this threshold.
item.name: dlPRBTrd4AtmosDataMig

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to migrate SRS resources to U subframes in a TMM scenario to prevent atmospheric ducting from affecting the SRS resources in S subframes. If this parameter is set to Close, SRS resources can only be allocated in S subframes instead of being migrated. If this parameter is set to Open, SRS resources are unconditionally migrated to U subframes during resource allocation. If this parameter is set to Adaptive, the system determines the interference with S subframes and U subframes and adaptively configures SRS resources in U or S subframes.
item.name: sRSMovSwch4TMM

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables TM8 SU stream building weight optimization in a TMM scenario to improve the performance of TM8 SU stream building. If it is set to ZF None Constant Modulus, the weight value for TM8 stream building is calculated by using the ZF non-constant modulus method. If it is set DOA Constant Modulus, the weight value for TM8 stream building is optimized by using the DOA constant modulus method. If it is set to ZF Constant Modulus, the weight value for TM8 stream building is calculated by using the ZF constant modulus method.
item.name: tM8SuWCalcSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval (in minutes) during which SRS resources are not migrated from U subframes to S subframes in a TMM scenario based on the NI value for adaptive SRS migration between S and U subframes after the SRS resources are migrated from S subframes to U subframes. It also indicates the interval during which SRS resources are not migrated from S subframes to U subframes in a TMM scenario after the SRS resources are migrated from U subframes to S subframes.
item.name: sRSMovIntervalThr4TMM

item.desc: This parameter is used to migrate SRS resources to U subframes in a TMM scenario. When the SRS resources are adaptively migrated based on the NI values of S and U subframes, the first value of this parameter (in dB) indicates the threshold for the positive difference between the NI value of S subframes and that of U subframes. If the positive difference between the NI value of S subframes and that of U subframes exceeds this parameter value, the SRS resources are migrated to U subframes. The second value of this parameter indicates the threshold for the positive difference between the NI value of U subframes and that of S subframes. If the positive difference between the NI value of U subframes and that of S subframes exceeds this parameter value, the SRS resources are migrated to S subframes.
item.name: sRSMovNiThr4TMM

item.desc: This parameter sets the ratio threshold for paging storm beginning. If paging storm-based paging capacity optimization is enabled in a cell and the result of the following formula within a period is larger than this threshold, it is considered that a paging storm occurs: Number of paging messages received on the S1 interface by cells/Number of paging messages configured on the UME for cells.
item.name: ratioThr4PagingStorm

item.desc: This parameter sets the ratio threshold for paging storm end. If paging storm-based paging capacity optimization is enabled in a cell and the results of the following formula within multiple periods are smaller than this threshold, it is considered that a paging storm ends: Number of paging messages received on the S1 interface by cells/Number of paging messages configured on the UME for cells.
item.name: ratioThr4PagingStormEnd

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to divide uplink RBs proportionally in network sharing scenarios. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), uplink RBs are proportionally divided. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), uplink RBs use all the bandwidth resources and cannot be divided proportionally.
item.name: netShareULRBRatioSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether SIB19+ information is delivered through enhanced SI scheduling in a cell. If it is set to Open, it indicates that enhanced SI scheduling is used to schedule SIB19+ information by using the SystemInformationBlockType1-v12j0-IEs field. If it is set to Close, it indicates that enhanced SI scheduling is not used. In this case, SIB19+ information is scheduled by using the SchedulingInfoList field.
item.name: enhancedSiSchedulingSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the blind redirection strategy of an NR system. For the NR system frequencies configured with neighbor cells, if this parameter is set to Strict Strategy, blind redirection can be triggered only when no neighbor cell is restricted by the HRL; if this parameter is set to Easing Strategy, blind redirection can be triggered as long as there is a neighbor cell that is not restricted by the HRL.
item.name: nRRatBlindRedStgy

item.desc: This parameter sets the altitude of the cell.
item.name: altitude

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the NSA adaptation of DSS frequency bands. In an NSA scenario, if UEs trigger SN addition for the frequency bands that do not support DSS, the throughput in the DSS cells is affected. If this parameter is set to Open, UEs are not allowed to trigger SN addition for the frequency bands that do not support DSS, thus improving the performance of the DSS cells.
item.name: dssBandAdaptNSASwch

item.desc: This array parameter enables or disables NR capability parsing for UEs. Each element in the array determines whether to parse the corresponding NR capability of UEs, 0 (Close) for not parsing and 1 (Open) for parsing. The first element indicates that the bandwidth capability of UEs is parsed and the second through eighth elements are reserved.
item.name: analysisNrCapSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables BLER optimization for the UEs with a high blocking rate. It determines whether to improve the BLER of the UEs with a high blocking rate at far points. If it is set to Open, the BLER of the UEs with a high blocking rate at far points can be improved.
item.name: blockUserBlerAdaptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the upper limit for identifying the UEs with a high blocking rate. If the ratio of the total number of BSRs of a UE to the number of scheduled BSRs is higher than this threshold, the UE is identified as the one with a high blocking rate.
item.name: blockHighThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the lower limit for identifying the UEs with a low blocking rate. If the ratio of the total number of BSRs of a UE to the number of scheduled BSRs is lower than this threshold, the UE is identified as the one with a low blocking rate.
item.name: blockLowThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the filter factor of the blocking rate. It is used to adjust the weight of the historical blocking rates in blocking rate-based filter. If it is set to a larger value, it indicates that more consideration is given to the current blocking rate during blocking rate-based filter. If the parameter is set to a smaller value, it indicates that more consideration is given to historical blocking rates during blocking rate-based filter.
item.name: blockFilterCoef

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables ECGI PLMN replacement in dedicated-carrier network sharing scenarios. If it is set to Open, the PLMN in the ECGI IE carried by a UE-level S1 message is set to the PLMN configured for the current serving cell. If it is set to Close, the PLMN in the ECGI IE carried by a UE-level S1 message is set to the current eNodeB-level PLMN.
item.name: s1EcgiPlmnConvertSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the uplink PRB usage for aggregation mode selection. If the Switch of Aggregation Mode Selection parameter is set to Open and the uplink PRB usage of a cell is higher than or equal to this threshold, the cell cannot act as the serving cell of UEs.
item.name: aggModeUlPrbRatioThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the downlink PRB usage for aggregation mode selection. If the Switch of Aggregation Mode Selection parameter is set to Open and the downlink PRB usage of a cell is higher than or equal to this threshold, the cell cannot act as the serving cell of UEs.
item.name: aggModeDlPrbRatioThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold proportion of the number of UEs for aggregation mode selection. If the Switch of Aggregation Mode Selection parameter is set to Open and the proportion of the number of UEs in a cell is higher than or equal to this threshold, the cell cannot act as the serving cell of UEs.
item.name: aggModeUserRatioThrd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables aggregation mode selection for UEs. If it is set to Open, aggregation mode selection is enabled for high-rate UEs. In this case, the multi-carrier aggregation mode with the highest aggregate bandwidth can be selected for the UEs. If it is set to Close, aggregation mode selection is disabled.
item.name: aggreModeSelectSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the energy saving state of a cell. It is an array consisting of six elements that indicate whether the corresponding energy saving functions of the cell take effect separately. The six elements represent the following six energy saving states in turn: symbol shutdown, channel shutdown, carrier shutdown, AAU deep-sleep, intelligent power-on/power-off, and BBU deep-sleep. If the value of an element is not set to 0 (Non energy saving), it indicates that the corresponding energy saving function is valid.
item.name: cellEsState

item.desc: PLMN User Label List
item.name: plmnUserLabel

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute SRS/PUSCH signal threshold for determining whether a UE belongs to the local pico RRU or RRU. A UE can be determined to belong to the local pico RRU or RRU only when the SRS/PUSCH signal strength of the UE is larger than this parameter value, and larger than the difference between the maximum signal strength of the UE and the value of the ucUeRelativeSignalThr (Relative Threshold for UEs to Activate an RFU) parameter. If the indicatorRptSwitch (RF Unit Index Report Switch) parameter is set to 1, the eNodeB determines whether the UE belongs to the pico RRU, and counts and reports the number of UEs belonging to the pico RRU. If the indicatorRptSwitch (RF Unit Index Report Switch) parameter is set to 2, the eNodeB determines whether the UE belongs to the RRU, and counts and reports the number of UEs belonging to the RRU.
item.name: ueAbsoluteSignalThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the relative SRS/PUSCH signal threshold for determining whether a UE belongs to the local RRU or pico RRU. A UE can be determined to belong to the local RRU or pico RRU only when the SRS/PUSCH signal strength of the UE is larger than the difference between the maximum signal strength of the UE and this parameter value, and larger than the value of the wUeAbsoluteSignalThr (Absolute Threshold for UEs to Activate an RFU) parameter. If the indicatorRptSwitch (RF Unit Index Report Switch) parameter is set to 1, the eNodeB determines whether the UE belongs to the pico RRU, and counts and reports the number of UEs belonging to the pico RRU. If the indicatorRptSwitch (RF Unit Index Report Switch) parameter is set to 2, the eNodeB determines whether the UE belongs to the RRU, and counts and reports the number of UEs belonging to the RRU.
item.name: ueRelativeSignalThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of bits in the multiplexed UCI after uplink accurate MCS authorization is enabled. It is used to determine whether a Qm can be reduced when UCI is multiplexed by the PUSCH. If this parameter is set to a value from 0 to 254 and the number of bits in the UCI multiplexed by the PUSCH is larger than this threshold, Qm reduction is not allowed in accurate MCS authorization to prevent the bit rate from exceeding the limit after Qm reduction. If this parameter is set to 255, Qm reduction is allowed in accurate MCS authorization when UCI is multiplexed by the PUSCH.
item.name: ulUciBitNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the BSR redundancy value for uplink accurate MCS authorization. It is valid when uplink accurate MCS authorization is enabled (the accMCSEnableSwchUl parameter is set to Open). The BSR redundancy value is used to cover the extra overhead introduced by packet assembly to avoid delay increase due to packet segmentation.
item.name: ulDecPaddingRedundant

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink accurate MCS authorization mode. It is used to control the Qm reduction of uplink MCSs to reduce the BLERs and the number of padding bits. A specific value indicates an allowed MCS adjustment type in the reduction of the number of padding bits.
item.name: ulDecPaddingMode

item.desc: This parameter sets the Qm reduction limit for downlink accurate MCS authorization. It is an array parameter consisting of three elements. The array elements represent the lower limits of Qm reduction corresponding to 16QAM, 64QAM, and 256QAM separately. If an array element is set to 2, it indicates that the lower limit of Qm reduction for the corresponding MCS is QPSK. If an array element is set to 4, it indicates that the lower limit of Qm reduction for the corresponding MCS is 16QAM. If an array element is set to 6, it indicates that the lower limit of Qm reduction for the corresponding MCS is 64QAM. If an array element is set to 8, it indicates that the lower limit of Qm reduction for the corresponding MCS is 256QAM.
item.name: dlExactMcsQmLimit

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to report RFU indicators. It is used to control whether to count and report the number of bytes and the number of UEs on the MAC layer of a pico RRU or RRU/RRU channel. If it is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB does not count or report the number of bytes or the number of UEs on the MAC layer of an RFU. If it is set to 1 (pRRUStatisOpen), the eNodeB counts the number of bytes and the number of UEs on the MAC layer of a pico RRU, and reports the statistics to the UME. If it is set to 2 (RRUStatisOpen), the eNodeB counts the number of bytes and the number of UEs on the MAC layer of an RRU, and reports the statistics to the UME. If it is set to 3 (RRUChnlStatisOpen), the eNodeB counts the number of bytes and the number of UEs on the MAC layer of an RRU channel, and reports the statistics to the UME.
item.name: indicatorRptSwitch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables uplink pre-scheduling based on DTX. If there is no uplink scheduling for UEs, downlink ACK/NACK feedback is transmitted through the PUCCH. If the PUCCH is subject to interference, DTX occurs frequently. If this parameter is set to Open to All Users or Open to General QoS Users, downlink ACK/NACK feedback is transmitted through the PUSCH, reducing DTX.
item.name: highDtxPreSchdSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of candidate UEs for downlink scheduling. RB resources may be fragmented during downlink scheduling. If these fragmented RB resources are not used, the resources are wasted. This parameter sets the number of candidate UEs for resource scheduling to avoid the waste of fragmented RB resources. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the fragmented RB resources are used so that the downlink PRB usage of a cell can be improved.
item.name: dlSchdCandUeNum

item.desc: This parameter sets what modes are available for aggregation mode selection. It is an array parameter consisting of eight elements. The first to third elements respectively indicate the following modes: LET CA mode, EN-DC mode, and single-carrier LTE mode. The remaining elements are reserved. If an element is set to 1 (Yes), the corresponding mode is an available option for aggregation mode selection. If an element is set to 0 (No), the corresponding mode is not an available option for aggregation mode selection.
item.name: aggreModeSelectModeInd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables restricted space division in network sharing scenarios. In a network sharing scenario, if this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the UEs that belong to different operators can be allocated to the same space-division cell group. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the UEs that belong to different operators and preempt resources cannot be allocated to the same space-division cell group.
item.name: netShareLimitMuSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets a policy for determining the home space-division cell groups of RBs. It is used to specify the data collection method for home space-division cell groups of RBs in network sharing scenarios. If this parameter is set to 0 (RB home primary user policy), statistics are collected in accordance with the policy that RBs belong to the space-division cell group of the primary UE in an MU-MIMO scenario. If this parameter is set to 1 (RB conversion policy), statistics on home space-division cell group of RBs are collected in accordance with an RB conversion policy, improving the data collection accuracy of RB resources of operators.
item.name: lteMuRbBelongPolicy

item.desc: This parameter sets the initial delta MCS index of MU-MIMO UEs in TMM scenarios. It is used to adjust the initial value of downlink outer-loop AMC for MU-MIMO UEs in TMM scenarios.
item.name: tMMMUDeltaMcsInit

item.desc: This parameter sets the initial delta MCS index of MU-MIMO UEs with general QoS type of services in TMM scenarios. It is used to adjust the initial value of downlink outer-loop AMC for MU-MIMO UEs with general QoS type of services in TMM scenarios.
item.name: tMMMUDeltaMcsInit4QoS

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of six elements. It is used to set the proportions of uplink bandwidth resources allocated to PLMNs in network sharing scenarios. The elements in the array parameter set the proportions of the uplink bandwidth resources allocated to PLMN 1 through PLMN 6 configured for a cell in turn.
item.name: ulOperatorRatio

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion of uplink bandwidth resources shared by PLMNs. The uplink bandwidth resources allocated in the proportion specified by this parameter can be shared by multiple PLMNs.
item.name: ulSharedRatio

item.desc: This parameter sets the SPIDs of the UEs for which aggregation mode selection is disabled. A maximum of 16 SPIDs can be configured. If the actual SPID of a UE is in the list specified by this parameter, the aggregation mode selection function is disabled for the UE. The value 0 indicates an invalid value.
item.name: aggModeForbidSpidList

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportions of available downlink PRB resources for different types of UEs in perception estimation. It is an array parameter consisting of eight elements. Element 0 sets the downlink PRB proportion used for downlink perception estimation of UEs without a type. Elements 1 through 7 set the downlink PRB proportions used for downlink perception estimation of UEs of type 1 through type 7. During the estimation of the downlink perception of a UE, the number of available PRBs of the UE in the estimated cell is the product of the total number of PRBs of the estimated cell and this parameter value.
item.name: percEstiBWFct

item.desc: This parameter sets the fitting coefficients of the downlink SE. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. Element 0 sets the RSRP fitting coefficient and element 1 sets the fitting constant. The estimated downlink fitting SE of a UE is calculated as follows: RSRP fitting coefficient x Measured RSRP value x Fitting constant.
item.name: dlSEFitCoeff

item.desc: Full Distinguished Name
item.name: FDN

item.desc: Date Time
item.name: DATETIME

item.desc: Collection period of measurement task.
item.name: granularityPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: id

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: moId

item.desc: Measurement Config Group ID
item.name: refCellMeasGroupLTE

item.desc: The parameter indicates whether or not configurating measurement for inter and RAT frequencies simultaneously. Number0 represents that eNB shall configurate measurement for inter and RAT frequencies simultaneously,while Number1 does mean that eNB shall configurate measurement for inter frequencies firstly ,then RAT frequencies next.
item.name: interFandInterR

item.desc: The parameter indicates UE whether or not performing both RSRP and RSRQ measurements.
item.name: dualMeasSwitch

item.desc: The parameter indicates whether starting periodical measurement of intra frequency or not. 0 represents close,1 represents open.
item.name: intraFPeriodMeasSwitch

item.desc: switch for inter-frequency periodical measurement
item.name: interFPeriodMeasSwitch

item.desc: switch for inter-RAT periodical measurement of GERAN
item.name: interRatGsmPeriodMeasSwitch

item.desc: switch for inter-RAT periodical measurement of UTRAN
item.name: interRatUtranPeriodMeasSwitch

item.desc: This parameter is used to configure the GERAN CCO network control command.
item.name: netWorkControlOrder

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable the function of ping-pong handover suppression. If the switch is turned on in cell B, when a UE performs handover from cell A to cell B, the ping-pong handover suppression timer is started in cell B, and the UE is prohibited from performing handover to cell A before the timer expires. When UEs are located on cell edges, it is recommended that the switch is turned on.
item.name: pingPongHoSwitch

item.desc: The prameter indicates how many cells from which UE could choose one for performing handover.
item.name: hoCandCelNum

item.desc: The parameter indicates the maximum cell number for attempt handover of load balance, there will be a attempt handover within the maximum cell number limitation when the criteria of load balance is meet.
item.name: lbMaxHOCell

item.desc: This parameter indicates the threshold of handover camping duration in KPI statistics.
item.name: timeOfShortHO

item.desc: The parameter is used to provide the information related to MBSFN and TDD UL/DL configuration of neighbour cells.00: Not all neighbour cells have the same MBSFN subframe allocation as the serving cell on this frequency, if configured, and as the PCell otherwise10: The MBSFN subframe allocations of all neighbour cells are identical to or subsets of that in the serving cell on this frequency, if configured, and of that in the PCell otherwise01: No MBSFN subframes are present in all neighbour cells11: Different UL/DL allocation in neighboring cells for TDD compared to the serving cell on this frequency, if configured, and compared to the PCell otherwiseFor TDD, 00, 10 and 01 are only used for same UL/DL allocation in neighboring cells compared to the serving cell on this frequency, if configured, and compared to the PCell otherwise.
item.name: neighCellConfig

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to perform CSFB measurement. If this parameter is set to No, no CSFB measurement is performed. If this parameter is set to Yes, CSFB measurement is performed. If this parameter is set to Adaptive, no CSFB measurement is performed for users in the center of the cell, and CSFB measurement is performed for users on the edge of the cell.
item.name: csfbMeasure

item.desc: This parameter indicates the prefer method of CS fallback to UTRAN.The default Prority configuration is that PS HO greater than Redirection.When the Lower priority Cofiguration is set on OMC,Higher priority will not be considerated.
item.name: csfbMethdofUMTS

item.desc: This parameter indicates the prefer method of CS fallback to GERAN.The default Prority configuration is that PS HO greater than Redirection.When the Lower priority Cofiguration is set on OMC,Higher priority will not be considerated.
item.name: csfbMethodofGSM

item.desc: This parameter indicates the prefer method of CS fallback to CDMA2000 1xRTT.The default Prority configuration is that enhanced 1xCSFB with PS HO to HRPD greater than enhanced 1xCSFB with redirection to HRPD greater than enhanced 1xCSFB greater than 1xCSFB.When the Lower priority Cofiguration is set on OMC,The Higher priority will not be considerated.
item.name: csfbMethdofCDMA

item.desc: This parameter is used to configure the time delay for the GAP activation/GAP deactivation.When the time delay expired,there will be a GAP GAP activation/GAP deactivation operation.
item.name: gapDelay

item.desc: This parameter indicates offset between server cell and neighboring cell.
item.name: ocs

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute threshold for intra-frequency/inter-frequency/inter-RAT measurement decision. If the RSRP value of the serving cell is lower than this threshold after layer-3 filtering, the UE triggers intra-frequency/inter-frequency/inter-RAT measurement.
item.name: measureThresh

item.desc: The parameter is RSRP layer-3 filtering coefficient in measurement used to smooth the measure value.The calculation is:Fn=(1-a)*Fm+a*Mn.whereMn is the latest received measurement result from the physical layer;Fn is the updated filtered measurement result, that is used for evaluation of reporting criteria or for measurement reporting;Fm is the old filtered measurement result, where F0 is set to M1 when the first measurement result from the physical layer is received; anda = 1/2(k/4), where k is the filterCoefficent for the corresponding measurement quantity received by the quantityConfig.
item.name: filterCoeffRsrp

item.desc: The parameter is RSRQ layer-3 filtering coefficient in measurement used to smooth the measure value.The calculation is:Fn=(1-a)*Fm+a*Mn.whereMn is the latest received measurement result from the physical layer;Fn is the updated filtered measurement result, that is used for evaluation of reporting criteria or for measurement reporting;Fm is the old filtered measurement result, where F0 is set to M1 when the first measurement result from the physical layer is received; anda = 1/2(k/4), where k is the filterCoefficent for the corresponding measurement quantity received by the quantityConfig.
item.name: filterCoeffRsrq

item.desc: The parameter is maximum intra-frequency measurement bandwidth.It is configured to UE when no intra-frequency neighbour cell is configured.
item.name: intraFMeasBW

item.desc: This array indicates priority of intra frequency.
item.name: lbIntraFreqPriority

item.desc: The parameter is inter-frequency number of neighbour cells.
item.name: interFreqNum

item.desc: The parameters indicate the numbers of GERAN Frequency Group.The GERAN carrier frequencies are organized in groups and the cell reselection parameters are provided per group of GERAN carrier frequencies.
item.name: geranCarriFreqNum

item.desc: The parameter is layer-3 filtering coefficient in GERAN measurement used to smooth the measure value.The calculation is:Fn=(1-a)*Fm+a*Mn.whereMn is the latest received measurement result from the physical layer;Fn is the updated filtered measurement result, that is used for evaluation of reporting criteria or for measurement reporting;Fm is the old filtered measurement result, where F0 is set to M1 when the first measurement result from the physical layer is received; anda = 1/2(k/4), where k is the filterCoefficent for the corresponding measurement quantity received by the quantityConfig.
item.name: filterCoeffGera

item.desc: This parameter is used to present the UTRAN frequency number.
item.name: utranCarriFreqNum

item.desc: The parameter indicates what kind of measurement results UE should report based on the measurement quantity cpich_RSCP or cpich_EcNo. 0 represents cpich_RSCP,while 1 represents cpich_EcNo.
item.name: quantityFddUtra

item.desc: The FilterCoefficient of RSCP is UcFilterCoeffUtra[0];The FilterCoefficient of EC/No is UcFilterCoeffUtra[1];Utran-Tdd can only use UcFilterCoeffUtra[0].
item.name: filCoeUtran

item.desc: This parameter is used to configure the CDMA frequcney number.
item.name: cdmaCarriFreqNum

item.desc: If cSFBbaseLAI equal to 1, then PLMN indicated in Register ALI will priority to other candidate PLMNs; If cSFBbaseLAI equal to 0, then PLMN indicated in Register ALI will not priority to other candidate PLMNs;
item.name: cSFBbaseLAI

item.desc: If multiPLMNLocStCSFB equal to 0,then Multi-PLMN local strategy for CSFB will not be effective; If multiPLMNLocStCSFB equal to 1,then Multi-PLMN local strategy for CSFB will be effective; And, the operator can config different local strategy of CSFB for different PLMN.
item.name: multiPLMNLocStCSFB

item.desc: This parameter is used to indicate whether the measurement of handover to small cell is configured to UE. IfmacroSmallIntraFreqMeasSwch equal to 1, then measurement of handover to small cell will apply to UE, otherwise, not apply.
item.name: macroSmallIntraFreqMeasSwch

item.desc: Only UE has stayed in small cell for enough time, then eNB may permit UE to handover to Small-cell, the average time UE stay in Small-cell must be longer than minStayTimeInSC
item.name: minStayTimeInSC

item.desc: The parameter is used to prevent ping-pong handover from macro cell to small cell. When a UE handover from small cell A to macro cell B , next handover from cell B to cell A, then handover from cell A to cell B, and the time which UE have stayed in small cell A and cell B shorter than wHenetPingPongThrd, UE is not allowed to handover back to the cell A.
item.name: pingPongThres4Macro2Small

item.desc: If handover between Macro and Small cell is applied, then ,UE can only stay in Macro cell. And if has stayed in Macro cell for enough time that longer than macrotSmallForbidTime, then UE can start handover between Macro and Small cell.
item.name: macrotSmallForbidTime

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables VoLTE service admission control in service-based handover. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB allows to admit the QCI1 and QCI2 services carried in the messages other than the initial context setup message. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB forbids admitting the QCI1 and QCI2 services carried in the messages other than the initial context setup message.
item.name: voiceAdmtSwch

item.desc: The switch of Intra-RAT Handover based on load. When this switch is turned on, eNodeb will consider load as a factor when select the target cell., otherwise will not.
item.name: intraRATHObasedLoadSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the handover target cell load threshold. if the target cell load is less than the threshold, then that target cell load is not too high, and then eNodeb will choose the best signal quality cell as target cell; if the target cell load exceeds the threshold, then eNodeb will choose the lowest load cell as target cell.
item.name: hoTarCellPRBThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute RSRQ threshold for target neighbor cells about the coverage-based A3, A4, or A5 event reporting by data users when periodical event-based reporting is started. In handover decision, the RSRQ value of the target neighbor cell is compared with the parameter value to determine whether handover should be implemented.
item.name: tarNeighCellRsrqThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute RSRQ threshold for the serving cell about the measurement event reporting when periodical event-based reporting is started. In handover decision, the RSRQ value of the serving cell is compared with the parameter value to determine whether handover should be implemented.
item.name: servCellRsrqThr

item.desc: This parameter indicates the trigger quantity of target cell order for handover based on the last event report, when it starts the periodic report based on event.
item.name: trigQuaofTarCellOrder

item.desc: The Operation Method of LTE to GERAN
item.name: methodLTEtoGSM

item.desc: The Operation Method of LTE to UTRAN
item.name: methodLTEtoUTRAN

item.desc: If multiPLMNLocSt4PSSwch equal to 0,then Multi-PLMN local strategy for PS will not be effective; If multiPLMNLocSt4PSSwch equal to 1,then Multi-PLMN local strategy for PS will be effective; And, the operator can config different local strategy of PS for different PLMN.
item.name: multiPLMNLocSt4PSSwch

item.desc: If multiPLMNLocSt4RdSwch equal to 0,then Multi-PLMN local strategy for Redirection will not be effective; If multiPLMNLocSt4RdSwch equal to 1,then Multi-PLMN local strategy for Redirection will be effective; And,the operator can config different local strategy of Redirection for different PLMN.
item.name: multiPLMNLocSt4RdSwch

item.desc: If multiPLMNLocSt4ReestabSwch equal to 0,then Multi-PLMN local strategy for RRC connection re-establishment will not be effective; If multiPLMNLocSt4ReestabSwch equal to 1,then Multi-PLMN local strategy for RRC connection re-establishment will be effective; And,the operator can config different local strategy of RRC connection re-establishment for different PLMN.
item.name: multiPLMNLocSt4ReestabSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates whether the eNodeB enable the UE type Judgement,bit 0 indicates ICIC,bit 1 indicate DLCOMP,bit2 indicates ULCOMP;
item.name: uePosiMeasSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables VoLTE quality-based SRVCC. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB monitors the VoLTE service quality of UEs. If the VoLTE service quality is poor, the VoLTE quality-based SRVCC procedure is triggered. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the VoLTE quality-based SRVCC procedure is not triggered.
item.name: srvccBasedVoLTEQualitySwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates whether measurement for handover based voice quality. When it is Yes, eNodeb will send the measure configure, and trigger handover based on the measure result; When it is No, eNodeb will trigger handover based on blind method.
item.name: meas4HOBasedVoLTEQual

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of inter-frequency handover based volte quality.
item.name: interFHOBasedVoLTEQualSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the redirection to 2G/3G/4G systems can be triggered for the UEs with QCI1 services. If it is set to 0 (Close), the redirection to 2G/3G/4G systems cannot be triggered for the UEs with QCI1 services. If it is set to 1 (Open), the redirection to 2G/3G/4G systems can be triggered for the UEs with QCI1 services.
item.name: qci1RedSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the multi-PLMN scene of serving cell and neighbor cell. It can be set according to the actal scene.
item.name: sceneOfRanShare

item.desc: The parameters corresponding to the blind redirect A2 strategy, the value of 0 indicates that blind redirect A2 will be issued in the initial measurement;Value of 1 indicates that blind redirect A2 will be open by Inter-Freq A2 or Inter-RAT A2.
item.name: blindA2Strategy

item.desc: The parameter is the switch of public/private Network handover Based on UE Speed.
item.name: hoBasedSpeedSwch

item.desc: This parameter is used to indicate the mediumspeed user belongs to the High-way users or normal users
item.name: mediumSpeedUserInd

item.desc: List of E-UTRAN frequencies not supported by R8 and R9 UE. In the Operating network, there may be some E-UTRAN frequencies not supported by R8 and R9 UE. The Operator could list out the frequencies by this parameter for the R8 and R9 UE, to avoid measurement, handover, and so on.
item.name: r8r9UnsuptEutraFreqs

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the handover of the UEs with uplink large-BSR services. If it is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB periodically collects statistics on the uplink BSR services of UEs. In the uplink BSRs received by a UE, if the percentage that the BSR values are larger than the bSRThr (Big Service BSR Threshold) parameter is higher than the value of the bsrStfHighThrPct (Percentage of UL Big-Service BSRs Meeting the Threshold) parameter, the UE is identified as that with uplink large-BSR services. The eNodeB hands over the UEs that have uplink large-BSR services to the cell on the target frequency.
item.name: handOverBasedULSRVSwch

item.desc: This parameter is Ran-Sharing policy configuration of CSFB and blind redirection.When values for 0, eNodeb will choose the highest priority of frequency in the highest priority RAT as the target frequency of CSFB and Blind Redirection;When the value is 1, eNodeb will identify single PLMN and multiple PLMN process, when single PLMN directly choose frequency according to the configuration of the RAT priority and frequency priority when CSFB and blind redirection, and when multiple PLMN eNodeb will order the frequencies according PLMN priority, and then order according the configuration of the RAT priority and frequency priority.If and only if the service cell and target cell have the same PLMN and only one PLMN then be considered as single PLMN scence.
item.name: csfbBldRedRanSharePlcy

item.desc: The parameter represents the measurement performance requirements scaling factor for the UE in RRC_CONNECTED state.For UE which support increased carrier monitoring E-UTRA or increased carrier monitoring UTRA, the measurement performance for different carriers may be configured by eNB to be either normal or reduced performance. eNB could scale the measurement performance requirements by the parameter when the UE be configured at least one reduced performance frequency of E-UTRAN or UTRA. If set the parameter 'Disable', the UE indicating support for increased carrier monitoring is not required to monitor more carreiers, and is only required to monitor at least the number of carriers same to the UE unsupport increased carrier monitoring. If set the parameter 'Config1' or 'Config2', the UE which support increased carrier monitoring shall monitor more carriers according to the definition of TS36.133, and the measurement performance shall satisfy the requirements scaled by the parameter.The detail please refer to the TS36.133(V12.6.0).
item.name: measScaleFactor

item.desc: whether handover based measurement when Primary carrier frequency priority is lower than inter-frequency
item.name: caPcellMeasure

item.desc: The parameter indicates the PerQCI measure GroupID response to intra-frequency.
item.name: perQCIIntraFreqMeaGrpCfg

item.desc: This parameter sets the PerQCI measurement configuration group ID used in the handover of a UE from the serving cell to an inter-RAT cell. If the wCDMAFHOMeasCfgSwch (Switch for Frequency-Level Measurement Configuration for Handover to WCDMA) parameter is set to 1 (Open), this parameter sets the measurement configuration of the handover from the serving cell to an SCDMA or SCDMA cell based on QCIs. If the wCDMAFHOMeasCfgSwch (Switch for Frequency-Level Measurement Configuration for Handover to WCDMA) parameter is set to 0 (Close), this parameter sets the measurement configuration of the handover from the serving cell to a TD-SCDMA, WCDMA, or CDMA cell based on QCIs. It is used to determine the measurement configuration for inter-RAT handover by matching the measurement group ID specified by the perQCIMeaGroupId (PerQCI Measurement Group ID) parameter.
item.name: perQCIInterRATMeaGrpCfg
