item.name: eutranFreqMeaCfgIndex

item.desc: The parameter is allowed measurement bandwidth for each frequency.It is configed to the max bandwidth of all neighbour cells each frequency.
item.name: interFMeasBW

item.desc: This parameter sets the band indicator of the downlink carrier frequencies of intra-RAT inter-frequency neighbor cells.
item.name: freqBandInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the frequencies of intra-RAT inter-frequency neighbor cells. If the frequency of an inter-frequency neighbor cell is deleted, the coverage-based inter-frequency measurement configuration for handover also needs to be modified.
item.name: interCarriFreq

item.desc: The parameter is frequency offset,used to define the priority of handover to specific frequency.
item.name: offsetFreq

item.desc: This array indicates the priority of candidate frequencies for Redirection target. eNB selects the target frequency based on this information. The value range of each integer array member is from 0 to 255. A higher value indicates a higher priority. The default value 0 means the corresponding frequency can not be selected as redirection target frequency.
item.name: eutranFreqRdPriority

item.desc: This parameter sets an inter-frequency priority in load balancing. A larger parameter value indicates that the inter-frequency priority is higher and UEs are more likely to be migrated to the frequency. If this parameter is set to 0, the corresponding frequency is not the target for load balancing.
item.name: lbInterFreqPriority

item.desc: This parameter sets the Ofn value of inter-frequency measurement event A4 for load balancing. If a measurement event A4 is delivered for load balancing, set this parameter to the inter-frequency measurement offset.
item.name: lbInterFreqOfn

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables automatic addition and optimization of inter-frequency neighbor cells through the ANR function. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), inter-frequency neighbor cells can be added and optimized automatically by the ANR function. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), inter-frequency neighbor cells cannot be added or optimized automatically by the ANR function.
item.name: interFreqANRInd

item.desc: The switch for inter frequency ANR, when the value of the parameter is Yes, the neighbor cell in this frequency can be removed by ANR function; else it cannot be.
item.name: interFreqANRDelInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the cell type that the frequency supports.
item.name: interFreqSupCellType

item.desc: This parameter sets the capability priorities based on which different frequencies support the VoIP services. It is an array parameter consisting of 16 elements. The elements indicate the capability priorities based on which the frequencies specified by the interCarriFreq (Inter-frequency Carrier) array parameter support the VoIP services. When the eNodeB delivers service-based inter-frequency handover measurement indications, the measurement IDs of the corresponding frequencies are sorted based on the element values of this array parameter. A larger element value indicates a higher priority of the frequency corresponding to the measurement ID. If an element is set to 0, it indicates that the corresponding frequency does not support the VoIP services, that is, the frequency is not selected when the eNodeB delivers a service-based inter-frequency handover measurement indication.
item.name: interFVoiceAbility

item.desc: This array is the priority of PSHO EUTRAN frequencies.A higher value indicates a higher priority, and the eNodeb will config the more front MeasID this frequency's measurement;when the frequency of this parameter is zero,eNodeb will not measure this frequency.
item.name: eutranFreqPSHOMeasInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the handover priorities of VoLTE UEs on E-UTRAN frequencies. It is an array parameter consisting of eight elements. The elements indicate the measurement priorities of the frequencies specified by the interCarriFreq (Inter-frequency Carrier) array parameter. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority and a smaller measurement ID value corresponding to the frequency measurement configurations sent by the eNodeB. If it is set to 0, the eNodeB does not send the measurement configurations of the frequency.
item.name: eutranFreqVTHOMeasInd

item.desc: The parameter represents measure performance configuration of each neighbouring inter-frequency for UE in RRC_CONNECTED state. For UE which support increased carrier monitoring E-UTRA, the reselection performance for different carriers may be configured by higher layers to be either normal or reduced. Please refer to the TS36.133(V12.4.0 or higher version)
item.name: interFreqMeasPerformance

item.desc: This parameter sets the ID of a PerQCI measurement configuration group for EN-DC UEs. It corresponds to the PerQCI measurement configurations of each frequency.
item.name: perQCIInterFreqMeaGrpCfg

item.desc: This parameter indicates the overlapping-coverage condition of neighbor cells. If the RSRP difference between a neighbor cell and the serving cell is larger than or equal to this parameter value and the UE that reports a measurement report is in the overlapping-coverage area between the serving cell and the neighbor cell, the measurement report can be included in overlapping-coverage evaluation; otherwise, the measurement report is not included in overlapping-coverage evaluation.
item.name: overlapDifferRSRPThd

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of 16 elements that correspond to the frequencies specified by the interCarriFreq parameter in turn. Each element in this array parameter indicates whether the CoperType parameter of the neighbor cells on a frequency can be modified through automatic CA configuration. If an element is set to 1 (Open), it indicates that the CoperType parameter of the neighbor cells on the corresponding frequency can be modified through automatic CA configuration. If an element is set to 0 (Close), it indicates that the CoperType parameter of the neighbor cells on the corresponding frequency cannot be modified through automatic CA configuration.
item.name: interFreqCASCInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the priority of the target frequency for handover of the UEs with uplink large-BSR services. The eNodeB hands over the UEs that have uplink large-BSR services to the target frequency whose priority is not zero. A larger parameter value indicates that the eNodeB more preferentially hands over the UEs with uplink large-BSR services to the corresponding target frequency.
item.name: srvHOTargetFreqPriUL

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of 16 elements that correspond to the frequencies specified by the interCarriFreq parameter in turn. Each element of this array parameter represents the priority for adding the neighbor cells on the corresponding frequency as the SCells. A larger element value indicates that the neighbor cells on the corresponding frequency can be more preferentially added as SCells.
item.name: scellFreqPriority

item.desc: This parameter sets the priority of a different frequency if dedicated-reselection for CA UEs is enabled. A larger parameter value indicates a higher dedicated-reselection priority of the frequency. If this parameter is set to 0, it indicates that the frequency is not carried in the dedicated-reselection IE delivered to a UE when the UE is released.
item.name: caReselInterFreqPriority

item.desc: This parameter sets an inter-frequency priority in CLB. A larger parameter value indicates that the inter-frequency priority is higher and UEs are more likely to reselect the frequency. If this parameter is set to 0, the corresponding frequency is not the target for CLB.
item.name: clbInterFreqPriority

item.desc: This parameter sets the E-UTRAN frequency point priority for user migration in high-load scenarios. The eNB selects a destination frequency point based on the priority. Priority value range: 0-255. The larger the parameter value is, the higher the frequency point prioity is. The default value is 0, indicating that the frequency point is not taken as the destination frequency point.
item.name: hlMigrtEutranFreqPrio

item.desc: This parameter sets the E-UTRAN frequency point priority for user migration in high-load scenarios. The eNB selects a destination frequency point based on the priority. Priority value range: 0-255. The larger the parameter value is, the higher the frequency point prioity is. The default value is 0, indicating that the frequency point is not taken as the destination frequency point.
item.name: softUpMigUETarFreqInd

item.desc: This parameter is the UL CA cooperation indicator for CA self-configuration. If the parameter is set to Yes, the neighbor cell on the frequency can be configured with the UL and DL CA cooperation relationship by the CA self-configuration function. If the parameter is set to No, the neighbor cell on the frequency can be configured with only the DL CA cooperation relationship by the CA self-configuration function.
item.name: interFreqULCASelfCfgInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the priorities of the target frequencies to which UEs are migrated based on their positions. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority of the frequency. The eNodeB migrates the UEs at the center or edge of a cell to the frequency with a higher priority after identifying them. The frequencies with a priority of 0 cannot be used as the target frequency for UE migration.
item.name: migBaseUEPosiTarFPri

item.desc: This parameter indicates the threshold of the number of users to execute camp load balancing and is used to control whether to enable camp load balancing to each frequency based on the number of users. When the number of users in the serving cell is larger than or equal to the threshold of a frequency, the cell executes camp load balancing to this frequency.
item.name: perFCLBCUExeThrd

item.desc: This parameter indicates the uplink PRB threshold to execute camp load balancing and is used to control whether to enable camp load balancing to each frequency. When the uplink total PRB usage of the serving cell is larger than or equal to the threshold of a frequency, the cell executes camp load balancing to this frequency.
item.name: perFULCLBPRBExeThrd

item.desc: This parameter indicates the downlink PRB threshold to execute camp load balancing and is used to control whether to enable camp load balancing to each frequency. When the downlink total PRB usage of the serving cell is larger than or equal to the threshold of a frequency, the cell executes camp load balancing to this frequency.
item.name: perFDLCLBPRBExeThrd

item.desc: This parameter is used to execute load balancing to each frequency based on the number of users. If the number of users in the LTE serving cell exceeds the threshold of the configured frequency during a measurement period, load balancing to each frequency is executed in this cell based on the number of users.
item.name: perFLBCUExeThrd

item.desc: This parameter is used to execute PRB load balancing in the uplink to each frequency. If the PRB usage in the LTE serving cell in the uplink exceeds the threshold of the configured frequency during a measurement period, uplink load balancing to each frequency is executed in this cell based on the PRB usage.
item.name: perFULPRBLBExeThrd

item.desc: This parameter is used to execute PRB load balancing in the downlink to each frequency. If the PRB usage in the LTE serving cell in the downlink exceeds the threshold of the configured frequency during a measurement period, downlink load balancing to each frequency is executed in this cell based on the PRB usage.
item.name: perFDLPRBLBExeThrd

item.desc: This parameter is used to execute PDCCH CCE load balancing in the downlink to each frequency. If the PDCCH CCE usage in the LTE serving cell in the downlink exceeds the threshold of the configured frequency during a measurement period, downlink load balancing to each frequency is executed in this cell based on the PDCCH CCE usage.
item.name: perFDLPDCCHCCELBExeThrd

item.desc: This parameter is used to execute PDCCH CCE load balancing in the uplink to each frequency. If the PDCCH CCE usage in the LTE serving cell in the uplink exceeds the threshold of the configured frequency during a measurement period, uplink load balancing to each frequency is executed in this cell based on the PDCCH CCE usage.
item.name: perFULPDCCHCCELBExeThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the priority of a target frequency for UE migration based on downlink big-packet services. If the eNodeB identifies a UE with downlink big-packet services, it migrates the UE to the frequency with a higher priority. The frequencies with a priority of 0 cannot be used as the target frequency for UE migration.
item.name: bigSRVHOTargetFreqPriDL

item.desc: This array parameter sets the priorities of the PCell for EN-DC. Each element in this array corresponds to one element in the intra-RAT inter-frequency configuration array. If an array element is set to 0, the corresponding frequency does not support EN-DC; otherwise, the corresponding frequency supports EN-DC.
item.name: endcPccFreqPrio

item.desc: This parameter sets the measurement priorities of the target frequencies for VoLTE quality-based inter-frequency handover. It is an array parameter consisting of 16 elements that indicate the priorities of the frequencies specified by the VoLTEQualProfLTE. RefEutranFreqLTE (Measurement Frequency Index of VoLTE Quality-Based E-UTRAN Handover) array parameter in turn. For the UEs that are identified as those with poor VoLTE quality by the eNodeB, a larger element value indicates that the priority for migrating the UEs to the corresponding frequency is higher. If an element is set to 0, the corresponding frequency is not used as the target frequency for VoLTE quality-based inter-frequency handover.
item.name: voLTEQualHOFreqMeasPri

item.desc: This array is the priority of PSHO EUTRAN frequencies. A higher value indicates a higher priority, and the eNodeb will config the more front MeasID this frequency's measurement;when the frequency of this parameter is zero for EN-DC User,eNodeb will not measure this frequency for EN-DC User.
item.name: enDcEutranFreqPSHOMeasInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the ID of a PerQCI measurement configuration group for EN-DC UEs. It corresponds to the PerQCI measurement configurations of each frequency.
item.name: enDcPerQCIIFMeaGrpCfg

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to configure allowable frequencies for specified IMEISV UEs. If it is set to Yes, only the IMEISV UEs that are configured with the Allowable Frequency Strategy or Allow and Prohibit Frequency Strategy parameter can use the allowable frequencies in measurement and handover.
item.name: allowFreq4SpecIMEISV

item.desc: This parameter sets the priorities of the frequencies used for the EN-DC anchor-based IMMCI function. When a UE with the EN-DC capability is released, the dedicated IMMCI reselection priority is configured based on this parameter value. A larger parameter value indicates a higher reselection priority of the frequency. The frequencies with the parameter value being zero are not carried in the dedicated reselection priority.
item.name: iMMCIEndcAnchFreqPri

item.desc: This parameter sets the VoLTE handover priorities of E-UTRAN frequencies for EN-DC UEs. It determines the sequence of the measurement IDs corresponding to the frequency measurement configurations sent by the eNodeB for EN-DC UEs. A larger parameter value indicates a higher handover priority of the corresponding frequency. If it is set to 0, the eNodeB does not send the measurement configurations of the frequency for EN-DC UEs.
item.name: enDcEutranFreqVTHOMeasInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the group ID of the measurement policy by QCI for SA UEs. It corresponds to the QCI-based inter-frequency measurement configuration. It can be set to Open if it is necessary to carry out differentiated mobility policies for different services of SA UEs.
item.name: sAPerQCIIFMeaGrpCfg

item.desc: This parameter sets the PS handover priority of an E-UTRAN frequency for SA UEs. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority and a smaller measurement ID value corresponding to the frequency measurement configurations sent by the eNodeB for SA UEs. If it is set to 0, the eNodeB does not send the measurement configurations of the frequency for SA UEs.
item.name: sAEutranFreqPSHOMeasInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the intra-RAT inter-frequency priority of the directional IMMCI of SA UEs. If the Directional IMMCI Switch of SA UEs parameter is set to Open, the eNodeB can carry dedicated IMMCI priority information based on this parameter value when releasing an SA UE.
item.name: sADirectIMMCIInterFPri

item.desc: This parameter sets the frequency priorities for NSA UEs during load balancing. It is a one-dimensional array and the array elements correspond to the priorities of the frequencies in the frequency array of measurement configurations in turn.
item.name: lbNSAInterFreqPriority

item.desc: This parameter sets the frequency priority for NSA UEs during camping load balancing. It is a one-dimensional array with the size of MAX_NUM_EUTRAN_FREQ_PRE_CELL. The array elements correspond to the priorities of the frequencies in the awInterCarriFreq array in turn.
item.name: clbNSAInterFreqPriority

item.desc: This parameter sets the EN-DC anchor indicators of E-UTRAN frequencies. The parameter value Yes corresponds to the anchor frequency layer planned by the operator. While the parameter value No corresponds to the non-anchor frequency layer. There is a one-to-one correspondence between the array elements of this parameter and those of the intra-RAT inter-frequency configuration array.
item.name: eutranFreqENDCAnchorInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the VoLTE handover priorities of E-UTRAN frequencies for SA UEs. It determines the sequence of the measurement IDs corresponding to the frequency measurement configurations sent by the eNodeB for SA UEs. A larger parameter value indicates a higher handover priority of the corresponding frequency. If it is set to 0, the eNodeB does not send the measurement configurations of the frequency for SA UEs.
item.name: sAEutranFreqVTHOMeasInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the priority of inter-frequency measurement for UE migration when MM IN coordination is enabled. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority. If it is set to 0, no inter-frequency measurement task is delivered.
item.name: tmmINCInterFreqPriority

item.desc: This parameter sets the priorities of the frequencies of the target cells for the poor-quality data UEs that are in the cells with atmospheric ducting interference to be handed over.
item.name: interFAtmosDataMigUEPrio

item.desc: This parameter sets the target frequency indicator for interference coordination between public and private networks. It is used to configure inter-frequency target frequencies for interference coordination between the public and private networks. One parameter value is mapped to one different frequency. If this parameter is set to No, vehicle arrival information cannot be sent to the corresponding inter-frequency neighbor cells in the public network. If this parameter is set to Yes, vehicle arrival information can be sent to the corresponding inter-frequency neighbor cells in the public network.
item.name: hsrICTargetFreqInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for executing camping load balancing based on the number of NSA UEs for a frequency. It is used to determine whether to enable camping load balancing based on the number of NSA UEs for each carrier frequency. If the proportion of the number of NSA UEs in the serving cell is larger than or equal to the threshold for a carrier frequency, camping load balancing is executed for this carrier frequency.
item.name: perFNsaClbCuExeThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the priorities of the inter-frequency migration of the UEs that are interfered at the DSS boundary. If a priority is set to 0, it indicates that the corresponding frequency does not support the migration of the UEs that are interfered at the DSS boundary. If a priority is set to a non-zero value, it indicates that the corresponding frequency supports the migration of the UEs that are interfered at the DSS boundary.
item.name: dSSBIFInterFMigPrio

item.desc: This parameter sets the priority of the target frequency point of traffic guidance for energy saving. The eNodeB selects a target frequency point in accordance with the priority. The larger the parameter value is, the higher the frequency point priority is. The default value is 0, indicating that the frequency point is not considered as a target frequency point.
item.name: eCGuidMigInterFreqPrio

item.desc: This parameter sets the frequency priority of the inter-frequency migration triggered by the UEs with general-QoS services. If the eNodeB needs to implement inter-frequency migration triggered by the UEs with general-QoS services, it delivers inter-frequency measurement information to the UEs based on the frequency priority specified by this parameter. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority of the corresponding frequency and a smaller measurement ID value corresponding to the frequency. If this parameter is set to 0, the eNodeB does not deliver inter-frequency measurement information.
item.name: qosTypeTrigMigInterFPrio

item.desc: This parameter sets the offset of the RSRP threshold for connection load balancing. It is used to adjust the RSRP threshold of inter-frequency A4 and A5-2 measurement delivered by the serving cell for load balancing. The RSRP threshold of inter-frequency A4 measurement actually delivered by the serving cell for load balancing is the sum of the value of the thresholdOfRSRP (Absolute RSRP Threshold for Event Decision) parameter and this parameter value. The A5-2 RSRP threshold of inter-frequency A5 measurement actually delivered by the serving cell for load balancing is the sum of the value of the a5Threshold2OfRSRP (Absolute RSRP Threshold 2 for Event A5 Decision) parameter and this parameter value.
item.name: lBRsrpOffset

item.desc: This array is the measurement indication of CSFB GERAN frequencies.When the frequency of this parameter is Yes, eNodeb will measure this frequency when CSFB based on measuring; otherwise, eNodeb will not measure this frequency when CSFB based on measuring.
item.name: geranFreqCSFBMeasInd

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of 16 elements. The elements indicate the SRVCC measurement indications of the GERAN frequencies specified by the startARFCN array parameter in turn. If an element is set to 1 (Yes), the eNodeB delivers an SRVCC measurement indication of the frequency corresponding to the element. If an element is set to 0 (No), the eNodeB delivers no SRVCC measurement indication for the frequency corresponding to the element.
item.name: geranFreqSRVCCMeasInd

item.desc: This parameter indicates the priority of a candidate frequency for the users in a high load cell to migrate to the GERAN system. The eNodeB selects the target frequency based on this priority.The priority ranges from 0 to 255.A higher value indicates a higher priority. By default, this parameter is set to 0, indicating that the frequency cannot be selected as the candidate frequency.
item.name: hlMigrtGeranFreqPrio

item.desc: This parameter sets the PerQCI measurement configuration group ID used in the handover of a UE from the serving cell to an inter-RAT GERAN cell. It is used to determine the measurement configurations for inter-RAT GERAN handover based on QCIs by matching the measurement group ID specified by the perQCIMeaGroupId (PerQCI Measurement Group ID) parameter.
item.name: perQCIGERANMeaGrpCfg

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of the UTRAN ANR self-delete function. If it is set to Open, the neighbor cell on this frequency can be deleted by the ANR function. Otherwise, the neighbor cell on this frequency cannot be deleted by the ANR function.

item.desc: This parameter indicates that if the inter-RAT UTRAN ANR function is enabled, the number of formal neighbor cells on this frequency cannot exceed the upper limit.

If an element is set to 1 (Yes), the eNodeB delivers an SRVCC measurement indication of the frequency corresponding to the element. If an element is set to 1 (Yes), the eNodeB delivers an SRVCC measurement indication of the frequency corresponding to the element. item.name: nrFreqMeaCfgIndex

item.desc: This parameter sets the band indicator for the NR DL frequency.
item.name: nRFreqBandInd

item.desc: This parameter sets an NR SSB frequency.
item.name: nRearfcn

item.desc: This parameter sets the measurement offset of NR frequencies. By using the measured NR frequency plus this parameter value, a UE can determine the entry and exit conditions of the related B1/B2 measurement event.
item.name: nRFreqOffset

item.desc: This parameter is the optimization switch for NR ANR frequency addition. If the parameter is set to Open, the neighbor cell on this frequency can be added by the ANR function. Otherwise, the neighbor cell on this frequency cannot be added by the ANR function.
item.name: eNDCFreqANRInd

item.desc: This array parameter enables or disables NR ANR frequency self-deletion. If an array element is set to Open, the neighbor cells on the corresponding frequency can be deleted through ANR self-deletion. If an array element is set to Close, the neighbor cells on the corresponding frequency cannot be deleted through ANR self-deletion.
item.name: eNDCFreqANRDelInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the SSB subcarrier spacing. This parameter value must be the same as that of the serving cell at the peer end.
item.name: sSBSCS

item.desc: This array parameter sets the priorities of the PCell and SCells for EN-DC. Each element in this array corresponds to one element in the NR inter-frequency configuration array. If an array element is set to 0, the corresponding NR frequency does not support EN-DC; otherwise, the corresponding NR frequency supports EN-DC.
item.name: nrPSCellFreqPrio

item.desc: This parameter sets the PS handover priority of an NR frequency. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority and a smaller MeasID value corresponding to the frequency measurement configurations sent by the eNodeB. If it is set to 0, the eNodeB does not send the measurement configurations of the frequency.
item.name: nRFreqPSHOMeasInd

item.desc: This parameter indicates whether the NR frequency belongs to the SA. If it is set to 1, it indicates that the NR frequency belongs to the SA. If it is set to 0, it indicates that the NR frequency does not belong to the SA.
item.name: nRFreqSAInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the priority the redirection of candidate frequencies to the target NR frequencies. The eNodeB selects the target frequency based on the priority. The priority ranges from 0 to 255. A higher value indicates a higher priority. By default, this parameter is set to 0, indicating that the frequency cannot be selected as the candidate frequency during redirection.
item.name: nRFreqRdPriority

item.desc: This parameter sets the handover priorities of VoLTE UEs on NR frequencies. It is an array parameter consisting of eight elements. The elements indicate the handover priorities of VoLTE UEs on the NR frequencies specified by the nRearfcn (NR SSB Frequency) array parameter. A larger element value indicates that the handover priority of the VoLTE UEs on the corresponding frequency is higher and the measurement ID value corresponding to the frequency measurement indication delivered by the eNodeB is smaller. If an element is set to 0, the eNodeB delivers no measurement indication for the corresponding frequency.
item.name: nRFreqVoLTEHOMeasInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the priorities of the frequencies that are used for fast return when the EPS fallback procedure ends. It is an array parameter consisting of eight elements. The elements indicate the priorities of the NR frequencies specified by the nRearfcn (NR SSB Frequency) array parameter. A larger element value indicates a higher priority of the corresponding frequency that is used for fast return when an EPS fallback procedure ends. If an element is set to 0, it indicates that UEs cannot fast return to the corresponding frequency when the EPS fallback procedure ends.
item.name: epsFBEndFRFreqPrio

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval for SSB frequency measurement by UEs.
item.name: sSBMeasPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration for SSB frequency measurement by UEs.
item.name: sSBMeasDuration

item.desc: This parameter sets the subframe offset for SSB frequency measurement. In an SSB measurement period of a UE, the UE measures the SSB frequency based on the subframe location corresponding to this parameter value. If the parameter value is larger than the actual period, the actual subframe offset position is determined based on the mode SSB period when the actual value is sent to UE.
item.name: sSBMeasSubframeOffset

item.desc: This parameter sets the time-domain bitmap position for the frequency-level SSB measurement for the UEs in RRC-connected state. If it is set to 1, the corresponding beams need to be measured; if it is set to 0, the corresponding beams do not need to be measured.
item.name: sSBToMeasBitmap

item.desc: This parameter indicates the SFN difference between 4G and 5G systems on each 5G frequency. The parameter value is calculated as follows: (4G SFN - 5G SFN) mod 1024.
item.name: systemFrameNumberOffset

item.desc: This parameter sets the offset of the frame boundary of 4G and 5G base stations on each 5G frequency. The parameter value is calculated by the following function: floor[(start position of the 4G frame header (in ms) - start position of the 5G frame header (in ms))/(5 x Ts)], where Ts is 1/30720 ms.
item.name: frameBoundaryOffset

item.desc: This parameter sets the group ID of the measurement policy by QCI for SA UEs. It corresponds to the QCI-based measurement configuration at the NR frequency level.
item.name: sAPerQCINRMeaGrpCfg

item.desc: This parameter sets the NR frequency priority of the directional migration of SA UEs. If the Directional Migration Switch of SA UEs parameter is set to Open, the eNodeB hands over or redirects SA UEs to a frequency with a non-zero priority.
item.name: sADirectMigNRFreqPri

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of SSBs required for NR cell measurement by UEs.
item.name: sSBConsolidationNumber

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRP threshold of the beams that are used for RSRP calculation. Only the beams whose RSRP is higher than this threshold can be used for RSRP calculation.
item.name: sSBConsolidationRSRPThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRQ threshold of the beams that are used for RSRQ calculation. Only the beams whose RSRQ is higher than this threshold can be used for RSRQ calculation.
item.name: sSBConsolidationRSRQThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the SINR threshold of the beams that are used for SINR calculation. Only the beams whose SINR is higher than this threshold can be used for SINR calculation.
item.name: sSBConsolidationSINRThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the NR frequency priority of the directional IMMCI of SA UEs. If the Directional IMMCI Switch of SA UEs parameter is set to Open, the eNodeB determines whether to carry dedicated IMMCI priority information based on this parameter value when releasing an SA UE.
item.name: sADirectIMMCINRFreqPri

item.desc: This parameter sets the priority of the target frequencies used for NR coverage monitoring in an EN-DC anchor-based handover. If EN-DC anchor-based handover based on NR coverage is enabled, the eNodeB hands over UEs to an anchor cell with NR coverage according to the priority specified by this parameter.
item.name: endcAnchHoMonNRCovFPrio

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the NR frequency can be used as an indication for the EN-DC dual-link service. If this parameter is set to YES, it indicates that this frequency is an NSA frequency layer planned by the operator and can be used for the EN-DC dual-link service. If this parameter is set to NO, it indicates that this frequency is a non-NSA frequency layer planned by the operator and cannot be used for the EN-DC dual-link service. Each element in this array corresponds to one element in the NR SSB carrier frequency configuration array.
item.name: nRFreqENDCInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the SINR threshold for NR neighbor cells in the joint decision of SN addition in an EN-DC scenario. If the SINR of an NR neighbor cell is lower than this threshold, this neighbor cell cannot be added as a PSCell of the SN.
item.name: snAddJointJudgeSinrThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRQ threshold for NR neighbor cells in the joint decision of SN addition in an EN-DC scenario. If the RSRQ of an NR neighbor cell is lower than this threshold, this neighbor cell cannot be added as a PSCell of the SN.
item.name: snAddJointJudgeRsrqThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRP threshold for NR neighbor cells in the joint decision of SN addition in an EN-DC scenario. If the RSRP of an NR neighbor cell is lower than this threshold, this neighbor cell cannot be added as a PSCell of the SN.
item.name: snAddJointJudgeRsrpThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute RSRP threshold for the RSRP decision of target neighbor cells when coverage-based handover or redirection to inter-RAT NR neighbor cells is enabled and the measurement events of data UEs are reported. It is used to control the triggering of handover or redirection to the inter-RAT NR neighbor cells with a good RSRP value.
item.name: covNRUnitJudgDTRSRPThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute RSRQ threshold for the RSRQ decision of target neighbor cells when coverage-based handover or redirection to inter-RAT NR neighbor cells is enabled and the measurement events of data UEs are reported. It is used to control the triggering of handover or redirection to the inter-RAT NR neighbor cells with a good RSRQ value.
item.name: covNRUnitJudgDTRSRQThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute SINR threshold for the SINR decision of target neighbor cells when coverage-based handover or redirection to inter-RAT NR neighbor cells is enabled and the measurement events of data UEs are reported. It is used to control the triggering of handover or redirection to the inter-RAT NR neighbor cells with a good SINR value.
item.name: covNRUnitJudgDTSINRThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute RSRP threshold for the RSRP decision of target neighbor cells when coverage-based handover or redirection to inter-RAT NR neighbor cells is enabled and the measurement events of voice UEs are reported. It is used to control the triggering of handover or redirection to the inter-RAT NR neighbor cells with a good RSRP value.
item.name: covNRUnitJudgVTRSRPThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute RSRQ threshold for the RSRQ decision of target neighbor cells when coverage-based handover or redirection to inter-RAT NR neighbor cells is enabled and the measurement events of voice UEs are reported. It is used to control the triggering of handover or redirection to the inter-RAT NR neighbor cells with a good RSRQ value.
item.name: covNRUnitJudgVTRSRQThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute SINR threshold for the SINR decision of target neighbor cells when coverage-based handover or redirection to inter-RAT NR neighbor cells is enabled and the measurement events of voice UEs are reported. It is used to control the triggering of handover or redirection to the inter-RAT NR neighbor cells with a good SINR value.
item.name: covNRUnitJudgVTSINRThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the DSS indication of NR frequencies. It indicates whether DSS is enabled for inter-RAT NR frequencies.
item.name: dssFreqInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the loose-time synchronization indication for NR frequencies. It is used for the gap function in NR measurement. If there are cells that correspond to the NR measurement frequency and whose clock synchronization mode is loose synchronization, the loose-time synchronization indication for this frequency is set to Yes. If there is no cell that corresponds to the NR measurement frequency or whose clock synchronization mode is loose synchronization, the loose-time synchronization indication for this frequency is set to No.
item.name: nrFreqLooseTimeSyncInd

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the frame boundaries of all the cells at a frequency are the same. It is used for the gap function in NR measurement. If the frame boundaries of all the cells at a frequency are the same, this parameter is set to Yes. If the frame boundaries of all the cells at a frequency are not the same, this parameter is set to No.
item.name: deriveSSBIndexFromCell

item.desc: This parameter sets whether NR frequencies support NSA services.
item.name: defaultFreqNsaMode

item.desc: This parameter sets whether there are cells that are on an NR frequency used for RRC-connected UEs and support RedCap UEs of specific types. It consists of two elements that indicate whether there are cells that are on the NR frequency and support RedCap UEs with 1Rx antennas and 2Rx antennas respectively. If the value of an element is 1, it indicates that there are such cells. If the value of an element is 0, it indicates that there are no such cells. For example, if the parameter value is 01, it indicates that there are cells that are on an NR frequency used for RRC-connected UEs and support RedCap UEs with 2Rx antennas and there is no cell that is on an NR frequency used for RRC-connected UEs or supports RedCap UEs with 1Rx antennas.
item.name: connRedCapUeSupTypeBitmap

item.name: isAnrCreated

item.name: isX2HOAllowed

item.desc: The parameter indicates the location relation between server cell and EUTRAN neighboring cell
item.name: shareCover

item.desc: The enable Flag that S1 HO Data Direct Forward can be done.
item.name: s1DataFwdFlag

item.desc: Status indication of the adjacent cell.the value of the parameter is RRC_IDLE only,what only permit the RRC_IDLE UE to reselecte to the cell;the value is RRC_CONNECTED only,what only permit the RRC_CONNECTED UE to handover to the cell;then he value is RRC_IDLE+RRC_CONNECTED ,what permit the RRC_IDLE UE to reselecte to the cell and the RRC_CONNECTED UE to handover
item.name: stateInd

item.desc: The parameter is used to determine whether the energy saving cell is covered by the adjacent cell. It indicates whether the adjacentCell according to this planning provides no, partial or full coverage for the cell which name-contains the EUtranRelation instance. The value partial is not allowed in an eNB overlaid scenario.
item.name: isESCoveredBy

item.desc: The parameter is used to determine whether the cell cover the energy savingcell.
item.name: coverESCell

item.desc: This parameter indicates the maximum uplink load on a compensation cell when an energy saving cell is awoken. The energy saving cell can be awoken if the downlink load on the compensation cell is higher than this threshold.
item.name: resPRBUp

item.desc: This parameter indicates the maximum downlink load on a compensation cell when an energy saving cell is awoken. The energy saving cell can be awoken if the downlink load on the compensation cell is higher than this threshold.
item.name: resPRBDown

item.desc: The parameter is the time window of switching on for energy saving cell.
item.name: switchonTimeWindow

item.desc: When load balancing based on intra-frequency measurement of A4 event is beginning, the neighbor cell that RSRP is no less than (serving cell's value + ucLBIntraMeasureOffset) in measurement report can only selected as target cell.
item.name: lbIntraMeasureOffset

item.desc: The Max Tolerance Number of RRC Connection Number for Cover Cell When switching on the ES Cell
item.name: numRRCCntNumCov

item.desc: This parameter sets the collaboration type of CoMP and CA (in bitmap format and in ascending order): UL CoMP, DL CoMP, DL CA, UL CA, eDL CA (non-Live CA), and eUL CA (non-Live CA).
item.name: coperType

item.desc: This parameter indicates the neighbor cell overlap coverage degree.
item.name: overlapCoverage

item.desc: This parameter indicates whether the neighbor coordination relationship of a cell can be modified by CA/CoMP self-configuration. If this parameter is set to Not allowed to modify, the neighbor coordination relationship of a cell cannot be modified by CA/CoMP self-configuration; otherwise, the neighbor coordination relationship of a cell can be modified by CA/CoMP self-configuration.
item.name: coperModSwch

item.desc: The switch for not support mobility based cover,it not support handover and redirection based cover when the value is Open.
item.name: noSupMobilitySwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates whether the handover parameters of the neighbor relation can be modified by the MRO function. If the value is Allowed to Modify CIO by MRO, the cell individual offset is allowed to be modified by the MRO function; If the value is Not Allowed to Modify CIO by MRO, the cell individual offset is not allowed to be modified by the MRO function.
item.name: supportMRO

item.desc: This parameter indicates whether a neighbor cell is a high-speed rail cell. In the high-speed rail scenarios, the eNodeB can process the UEs at different speeds based on this parameter.
item.name: hSpeedRailCellInd

item.desc: This parameter indicates whether a neighbor cell is the target cell for downlink big service-based handover. The eNodeB selects the target cells for downlink big service-based handover based on this parameter.
item.name: bigSRVHOIndDL

item.desc: This parameter indicates whether a neighbor cell is the target cell for uplink big service-based handover. The eNodeB selects the target cells for uplink big service-based handover based on this parameter.
item.name: bigSRVHOIndUL

item.desc: This parameter is used to indicate whether the neighbor cell is the basic coverage cell of the service cell for spectrum sharing.
item.name: isBasicCoverageCell

item.desc: This parameter indicates whether a neighbor relation is a whitelist neighbor relation. If it is set to Yes, it means that the neighbor relation is a whitelist neighbor relation that cannot be automatically deleted by the ANR or put into the neighbor cell blacklist by the ANR. If it is set to No, the neighbor relation can be automatically deleted by the ANR or put into the neighbor cell blacklist by the ANR.
item.name: whiteListNbrInd

item.desc: This parameter sets an individual offset between NSA cells. It is used for an NSA UE to determine the individual offset of the cell corresponding to the measurement object (parameter path: MeasObjectEUTRA greater than cellsToAddModList greater than cellIndividualOffset).
item.name: nSACellIndivOffset

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the update of the general inter-cell overlapping coverage degree. If it is set to Open, the overlapping coverage degree and coverage relation parameters calculated through the general overlapping coverage degree function update the Auto-updated Inter-cell Overlapping Coverage Degree and Auto-updated Relation Between the Serving Cell and E-UTRAN Intra-RAT Neighbor Cells parameters in the EMS. If it is set to Close, the overlapping coverage degree and coverage relation parameters calculated through the general overlapping coverage degree function do not update the parameters in the EMS.
item.name: overlapRateUpdateSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the inter-cell overlapping coverage degree. It is automatically calculated by the eNodeB. If it is set to 255 (an invalid value), it indicates that the overlapping coverage degree has not been automatically updated.
item.name: overlapRate

item.desc: This parameter indicates the auto-updated coverage relation between the serving cell and an E-UTRAN intra-RAT neighbor cell, including neighboring, same coverage, containing, and contained.
item.name: autoShareCover

item.desc: This is reservaed parameter 1 for neighbor relations of LTE services.
item.name: algLTENBRRsved1

item.desc: This parameter sets the individual offset between PLMNs. It is used to determine the individual offset of the cell corresponding to the measurement object. There is a one-to-one correspondence between the items in the PLMN list of the individual offsets of cells and the items in the PLMN list of neighbor cells.
item.name: cellIndiOffstPlmn

item.desc: This parameter sets the individual offset between NSA cells in different PLMNs. It is used for an NSA UE of a PLMN to determine the individual offset of the cell corresponding to the measurement object. There is a one-to-one correspondence between the items in the PLMN list of the individual offsets of NSA cells and the items in the PLMN list of neighbor cells.
item.name: nSACellIndOffPlmn

item.desc: This parameter sets the power collaboration relation between a neighbor cell and the serving cell. If this parameter is set to Yes, the neighbor cell can be used as a target neighbor cell for power collaboration. The LTE cell collaborates with the NR neighbor cell to maximize the use of resources on the same frequency band. They can collaborate in multiple ways. In the current version, only Dynamic Spectrum Sharing (DSS) is supported.

item.name: voiceMobilitySwch

If it is set to Yes, the neighbor relation is the whitelist neighbor relation that cannot be automatically deleted or put into the neighbor cell blacklist by the ANR function. If it is set to No, the neighbor relation can be automatically deleted or put into the neighbor cell blacklist by the ANR function.

If it is set to Open, the data of UE handover from 4G to 5G is forwarded directly through the X2 interface, improving the data forwarding performance of the eNodeB. If it is set to Close, the data of the UE handover from 4G to 5G is forwarded through the core network.

item.desc: The parameter is cell barred indicator If the cell barred indicator is set to 'barred', UEs are not permitted to select/re-select this cell, even for emergency calls
item.name: cellBarred

item.desc: When Cell Policy Shutdown Command is received from OMC, the timer is open.And if timer is time-out,the UEs in the cell will be moved out forcibly.
item.name: preBlockTimer

item.desc: The parameter indicates whether UE can reselect to intra-frequency cells when the highest ranked cell is barred, or treated as barred by the UE
item.name: isIntraFreqReselection

item.desc: The parameter indicates whether UE can access in CSG cell
item.name: csgIndication

item.desc: The parameter indicates the minimum required received power level of the cell which satisfies the condition of being selected by UE Only the measured received power level of the cell is over Sel_Qrxlevmin can the cell be selected
item.name: selQrxLevMin

item.desc: The parameter indicates the offset of the minimum required received power level of the cell which satisfies the condition of being selected or reselected by UE It will affect the minimum required received power level in the cell
item.name: qrxLevMinOfst

item.desc: The parameter is Maximum allowed transmission power on an uplink carrier frequency in dBm.The UE transmit power on one serving cell shall not exceed the configured maximum UE output power of the serving cell determined by this value.
item.name: intraPmax

item.desc: Maximum UE Transmission Power Offset
item.name: intraPmaxOffset

item.desc: The parameter indicates whether users with AC below 10 be barred to trigger an emergency call.If The parameter is set to false, all the user with AC0~9 can initialize emergency call.
item.name: acBarringForEmergency

item.desc: The parameter indicates the access probability for mobile originating signalling .If the random number drawn by the UE is lower than the parameter, access is allowed; Otherwise the access is barred. It means higher access probability as this field set to a big value, but lower access probability as this field set to a small value. In addition, when the parameter Ac-barring factors' working mode been configured in dynamic , this parameter means the minimum factor that the eNB can adjust downward to.
item.name: acBarringFactor

item.desc: The parameter indicates the mean access barring time of mobile originating signalling.If the value is big, it use more time to access signalling, otherwise little time needed.
item.name: acBarringTime

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of five elements. Elements 0 through 5 indicate whether the UEs of AC11 to AC15 are allowed to access the network when initiating calling signaling access. If an element is set to 1 (Yes), the UEs of the corresponding AC are allowed to access the network. If an element is set to 0 (No), the UEs of the corresponding AC are not allowed to access the network.
item.name: acBarringForSpecialAC

item.desc: The parameter indicates the access probability for mobile originating callsIf the random number drawn by the UE is lower than the parameter, access is allowed Otherwise the access is barred. In addition, when the parameter Ac-barring factors' working mode been configured in dynamic , this parameter means the minimum factor that the eNB can adjust downward to.
item.name: acBarringFactorOrig

item.desc: The parameter indicates the mean access barring time of mobile originating calls.
item.name: acBarringTimeOrig

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of five elements. Elements 0 through 5 indicate whether the UEs of AC11 to AC15 are allowed to access the network when initiating calls. If an element is set to 1 (Yes), the UEs of the corresponding AC are allowed to access the network. If an element is set to 0 (No), the UEs of the corresponding AC are not allowed to access the network.
item.name: acBarringForSpecialACtOrig

item.desc: The parameter indicates the hysteresis value for cells In cell-ranking criterion R of cell reselection, the R value of serving cell equals to the measured value plus the hysteresis value For detail description please refer to TS 36304
item.name: qhyst

item.desc: The parameter indicates time windows for judging medium/high mobility state of UE If the number that the cell performs reselection during time period T_Crmax exceeds NCR_H, UE will be considered in high mobility state If the number that the cell performs reselection during time period TCrmax exceeds NCR_M, UE will be considered in medium mobility state
item.name: tEvaluation

item.desc: If criteria for high mobility state or medium mobility state are not detected in T_Crmaxhyst, it shall enter normal mobility state
item.name: tCrMaxHyst

item.desc: The parameter indicates threshold of cell reselection for judging high mobility state If number of cell reselections during time period TCrmax exceeds NCR_H, UE will be considered in high mobility state
item.name: nCellChangeHigh

item.desc: The parameter indicates threshold of cell reselection for judging medium mobility state If number of cell reselections during time period T_Crmax exceeds NCR_M, UE will be considered in medium mobility state
item.name: nCellChangeMedium

item.desc: The parameter indicates additional hysteresis applied in medium mobility state
item.name: qHystSFMedium

item.desc: The parameter indicates additional hysteresis applied in high mobility state
item.name: qHystSFHigh

item.desc: The parameter is a switch indicating whether S_nonintrasearch is configured or not If the value is False, UE always performs measurements of inter-RAT frequencies or inter-frequencies of equal or lower priority If the value is True, S_nonintrasearch is configured to UE, and UE judges whether to perform the measurements of inter-RAT frequencies or inter-frequencies of equal or lower priority For detail description please refers to TS 36304
item.name: sNintraSrchPre

item.desc: The parameter indicates the measurement triggering threshold for cell reselection (S_nonintrasearch) used by UE to judge whether inter-frequency/inter-RAT should be performed If the quality of serving cell exceeds S_nonintrasearch, UE may choose not to perform measurements of inter-RAT frequencies or inter-frequencies of equal or lower priority if the quality of serving cell is not larger than S_nonintrasearch, UE shall perform measurements of inter-RAT frequencies or inter-frequencies cells of equal or lower priority For detail description please refers to TS 36304
item.name: snonintrasearch

item.desc: The parameter indicates the threshold for cell reselection to a cell on a lower priority RAT or frequency There have 3 elements fulfilled for cell reselection criteria : (1) No cell of a higher priority RAT or frequency fulfills the criteria above (2) SServingCell less than ThresholdServing_Low and the SnonServingCell,x of a cell of a lower priority frequency RAT or frequency is greater than ThresholdX_Low (including inter-frequency and inter-RAT) during a time interval TreselectionRAT (3) more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell For detail description please refers to TS 36304
item.name: threshSvrLow

item.desc: Intra_Pmax is the most uplink usable transmitting power of UE of cell configured Intra_Pmax is used for the intra-frequency neighboring E-UTRA cell reselection If Intra_Pmax is absent, the maximum power according to the UE capability is used
item.name: iIntraPmax

item.desc: Maximum UE Transmission Power of Intra-Frequency Reselection Offset
item.name: iIntraPmaxOffset

item.desc: The parameter indicates intra-frequency cell reselection priority The less its value is, the lower its priority class is
item.name: cellReselectionPriority

item.desc: The parameter indicates the minimum required received power level of intra-frequency cell which satisfies the condition of being reselected by UE
item.name: intraQrxLevMin

item.desc: The parameter is a switch indicating whether S_intrasearch is configured or not If the value is False, S_intrasearch is not configured to UE, and UE performs the intra-frequency measurement periodically according to the period inicated by the parameter Treselections If the value is True, S_intrasearch is configured to UE, and UE judges whether to perform the intra-frequency measurement For detail description please refer to TS 36304
item.name: intraSearch

item.desc: The parameter indicates the intra-frequency cell reselection timerUE shall reselect the new cell of EUTRAN if the new intra-frequency cell is better ranked than the serving cell according to the cell-ranking criterion R during a time interval indicated by TreselectionIntraEUTRAN
item.name: tReselectionIntraEUTRA

item.desc: The parameter is used to indicate whether all the neighboring cells use Antenna Port 1 for intra-frequency cell reselection When set to TRUE, the UE may assume that at least two cell-specific antenna ports are used in all neighboring cells
item.name: intraPresenceAntPort1

item.desc: The parameter indicates scaling factor of reselection time applied in medium mobility state.The concerned mobility control related parameter uctRslIntraEutra is multiplied with uctReselIntraSFM if the UE is in Medium Mobility state.
item.name: sfIntraMedium

item.desc: The parameter indicates scaling factor of reselection time applied in high mobility state.The concerned mobility control related parameter uctRslIntraEutra is multiplied with uctReselIntraSFH if the UE is in High Mobility state.
item.name: sfIntraHigh

item.desc: Inter-Frequency Number
item.name: interFreqNum

item.desc: The parameter indicates the extended number of inter-frequency, and the maximum number is 8.
item.name: interFreqNumExt

item.desc: This parameter indicates the minimum required quality level of the cell which satisfies the condition of being selected by UE. Only the measured received quality level of the cell is over ucCellSelQqualMin can the cell be selected. Range of the parameter is actual value which equals to the value in 36.331.
item.name: cellSelQqualMin

item.desc: Offset to the signalled Qqualmin taken into account in the Squal evaluation as a result of a periodic search for a higher priority PLMN while camped normally in a VPLMN
item.name: qQualminoffset

item.desc: Service specific access class barring for MMTEL voice originating calls If the random number drawn by the UE is lower than this value, access is allowed Otherwise the access is barred. In addition, when the parameter Ac-barring factors' working mode been configured in dynamic , this parameter means the minimum factor that the eNB can adjust downward to.
item.name: voiceBarringFactor

item.desc: Service specific access class barring for MMTEL voice originating calls.
item.name: voiceBarringTime

item.desc: This parameter is an array of five elements to prevent the UEs of the corresponding AC levels from initiating multimedia voice calls. The elements correspond to AC11, AC12, AC13, AC14, and AC15 separately. If an element is set to No, it indicates that the UEs of the corresponding AC level are allowed to initiate the access procedure of multimedia voice calls. If an element is set to Yes, it indicates that the UEs of the corresponding AC level are not allowed to initiate the access procedure of multimedia voice calls.
item.name: voiceBarForSpecAC

item.desc: Service specific access class barring for MMTEL video originating calls If the random number drawn by the UE is lower than this value, access is allowed Otherwise the access is barred. In addition, when the parameter Ac-barring factors' working mode been configured in dynamic , this parameter means the minimum factor that the eNB can adjust downward to.
item.name: videoBarringFactor

item.desc: Service specific access class barring for MMTEL video originating calls.
item.name: videoBarringTime

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of five elements. Elements 0 through 5 indicate whether the UEs of AC11 to AC15 are allowed to access the network when initiating multimedia video calls. If an element is set to 1 (Yes), the UEs of the corresponding AC are allowed to access the network. If an element is set to 0 (No), the UEs of the corresponding AC are not allowed to access the network.
item.name: videoBarForSpecAC

item.desc: This parameter indicates the intra-frequency measurement triggering threshold for cell reselection (ucSIntraSrchQ) used by UE to judge whether intra-frequency measurement should be performed. If the quality of serving cell is not larger than ucSIntraSrchQ, UE performs intra-frequency measurement. For detail description please refers to TS 36.304. Range of the parameter is actual value which equals to the value in 36.331.
item.name: sIntraSrchQ

item.desc: This parameter indicates the measurement triggering threshold for cell reselection(SnonintrasearchQ) used by UE to judge whether inter-frequency/inter-RAT should be performed. If the quality of serving cell exceeds Snonintrasearch, UE may choose not to perform measurements of inter-RAT frequencies or inter-frequencies of equal or lower priority. if the quality of serving cell is not larger than SnonintrasearchQ, UE shall perform measurements of inter-RAT frequencies or inter-frequencies cells of equal or lower priority. For detail description please refers to TS 36.304. Range of the parameter is actual value which equals to the value in 36.331.
item.name: sNintraSrchQ

item.desc: Specifies the minimum required quality level in the cell in dB
item.name: intraFreqQqualMin

item.desc: This parameter indicates the threshold for cell reselection to a cell on a lower priority RAT or frequency. There have 3 elements fulfilled for cell reselection criteria: (1) No cell of a higher priority RAT or frequency fulfills the criteria above; (2) SServingCell less than threshSrvLowQ and the SnonServingCell,x of a cell of a lower priority frequency RAT or frequency is greater than threshSrvLowQ (including inter-frequency and inter-RAT) during a time interval TreselectionRAT; (3) more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell. For detail description please refers to TS 36.304. Range of the parameter is actual value which equals to the value in 36.331.
item.name: threshSrvLowQ

item.desc: This parameter indicate the reselection priority of RAT. The reselcection priority of RAT is defined by SPID value sent to eNB from EPC with S1 interface.EUTRAN, GERAN, UTRAN is divided into High , Medium, Low class, and its priority is determined by SPID value respectivily .
item.name: cellReselPrioBaseSpid

item.desc: The parameter indicates the intra-frequency measurement triggering threshold for cell reselection (S_intrasearch) used by UE to judge whether intra-frequency measurement should be performed if the quality of serving cell exceeds S_Intrasearch, UE may choose to not perform intra-frequency measurement; if the quality of serving cell is not larger than S_intrasearch, UE performs intra-frequency measurement For detail description please refer to TS 36304
item.name: sIntraSearch

item.desc: Srxlev (RSRP) threshold of intra-frequency measurement for cell re-selection (s-IntraSearchP-r9 IE in SIB3). If the serving cell fulfils Srxlev greater than SIntraSearchP and Squal greater than SIntraSearchQ, the UE may choose not to perform intra-frequency measurements (Release 9).
item.name: r9SIntraSrchP

item.desc: Srxlev (RSRP) threshold of inter-frequency measurement for cell re-selection (s-NonIntraSearchP-r9 IE in SIB3). If the serving cell fulfils Srxlev greater than SnonIntraSearchP and Squal greater than SnonIntraSearchQ, the UE may choose not to perform measurements of E-UTRAN inter-frequencies or inter-RAT frequency cells of equal or lower priority (Release 9)
item.name: r9SNintraSrchP

item.desc: If select 'Open', then the parameter Threshold (in dB) of the serving cell when reselecting towards a lower priority RAT/ frequency RSRQ (Release 9) (threshServingLowQ-r9 IE) shall present in SIB3.
item.name: threshSrvLowQSwitch

item.desc: The switch of whether to send speedStateReselectionPars in sib3 and SpeedStateScaleFactors in sib5/6/7/8. If switch is open, speedStateReselectionPars and SpeedStateScaleFactors will be sent
item.name: reselParaBaseSpeedFlag

item.desc: The parameter indicates the access probability for CSFB If the random number drawn by the UE is lower than the parameter, access is allowed Otherwise the access is barred. In addition, when the parameter Ac-barring factors' working mode been configured in dynamic , this parameter means the minimum factor that the eNB can adjust downward to.
item.name: csfbBarringFactor

item.desc: The parameter indicates the access probability for CSFB If the random number drawn by the UE is lower than the parameter, access is allowed Otherwise the access is barred.
item.name: csfbBarringTime

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of five elements. Elements 0 through 5 indicate whether the UEs of AC11 to AC15 are allowed to access the network when initiating CSFB calls. If an element is set to 1 (Yes), the UEs of the corresponding AC are allowed to access the network. If an element is set to 0 (No), the UEs of the corresponding AC are not allowed to access the network.
item.name: csfbBarForSpecAC

item.desc: This parameter indicates the working mode of AC barring. It is one byte in length. The working modes represented by the bits from the rightmost bit (the lowest bit) are as follows: Dynamic adjust based on CC Hardware, Dynamic adjust based on Ratio of user number, Dynamic adjust based on BPL load, Dynamic adjust based on Ratio of MMTEL Voice user number, Dynamic adjust based on Ratio of MMTEL Video user number, and Dynamic adjust based on Ratio of RRC Rejection Ratio. If a bit is set to 1, the corresponding feature is enabled; if a bit is set to 0, the corresponding feature is disabled. If all the bits are set to 0, AC barring works statically. The two leftmost bits (two high bits) are not defined.
item.name: acBarWorkMode

item.desc: When switch is Open, the eMFBI function of this cell is valid, otherwise it is not be used.
item.name: freqBandPriSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicated whether the cell support the frequence Band Priority Adjustment or not.When parameter is Support, eNB decides the access band of UE according to mutiBandList first, and then according to freqBandInd; When parameter is Not Support, eNB decides the access band of UE according to freqBandInd first, and then according to mutiBandList.
item.name: freqBandPriInd

item.desc: Indicates whether UE is requested to use the establishment cause mo-VoiceCall for mobile originating MMTEL voice calls.
item.name: voiceServiceCauseIndSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum required receiving power level for eMTC UEs to satisfy the cell selection conditions in normal coverage scenarios. A cell can be selected only when its measured receiving power level is higher than Sel_Qrxlevmin.
item.name: eMTCSelQrxLevMin

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum offset of the required receiving power level for eMTC UEs to satisfy the cell selection and reselection conditions. It affects the minimum receiving power level required by cells.
item.name: eMTCQrxLevMinOfst

item.desc: This parameter indicates the hysteresis value of cell reselection for eMTC UEs. In the cell-ranking criterion R for cell reselection, the R value of the serving cell is equal to the measured value plus the reselection hysteresis value. For details, refer to TS 36.304.
item.name: eMTCQhyst

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the configuration of the S_nonintrasearch parameter for eMTC cell broadcasting. If it is set to No, the S_nonintrasearch parameter is not configured for eMTC UEs and the eMTC UEs always measure the signal strength of the neighbor cells in the systems or carriers whose priority is equal to or lower than the current E-UTRA frequency. If it is set to Yes, the S_nonintrasearch parameter is configured for eMTC UEs and the eMTC UEs determine whether to measure the signal strength of the systems or carriers whose priority is equal to or lower than the current E-UTRA frequency. For details, refer to TS 36.304.
item.name: eMTCSNintraSrchPre

item.desc: This parameter indicates the inter-frequency/inter-RAT measurement triggering threshold of cell reselection for eMTC UEs (S_nonintrasearch). With this parameter, eMTC UEs determine whether to measure the signal strength of the systems or carriers whose priority is equal to or lower than the current carrier frequency. If the quality value of the serving cell exceeds the S_nonintrasearch parameter value, the eMTC UEs do not measure the signal strength of the systems or carriers whose priority is equal to or lower than the current carrier frequency. If the quality value of the serving cell is smaller than or equal to the S_nonintrasearch parameter value, the eMTC UEs measure the signal strength of the systems or carriers whose priority is equal to or lower than the current carrier frequency. For details, refer to TS 36.304.
item.name: eMTCSNintraSrch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the lower threshold for cell reselection to a cell on a low-priority RAT or frequency. The cell reselection criteria are as follows: (1) No cell on a higher-priority RAT or frequency fulfills the criteria. (2) SServingCell is less than ThresholdServing_Low and SnonServingCell,x of a cell on a lower-priority RAT or frequency is larger than ThresholdX_Low (including inter-frequency and inter-RAT) during the time interval TreselectionRAT. (3) The duration when the eMTC UE camps on the current serving cell is longer than one second. For details, refer to TS 36.304.
item.name: eMTCThreshSvrLow

item.desc: This parameter indicates the priority of intra-frequency eMTC cell reselection. A smaller parameter value indicates a lower reselection priority.
item.name: eMTCIntraReselPrio

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum required receiving power level for eMTC UEs to satisfy the intra-frequency cell reselection conditions in normal coverage scenarios.
item.name: eMTCIntraQrxLevMin

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the configuration of the S_intrasearch parameter for eMTC cell broadcasting. If it is set to No, the S_intrasearch parameter is not configured for eMTC UEs and the eMTC UEs perform intra-frequency measurement at the interval specified by the Treselections parameter. If it is set to Yes, the S_intrasearch parameter is configured for eMTC UEs and the eMTC UEs determine whether to perform intra-frequency measurement. For details, refer to TS 36.304.
item.name: eMTCSIntraSrchPre

item.desc: This parameter indicates the intra-frequency measurement triggering threshold (S_intrasearch) for eMTC cell reselection. With this parameter, eMTC UEs determine whether to perform intra-frequency measurement. If the quality of the serving cell exceeds the value of S_intrasearch, eMTC UEs do not perform intra-frequency measurement. If the quality of the serving cell is less than or equal to the value of S_intrasearch, eMTC UEs perform intra-frequency measurement. For details, refer to TS 36.304.
item.name: eMTCSIntraSrch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the duration for intra-frequency eMTC cell reselection in normal coverage scenarios. According to the cell-ranking criterion R for cell reselection, a new intra-frequency EUTRAN cell can be reselected as the serving cell only when it is better ranked than the serving cell during the period specified by TreselectionIntraEUTRAN.
item.name: eMTCtRslIntraEutra

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum required quality level for eMTC UEs to satisfy the cell selection conditions in normal coverage scenarios. A cell may be selected only when its measured quality level is higher than ucCellSelQqualMin. The parameter range is an actual value, equal to the value specified in TS 36.331.
item.name: eMTCCellSelQqualMin

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum offset of the required quality level for eMTC cell reselection.
item.name: eMTCQqualminoffset

item.desc: This parameter indicates the intra-frequency measurement triggering threshold (ucSIntraSrchQ) for eMTC cell reselection. With this parameter, a UE determines whether to perform intra-frequency measurement. If the quality of the serving cell is less than or equal to the value of ucSIntraSrchQ, UEs perform intra-frequency measurement. For details, refer to TS 36.304.The parameter range is an actual value, equal to the value specified in TS 36.331.
item.name: eMTCSIntraSrchQ

item.desc: This parameter indicates the inter-frequency/inter-RAT measurement triggering threshold of cell reselection for eMTC UEs (SnonintrasearchQ). With this parameter, eMTC UEs determine whether to measure the signal strength of the systems or carriers whose priority is equal to or lower than the current carrier frequency. If the quality value of the serving cell exceeds the SnonintrasearchQ parameter value, the eMTC UEs do not measure the signal strength of the systems or carriers whose priority is equal to or lower than the current carrier frequency. If the quality value of the serving cell is smaller than or equal to the SnonintrasearchQ parameter value, the eMTC UEs measure the signal strength of the systems or carriers whose priority is equal to or lower than the current carrier frequency. For details, refer to TS 36.304.The parameter range is an actual value, equal to the value specified in TS 36.331.
item.name: eMTCSNintraSrchQ

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum required quality level for eMTC cell reselection in normal coverage scenarios.
item.name: eMTCIntraFreqQqualMin

item.desc: This parameter indicates the low threshold for cell reselection to a cell on a low-priority RAT or frequency. The cell reselection criteria are as follows: (1) No cell on a higher-priority RAT or frequency fulfills the criteria. (2) SServingCell is less than ucThreshSrvLowQ and SnonServingCell,x of a cell on a lower-priority RAT or frequency is larger than ucThreshSrvLowQ (including inter-frequency and inter-RAT) during the time interval TreselectionRAT. (3) The duration when the eMTC UE camps on the current serving cell is longer than one second. For details, refer to TS 36.304.The parameter range is an actual value, equal to the value specified in TS 36.331.
item.name: eMTCThreshSrvLowQ

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRP threshold of intra-frequency measurement for cell reselection for eMTC UEs (s-IntraSearchP-r9 IE in SIB3). If the serving cell meets the following two conditions: Srxlev greater than SIntraSearchP and Squal greater than SIntraSearchQ, the eMTC UE does not perform intra-frequency measurement (Release 9).
item.name: eMTCR9SIntraSrchP

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRP threshold of inter-frequency measurement for cell reselection for eMTC UEs (s-NonIntraSearchP-r9 IE in SIB3). If the serving cell meets the following two conditions: Srxlev greater than SnonIntraSearchP and Squal greater than SnonIntraSearchQ, the eMTC UE does not perform equal-priority or low-priority inter-frequency or intra-frequency measurement (Release 9).
item.name: eMTCR9SNintraSrchP

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the configuration of the ThresholdServingLowQ parameter. If it is set to Close, the ThresholdServingLowQ parameter is not configured in SIB3. If it is set to Open, the ThresholdServingLowQ parameter is configured in SIB3 of eMTC cells.
item.name: eMTCThreshSrvLowQSwitch

item.desc: Indicates whether UE is requested to use the establishment cause mo-VoiceCall for mobile originating MMTEL video calls.
item.name: videoServiceCauseIndSwch

item.desc: During this period, no more update for the same type of SIB2 barring parameter since the last one occurred.
item.name: aCBPendingWin

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables adaptive control of the minimum receiving level. If it is set to Close, adaptive control of the minimum receiving level is disabled. If it is set to Fixed adjustment, the minimum receiving level is set to a fixed value. If it is set to Self-adaptive adjustment based on time control, the minimum receiving level is adjusted periodically.
item.name: dlCoverOptimSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the offset for downlink coverage self-optimization. It is used to automatically adjust the minimum receiving level of a cell, and then the number of UEs that camp on the cell.
item.name: selQrxMinOffset

item.desc: This parameter sets the sub-priority for reselecting intra-frequency cells. A smaller parameter value indicates a lower sub-priority.
item.name: intraReselSubPrio

item.desc: This parameter sets the period during which the optimized minimum receiving level in a cell remains unchanged. It is used for downlink coverage self-optimization adjustment. When downlink coverage self-optimization is enabled, this timer is started. When downlink coverage self-optimization is disabled, this timer is stopped. When the timer times out, the optimized minimum level is used in the cell.
item.name: dlCoverOptKeepTimeLen

item.desc: This parameter sets the period during which the minimum receive level in a cell remains unchanged before it is optimized. It is used for the recovery of downlink coverage self-optimization adjustment. Before the timer times out, the optimized minimum level is used in the cell. After the timer times out, the minimum level is used in the cell.
item.name: dlCoverOptRecoverTimeLen

item.desc: This parameter sets a special user access control configuration group ID. It corresponds to a group of access control parameters customized by the operator.
item.name: pLMNACBGroupId
