item.desc: Index for Inter-frequency. 'only for ITRAN'
item.name: freqRslCfgIndex

item.desc: This parameter sets the indicator of the frequency band where a carrier frequency is located. It indicates an E-UTRAN operating band, including the uplink operating band (for eNodeB receiving/UE sending) and the corresponding downlink operating band (for eNodeB sending/UE receiving).
item.name: freqBandInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the central frequency of downlink inter-frequency carriers. It is represented by E-UTRA Absolute Radio Frequency Channel Number (EARFCN). For the relationship between the central frequency of downlink inter-frequency carriers and EARFCN, refer to 36.101-5.7.3.
item.name: interCarriFreq

item.desc: The parameter indicates the minimum required received power level of inter-frequency cell which satisfies the condition of being reselected by UE It is a key parameter of S_nonServingCell,x which is necessary to calculate for reselection to a inter-frequency neighbour cell
item.name: interQrxLevMin

item.desc: Inter_Pmax is the most uplink usable transmitting power of UE of cell configured Inter_Pmax is used for the inter-frequency neighboring E-UTRA cell reselection If Inter_Pmax is absent, the maximum power according to the UE capability is used
item.name: interPmax

item.desc: The parameter indicates the inter-frequency cell reselection timerUE shall reselect the new cell of EUTRAN if the new inter-frequency cell is better ranked than the serving cell according to the cell-ranking criterion R during a time interval indicated by TreselectionInterEUTRAN
item.name: tReselectionInterEUTRA

item.desc: The parameter is used to indicate whether all the neighboring cells use Antenna Port 1 for inter-frequency cell reselection When set to TRUE, the UE may assume that at least two cell-specific antenna ports are used in all neighboring cells
item.name: interPresenceAntPort1

item.desc: The parameter indicates scaling factor of reselection time applied in medium mobility state.The concerned mobility control related parameter auctRslInterEutra is multiplied with auctReselInterSFM if the UE is in Medium Mobility state.
item.name: sfInterMedium

item.desc: The parameter indicates scaling factor of reselection time applied in high mobility state.The concerned mobility control related parameter auctRslInterEutra is multiplied with auctReselInterSFH if the UE is in High Mobility state.
item.name: sfInterHigh

item.desc: The parameter indicates the threshold for cell reselection to a cell on a higher priority frequency There have 2 elements fulfilled for cell reselection criteria: (1) the SnonservingCell,x of a cell of a higher priority frequency is greater than InterThresholdX_High during a time interval Treselection (2) more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell Range of the parameter is actual value which equals to double of value in 36331
item.name: interThrdXHigh

item.desc: The parameter indicates the threshold for cell reselection to an inter-frequency cell on a lower priority frequency There have 3 elements fulfilled for cell reselection criteria : (1) No cell of a higher priority frequency or inter-RAT fulfills the criteria above (2) SServingCell less than ThresholdServing_Low and the SnonServingCell,x of a cell of a lower priority frequency is greater than InterThresholdX_Low during a time interval Treselection (3) more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell For detail description please refer to TS 36304 Range of the parameter is actual value which equals to double of value in 36331
item.name: interThrdXLow

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute priority of neighboring E-UTRAN frequencies for cell reselection. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority. If it is set to No Priority, it indicates that no reselection priority is configured for this frequency. Priorities can be separately configured for different E-UTRAN carrier frequencies and UEs can perform the cell reselection procedure on the carrier frequencies that are contained in system information broadcasting messages and have reselection priorities.
item.name: interReselPrio

item.desc: This parameter sets the offset of the frequency with the same priority for inter-frequency cell reselection. It corresponds to the Qoffsetfrequency parameter defined in 3GPP TS 36.304.During the calculation of the R value of a neighbor cell for inter-frequency reselection, this parameter indicates the offset of the frequency specified by the interCarriFreq (Inter-frequency Carrier) parameter corresponding to the neighbor cell. A larger parameter value indicates a smaller R value of an inter-frequency neighbor cell and a lower probability that the UE reselects this neighbor cell. A smaller parameter value indicates a larger R value of an inter-frequency neighbor cell and a higher probability that the UE reselects this neighbor cell.
item.name: qOffsetFreq

item.desc: Specifies the minimum required quality level in the cell in dB
item.name: interFreqQqualMin

item.desc: This parameter indicates the threshold for cell reselection to a cell on a higher priority frequency. There have 2 elements fulfilled for cell reselection criteria: (1) the SnonservingCell,x of a cell of a higher priority frequency is greater than InterThresholdX_HighQ during a time interval Treselection (2) more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell. Range of the parameter is actual value which equals to the value in 36.331.
item.name: interThreshXHighQ

item.desc: This parameter indicates the threshold for cell reselection to an inter-frequency cell on a lower priority frequency. There have 3 elements fulfilled for cell reselection criteria : (1) No cell of a higher priority frequency or inter-RAT fulfills the criteria above (2) SServingCell less than ThresholdServing_LowQ and the SnonServingCell,x of a cell of a lower priority frequency is greater than InterThresholdX_LowQ during a time interval Treselection (3) more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell. For detail description please refers to TS 36.304. Range of the parameter is actual value which equals to the value in 36.331.
item.name: interThreshXLowQ

item.name: interFreqMeasPerformance

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum required receiving power level for eMTC UEs to satisfy the inter-frequency cell reselection conditions in normal coverage scenarios. It is a key parameter of S_nonServingCell,x, which is necessary for reselection to an inter-frequency neighbor cell.
item.name: eMTCInterQrxLevMin

item.desc: This parameter indicates the duration for inter-frequency eMTC cell reselection in normal coverage scenarios. According to the cell-ranking criterion R for cell reselection, a new inter-frequency EUTRAN cell can be reselected as the serving cell only when it is better ranked than the serving cell during the period specified by TreselectionInterEUTRAN.
item.name: eMTCtRslInterEutra

item.desc: This parameter indicates the high threshold for cell reselection to a non-serving cell on a high-priority frequency. The conditions for cell reselection to a high-priority cell are as follows:(1) In the period specified by Treselection, SnonservingCell,x of the high-priority cell is greater than InterThresholdX_High. (2) The duration when the eMTC UE camps on the current serving cell is more than one second. The parameter range is an actual value, equal to twice of the value specified in TS 36.331.
item.name: eMTCInterThrdXHigh

item.desc: This parameter indicates the low threshold for cell reselection to a non-serving cell on a low-priority frequency. The cell reselection criteria are as follows: The conditions for cell reselection to a low-priority cell are as follows:(1) There is no high-priority carrier frequency or inter-RAT cells meeting the conditions of the reselection to high-priority carrier frequencies. (2) In the period specified by Treselection, SServingCell is less than ThresholdServing_Low and SnonServingCell,x of the low-priority cell is greater than InterThresholdX_Low. (3) The duration when the eMTC UE camps on the current serving cell is more than one second. For details, refer to TS 36.304.The parameter range is an actual value, equal to twice of the value specified in TS 36.331.
item.name: eMTCInterThrdXLow

item.desc: This parameter indicates the priority of inter-frequency eMTC cell reselection. A smaller parameter value indicates a lower reselection priority.
item.name: eMTCInterReselPrio

item.desc: This parameter indicates the frequency offset of inter-frequency neighbor cells for eMTC cell reselection. In the cell-ranking criterion R, this parameter is used to calculate the R value of the inter-frequency neighbor cells with the same priority, Rn = Qmeas,n - Qoffset. In the case of inter-frequency: Qoffset is equal to Qoffsets,n plus Qoffsetfrequency. If Qoffsets,n is valid, Qoffset is equal to Qoffsetfrequency.
item.name: eMTCQOffsetFreq

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum required quality level for eMTC cell reselection in normal coverage scenarios.
item.name: eMTCInterFreqQqualMin

item.desc: This parameter indicates the high RSRQ threshold for cell reselection to a non-serving cell on a high-priority frequency. The conditions for cell reselection to a high-priority cell are as follows:(1) In the period specified by Treselection, SnonservingCell,x of the high-priority cell is greater than InterThresholdX_HighQ. (2) The duration when the eMTC UE camps on the current serving cell is more than one second. The parameter range is an actual value, equal to the value specified in TS 36.331.
item.name: eMTCInterThreshXHighQ

item.desc: This parameter indicates the low RSRQ threshold for cell reselection to a non-serving cell on a low-priority frequency. The cell reselection criteria are as follows: The conditions for cell reselection to a low-priority cell are as follows:(1) There is no high-priority carrier frequency or inter-RAT cells meeting the conditions of the reselection to high-priority carrier frequencies. (2) In the period specified by Treselection, SServingCell is less than ThresholdServing_LowQ and SnonServingCell,x of the low-priority cell is greater than InterThresholdX_LowQ. (3) The duration when the eMTC UE camps on the current serving cell is more than one second. For details, refer to TS 36.304.The parameter range is an actual value, equal to the value specified in TS 36.331.
item.name: eMTCInterThreshXLowQ

item.desc: This parameter sets the sub-priority for reselecting inter-frequency E-UTRAN cells. A smaller parameter value indicates a lower sub-priority.

item.desc: This parameter indicates the absolute priority of neighboring E-UTRAN frequencies for cell reselection. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority. If it is set to No Priority, it indicates that no reselection priority is configured for this frequency. Priorities can be separately configured for different E-UTRAN carrier frequencies and UEs can perform the cell reselection procedure on the carrier frequencies that are contained in system information broadcasting messages and have reselection priorities.

It's used to caculate the cell-ranking criterion Rn for neighboring cells in equeal priority inter-frequency, i.e. Rn =Qmeas,n - Qoffset .For inter-frequency: Qoffset equals to Qoffsets,n plus Qoffsetfrequency, if Qoffsets,n is valid, otherwise this equals to Qoffsetfrequency.

Range of the parameter is actual value which equals to the value in 36.331.

For detail description please refers to TS 36.304. Range of the parameter is actual value which equals to the value in 36.331.

item.desc: The parameter represents measure performance configuration of each neighbouring inter-frequency. For UE which support increased carrier monitoring E-UTRA, the reselection performance for different carriers may be configured by higher layers to be either normal or reduced. Please refer to the TS36.133(V12.4.0 or higher version).
item.name: interFreqMeasPerfExt

item.desc: This parameter indicates the minimum RSRP value Qrxlevmin (in dBm) required by the cell on this E-UTRAN inter-frequency during cell reselection for eMTC UEs in normal coverage scenarios. An eMTC UE uses this parameter to calculate the Srxlev value of the cells on the E-UTRAN inter-frequency during cell reselection evaluation. A smaller value indicates that the Srxlev value evaluated is higher and it is easier for UEs to be reselected to the cells on the E-UTRAN inter-frequency. Srxlev = Qrxlevmeas - (Qrxlevmin + Qrxlevminoffset) - max(P_EMAX_H -P_PowerClass, 0)
item.name: eMTCInterQrxLevMinExt

item.desc: This parameter indicates the duration for inter-frequency E-UTRAN cell reselection (T-reselectionEUTRA) for eMTC UEs in normal coverage scenarios. It specifies the period of time for evaluating whether a neighbor cell fulfills the reselection criteria. For example, for an inter-frequency E-UTRAN neighbor cells with the same reselection priority as the serving cell, the reselection criterion is as follows: According to the cell-ranking criterion R, the neighbor cell should be at least better ranked than the serving cell during the period specified by Treselection. A larger parameter value indicates a longer delay to evaluate whether a neighbor cell fulfills the reselection criteria, later reselection, and worse KPIs (such as a lower paging success rate, access success rate, and handover success rate). A smaller parameter value may cause earlier reselection or ping-pong reselection.
item.name: eMTCtRslInterEutraExt

item.desc: This parameter sets the Srxlev threshold (Thresh-X_LowP, in dB) used for an eMTC UE to be reselected to a lower-priority E-UTRAN frequency than the current serving frequency. This threshold should be configured for each E-UTRAN frequency separately. If the threshServingLowQ-r9 IE is not contained in SIB3, the eMTC UE is reselected to a cell on a lower-priority E-UTRAN frequency than the serving frequency if the following conditions are met: - In the period specified by T-reselectionEUTRA, Srxlev is less than Thresh-Serving_LowP in the serving cell and Srxlev is greater than Thresh-X_LowP in the inter-frequency neighbor cells. - The duration when the eMTC UE camps on the current serving cell is more than one second.
item.name: eMTCInterThrdXLowExt

item.desc: This parameter sets the Srxlev threshold (Thresh-X_HighP, in dB) used for an eMTC UE to be reselected to a higher-priority E-UTRAN frequency than the current serving frequency. This threshold should be configured for each E-UTRAN frequency separately. If the threshServingLowQ-r9 IE is not contained in SIB3, the eMTC UE is reselected to a cell on a higher-priority E-UTRAN frequency than the serving frequency if the following conditions are met: - In the period specified by T-reselectionEUTRA, Srxlev is greater than Thresh-X_HighP in the inter-frequency neighbor cells. - The duration when the eMTC UE camps on the current serving cell is more than one second.
item.name: eMTCInterThrdXHighExt

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum RSRQ value (Qqualmin, in dB) required by eMTC cells and used by eMTC UEs to calculate the cell selection criterion Squal of a neighbor cell on the E-UTRAN inter-frequency for cell reselection. Squal = Qqualmeas - (Qqualmin + Qqualminoffset), where, Qqualmeas represents the measured RSRQ value.
item.name: eMTCInterFreqQqualMinExt

item.desc: This parameter sets the Squal threshold (Thresh-X_HighQ, in dB) used for an eMTC UE to be reselected to a higher-priority E-UTRAN frequency than the current serving frequency. This threshold should be configured for each E-UTRAN frequency separately. If the threshServingLowQ-r9 IE is contained in SIB3, the UE is reselected to a cell on a higher-priority E-UTRAN frequency than the serving frequency if the following conditions are met: - In the period specified by T-reselectionEUTRA, Squal is greater than Thresh-X_HighQ in the inter-frequency neighbor E-UTRAN cells. - The duration when the eMTC UE camps on the current serving cell is more than one second.
item.name: eMTCInterThreshXHighQExt

item.desc: This parameter sets the frequency-specific offset (Qoffset_frequency) for the E-UTRAN frequencies with the same priority. In the following cases, an eMTC UE selects the top N cells according to the cell-ranking criterion R of each cell for intra-frequency cell reselection:(1) Intra-frequency cell reselection,(2) Reselection to an E-UTRAN inter-frequency with the same priority as the serving frequency,(3) There are more than one candidate neighbor cells when the eMTC UE is reselected to high/low-priority E-UTRAN frequencies. For a neighbor cell, the formula is Rn = Qmeas_n - Qoffset. For an inter-frequency neighbor cell, the formula is Qoffset = Qoffset_s_n + Qoffset_frequency, where, Qoffset_s_n indicates the specific offset for the neighbor cell.
item.name: eMTCQOffsetFreqExt

item.desc: This parameter indicates the absolute priorities of neighboring E-UTRAN frequencies for cell reselection, ranging from 0 to 7 (0 for the lowest priority and 7 for the highest priority). This parameter should be configured for each E-UTRAN frequency separately and the inter-RAT (E-UTRAN, UTRAN, GERAN, and CDMA2000) priorities can not be the same. An eMTC UE performs cell reselection evaluation only on the E-UTRAN frequencies that are contained in system broadcasting information and provide reselection priorities for UEs.
item.name: eMTCInterReselPrioExt

item.desc: This parameter sets the Srxlev threshold (Thresh-X_LowP, in dB) used for an eMTC UE to be reselected to a lower-priority E-UTRAN frequency than the current serving frequency. This threshold should be configured for each E-UTRAN frequency separately. If the threshServingLowQ-r9 IE is contained in SIB3, the UE is reselected to a cell on a lower-priority E-UTRAN frequency than the serving frequency if the following conditions are met: - In the period specified by T-reselectionEUTRA, Squal is less than Thresh-Serving_LowQ in the serving cell and Squal is greater than Thresh-X_LowQ in the inter-frequency E-UTRAN neighbor cells. - The duration when the eMTC UE camps on the current serving cell is more than one second.
item.name: eMTCInterThreshXLowQExt

item.desc: This parameter sets the sub-priority for reselecting inter-frequency E-UTRAN cells. A smaller parameter value indicates a lower sub-priority.

item.desc: This parameter sets a list of carrier frequencies of UTRAN FDD cells. It is an array parameter consisting of 16 elements. Each 4G cell can be configured with a maximum 16 carrier frequencies of UTRAN FDD cells. Each element of this array parameter indicates a target UTRAN carrier frequency for cell reselection of 4G UEs.
item.name: utranCarriFreq

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute priority for reselecting neighbor UTRAN FDD cells. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority. If it is set to No Priority, it indicates that no reselection priority is configured for this frequency. Priorities can be separately configured for UTRAN FDD carrier frequencies and UEs can perform the cell reselection procedure on the carrier frequencies that are contained in system information broadcasting messages and have reselection priorities.
item.name: utranReselPriority

item.desc: The parameter indicates the minimum required received power level of UTRAN FDD cell which satisfies the condition of being reselected by UE It is a key parameter of SnonServingCell,x which is necessary to calculate for reselection to a UTRAN FDD neighbour cell Range of the parameter is actual value which equals to double of value in 36331 plus 1
item.name: qRxLevMin

item.desc: The parameter indicates the threshold for cell reselection to a higher priority UTRAN FDD cell There have 2 elements fulfilled for cell reselection criteria: (1) the SnonservingCell,x of a higher priority UTRAN FDD cell is greater than utran_ThreshX_High _FDD during a time interval Treselection (2) more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell
item.name: threshXHigh

item.desc: The parameter indicates the threshold for cell reselection to a lower priority frequency UTRAN FDD cell There have 3 elements fulfilled for cell reselection criteria : (1) No cell of a higher priority frequency or inter-RAT fulfills the criteria above (2) SServingCell less than ThresholdServing_Low and the SnonServingCell,x of a lower priority UTRAN FDD cell is greater than utran_ThreshX_Low _FDD during a time interval Treselection (3) more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell
item.name: threshXLow

item.desc: The parameter indicates Mximum TX power level which an UE may use when accessing the cell on RACH utran_Pmax_FDD is used for UTRAN FDD neighbour cell reselection
item.name: pMaxUTRA

item.desc: The parameter indicates the minimum quality requirement of UTRAN FDD cell which satisfies the condition of being reselected by UE It is a key parameter of SnonServingCell,x which is necessary to calculate for reselection to a UTRAN FDD neighbour cell
item.name: qQualMin

item.desc: This specifies the Squal threshold (in dB) used by the UE when reselecting towards a higher priority RAT/ frequency than the current serving frequency Each frequency of E-UTRAN and UTRAN FDD might have a specific threshold
item.name: utranThrXHighQFdd

item.desc: This specifies the Srxlev threshold (in dB) used by the UE when reselecting towards a lower priority RAT/ frequency than the current serving frequency Each frequency of E-UTRAN and UTRAN, each group of GERAN frequencies, each band class of CDMA2000 HRPD and CDMA2000 1xRTT might have a specific threshold
item.name: utranThrXLowQFdd

item.desc: This parameter sets the frequency band indicators for reselection from LTE cells to GERAN cells. It is an array parameter consisting of 16 elements. Elements 0 to 15 indicate the frequency bands where the downlink carrier frequencies of the 16 target GERAN frequencies are.
item.name: bandIndicator

item.desc: This parameter sets the format indicators of the remaining ARFCNs for LTE-to-GERAN cell reselection. It is an array parameter consisting of 16 elements. Elements 0 through 15 indicate the format indicators of the remaining ARFCNs corresponding to the 16 target GERAN frequencies. There are two types of format indicators of the remaining ARFCNs: explicitly and equally spaced.
item.name: followARFCNInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the equally spaced ARFCNs for LTE-to-GERAN cell reselection. It is an array parameter consisting of 16 elements. Elements 0 through 15 indicate the equally spaced ARFCNs corresponding to the 16 target GERAN frequencies in turn.
item.name: arfcnSpacing

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of equally spaced ARFCNs for LTE-to-GERAN cell reselection. It is an array parameter consisting of 16 elements. Elements 0 through 15 indicate the numbers of equally spaced ARFCNs corresponding to the 16 target GERAN frequencies in turn.
item.name: followARFCNNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum receive level for LTE-to-GERAN cell reselection. It is an array parameter consisting of 16 elements. Elements 0 through 15 indicate the minimum receive levels for reselecting to GERAN cells on the 16 target GERAN frequencies in turn. If the receive level of a cell on a target GERAN frequency is higher than or equal to the corresponding element value, the cell can be selected as a target for cell reselection.
item.name: qRxLevMin

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of 16 elements. Elements 0 through 15 indicate the maximum available uplink transmit power of UEs on the 16 GERAN frequencies in turn. It is used for inter-RAT GERAN neighbor cell reselection.
item.name: pMaxGERAN

item.desc: This parameter sets the low thresholds for reselecting to high-priority GERAN cells. It is an array parameter consisting of 16 elements. Elements 0 through 15 indicate the low thresholds for reselecting to 16 high-priority target GERAN frequencies. If the signal quality level of a cell on a target frequency is higher than or equal to the corresponding element value, the cell can be selected as a target for cell reselection.
item.name: geranThreshXHigh

item.desc: This parameter sets the low thresholds for reselecting to high-priority GERAN cells. It is an array parameter consisting of 16 elements. Elements 0 through 15 indicate the low thresholds for reselecting to the 16 high-priority target GERAN frequencies. If the signal quality level of a cell on a target frequency is higher than or equal to the corresponding element value, the cell can be selected as a target for cell reselection.
item.name: geranThreshXLow

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute priority for reselecting neighbor GERAN cells. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority. If it is set to No Priority, it indicates that no reselection priority is configured for this frequency. Priorities can be separately configured for GERAN carrier frequencies and UEs can perform the cell reselection procedure on the carrier frequencies that are contained in system information broadcasting messages and have reselection priorities.
item.name: geranReselectionPriority

item.desc: This parameter sets the Network Color Codes (NCCs) corresponding to the inter-RAT GERAN cell reselection frequency groups. It is an array parameter consisting of 16 elements for low-priority GERAN cell reselection. Elements 0 through 15 indicate whether the broadcast channels of the 16 GERAN frequencies are traced. Each element has eight bits that correspond to broadcast channels 1 through 8 in turn. If a bit is set to 0, it indicates that the broadcast channel of the corresponding frequency is not traced. If a bit is set to 1, it indicates that the broadcast channel of the corresponding frequency is traced.
item.name: nccPermitInd

item.desc: This parameter sets a list of start ARFCNs. It is an array parameter consisting of 16 elements. It is used to configure the target frequencies for LTE-to-GERAN reselection. Elements 0 through 15 indicate the start ARFCNs of the 16 target GERAN frequencies for resection.
item.name: startARFCN

item.name: tReselNrRSFM

item.desc: This parameter indicates the reselection timer scale factor at high speed. When UE is in high speed state, the timer of reselection to NR system cell needs to be multiplied by the parameter value to scale.

If it is set to Open, system broadcasting information carries the IE. If it is set to Close, system broadcasting information does not carry the IE.

item.desc: Index for NR Frequencies. 'only for ITRAN'
item.name: freqRslCfgIndex

item.desc: This parameter sets a list of indicators of the frequency bands where uplink and downlink carrier frequencies are. It is an array parameter consisting of eight elements. Each element indicates an indicator of the frequency band where uplink and downlink carrier frequencies are. During 4G-to-5G reselection, the uplink and downlink carrier frequencies of a cell must belong to the same frequency band.
item.name: band

item.desc: This parameter sets a list of NR SSB frequencies. It is an array parameter consisting of eight elements. Each element indicates an NR SSB frequency for 4G-to-5G reselection.
item.name: nrCarriFreq

item.desc: This parameter sets the SSB sub-carrier spacing.
item.name: sSBSCS

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute priority for reselecting neighbor NR cells. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority. If it is set to No Priority, it indicates that no reselection priority is configured for this frequency. Priorities can be separately configured for NR carrier frequencies and UEs can perform the cell reselection procedure on the carrier frequencies that are contained in system information broadcasting messages and have reselection priorities.
item.name: nrReselPrio

item.desc: This parameter indicates the high threshold for cell reselection to a non-serving cell on a high-priority frequency. The conditions for cell reselection to a high-priority cell are as follows:(1) In the period specified by Treselection, SnonservingCell,x of the high-priority cell is greater than InterThresholdX_High. (2) The duration when the UE camps on the current serving cell is more than one second. The parameter range is an actual value, equal to twice of the value specified in TS 36.331.
item.name: nrThrdXHigh

item.desc: This parameter indicates the low threshold for cell reselection to a non-serving cell on a low-priority frequency. The cell reselection criteria are as follows: The conditions for cell reselection to a low-priority cell are as follows:(1) There is no high-priority carrier frequency or inter-RAT cells meeting the conditions of the reselection to high-priority carrier frequencies. (2) In the period specified by Treselection, SServingCell is less than ThresholdServing_Low and SnonServingCell,x of the low-priority cell is greater than InterThresholdX_Low. (3) The duration when the UE camps on the current serving cell is more than one second. For details, refer to TS 36.304.The parameter range is an actual value, equal to twice of the value specified in TS 36.331.
item.name: nrThrdXLow

item.desc: This parameter indicates the high RSRQ threshold for cell reselection to a non-serving cell on a high-priority frequency. The conditions for cell reselection to a high-priority cell are as follows:(1) In the period specified by Treselection, SnonservingCell,x of the high-priority cell is greater than InterThresholdX_HighQ. (2) The duration when the UE camps on the current serving cell is more than one second.
item.name: nrThrdXHighQ

item.desc: This parameter indicates the low RSRQ threshold for cell reselection to a non-serving cell on a low-priority frequency. The cell reselection criteria are as follows: The conditions for cell reselection to a low-priority cell are as follows:(1) There is no high-priority carrier frequency or inter-RAT cells meeting the conditions of the reselection to high-priority carrier frequencies. (2) In the period specified by Treselection, SServingCell is less than ThresholdServing_LowQ and SnonServingCell,x of the low-priority cell is greater than InterThresholdX_LowQ. (3) The duration when the UE camps on the current serving cell is more than one second.
item.name: nrThrdXLowQ

item.desc: Inter_Pmax is the maximum uplink available transmit power configured for UEs. It is related to the UE type. Inter_Pmax is used for NR neighboring E-UTRA cell reselection. If Inter_Pmax is absent, the maximum power depends on the UE capability.
item.name: nrPmax

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum received power level for the NR cells that satisfy the conditions of being reselected by UEs. It is a key parameter of SnonServingCell,x, which is necessary for reselection to an NR neighbor cell.
item.name: qrxLevMin

item.desc: This parameter sets the sub-priority of NR cell reselection. A smaller parameter value indicates a lower reselection sub-priority.
item.name: nrReselSubPrio

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum quality level for the NR cells that satisfy the conditions of being reselected by UEs. It is a key parameter of SnonServingCell,x that is calculated for the reselection to an NR neighbor cell.
item.name: qQualMin1

item.desc: This parameter indicates the absolute RSRP threshold for NR cell measurement. Only the beams whose RSRP is higher than this threshold can be used for RSRP calculation for NR cells.
item.name: sSBConsolidationRSRPThr1

item.desc: This parameter indicates the absolute RSRQ threshold for NR cell measurement. Only the beams whose RSRP is higher than this threshold can be used for RSRP calculation for NR cells.
item.name: sSBConsolidationRSRQThr1

item.desc: This parameter sets the end symbol for RSSI measurement. When the symbol specified by this parameter is detected during an RSSI measurement, the RSSI measurement ends.
item.name: rSSIMeasEndSymbol

item.desc: This parameter sets the subframe offset for SSB frequency measurement. In an SSB measurement period of a UE, the UE measures the SSB frequency based on the subframe location corresponding to this parameter value. If the parameter value is larger than the actual period, the actual subframe offset position is determined based on the mode SSB period when the actual value is sent to UE.
item.name: sSBMeasSubframeOffset

item.desc: This parameter sets the time slots for a UE to perform RSSI measurement. From left to right, the first bit corresponds to the first slot in the SMTC window, the second bit corresponds to the second slot in the SMTC window, the third bit corresponds to the third slot in the SMTC window, and so on. A UE measures the time slots that are set to 1 in the bitmap but does not measure the time slots that are set to 0.
item.name: rSSIMeasSlots

item.desc: This parameter indicates whether the frame boundaries of all the cells on the frequency are the same. If it is set to 1, it indicates that the frame boundaries are the same. If it is set to 0, it indicates that the frame boundaries are different from each other.
item.name: deriveSSBIndexFromCell

item.desc: This parameter sets the time-domain bitmap position for idle frequency-level SSB measurement. If it is set to 1, the corresponding beams need to be measured; if it is set to 0, the corresponding beams do not need to be measured.
item.name: sSBToMeasBitmap

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of SSBs required for NR cell measurement by UEs. It is used for the UEs to evaluate the quality of NR cells during the reselection from LTE cells to NR cells. A larger parameter value indicates that the number of SSBs involved in measurement and evaluation is larger and it is more difficult to reselect cells. A smaller parameter value indicates that the number of SSBs involved in measurement and evaluation is smaller and it is easier to reselect cells.
item.name: maxRSIndexCellQual

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval for SSB frequency measurement by UEs. A larger parameter value indicates less frequent SSB measurement.
item.name: sSBMeasPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the measurement duration of a UE within an SSB measurement period. If the actual duration for SSB transmission increases, this parameter should be set to a larger value. If the actual duration for SSB transmission decreases, this parameter should be set to a smaller value.
item.name: sSBMeasDuration

item.desc: This parameter indicates the SFN difference between 4G and 5G systems on each 5G frequency. The parameter value is calculated as follows: (4G SFN - 5G SFN) mod 1024.
item.name: systemFrameNumberOffset

item.desc: This parameter sets the offset of the frame boundary of 4G and 5G base stations on each 5G frequency. It indicates the system time difference between 4G frequencies and 5G frequencies. The parameter value is calculated by the following function: floor[(start position of the 4G frame header (in ms) - start position of the 5G frame header (in ms))/(5 x Ts)], where Ts is 1/30720 ms.
item.name: frameBoundaryOffset

item.desc: This parameter determines whether there are NR cells that correspond to the NR reselection frequency and whose clock synchronization mode is loose synchronization. If yes, this parameter is set to Yes. If not, this parameter is set to No.
item.name: nrFreqLooseSyncInd

item.desc: This parameter sets whether there are cells that are on an NR frequency used for idle UEs and support RedCap UEs of specific types. It consists of two elements that indicate whether there are cells that are on the NR frequency and support RedCap UEs with 1Rx antennas and 2Rx antennas respectively. If the value of an element is 1, it indicates that there are such cells. If the value of an element is 0, it indicates that there are no such cells. For example, if the parameter value is 01, it indicates that there are cells that are on an NR frequency used for idle UEs and support RedCap UEs with 2Rx antennas and there is no cell that is on an NR frequency used for idle UEs or supports RedCap UEs with 1Rx antennas.
item.name: idleRedCapUeSupTypeBitmap

item.desc: This parameter sets ARP scheduling weights. It is used for priority calculation. An array subscript plus 1 corresponds to an ARP level; that is, array element 0 corresponds to the weight of ARP 1.
item.name: weightARP

item.desc: This parameter sets the weight of the services with different priorities. It is used by the wDlSrvPriLv field in the R_QOS table to index the corresponding priority weight value. A lager parameter value indicates a higher priority.
item.name: weightSRVDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the weight of the services with different priorities. It is used by the wUlSrvPriLv field in the R_QOS table to index the corresponding priority weight value. A lager parameter value indicates a higher priority.
item.name: weightSRVUl

item.desc: This parameter indicates the EPF scheduling factor for each SPID. When SPID weighing of the EPF algorithm is enabled, a larger SPID factor value indicates a higher priority of the UE corresponding to the SPID and more chances for scheduling.
item.name: fFSPID

item.desc: This parameter sets the EPF scheduling factor for non-SPID UEs. If the SPID weight of the EPF algorithm is enabled, it is used to adjust the scheduling priority of a UE. A larger SPID factor value indicates a higher priority of the UE.
item.name: nonSpidFFSPID

item.desc: The weight of service sub-fair factor used for priority calculation
item.name: serviceWeight

item.desc: The EPF algorithm needs new SPID factors. This parameter determines whether an SPID is valid and sets the effective weight value. A larger parameter value indicates a larger SPID weight value and a better reflection of the difference in scheduling guarantee for different SPIDs.
item.name: sPIDWeight

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables short-interval SPS. If it is set to Close, short-interval SPS corresponding to the QCI is disabled. If it is set to Short SPS-Interval, short-interval SPS corresponding to the QCI is enabled.
item.name: sPSSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines the period for AMBR Limit.
item.name: perTimer4AMBRLimt

item.desc: This parameter indicates the Guarantee QCI number of cell.
item.name: guaQCINum

item.desc: This parameter indicates the Guarantee QCI.The actual size of the array is same as Guarantee QCI Number of cell. The value 1 indicates QCI1,the value 2 indicates QCI2,and so on.
item.name: guaQCIInd

item.desc: This parameter indicates the Guarantee QCI number for AMBR limit judging threshold, corresponding to the QCI which Guarantee QCI Indicator of AMBR Limit indicated.
item.name: ambrLimtGuaQCINum

item.desc: This parameter indicates the Guarantee QCI Number percent for AMBR recover judging.
item.name: ambrRecQCINumPerc

item.desc: This parameter indicates the downlink PRB threshold for AMBR limit judging threshold. The juding threshold can be configured two level value, corresponding to the first array element and the second array element respectively,and the first level value should be smaller than the second level value.
item.name: prbThrd4AMBRLimtDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink PRB usage threshold for uplink AMBR limiting decision. It is an array parameter consisting of three elements. The first element through the third element of the array parameter indicate the first threshold through the third threshold in ascending order for uplink AMBR limiting decision. If the uplink PRB usage of a cell falls into the following ranges in turn, the rate limiting intensity of UEs increases accordingly: larger than the first element and smaller than or equal to the second element, larger than the second element and smaller than or equal to the third element, and larger than the third element.
item.name: prbThrd4AMBRLimtUl

item.desc: This parameter indicates the downlink PBR threshold for AMBR recover judging threshold. The juding threshold can be configured two level value,the first level value should be smaller than the second level value,and corresponding to the first array element and the second array element respectively.
item.name: prbThrd4AMBRRecDl

item.desc: This parameter indicates the uplink PBR threshold for AMBR recover judging threshold. The juding threshold can be configured two level value, the first level value should be smaller than the second level value, and corresponding to the first array element and the second array element respectively..
item.name: prbThrd4AMBRRecUl

item.desc: This parameter indicates the condition for AMBR rate limit. If it is set to 0, it indicates that the rate is limited based on the number of guaranteed QCIs; if it is set to 1, it indicates that the rate is limited based on the number of guaranteed QCIs to be scheduled.
item.name: ambrLimitTrigger

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of guaranteed DL QCIs to be scheduled. If the threshold is exceeded, downlink AMBR rate limiting will be triggered.
item.name: ambrLimtGuaQCIWaitNumDL

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of UEs waiting to be scheduled for guaranteed uplink QCIs. If the threshold is exceeded, uplink AMBR rate limiting will be triggered.
item.name: ambrLimtGuaQCIWaitUeNumUL

item.desc: This parameter indicates the number of rate-limiting SPIDs in a cell. If the rates of SPIDs need to be limited, this parameter is modified based on the number of SPIDs whose rates need to be limited.
item.name: limitSPIDNum

item.desc: This parameter indicates the SPID type of rate-limiting services in a cell. The actual size of the array is the same as the number of SPIDs for rate limit, 1 for SPID1, 2 for SPID2, 3 for SPID3, and so on.
item.name: limitSPIDInd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables guaranteed QCI-triggered rate limit. If it is set to 1, rate limit is triggered based on the number of guaranteed QCIs. If it is set to 0, rate limit is triggered only by the PRB usage of the cell instead of the number of guaranteed QCIs.
item.name: guaQCITriggerSwitch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the determination of the AMBR rate limiting gear based on the number of UEs in cells. If it is set to Open, the system determines which rate limiting gear is used based on both PRB utilization and the number of UEs with RRC connections. If it is set to Close, the system determines which rate limiting gear is used based on only PRB utilization.
item.name: rRCThrd4AMBRLimtSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the number of UEs with RRC connections. It is used for enabling downlink AMBR rate limiting. Three threshold values can be configured, corresponding to the first, second, and third array element separately. The first threshold value is smaller than the second threshold value, and the second threshold value is smaller than the third threshold value.
item.name: rRCThrd4AMBRLimtDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the number of UEs with RRC connections. It is used for enabling uplink AMBR rate limiting. Three threshold values can be configured, corresponding to the first, second, and third array element separately. The first threshold value is smaller than the second threshold value, and the second threshold value is smaller than the third threshold value.
item.name: rRCThrd4AMBRLimtUl

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the number of UEs with RRC connections. It is used for disabling downlink AMBR rate limiting. Three threshold values can be configured, corresponding to the first, second, and third array element separately. The first threshold value is smaller than the second threshold value, and the second threshold value is smaller than the third threshold value.
item.name: rRCThrd4AMBRRecDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the number of UEs with RRC connections. It is used for disabling uplink AMBR rate limiting. Three threshold values can be configured, corresponding to the first, second, and third array element separately. The first threshold value is smaller than the second threshold value, and the second threshold value is smaller than the third threshold value.
item.name: rRCThrd4AMBRRecUl

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables AMBR rate limit for UEs. It is used to determine whether the downlink traffic of UEs is restricted by the AMBR. If it is set to Open, the maximum downlink traffic of UEs can exceed the AMBR limit. If it is set to Close, the maximum downlink traffic of UEs cannot exceed the AMBR limit.
item.name: aMBRNoLimitSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum transmission rate of UEs after AMBR limiting is removed. It is the AMBR of UEs if the aMBRNoLimitSwch (Switch for Removing AMBR Rate Limit) parameter is set to 1 (Open).
item.name: aMBRRate4NoLimit

item.desc: This parameter indicates the rate-limiting coefficient of the rate-limiting ARP services in a cell. The actual size of the array is the same as the number of ARPs for rate limit. The first element value 0.1 in the memory indicates the rate-limiting coefficient 0.1 corresponding to the first ARP index of the Rate-Limiting ARP Indicator of AMBR Limit array parameter.That means, if an ARP rate-limiting coefficient is configured, a user establishes a bearer containing the rate-limiting QCI, and the ARP of the bearer is the first ARP index of the Rate-Limiting ARP Indicator of AMBR Limit array parameter. In this case, the rate limit of this kind of users is the rate limit value multiplied by 0.1.
item.name: limitARPCoef

item.desc: This parameter indicates the number of frequencies for the users of category 0.
item.name: expHoTarFreqNum4Cate0

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of three elements that indicate the optimized-measurement timers of preferential frequencies for three types of category 0 UEs whose services are guaranteed by the eNodeB: UEs of type 1 (voice services are guaranteed), UEs of type 2 (uplink data services are guaranteed), and UEs of type 3 (downlink data services are guaranteed). After the eNodeB delivers an optimized-measurement task of preferential frequencies to a UE, it starts the timer corresponding to the UE to wait for the measurement report. If the eNodeB receives a measurement report about the preferential frequencies before the timer expires, it selects a target neighbor cell based on the measurement report to trigger a handover procedure. When the timer expires, the eNodeB deletes the optimized-measurement task of preferential frequencies of the UE.
item.name: measTimerBasedCate0

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of three elements that indicate the optimized-measurement configuration indexes of preferential frequencies for three types of category 0 UEs whose services are guaranteed by the eNodeB: UEs of type 1 (voice services are guaranteed), UEs of type 2 (uplink data services are guaranteed), and UEs of type 3 (downlink data services are guaranteed). For a measurement configuration index, the eNodeB delivers an optimized-measurement task for preferential-frequency measurement to the type of UE corresponding to the measurement configuration index. After receiving the measurement report about the preferential frequency, the eNodeB selects a target neighbor cell to trigger a handover procedure.
item.name: expHoMeasCfgIndx4Cate0

item.desc: This parameter sets the A1 RSRP threshold offset to disable inter-frequency/inter-RAT measurement for the data users of category 0. The A1 RSRP threshold to disable inter-frequency/inter-RAT measurement for the data users of category 0 is the sum of this parameter value and the A1 RSRP threshold to disable inter-frequency/inter-RAT measurement for the ordinary data users.
item.name: a1RsrpOff4DTCate0

item.desc: This parameter sets the A1 RSRP threshold offset to disable inter-frequency/inter-RAT measurement for the voice users of category 0. The A1 RSRP threshold to disable inter-frequency/inter-RAT measurement for the voice users of category 0 is the sum of this parameter value and the A1 RSRP threshold to disable inter-frequency/inter-RAT measurement for the ordinary voice users.
item.name: a1RsrpOff4VTCate0

item.desc: This parameter sets the A2 RSRP threshold offset to enable inter-frequency measurement for the data users of category 0. The A2 RSRP threshold to enable inter-frequency measurement for the data users of category 0 is the sum of this parameter value and the A2 RSRP threshold to enable inter-frequency measurement for the ordinary data users.
item.name: opeInterFA2RsrpOff4DTCate0

item.desc: This parameter sets the A2 RSRP threshold offset to enable inter-frequency measurement for the voice users of category 0. The A2 RSRP threshold to enable inter-frequency measurement for the voice users of category 0 is the sum of this parameter value and the A2 RSRP threshold to enable inter-frequency measurement for the ordinary voice users.
item.name: opeInterFA2RsrpOff4VTCate0

item.desc: This parameter sets the A2 RSRP threshold offset to enable inter-RAT measurement for the data users of category 0. The A2 RSRP threshold to enable inter-RAT measurement for the data users of category 0 is the sum of this parameter value and the A2 RSRP threshold to enable inter-RAT measurement for the ordinary data users.
item.name: opeRatA2RsrpOff4DTCate0

item.desc: This parameter sets the A2 RSRP threshold offset to enable inter-RAT measurement for the voice users of category 0. The A2 RSRP threshold to enable inter-RAT measurement for the voice users of category 0 is the sum of this parameter value and the A2 RSRP threshold to enable inter-RAT measurement for the ordinary voice users.
item.name: opeRatA2RsrpOff4VTCate0

item.desc: This parameter determines whether A1/A2 measurement takes effect for the users of category 0. If it is set to Close, the A1/A2 measurement of the users of category 0 is the same as that of ordinary users. If it is set to Open, special A1/A2 measurement is enabled for the users of category 0.
item.name: a1A2BasedCate0EffectSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the A1 RSRP threshold offset to disable inter-frequency/inter-RAT measurement for the video users of category 0. The A1 RSRP threshold to disable inter-frequency/inter-RAT measurement for the video users of category 0 is the sum of this parameter value and the A1 RSRP threshold to disable inter-frequency/inter-RAT measurement for the ordinary video users.
item.name: a1RsrpOff4VDCate0

item.desc: This parameter sets the A2 RSRP threshold offset to enable inter-frequency measurement for the video users of category 0. The A2 RSRP threshold to enable inter-frequency measurement for the video users of category 0 is the sum of this parameter value and the A2 RSRP threshold to enable inter-frequency measurement for the ordinary video users.
item.name: opeInterFA2RsrpOff4VDCate0

item.desc: This parameter sets the A2 RSRP threshold offset to enable inter-RAT measurement for the video users of category 0. The A2 RSRP threshold to enable inter-RAT measurement for the video users of category 0 is the sum of this parameter value and the A2 RSRP threshold to enable inter-RAT measurement for the ordinary video users.
item.name: opeRatA2RsrpOff4VDCate0

item.desc: This parameter determines whether uplink data users and downlink data users use different A1/A2 thresholds. If it is set to Close, uplink data users and downlink data users use the same A1/A2 threshold. If it is set to Open, uplink data users and downlink data users use different A1/A2 thresholds.
item.name: a1a2Diff4ULDLDTSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the A1 RSRP threshold offset to disable inter-frequency/inter-RAT measurement for the downlink data users of category 0. The A1 RSRP threshold to disable inter-frequency/inter-RAT measurement for the downlink data users of category 0 is the sum of this parameter value and the A1 RSRP threshold to disable inter-frequency/inter-RAT measurement for the ordinary data users. This parameter is valid only when the ucA1A2Diff4ULDLDTSwch parameter is set to Open.
item.name: a1RsrpOff4DLDTCate0

item.desc: This parameter sets the A2 RSRP threshold offset to enable inter-frequency measurement for the downlink data users of category 0. The A2 RSRP threshold to enable inter-frequency measurement for the downlink data users of category 0 is the sum of this parameter value and the A2 RSRP threshold to enable inter-frequency measurement for the ordinary data users. This parameter is valid only when the ucA1A2Diff4ULDLDTSwch parameter is set to Open.
item.name: a2RsrpOff4DLDTCate0

item.desc: This parameter determines whether voice and video users use different A1/A2 thresholds. If it is set to Close, voice and video users use the same A1/A2 threshold. If it is set to Open, voice and video users use different A1/A2 thresholds.
item.name: a1A2Diff4VTVDSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRP threshold offset of the serving cell for the users of category 1 in coverage-based SRVCC to GERAN. The RSRP threshold of the serving cell for the users of category 1 in coverage-based SRVCC to GERAN is the sum of this parameter value and the RSRP threshold of the serving cell for ordinary voice users in coverage-based SRVCC to GERAN.
item.name: srvccRsrpoff4GERANcate1

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRQ threshold offset of the serving cell for the users of category 1 in coverage-based SRVCC to GERAN. The RSRQ threshold of the serving cell for the users of category 1 in coverage-based SRVCC to GERAN is the sum of this parameter value and the RSRQ threshold of the serving cell for ordinary voice users in coverage-based SRVCC to GERAN.
item.name: srvccRsrqoff4GERANcate1

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold offset of neighbor cells for the users of category 1 in coverage-based SRVCC to GERAN. The threshold of neighbor cells for the users of category 1 in coverage-based SRVCC to GERAN is the sum of this parameter value and the threshold of neighbor cells for ordinary voice users in coverage-based SRVCC to GERAN.
item.name: srvccNbrTrdoff4GERANcate1

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRP threshold offset of the serving cell for the users of category 1 in coverage-based SRVCC to UTRAN. The RSRP threshold of the serving cell for the users of category 1 in coverage-based SRVCC to UTRAN is the sum of this parameter value and the RSRP threshold of the serving cell for ordinary voice users in coverage-based SRVCC to UTRAN.
item.name: srvccRsrpoff4UTRANcate1

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRQ threshold offset of the serving cell for the users of category 1 in coverage-based SRVCC to UTRAN. The RSRQ threshold of the serving cell for the users of category 1 in coverage-based SRVCC to UTRAN is the sum of this parameter value and the RSRQ threshold of the serving cell for ordinary voice users in coverage-based SRVCC to UTRAN.
item.name: srvccRsrqoff4UTRANcate1

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSCP threshold offset of neighbor cells for the users of category 1 in coverage-based SRVCC to UTRAN. The RSCP threshold of neighbor cells for the users of category 1 in coverage-based SRVCC to UTRAN is the sum of this parameter value and the RSCP threshold of neighbor cells for ordinary voice users in coverage-based SRVCC to UTRAN.
item.name: srvccRscpoff4UTRANcate1

item.desc: This parameter sets the Ec/No threshold offset of neighbor cells for the users of category 1 in coverage-based SRVCC to UTRAN. The Ec/No threshold of neighbor cells for the users of category 1 in coverage-based SRVCC to UTRAN is the sum of this parameter value and the Ec/No threshold of neighbor cells for ordinary voice users in coverage-based SRVCC to UTRAN.
item.name: srvccEcNooff4UTRANcate1
