item.desc: Reserved parameter11.
item.name: reserveParam11

item.desc: Reserved parameter12.
item.name: reserveParam12

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the downlink general QoS function. If it is set to Open, specific types of downlink services can be provided with a special guarantee. If it is set to Close, no special guarantee is provided.
item.name: generalQosSwitch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the type of the downlink services that need to be preferentially guaranteed in a high traffic scenario. If there are a large number of RRC users, this parameter indicates the only service type that needs to be guaranteed for the generalized QoS.
item.name: dlPriorityGuarType

item.desc: This parameter indicates the downlink PBR window compensation and is used to change the largest amount of downlink PBR window compensation.
item.name: dlPbrCompensationLimit

item.desc: This parameter sets the SPID types of the UEs for which resource scheduling is restricted. It is an array parameter consisting of three elements. Each element represents the type number of a SPID of the UEs for which resource scheduling is restricted. The value 0 indicates an invalid value. If an element is set to a non-zero value, it indicates that the resource scheduling of the UEs with the corresponding SPID is restricted. For the UEs with the SPIDs specified by this array parameter, the maximum proportion of RBs that can be scheduled is determined by the MaxRBRatio4LimitedSPID (Maximum Ratio of NGBR RBs for Restricted SPID Types) parameter.
item.name: limitSPIDTypeCode

item.desc: This parameter sets the upper proportion threshold for resource allocation of the UEs with the restricted SPIDs. It is an array parameter consisting of three elements. The three elements of this array parameter correspond to the three elements of the limitSPIDTypeCode (Type Code of Restricted SPIDs) array parameter, and each element represents the maximum proportion of available RBs for NGBR services of the UEs with the corresponding SPIDs.
item.name: maxRBRatio4LimitedSPID

item.desc: This parameter sets the total number of restricted SPID types based on the number of restricted SPID types. Up to three restricted SPID types can be configured. If the number of restricted SPID types is 0, proportional scheduling of SPID resources is disabled.
item.name: limitedSPIDTypeNum

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the general QoS in the uplink. If this parameter is set to Open, the eNodeB identifies the UEs that send the uplink packets with a specified length, so that it can preferentially allocate uplink RB resources to such UEs. If this parameter is set to Close, the eNodeB cannot identify the UEs that send the uplink packets with a specified length, and therefore the uplink rate of these UEs cannot be guaranteed.
item.name: generalQoSULSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval for scheduling two adjacent TBs on LCG3 for UEs. If the actual scheduling interval exceeds this parameter value, TB identification is considered to fail and TBs need to be identified again.
item.name: interval4AdjacentULTB

item.desc: This parameter sets the accumulated size of uplink TBs on LCG3 of UEs. If the accumulated size of TBs scheduled in the uplink of a UE exceeds this parameter value, the UE is identified as a guaranteed user.
item.name: accumuULTB

item.desc: This parameter sets the upper limit of the accumulated size of uplink TBs on LCG3 of UEs. If the accumulated size of TBs scheduled in the uplink of a UE exceeds this threshold, the guarantee for the UE stops.
item.name: accumuULTBUpperLimit

item.desc: This parameter sets the type of uplink guaranteed UE. If the uplink generalized QoS function is enabled, the eNodeB identifies a type of UE as guaranteed UEs based on the requested uplink data volume. This parameter sets the type of guarantee parameter used by this type of guaranteed UE. The PBR adjustment values vary with the types of guarantee parameters.
item.name: trafULType4Guar

item.desc: This parameter sets the SBR usage indicator for general QoS. If the general QoS function is enabled and this parameter is set to 0, the following formula holds true: PBR = PBR + SBR. If this parameter is set to 1, the following formula holds true: PBR = max(PBR,SBR).
item.name: sbrUseMethodInd

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to grant the PBR as an extra rate in the uplink and downlink at the same time or separately. When the PBR is granted as an extra rate, for example, in the downlink, and the ePF algorithm is used, the PBR can be extra increased, compared with the scenario where this function is disabled under the same conditions (such as the MLP NGBR bearer and the same channel quality).
item.name: pbrExtraRateSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the uplink big-BSR UEs identified by general QoS are handed over to other cells. If it is set to Open, uplink big-BSR UEs identified by general QoS are handed over to other cells when certain conditions are met. (For details, refer to the related algorithm documents)
item.name: bigBsrUlUeReportMode

item.desc: When uplink service-based handover is enabled and the reporting mode is set to 1, this parameter is used as the reporting period. When the period expires, information of the current big-BSR UEs is reported to the RRM and the big-BSR UEs are handed over to the target cell.
item.name: bigBsrUlRprtPrd4GQOS

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables RB resource restriction on GBR services to prevent NGBR resource shortage because too many resources are occupied by GBR services. If this parameter is set to Open, the resources for non-guaranteed GBR services are restricted.
item.name: limitGbrSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for PRB usage in the case of slight congestion. If PRB usage exceeds this threshold, there may be slight congestion in the network. In addition, the number of RRC UEs must be considered to determine whether slight congestion occurs.
item.name: prbThr4LowCongestGbrRbLmt

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for PRB usage in the case of serious congestion. If PRB usage exceeds this threshold, there may be serious congestion in the network. In addition, the number of RRC UEs must be considered to determine whether serious congestion occurs.
item.name: prbThr4HighCongestGbrRb

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion of the RB resources available for GBR services in the case of light congestion. If the proportion exceeds this parameter value, non-guaranteed GBR services are not scheduled while guaranteed GBR services are not affected.
item.name: limitGbrRatio

item.desc: In the case of serious congestion, the proportion of total RB resources available for GBR services is calculated as follows: GBR resource proportion - GBR resource proportion offset. If the proportion exceeds this parameter value, non-guaranteed GBR services are not scheduled.
item.name: limitGbrRatioOffset

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of guaranteed QCIs in GBR resource control, that is, the number of QCIs (GBR services) that are not restricted by the number of PRBs. This number needs to be used together with the Guaranteed QCI List in GBR Resource Control parameter in this table. In other words, the first n (Number of Guaranteed QCIs in GBR Resource Control) elements in the list (Guaranteed QCI List in GBR Resource Control) are guaranteed QCIs.
item.name: unLimitQciNumGbrRbLmt

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the number of RRC UEs in the case of slight congestion. If the number of RRC UEs exceeds this threshold, there may be slight congestion in the network. In addition, PRB usage must be considered to determine whether slight congestion occurs.
item.name: rrcThr4LowCongestGbrRbLmt

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the number of RRC UEs in the case of serious congestion. If the number of RRC UEs exceeds this threshold, there may be serious congestion in the network. In addition, PRB usage must be considered to determine whether serious congestion occurs.
item.name: rrcThr4HighCongestGbrRb

item.desc: GBR resource control is to restrict RB resources for GBR services: Within a period of time (TTI), the maximum number of RBs is calculated. If the number of RBs occupied by GBR services is equal to or greater than this threshold, non-guaranteed GBR services are not scheduled. This period of time is called a control window, namely, GBR resource control window length.
item.name: limitGbrWinSize

item.desc: The adjustment of the GBR resource restriction policy depends on the congestion condition. This parameter sets the period of congestion determination. A longer period indicates that the GBR restriction policy is changed less frequently.
item.name: judgePeriod4GbrRbLmt

item.desc: This parameter sets the list of the guaranteed QCIs that are not restricted by the number of PRBs in GBR resource control. The QCIs are of only GBR service type. These QCIs are not restricted by GBR resources, but the used RB resources are counted in the number of used RBs for GBR services.
item.name: unLimitQciListGbrRbLmt

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the adaption of the cell-level downlink scheduling algorithm. If it is set to Open, an algorithm can be changed to the MAX C/I algorithm when the number of RRC-connected UEs is within a certain range, improving the downlink spectrum efficiency of the cell.
item.name: dlSchdAdapSwitch

item.desc: PBR guarantee can be enabled in some network sharing scenarios (case 1, case 2, and case 4). In these scenarios, if this parameter is set to Open, the resources used by PBR services can be guaranteed, that is, the PBR services are not restricted by the PRB resources of an operator group. If this parameter is set to Close, the PBR services fail to be scheduled if there is no PRB resource available for the operator group.
item.name: netSharePBRGuaSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the guaranteed-rate adjustment for the far-point UEs with the downlink generalized QoS. If it is set to 0, it indicates that the guaranteed-rate adjustment for the far-point UEs with the downlink generalized QoS is disabled. If it is set to 1, it indicates that the guaranteed-rate adjustment for the far-point UEs with the downlink generalized QoS is enabled.
item.name: genQosSbrAdjustSwchDL

item.desc: This parameter sets the adjustment proportion of the downlink generalized QoS SBR. When the guaranteed-rate adjustment for the far-point UEs with the downlink generalized QoS is enabled, the SBR of far-point UEs is the configured SBR value multiplied by this parameter value.
item.name: genQosSbrAdjustRadioDL

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables downlink PBR rate guarantee. It is used to set a PBR scheduling policy. If it is set to Open, downlink PBR scheduling is preferentially guaranteed based on the guaranteed PBR rate. In a heavy-load scenario, downlink PBR scheduling can be fully guaranteed. However, downlink PBR scheduling may not be always guaranteed because radio resources (such as PRBs and CCEs) are limited even though this parameter is set to Open.
item.name: schdModeOfDLPbr

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the adaptive adjustment of the enhanced downlink scheduling algorithm. If it is set to Open, the downlink scheduling algorithm of a cell is adjusted adaptively based on the PBR usage of the cell to achieve fine control over the scheduling proportion of far-point UEs, midpoint UEs, and near-point UEs.
item.name: enhancedSchdAdapDLSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the adaptive policy of the downlink scheduling algorithm. To use the linear method, this parameter is set to 0. To use the exponential method, this parameter is set to 1.
item.name: schdAdpMthdDL

item.desc: This parameter sets the PRB usage level threshold for the adaptive adjustment of the enhanced downlink scheduling algorithm. It is used to determine the level of the current cell and the policy corresponding to the level. The digit 0 and the array element [0] define the PRB usage range of level 0, the array elements [0] and [1] define the PRB usage range of level 1,. , and the array element [4] and the digit 100 define the PRB usage range of level 5.
item.name: prbRatioThr4SchdAdp

item.desc: This parameter sets the SE threshold for identifying near-point UEs. It is used to identify near-point UEs and midpoint UEs. If the SE value of a UE is smaller than this threshold and larger than or equal to the SE threshold for identifying midpoint UEs, the UE is identified as a midpoint UE. If the SE value of a UE is larger than or equal to this threshold, the UE is identified as a near-point UE.
item.name: seNearThr4SchdAdp

item.desc: This parameter sets the PF coefficient of each level for near-point UEs. It is used to adjust the rate of near-point UEs when the linear method is used. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority of near-point UEs and a higher UE rate.
item.name: pfCoefNear4SchdAdp

item.desc: This parameter sets the beta value of each level of the near-point UEs when the adaptive adjustment of the enhanced downlink scheduling algorithm is enabled. It is used to adjust the rate of near-point UEs. It must be used together with the adjustment of the beta value of each level of midpoint UEs and that of far-point UEs.
item.name: betaNear4SchdAdp

item.desc: This parameter sets the SE threshold for identifying midpoint UEs. It is used to identify far-point UEs and midpoint UEs. If the SE value of a UE is smaller than this threshold and larger than or equal to the SE threshold for identifying far-point UEs, the UE is identified as a far-point UE. If the SE value of a UE is larger than or equal to this threshold and smaller than the threshold for identifying near-point UEs, the UE is identified as a midpoint UE.
item.name: seMidThr4SchdAdp

item.desc: This parameter sets the PF coefficient of each level for midpoint UEs. It is used to adjust the rates of midpoint UEs when the linear method is used. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority of midpoint UEs and a higher UE rate.
item.name: pfCoefMid4SchdAdp

item.desc: This parameter sets the beta value of each level of the midpoint UEs when the adaptive adjustment of the enhanced downlink scheduling algorithm is enabled. It is used to adjust the rate of midpoint UEs. It must be used together with the adjustment of the beta value of each level of far-point UEs and that of near-point UEs.
item.name: betaMid4SchdAdp

item.desc: This parameter sets the SE threshold for identifying far-point UEs. It is used to identify very-far-point UEs and far-point UEs. If the SE value of a UE is smaller than this threshold, the UE is identified as a very-far-point UE. If the SE value of a UE is larger than or equal to this threshold and smaller than the threshold for midpoint UEs, the UE is identified as a far-point UE.
item.name: seFarThr4SchdAdp

item.desc: This parameter sets the PF coefficient of each level for far-point UEs. It is used to adjust the rate of far-point UEs when the linear method is used. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority of far-point UEs and a higher UE rate.
item.name: pfCoefFar4SchdAdp

item.desc: This parameter sets the beta value of each level of the far-point UEs when the adaptive adjustment of the enhanced downlink scheduling algorithm is enabled. It is used to adjust the rate of far-point UEs. It must be used together with the adjustment of the beta value of each level of midpoint UEs and that of near-point UEs.
item.name: betaFar4SchdAdp

item.desc: This parameter sets the scheduling factor for downlink NSA UEs. It is used to adjust the priority of the downlink NSA UEs when the ePF algorithm is used. A larger parameter value indicates a higher scheduling priority of the downlink NSA UEs when the ePF algorithm is used and higher probability of UE scheduling.
item.name: fFNsaUserDL

item.desc: This parameter sets the scheduling factor for uplink NSA UEs. It is used to adjust the priority of the uplink NSA UEs when the ePF algorithm is used. A larger parameter value indicates a higher scheduling priority of the uplink NSA UEs when the ePF algorithm is used and higher probability of UE scheduling.
item.name: fFNsaUserUL

item.desc: This parameter sets the scheduling factor for downlink non-NSA UEs. It is used to adjust the priority of the downlink non-NSA UEs when the ePF algorithm is used. A larger parameter value indicates a higher scheduling priority of the downlink non-NSA UEs when the ePF algorithm is used and higher probability of UE scheduling.
item.name: fFNonNsaUserDL

item.desc: This parameter sets the scheduling factor for uplink non-NSA UEs. It is used to adjust the priority of the uplink non-NSA UEs when the ePF algorithm is used. A larger parameter value indicates a higher scheduling priority of the uplink non-NSA UEs when the ePF algorithm is used and higher probability of UE scheduling.
item.name: fFNonNsaUserUL

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink intelligent scheduling type. It is used to determine how to improve the spectrum efficiency of cells in high-load scenarios. If it is set to 1, the eNodeB adjusts the scheduling opportunities of different UEs based on the spectrum efficiency obtained by the average CQI of the cell to improve the resource usage of mid-point and near-point UEs. If it is set to 2, the eNodeB adjusts the scheduling opportunities of different UEs based on the spectrum efficiency output by the cell traffic model to improve the spectrum efficiency of the cell. If it is set to 0, the eNodeB does not actively improve the spectrum efficiency of the cell.
item.name: dLSmartSchdSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the policy for fair allocation of radio PRB resources in network sharing scenarios with multiple operators. If it is set to UserFairness (0), it indicates that radio PRB resources are fairly scheduled among all the UEs. If the parameter is set to OperatorFairness (1), it indicates that radio PRB resources are fairly scheduled among the operators.
item.name: resSchdFairPolicy

item.desc: This parameter is an array with six elements and indicates whether the UEs of the QoS type1 to QoS type6 corresponding to the elements disable DRX. If there is a generalized QoS type whose DRX disabling indication is set to Yes for a UE service, the UE is not configure with DRX information or the original DRX information of the UE is released.
item.name: qosTypeDrxCloseInd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables rate balancing. It is used to set a rate balancing type. If it is not set to Close, in a high-load cell, the resources of high-rate UEs are limited, so that the user experience of low-rate UEs can be effectively improved. In this way, the UE rates in the cell are more balanced, and the overall user perception in the cell is improved. If it is set to Only Uplink, only the uplink rate is balanced. If it is set to Only Downlink, only the downlink rate is balanced. If it is set to Both Uplink and Downlink, both the uplink rate and downlink rate are balanced.
item.name: rateBalSwch

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of six elements that correspond to the AMBR weight factors of general QoS guarantee types 0 to 5 separately. If the EPF algorithm is used as the QoS scheduling algorithm, this parameter is used to calculate the scheduling priority of the corresponding guarantee type. A larger element value indicates a larger AMBR scheduling weight of the corresponding guarantee type and thus more chances that the services of the guarantee type can be scheduled.
item.name: dLGenQosAMBRCoef

item.desc: This parameter sets the preset BSR for the responses to SRs. If the srRBNumAuthMode parameter is set to 3, the eNodeB allocates RBs for the SRs of the current UE based on the parameter value.
item.name: bSR4SR

item.desc: This parameter sets a preset virtual BSR for the SRs of the UEs with large BSRs. It is used for the UEs with large BSRs to respond to the SRs for resource allocation. If the srRBNumAuthMode parameter is set to 3 and the current UE is identified as a UE with a large BSR, the eNodeB responds to the SRs to allocate resources based on the parameter value.
item.name: bSR4SR4Large

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to preferentially allocate uplink CCEs to large-traffic UEs. It is used to increase the uplink scheduling opportunity of large-traffic UEs.
item.name: guarUeUlCcePriAlloSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for determining whether to preferentially allocate uplink CCEs to large-traffic UEs. If the number of RRC connections in a cell exceeds the threshold, the uplink CCE allocation priority of large-traffic UEs can be increased.
item.name: rRCNumThr4CcePriAllo

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to restrict the number of RBs scheduled by abnormal UEs. It is used in the scenarios where the proportion of the number of RBs scheduled by abnormal UEs is high so that the overall PRB usage of the cell can be back to normal.
item.name: ueLimitedSchdSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the padding rate threshold for identifying abnormal UEs. If the padding rate of a UE exceeds this threshold, the UE is identified as an abnormal UE.
item.name: abUePaddingThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the time window for collecting statistics on the padding rate of abnormal UEs and the number of RBs scheduled by abnormal UEs. It is used to specify the period for identifying abnormal UEs. A larger parameter value indicates a longer period for identifying abnormal UEs and higher identification accuracy.
item.name: abUeStaticWin

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of RBs scheduled by an abnormal UE. A smaller parameter value indicates a smaller number of RBs that can be scheduled by an abnormal UE.
item.name: abUeSchdRBNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for identifying abnormal UEs. If the average number of RBs scheduled by abnormal UEs exceeds the threshold, the system restricts the number of RBs scheduled by abnormal UEs.
item.name: abUeSchdRBNumThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion offsets of the uplink bandwidth resources allocated to different PLMNs or PLMN groups in network sharing scenarios. This parameter is an array consisting of six elements that in turn represent the offsets of the corresponding elements specified by the ratioOperatorn (Bandwidth Resource Ratio of PLMNs in Network Sharing) or ratioOperatorGroupn (Bandwidth Resource Ratio of PLMN Groups in Network Sharing) array parameter to the uplink bandwidth resource partitions of PLMN1 through PLMN6 or PLMN group 1 through PLMN group 6.
item.name: ulRatioOprOffset

item.desc: This parameter sets the offset of the proportion of shared uplink bandwidth resources when multiple operators share uplink bandwidth resources. In such a scenario, the proportion of shared downlink bandwidth resources is specified by the ratioShared (Resource Ratio of Shared in Network Sharing) parameter, and the proportion of shared uplink bandwidth resources is the sum of this parameter and the value of the ratioShared parameter.
item.name: ratioSharedOffset

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to allocate network resources by QCI service level. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), in network sharing scenarios, the eNodeB sets the maximum and minimum network resource proportions for specific QCI services in specific PLMNs to allocate network resources by QCI service level. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB allocates network resources by operator level in network sharing scenarios.
item.name: qciRbPartitionSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum equivalent BSR size. It is used to maintain the BSRs of UEs. If the ucEffBsrProcMethod (Equivalent-BSR Maintenance Policy) parameter is set to 1, the BSR sizes of UEs received by the eNodeB are not smaller than the parameter value.
item.name: minEffBsr

item.desc: This parameter sets a maintenance policy for equivalent BSRs of UEs. If this parameter is set to 0, it indicates that the actual BSRs are used as the equivalent BSRs for maintenance, and no special processing is required. If this parameter is set to 1, it indicates that equivalent BSRs are maintained based on the actual BSRs and historical TB sizes. In this case, the padding ratio of the cell may reduce.
item.name: effBsrProcMethod

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink RB preemption coefficient of PLMNs in the network sharing scenarios where PLMNs can flexibly preempt RBs and some PLMNs have surplus RBs. It is used to set the RB preemption coefficient for the remaining PLMNs to preempt RBs. With this parameter, the PLMNs can preempt RBs equally, proportionally, or in a compromised way (the combination of equal preemption and proportional preemption).
item.name: dlRbPreempCoeff

item.desc: This parameter sets the loss coefficient of the number of RBs in historical scheduling. It is used to determine the loss of RBs in each historical scheduling subframe in the case that the PLMNs flexibly preempts RBs in network sharing scenarios. A smaller parameter value indicates a smaller RB loss in historical scheduling, more-complete RBs in historical scheduling, and a smaller error between the total scheduled-RB ratio and the configured-RB ratio. However, in the case of discontinuous services, the resources of the PLMNs that preempt more RBs may not be scheduled over a longer period of time.
item.name: hisRbLossCoeff

item.desc: This parameter sets the window size for uplink flow control. It is used to control the uplink rate of UEs. A smaller parameter value indicates a larger number of times that the PBRs are scheduled and more accurate control on the uplink rate of UEs.
item.name: ulFlowWndSize

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink target TCP RTT of self-healing guarantee for general-QoS services. It is an array parameter consisting of five elements, which set the downlink target TCP RTT guaranteed for the UEs with QoS type1 through type5 services respectively. This parameter is valid only if the element (corresponding to the service type) of the aucServiceJudgeMethod4Adapt (Evaluation Criteria of Self-Healing Guarantee for General-QoS Services) parameter is set to 3 or 4. During the self-healing guarantee for a UE with a type of general-QoS service, the eNodeB compares the actual TCP RTT of the UE with the corresponding element of this parameter to adjust the corresponding guarantee level.
item.name: targetRtt4Adapt

item.desc: This parameter sets the target rates of self-healing guarantee for general-QoS services. It is an array parameter consisting of five elements, which set the target rates guaranteed for the UEs with QoS type1 through type5 services respectively. This parameter is valid only if the element (corresponding to the service type) of the aucServiceJudgeMethod4Adapt (Evaluation Criteria of Self-Healing Guarantee for General-QoS Services) parameter is set to 1 or 2. During the self-healing guarantee for a UE with a type of general-QoS service, the eNodeB compares the actual (uplink or downlink) rate of the UE with the corresponding element of this parameter to adjust the corresponding guarantee level.
item.name: targetRate4Adapt

item.desc: This parameter sets the default guarantee levels of self-healing guarantee for general-QoS services. It is an array parameter consisting of five elements, which set the initial guarantee levels of the UEs with QoS type1 through type5 services respectively. If an element is set to 0, it indicates that the corresponding type of service of the UEs is not guaranteed. If an element is set to a value in the range from 1 through 5, it indicates that the corresponding type of service of the UEs is guaranteed at the corresponding guarantee level. The guarantee degree of level 1 through level 5 guarantee increases in sequence.
item.name: defaultGQosLevel4Adapt

item.desc: This parameter sets the evaluation criteria of self-healing guarantee for general-QoS services. It is an array parameter consisting of five elements, each of which sets the basis for adjusting the self-healing guarantee levels of the UEs with QoS type1 through type5 services. If an element is set to 0, it indicates that the self-healing guarantee level of the corresponding type of service is not evaluated. If an element is set to 1, it indicates that the self-healing guarantee level of the corresponding type of service is evaluated based on the downlink rate. If an element is set to 2, it indicates that the self-healing guarantee level of the corresponding type of service is evaluated based on the uplink rate. If an element is set to 3, it indicates that the self-healing guarantee level of the corresponding type of service is evaluated based on the TCP RTT after Uu acceleration optimization. If an element is set to 4, it indicates that the self-healing guarantee level of the corresponding type of service is evaluated based on the actual TCP RTT of the Uu interface.
item.name: serviceJudgeMethod4Adapt

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables downlink AMBR guarantee enhancement for the UEs with general-QoS services. If an element of this parameter is set to 1 (Open), in high-traffic scenarios, the scheduling priority of the downlink AMBR services of the UEs with the corresponding general-QoS service increases. This parameter is an array consisting of five elements that set whether to enable downlink AMBR guarantee enhancement for the UEs with general-QoS services of type1 through type5 respectively.
item.name: dlAmbrPFCoeff4GuaEnSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the protection coefficients of downlink AMBR guarantee enhancement. It is valid if the dlAmbrPFCoeff4EnhanceSwch (Switch of Downlink AMBR Guarantee Enhancement) parameter is set to 1 (Open). It is used to adjust the scheduling priority of the UEs with the general-QoS services of type1 through type5. This parameter is an array consisting of five elements that correspond to enhanced protection coefficients for downlink AMBR guarantee of the UEs with general-QoS services of type1 through type5. A smaller parameter value indicates a higher priority and a bigger AMBR service scheduling opportunity for the UEs with the general-QoS services of type1 through type5.
item.name: dlAmbrPFCoeff4Protect

item.desc: This parameter sets the AMBR guarantee coefficients of uplink general-QoS services. It is an array consisting of six elements and used for priority calculation in the same EMLP. Elements 0 through 5 set the AMBR guarantee coefficients of the general-QoS services of type0 through type5 respectively. A larger element value indicates a higher scheduling priority of large-packet UEs on the AMBR layer.
item.name: uLAMBRCoef

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enhance the guarantee of AMBR services for large-packet UEs. It is used to control whether to increase the scheduling priority of AMBR services of large-packet UEs in large-capacity scenarios. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the scheduling priority of large-packet UEs in large-capacity scenarios increases.
item.name: ambrPFCoeff4EnhanceSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the protection coefficient of AMBR guarantee enhancement. In high-traffic scenarios, if the ambrPFCoeff4EnhanceSwch (Switch of AMBR Guarantee Enhancement) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and this parameter is set to a larger value, the scheduling opportunity of large-packet UEs on the AMBR layer may decrease and that of ordinary UEs on the AMBR layer may increase.
item.name: ambrPFCoeffProtect

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink RB preemption coefficient of PLMNs in the network sharing scenarios where PLMNs can flexibly preempt RBs and some PLMNs have surplus RBs. It is used to set the RB preemption coefficient for the remaining PLMNs to preempt RBs.
item.name: ulRbPreempCoef

item.desc: This parameter sets the general-QoS service types of the UEs for which the SR-based scheduling priority needs to be increased. It is an array parameter consisting of six elements. Elements 0 through 5 set whether to increase the SR-based scheduling priority of the UEs with general-QoS services of type 1 through type 6. If the srimpoveProritytoLayer (SR-Based Scheduling Priority Increase Policy for the UEs with general-QoS Services) parameter is not set to 0 (Close) and an element of this parameter is set to 1, it indicates that the SR-based scheduling priority of the corresponding type of UE can be increased. If an element of this parameter is set to 0 (Close), it indicates that the SR-based scheduling priority of the corresponding type of UE cannot be increased.
item.name: srImprovePriorityTypeList

item.desc: This parameter sets the size of the resource token memory of a PLMN in the network sharing scenarios where PLMNs can flexibly preempt resources. The maximum resource management scope of a PLMN is the RBs in the subframes configured for the token memory. A larger parameter value indicates a larger size of the token memory for the resources shared among the PLMNs, more-complete RBs in historical scheduling, and a smaller error between the total scheduled-RB ratio and the configured-RB ratio. However, in the case of discontinuous services, the resources of the PLMNs that preempt more RBs may not be scheduled over a longer period of time.
item.name: rbShareTokenMemory

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to increase the SR-based scheduling priority of the UEs with general-QoS services. For the UEs whose general-QoS service types correspond to the elements with the value 1 in the srImprovePriorityTypeList (General-QoS Service Types of UEs for Which the SR-Based Scheduling Priority Needs to Be Increased) array parameter, if this parameter is set to 1 (Upgrade level 1), it indicates that the SR-based scheduling priority of such UEs is higher than that of ordinary UEs; if this parameter is set to 2 (Upgrade level 2), it indicates that the SR-based scheduling priority of such UEs is higher than that of VoLTE UEs; if this parameter is set to 0 (Close), it indicates that the SR-based scheduling priority of such UEs is not increased.
item.name: srimpoveProritytoLayer

item.desc: This parameter sets a packet optimization ID selection policy. If this parameter is set to 0, it indicates that the UEs with general-QoS services are identified in accordance with the packet-level identification policy of the existing packets. If this parameter is set to 1, it indicates that the UEs with general-QoS services are identified in accordance with the packet-level identification policy of new packets.
item.name: qosPacketGuaPolicy

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timers for exiting packet-level guarantee of uplink services. It is an array parameter consisting of five elements. Elements 0 through 4 respectively set the duration of the timers for exiting uplink service guarantee after the UEs with general-QoS services of type 1 through type 5 receive a high-priority packet clearing flag in the downlink. When the UEs with a type (type 1 through type 5) of general-QoS service receive a packet-level guarantee exit flag from the downlink MAC, the timer corresponding to the type is started. When the timer expires, the uplink packet-level guarantee for the UEs with the type of general-QoS service stops.
item.name: ulPktGuaExitDelay

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable the uplink conservative procedure for RB increase and MCS decrease for the UEs with the services of a general-QoS type. It is an array parameter consisting of five elements, which respectively set whether to enable the uplink conservative procedure for RB increase and MCS decrease for the UEs with the services of general-QoS type1 through general-QoS type5. If an element is set to 1, it indicates that the uplink conservative procedure for RB increase and MCS decrease for the UEs with the services of this general-QoS type is enabled. If an element is set to 0, it indicates that the uplink conservative procedure for RB increase and MCS decrease for the UEs with the services of this general-QoS type is disabled.
item.name: ulRbConsTypeSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum number of RBs allocated to UEs with downlink general-QoS services in downlink scheduling of non-QCI1 bearers of the UEs. This parameter is an array consisting of five elements that correspond to general-QoS services of type 1 through type 5 respectively.
item.name: dlMinRbNumForGenQos

The value range of each array element (an integer) is from 0 to 255. The default value 0 means that the corresponding frequency is not an expected frequency. A non-zero value means that the corresponding frequency is an expected frequency and a higher value indicates a higher priority. If the service frequency is not configured, the priority for the service frequency is 0 by default.

item.desc: This array parameter sets the priorities of expected frequencies for the users of category 2, and the array elements correspond to the priorities of the frequencies in awExpHoTarFreq4Cate0. A non-zero value means that the corresponding frequency is an expected frequency and a higher value indicates a higher priority. If the service frequency is not configured, the priority for the service frequency is 0 by default.
item.name: expHoTarFreqPri4Cate2

item.desc: This array parameter sets the priorities of expected frequencies for the users of category 3, and the array elements correspond to the priorities of the frequencies in awExpHoTarFreq4Cate0. The value range of each array element (an integer) is from 0 to 255. The default value 0 means that the corresponding frequency is not an expected frequency. A non-zero value means that the corresponding frequency is an expected frequency and a higher value indicates a higher priority. If the service frequency is not configured, the priority for the service frequency is 0 by default.

item.desc: This parameter indicates the coverage-based measurement configuration index of inter-frequency handover for category-3 users. Each array element corresponds to one frequency in awExpHoTarFreq4Cate0.
item.name: interFHOMeasCfgIndx4Cate3

item.desc: This parameter indicates the coverage-based measurement configuration index of inter-frequency handover for the users of category 4. Each array element corresponds to one frequency in awExpHoTarFreq4Cate0.
item.name: interFHOMeasCfgIndx4Cate4

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink limited AMBRs. It is an array parameter consisting of three elements. The first through third elements of the array parameter represent the three downlink limited AMBRs specified by the dlPRBThrd4AMBRLimt (Downlink PRB Threshold for AMBR Limit) parameter, that is, the rates of UEs in a cell cannot exceed the corresponding element value. The values of elements 1 through 3 decrease in turn, indicating that the UE rates are limited more greatly in turn.

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink limited AMBRs. It is an array parameter consisting of three elements. The first through third elements of the array parameter represent the three uplink limited AMBRs specified by the ulPRBThrd4AMBRLimt (Uplink PRB Threshold for AMBR Limit) parameter, that is, the rates of UEs in a cell cannot exceed the corresponding element value. The values of elements 1 through 3 decrease in turn, indicating that the UE rates are limited more greatly in turn.

The CCE power allocation criterion can be relaxed at most three times by 1 dB each time.

item.desc: This parameter sets the time granularity of super-cell self-organization detection. When the parameter is set to Hour, the super-cell detection period uses hours as the time granularity. When the parameter is set to Day, the super-cell detection period uses days as the time granularity.
item.name: scAutoCombSplitGrade

item.desc: Time Length Of Hour Grade
item.name: hourAutoCfgCycle

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of times that the hour-grade combination/splitting trigger condition is satisfied. This parameter takes effect when the Time Grade of SuperCell Self-organize Detection parameter is set to hour. If the number of times that the combination/splitting trigger condition is satisfied per hour is larger than or equal to the threshold, the hour-grade detection condition is satisfied. If the number of times that the combination/splitting trigger condition is satisfied per hour is less than the threshold, the hour-grade detection condition is not satisfied.
item.name: hourAutoCfgTrigNumThd

item.desc: Time Length Of Day Grade
item.name: dayAutoCfgCycle

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of times that the day-grade combination/splitting trigger condition is satisfied. This parameter takes effect when the Time Grade of SuperCell Self-organize Detection parameter is set to day. If the number of times that the combination/splitting trigger condition is satisfied per day is larger than or equal to the threshold, the day-grade detection condition is satisfied. If the number of times that the combination/splitting trigger condition is satisfied per day is less than the threshold, the day-grade detection condition is not satisfied.
item.name: dayAutoCfgTrigNumThd

item.desc: Ratio Threshold of RRC Ue Num for SuperCell Combine Triger
item.name: cellCombRRCNumRatioThd

item.desc: Ratio Threshold of RRC Ue Num for SuperCell Split Triger
item.name: cellSplitRRCNumRatioThd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold proportion of the number of RRC-connected UEs that are abnormally released. It is used to determine whether a cell can be split. If the proportion of the number of RRC-connected UEs in the cell is larger than the parameter value, the cell is not split. If the proportion of the number of RRC-connected UEs in the cell is smaller than or equal to the parameter value, the cell can be split.
item.name: cellAutoCfgRRCNumThd

item.desc: This parameter sets the avoidance period of cell combination or splitting. When the cells to be combined or split satisfy the cell combination/splitting conditions, if the number of RRC connections at the moment does not meet the conditions, the avoidance period is started. When the avoidance period expires, the number of RRC connections at the moment will be judged again.
item.name: autoCfgAviodCycle

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of RRC UEs for cell combination or splitting. When the cells to be combined or split satisfy the cell combination/splitting conditions, if the number of RRC connections at the moment exceeds the threshold, the avoidance period is started. When the avoidance period expires, the number of RRC connections at the moment will be judged again.
item.name: scSplitRRCRelRatioThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the gain threshold for cell splitting. It is used to determine whether the gain of cell splitting meets the requirement. If the equivalent throughput gain obtained after cell splitting is larger than or equal to the threshold, it indicates that the gain requirement is met and the cell splitting result can be applied. If the equivalent throughput gain obtained after cell splitting is smaller than the threshold, it indicates that the gain requirement is not met and the cell needs to be rolled back.
item.name: scSplitGainThd

item.desc: This parameter sets the punishment period of cell ping-pong combination or splitting. If the evaluation of super-cell splitting fails for three consecutive times, the punishment period will be started.
item.name: scAutoCfgPingPongCycle

item.desc: Resolve Policy of SuperCell Combine or Split
item.name: scAutoCombSpliyPolicy

item.name: gridStructureSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of inter-frequencies in a grid. A larger parameter value indicates that there are more inter-frequencies in a grid and it is more accurate to reflect the distribution of inter-frequency neighbor cells around a grid.
item.name: maxGridInterFreqNum

item.desc: This parameter indicates the maximum number of neighbor cells at each frequency per grid. A larger parameter value indicates that there are more inter-frequency neighbor cells in a grid and it is more accurate to reflect the distribution of inter-frequency neighbor cells around a grid.
item.name: maxGridPerFreqNbrCellNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRP threshold of inter-frequency neighbor cells per grid. If the RSRP of an inter-frequency neighbor cell is greater than or equal to the threshold when the eNodeB receives a measurement report of the neighbor cell, the neighbor cell can be included in the grid; otherwise, information about the neighbor cell is removed from the measurement report.
item.name: gridInterFNbrRsrpThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRP threshold when there is only serving cell information included in the measurement report during grid construction. If there is only serving cell information included in the measurement report, the measurement information can be included in the grid if the RSRP of the serving cell is larger than this threshold; otherwise, the measurement information is removed.
item.name: gridOnlySrvCellRsrpThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the valid time length of intra-frequency measurement reports of a UE per grid. When receiving an intra-frequency measurement report from the UE, the eNodeB updates intra-frequency measurement information of the UE and starts this timer. If no intra-frequency measurement report is received from the UE and this timer expires, the eNodeB deletes intra-frequency measurement information of the UE.
item.name: gridIntraMrValidTimeLen

item.desc: This parameter sets the period for the determination of the available attributes of the neighbor cells in a grid. In this period of time, the number of measurement reports and the number of handover attempts of the neighbor cells in the grid are collected. At the end of the period, the system determines whether to update the available attributes of the neighbor cells based on the statistics.
item.name: gridNbrAvalidAttribPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of measurement reports for determining the available attributes of the neighbor cells in a grid. In the period for determining neighbor attributes, if the number of measurement reports of a neighbor cell is larger than or equal to this threshold, the system immediately determines whether to update the available attributes of the neighbor cell; otherwise, the system makes this decision at the end of the period.
item.name: gridNbrAvailAttribMrNumThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRP threshold for determining the available attributes of the neighbor cells in a grid. In the period for determining neighbor attributes, if the number of measurement reports of a neighbor cell is larger than or equal to the threshold of the number of measurement reports for determining the available attributes of the neighbor cells in a grid and if the RSRP of the neighbor cell is lower than this threshold, the neighbor cell is marked as unavailable.
item.name: gridNbrAvailAttribRsrpThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the measurement report ratio threshold for determining the available attributes of the neighbor cells in a grid. In the period for determining neighbor attributes, if the number of measurement reports of a neighbor cell is larger than or equal to the threshold of the number of measurement reports for determining the available attributes of the neighbor cells in a grid and if the measurement report ratio of the neighbor cell is lower than this threshold, the neighbor cell is marked as unavailable.
item.name: gridNbrAvailAttrMrRatioThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the handover success rate threshold for determining the available attributes of the neighbor cells in a grid. In the period for determining neighbor attributes, if the handover success rate of the neighbor cell is lower than this threshold, the neighbor cell is marked as unavailable.
item.name: gridNbrAvailHoSucRateThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRP threshold of inter-frequency neighbor cells in a grid for load balancing. When an inter-frequency neighbor cell is obtained from the RF fingerprint database for load balancing in UE handover, the neighbor cell is not selected if the RSRP of the neighbor cell is smaller than this threshold.
item.name: lbGridNbrRsrpThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the number of measurement reports of inter-frequency neighbor cells in a grid for load balancing. When an inter-frequency neighbor cell is obtained from the RF fingerprint database for load balancing in UE handover, the neighbor cell is not selected if the number of measurement reports of the neighbor cell is smaller than this threshold.
item.name: lbGridNbrMrRptNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the MR ratio threshold of inter-frequency neighbor cells in a grid for load balancing. When an inter-frequency neighbor cell is obtained from the RF fingerprint database for load balancing in UE handover, the neighbor cell is not selected if the MR ratio of the neighbor cell is smaller than this threshold.
item.name: lbGridNbrRptRatioThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of attempts in the handover to an inter-frequency neighbor cell in a grid for load balancing. When an inter-frequency neighbor cell is obtained from the RF fingerprint database for load balancing in UE handover, the neighbor cell is not selected if the number of attempts in the handover to this neighbor cell is smaller than this threshold.
item.name: lbGridNbrHoAttemptThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the handover success rate of an inter-frequency neighbor cell in a grid for load balancing. When an inter-frequency neighbor cell is obtained from the RF fingerprint database for load balancing in UE handover, the neighbor cell is not selected if the success rate of the handover to this neighbor cell is smaller than this threshold.
item.name: lbGridNbrHoSuccRateThrd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the fingerprint database application functions on the eNodeB side. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB starts to report real-time UE information to the fingerprint database, and the fingerprint database application functions on the eNodeB are enabled.

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables dynamic breathing network power adjustment. It is used to control the role of the cell in dynamic breathing network power adjustment.If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the cell is not involved in dynamic breathing network power adjustment.If this parameter is set to 1 (Dynamic Breathing Network Power Decreases), the cell acts as a power lender and lends power to other cells.If this parameter is set to 2 (Dynamic Breathing Network Power Increases), the cell acts as a power borrower and dynamically adjusts the total power and CRS power of the cell based on the service load of each cell to expand or reduce coverage and adapt to service load changes, optimizing network traffic and improving QoS.
item.name: dbnSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval at which dynamic breathing network power is adjusted. At the end of each period specified by this parameter, the eNodeB dynamically adjusts the transmit power and CRS power of the cell based on the service load within the period, so that the cell coverage can automatically expand or decrease as service requirements change, thus optimizing the network capacity and improving user experience. CRS power is the reference signal power used for signal synchronization and channel quality measurement. It is adjusted together with the total cell transmit power to achieve dynamic balance of coverage.
item.name: dbnPwrAdjPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum borrowed power during power sharing if dynamic breathing network power adjustment is enabled. It is used to control the degree of CRS power increase in a cell if the dynamic breathing network power sharing policy is used to ensure that power resources are properly allocated among different cells.
item.name: dbnMaxPwrOffsetThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the load thresholds for dynamic breathing network power adjustment. It is an array parameter consisting of four elements and used to adjust power based on load to optimize network resources. This parameter defines the following thresholds:Element 0 sets the low load threshold for the proportion of the number of RRC-Connected UEs.Element 1 sets the high load threshold for the proportion of the number of RRC-Connected UEs.Element 2 sets the low load threshold of the uplink/downlink PRB usage.Element 3 sets the high load threshold of the uplink/downlink PRB usage.Element 0 indicates the proportion of the number of RRC-Connected UEs to the number specified by the lbUeNumThrd (Threshold of the Number of RRC-Connected Users for Load Balancing) parameter.If the proportion of the number of RRC-Connected UEs in the cell is smaller than or equal to the value of element 0, and the uplink and downlink PRB usage of the cell is smaller than or equal to the value of element 2, the eNodeB increases the CRS power of the cell.If the proportion of the number of RRC-Connected UEs in the cell is larger than the value of element 1, or the uplink or downlink PRB usage of the cell is larger than the value of element 3, the eNodeB reduces the CRS power of the cell.
item.name: dbnLoadThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the adaptive rate adjustment thresholds for dynamic breathing network power adjustment. It is an array parameter consisting of four elements and used to adjust power based on load to optimize network resources. This parameter defines the following thresholds:Element 0 sets the low load threshold of the uplink rate.Element 1 sets the high load threshold of the uplink rate.Element 2 sets the low load threshold of the downlink rate.Element 3 sets the high load threshold of the downlink rate.If the uplink IP throughput of the cell is larger than the value of element 0 and the downlink IP throughput of the cell is larger than the value of element 2, the eNodeB increases the CRS power of the cell.If the uplink IP throughput of the cell is smaller than or equal to the value of element 1 or the downlink IP throughput of the cell is smaller than or equal to the value of element 3, the eNodeB decreases the CRS power of the cell.
item.name: dbnRateAdjThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the service indicator thresholds for dynamic breathing network power adjustment. It is an array parameter consisting of three elements and used to adjust power to optimize network resources. This parameter defines the following thresholds:Element 0 sets the threshold of the radio connection loss ratio for power rollback.Element 1 sets the threshold of the RRC connection setup success rate for power rollback.Element 2 sets the threshold of the intra-RAT incoming handover success rate for power rollback.If the radio connection loss ratio of the cell is larger than or equal to the value of element 0, the RRC connection setup success rate of the cell is smaller than the value of element 1, or the intra-RAT incoming handover success rate of the cell is smaller than the value of element 2, the eNodeB rolls back the increased CRS power of the cell.
item.name: dbnIndicatorThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the cells that borrow power from other cells can use the remaining power of the RRU if dynamic breathing network power adjustment is enabled. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the cells that borrow power from other cells can use the remaining power of the RRU to improve the power efficiency and network performance. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the cells that borrow power from other cells do not use the remaining power of the RRU. In this case, the fixed-power allocation policy is used.
item.name: dbnRemainPwrRRUSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the power adjustment thresholds if dynamic breathing network power adjustment is enabled. It is an array parameter consisting two elements.Element 0 sets the power lending threshold. If the power usage of the cell is lower than this threshold, the cell can lend surplus power to other cells to improve the resource usage efficiency.Element 1 sets the power recovery threshold. If the power usage of the cell is higher than this threshold, the cell recovers the lent power to meet its own power requirement.With the two thresholds, power can be adaptively adjusted and allocated, optimizing the use of network resources while ensuring service quality and system stability.
item.name: dbnPwrAdjThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute priority of power allocation when cells share borrowed power in the case that dynamic breathing network power adjustment is enabled. A smaller parameter value indicates a higher priority and the cell with a higher priority can be allocated with power more preferentially in the case that the system power is limited.
item.name: dbnPriorityAbsValue

item.desc: This parameter sets the CRS power adjustment type if dynamic breathing network power adjustment is enabled. It determines how the cells that do not borrow power from other cells adjust CRS power. In the case of CRS power increase through dynamic breathing network power adjustment, if the cell does not borrow power from other cells and this parameter is set to 0 (Middle 6RB CRS Increase Power of All Subframes), the CRS power of the six middle RBs in all the subframes increases. In this case, the twelve middle RBs in all the subframes cannot be scheduled for UEs and therefore the increase in cell traffic is small. If this parameter is set to 1 (Only the Middle 6RB CRS of Subframe 0 Increases Power), the CRS power of the six middle RBs in only subframe 0 increases. In this case, only the twelve middle RBs in subframe 0 cannot be scheduled for UEs and therefore the increase in cell traffic is large.
item.name: dbnCRSBoostMode

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for optimizing the broadcast weight for the cell that is not operating properly. When the period during which the cell is not operating properly is longer than this parameter value, the broadcast weight optimization stops. When the system detects that the cell is not operating properly, this timer is started. When broadcast weight optimization is disabled, this timer is stopped. When the timer times out, broadcast weight optimization is stopped.
item.name: broadcastWgtOptAbnormalTime

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of times that the measurement result is reported after an event is triggered in measurement for broadcast weight optimization. For a UE, after an event is triggered, the UE reports the measurement result periodically. If the number of measurement result reporting exceeds the parameter value, the UE stops reporting the measurement result.
item.name: rptAmt

item.desc: This parameter sets the hysteresis range in event A4 decision for broadcast weight optimization.
item.name: hysteresis

item.desc: This parameter sets the difference of the following two points of time: the time when an event occurs and the time when the event is reported in broadcast weight optimization. A detected event is triggered and reported only when the event always satisfies the event-triggering condition within this period of time. The larger the parameter value is, the stricter it is to determine whether an event can be triggered. This parameter is configured as required. If the parameter value is too large, communication quality may be affected sometimes.
item.name: trigTime

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute RSRP threshold for the decision of event A4 in the serving cell. The relationship between the actual values of the threshold for event A4 and the values specified in TS36.331 is as follows: -140 corresponding to 1, -139 corresponding to 2, and so on; -44 corresponding to 97, and the value 0 specified in TS36.331 cannot be obtained.
item.name: a4RsrpThreshold

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the cell sends the CSI-RS. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the cell does not send the CSI-RS and the UEs in the cell cannot transmit data in TM9 mode. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the cell sends the CSI-RS and the UEs in the cell can transmit data in TM9 mode if they support TM9 and the specified conditions are met.
item.name: csiRSSWCH

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval at which the eNodeB sends CSI-RSs. If this parameter is set to 5, it indicates that the eNodeB sends CSI-RSs every five milliseconds; if this parameter is set to 10, it indicates that the eNodeB sends CSI-RSs every ten milliseconds; if this parameter is set to 20, it indicates that the eNodeB sends CSI-RSs every 20 milliseconds; and so on.
item.name: csiPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of ports supported by a CSI-RS antenna. The parameter value 1 indicates that the CSI-RS antenna of the cell supports a single port, the parameter value 2 indicates that the CSI-RS antenna supports two ports, the parameter value 4 indicates that the CSI-RS antenna supports four ports, and the parameter value 8 indicates that the CSI-RS antenna supports eight ports. For details, refer to TS 36.211 [6.10.5].
item.name: csiRSAntPortsCount

item.desc: This parameter sets a CSI-RS resource configuration index. It is used to determine the time domain and frequency domain positions for sending the CSI-RS. For details, refer to Table 6.10.5.2-1 and Table 6.10.5.2-2 in TS 36.211.
item.name: csiRSResCfgIdx

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of zeroTxPowerCSIRS. When this switch is closed,for the the UE which is R10 and does not support TM9 is always not configured zero power CSI-RS, when the switch is open, for the UE whicn is R10 and does not supported TM9 will be configured zero power CSI-RS once the conditions of configure zero power CSI-RS are met.
item.name: zeroPowerCSIRSSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of identify special terminal by FGI when configure Zero power CSI-RS.When the value of this parameter is 1, it does not identify special terminals by FGI when configure zero power CSI-RS,and cofigure zero power CSI-RS for all R10 UE;When the value of this parameter is 2, it is identified as special terminal by two bits of FGI,only the special terminals which satisfy the following conditions are configured zero power CSI-RS: [Must] TDD bit19=0(InterRAT ANR corresponding)[Must]TDD bit114=1(Measurement Reporting of both UTRA RSCP and Ec/N0)and it When the value of this parameter is 3, it is identified as special terminal by three bits of FGI, the special terminals which satisfy the following conditions are not configured zero power CSI-RS: [Must] TDD bit3=0(RLC UM SN/PDCP SN not VoLTE corresponding) [Must] TDD bit19=1(InterRAT ANR corresponding) [Must] TDD bit114=1(Measurement Reporting of both UTRA RSCP and Ec/N0).
item.name: specialUeIndentifySwch

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of scheduling R8/R9/R10 UEs in the same subframe. If the switch is turned on, R8/R9 UEs can be scheduled in the subframe where CSI-RS is transmitted.
item.name: r8R9R10SchdSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the lower MCS threshold for scheduling R8/R9/R10 UEs in the same subframe. In other words, it is the MCS threshold for scheduling the R8/R9/R10 UEs that fail to identify the CSI-RS in the subframe sent by the CSI-RS. No order reduction is executed on the UEs that fail to identify the CSI-RS and the MCS value is less than or equal to this threshold.
item.name: r8R9R10MCSThreshold

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the cell sends the CSI-RS in accordance with 3GPP R13. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), it indicates that the cell sends the CSI-RS in accordance with 3GPP R13. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), it indicates that the cell is not allowed to send the CSI-RS in accordance with 3GPP R13.
item.name: r13CSIRSSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval at which the eNodeB sends the CSI-RS. It is valid only when the r13CSIRSSwch (R13 CSI RS Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open). If this parameter is set to 5, it indicates that the eNodeB sends the CSI-RS every five milliseconds; if this parameter is set to 10, it indicates that the eNodeB sends the CSI-RS every ten milliseconds; if this parameter is set to 20, it indicates that the eNodeB sends the CSI-RS every 20 milliseconds; and so on.
item.name: r13CSIRSPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the index of a TM9 interference suppression weight of a TMM base station. It is used to adjust the interference suppression level of TM9 service channels of the UEs in B-MIMO groups of TMM base stations. The values 0 through 3 correspond to the interference suppression weights with the interference cancellation capabilities of 0 dB, -15 dB, -20 dB, and -25 dB respectively. A larger parameter value indicates a better interference suppression effect but worse TM9 demodulation performance of cell-edge UEs.
item.name: tMMTm9MaskIndex

item.desc: This parameter sets the type of reference signal and whether the R-PDCCH of the RN is interleaved. If this parameter is set to 0 (Interleaving CRS), it indicates that the current cell is an interleaving cell and the supported reference signal is CRS. If this parameter is set to 1 (NoInterleaving CRS), it indicates that the current cell is a non-interleaving cell and the supported reference signal is CRS. If this parameter is set to 2 (NoInterleaving DMRS), it indicates that the current cell is a non-interleaving cell and the supported reference signal is DMRS.
item.name: rnInterleavingRS

item.desc: This parameter sets the type of R-PDCCH resource that is semi-statically allocated by the DeNB. It is used to adjust the resource allocation method. If this parameter is set to 0 (Type0), the resources must be allocated based on RBGs, the requirement for the number of RBs allocated to UEs should be met, and discontinuous positions of the allocated RBs are acceptable. If this parameter is set to 1 (Type1), the resources must be allocated based on individual RBs, the requirement for the number of RBs allocated to UEs should be met, and the positions of the allocated RBs must be in the same RB subset. If this parameter is set to 2 (Type2 Localized), the resources are allocated based on RBGs and the positions of the allocated RBs are continuous. If this parameter is set to 3 (Type2 Distributed), the resources can be allocated based on RBGs or individual RBs and the positions of the allocated RBs are continuous.

item.desc: Atmospheric ducting voice quality is detected by period. If the system determines that the voice quality is poor in consecutive periods, voice quality handover is triggered. This parameter is used together with the voice quality determination period.
item.name: atmosDetectPrdNum

item.desc: There are two atmospheric voice quality detection modes: wireless quality detection and link quality detection. They identify poor voice quality users and trigger handover based on the uplink SINR and uplink HARQ failures separately.
item.name: atmosDetectMode

item.desc: Atmospheric ducting voice link quality detection is not valid until the number of new HARQ transmissions exceeds this threshold.
item.name: atmosHarqNewTxCnt

item.desc: In an atmospheric ducting voice link quality detection period, the HARQ failure ratio is the ratio of the number of HARQ failures to the number of HARQ transmissions. If the HARQ failure ratio is higher or equal to this threshold, it is considered that the link quality is poor and the handover based on atmospheric ducting voice link quality is triggered.
item.name: atmosHFRatio

item.desc: In an atmospheric ducting voice link quality detection period, if the accumulated number of Buffer Status Report (BSR) bytes on the voice bearer is higher than this threshold, it is considered that the voice link quality is poor and a handover is triggered.
item.name: atmosAccuBsr

item.desc: This parameter indicates the maximum number of consecutive new HARQ failures of atmospheric ducting voice. It is not necessary to collect the statistics within the voice quality detection period. The counter starts counting when an HARQ acknowledgment message is received. If the value of the counter reaches this threshold, it is considered that RRC connection reconfiguration may fail due to too bad uplink quality, causing user drops. In this case, the handover based on atmospheric voice quality is forbidden.
item.name: atmosLastHarqFailNum

item.desc: If the actual SINR value of atmospheric wireless voice quality detection is lower than this threshold, it is considered that the wireless channel quality is too bad to guarantee voice quality and the UE needs to be handed over.
item.name: atmosSinrThrUl

item.desc: This parameter indicates the starting position of the reserved RB function for VoLTE users. The starting position cannot exceed the upper limit of the bandwidth. The starting position should avoid the PUCCH segment. If the starting position is in the PUCCH segment, the number of reserved RBs available reduces. The starting position should avoid the PRACH segment. If the starting position is in the PRACH segment, the number of reserved RBs available reduces. The starting position should avoid the high-interference RB segment. If the starting position is in the high-interference RB segment, the number of reserved RBs available reduces.
item.name: voiceRbRsvStartUl

item.desc: This parameter indicates the number of reserved PUSCH RBs for VoLTE users. The parameter value cannot exceed the upper limit of the bandwidth. The parameter value cannot exceed the total number of RBs following the starting position.
item.name: voiceRbRsvNumUl

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the reserved RB function for VoLTE users. If it is set to 0, the reserved RB function is disabled. If it is set to 1, the reserved RB function is enabled. The parameter values 2 and 3 are reserved values. This function is supported only in the bandwidth of 10 M, 15 M, and 20 M.
item.name: voiceRbRsvSwchUl

item.desc: In the atmospheric ducting VoLTE migration strategy based on voice quality, this parameter is used to configure the system to which users migrate. This parameter defines an array with four elements, respectively corresponding to EUTRA-FDD, EUTRA-TDD, GERAN, and UTRA-FDD from left to right. The value 0 indicates that migration to the corresponding system is prohibited while the value 1 indicates that migration to the corresponding system is allowed.
item.name: atmosVoLTERATInd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables DL256QAM for VoLTE UEs. 1) If it is set to Open, VoLTE UEs support DL 256QAM. 2) If it is set to Close, VoLTE UEs do not support DL256QAM; that is, VoLTE UEs fail to configure and schedule DL256QAM tables. If DL256QAM reconfiguration is already triggered before the QCI1 bearer of a VoLTE UE is established, the reconfiguration rolls back to DL64QAM tables when the bearer is established.
item.name: dl256QAMSwch4VoLTE

item.desc: This parameter indicates which UEs in the atmospheric ducting cell are not configured with DRX: If the value is This feature is not available to all users, DRX does not take effect; if the value is This feature is only available to VoLTE users, DRX is not configured for VoLTE UEs; and if the value is This feature is available to all users, DRX is not configured for all UEs.
item.name: atmosDisableDRXInd

item.desc: This parameter indicates RSRP measurement threshold 1 for event B2 in atmospheric ducting VoLTE migration.
