item.desc: This parameter indicates RSRQ measurement threshold 1 for event B2 in atmospheric ducting VoLTE migration.
item.name: atmosRsrqSrvThrd

item.desc: This parameter indicates thresholds B1 and B2-2 for events B1 and B2 to use the RSCP during the migration to UTRAN in atmospheric ducting VoLTE migration.
item.name: atmosRscpSysNbrThrd

item.desc: This parameter indicates thresholds B1 and B2-2 for events B1 and B2 to use the Ec/No during the migration to UTRAN in atmospheric ducting VoLTE migration.
item.name: atmosEcNoSysNbrThrd

item.desc: This parameter indicates thresholds B1 and B2-2 for events B1 and B2 to use the RSCP during the migration to GERAN in atmospheric ducting VoLTE migration.
item.name: atmosGERANNbrThrd

item.desc: This parameter indicates the RSRP threshold for measurement A4 of UEs when event A4 is configured as RSRP measurement in atmospheric ducting VoLTE migration.
item.name: atmosRsrpNbrThrd

item.desc: This parameter indicates the RSRQ threshold for measurement A4 of UEs when event A4 is configured as RSRQ measurement in atmospheric ducting VoLTE migration.
item.name: atmosRsrqNbrThrd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables reference voice quality for the intra-RAT handover of VoLTE users. If it is set to Open, the voice quality indication is considered as a reference when a VoLTE user meets the coverage-based inter-RAT handover conditions to determine whether to execute the handover. If it is set to Close, a VoLTE user that meets the coverage-based inter-RAT handover conditions is directly handed over without considering the voice quality indication.
item.name: intraSysCoverQualitySwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the forbidding of VoLTE calls in the cells with weak signals. It is used for MO or MT calls separately. If the uplink measurement value of a UE is lower than the threshold, the eNodeB rejects the setup request for the bearers of QCI1. If the CN supports message 503 and the UE supports CSFB after receiving message 503, the CSFB procedure is triggered.
item.name: weakCellForbidVTCallSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the SINR threshold for forbidding VoLTE calls in the cells with weak signals. If the uplink measurement value of a UE is lower than the threshold, the eNodeB rejects the setup request for the bearers of QCI1. If the CN supports message 503 and the UE supports CSFB after receiving message 503, the CSFB procedure is triggered.
item.name: weakCellSinrThrd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the recommended bit rate function. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB sends a MAC CE to a UE based on the measured UE information to notify the UE of the recommended uplink bit rate. If it is set to Close, the eNodeB does not intentionally send a MAC CE to a UE.
item.name: rBRSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables Access Network Bit Rate Recommendation Query (ANBRQ). If this parameter is set to Close, ANBRQ is disabled. If this parameter is set to Open, ANBRQ is enabled.
item.name: aNBRQSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum interval for UEs to send Access Network Bit Rate Recommendation Query (ANBRQ) messages.
item.name: aNBRQProhibitTimer

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the recommended downlink bit rate function. If it is set to Close, the eNodeB does not adjust the downlink speed of UEs through MAC CE. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB adjusts the downlink speed of UEs through MAC CE.
item.name: rBRDLSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the reserved RB function for VoLTE users. If it is set to Close, the reserved RB function is disabled. If it is set to Open, the reserved RB function is enabled. The parameter values Reserve1 and Reserve2 are reserved values. This function is supported only in the bandwidth of 10 M, 15 M, and 20 M.
item.name: dlVoiceRbRsvSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the starting positions of the reserved PDSCH RBs for VoLTE users. To configure the starting position, attention must be paid to the following: 1. The parameter value cannot exceed the upper limit of the bandwidth. 2. The reserved RBs may be decreased if the starting position is in the range of the PDSCH disabling bitmap, or in the case of MAGIC RADIO RB overlapping/high-speed rail ICO RB overlapping/PHS. 3. The starting positions should bypass high-interference RB segments. If the starting positions are in a high-interference RB segment, the number of reserved RBs available reduces. 4. To better use RB resources in an economical way, it is recommended that the starting positions of RBG resources be used as those of RB resources. For a bandwidth of 10 MHz, the RBG size is 3; for 15 MHz and 20 MHz, the RBG size is 4.
item.name: dlVoiceRbRsvStart

item.desc: This parameter indicates the number of reserved PDSCH RBs for VoLTE users. 1. The parameter value cannot exceed the upper limit of the bandwidth. 2. The parameter value cannot exceed the total number of RBs following the starting position.
item.name: dlVoiceRbRsvNum

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the upgrade of the DCCH priorities of VoLTE MO and MT users. If it is set to close, the upgrade of the DCCH priorities of VoLTE MO and MT users is disabled. If it is set to Upgrade MO/MT DL DCCH, only the downlink DCCH priorities of VoLTE MO and MT user are upgraded. If it is set to Upgrade MO/MT UL DCCH, only the uplink DCCH priorities of VoLTE MO and MT user are upgraded. If it is set to Upgrade MO/MT ALL DCCH, both the uplink and downlink DCCH priorities of VoLTE MO and MT user are upgraded.
item.name: voLTEMoMtDcchPriSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables DRX for VoLTE MO or MT users. For the VoLTE MO or MT users identified based on MSG3 messages, if this parameter is set to Open, DRX is disabled on the eNodeB from initial access to QCI1 bearer setup.
item.name: vtMoMtRecDrxSwch

item.desc: This parameter is Event Based DRX Reconfiguration Optimization Switch. The parameter value is set to Close: Do not reconfig DRX; The parameter value is set to Open: may reconfig DRX base on event:When A2 satisfies to enable Gap configuration , DRX is turned off; when A1 satisfies to disenable Gap, DRX is turned on.
item.name: dRXReConfigSwch

item.desc: When a VoLTE call occurs at the edge of a cell, it may fail if the TB size is too small. Therefore, the transmission bandwidth can afford a VoLTE call only when the size of the scheduled TBs is larger than the minimum value. If this parameter is set to Open, the eNodeB automatically recognizes scenarios and enables the minimum TB size for TB scheduling.
item.name: qCI5MinTBSizeSwch

item.desc: The parameter enables or disables SRS measurement for VoLTE users. If it is set to Open, SRS measurement is enabled for VoLTE users. If it is set to Close, SRS measurement is disabled for VoLTE users.
item.name: qci1SrsSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables VoLTE scheduling by layer. If it is set to Open, the number of pre-scheduled VoLTE users decreases when the load on the eNodeB is high, improving the user perception on data services. If it is set to Close, VoLTE scheduling by layer is disabled.
item.name: voLTEUllayerSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the configuration list of VoLTE scheduling by layer. It is controlled by bits. The first element represents the scheduling strategy used when the eNodeB load is high. The second element represents the scheduling strategy used when scheduling is limited. The meanings of the bits from low to high are as follows:0: VoLTE SR compensation scheduling1: pre-scheduling in the active period2: pre-scheduling in the silent period3: quick pre-scheduling for far-point UEs4: delayed scheduling5: compensation scheduling for delayed scheduling6: uplink pre-scheduling triggered by the downlink7: pre-scheduling after HARQ FAIL in the silent period8: QCI5 pre-scheduling9: pre-scheduling during QCI1 bearer setup10: VoLTE BSR priority increase to the SR priorityIf a bit is set to 0, it indicates that the corresponding layer-based scheduling strategy is enabled. If a bit is set to 1, it indicates that the corresponding layer-based scheduling strategy is disabled.
item.name: voLTELoadList

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink MCS threshold for better VoLTE quality. If the MCS of VoLTE UEs is higher than this threshold over a period of time, the eNodeB considers that the VoLTE quality is good enough and stops the inter-frequency handover or SRVCC procedure based on the VoLTE quality.
item.name: mCSThrd4VoLTEBetterDL

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink MCS threshold for worse VoLTE quality. If the MCS of VoLTE UEs is lower than this threshold over a period of time, the eNodeB triggers the inter-frequency handover or SRVCC procedure based on the VoLTE quality.
item.name: mCSThrd4VoLTEWorseDL

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink SINR threshold for better VoLTE quality. If the VoLTE SINR at which the UE concentrates the maximum transmit power on one RB is lower than this threshold, the eNodeB triggers the inter-frequency handover or SRVCC procedure based on the VoLTE quality.
item.name: sINRThrd4VoLTEWorseUL

item.desc: This parameter indicates the uplink SINR threshold for better VoLTE quality. If the VoLTE SINR at which the UE concentrates the maximum transmit power on one RB is higher than this threshold, the eNodeB considers that the VoLTE quality is good enough, and stops the inter-frequency handover or SRVCC procedure based on the VoLTE quality.
item.name: sINRThrd4VoLTEbetterUL

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables non-standard SRVCC-based handover. If it is set to Close, the SRVCC handover indication IE is configured in accordance with the standard SRVCC procedure. If it is set to Open, the SRVCC handover indication IE is set to CS only.
item.name: sRVCCCSonlySwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the worse-quality handover threshold based on voice quality. If voice quality is worse over consecutive periods, the voice quality-based handover procedure is triggered.
item.name: qualityWorseCnt

item.desc: This parameter sets the power increase threshold in the dynamic scheduling of the downlink VoIP service of a single UE. It is used to control the dynamic power increase value of VoIP services.
item.name: maxBoostPwr

item.desc: This parameter sets the better-quality handover threshold based on voice quality. If voice quality is better over consecutive periods, the voice quality-based handover procedure is stopped.
item.name: qualityBetterCnt

item.desc: This parameter sets the period for calculating the EMI value. If the EMI function is enabled, the uplink and downlink EMI values of a VoLTE UE are calculated in each statistical period to evaluate the call quality of the UE during this period of time.
item.name: eMIPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the range of EMI values. The first element of the parameter value indicates the maximum value of EMI counter range 1, the second element indicates the maximum value of EMI counter range 2, the third element indicates the maximum value of EMI counter range 3, the fourth element indicates the maximum value of EMI counter range 4, and the fifth element indicates the minimum value of EMI counter range 4.
item.name: eMIValue

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables PDSCH-PUSCH enhancement. If it is set to 0, PDSCH-PUSCH enhancement is disabled. If it is set to 1, PDSCH-PUSCH enhancement is enabled for VoLTE UEs only.
item.name: pdschPuschEnSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the strategy for processing weak-field QCI2 videos. If it is set to Close, no operation is performed. If it is set to Banning to Setup, the baseband disables QCI2 establishment after sending a weak-field report. If it is set to Releasing, the baseband releases the established QCI2 bearers after sending a weak-field report. If it is set to Banning to Setup and Releasing, the baseband disables QCI2 establishment or releases the established QCI2 bearers after sending a weak-field report.
item.name: weakCellStrategy4Video

item.desc: This parameter sets the SINR threshold for determining whether a UE has weak-field video services. If the uplink measurement value of the UE is lower than this threshold, the establishment of the QCI2 bearer is rejected.
item.name: weakCellSinrThrd4AddVideo

item.desc: This parameter sets the SINR threshold for determining whether a UE has weak-field video services. If the uplink measurement value of the UE is lower than this threshold, the QCI2 bearer is released.
item.name: weakCellSinrThrd4DelVideo

item.desc: This parameter indicates whether a video UE whose QCI2 bearer is established or is to be established is in the period indicated by the weak field. Before the QCI2 bearer is established, the eNodeB compares the SINR filtering result with the threshold for rejecting the establishment of QCI2 bearers in a weak field scenario. If the SINR is lower than the threshold, the eNodeB reports a weak-field indication (an indication for rejecting the establishment of a QCI2 bearer); otherwise, the eNodeB reports a strong-field indication (an indication for establishing a QCI2 bearer). After the QCI2 bearer is established, the eNodeB compares the SINR filtering result with the threshold for releasing QCI2 bearers in a weak field scenario. If the SINR is lower than the threshold, the eNodeB reports a weak-field indication (an indication for releasing the QCI2 bearer); otherwise, the eNodeB reports a strong-field indication (an indication for not releasing the QCI2 bearer).
item.name: weakCellSinrPeriod4Video

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the identification of abnormal VoLTE UEs. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB identifies abnormal VoLTE UEs and takes some special scheduling measures on them.
item.name: abUseIdntfySwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of conservative orders of the MCS for the UEs with HARQ failures caused by MCS jump. If the system identifies that a UE has a HARQ failure caused by MCS jump, it conserves the MCS scheduled for the UE.
item.name: abHFConseMcs

item.desc: This parameter sets the period of radio channel restriction determination, that is, whether poor channel quality results in abnormal voice quality in this period of time. If the BSR of a UE always reaches this threshold and there are resources scheduled for the UE, it is considered that the channel quality is abnormal and some measures need to be taken.
item.name: sINRLimitWin

item.desc: This parameter sets the period of time during which the scheduling opportunities are restricted. If a UE is not scheduled when its BSR meets this parameter value, the UE is identified as a scheduling-restricted UE. Special measures are taken on the UEs whose scheduling is restricted.
item.name: scheLimitWin

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of conservative orders of the PDCCH for the UEs with HARQ failures caused by DCI0 loss. If the system identifies that a UE has a HARQ failure caused by DCI0 loss, it conserves the PDCCH for the UE. The parameter value is added to the currently-allocated PDCCH for PDCCH resource allocation.
item.name: abHFPDCCHUpPower

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the number of times that large BSRs of abnormal VoLTE UEs are identified. If the BSR of a UE consecutively reaches this threshold, the system identifies it as a large-BSR error and performs a special processing procedure.
item.name: abAccBigBsrTimes

item.desc: This parameter sets the BSR threshold for identifying abnormal VoLTE UEs. When the BSR of a UE reaches the threshold, the system identifies it as a BSR error and performs a special processing procedure.
item.name: abAccBsrThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the number of abnormal VoLTE UEs that can be guaranteed. It can both identify and guarantee the maximum number of abnormal UEs. If the number of abnormal UEs exceeds this parameter, the identification and guarantee strategy does not apply to extra abnormal UEs.
item.name: abUserIdntfyNumThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the period of time for processing abnormal VoLTE UEs. When an abnormal VoLTE UE is identified, a processing policy is started and lasts for the time specified by this parameter.
item.name: abUserIdentifyTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the the threshold for the number of HARQ failures in the identification of abnormal VoLTE UEs. If it is set to a smaller value, it is easier to trigger a HARQ failure. If it is set to a larger value, it is more difficult to trigger a HARQ failure.
item.name: abHFThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the large-BSR threshold for identifying abnormal VoLTE UEs. It is used to determine whether an abnormal UE has a large number of packages. If the BSR of a UE exceeds this threshold, the UE is considered to have a large number of packages and the packages of the UE are discarded.
item.name: abAccBigBsrThrd

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to trigger uplink pre-scheduling by the downlink scheduling of voice services. It can ensure A/N feedback on the PUSCH to avoid wrong DTX detection by the PUCCH.
item.name: preSchd4PUCCH

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval between VoLTE quality detection. It is used to adjust the sensitivity of VoLTE quality detection. A smaller parameter value indicates a higher VoLTE quality detection sensitivity.
item.name: volteQualityDetectPrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the lower limit of the SINR to activate TTI bundling. If the SINR is lower than this threshold, TTI bundling is not activated. This parameter is used to avoid very poor uplink channel condition when TTI bundling is activated.
item.name: tTIBundSinrInLowerLimit

item.desc: This parameter sets the lower limit of the downlink MCS to activate TTI bundling. If the downlink MCS is lower than this threshold, TTI bundling is not activated. This parameter is used to avoid very poor downlink channel condition when TTI bundling is activated.
item.name: tTIBundDlMcsInLowerLimit

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum MCS value that can be used for uplink scheduling of VoLTE UEs. The TTIB and RLC fragmentation functions are not restricted by this parameter.
item.name: ulMCSMax4VT

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum MCS value that can be used for uplink scheduling of VoLTE UEs. The SPS and TTIB functions are not restricted by this parameter.
item.name: ulMCSMin4VT

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum MCS value that can be used for downlink scheduling of VoLTE UEs with QCI1 services. The SPS function is not restricted by this parameter.
item.name: dlMCSMin4VT

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum MCS value that can be used for downlink scheduling of VoLTE UEs with QCI1 services.
item.name: dlMCSMax4VT

item.desc: This parameter sets the single-RB SINR threshold offset for determining whether the uplink voice quality is degraded. If in qualityWorseCnt (Voice Quality-Based Worse-Quality Handover Threshold) consecutive volteQualityDetectPrd (VoLTE Quality Detection Interval) of the uplink single-RB SINR of a UE meets the following condition, the eNodeB triggers inter-frequency handover for the UE: sINRThrd4VoLTEWorseUL (UL SINR Threshold for Worse VoLTE Quality) less than UE uplink single-RB SINR less than or equal to sINRThrd4VoLTEWorseUL (UL SINR Threshold for Worse VoLTE Quality) + this parameter.
item.name: uLSINRTd4VoLTEWorseOffset

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink MCS threshold for determining whether the downlink voice quality is degraded. If the downlink MCS value of a UE meets both of the following conditions within consecutive N (specified by the qualityWorseCnt (Voice Quality-Based Worse-Quality Handover Threshold) parameter) periods (specified by the volteQualityDetectPrd (VoLTE Quality Detection Interval) parameter), the eNodeB triggers an inter-frequency migration procedure for the UE:(1) The downlink MCS value of the UE is larger than the mCSThrd4VoLTEWorseDL (DL MCS Threshold for Worse VoLTE Quality) parameter and smaller than or equal to the sum of the mCSThrd4VoLTEWorseDL parameter and this parameter. (2) The downlink BLER of the UE is larger than or equal to the difference between the srvccDlBler (BLER Threshold for Triggering Migration Due to Poor Downlink Quality) parameter and the dlBlerOffset (BLER Threshold Offset for Triggering Migration Due to Poor Downlink Quality) parameter, and smaller than the srvccDlBler parameter.
item.name: dLMCSTd4VoLTEWorseOffset

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink BLER threshold for determining whether the downlink voice quality is degraded. If the downlink MCS value and the downlink BLER of a UE meet both of the following conditions within consecutive N (specified by the qualityWorseCnt (Voice Quality-Based Worse-Quality Handover Threshold) parameter) periods (specified by the volteQualityDetectPrd (VoLTE Quality Detection Interval) parameter), the eNodeB triggers an inter-frequency migration procedure for the UE:(1) The downlink MCS value of the UE is larger than the mCSThrd4VoLTEWorseDL (DL MCS Threshold for Worse VoLTE Quality) parameter and smaller than or equal to the sum of the mCSThrd4VoLTEWorseDL parameter and the dLMCSTd4VoLTEWorseOffset (DL MCS Threshold Offset for Poor VoLTE Quality) parameter. (2) The downlink BLER of the UE is larger than or equal to the difference between the srvccDlBler (BLER Threshold for Triggering Migration Due to Poor Downlink Quality) parameter and this parameter, and smaller than the srvccDlBler parameter.
item.name: dlBlerOffset

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink BLER threshold for determining whether the downlink voice quality is degraded. If in qualityWorseCnt (Voice Quality-Based Worse-Quality Handover Threshold) consecutive volteQualityDetectPrd (VoLTE Quality Detection Interval) of the downlink of the downlink MCS and downlink BLER of a UE meet the following conditions, the eNodeB triggers inter-frequency migration or SRVCC for the UE: 1. UE downlink MCS less than or equal to mCSThrd4VoLTEWorseDL (DL MCS Threshold for Worse VoLTE Quality). 2. UE downlink BLER greater than or equal to this parameter.
item.name: srvccDlBler

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the optimization of uplink HARQ combination of VoLTE UEs. If it is set to 1 (Open) in the scenario where the uplink channel quality of VoLTE UEs is poor and the uplink BLER of the QCI1 service in a cell is high, the eNodeB combines HARQ data every N (Transmission Times of Each Group for VoLTE Uplink Retransmission Combination Optimization) times. In this way, the probability that the noise data is involved in HARQ combination can be reduced.
item.name: voLTEUlHarqOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times that uplink HARQ combination of VoLTE UEs is optimized. It is valid when the voLTEUlHarqStrategy (Uplink HARQ Combination Strategy of VoLTE UEs) parameter is set to 1 (Group Decoding) or 2 (Dual Decoding). If the voLTEUlHarqStrategy parameter is set to 1 (Group Decoding) or 2 (Dual Decoding) and the number of times that the eNodeB combines uplink HARQ data is larger than the parameter value, the cached historical HARQ data is discarded.
item.name: voLTEUlHarqGroupNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the priority for responding to uplink CoMP requests of UEs. If it is set to 0 (Voice preferred), it indicates that the eNodeB preferentially responds to the uplink CoMP requests of the UEs with voice and signaling services. If it is set to 1 (Far-point Voice preferred), it indicates that the eNodeB responds to the uplink CoMP requests of the following UEs in turn: far-point UEs with voice and signaling services, non-far-point UEs with voice and signaling services, UEs of a QoS type, and other UEs. If it is set to 2 (Type User preferred), it indicates that the eNodeB preferentially responds to the uplink CoMP requests of the UEs of a QoS type, UEs with voice services, and UEs signaling services.
item.name: uLCoMPPriority

item.desc: This parameter sets the SINR threshold of far-point UEs with voice services in uplink joint reception. If the SINR of a single RB of a voice UE is smaller than the parameter value, the UE is considered to be a far-point UE with the voice service. If the ucULCoMPPriority (Uplink CoMP Priority) parameter is set to 1 (Far-point Voice preferred), the eNodeB preferentially responds to the uplink joint-reception requests of the far-point UEs with voice services.
item.name: sinrThr4FarPointVoiceJRUe

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to assign higher scheduling priorities for VoLTE UEs with initial downlink transmission. In the case that the downlink scheduling resources of the eNodeB are insufficient, if this parameter is set to Open, when the eNodeB performs downlink initial scheduling, VoLTE UEs have higher scheduling priorities than non-VoLTE UEs' signaling scheduling.
item.name: voLTEDlNewTxPrioSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to control the RB allocation direction in subbands if NI-based frequency-domain position selection for QCI1 scheduling is enabled. If NI-based frequency-domain position selection for QCI1 scheduling is enabled and this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the RB allocation direction depends on the random numbers. For even random numbers, RBs are allocated to low frequencies first and then to high frequencies. For odd random numbers, RBs are allocated to high frequencies first and then to low frequencies.
item.name: swch4SubRbAllocDirection

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of times that TBs are transmitted to increase the uplink TB size of VoLTE UEs. It is valid if the rlcSegmentUl or tTIBRlcSegSwch parameter is set to 1 (Open).
item.name: maxHarqNum4SegTb

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the optimization of VoLTE services of the UEs at far points. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the far-point UEs that meet certain conditions and use VoLTE services can use a larger target BLER. In this case, if the CRC returns ACK messages, the MCS indexes increase more rapidly.
item.name: remoteOpt4VoLTESwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the non-conservative MCS policy for VoLTE UEs at far points in QCI5 scheduling. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the far-point UEs that use VoLTE services and meet certain conditions can use the non-conservative MCS policy in QCI5 scheduling.
item.name: conservedCancel4QCI5Swch

item.desc: This parameter is valid if the switch for optimizing VoLTE services of far-point UEs is set to 1 (Open). The larger of this parameter and the voLTEBlerUl parameter is used as the target BLER for scheduling the far-point UEs with VoLTE services. A larger target BLER indicates more rapid MCS index increase and a higher physical transmission rate during scheduling.
item.name: bler4Congestion

item.desc: This parameter sets the TB size threshold to determine whether the non-conservative MCS policy is used in QCI5 scheduling. If the TB size authorized for scheduling is smaller than the threshold, the non-conservative MCS policy is used in QCI5 scheduling. If the TB size authorized for scheduling is larger than or equal to the threshold, the conservative MCS policy is used in QCI5 scheduling.
item.name: qCI5TbsizeThr4NonConserve

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables downlink flow control optimization for VoLTE services. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. The first element enables or disables downlink flow control optimization for the QCI1 service. If this element is set to 1 (Open), the maximum downlink rate of the QCI1 service can be ten times that configured on the core network. The second element enables or disables downlink flow control optimization for the QCI2 service. If this element is set to 1 (Open), the maximum downlink rate of the QCI2 service can be five times that configured on the core network. If an element is set to 0 (Close), the maximum downlink rate of the corresponding QCI service is equal to the value configured on the core network.
item.name: voLTEDLFlowCtrlOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of two elements, which respectively set the low MCS threshold and the high MCS threshold for adjusting the recommended downlink bit rates. Three intervals are divided by the two thresholds: the interval in which the values are less than or equal to the low MCS threshold, the interval in which the values are greater than the low MCS threshold and less than or equal to the high MCS threshold, and the interval in which the values are greater than the high MCS threshold. If the average MCS values of VoLTE UEs are in each of the three intervals, for the AMR-WB coding mode, the bit rates are expected to be adjusted to 6.6 kbps, 12.65 kbps, and 23.85 kbps respectively; for the AMR-NB coding mode, the bit rates are expected to be adjusted to 5.9 kbps, 12.2 kbps, and 12.2 kbps respectively; for the EVS coding mode, the bit rates are expected to be adjusted to 9.6 kbps, 13.2 kbps, and 24.4 kbps respectively.The actual effective bit rate is also related to the UE policy. This parameter takes effect if the rBRDLSwch (Switch of DL Recommended Bit Rates) or aNBRQSwch (ANBRQ Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open).
item.name: mCSThr4DLRBR

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of two elements, which respectively set the low SINR threshold and the high SINR threshold for adjusting the recommended uplink bit rates in TDD cells. Three intervals are divided by the two thresholds: the interval in which the values are less than or equal to the low SINR threshold, the interval in which the values are greater than the low SINR threshold and less than or equal to the high SINR threshold, and the interval in which the values are greater than the high SINR threshold. If the filtering SINR values of VoLTE UEs are in each of the three intervals, for the AMR-WB coding mode, the bit rates are expected to be adjusted to 6.6 kbps, 12.65 kbps, and 23.85 kbps respectively; for the AMR-NB coding mode, the bit rates are expected to be adjusted to 5.9 kbps, 12.2 kbps, and 12.2 kbps respectively; for the EVS coding mode, the bit rates are expected to be adjusted to 9.6 kbps, 13.2 kbps, and 24.4 kbps respectively.The actual effective bit rate is also related to the UE policy. This parameter takes effect if the rBRSwch (Switch of Recommended Bit Rates) or aNBRQSwch (ANBRQ Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open).
item.name: sinrThrTDD4ULRBR

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the offhook protection timer for the recommended bit rate function. It is used to set the duration during which the recommended bit rate cannot be adjusted after a QCI1 bearer is established. If both of the following conditions are met, the timer is started after a QCI1 bearer is established:(1) The rBRDLSwch, aNBRQSwch, or rBRSwch parameter is set to Open. (2) The UE supports adjusting the recommended bit rate or querying the recommended bit rate. Bit rate adjustment is not allowed before the timer expires. After the timer expires, the eNodeB is allowed to deliver the MAC CE to the UE to adjust the bit rate.
item.name: rBRPickUpProtectTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the RB usage threshold for adjusting the recommended downlink bit rates. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. The first element indicates the RB usage threshold for downlink rate increase. The rate can increase only if the actual RB usage of the cell is lower than the threshold. The second element indicates the RB usage threshold for downlink rate decrease. The rate can decrease only if the actual RB usage of the cell is higher than the threshold.
item.name: rbUsageThr4DLRBR

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to reserve RBs for TTIB-enabled VoLTE UEs in PUSCH transmission. If the voiceRbRsvSwchUl (Switch for The Reserved VoLTE RB Function) parameter is set to 1 (Open): If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), RBs can be reserved for TTIB-enabled VoLTE UEs in PUSCH transmission; if this parameter is set to 0 (Close), RBs cannot be reserved for TTIB-enabled VoLTE UEs in PUSCH transmission.
item.name: enterPUSCHRBRsvSwch4TTIB

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to include DTX in downlink BLER calculation for PDSCH power boosting of downlink VoLTE services. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), DTX is included in downlink BLER calculation for PDSCH power boosting. In this case, it is easier to meet the conditions for PDSCH power boosting, reducing the downlink BLER of VoLTE services. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), DTX cannot be included in downlink BLER calculation for PDSCH power boosting. In this case, it is more difficult to meet the conditions for PDSCH power boosting, increasing the downlink BLER of VoLTE services.
item.name: dTXStatSwch4PDSCHBoost

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to include DTX in BLER threshold calculation for voice quality-based handover. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), DTX can be included in BLER threshold calculation for voice quality-based handover. In this case, if the quality of downlink VoLTE services is worse and DTX occurs more frequently, it is easier to meet the conditions for triggering voice quality-based handover, reducing the dropped-call rate and packet loss rate of VoLTE services. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), DTX cannot be included in BLER threshold calculation for voice quality-based handover. In this case, if the quality of downlink VoLTE services is worse and DTX occurs more frequently, it is more difficult to meet the conditions for triggering voice quality-based handover, increasing the dropped-call rate and packet loss rate of VoLTE services.
item.name: dTXStatInBlerSwch4QualHo

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to use filtering SINR values during voice quality-based handover. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), filtering SINR values are used during voice quality-based handover, improving the success rate of voice quality-based handover and reducing the dropped-call rate. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), transient SINR values are used during voice quality-based handover. In this case, call drops may occur because voice quality-based handover measurement is performed or the RRC Connection Reconfiguration Complete message fails to be scheduled.
item.name: qualHOFilterSinrSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum numbers of scheduled RBs in localized downlink VRB assignment. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. Element 0 sets the minimum number of scheduled RBs in localized downlink VRB assignment for the UEs with QCI1 services. Element 1 sets the minimum number of scheduled RBs in localized downlink VRB assignment for the UEs with non-QCI1 services. Element 1 is valid if the type1RBAllocEnableSwchDl (Switch of Type1 RB Allocation) parameter is set to 1 (Open). If the minimum number of RBs scheduled for the UEs with QCI1 and non-QCI1 services is larger than 1, the downlink error packet rate of the UEs decreases.
item.name: dlMinRbNumForVRB

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to remove the restriction on the number of available RBs for scheduling during the RLF observation period of VoLTE UEs. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. Element 0 sets whether to remove the restriction on the number of available RBs for QCI1 and QCI2 service scheduling during the RLF observation period of VoLTE UEs and element 1 sets whether to remove the restriction on the number of available RBs for signaling scheduling during the RLF observation period of VoLTE UEs. If an element is set to 0 (Close), the number of available RBs for the corresponding scheduling is restricted during the RLF observation period of VoLTE UEs. In this case, the corresponding scheduling is likely to be fragmented, resulting in a longer scheduling delay and a higher packet loss rate. If an element is set to 1 (Open), the number of available RBs for the corresponding scheduling is not restricted during the RLF observation period of VoLTE UEs. In this case, the scheduling delay and packet loss rate do not deteriorate.
item.name: rLFCancelRBLimitSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the SINR threshold of a single RB for evaluating poor uplink channel quality of a UE during call hold identification. If the uplink SINR of a single RB of a UE is smaller than or equal to the threshold, it indicates that the channel quality of the UE is poor and does not meet the call hold identification conditions. If the uplink SINR of a single RB of a UE is larger than the threshold, it indicates that the channel quality of the UE is good and meets the call hold identification conditions.
item.name: callHoldIdenSINRThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the BLER threshold for evaluating the uplink channel quality of UEs during call hold identification. If the uplink BLER of a UE is smaller than or equal to the threshold, it indicates that the packet error rate in Uu scheduling is low and meets the call hold identification conditions. If the uplink BLER of a UE is larger than the threshold, it indicates that the channel quality during Uu scheduling is poor and does not meet the call hold identification conditions.
item.name: callHoldIdenBLERThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of HARQ failures for poor-quality VoLTE UEs to exit reserved uplink VoLTE RB segments. It is an array consisting of two elements. Element 0 sets the threshold number of HARQ failures for identifying the channel quality of the UEs to be good after the UEs are scheduled in the reserved RB segments. Element 1 sets the threshold number of HARQ failures for identifying the channel quality of the UEs to be still poor after the UEs are scheduled in the reserved RB segments. After a UE is scheduled in a reserved RB segment, the current period is identified as a good-quality period if the number of HARQ failures of the UE is smaller than the value of element 0. If consecutive M periods are identified as good-quality periods, the UE is identified as a good-quality UE and is not scheduled in the reserved RB segment. After a UE is scheduled in a reserved RB segment, the current period is still identified as a poor-quality period if the number of HARQ failures of the UE is larger than or equal to the value of element 1. If consecutive M periods are still identified as poor-quality periods, the UE is still identified as a poor-quality UE and is not scheduled in the reserved RB segment. M is the value of element 1 of the ulNum4DecisionPrid (Number of Consecutive Periods for Poor-Quality or Good-Quality VoLTE UE Decision in Uplink VoLTE RB Reservation) parameter.
item.name: ulExitRbRsvHarqFailThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of consecutive periods during which the channel quality of VoLTE UEs is identified to be poor or good in the case that uplink VoLTE RB reservation is enabled. It is an array parameter consisting of three elements. Element 0 sets the number of consecutive periods during which the channel quality of a VoLTE UE is identified to be poor. Element 1 sets the number of consecutive periods during which the channel quality of a VoLTE UE is identified to be good when the UE is scheduled in a reserved RB segment. Element 2 sets the number of consecutive periods for a poor-quality VoLTE UE to wait for another poor-quality-VoLTE-UE identification after the UE scheduled in a reserved RB segment is still identified as a poor-quality UE and therefore exits the reserved RB segment. If the uplink channel quality of a VoLTE UE is identified to be poor, it can be scheduled in the reserved uplink RB segments. If the uplink channel quality of a poor-quality VoLTE UE is identified to be good or still poor when it is scheduled in a reserved uplink RB segment, it exits the reserved uplink RB segment.
item.name: ulNum4DecisionPrid

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of HARQ failures for identifying abnormal UEs if downlink VoLTE RB reservation is enabled. After a QCI1 bearer is established, if the dlVoiceRbRsvSwch parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB periodically performs abnormal-UE identification. If the number of downlink HARQ failures within the period specified by the dlVoiceRbRsvPeriod (Period for Identifying Abnormal UEs in Downlink VoLTE RB Reservation) parameter is larger than or equal to this parameter value, the VoLTE UE can be scheduled in a reserved downlink VoLTE RB segment and use the RB resources in the reserved segment.
item.name: dlVoiceRbRsvHarqFailThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the period for identifying abnormal UEs if downlink VoLTE RB reservation is enabled. After a QCI1 bearer is established, if the dlVoiceRbRsvSwch parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB periodically detects the number of HARQ failures within the period specified by this parameter to determine whether the current period is a poor-quality period. If the current period is identified as a poor-quality period, the VoLTE UE can be scheduled in a reserved downlink VoLTE RB segment and use the RB resources in the reserved segment.
item.name: dlVoiceRbRsvPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to exit the uplink VoLTE RB reservation function. If the voiceRbRsvSwchUl parameter is set to 1 (Open), the poor-quality VoLTE UEs for which uplink VoLTE RB reservation is enabled can exit reserved uplink VoLTE RB segments when their channel quality becomes good or is still poor even if they are scheduled in the reserved uplink VoLTE RB segments.
item.name: ulVoiceRbRsvExitSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of HARQ failures for identifying abnormal UEs if uplink VoLTE RB reservation is enabled. After a QCI1 bearer is established, if the voiceRbRsvSwchUl parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB periodically performs abnormal-UE identification. If the number of uplink HARQ failures within the period specified by the ulVoiceRbRsvPeriod (Period for Identifying Abnormal UEs in Uplink VoLTE RB Reservation) parameter is larger than or equal to this parameter value, this period is regarded as a poor-quality period. If consecutive L (L is the value of element 0 of the ulNum4DecisionPrid (Number of Consecutive Periods for Poor-Quality or Good-Quality VoLTE UE Decision in Uplink VoLTE RB Reservation) parameter) periods are identified as poor-quality periods, the VoLTE UE can be scheduled in a reserved uplink VoLTE RB segment and use the RB resources in the reserved segment.
item.name: ulVoiceRbRsvHarqFailThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the period for identifying abnormal UEs if uplink VoLTE RB reservation is enabled. After a QCI1 bearer is established, if the voiceRbRsvSwchUl parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB periodically detects the number of HARQ failures within the period specified by this parameter to determine whether the current period is a poor-quality period. If consecutive L (L is the value of element 0 of the ulNum4DecisionPrid (Number of Consecutive Periods for Poor-Quality or Good-Quality VoLTE UE Decision in Uplink VoLTE RB Reservation) parameter) periods are identified as poor-quality periods, the VoLTE UE can be scheduled in a reserved uplink VoLTE RB segment and use the RB resources in the reserved segment.
item.name: ulVoiceRbRsvPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink HARQ combination strategy of VoLTE UEs. If this parameter is set to 1 (Group Decoding) or 2 (Dual Decoding) in the scenarios where the uplink channel quality of VoLTE UEs is poor and the uplink BLER of the QCI1 services in the cell is high, the probability that the noise data is involved in HARQ combination can decrease. If this parameter is set to 1 (Group Decoding), the eNodeB combines HARQ data every N (specified by the voLTEUlHarqGroupNum (Transmission Times of Each Group for VoLTE Uplink Retransmission Combination Optimization) parameter) times. If this parameter is set to 2 (Dual Decoding), the eNodeB performs secondary HARQ combination based on the result of group decoding and common HARQ combination to improve the demodulation performance of uplink scheduling of VoLTE UEs.
item.name: voLTEUlHarqStrategy

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of times that uplink one-way faults consecutively occur on a VoLTE UE. It is used to check whether the call quality of the VoLTE UE is poor. If the voiceULOwfWorseRecovSwch (Switch for Recovering VoLTE Calls with Poor Quality Caused by Uplink One-Way Faults) parameter is not set to 0 (Close) and the eNodeB detects that the number of consecutive uplink one-way faults of a VoLTE UE is larger than or equal to this threshold, the eNodeB determines that the call quality of the VoLTE UE is poor.
item.name: voiceWorseConULOwfNum

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to recover the VoLTE calls with poor quality caused by uplink one-way faults. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. Element 0 and element 1 respectively set whether to recover the VoLTE calls of SA UEs and NSA UEs with poor call quality caused by uplink one-way faults. If an element is set to 1 (Intra-cell Handover Strategy), the eNodeB preferentially triggers the intra-cell handover procedure for the VoLTE UEs with poor call quality caused by uplink one-way faults. If an element is set to 2 (Blind Redirection Strategy), the eNodeB preferentially triggers the blind redirection procedure for the VoLTE UEs with poor call quality caused by uplink one-way faults. If an element is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB does not trigger any special procedure for the VoLTE UEs with poor call quality caused by uplink one-way faults.
item.name: voiceULOwfWorseRecovSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the RRC reconfiguration timer for UEs with poor voice quality. If the voiceULOwfWorseRecovSwch (Switch for Recovering VoLTE Calls with Poor Quality Caused by Uplink One-Way Faults) parameter is not set to 0 (Close), this timer is started when the eNodeB sends an RRCReconfiguration message during an intra-cell handover for a voice UE with poor uplink one-way call quality. This timer stops when the eNodeB receives an RRCReconfigurationComplete message from the UE. When this timer expires, the eNodeB triggers the blind redirection procedure for the UE.
item.name: voiceWorseRecfgProtTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to perform admission control on the access of voice users and/or the establishment of QCI1 and QCI2 bearers to ensure user experience in the cell.
item.name: voLTEACSwch

item.desc: This parameter is used to guarantee user experience in a cell. It sets the limit of the number of accessed QCI1 bearers in a cell. The operator can configure the parameter as required, but the parameter value cannot exceed the number of users allowed to be admitted in the cell.
item.name: qci1NumACThrd

item.desc: This parameter is used to guarantee user experience in a cell. It sets the limit of the number of accessed QCI2 bearers in a cell. The operator can configure the parameter as required, but the parameter value cannot exceed the number of users allowed to be admitted in the cell.
item.name: qci2NumACThrd

item.desc: Switch of VoLTE user number congestion control , which determine whether VoLTE user number congestion control is valid or not.
item.name: volteCongSwch

item.desc: Performance period of VoLTE user number congestion control is used to evaluate VoLTE user number load and SRVCC process.
item.name: voLTECongPeriod

item.desc: This parameter is used to judge whether the VoLTE user number of the cell is congestion or not.
item.name: volteCongStarThrd

item.desc: This parameter is used to judge whether the VoLTE user number congestion of the cell is relieve or not.
item.name: volteCongStopThrd

item.desc: This parameter determines the number of volte user migrated by SRVCC.
item.name: volteNum2Migration

item.desc: For this parameter and MMTELVoice user ratio hysteresis for the adjustment of SSAC barring parameter,once the MMTELVoice user ratio load is greater than the sum of two, the launch of the downward adjustment of ssac-BarringForMMTEL-Voice-Factor begins and contiues untill the MMTELVoice user ratio load is less than or equal to this parameter, or the ssac-BarringForMMTEL-Voice-Factor reaches its low limit. While ,once the MMTELVoice user ratio load is lower than their difference,the launch of the upward adjustment of ssac-BarringForMMTEL-Voice-Factor begins and contiues untill the MMTELVoice user ratio load is greater than or equal to this parameter,or the ssac-BarringForMMTEL-Voice-Factor reaches the upper limit of 1.
item.name: acbVolteVoiceThrsh

item.desc: For this parameter and MMTELVoice user ratio trigger threshold for the adjustment of SSAC barring parameter,once the MMTELVoice user ratio load is greater than the sum of two, the launch of the downward adjustment of ssac-BarringForMMTEL-Voice-Factor begins and contiues untill the MMTELVoice user ratio load is less than or equal to the later, or the ssac-BarringForMMTEL-Voice-Factor reaches its low limit. While ,once the MMTELVoice user ratio load is lower than their difference,the launch of the upward adjustment of ssac-BarringForMMTEL-Voice-Factor begins and contiues untill the MMTELVoice user ratio load is greater than or equal to the later,or the ssac-BarringForMMTEL-Voice-Factor reaches the upper limit of 1.
item.name: acbVolteVoiceHys

item.desc: MMTELVoice user ratio load estimation window for the adjustment of SSAC barring parameter.
item.name: acbVolteVoiceLoadWin

item.desc: For this parameter and MMTELVideo user ratio hysteresis for the adjustment of SSAC barring parameter,once the MMTELVideo user ratio load is greater than the sum of two, the launch of the downward adjustment of ssac-BarringForMMTEL-Video-Factor begins and contiues untill the MMTELVideo user ratio load is less than or equal to this parameter, or the ssac-BarringForMMTEL-Video-Factor reaches its low limit. While ,once the MMTELVideo user ratio load is lower than their difference,the launch of the upward adjustment of ssac-BarringForMMTEL-Video-Factor begins and contiues untill the MMTELVideo user ratio load is greater than or equal to this parameter,or the ssac-BarringForMMTEL-Video-Factor reaches the upper limit of 1.
item.name: acbVolteVideoThrsh

item.desc: For this parameter and MMTELVideo user ratio trigger threshold for the adjustment of SSAC barring parameter,once the MMTELVideo user ratio load is greater than the sum of two, the launch of the downward adjustment of ssac-BarringForMMTEL-Video-Factor begins and contiues untill the MMTELVideo user ratio load is less than or equal to the later, or the ssac-BarringForMMTEL-Video-Factor reaches its low limit. While ,once the MMTELVideo user ratio load is lower than their difference,the launch of the upward adjustment of ssac-BarringForMMTEL-Video-Factor begins and contiues untill the MMTELVideo user ratio load is greater than or equal to the later,or the ssac-BarringForMMTEL-Video-Factor reaches the upper limit of 1.
item.name: acbVolteVideoHys

item.desc: MMTELVideo user ratio load estimation window for the adjustment of SSAC barring parameter.
item.name: acbVolteVideoLoadWin
