If CFI compression is enabled, a larger parameter value can reduce the number of CFI symbols by proportion on the subframes for common scheduling, thus reducing the number of CFI symbols and improving PDCCH usage.
item.name: cFIAdaptCoff

item.desc: This parameter sets the self-adaption threshold coefficient of the CFI symbols on the subframes for common scheduling. If CFI compression is enabled, a larger parameter value can reduce the number of CFI symbols by proportion on the subframes for common scheduling, thus reducing the number of CFI symbols and improving the PDCCH usage.
item.name: commCFIAdaptCoff

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables uplink CCE power requirement optimization. If it is set to Open when the estimated number of CFI symbols is too large, the uplink CCE power compensation value can be reduced to decrease the number of CFI symbols.
item.name: uLCCEPwrAddPromSwth

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of CFI symbols in CFI self-adaptation. A smaller parameter value can reduce the maximum number of CFI symbols in the CFI self-adaptation procedure to improve the PDCCH utilization rate.
item.name: maxCFIAdapt

item.desc: This parameter sets the self-adaption threshold coefficient of the CFI symbols on simultaneous subframes. In a TDD system, if CFI compression is enabled, a larger parameter value can reduce the number of CFI symbols on simultaneous subframes by proportion, thus improving the PDCCH usage rate.
item.name: symTxRxCFIAdaptCoff

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of CFI symbols on simultaneous subframes in CFI self-adaptation in a TDD system. A smaller parameter value indicates a smaller peak number of CFI symbols occupied and a higher PDCCH usage rate.
item.name: symTxRxMaxCFIAdapt

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables inter-beam power sharing for the PDCCH in a smart space-division FMM group. If it is set to Open, the PDCCH performance can be improved.
item.name: sSCGPdcchPwrShareSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable PDCCH conversion optimization. If this parameter is set to Open, the eNodeB increases the PDCCH power and CCE aggregation level to improve the PDCCH demodulation performance.
item.name: pdcchConvertOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum number of available PDCCH symbols for CFI adaptation. The larger the parameter value is, the more available PDCCH resources there are.
item.name: minCFIAdapt

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the function of increasing PDCCH resources available for VoLTE UEs. If this parameter is set to Open, more PDCCH resources can be available for VoLTE UEs in the case that CFI adaptation is enabled for the VoLTE UEs.
item.name: volteCFIEnhancedSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the downlink PRB usage for CFI compression. It is used to determine whether CFI compression takes effect. If the cFICompressSwth parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the downlink PRB usage of the cell is higher than or equal to this threshold, CFI compression takes effect.
item.name: cfiComprssDlPrbRatioThr

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to count the number of CCE allocation failures based on the number of available PRBs. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), CCEs are allocated and counted in a best-effort way. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), whether to count the number of CCE allocation failures depends on the number of PRBs available in the current TTI. If there is no available PRB in the current TTI, the number of CCE allocation failures is not counted, reducing the collection of the statistics on the number of CCE allocation failures.
item.name: cCEFailStatBasedPrbSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to add CCEs when CCE allocation fails. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the number of CCEs that need to be added is estimated based on the number of UEs for which resources are successfully scheduled. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the number of CCEs that need to be added is estimated when CCE allocation fails.
item.name: cceAddBasedCceFailSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink PRB usage threshold in the case that CCEs are insufficient. If the uplink PRB usage is lower than this threshold and CCEs are insufficient within a period, CCEs need to be added.
item.name: ulCceLessPrbRatioThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion of subframes in the case that uplink CCEs are insufficient. Within a period, if the number of subframes in which CCE allocation fails exceeds this threshold, it is considered that uplink CCEs are insufficient.
item.name: ulCceLessTtiRatio

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink PRB usage threshold in the case that CCEs are insufficient. If the downlink PRB usage is lower than this threshold and CCEs are insufficient within a period, CCEs need to be added.
item.name: dlCceLessPrbRatioThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion of subframes in the case that downlink CCEs are insufficient. Within a period, if the number of subframes in which CCE allocation fails exceeds this threshold, it is considered that downlink CCEs are insufficient.
item.name: dlCceLessTtiRatio

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of RRC-connected UEs for rolling back the maximum PDCCH index of signaling. If the number of RRC-connected UEs is larger than the threshold, the maximum PDCCH index needs to be rolled back to schedule more UEs.
item.name: rRCNumThrForCCE

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum PDCCH indexes that can be rolled back. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. The first element and the second element represent the maximum PDCCH indexes that can be rolled back for non-VoLTE UEs and VoLTE UEs respectively, and are used to adjust CCEs used by the non-VoLTE UEs and VoLTE UEs.
item.name: pDCCHIdxFallBack

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to control the PDCCH demodulation performance in signaling scheduling by setting the maximum PDCCH indexes. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the maximum PDCCH index for signaling scheduling is the value of the maxPdcchIdxForDCCH (Maximum PDCCH Index for Signaling Scheduling) parameter. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the maximum PDCCH indexes for signaling scheduling of non-VoLTE UEs and VoLTE UEs are the values of the first and second elements of the pdcchIdxMaxValue array parameter separately.
item.name: dcchOwnMaxPdcchIdxSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum PDCCH index for signaling scheduling. During PDCCH self-adaptation of signaling, if the dcchOwnMaxPdcchIdxSwch (Switch for Setting the Maximum PDCCH Indexes for Signaling Scheduling) parameter is set to 1 (Open), the PDCCH index cannot exceed this parameter value. A larger parameter value indicates better PDCCH demodulation performance of signaling.
item.name: maxPdcchIdxForDCCH

item.desc: This parameter sets the period for which the eNodeB determines whether CCEs are insufficient. If the CCEs are insufficient in a period, additional CCEs are added in the next period.
item.name: cceLessStatPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the BF gain coefficient of the PDCCH inner-loop. A more-accurate inner-loop measurement value can be obtained by subtracting the BF gain value from the inner-loop value of the PDCCH. Where, the BF gain is the gain of the CSI-RS beams relative to the CRS beams.
item.name: bFgainFactorForPDCCH

item.desc: This parameter sets the period during which statistics on the muting-RBs are collected. If the CRSMutingPDCCHFBSwch (PDCCH Index Decrease Switch in CRS Muting Scenarios) parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB collects statistics on the levels of muting-RBs in the period specified by this parameter to determine the values by which the PDCCH indexes decrease.
item.name: cRSMutingRBStatPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the values by which the PDCCH indexes decrease in CRS muting scenarios. It is an array parameter consisting of twelve elements. It is valid if the CRSMutingPDCCHFBSwch (PDCCH Index Decrease Switch in CRS Muting Scenarios) parameter is set to 1 (Open). Elements 0 through 3 indicate the values by which the PDCCH indexes that correspond to the muting-RB (RBs whose CRS power needs to be muted) levels of 0%, 30%, 60%, and 100% for far-point UEs in turn decrease. Elements 4 through 7 indicate the values by which the PDCCH indexes that correspond to the muting-RB levels of 0%, 30%, 60%, and 100% for middle-point UEs in turn decrease. Elements 8 through 11 indicate the values by which the PDCCH indexes that correspond to the muting-RB levels of 0%, 30%, 60%, and 100% for near-point UEs in turn decrease.
item.name: cRSMutingFBPDCCH

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables PDCCH index decrease. It is used to determine whether to adjust the PDCCH indexes in CRS muting scenarios. If CRS muting is enabled in LTE networks, the CQIs of UEs may be smaller, the PDCCH indexes may be larger, and more CCE resources may be used. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the PDCCH indexes can be decreased by certain values to improve the CCE resource usage.
item.name: cRSMutingPDCCHFBSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to allocate uplink and downlink CCE resources based on subframes in DSS time division scenarios. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), uplink and downlink CCE resources are allocated based on subframes.
item.name: cceTimeDivisionSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink CCE proportion in time division scheduling of uplink and downlink CCE resource allocation. It is used to control the number of available downlink CCE resources allocated to subframes. To increase the number available downlink CCE resources allocated to subframes, set this parameter to a larger value.
item.name: cceSubfrmDlRatioOnNR

item.desc: This parameter sets the steps for PDCCH index decrease. It is used to set the values of PDCCH index decrease in the case that consecutive ACK messages are received on the PDCCH. This parameter is an array consisting of two elements. Element 1 sets the step for ordinary UEs and element 2 sets the step for VoLTE UEs.
item.name: pdcchDownSteplength

item.desc: This parameter sets the steps for outer-loop PDCCH index increase. It is used to set the value of outer-loop PDCCH index increase. This parameter is an array consisting of two elements. Element 1 sets the step for ordinary UEs and element 2 sets the step for VoLTE UEs.
item.name: pdcchUpSteplength

item.desc: This parameter sets the window lengths for outer-loop PDCCH index increase. When the number of times that DTX occurs reaches the parameter value, the PDCCH index increases. This parameter is an array consisting of two elements. Element 1 sets the window length for ordinary UEs and element 2 sets the window length for VoLTE UEs.
item.name: pdcchUpWindowlength

item.desc: This parameter sets the window lengths for outer-loop PDCCH index decrease. If no DTX occurs on the PDCCH within the window length, the PDCCH index decreases. This parameter is an array consisting of two elements. Element 1 sets the window length for ordinary UEs and element 2 sets the window length for VoLTE UEs.
item.name: pdcchDownWindowlength

item.desc: This parameter sets the lower limit of the offset for PDCCH index decrease. The total PDCCH index decrease is smaller than or equal to the parameter value.
item.name: pdcchIdxLowLimitdelta

item.desc: This parameter sets the high threshold of the proportion of subframes with insufficient CCEs. It is used to check whether the CCEs allocated to the cell are insufficient. If the number of TTIs in which CCEs are insufficient within a statistical period is larger than the threshold, the CCEs are insufficient.
item.name: cceLessTtiRatioHiThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the low threshold of the proportion of subframes with insufficient CCEs. It is used to check whether the CCEs allocated to the cell are sufficient. If the number of TTIs in which CCEs are insufficient within a statistical period is smaller than the threshold, the CCEs are sufficient.
item.name: cceLessTtiRatioLowThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the offsets to the adaptive CFI threshold for common-scheduling subframes and bidirectional subframes. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. Element 0 sets the offset to the adaptive CFI threshold for common-scheduling subframes and element 1 sets the offset to the adaptive CFI threshold for bidirectional subframes. The adaptive CFI threshold used for common-scheduling subframes or bidirectional subframes is the difference between the CFI threshold selected for the adaptive CFI threshold and the value of element 0 or element 1 of this parameter.
item.name: cFIAdaptThrOffset

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables adaptive-CFI-threshold selection. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the adaptive CFI threshold is adaptively adjusted based on the CCE allocation failures and PRB usage in the range from cfiAdaptThrd (Threshold of CFI adaption) to cFIAdaptCoff (Self-Adaption Threshold Coefficient of CFI Symbols). If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the adaptive CFI threshold is the cfiAdaptThrd value configured on the UME.
item.name: cFIAdaptThrSelectSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold proportion of remaining RBs in each scheduling subframe. If the ratio of the number of remaining RBs in a subframe after RB estimation is completed to the total number of RBs in the bandwidth is larger than or equal to the threshold, the eNodeB determines that there are insufficient CCEs in the current subframe.
item.name: rbRestRatioThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of RRC-Connected UEs used in large-capacity PDCCH optimization. It is used to check whether a cell is in a large-capacity scenario. If the number of UEs in a cell exceeds this threshold, it is determined that the cell is in a large-capacity scenario and PDCCH resource allocation is optimized.
item.name: pdcchHiLoadRRCNumThr

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to optimize the adaptive PDCCH parameters. In large-capacity scenarios, if this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB reduces the adaptive CCE aggregation level of UEs, thus reducing the probability of CCE allocation failures caused by insufficient CCE resources and power in the cell.
item.name: pdcchAdpParaOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to optimize the PDCCH parameters related to common scheduling in large-capacity scenarios. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB restricts the number of CCE resources used for common scheduling, thus reducing the number of times that CCEs fail to be allocated due to insufficient CCE resources and power.
item.name: commonPdcchParaOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to optimize the adaptive CFI parameters in large-capacity scenarios. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the number of available PDCCH resources can increase, decreasing the number of times that CCEs fail to be allocated due to insufficient CCE resources and power.
item.name: cfiAdpParaOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of selected UEs with a low CCE aggregation level. It is used to increase the number of selected UEs at medium and near points during scheduling. If the number of currently selected UEs with a low CCE aggregation level is smaller than or equal to the threshold, the number of UEs to be scheduled needs to be increased.
item.name: smallCCENumThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the offset threshold for fuzzy DTX fed back on the PUCCH. It is used to check whether DTX occurring on the PUCCH is fuzzy DTX. If the difference between the DTX proportion fed back on the PUCCH and that fed back on the PUSCH is larger than the threshold, it is determined that the DTX fed back on the PUCCH is fuzzy DTX.
item.name: pucchFuzzyDtxDalta

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to delete fuzzy DTX for outer-loop PDCCH control. It is used to eliminate the impact of fuzzy DTX on outer-loop PDCCH control. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), outer-loop PDCCH control statistics do not include the data of fuzzy DTX fed back by the PUCCH or that fed back by the PUSCH in the case of high interference. In this case, the CCE aggregation level may reduce.
item.name: pdcchFuzzyDtxDelSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of selected UEs with a low CCE aggregation level. If the parameter value is larger than 0 and the number of selected UEs with a low CCE aggregation level is insufficient, the eNodeB extra selects UEs with a low CCE aggregation level to increase the number of UEs to be scheduled in the cell. The extra number is the value of this parameter. If this parameter is set to 0, it indicates that no more UE with a low CCE aggregation level is selected.
item.name: cCEAddQosUENum

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of CCE allocation failures for the maximum PDCCH index adaptation function. It is an array parameter consisting of three elements and used to control whether to adjust the maximum PDCCH index. Elements 0 through 2 indicate the thresholds of the number of CCE allocation failures for data services, voice services, and signaling services respectively. If the number of CCE allocation failures of services of a certain type is larger than the corresponding threshold, the eNodeB decreases the maximum PDCCH index value for scheduling the services, reducing the number of CCE allocation failures due to insufficient resources.
item.name: cceAllocFailNumThr

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable the adaption of the maximum PDCCH index. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB reduces the adaptive CCE aggregation level of UEs, thus reducing the probability of CCE allocation failures caused by insufficient CCE resources and power in the cell.
item.name: maxPdcchIdxAdpSwch

item.desc: Full Distinguished Name
item.name: FDN

item.desc: Date Time
item.name: DATETIME

item.desc: Collection period of measurement task.
item.name: granularityPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: id

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: moId

item.desc: HARQ has the retransmit mechanism. The parameter indicates the maximum transmit for HARQ and can be configurated different value for different sevice.
item.name: harqMaxTxNum

item.desc: The parameter indicates the timer of periodic buffer status report.
item.name: prdBsrTimer

item.desc: The parameter indicates the timer of buffer status report retransmition.
item.name: retxBsrTimer

item.desc: Master switch for normal user HTTP experience.
item.name: httpCare4NormUserSwch

item.desc: The first switch for for the eighth level user experience,and it is used for controlling DNS proxy,It is valid only under the condition of httpCare4NormUserSwch open.
item.name: dnsProxy4NormUserSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the identification of the current service flow. If the ServiceMAC. HttpCare4NormUserSwch parameter is set to Open and this parameter is set to Open, the eNodeB identifies whether the current service flow is an HTTP service flow.
item.name: httpRecog4NormUserSwch

item.desc: The third switch for the eighth level user experience,and it is used for controlling Pre-Scheduling for three times handshake and subsequent get request,It is valid only under the condition of ucHttpCare4NorUserSwch open.
item.name: httpPreSch4NormUserSwch

item.desc: This parameter is used for extending,and high-layer will recongnize HTTP or SYN ACK for normal user using this port.
item.name: port4HTTPOrSYNACK4NormUser

item.desc: This parameter sets the hysteresis threshold for adjusting abnormal TA values. If either of the following conditions is met, a large smoothing factor is used for time offset filtering:(1) The consecutive number of times that the time offset values obtained through SRS measurement exceeds the parameter value. (2) The consecutive number of times that the time offset values obtained through PUSCH measurement meet both the SINR and DCI0Lost requirements exceeds the parameter value. In other cases, a small smoothing factor is used for time offset filtering.
item.name: taDelayThr

item.desc: This Parameter is the length of the window which is used for random access procedure. The purpose is to avoid transmitting SR so as to reduce the related time delay.
item.name: preSchedWindowLen

item.desc: When the SINR is very low,even if the scheduled MCS of BCCH/PCCH/Msg2 is 0, ue also fails to receive these messages possibly. According to the protocol, the code rate of the common messages can be reduced future to ensure the performance of ue far away.
item.name: commCodeRate

item.desc: This Parameter is used to control whether all Msg5 is Pre-Scheduled.
item.name: msg5DelayOptSwch

item.desc: UL Grant BSR times for Msg5 of initial RA.
item.name: grantTimes4Msg5UL

item.desc: UL Grant times for RA except Msg5 of initial RA.
item.name: grantTimes4OthersUL

item.desc: The eNodeB uses TA measurement to determine whether a user exceeds the given TA threshold. If yes, the user will be forcedly released. The parameter value is a given TA threshold, and the unit is Ts.
item.name: taMaxThr

item.desc: This is the threshold of MR reporting out loop SINR, the reported SINR contains out loop only MCS not less than the value.
item.name: mrRptOlSINRThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold used to control the maximum bandwidth ratio for normal pre-scheduling and real BSR and special BSR in a TTI when neither real BSR nor special BSR is more than the threshold. If there is only real BSR in the TTI, the parameter does not take effect.
item.name: rBRatioIncludNormPreSch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold used to control the maximum ratio of bandwidth occupied by uplink-triggered and downlink-triggered normal pre-scheduling in a TTI when there is only normal pre-scheduling.
item.name: rBRatio4NormalPreSch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of RRC users, and when the threshold is reached, special pre-scheduling and normal pre-scheduling will be disabled.
item.name: rRCNumThres

item.desc: This parameter is a switch used to control the priority relationship among the virtual BSR for special pre-scheduling, virtual BSR for normal pre-scheduling, and real BSR.
item.name: preScheBSRPrioSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the SR learning factor. The parameter value affects the convergence rate of learning.
item.name: srTbsizeFilterFactor

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for SR scheduling to switch from fixed 2RB scheduling to SR estimation scheduling. If the padding value in SR estimation is higher than the threshold, no switching is performed. If the SR estimation is lower than the threshold, switch to SR estimation scheduling.
item.name: paddingSize4SrLow

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for SR scheduling to switch from the estimated value to RB2MCSx. If the padding value in SR estimation is higher than the threshold, switch to fixed 2RB scheduling. If the padding value in SR estimation is lower than the threshold, no switching is performed.
item.name: paddingSize4SrHigh

item.desc: This parameter sets the learning data size in SR authorization.
item.name: learnDataSize4SR

item.desc: This parameter is the switch used to control SR authorization mode.
item.name: sRAuthMode

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for enabling uplink 1RB scheduling. When the single RB SINR of the UE is larger than the threshold, the UE supports 1RB scheduling. When the single RB SINR of the UE is smaller than the threshold, the UE does not support 1RB scheduling.
item.name: singleSinr1RBThrdUL

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of pits for initial random access to be pre-scheduled.
item.name: preSchPitNum4InitiRA

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables TA distribution-based KPI reporting. If this parameter is set to Open, the CMA brings the related information generated during the UE's access to the cell to the user plane through the unidirectional queue, and the user plane reports the TA-related counters based on the information.
item.name: kpiBaseOnTASwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to identify IMEI UEs and enable the specified pre-scheduling functions. It is an array parameter consisting of eight elements, each of which indicates whether to enable the corresponding pre-scheduling function. The first element indicates whether to enable the ICMP ping pre-scheduling function, the second element indicates whether to enable the Web page browsing pre-scheduling function (including TCP, HTTP, and SYNACK and FINACK pre-scheduling), and other elements are reserved.
item.name: preSchd4IMEI

item.desc: This parameter represents the size for TCP ACK.
item.name: tCPACKSize

item.desc: This Parameter used for TCP Ack (not HTTP)Delay function,and it stands how long to set a virual BSR.
item.name: bSRSetInterval4TCPACK

item.desc: This Parameter used for TCP Ack (not HTTP) Delay function ,and it stands how many times to set virual BSR.
item.name: virtulBSRSetNum4TCPACK

item.desc: HTTP TCP ACK Size for normal user and it main consider headers of each layer.
item.name: tCPACKSize4HTTP4NormUser

item.desc: This Parameter used for TCP Ack Delay function of HTTP ,and it stands how long to set a virual BSR.
item.name: bSRSetInterval4HTTPACK

item.desc: This Parameter used for TCP Ack Delay function of HTTP ,and it stands how many times to set virual BSR.
item.name: virtulBSRSetNum4HTTPACK

item.desc: This parameter sets the byte size of each virtual BSR. It is used for the HTTP Three Times Handshake and Get Request Pre-scheduling function for HTTP perception optimization for ordinary users.
item.name: virBSR4Get

item.desc: This Parameter used for HTTP three times handshake and Get Request Pre-scheduling function,and it stands time Interval for setting virual BSR.
item.name: virtulBSRSetInterval4Get

item.desc: This Parameter used for HTTP three times handshake and Get Request Pre-scheduling function,and it stands how many times to set virual BSR.
item.name: virtulBSRSetNum4Get

item.desc: This parameter is used for FIN pre-schedule and it represents times of pre-schedule.
item.name: virBSRSetNum4FIN4NormUe

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of RRC-connected UEs entering a special procedure in non-MM scenarios. The special procedure refers to the reduction of the number of pre-scheduling attempts and the decrease of CCE resources during initial access.
item.name: rRCNumEnterSpecSched

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of RRC-connected UEs entering a special procedure in MM scenarios. The special procedure refers to the reduction of the number of pre-scheduling attempts and the decrease of CCE resources during initial access.
item.name: rRCNumEnterSpecSched4MM

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of RRC-connected UEs exiting a special procedure in non-MM scenarios. The special procedure refers to the reduction of the number of pre-scheduling attempts and the decrease of CCE resources during initial access.
item.name: rRCNumExitSpecSched

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of RRC-connected UEs exiting a special procedure in MM scenarios. The special procedure refers to the reduction of the number of pre-scheduling attempts and the decrease of CCE resources during initial access.
item.name: rRCNumExitSpecSched4MM

item.desc: When a far-point MSG3 message is scheduled with RB and MCS combination (4,1), the eNodeB fails to demodulate the MSG3 message. As a result, the MSG3 message fails to be retransmitted and MSG3 HARQ transmission fails. After the MSG3 configuration is modified from RB and MCS combination (4,1) to (2,2) or (3,0), the access success rate of far-point UEs can be improved. Therefore, this parameter is used to control which RB and MCS combination is used for MSG3 resource allocation. If R_SRVMAC. UcMsg3ResourceAdjustStrategy is 0, RB and MCS combination (3,0) scheduling is used. If R_SRVMAC. UcMsg3ResourceAdjustStrategy is 1, RB and MCS combination (4,1) scheduling is used. If R_SRVMAC. UcMsg3ResourceAdjustStrategy is 2, RB and MCS combination (2,2) scheduling is used.
item.name: msg3ResourceAdjStrategy

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables pre-scheduling of 5G measurement and SN addition reconfiguration completion messages during initial access in NSA scenarios.
item.name: nSARRCPreschdSwch

item.desc: To reduce the delay of initial access in an NSA scenario, the two RRC reconfiguration completion messages (5G measurement and SN addition reconfiguration completion messages) are actively granted. This parameter sets the number of times that pre-scheduling is actively granted. In an FDD system, DCI0 is sent six consecutive times. In a TDD system, DCI0 is sent four consecutive times.
item.name: grantTimes4NSARRCMsgUL

item.desc: In the current version, the two RRC reconfiguration messages (5G measurement and SN addition reconfiguration messages) involved during initial access in an NSA scenario cannot be accurately identified. According to the current test plan, a certain number of RRC reconfiguration completion messages are tentatively pre-scheduled after 4G access during initial access in an NSA scenario. This parameter sets the number of RRC reconfiguration messages that are pre-scheduled during initial access in an NSA scenario. This parameter is configured to 3 in the current version.
item.name: nSARRCMsgNum4Preschd

item.desc: To reduce the delay of initial access in an NSA scenario, the two RRC reconfiguration completion messages (5G measurement and SN addition reconfiguration completion messages) are actively granted through the configuration of virtual BSRs. This parameter sets the BSR size.
item.name: grantBsr4NSARRCMsgUL

item.desc: This parameter controls the priority of optimization.
item.name: optPara

item.desc: This parameter sets the BLER threshold for decreasing the number of UEs in an uplink adaptive transmission SDM group. If the Switch for the Adaptation of the Maximum Number of UEs in an SDM Transmission Group parameter is set to Open, the maximum number of streams allowed by a transmission SDM group is decremented by one when the BLER of the UEs in the transmission SDM group is higher than this threshold.
item.name: mMReduceUEBLER4NewtrsUL

item.desc: This parameter sets the BLER threshold for increasing the number of UEs in an uplink adaptive transmission SDM group. If the Switch for the Adaptation of the Maximum Number of UEs in an SDM Transmission Group parameter is set to Open, the maximum number of streams allowed by a transmission SDM group is incremented by one when the BLER of the UEs in the transmission SDM group is lower than this threshold.
item.name: mMAddUEBLER4NewtrsUL

item.desc: This parameter sets the BLER threshold for decreasing the number of UEs in an uplink adaptive retransmission SDM group. If the Switch for the Adaptation of the Maximum Number of UEs in an SDM Retransmission Group parameter is set to Open, the maximum number of streams allowed by a retransmission SDM group is decremented by one when the BLER of the UEs in the retransmission SDM group is higher than this threshold.
item.name: mMReduceUEBLER4RetrsUL

item.desc: This parameter sets the BLER threshold for increasing the number of UEs in an uplink adaptive retransmission SDM group. If the Switch for the Adaptation of the Maximum Number of UEs in an SDM Retransmission Group parameter is set to Open, the maximum number of streams allowed by a retransmission SDM group is incremented by one when the BLER of the UEs in the retransmission SDM group is lower than this threshold.
item.name: mMAddUEBLER4RetrsUL

item.desc: This parameter sets the PRB usage threshold for disabling the uplink PHR procedure. A larger parameter value indicates a higher threshold for disabling the PHR procedure and a higher probability for triggering the PHR procedure.
item.name: phrProcessDisablePrbThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the determination coefficient of the TB size for uplink MM pairing. If it is set to 0, it indicates that the TB size is not considered in uplink MM pairing. If it is set to a non-zero value, it indicates that the TB size of the paired UEs can be put in the pairing queue only when the gain rate of the TB size reaches a certain value.
item.name: lamdaOfTBSize4ULMM

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to optimize the retransmission scheduling for non-MSG3 messages during random access. If this parameter is set to Open, UEs adaptively retransmit data. If this parameter is set to Close, UEs non-adaptively retransmit data.
item.name: raRetxSchdOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables beam SDM in the uplink. In some scenarios, beam measurement is more accurate than correlation determination. In these cases, this parameter should be set to Open to improve SDM performance in the uplink. When it is set to Open, beam measurement is preferentially used during uplink MM SDM scheduling. If the beam measurement conditions are met, the correlation is not determined. If the beam measurement conditions are not met, the correlation is determined. If this parameter is set to Close, the correlation is determined during uplink MM SDM scheduling, without considering the beam measurement conditions.
item.name: uLMMBeamSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the uplink MM beam SDM interval, that is, the minimum interval of the active beams between two UEs that can be involved in SDM scheduling when uplink beam SDM is enabled. If the intervals of the active beams between a UE and all other UEs in the SDM group are larger than this parameter value, the UE can be involved in SDM scheduling without the determination of the correlation conditions. Otherwise, the UE can be involved in SDM scheduling only when the conditions of the correlation between the UE and all other UEs in the SDM group are satisfied.
item.name: uLMMBeamIntervalThresh

item.desc: This parameter sets the width of uplink MM beams. It indicates beam granularity, that is, the angle range of beams. With this parameter, beams are split in an angle range of -60 degrees to 60 degrees to meet the accuracy requirement of beam SDM in different scenarios. A smaller parameter value indicates a higher accuracy.
item.name: uLMMBeamWidth

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables ping optimization.
item.name: timeDelayOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables of disables the Type6 function. If it is set to Open, the rate for ordinary UEs to download data can be controlled.
item.name: aMBRLimitType6Swch

item.desc: This parameter sets the AMBR limiting value for the UEs with the Type6 function enabled. A larger parameter value indicates more traffic. A smaller parameter value indicates less traffic.
item.name: aMBRLimitType6DL4NormUe

item.desc: When downlink rate limiting is enabled and the Type6 function is operating, this parameter sets the lower limit of the AMBR of the UEs that can be guaranteed by the Type6 function.
item.name: lowLim4Type6UEGua

item.desc: This parameter sets the upper limit of the AMBR of the UEs whose service optimization is guaranteed when downlink rate limiting is enabled and the Type6 function is operating.
item.name: upLim4NonType6UEGu

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of HARQ transmissions of downlink signaling in initial access. It is used to improve signaling transmission reliability.
item.name: harqMaxTxNum4DlDcch

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of HARQ transmissions of uplink signaling in initial access. It is used to improve signaling transmission reliability.
item.name: harqMaxTxNum4UlDcch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the optimization for the maximum number of HARQ transmissions of downlink signaling. It determines whether to configure the number of dedicated HARQ transmissions of initial access signaling.
item.name: harqMaxTxNum4DlDcchSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the optimization for the maximum number of HARQ transmissions of uplink signaling. It determines whether to configure the number of dedicated HARQ transmissions of initial access signaling.
item.name: harqMaxTxNum4UlDcchSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of RRC-connected UEs used in the uplink PBR bearer scheduling window algorithm. It is used to trigger the PBR bearer scheduling window optimization policy that reduces the number of times that PBR bearers are scheduled and increases the number of times that AMBR bearers are scheduled. When the number of RRC-connected UEs in a cell is larger than or equal to the threshold, the optimization policy is triggered. If the number of RRC-connected UEs in a cell is smaller than the threshold minus 20, the optimization policy is not triggered.
item.name: ulPBRFlowWndAdapAdjThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for pre-scheduling validation. It is used to determine whether pre-scheduling takes effect to reduce invalid scheduling within a short period and uplink padding after pre-scheduling is enabled. When the interval between the current pre-scheduling and the adjacent pre-scheduling is longer than or equal to the threshold, the current pre-scheduling is triggered. When the interval between the current pre-scheduling and the adjacent pre-scheduling is shorter than the threshold, the current pre-scheduling is not triggered.
item.name: preSchdValidThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the PUSCH power threshold for UE pre-scheduling. It is used to determine whether a UE can trigger pre-scheduling. If the transmit power of a single RB on the PUSCH is larger than or equal to the threshold, the UE cannot trigger pre-scheduling. If the transmit power of a single RB on the PUSCH is smaller than the threshold, the UE can trigger pre-scheduling.
item.name: preSchdPuschPwrThr

item.desc: Full Distinguished Name
item.name: FDN

item.desc: Date Time
item.name: DATETIME

item.desc: Collection period of measurement task.
item.name: granularityPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: id

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: moId

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to dynamically adjust multiple target BLERs of UEs. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB divides radio channels into grids in terms of demodulation, cell interference, and SINR values, collects scheduling data of each grid, periodically calculates the spectrum efficiency and traffic corresponding to different BLERs of each grid, and uses the BLER corresponding to the highest spectrum efficiency and traffic as the target to achieve the optimal uplink spectrum efficiency and traffic of the entire cell.
item.name: uLAIMultiBlerEnable

item.desc: This parameter sets the status update period (or statistical period, in minutes) for intelligent uplink BLER learning. If the ucULAIMultiBlerEnable (Switch of Multiple Target BLERs for Intelligent Uplink BLER Learning) parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB collects scheduling data based on grids within the period specified by this parameter and calculates the target BLER of each grid.
item.name: uLBlerUpdatePeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the minimum valid number of times that the resources in the cell are scheduled. It is used to set the threshold number of samples for BLER learning and calculation. In a grid, if the accumulated number of times that the resources in the cell are scheduled within the period specified by the ucULBlerUpdatePeriod (Status Update Period for Intelligent Uplink BLER Learning) parameter exceeds this threshold, BLER learning and calculation are triggered in the cell.
item.name: uLBlerSampleNumThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the SINR threshold of near-point grids for uplink BLER learning. If the SINR of a grid exceeds this threshold, the grid is considered as a near-point grid. The target BLERs learned from near-point grids should be small to avoid cell traffic decrease.
item.name: uLSinrThr2LowBler

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum BLER in intelligent uplink BLER learning. It is used to control the maximum BLER that can be learned through intelligent uplink BLER learning. If the learned BLER value is larger than this parameter value, this parameter is used as the target BLER.
item.name: uLBlerMaxThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the PRB usage interval division thresholds for uplink intelligent BLER learning. It is used to divide the PRB usage intervals corresponding to low, medium, and high cell load separately. This parameter is an array consisting of two elements. If the PRB usage of the cell is smaller than or equal to element 0, it is considered that the cell load is low. If the PRB usage of the cell is larger than element 0 and smaller than or equal to element 1, it is considered that the cell load is medium. If the PRB usage of the cell is larger than element 1, it is considered that the cell load is high.
item.name: uLBlerPRBRatioThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the coefficients of the impact of spectrum efficiency and traffic on the determination of the optimal target BLER when the cell load is low, medium, and high separately. It is an array parameter consisting of six elements. Elements 0 and 1 respectively set the spectrum efficiency weight coefficient and traffic weight coefficient when the cell load is low. Elements 2 and 3 respectively set the spectrum efficiency weight coefficient and traffic weight coefficient when the cell load is medium. Elements 4 and 5 respectively set the spectrum efficiency weight coefficient and traffic weight coefficient when the cell load is high. The cell load is determined by the aucULBlerPRBRatioThr (PRB Usage Interval Division Thresholds for Uplink Intelligent BLER Learning) parameter.
item.name: uLBlerWeightFactor

item.desc: This parameter sets the statistical gain threshold for selecting the optimal BLER. If the gain ratio of a higher BLER to a lower BLER is larger than this threshold, it indicates that the higher BLER is a better one.
item.name: uLGainThr4upBler

item.desc: This parameter is an array for interference interval division of the cell. It is used to divide statistics grids for intelligent AMC. It is an array parameter consisting of four elements, each of which sets an interference division value of the cell. A maximum of five interference intervals can be divided for a cell.
item.name: cellNISplitArray

item.desc: This parameter sets the path loss thresholds for adaptive uplink BLERs. It is used to divide the path loss intervals. It is an array parameter consisting of four elements, each of which sets a path loss interval division value. A maximum of five path loss intervals can be divided.
item.name: pLThr

item.desc: This parameter is an array for PUSCH PS interval division. It is used to divide statistics grids for intelligent AMC. It is an array parameter consisting of four elements, each of which sets a PUSCH PS division value of the cell. A maximum of five PUSCH PS intervals can be divided.
item.name: puschPsSplitArray

item.desc: This parameter sets the step multiples of adaptive uplink BLERs. It is used to increase the ACK steps of different path loss intervals. This parameter is an array consisting of five elements that respectively set the increase multiples of the ACK steps of path loss interval 1 through path loss interval 5.
item.name: ulAmcStepRatio4BlerAdapt

item.desc: This parameter sets the adjustment value per unit in grid-level reinforcement learning. It is used to set the initial uplink outer-loop value for new UEs in a grid. The initial uplink outer-loop value of a new UE is equal to the grid-level reinforcement learning result plus this parameter value.
item.name: adjustmentPerUnit

item.desc: This parameter sets the CCE usage threshold for enabling uplink adaptive BLERs. It is one of the conditions for deciding whether to enable uplink adaptive BLERs. The adaptive uplink BLERs are enabled when both of the following conditions are met:(1) The uplink CCE usage of the cell is smaller than or equal to the parameter value. (2) The PRB usage of the cell is smaller than or equal to the value of the uIPrbRateThr (PRB Usage Threshold for Adaptive Uplink BLERs) parameter.
item.name: cceRateThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the differences between the grid-level reinforcement learning results and the default initial outer-loop value of AMC. It is used to control the differences between the learned outer-loop values and the default outer-loop value. The differences between the learned outer-loop values and the default outer-loop value should be smaller than or equal to the parameter value.
item.name: deltaSinrVaryThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of ACK/NACK messages that indicate the results of using the grid-level reinforcement learning results as the initial outer-loop AMC values. When the number of ACK/NACK messages received by the samples in a grid is larger than or equal to the threshold, the initial outer-loop value obtained through reinforcement learning is used.
item.name: meshANNumMin

item.desc: This parameter sets the PRB usage threshold for enabling uplink adaptive BLERs. It is one of the conditions for determining whether to enable uplink adaptive BLERs. The adaptive uplink BLERs are enabled when both of the following conditions are met: (1) The uplink PRB usage of the cell is smaller than or equal to the parameter value. (2) The CCE usage of the cell is smaller than or equal to the value of the cceRateThr (CCE Usage Threshold for Adaptive Uplink BLERs) parameter.
item.name: ulPrbRateThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the default blocking rate. The blocking rate is the ratio of the BSR size of UEs to the scheduling TB size within a period of time. If the BSR size is 0, the blocking rate is equal to the parameter value.
item.name: defBlockRatio

item.desc: This parameter sets the CE level supported by the current FDD cell. It is an eMTC-related parameter. A larger parameter value indicates a larger number of UEs in weak-coverage areas, more physical resources consumed, and smaller cell capacity.
item.name: ceLevels

item.desc: If this switch is open,paging occasion of Paging message is determined in the I-eDRX paging mechanism.When this switch is closed,Cell calculate paging occasion of Paging message in the legacy paging mechanism.
item.name: emtcIdleeDRXAllowedSwch

item.desc: If this switch is open,the cell support the C-DRX for eMTC.When this switch is closed,the cell do not support the C-DRX for eMTC.
item.name: emtcConnecteDRXSwch

item.desc: When set to Common, a cell has one RAB parameters. Otherwise, per PLMN has its own EAB parameters.
item.name: emtcEABParamSelMode

item.desc: Indicates the category of UEs for which EAB applies. Value a corresponds to all UEs, value b corresponds to the UEs that are neither in their HPLMN nor in a PLMN that is equivalent to it, and value c corresponds to the UEs that are neither in the PLMN listed as most preferred PLMN of the country where the UEs are roaming in the operator-defined PLMN selector list on the USIM, nor in their HPLMN nor in a PLMN that is equivalent to their HPLMN.
item.name: emtcEABCategCommon

item.desc: Extended access class barring for AC 0-9. The first/ leftmost bit is for AC 0, the second bit is for AC 1, and so on.
item.name: emtcEABBarBitmapCom

item.desc: This parameter sets the EAB working mode for eMTC terminals. If it is set to Static, the enabling of EAB depends on the configuration on the OMC. If it is set to Dynamic, the enabling of EAB depends on the CPU load of the eNodeB.
item.name: emtcEABWorkMode

item.desc: The scheduler algorithm for GBR service of eMTC.
item.name: schedAlg4EMTCGBR

item.desc: The scheduler algorithm for NGBR service of eMTC.
item.name: schedAlg4EMTCNGBR

item.desc: eMTC GBR traffic priority scheduling, configuration of 1 indicates eMTC service priority scheduling of ordinary users NGBR service, configuration of 0 indicates eMTC service after scheduling ordinary users NGBR service.
item.name: gbrPriorSched4EMTC

item.desc: This parameter sets the initial PRACH CE level during eMTC handover. If this parameter is not configured, the UE selects the corresponding PRACH CE level in accordance with the measured RSRP value.
item.name: hoInitialCElevel

item.desc: This parameter indicates whether the eNodeB configures both the initial CE level and the RSRP threshold of the CEL level or only the RSRP threshold of the CEL level when eMTC terminals are handed over base on contention. If the eNodeB configures both the initial CE level and the RSRP threshold of the CEL level, the eMTC terminals access the network by using the PRACH resources corresponding to the initial CE level. If the eNodeB configures only the RSRP threshold of the CEL level, the eMTC terminals determine the CE level based on the measured RSRP and the configured RSRP threshold of the CE level, and access the network by using the PRACH resources corresponding to the CE level.
item.name: emtcHOCEConfig

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables priority configuration of eMTC services. It is used to configure the service priority for eMTC UEs. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the priority of eMTC services is lower than that of LTE services. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the priorities of different eMTC services are configured by other parameters.
item.name: priorSched4EMTC

item.desc: This parameter sets the priority-based scheduling strategy of the VoLTE services for eMTC UEs in the case that the eMTC UEs and LTE UEs are configured with the same eMLP. It is used to adjust priority relation between VoLTE services and eMTC VoLTE services. If this parameter is set to 0, the priority of the VoLTE services is higher than that of eMTC VoLTE services. If this parameter is set to 1, the priority of VoLTE services is lower than that of eMTC VoLTE services. If this parameter is set to 2, the priority of VoLTE services is the same as that of eMTC VoLTE services.
item.name: prieLTEeMTC4Volte

item.desc: This parameter sets the priority-based scheduling strategy of the GBR services for eMTC UEs in the case that the eMTC UEs and LTE UEs are configured with the same eMLP. It is used to adjust priority relation between LTE GBR services and eMTC VoLTE services. If it is set to 0, the priority of the LTE GBR services is higher than that of the eMTC GBR services. If it is set to 1, the priority of the LTE GBR services is lower than that of the eMTC GBR services. If it is set to 2, the priority of the LTE GBR services is the same as that of the eMTC GBR services. If it is set to 3, all the eMLPs of the LTE GBR services are higher than those of the eMTC GBR services.
item.name: prieLTEeMTC4GBR

item.desc: This parameter sets the priority-based scheduling strategy of the NGBR services for eMTC UEs in the case that the eMTC UEs and LTE UEs are configured with the same eMLP. It is used to adjust priority relation between LTE NGBR services and eMTC VoLTE services. If this parameter is set to 0, the priority of the LTE NGBR services is higher than that of the eMTC NGBR services. If this parameter is set to 1, the priority of the LTE NGBR services is lower than that of the eMTC NGBR services. If this parameter is set to 2, the priority of the LTE NGBR services is the same as that of the eMTC NGBR services. If this parameter is set to 3, all the eMLPs of the LTE NGBR services are higher than those of the eMTC NGBR services.
item.name: prieLTEeMTC4NGBR

item.desc: This parameter configures the statistical CPU load window for CPU load-based dynamic EAB adjustment for eMTC terminals.
item.name: eMTCEABCCLoadWin

item.desc: This parameter is used to configure the CPU load threshold for enabling eMTC EAB.
item.name: eMTCEABCCLoadTriggerThrd

item.desc: This parameter is used to configure the CPU load threshold for stopping eMTC EAB.
item.name: eMTCEABCCLoadStopThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: moId

item.desc: The parameter defines the RSRP Threshold for each CE level PRACH resource set.
item.name: rsrpThrPrachInfoList

item.desc: the sum of Preamble Attempt Num for all CE Level.
item.name: preambleTransMaxCE

item.desc: the Msg3 PUSCH repetation num for CE ModeA.
item.name: msg3PUSCHRepetNumModeA

item.desc: the Msg3 PUSCH repetation num for CE ModeB.
item.name: msg3PUSCHRepetNumModeB

item.desc: EMTC coverage enhancement can be divided into four levels: level 0, level 1, level 2, and level 3. Levels 0 and 1 are called CE MODEA and levels 2 and 3 are called CE MODEB. The coverage level indicates the coverage capability of an eNodeB. A higher level indicates a stronger coverage capability. This parameter indicates the number of times that the MSG2/4 PDSCH message is repeatedly sent for CE Mode A.
item.name: raPDSCHRepetNumModeA

item.desc: The prameter Msg2/4 PDSCH repet num ModeB which is included in DCI6-1B is used to determine the actual number of repetitions cooperating with the max nunber of PDSCH repetitions according to the table 7.1.11-2.
item.name: raPDSCHRepetNumModeB

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of random-access preamble signatures based on contention conflicts for eMTC UEs in the cell. It is used for sending MSG1 messages when the random access procedure is triggered in non-handover scenarios of UEs.
item.name: emtcNumRAPreambles

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of signatures of random-access preambles in group A for eMTC UEs. It is a physical-resource allocation parameter of the PRACH for eMTC UEs. When a UE sends an MSG1 message during access, it selects the preambles in group A.
item.name: emtcSizeRAGroupA

item.desc: Based on this parameter of message3 size, UE determines to select the Random Access Preambles group A or group B for EMTC.
item.name: emtcSelPreGrpThresh

item.desc: The parameter is a power control margin for message 3 transmission configured by the eNB and is used to select the Random Access Preambles for EMTC.
item.name: emtcMsgPwrOfstGrpB

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of times that MSG3 messages are sent by eMTC UEs during random access.
item.name: emtcMaxHARQMsg3Tx

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion of the number of contention-based access preambles of the UEs at a Coverage Enhancement (CE) level to the number of access preambles of the UEs at the corresponding CE level. It is used to differentiate the number of contention-based access preambles of UEs at each CE level from the number of non-contention-based access preambles of UEs at each CE level. This parameter is an array consisting of four elements. Element 0 sets the proportion of the number of contention-based access preambles of the UEs at CE level 0 to the number of access preambles of the UEs at CE level 0. Element 1 sets the proportion of the number of contention-based access preambles of the UEs at CE level 1 to the number of access preambles of the UEs at CE level 1. Element 2 sets the proportion of the number of contention-based access preambles of the UEs at CE level 2 to the number of access preambles of the UEs at CE level 2. Element 4 sets the proportion of the number of contention-based access preambles of the UEs at CE level 4 to the number of access preambles of the UEs at CE level 4.
item.name: contentionPidRatio

item.desc: This parameter sets the ratio of MAC non-contention-based random access preambles of CE level 0-3 to non-contention-based random access preambles of CE level 0-3 in all scenarios.
item.name: macContFreePidRatio

item.desc: This parameter sets the start index of the logical root sequence for generating 64 PRACH preambles in an eMTC cell. In a time-division scenario between an eMTC cell and an LTE cell, there may be inter-cell PRACH interference, which results in a greater number of PRACH-related false detections. This problem can be avoided by preventing the physical root sequence used by eMTC cells from overlapping with that used by LTE cells.
item.name: eMTCLogRtSeqStNum

item.name: FDN

item.name: DATETIME

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: id

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: moId

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of times that the PUSCH is repeatedly transmitted for UEs in mode A. It is a physical-resource allocation parameter of eMTC UEs. If this parameter is set to a larger value, the coverage performance can improve.
item.name: puschMaxNumRepModeA

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of times that the PUSCH is repeatedly transmitted for UEs in mode B. It is a physical-resource allocation parameter of eMTC UEs. If this parameter is set to a larger value, the coverage performance can improve.
item.name: puschMaxNumRepModeB

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times that the PUCCH format 1/1a for BL/CE UEs in mode A is repeatedly transmitted. It is a physical-resource allocation parameter of eMTC UEs and the parameter value is related to the path loss of UEs.
item.name: numRepetCE4MAfmt1

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times that the PUCCH format 1/1a for BL/CE UEs in mode B is repeatedly transmitted. It is a physical-resource allocation parameter of eMTC UEs.
item.name: numRepetCE4MBfmt1

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times that the PUCCH format 2/2a/2b for BL/CE UEs in mode A is repeatedly transmitted. It is a physical-resource allocation parameter of eMTC UEs and the parameter value is related to the path loss of UEs.
item.name: numRepetCE4MAfmt2

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval of the cyclic shift alpha(n_s) of the PUCCH format 1/1a/1b used by the eMTC UEs in the cell. It is a parameter related to physical-resource allocation for eMTC UEs on the PUCCH.
item.name: pucchDeltaShf4EMTC

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of channels that carry SR information and are reserved for the UEs in coverage enhancement mode A in each subframe. It is a parameter related to physical-resource allocation for eMTC UEs on the PUCCH. It is used to periodically report SR information and the parameter value is related to the supported number of UEs involved in SR reporting in coverage enhancement mode A.
item.name: nPucchSr4ModeA

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of channels that carry SR information and are reserved for the UEs in coverage enhancement mode B in each subframe. It is a parameter related to physical-resource allocation for eMTC UEs on the PUCCH. It is used to periodically report SR information and the parameter value is related to the supported number of UEs involved in SR reporting in coverage enhancement mode B.
item.name: nPucchSr4ModeB

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of channels that carry SPS ACK/NACK information and are reserved for the UEs in coverage enhancement mode A in each subframe. It is related to physical-resource allocation of eMTC UEs on the PUCCH and the parameter value is related to the supported number of UEs involved in downlink SPS.
item.name: nPucchSemiAn4eMTC

item.desc: This parameter sets the SR reporting period of the UEs in coverage enhancement mode A in the cell. It is an array parameter consisting of four elements that correspond to a maximum of four SR reporting periods. For example, [10,20,40,80] indicates that the configured SR reporting periods are 10 ms, 20 ms, 40 ms, and 80 ms.
item.name: srTrPeriod4ModeA

item.desc: This parameter sets the SR reporting period of the UEs in coverage enhancement mode B in the cell. It is an array parameter consisting of four elements that correspond to a maximum of four SR reporting periods. For example, [10,20,40,80] indicates that the configured SR reporting periods are 10 ms, 20 ms, 40 ms, and 80 ms.
item.name: srTrPeriod4ModeB

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of UEs that are in coverage enhancement mode B and can multiplex one RB in each SR period. It is a parameter related to physical-resource allocation for eMTC UEs on the PUCCH. It is an array parameter consisting of four elements. Element 0 sets the number of UEs that can multiplex one RB in the SR period specified by the sRTrPeriod4ModeA[0] parameter. If the number of UEs allocated with an SR RB is larger than the value of element 0 when a UE accesses the network, the eNodeB allocates resources to the UE on the next SR RB, and so on.
item.name: srTrCHNum4ModeA

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of UEs that are in coverage enhancement mode B and can multiplex one RB in each SR period. It is a parameter related to physical-resource allocation for eMTC UEs on the PUCCH. It is an array parameter consisting of four elements. Element 0 sets the number of UEs that can multiplex one RB in the SR period specified by the sRTrPeriod4ModeB[0] parameter. If the number of UEs allocated with an SR RB is larger than the value of element 0 when a UE accesses the network, the eNodeB allocates resources to the UE on the next SR RB.
item.name: srTrCHNum4ModeB

item.desc: This parameter sets the CQI/PMI reporting period of the UEs in coverage enhancement mode A in the cell. It is an array parameter consisting of three elements that correspond to a maximum of three CQI/PMI reporting periods. For example, [20,40,80] indicates that the configured CQI/PMI reporting periods are 20 ms, 40 ms, and 80 ms.
item.name: cqiRptPeriod4ModeA

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of UEs that are in coverage enhancement mode A and can multiplex one RB in each CQI period. It is a parameter related to physical-resource allocation for eMTC UEs on the PUCCH. This parameter is an array consisting of three elements. Element 0 sets the number of UEs that can multiplex one RB in the CQI/PMI period specified by the cQIRptPeriod4ModeA[0] parameter. Element 1 sets the number of UEs that can multiplex one RB in the CQI/PMI period specified by the cQIRptPeriod4ModeA[1] parameter. Element 2 sets the number of UEs that can multiplex one RB in the CQI/PMI period specified by the cQIRptPeriod4ModeA[2] parameter. If the number of UEs allocated with an CQI RB is larger than the value of element 0 when a UE accesses the network, the eNodeB allocates resources to the UE on the next CQI RB, and so forth.
item.name: cqiRptChNum4ModeA

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of RBs that are occupied by the PUCCH carrying CQI information and are reserved for the UEs in coverage enhancement mode A in each subframe.
item.name: numPucchCqiRB4ModeA

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of UEs that can multiplex one RB occupied by the PUCCH format 2 and are in coverage enhancement mode A in the cell.

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the start offset positions of the resources occupied by the PUCCH that carries the ACK/NACK information of the UEs at each coverage enhancement level are the same. If this parameter is set to 0, it indicates that the start offsets positions of the resources occupied by the PUCCH that carries the ACK/NACK information of the UEs at each coverage enhancement level are different and do not dynamically overlap with those of the resources that are used for transmitting the ACK/NACK information of LTE UEs. If this parameter is set to 1, it indicates that the start offset positions of the resources occupied by the PUCCH that carries the ACK/NACK information of the UEs at each coverage enhancement level are the same and do not dynamically overlap with those of the resources that are used for transmitting the ACK/NACK information of LTE UEs.

If the consecutive number of times that downlink DTX occurs or the consecutive number of times that uplink DCI0 loss occurs is larger than or equal to the parameter value, the outer-loop value of the MPDCCH can decrease.

item.name: type2CSSStartNBoffset

item.desc: This parameter sets the start narrowband offset value of UE-specific MPDCCH search spaces. It is used to calculate the start narrowbands occupied by UE-specific search spaces. It can prevent the narrowbands occupied by UE-specific MPDCCH search spaces from overlapping with those occupied by paging, MIB, SIB, and type-2 MPDCCH search spaces.
item.name: uSStartNBoffset

item.desc: This parameter sets the PUCCH resource allocation type of the cell. It is used to adjust the overhead of RBs occupied by the PUCCH. In the scenario where eMTC cells and LTE cells coexist, the PUCCH of the eMTC cells is allocated above that of the LTE cells or the PUCCHs of the eMTC cells and LTE cells are alternately allocated. The parameter value 0 (PUCCH TYPE0) indicates that the PUCCHs of the eMTC cells and LTE cells are alternately allocated and the parameter value 2 (PUCCH TYPE2) indicates that the PUCCH of the eMTC cells is allocated above that of the LTE cells.

item.name: emtcDlAvailNbNum

It is used to control whether eMTC UEs can occupy the GSM spectrum on the MPDCCH when GSM UEs and eMTC UEs share the same spectrum. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), eMTC UEs can occupy the GSM spectrum on the MPDCCH to improve spectrum utilization.
item.name: gsmMPdcchCoSpectrumSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables uplink eMTC MPDCCH strategy reservation. If it is set to 0, the uplink eMTC MPDCCH strategy is not reserved. If it is set to 1, the uplink eMTC MPDCCH strategy is dynamically reserved. If it is set to 2, the uplink eMTC MPDCCH strategy is proportionally reserved.
item.name: mpdcchReserveSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the number of downlink non-VoLTE eMTC users who are not notified of uplink MPDCCH allocation failures when the uplink eMTC MPDCCH strategy is reserved.

item.desc: This parameter sets the ratio of uplink eMTC scheduling when the uplink eMTC MPDCCH strategy is proportionally reserved.

item.name: uLSchdRatio4OneUe

item.desc: This parameter sets the reserved-narrowband index for downlink eMTC RB reservation. It is used to control whether downlink eMTC RB reservation is enabled. In an eMTC network test, a narrowband RB is reserved for all the cells in the test area for which downlink eMTC RB reservation is enabled. The data services in eMTC cells preferentially use the reserved RB, while the LTE cells cannot use the reserved RB. This parameter is applicable to the scenarios where there is multi-cell coverage in the test area and there is neighbor cell interference between tested cells. This parameter is valid only for the cells with eMTC enabled. By default, this parameter is set to Close. If it is set to a value from NB0 to NB15, it indicates that downlink eMTC RB reservation is enabled and the parameter value is the reserved-narrowband index. The parameter value depends on the MPDCCH narrowband index configured for the tested eMTC UEs.
item.name: dleMTCRbRsvIndex

item.desc: This parameter sets the reserved-narrowband index for uplink eMTC RB reservation. It is used to control whether uplink eMTC RB reservation is enabled. In an eMTC network test, a narrowband RB is reserved for all the cells in the test area for which downlink eMTC RB reservation is enabled. The data services in eMTC cells preferentially use the reserved RB, while the LTE cells cannot use the reserved RB. This parameter is applicable to the scenarios where there is multi-cell coverage in the test area and there is neighbor cell interference between tested cells. This parameter is valid only for the cells with eMTC enabled. By default, this parameter is set to Close. If it is set to a value from NB0 to NB15, it indicates that downlink eMTC RB reservation is enabled and the parameter value is the reserved-narrowband index.
item.name: uleMTCRbRsvIndex

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the support of a larger uplink TB size by eMTC UEs. According to the protocol of Release 14, eMTC CAT-M1 UEs support a larger uplink TB size. This parameter determines whether the eNodeB can use a larger combination of MCSs and RBs in CAT-M1 UE scheduling. In the previous versions, the maximum TB size in the table corresponding to the combination of MCSs and RBs cannot be larger than 1000 bytes. If this parameter is set to Open, the eNodeB supports a larger TB size (up to 2984 bytes) for uplink scheduling of the UEs with the CAT-M1 capability. If this parameter is set to Close, the eNodeB does not support a larger TB size for uplink scheduling, that is, the maximum TB size in the table corresponding to the combination of MCSs and RBs cannot be larger than 1000 bytes. If there are eMTC CAT-M1 UEs in cells, this parameter can be set to Open for the UEs to support higher uplink peak scheduling throughput. If there is no eMTC CAT-M1 UE in cells, this parameter can be set to Close. The base station not support function of uplink max tbsize, that scheduling limitation for the combination of MCS and RB is not bigger than max tbsize 1000 bytes. When the base station have the ue support cat-m1,that can open the switch and ue support the bigger scheduling uplink throughput. When base station not have cat-m1 emtc ,that can closed the switch.
item.name: puschMaxTbsSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the downlink 10-HARQ feature for eMTC UEs. If it is set to Open, full-duplex downlink peak traffic can be increased.
item.name: pdsch10HarqSwch

item.desc: The parameter indicates Timer for UE to wait for RRC connection response. UE will start T300 after sending RRC CONNECTION REQUEST message. The T300 will be stopped before it expires if :1. UE received RRCConnectionSetup or RRCConnectionReject;2. cell re-selection occurred; 3. UE NAS layer terminated RRC connection establishment procedure;When T300 expires, UE will:1.reset MAC2.release the MAC configuration 3.re-establish RLC for all RBs that are established, and inform upper layers about the failure of establish the RRC connection.
item.name: emtcT300

item.desc: The parameter indicates Timer for UE to wait for RRC connection re-establishment response. UE shall start T301 after RRCConnectionReestabilshmentRequest message is transmitted.When UE receives the RRCConnectionReestablishment or RRCConnectionReestablishmentReject message,UE shall stop this timer.When Timer is expired, UE switches to IDLE.
item.name: emtcT301

item.desc: Upon detecting radio link problems, the UE shall start T310_UE. Upon receiving N311 _UE consecutive in-sync indications from lower layers, upon triggering the handover procedure and upon initiating the connection re-establishment procedure. If security is not activated: go to RRC_IDLE else: initiate the connection re-establishment procedure.

item.desc: This parameter sets the reference value of the probability of the access to a cell when an eMTC UE originates an RRC connection setup request for mo-Signalling. If it is set to 1, it indicates that no barring parameter is applied. If the random number generated by an eMTC UE is smaller than this parameter value, the UE can access the network; otherwise it cannot access the network. A larger parameter value indicates a higher probability of successful RRC connection setup requests originated by eMTC UEs for mo-Signalling. If AC barring parameters can be dynamically adjusted, this parameter indicates the minimum access factor of mo-Signalling that can be the dynamically adjusted by the eNodeB.
item.name: eMTCAcProbFactorSig

item.desc: This parameter sets the reference value of the probability of the access to a cell when an eMTC UE originates an RRC connection setup request for mo-Data. If it is set to 1, it indicates that no barring parameter is applied. If the random number generated by an eMTC UE is smaller than this parameter value, the UE can access the network; otherwise it cannot access the network. A larger parameter value indicates a higher probability of successful RRC connection setup requests originated by eMTC UEs for mo-Data. If AC barring parameters can be dynamically adjusted, this parameter indicates the minimum access factor of mo-Data that can be the dynamically adjusted by the eNodeB.
item.name: eMTCAcProbFactorOrig

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to activate frequency hopping during the random access procedure of eMTC UEs. It is used to control whether to activate frequency hopping in MSG2/MSG3/MSG4 scheduling on the MPDCCH, PUSCH, and PDSCH during the random access procedure of the eMTC UEs with different Coverage Enhancement (CE) levels.
item.name: rarHopConfigSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the PRACH configuration index of BL/CE level 0 through level 3. It indicates the time domain resources for UEs to send MSG1 messages.
item.name: prachConfInd4eMTC

item.desc: This parameter sets the start offset of the BL/CE level 0 through 3 PRACH frequency domain for physical resource allocation to eMTC UEs on the PUCCH. It is the frequency domain positions for eMTC UEs to send the MSG1 messages during the access procedure.
item.name: prachFreqOffset4eMTC

item.desc: This parameter sets the start subframe of BL/CE level 0 through level 3. It is used to configure the time domain period for UEs to send MSG1 messages during the access procedure.
item.name: prachStartSubframe

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of preamble transmission attempts for BL/CE levels 0, 1, 2, and 3. It is a parameter related to physical-resource allocation for eMTC UEs on the PUCCH. It is used to control the maximum number of MSG1 transmission attempts in the access procedure.
item.name: maxNumPreambleAttemptCE

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times that preambles are repeatedly transmitted per attempt for BL/CE levels 0, 1, 2, and 3. It is a parameter related to physical-resource allocation for eMTC UEs on the PUCCH. It is used for MSG1 transmission in the access procedure and its value is related to the current path loss.
item.name: numRepPerPreambleAttempt

item.desc: This parameter sets the first preamble ID for BL/CE levels 0, 1, 2, and 3. It is related to physical-resource allocation of the eMTC PUCCH. It is used for MSG1 messages in the access procedure, and its value is related to the number of UEs.
item.name: firstPreamble

item.desc: This parameter sets the last preamble ID for BL/CE levels 0, 1, 2, and 3. It is related to physical-resource allocation of the eMTC PUCCH. It is used for MSG1 messages in the access procedure, and its value is related to the number of UEs.
item.name: lastPreamble

item.desc: This parameter indicates the periodically-controlled MPDCCH parameter of UE-specific CE level. It is used to configure the MPDCCH listening cycle. If it is configured to a larger value, the cycle for MPDCCH listening is longer and the number of available subframes for MPDCCH listening is smaller.
item.name: mPDCCHStartSFUESS

item.desc: This parameter indicates the maximum number of times that the MPDCCH is repeatedly transmitted. It is a CE level parameter. For the UEs at the same CE level, the value of this parameter must be the same.
item.name: mPDCCHNumRepetition

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of narrowbands occupied by the UEs with a CE level in the type-2 common search space. If this parameter is set to 0, it indicates that the UEs with the current CE level can share all the narrowbands. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, it indicates that the UEs with the current CE level can exclusively occupy part of the narrowbands.
item.name: nbNum4Type2CE

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of narrowbands occupied by the UEs with a CE level in the UE-specific search spaces. If this parameter is set to 0, it indicates that the UEs with the current CE level can share all the narrowbands. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value, it indicates that the UEs with the current CE level can exclusively occupy part of the narrowbands.
item.name: nbNum4USSCE

item.desc: For a UE-specific search space in a scenario where narrowband resources are shared, this parameter sets the maximum number of available PRBs in a CE-level PRB set. If the nbNum4USSCE parameter is set to 0, the maximum number of available PRBs in a CE-level PRB set cannot exceed this parameter value.
item.name: prbSet4USSSharedCE

item.desc: For a UE-specific search space in a scenario where narrowband resources are exclusively occupied, this parameter sets the maximum number of available PRBs in a CE-level PRB set. If the nbNum4USSCE parameter is set to a non-zero value, the maximum number of available PRBs in a CE-level PRB set cannot exceed this parameter value.
item.name: prbSet4USSSeparatedCE

item.desc: This parameter sets the number (r1 to r4) of repeated selections for the UE-specific search space at the CE level. It reflects the number of actual repeated selections of the MPDCCH under the maximum number of repeated selections for the UE-specific search space. It is a CE-level parameter.
item.name: repSelecUSS

item.desc: This parameter sets the CE level of the ECCE aggregation level for the type-2 search space.
item.name: ecCELevelType2CSS

item.desc: This parameter sets the CE level of the ECCE aggregation level for the UE-specific search space. ECCEs are used to carry DCI information of downlink control channels. Channel quality varies with the aggregation level. A larger CE level indicates worse UE channel quality. The ECCE aggregation level should be increased to resist interference.
item.name: ecCELevelUSS

item.desc: The initial index value of MPDCCH self-adaption.
item.name: mpdcchIdxInitial

item.desc: Maximum number of repetitions for MPDCCH common search space (CSS) for RAR, Msg3 and Msg4.

The downlink operating frequency bands are used for the eNodeB to send signals and for UEs to receive signals.

item.desc: This parameter sets the SSB measurement period during which a UE measures the SSB frequency in a periodic inter-RAT NR measurement. It is valid if the Switch of Periodic Inter-RAT NR Measurement parameter is set to Open.
item.name: sSBMeasDuration

item.desc: This parameter sets the SSB measurement subframe offset of the frequency to be measured during a periodic inter-RAT NR measurement. In an SSB measurement period of a UE, the UE measures the SSB frequency based on the subframe location corresponding to this parameter value.
item.name: sSBMeasSubframeOffset

item.desc: This parameter sets the time-domain bitmap position for the frequency-level SSB measurement for the UEs in RRC-connected state. If a bit is set to 1, the corresponding beam needs to be measured. If a bit is set to 0, the corresponding beam does not need to be measured.
