item.desc: This parameter determines the number of CA UE chosen to back off when the rate of users in cell reaches threshold of CA UE Back Off.
item.name: numCABackOff

item.desc: The parameter represents the cell preset allocations of network RRC License. When the user purchased the eNB level, or baseband board level, or cell level RRC License, the eNB shall ignore this parameter, and not used into the cell admission control process. When the user purchased the network level RRC License or doesn't need purchase any level RRC License, the eNB shall treat this parameter as the user preset cell allocations of network RRC License and use it into the cell adimission control process. About the CA(Carrier Aggregation) user, in the admission control process of PCell shall be counted as an RRC connection user and consume an RRC License, and in the admission control process of SCell shall be counted as an RRC connection user but not consume RRC License.
item.name: cellPresetNetRRCLic

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables RRC resource preemption. If it is set to Open, some high-priority users (for example, VoLTE users) can preempt the RRC resources of low-priority users in the case of admission failure due to RRC resource restriction.
item.name: userNumPreemptSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables RRC resource preemption redirection. If it is set to Open, the low-priority users whose resources are preempted are redirected. If it is set to Close, the low-priority users whose resources are preempted are released without redirection.
item.name: userNumPreemptRedSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets which QCI UEs are prohibited from being selected for resource preemption based on the number of RRC UEs.
item.name: userNumPreemptTraffTypeInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of eMTC terminals connected to the cell. The larger the parameter value is, the larger the number of eMTC terminals allowed to be connected to the cell is.
item.name: eMTCRRCResourceNumThrd

item.desc: This parameter and the The Number of RRC Resource for eMTC Terminals parameter work together to determine the number of RRC resources reserved for the eMTC handover users.
item.name: eMTCRRCResNumReserved

item.desc: This parameter determines how to allocate the numbers of RRC users in network sharing scenarios. If it is set to PLMN Based RRC User Number Resource Sharing, the numbers of RRC users are allocated by PLMN. If it is set to PLMN Group Based RRC User Number Resource Sharing, the numbers of RRC users are allocated by PLMN group.
item.name: rRCResourceAllocationMode

item.desc: This parameter enables or disable the admission control by the number of eMTC RRC users in network sharing scenarios. If it is set to Open, the system determines whether to admit eMTC users based on the ratio of the number of eMTC RRC users in the current PLMN (or PLMN group). If it is set to Close, the admission of eMTC users is independent of PLMNs (or PLMN groups).
item.name: eMTCRRCAC4NetSharSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportions of the numbers of RRC-connected eMTC UEs allocated to PLMNs or PLMN groups. If the rRCResourceAllocationMode (Allocation Mode of the Numbers of RRC Users in Network Sharing Scenarios) parameter is set to 0 (PLMN Based RRC User Number Resource Sharing), the elements of this array parameter indicate the proportions of the numbers of RRC-connected eMTC UEs allocated to PLMN1 through PLMN6 in turn. If the rRCResourceAllocationMode (Allocation Mode of the Numbers of RRC Users in Network Sharing Scenarios) parameter is set to 1 (PLMN Group Based RRC User Number Resource Sharing), the elements of this array parameter indicate the proportions of the numbers of RRC-connected eMTC UEs allocated to PLMN group 1 through PLMN group 6 in turn.
item.name: eMTCRRCRatio4PLMN

item.desc: This parameter sets the sliding window length of the number of RRC-connected eMTC UEs. If the eMTCRRCAC4NetSharSwch (Admission Control Switch for the Numbers of eMTC RRC Users in Network Sharing Scenarios) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the proportion of the number of remaining RRC-connected eMTC UEs in the current cell is smaller than the parameter value, the number of newly connected eMTC UEs is limited by the proportion of the number of RRC-connected eMTC UEs admitted by an operator to prevent the number of RRC-connected eMTC UEs admitted by other operators from being too small.
item.name: eMTCRrcNumWindowLength

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of six elements. It is used to set the proportions of RRC resources allocated to different PLMN groups in network sharing scenarios. The elements in the array parameter indicate the proportions of the RRC resources allocated to PLMN group 1 through PLMN group 6 in turn.
item.name: rRCRatio4PLMNGroup

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of six elements. It is used to set the proportions of eMTC RRC resources allocated to different PLMN groups in network sharing scenarios. The elements in the array parameter indicate the proportions of the eMTC RRC resources allocated to PLMN group 1 through PLMN group 6 in turn.
item.name: eMTCRRCRatio4PLMNGroup

item.desc: This parameter enables or disable the addition of inter-band CA. If it is set to Open, a candidate cell is not added as an SCell of a UE if the number of UEs in the candidate cell exceeds the threshold and the candidate cell and the PCell are on different bands.
item.name: caInterBandRestrictSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disable the addition of intra-band CA. If it is set to Open, a candidate SCell is not added as an SCell of a UE if the number of UEs in the candidate SCell exceeds the threshold and the candidate SCell and the PCell are on the same band.
item.name: caIntraBandRestrictSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the number of inter-band CA UEs. If the ratio of the number of UEs in a cell (including the UEs for which the cell is the serving cell and the UEs for which the cell is an SCell) to the maximum number of UEs that can be connected to the cell is greater than or equal to this threshold, and if this cell and the PCell are on different bands, the cell cannot be configured as an SCell for the UE.
item.name: caInterBandRestrictThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the number of intra-band CA UEs. If the ratio of the number of UEs in a cell (including the UEs for which the cell is the serving cell and the UEs for which the cell is an SCell) to the maximum number of UEs that can be connected to the cell is greater than or equal to this threshold, and if this cell and the PCell are on the same band, the cell cannot be configured as an SCell for the UE.
item.name: caIntraBandRestrictThrd

item.desc: If it is set to Open, the eNodeB connects a common UE in initial access when the number of RRC UEs is restricted. If the UE establishes a high-priority service in a certain period of time, the eNodeB triggers a preemption procedure for low-priority UEs in the cell. If the UE establishes a low-priority service, it is released.
item.name: rrcPrmptWaitSwch

item.desc: This parameter configures high-priority services for congestion control. The configured services still can be established in the case of PRB resource preemption failures.
item.name: conHighPriQCI

item.desc: This parameter sets the service setup waiting time in resource preemption based on the number of RRC UEs.
item.name: rrcPrmptWaitTime

item.name: FDN

item.name: DATETIME

item.name: granularityPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: id

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: moId

item.desc: The parameter indicates the frame number and subframe number configuration, via different configuration, different opportunity used to transmit PRACH is also configured. In fact, the parameter gives the access opportunity for PRACH. The larger the number of frame and subframe used to transmit PRACH is, the more the access opportunity is.
item.name: prachConfigIndex

item.desc: The parameter is used to determine the frequency position used for PRACH. The PRACH uses 6 RB, from 0 to N_RB^UL-6.
item.name: prachFreqOffset

item.desc: This parameter sets whether a cell is a high-speed cell, 0 for a non-high-speed cell and 1 for a high-speed cell. In a high-speed cell (a cell moving at a high speed), only some specified cyclic shifts of PRACH prefix sequences can be generated for UEs through the root sequences. In a non-high-speed cell, any cyclic shifts of PRACH prefix sequences can be generated for UEs through the root sequences.
item.name: highSpeedFlag

item.desc: The parameter defines the number of contention based random access preambles.
item.name: numberOfRAPreambles

item.desc: The parameter indicates the logical root sequence start number used to generate prach preamble. There are 64 preambles available in each cell. The set of 64 preamble sequences in a cell is found by including first, in the order of increasing cyclic shift, all the available cyclic shifts of a root Zadoff-Chu sequence with the logical index RACH_ROOT_SEQUENCE, where RACH_ROOT_SEQUENCE is broadcasted as part of the System Information. Additional preamble sequences, in case 64 preambles cannot be generated from a single root Zadoff-Chu sequence, are obtained from the root sequences with the consecutive logical indexes until all the 64 sequences are found.
item.name: rootSequenceIndex

item.desc: The parameter is used to determine the shift number of cyclic shift. There are 64 preambles available in each cell. The set of 64 preamble sequences in a cell is found by including first, in the order of increasing cyclic shift, all the available cyclic shifts (correlative to Ncs) of a root Zadoff-Chu sequence with the logical index RACH_ROOT_SEQUENCE, where RACH_ROOT_SEQUENCE is broadcasted as part of the System Information. Additional preamble sequences, in case 64 preambles cannot be generated from a single root Zadoff-Chu sequence, are obtained from the root sequences with the consecutive logical indexes until all the 64 sequences are found.
item.name: ncs

item.desc: The parameter defines the number of Random Access preambles in Group A.
item.name: sizeOfRAPreamblesGroupA

item.desc: If no Random Access Response is received by UE after UE transmitted Random Access Preamble, UE will increase transmit power for PRACH by Power step and retry to transmit Random Access Preamble until Preamble_Transmission_Counter is equal to Max_retransmit_number_for_prach.
item.name: powerRampingStep

item.desc: If no Random Access Response is received by UE after UE transmitted Random Access Preamble, UE will increase transmit power for PRACH by Power step and retry to transmit Random Access Preamble until Preamble_Transmission_Counter is equal to Max_retransmit_number_for_prach.
item.name: preambleTransMax

item.desc: The parameter indicates initial power for preamble of PRACH. It is that the first transmit power.
item.name: preambleIniReceivedPower

item.desc: Based on this parameter of message3 size, UE determines to select the Random Access Preambles group A or group B.
item.name: messageSizeGroupA

item.desc: The parameter is a power control margin for message 3 transmission configured by the eNB and is used to select the Random Access Preambles group A or group B.
item.name: messagePowerOffsetGroupB

item.desc: This parameter sets the size of the random-access monitoring window. After sending a random-access prefix, the UE monitors the random-access response within the duration specified by this parameter.
item.name: raResponseWindowSize

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of times that MSG3 HARQ messages are sent during random access.
item.name: maxHarqMsg3Tx

item.desc: Expected Random Access Conflict Probability by Cell.
item.name: raCollProb

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of preamble signatures for contention-free random access in the cell at the MAC layer.
item.name: macNonContenPreamble

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the MAC contention resolution timer. During the random access procedure of a UE, if the uplink message contains the C-RNTI MAC or CCCH information, the timer is started. The UE monitors the PDCCH and waits for a response from the network to check whether it is allowed to access the network. After the contention is resolved, the UE stops the timer. If the timer expires, the UE determines that a contention occurs and initiates a new random access procedure.
item.name: macContResTimer

item.desc: The switch of PRACH starting RB configuration method. Zero means PrachFreqOffset is adaptive , and one means PrachFreqOffset is manual configured.
item.name: prachFreqOffsetFlag

item.desc: This parameter is in Normal coverage and High way coverage, for PRACH ultimate capacity test, opened in the PRACH ultimate capacity test, the other is turned off by default.
item.name: prachUltiCapSwch

item.desc: This parameter is to reducing the current cell Msg1 false alarm probability caused by neighbor cell. When this part of the false alarm probability needs to be reduced, the switch is turned on, the other conditions are turned off by default.
item.name: prachFMRecOnTASwch

item.desc: If the cell radius calculated based on TA of the current PRACH ID is larger than the TA threshold R (in meters), the current PRACH ID is considered to be false.
item.name: prachFMRecTAThresh

item.desc: This parameter is to extending the current cell coverage. When the cell radius is greater than 12.23Km and is less than or equal to 118.93Km, the switch is turned on, the other conditions are turned off by default.
item.name: prachSupFarCoverSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the system notifies the control plane of sending SI when an MSG3Lost is identified. The reason for the MSG3Lost problem is that a cell is established or deleted when the Format3 parameter is updated. In this case, the shutdown of the RRU PA results in the loss of paging messages and the UE fails to update the system.
item.name: prachUpdateDetectionSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables residual-RE protection for the PRACH when DSS is enabled. If DSS is enabled, the frequency deviation of residual REs may cause interference to DDC filters, which may degrade the PRACH demodulation performance and cause discard or false detection of MSG1 messages. If this parameter is set to Open, the problem can be avoided and therefore the PRACH demodulation performance can be improved.
item.name: rachProtecSwch

item.desc: This parameter is reserved parameter 1.
item.name: reserve1

item.desc: This parameter sets the adjustment coefficient for the PRACH detection threshold in DSS scenarios. It is configured based on the access performance (indicated by MSG1 messages) of the eNodeB to adjust the PRACH detection threshold and improve the access success rate of UEs in a cell.
item.name: dssPrachDetThrCoef

item.desc: This parameter sets the power offset to the PRACH during MSG3 scheduling. It is used to improve the uplink transmit power of UEs during MSG3 scheduling or UE access, and thus improve the anti-interference capability of the PUSCH.
item.name: deltaPreambleMsg3

item.desc: The parameter specifies the filtering coefficient for RSRP measurements used to calculate path loss for PUSCH , PUCCH and SRS. The parameter is a cell specific parameter.
