item.name: phrThpThrInAtmosduct

item.desc: This parameter sets the switch of the CRS power adaption function when the atmosphere duct detection function is enabled. When the atmosphere duct detection function (ucAtmosphericSwch) is enabled, if the CRS power adaption function is also enabled, CRS transmit power can be adjusted in accordance with interference; otherwise, CRS power will not be adjusted.
item.name: atmosRsDecSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the path loss threshold of user perception when the atmosphere duct detection function is enabled. If interference is larger than the maximum interference that the path loss point can bear, the CRS power adaption function should be enabled.
item.name: atmosRsDecPLThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum offset of the upper and lower limits for key-index-based PUSCH dynamic scheduling power adjustment. The first value in the parameter indicates the maximum offset of the lower limit and the second value in the parameter indicates the maximum offset of the upper limit. The initial power adjustment for PUSCH dynamic scheduling cannot exceed the upper limit and lower limit.
item.name: puschDSKeyIndBasePwAdjLim

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum offset of the upper and lower limits for key-index-based PUCCH power adjustment. The first value in the parameter indicates the maximum offset of the lower limit and the second value in the parameter indicates the maximum offset of the upper limit. The initial power adjustment for PUCCH cannot exceed the upper limit and lower limit.
item.name: pucchKeyIndBasedPwAdjLim

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum offset of the upper and lower limits for key-index-based PUSCH semi-scheduling power adjustment. The first value in the parameter indicates the maximum offset of the lower limit and the second value in the parameter indicates the maximum offset of the upper limit. The initial power adjustment for PUSCH semi-scheduling cannot exceed the upper limit and lower limit.
item.name: puschSSKeyIndBasePwAdjLim

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of supporting high-power UEs by the eNodeB. If the parameter is set to Open, the eNodeB does not deliver the Pmax parameter in the SIB, and a UE determines the maximum uplink transmit power in accordance with the PowerClass and Band information. The eNodeB determines the Pmax parameter of a UE in accordance with the PowerClass and Band information in the UE capability to do uplink power control calculation.
item.name: highPowerSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the maximum BLER at MCS0. If the BLER at MSC0 exceeds this threshold, measures need to be taken to increase power and decrease the BLER in uplink PUSCH power control.
item.name: mCS0BlerHThr

item.desc: This parameter indicates the path loss threshold for OI-based power control, and, together with the OIDecPowUeType parameter, determines the path loss range of the UEs involved in OI-based power control.
item.name: oIDecPowPLThr

item.desc: This parameter defines the UE type for OI-based power control, including all the interfering UEs, outer interfering UEs, and inter interfering UEs. Inter interfering applies to strong overlap areas, and outer interfering applies to normal overlap areas.
item.name: oIDecPowUeType

item.desc: This parameter indicates the threshold of event A3 for OI-based power control. When the RSRP difference between the neighbor cell and the serving cell is lager than this threshold, the UE reports the RSRP, and the eNodeB uses the reported value to determine the interference with the neighbor cell from the UE.
item.name: oIPuschPowA3Offset

item.desc: This parameter indicates the high threshold for OI. If the IoT value is larger than this threshold, it is considered that the interference is high.
item.name: oIHiIoTThr

item.desc: This parameter indicates the low threshold for OI. If the IoT value is larger than this threshold, it is considered that the interference is low.
item.name: oILwIoTThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the upper Fi margin for uplink SU-MIMO. It is used to provide SU-MIMO power compensation and obtain high SU-MIMO traffic gain.
item.name: fiMarginforSU

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to support high-power UEs with the P-max configuration. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB sends the P-max parameter in SIB and the UE determines the maximum uplink transmit power to be used based on the power class and band information; the eNodeB determines the P-max parameter of the UE based on the power class and band information in the UE capability for uplink power control calculation.
item.name: pmaxConfigHighPowerSwch

item.desc: This parameter implements PUSCH power control when neighbor interference is comprehensively considered. It is used to implement OI power control over the UEs of different QCI types.
item.name: oIPuschPowCtrlSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables closed-loop power control on the PUSCH during access. If it is set to Open, PUSCH power is adjusted based on the SINR during access; otherwise, PUSCH power is not adjusted during access.
item.name: accPowCtrlSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the upper limit of the target SINR for closed-loop power control on the PUSCH during the access of 64QAM UEs. If the actual SINR value of a UE is larger than this threshold, the transmit power of the UE is decreased.
item.name: acc64SINRUpThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the upper limit of the target SINR for closed-loop power control on the PUSCH during the access of 16QAM UEs. If the actual SINR value of a UE is larger than this threshold, the transmit power of the UE is decreased.
item.name: acc16SINRUpThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the lower limit of the target SINR for closed-loop power control on the PUSCH during access. If the actual SINR value of a UE is smaller than this threshold, the transmit power of the UE is increased.
item.name: accSINRLowThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the power compensation for physical PUCCH format 5. It is an offset to PUCCH format 1a.
item.name: deltaFPucchFormat5

item.desc: In an NSA scenario, this parameter is used to allocate the maximum Tx power to the LTE UEs that do not support power sharing.
item.name: pmaxOfLte4NonSharingPwrUE

item.desc: In an NSA scenario, this parameter is used to allocate the maximum Tx power to the LTE UEs that support power sharing.
item.name: pmaxOfLte4SharingPwrUE

item.desc: This parameter sets the scale-down factor for the window length of adaptive power control to adjust the power control speed. A smaller parameter value indicates a shorter window length for adaptive power control and a faster power control speed. This parameter is applicable to the scenarios where there are more discrete network scheduling. It is not recommended that this parameter be set to a smaller value in the case of continuous services.
item.name: scalingDownFactor

item.desc: This parameter controls the allocation of the power of NSA UEs on both the LTE and NR sides in a semi-static way. With the current power sharing solution in an NSA scenario, LTE cells and NR cells occupy 20 dBm of the power by default, and therefore the coverage of far points is limited due to insufficient uplink power. This parameter can be used to solve this problem. If the power of an LTE cell is restricted, higher power can be reconfigured to the LTE cell.
item.name: adpAllocNsaUlPwrSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to enable atmospheric ducting based on the period. If it is set to Open, atmospheric ducting takes effect within the configured period in accordance with the atmospheric-ducting switch configuration policy. Within non-configured periods, atmospheric ducting is disabled. If this parameter is set to Close, the enabling or disabling of atmospheric ducting depends on the atmospheric-ducting switch configuration policy, independent of the period.
item.name: atmosphericTimeSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the valid periods for atmospheric ducting in 24 hours.
item.name: atmosphericValidHourTime

item.desc: This parameter indicates the valid months for atmospheric ducting. If the value of a bit is 0, it indicates that the corresponding month is invalid. If the value of a bit is 1, it indicates that the corresponding month is valid.
item.name: atmosphericValidMonth

item.desc: This parameter sets the upper limit of the power on the LTE side when semi-static allocation of LTE/NR power is enabled for NSA UEs. If the LTE power allocated in a semi-static way cannot meet the uplink quality requirements of UEs, this parameter can be set to a larger value to improve the LTE power. If the LTE coverage is not restricted, this parameter can be set to a smaller value to improve the traffic on the NR side.
item.name: maxAdpUlLtePwrOfNsa

item.desc: This parameter sets the power allocation type for the UE that supports and enables dynamic power sharing. If it is set to EnodeB distribute LTE/NR power, the total transmit power of the UE in both the LTE and NR systems does not exceed the maximum transmit power of the UE. If it is set to UE distribute LTE/NR power, the transmit power of the NR system is reduced when the total transmit power of the UE in both the LTE and NR systems exceeds the maximum transmit power of the UE.
item.name: opt4DynSharingPwrNsaUE

item.desc: This parameter determines how to select the type of the cells for OI information transfer, including the selection based on intra-eNodeBs and the adaptive selection based on overlapping coverage. The selection based on intra-eNodeBs is applicable to the scenario where most interference occurs in the eNodeB.
item.name: oISendTypeswch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to configure differentiated uplink power control parameters for UEs with the general QoS. If it is set to Open, differentiated radio channel experience can be provided for the guaranteed UEs with the general QoS. In this case, differentiated uplink power control can be provided for guaranteed users to allow them to enjoy different radio experience from common users.
item.name: pc4GeneralQosSwchUl

item.desc: This parameter sets the path loss offset of closed-loop power control on the PUSCH for UEs with the general QoS. This parameter is configured to provide guaranteed uplink traffic for the guaranteed UEs with the general QoS. A larger parameter value indicates a larger target value for power control for the guaranteed UEs with the general QoS and higher throughput, but a larger NI increase in the entire network.
item.name: deltaPL4QoS

item.desc: This parameter sets the target BLER of power control on the PUSCH for UEs with the general QoS at near points. It is configured to provide guaranteed uplink traffic for the guaranteed UEs with the general QoS. A larger parameter value indicates more uplink traffic gain, but higher transmit power of UEs and heavier interference in the entire network.
item.name: targetBler4A14QoS

item.desc: This parameter sets the target BLER of power control on the PUSCH for UEs with the general QoS at midpoints. It is configured to provide guaranteed uplink traffic for the guaranteed UEs with the general QoS. A larger parameter value indicates more uplink traffic gain, but higher transmit power of UEs and heavier interference in the entire network.
item.name: targetBler4A24QoS

item.desc: This parameter sets the ACK threshold for uplink power decrease on the PUSCH in atmospheric ducting scenarios. If the number of ACK messages received in a period of time is larger than the threshold, the transmit power of UEs is decreased.
item.name: atmosphericUlPcAckThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the initial transmit power of the PRACH preamble in an atmospheric ducting scenario.
item.name: atmosphericPreInitPwr

item.desc: This parameter sets the upper limit of the f(i) margin for UEs with the general QoS. It is configured to provide guaranteed uplink traffic for the guaranteed UEs with the general QoS. A larger parameter value indicates a larger power control increase on the PUSCH and more traffic gain, but a higher IoT increase in the entire network.
item.name: puschPwrFiUpMargin4QoS

item.desc: This parameter sets the upper limit of the NI of adaptive power control on the PUSCH for UEs with the general QoS; that is, the target value of power control can be guaranteed within this NI range. It is configured to guarantee uplink performance for the guaranteed UEs with the general QoS. If it is set to a larger value, the uplink performance at near points is better. If it is set to a smaller value, the uplink transmit power is lower.
item.name: puschPwrNiThr4QoS

item.desc: This parameter sets the upper limit of PUSCH Fi in atmospheric ducting scenarios.
item.name: atmosphericFiUpLimit

item.desc: In the calculation of the transmit power of the PUSCH in an atmospheric ducting scenario, this parameter is used to compensate the path loss of cells. It corresponds to the data transmission on the PUSCH in semi-static and dynamic scheduling authorization (j = 0 and j = 1).
item.name: atmosphericAlfa

item.desc: This parameter sets the NACK threshold for uplink power increase on the PUSCH in atmospheric ducting scenarios. If the number of NACK messages received in a period of time is larger than the threshold, or the NACK message is HARQ Fail and neither f(i) nor transmit power reaches the upper limit, the transmit power of UEs is increased.
item.name: atmosphericUlPcNackThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink transmit power offset for interference coordination between public and private networks in a high-speed railway scenario. It is used to control the decrease of the uplink transmit power of the neighbor cells in the public network. If it is set to 0, the uplink transmit power of the neighbor cells in the public network is not decreased. If it is set to a non-zero value, the uplink transmit power of the neighbor cells in the public network needs to be decreased by N dB. (The value N is the value of this parameter. In absolute power control configuration, this parameter is fixed to 4 dB. ) In this way, the interference between public and private networks can be coordinated]
item.name: iCoULPowerOffset

item.desc: This parameter sets the lower limit of the f(i) value for closed-loop power control on the PUSCH. It is used to adjust the transmit power of UEs.
item.name: puschPwrFilowLimit

item.desc: This parameter sets the upper limit of the f(i) value for closed-loop power control on the PUSCH. It is used to adjust the transmit power of UEs.
item.name: puschPwrFiupLimit

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for triggering fast decrease of uplink power based on the inner-loop SINR on the MM. When a UE enters the procedure for uplink fast power control, the power of the UE is decreased if the inner-loop SINR of the UE is higher than this threshold.
item.name: innerSINRThr4PwrCtr

item.desc: This parameter sets the compensation value for the target MCS of the UEs at far points for power control. For a far-point UE, the final target MCS value for remote power control is the sum of the value calculated by SingleRbSinr plus this compensation value.
item.name: deltaTargetMCS4A2

item.desc: This parameter sets the upper limit of the amount of PUSCH power adjustment. If it is set to 0, the upper limit of the amount of PUSCH power adjustment is not controlled, that is, the transmit power of UEs is not intentionally decreased when the power adjustment amount is higher than this upper limit or the actual SINR is larger than the upper SINR limit. If it is set to a non-zero value, the upper limit of the amount of PUSCH power adjustment is controlled, that is, the transmit power of UEs is decreased when the power adjustment amount is higher than this upper limit and the actual SINR is larger than the upper SINR limit.
item.name: ulPCMaxFiThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the upper limit of the PUSCH SINR. When the power adjustment amount meets this threshold and the actual SINR is larger than this value, the transmit power of UEs is decreased during uplink scheduling.
item.name: ulPCMaxSINRThrd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the optimization for the assistant scheduler of the NSA eNodeB. If it is set to Open, the uplink traffic on the LTE side increases in the case of power restriction.
item.name: nSAPowAlloOptiSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables SCG deletion based on LTE coverage in NSA scenarios. If it is set to Open, the LTE coverage in NSA scenarios is the same as that in non-NSA scenarios in principle.
item.name: sinrBasedNSADeleteSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of times that hysteresis occurs in the case of SCG deletion based on LTE coverage. It can be used to modify the duration from the time when the SCG deletion based on LTE coverage is triggered to the time when the SCG deletion based on LTE coverage is actually completed.
item.name: sinrBasedNSADeleteHys

item.desc: This parameter sets the SINR threshold in the case of SCG deletion based on LTE coverage. The configuration of this threshold can ensure the UE-level rate to a certain extent, for example, 200 kb/s.
item.name: upPowAdjSINRThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum transmit power on the LTE side when the optimization for the assistant scheduler of the NSA eNodeB is enabled. The maximum uplink transmit power of a UE on the LTE side cannot exceed this parameter value.
item.name: nSALTEPmax

item.desc: This parameter sets the difference between the upper Fi margin of UEs when the eNodeB performs uplink 256QAM scheduling for the UEs and the upper Fi margin of UEs when the eNodeB performs uplink 16QAM scheduling for the UEs. A larger parameter value indicates higher transmit power of the current UE.
item.name: fiMarginfor256Qam

item.desc: This parameter sets the decision threshold for reducing the transmit power of UEs when the eNodeB performs uplink 256QAM scheduling for the UEs. When the eNodeB performs uplink 256QAM scheduling for a UE and the PUSCH SINR of the UE is higher than this parameter value, the UE can reduce the transmit power.
item.name: maxSINRThr256Qam

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables high power for NSA cells. It indicates whether the eNodeB allows NSA UEs to transmit data by using power higher than Class 3. If it is set to Close, the eNodeB does not allow NSA UEs to transmit data by using power higher than Class 3. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB allows NSA UEs to transmit data by using power higher than Class 3.
item.name: nsaHighPowerSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables PUSCH power control optimization. It is used to adjust the transmit power of the UEs at far points. If the transmit power of the far-point UEs is too low, this parameter can be set to Open to increase the transmit power of the UEs.
item.name: powCtrlOpt4FarPoint

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable closed-loop power control when TTIB is enabled. If it is set to Open and TTIB is enabled, closed-loop power control can be adjusted, increasing the transmit power of UEs and improving user experience.
item.name: puschPowerCtrl4TTIBSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable parameter configuration for VoLTE PUSCH closed-loop power control. If this parameter is set to Open, the target MCSs, target BLERs, and window lengths can be configured for QCI1 and QCI2 UEs for closed-loop power control, thus allowing refined power adjustment for UEs with different path loss values.
item.name: voLTEPcCfgSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the target MCSs for closed-loop power control for QCI1 UEs. It is an array consisting of eight elements. The eNodeB calculates three path loss thresholds, A0, A1, and A2, which are in an ascending order. The following four path loss ranges are obtained based on the three thresholds: less than or equal to A0, A0 to A1, A1 to A2, and greater than A2. The first through fourth elements respectively set the target MCSs for QCI1 UEs with path loss values that are in the four ranges in the scenario where 16QAM is used. The fifth through eighth elements respectively set the target MCSs for QCI1 UEs with path loss values that are in the four ranges in the scenario where 64QAM or 256QAM is used. This parameter allows refined power adjustment for QCI1 UEs with different path loss values.
item.name: qci1PcTargetMcs

item.desc: This parameter sets the target MCSs for closed-loop power control for QCI2 UEs. It is an array consisting of eight elements. The eNodeB calculates three path loss thresholds, A0, A1, and A2, which are in an ascending order. The following four path loss ranges are obtained based on the three thresholds: less than or equal to A0, A0 to A1, A1 to A2, and greater than A2. The first through fourth elements respectively set the target MCSs for QCI2 UEs with path loss values that are in the four ranges in the scenario where 16QAM is used. The fifth through eighth elements respectively set the target MCSs for QCI2 UEs with path loss values that are in the four ranges in the scenario where 64QAM or 256QAM is used. This parameter allows refined power adjustment for QCI2 UEs with different path loss values.
item.name: qci2PcTargetMcs

item.desc: This parameter sets the target BLERs for closed-loop power control for QCI1 UEs. It is an array consisting of four elements. The eNodeB calculates three path loss thresholds, A0, A1, and A2, which are in an ascending order. The following four path loss ranges are obtained based on the three thresholds: less than or equal to A0, A0 to A1, A1 to A2, and greater than A2. The four elements respectively set the target BLERs for QCI1 UEs with path loss values that are in the four ranges, allowing refined power adjustment for QCI1 UEs with different path loss values.
item.name: qci1TargetBler

item.desc: This parameter sets the target BLERs for closed-loop power control for QCI2 UEs. It is an array consisting of four elements. The eNodeB calculates three path loss thresholds, A0, A1, and A2, which are in an ascending order. The following four path loss ranges are obtained based on the three thresholds: less than or equal to A0, A0 to A1, A1 to A2, and greater than A2. The four elements respectively set the target BLERs for QCI2 UEs with path loss values that are in the four ranges, allowing refined power adjustment for QCI2 UEs with different path loss values.
item.name: qci2TargetBler

item.desc: This parameter sets the window length for PUSCH closed-loop power control for QCI1 UEs. When the number of scheduling operations performed for a QCI1 UE reaches this parameter value, a new window for adjusting power control is started.
item.name: qci1PCWinThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the window length for PUSCH closed-loop power control for QCI2 UEs. This array parameter consists of two elements, which respectively set the window lengths for PUSCH closed-loop power control in LTE FDD and LTE TDD. When the number of scheduling operations performed for a QCI2 UE reaches the first or second element value, a new window for power control is started.
item.name: qci2PCWinThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the target value margin for power control when orthogonal-projection optimization is enabled. It is valid when the orthPrjSwch (Orthogonal Projection Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open). If the PcOpt4OrthPrj (Power Control Optimization Policy in Orthogonal Projection) parameter is set to a non-zero value, the power of UEs decreases after it reaches the target value. If this parameter is set to a larger value, the target value for power control increases, avoiding power decrease of UEs.
item.name: pcOrthPrjMargin

item.desc: This parameter sets the SingleRbsinr threshold for forbidding secondary capability query on far-point UEs. It is an array parameter consisting of four elements, which set the SingleRbsinr threshold for TDD macro cells, FDD macro cells, TMM macro cells, and FMM macro cells respectively. If the farUeCapQueryForbidSwch parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the SingleRBSINR value of a far-point UE is smaller than the corresponding element value in a scenario, the UE is determined to be a far-point UE and secondary capability query is forbidden for this UE.
item.name: singleRbsinrThr4FarUe

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to forbid secondary capability query on far-point UEs. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), secondary capability query can be performed on UEs at far points. If the capability query times out, the access success rate may be reduced. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), it is forbidden to perform secondary capability query on far-point UEs.
item.name: farUeCapQueryForbidSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the target MCS values of closed-loop PUSCH power control. It is used to set the target MCS values corresponding to different path loss intervals of large-packet UEs. This parameter is an array consisting of eight elements. The first four elements respectively set the target MCS values of UEs at extreme near points, near points, middle points, and far points in 16QAM mode. The last four elements respectively set the target MCS values of UEs at extreme near points, near points, middle points, and far points in 64QAM mode.
item.name: largeBsrPcTargetMcs

item.desc: This parameter sets the target BLERs of closed-loop power control for large-packet UEs. This parameter is an array consisting of four elements that respectively set the target BLERs of UEs at extreme near points, near points, middle points, and far points.
item.name: largeBsrTargetBler

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum transmit power of LTE cells when the LTE cells share U subframes in dynamic power sharing scenarios of NSA UEs. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. Element 1 sets the maximum transmit power of LTE cells if the LTE cells provide the uplink primary data splitting path, and element 2 sets the maximum transmit power of LTE cells if the NR cells provide the uplink primary data splitting path.
item.name: ltePmax4SplitPath

item.desc: This parameter sets the target MCS values of closed-loop PUSCH power control. It is used to set the target MCS values corresponding to different path loss intervals of UEs. This parameter is an array consisting of eight elements. The first four elements respectively set the target MCS values of UEs at extreme near points, near points, middle points, and far points in 16QAM mode. The last four elements respectively set the target MCS values of UEs at extreme near points, near points, middle points, and far points in 64QAM mode.
item.name: pcTargetMcs

item.desc: This parameter sets the rollback value of the maximum uplink LTE transmit power in dynamic power sharing scenarios of NSA UEs. This parameter is an array consisting of 8 elements. The first four elements set the rollback values of the transmit power in 256QAM, 64QAM, 16QAM, and QPSK respectively if the number of RBs is larger than 18. The last four elements set the rollback values of the transmit power in 256QAM, 64QAM, 16QAM, and QPSK respectively if the number of RBs is smaller than or equal to 18.
item.name: pmaxMpr

item.desc: This parameter sets the power sharing mode for ordinary UEs. If this parameter is set to 0 (Class-UE Autonomous Power Sharing), power sharing similar to that automatically initiated by UEs is enabled for ordinary UEs and the power is allocated by the UEs. If this parameter is set to 1 (Power sharing by bearer), power sharing by bearer is enabled for ordinary UEs and the power is allocated by the eNodeB.
item.name: commonUePowMode

item.desc: This parameter sets the path loss offset to closed-loop PUSCH power control for large-packet UEs.
item.name: deltaPL4LargeBsr

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to distinguish shared U subframes from dedicated U subframes for ordinary UEs in dynamic power sharing scenarios of NSA networks. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), it indicates that there is no difference between dedicated U subframes and shared U subframes for ordinary UEs. If this parameter is set to 1 (NR power preferred) or 2 (LTE power preferred), it indicates that dedicated U subframes are different from shared U subframes for ordinary UEs. In addition, in the scenarios where both SCG bearers and MCG bearers are used, if this parameter is set to 1 (NR power preferred), it indicates that power of SCG bearers is guaranteed preferentially for NR cells; if this parameter is set to 2 (LTE power preferred), it indicates that power of MCG bearers on shared U subframes is guaranteed preferentially for LTE cells.
item.name: dynPwrShareOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the RB reduction factor of LTE cells in M1 scheduling in dynamic power sharing scenarios of NSA UEs. It is used to control the number of RBs for LTE scheduling. The number of RBs scheduled by LTE cells is smaller than or equal to the product of the number of RBs for full-power scheduling of LTE cells multiplied by the reduction factor.
item.name: dynPwrSharM1Factor

item.desc: In dynamic power sharing scenarios of NSA UEs, this parameter sets the estimated traffic reduction factor from LTE scheduling to M1 scheduling. It is used for LTE traffic estimation in 4G-5G power coordination scenarios of large-packet UEs.
item.name: dynPwrSharM1TbsFactor

item.desc: This parameter sets the lower limit of Transmit Power Control (TPC) for sending MSG3 messages in handover scenarios. A larger parameter value indicates higher power for sending MSG3 messages.
item.name: hoMsg3TpcLimit

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to use a fixed target MCS value for large-packet UEs at far points. If it is set to 0 (Close), the target MCS value is adaptively adjusted based on the current channel condition. If it is set to 1 (Open), the target MCS value is a fixed value.
item.name: largeBsrA2McsFixSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the lower limit of Fi of closed-loop power control for large-packet UEs. It is used to adjust the transmit power of large-packet UEs. A larger parameter value indicates higher transmit power of large-packet UEs.
item.name: largeBsrFiLowLimit

item.desc: This parameter sets the scale-down factor of the window length of adaptive power control for large-packet UEs. It is used to adjust the power control speed. A smaller parameter value indicates a smaller window length for adaptive power control and a higher power control speed.
item.name: largeBsrScalingDownFactor

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to optimize MSG5 power control in the access phase. If it is set to 1 (Open), closed-loop power control can be implemented based on the MSG5 messages.
item.name: msg5PowCtrlOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to configure parameters of closed-loop PUSCH power control for large-packet UEs and ordinary UEs separately. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), large-packet UEs use the power control parameters that are different from those of ordinary UEs. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), large-packet UEs use the same power control parameters as ordinary UEs.
item.name: pcDiffCfgSwth

item.desc: Full Distinguished Name
item.name: FDN

item.desc: Date Time
item.name: DATETIME

item.desc: Collection period of measurement task.
item.name: granularityPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: id

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: moId

item.desc: For each UE, the ratio of PDSCH EPRE to cell-specific RS EPRE among PDSCH REs in all the OFDM symbols not containing cell-specific RS is equal and is denoted by Rho_A.The UE may assume that for 16 QAM or 64 QAM or spatial multiplexing with more than one layer or for PDSCH transmissions associated with the multi-user MIMO transmission scheme Rho_A is equal to Delta_power_offset + P_A + 10log10(2) [dB] when the UE receives a PDSCH data transmission using precoding for transmit diversity with 4 cell-specific antenna ports, and Rho_A is equal to Delta_power_offset + P_A [dB] otherwise, where Delta_power_offset is 0 dB for all PDSCH transmission schemes except multi-user MIMO and P_A is a parameter provided by higher layers. Not necessarily valid in some cases, e.g. QPSK with no spatial multiplexing and without multi-user MIMO transmission mode. The parameter is corresponding to the PDSCH data sourced from BCCH logical channel.
item.name: paForBCCH

item.desc: For each UE, the ratio of PDSCH EPRE to cell-specific RS EPRE among PDSCH REs in all the OFDM symbols not containing cell-specific RS is equal and is denoted by Rho_A.The UE may assume that for 16 QAM or 64 QAM or spatial multiplexing with more than one layer or for PDSCH transmissions associated with the multi-user MIMO transmission scheme Rho_A is equal to Delta_power_offset + P_A + 10log10(2) [dB] when the UE receives a PDSCH data transmission using precoding for transmit diversity with 4 cell-specific antenna ports, and Rho_A is equal to Delta_power_offset + P_A [dB] otherwise, where Delta_power_offset is 0 dB for all PDSCH transmission schemes except multi-user MIMO and P_A is a parameter provided by higher layers. Not necessarily valid in some cases, e.g. QPSK with no spatial multiplexing and without multi-user MIMO transmission mode. The parameter is corresponding to the PDSCH data sourced from CCCH logical channel.
item.name: paForCCCH

item.desc: For each UE, the ratio of PDSCH EPRE to cell-specific RS EPRE among PDSCH REs in all the OFDM symbols not containing cell-specific RS is equal and is denoted by Rho_A.The UE may assume that for 16 QAM or 64 QAM or spatial multiplexing with more than one layer or for PDSCH transmissions associated with the multi-user MIMO transmission scheme Rho_A is equal to Delta_power_offset + P_A + 10log10(2) [dB] when the UE receives a PDSCH data transmission using precoding for transmit diversity with 4 cell-specific antenna ports, and Rho_A is equal to Delta_power_offset + P_A [dB] otherwise, where Delta_power_offset is 0 dB for all PDSCH transmission schemes except multi-user MIMO and P_A is a parameter provided by higher layers. Not necessarily valid in some cases, e.g. QPSK with no spatial multiplexing and without multi-user MIMO transmission mode. The parameter is corresponding to the PDSCH data sourced from PCCH logical channel.
item.name: paForPCCH

item.desc: For each UE, the ratio of PDSCH EPRE to cell-specific RS EPRE among PDSCH REs in all the OFDM symbols not containing cell-specific RS is equal and is denoted by Rho_A.The UE may assume that for 16 QAM or 64 QAM or spatial multiplexing with more than one layer or for PDSCH transmissions associated with the multi-user MIMO transmission scheme Rho_A is equal to Delta_power_offset + P_A + 10log10(2) [dB] when the UE receives a PDSCH data transmission using precoding for transmit diversity with 4 cell-specific antenna ports, and Rho_A is equal to Delta_power_offset + P_A [dB] otherwise, where Delta_power_offset is 0 dB for all PDSCH transmission schemes except multi-user MIMO and P_A is a parameter provided by higher layers. Not necessarily valid in some cases, e.g. QPSK with no spatial multiplexing and without multi-user MIMO transmission mode. The parameter is corresponding to the PDSCH data sourced from Msg2.
item.name: paForMSG2

item.desc: For each UE, the ratio of PDSCH EPRE to cell-specific RS EPRE among PDSCH REs in all the OFDM symbols not containing cell-specific RS is equal and is denoted by Rho_A.The UE may assume that for 16 QAM or 64 QAM or spatial multiplexing with more than one layer or for PDSCH transmissions associated with the multi-user MIMO transmission scheme Rho_A is equal to Delta_power_offset + P_A + 10log10(2) [dB] when the UE receives a PDSCH data transmission using precoding for transmit diversity with 4 cell-specific antenna ports, and Rho_A is equal to Delta_power_offset + P_A [dB] otherwise, where Delta_power_offset is 0 dB for all PDSCH transmission schemes except multi-user MIMO and P_A is a parameter provided by higher layers. Not necessarily valid in some cases, e.g. QPSK with no spatial multiplexing and without multi-user MIMO transmission mode. The parameter is corresponding to the PDSCH data sourced from DCCH logical channel and its assignment is through CCCH logical channel.
item.name: paForDCCH

item.desc: For each UE, the ratio of PDSCH EPRE to cell-specific RS EPRE among PDSCH REs in all the OFDM symbols not containing cell-specific RS is equal and is denoted by Rho_A.The UE may assume that for 16 QAM or 64 QAM or spatial multiplexing with more than one layer or for PDSCH transmissions associated with the multi-user MIMO transmission scheme Rho_A is equal to Delta_power_offset + P_A + 10log10(2) [dB] when the UE receives a PDSCH data transmission using precoding for transmit diversity with 4 cell-specific antenna ports, and Rho_A is equal to Delta_power_offset + P_A [dB] otherwise, where Delta_power_offset is 0 dB for all PDSCH transmission schemes except multi-user MIMO and P_A is a parameter provided by higher layers. Not necessarily valid in some cases, e.g. QPSK with no spatial multiplexing and without multi-user MIMO transmission mode. The parameter is corresponding to the PDSCH data sourced from DCCH logical channel and its assignment is through CCCH logical channel.
item.name: paForDTCH

item.desc: Switch of PDSCH power control, increase PDSCH transmit power by increasing PA when MCS less than 9.
item.name: pdschCLPCSwchDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the power offset of the PCFICH to the DTCH_PA. It is used to determine the transmit power of the PCFICH.
item.name: pcfichPwrOfst

item.desc: This parameter sets the power offset of the PHICH to the DTCH_PA. It is used to determine the transmit power of the PHICH.
item.name: phichPwrOfst

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of four elements. The first to fourth elements represent the offsets of the transmit power of the PDCCH DCI0 to the value of the paForDTCH (Power Offset Between PDSCH and Cell RS (P_A_DTCH)) parameter when the CCE aggregation levels are 1, 2, 4, and 8 separately. This parameter is used to adjust the transmit power of the PDCCH DCI0.
item.name: pdcchF0PwrOfst

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of four elements. The first to fourth elements represent the offsets of the transmit power of the PDCCH DCI1 to the value of the paForDTCH (Power Offset Between PDSCH and Cell RS (P_A_DTCH)) parameter when the CCE aggregation levels are 1, 2, 4, and 8 separately. This parameter is used to adjust the transmit power of the PDCCH DCI1.
item.name: pdcchF1PwrOfst

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of four elements. The first to fourth elements represent the offsets of the transmit power of the PDCCH DCI1A to the value of the paForDTCH (Power Offset Between PDSCH and Cell RS (P_A_DTCH)) parameter when the CCE aggregation levels are 1, 2, 4, and 8 separately. This parameter is used to adjust the transmit power of the PDCCH DCI1A.
item.name: pdcchF1APwrOfst

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of four elements. The first to fourth elements represent the offsets of the transmit power of the PDCCH DCI1B to the value of the paForDTCH (Power Offset Between PDSCH and Cell RS (P_A_DTCH)) parameter when the CCE aggregation levels are 1, 2, 4, and 8 separately. This parameter is used to adjust the transmit power of the PDCCH DCI1B.
item.name: pdcchF1BPwrOfst

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of four elements. The first to fourth elements represent the offsets of the transmit power of the PDCCH DCI1C to the value of the paForDTCH (Power Offset Between PDSCH and Cell RS (P_A_DTCH)) parameter when the CCE aggregation levels are 1, 2, 4, and 8 separately. This parameter is used to adjust the transmit power of the PDCCH DCI1C.
item.name: pdcchF1CPwrOfst

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of four elements. The first to fourth elements represent the offsets of the transmit power of the PDCCH DCI1D to the value of the paForDTCH (Power Offset Between PDSCH and Cell RS (P_A_DTCH)) parameter when the CCE aggregation levels are 1, 2, 4, and 8 separately. This parameter is used to adjust the transmit power of the PDCCH DCI1D.
item.name: pdcchF1DPwrOfst

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of four elements. The first to fourth elements represent the offsets of the transmit power of the PDCCH DCI2 to the value of the paForDTCH (Power Offset Between PDSCH and Cell RS (P_A_DTCH)) parameter when the CCE aggregation levels are 1, 2, 4, and 8 separately. This parameter is used to adjust the transmit power of the PDCCH DCI2.
item.name: pdcchF2PwrOfst

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of four elements. The first to fourth elements represent the offsets of the transmit power of the PDCCH DCI2A to the value of the paForDTCH (Power Offset Between PDSCH and Cell RS (P_A_DTCH)) parameter when the CCE aggregation levels are 1, 2, 4, and 8 separately. This parameter is used to adjust the transmit power of the PDCCH DCI2A.
item.name: pdcchF2APwrOfst

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of four elements. The first to fourth elements represent the offsets of the transmit power of the PDCCH DCI3 to the value of the paForDTCH (Power Offset Between PDSCH and Cell RS (P_A_DTCH)) parameter when the CCE aggregation levels are 1, 2, 4, and 8 separately. This parameter is used to adjust the transmit power of the PDCCH DCI3.
item.name: pdcchF3PwrOfst

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of four elements. The first to fourth elements represent the offsets of the transmit power of the PDCCH DCI3A to the value of the paForDTCH (Power Offset Between PDSCH and Cell RS (P_A_DTCH)) parameter when the CCE aggregation levels are 1, 2, 4, and 8 separately. This parameter is used to adjust the transmit power of the PDCCH DCI3A.
item.name: pdcchF3APwrOfst

item.desc: This parameter sets the ratio of the Energy Per Resource Elements (EPREs) of the CSI-RS to those of the CRS. It is used to adjust the offset of CSI-RS power to CRS power.
item.name: csiRSPwrOfst

item.desc: The parameter is the switch of downlink power control function.When this switch is on, it is possible to process downlink power control.
item.name: pwrCtlSwchDl

item.desc: The parameter is the average cell RB ratio threshold in one TTI.When cell RB ratio in one schedling TTI exceed this threshold, it is possible to process downlink power control.
item.name: cellRBRatioThr4PwrCtrl

item.desc: The parameter is the RB ratio threshold for Ues satisfying power adjustment conditions in one TTI.When RB ratio in one schedling TTI exceed this threshold, it is possible to process downlink power control for these UEs.
item.name: rbRatioThr4PwrCtrl

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of seven elements. The first element to the seventh element of the array parameter represent the MCS index thresholds for downlink power reduction of the UEs that are configured with the altCQITable parameter and whose scheduling ranks range from 2 to 8 separately. Downlink power adjustment is possible only when the smaller of two MCS indexes of a UE is larger than or equal to the threshold.
item.name: qamMcsThr4PwrCtrl

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of seven elements. The first element to the seventh element of the array parameter represent the MCS index thresholds for downlink power reduction of the UEs that are not configured with the altCQITable parameter and whose scheduling ranks range from 2 to 8 separately. Downlink power adjustment is possible only when the smaller of two MCS indexes of a UE is larger than or equal to the threshold.
item.name: mcsThres4PwrCtrl

item.desc: The parameter is the power adjustment value for TM9 in one TTI.When a scheduling UE satisfy all the qulificaitons for downlink power control, then this UE's transmit power will be adjusted according to this parameter.
item.name: adjustPwr4PwrCtrl

item.desc: This parameter controls downlink CRS power adaption. If downlink CRS power adaption is enabled, CRS power is processed based on the parameter value. 0: Close1: CrsPwrAdpt2: LteCrsPunch3: NrCrsPunch4: LteNrCrsPunch5: LteCrsPunchAndCrsPwrAdpt.
item.name: crsPwrCtlSwch

item.desc: The parameter is the cell RB ratio threshold in one TTI.When cell RB ratio in one schedling TTI below this threshold, it is possible to process CRS power adaptive function.
item.name: rbRatioThr4CrsCtrl

item.desc: The parameter is the number of RRC UE in one TTI.When the number of RRC UE in one schedling TTI below this threshold, it is possible to process CRS power adaptive function.
item.name: uenumThr4CrsCtrl

item.desc: The parameter is one of the CRS power adjustment value in one TTI.
item.name: adjustPwr4CrsCtrl1

item.desc: The parameter is one of the CRS power adjustment value in one TTI.
item.name: adjustPwr4CrsCtrl2

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of downlink PDSCH adaptive power adjustment function.'0'stands for no PDSCH adaptive power adjustment,'1'stands for QPSK UE adaptive power adjustment function is turned on, '2' stands for BF UE adaptive power adjustment function is turned on,'3'stands for functions of '1'and '2'referring to are both truned on .
item.name: pdschPwrAdjustSwthDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the assignment type of downlink PDSCH shared power. If it is set to 0, shared power is equally assigned. If it is set to 1, shared power is assigned by QoS priority.
item.name: sharePwrAssignTypeDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum power adjustment value for the UEs who satisfy the power adjustment conditions.
item.name: maxPowerAdjustValue

item.desc: The parameter is the power adjustment value for TM3 in one TTI.When a scheduling UE satisfy all the qulificaitons for downlink power control, then this UE's transmit power will be adjusted according to this parameter.
item.name: adjustPwr4TM3PwrCtrl

item.desc: This parameter is the power water-injection switch. If the switch is turned on, when BF gain control is disabled, if real SINR of the MU-UE is larger than the SINR corresponding to the maximum MCS, decrease the power, and the adjustment value is equal to the difference between the two; otherwise, increase the power. If the switch is turned off, do not implement power water-injection, and power adjustment is not affected.
item.name: pwrWaterFillSwchDL

item.desc: This parameter is applied in enabling the lean carrier and determines the DRX state. It indicates that the DRX state is activated during ucPostOnDurat4CrsCtrl TTIs after the onduration timer expires.
item.name: postOnDurat4CrsCtrl

item.desc: This parameter is applied in enabling the lean carrier and determines the DRX state. It indicates that the DRX state is activated during ucPreOnDurat4CrsCtrl TTIs before the onduration timer is started.
item.name: preOnDurat4CrsCtrl

item.desc: This parameter sets the PDSCH power adjustment mode. If it is set to 0, PDSCH power adjustment is disabled. If it is set to 1, power is adjusted based on the residual RBs of the current cell. If it is set to 2 power is adjusted based on the shared power obtained from other carriers. If there is no shared power, power is not adjusted. If it is set to 3, both values 1 and 2 apply.
item.name: pdschPwrAdjustMode

item.desc: This parameter determines the UEs that can share PDSCH power. If it is set to 0, the power of the QPSK users based on CRS demodulation is dynamically adjusted. If it is set to 1, the power of BF users is dynamically adjusted. If it is set to 2, the power of both the QPSK users based on CRS demodulation and the BF users is dynamically adjusted.
item.name: pdschPwrAdjustUEType

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink power offset for interference coordination between public and private networks in a high-speed railway scenario. It is used to control the decrease of the downlink reference signal power of the neighbor cells in the public network. If it is set to 0, the downlink reference signal power of the neighbor cells in the public network is not decreased. If it is set to a non-zero value, the downlink reference signal power of the neighbor cells in the public network needs to be decreased by N dB. (The value N is the value of this parameter. ) In this way, the interference between public and private networks can be coordinated.
item.name: iCoDLPowerOffset

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the EMF function. It is used for the eNodeB to check whether the transmit power of the monitored cell meets the EMF specifications and to take further measures.
item.name: emfFunctionSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the reference value of Equivalent Isotropically Radiated Power (EIRP) backoff. The parameter value plus the offset of the EIRP backoff value to the reference value of the EIRP backoff threshold of each beam equals the EIRP backoff value of the corresponding beam. The average radiated power of the corresponding beam in terms of time is controlled to be not higher than the power obtained after the backoff of the maximum radiated power in its direction.
item.name: pwrBackOffThrRef

item.desc: This parameter sets the average window length in the time domain for EMF detection or monitoring and EMF control, that is, the time interval for EMF power control.
item.name: emfCtrlWindow

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold type of EMF power. If this parameter is set to EIRP, it indicates that the threshold of Equivalent Isotropic Radiated Power (EIRP) type is used. The EMF function controls the maximum average EIRP by using this threshold. If this parameter is set to powerBackOff, it indicates that the threshold of power backoff type is used. The threshold of EIRP type is the maximum EIRP minus this parameter value. The EMF function controls the maximum average EIRP by using this EIRP threshold.
item.name: emfThrType

item.desc: This parameter sets the reference value of the Equivalent Isotropically Radiated Power (EIRP) threshold. The parameter value plus the offset of the EIRP threshold to the reference value of the EIRP threshold of each beam equals the EIRP threshold of the corresponding beam. The average radiated power of the corresponding beam in terms of time is controlled to be not higher than the EIRP threshold.
item.name: eirpThrRef

item.desc: This parameter sets the length of the EMF slide window. It is used to calculate the average power of the beams in a time window.
item.name: emfSlidingWindow

item.desc: This parameter sets the offsets of the Equivalent Isotropically Radiated Power (EIRP) backoff value threshold of each beam to the reference EIRP backoff value threshold. This parameter is an array consisting of twenty-four elements that indicate the offsets of the EIRP backoff value threshold for beam 1 through beam 24 in turn. The EIRP backoff value threshold for beam 1 through beam 24 is the sum of the corresponding element value of this array parameter and the value specified by the pwrBackOffThrRef (Reference Value of the EIRP Backoff Threshold) parameter.
item.name: pwrBackOffThrOffset

item.desc: This parameter sets the offsets of the Equivalent Isotropically Radiated Power (EIRP) threshold of each beam to the reference EIRP threshold. This parameter is an array consisting of twenty-four elements that indicate the offsets of the EIRP threshold for beam 1 through beam 24 in turn. The EIRP value threshold for beam 1 through beam 24 is the sum of the corresponding element value of this array parameter and the value specified by the pwrBackOffThrRef (Offset of the EIRP Threshold of Each Beam to the Reference EIRP Threshold) parameter. The average radiated power of beam 1 through beam 24 in terms of time cannot be higher than the EIRP threshold of beam 1 through beam 24.
item.name: eirpThrOffset

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables downlink dynamic power overload protection for service channels. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB protects RRU power from exceeding the maximum value during downlink service channel scheduling. If it is set to Close, the eNodeB does not protect the RRUs from overload during downlink service channel scheduling.
item.name: dynamicPowerSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to perform power optimization for UEs with poor general QoS channel quality. It is used to increase the downlink channel power of UEs with poor channel quality and improve downlink channel demodulation performance and user experience. For the UEs with poor general QoS channel quality, if this parameter is set to Open, the downlink channel power is increased; if this parameter is set to Close, the downlink channel power is not increased.
item.name: dlPwrOptSwch4GenQoS

item.desc: This parameter is an exclusive EMF customization parameter and used to control the EMF policy of a specific operator.
item.name: operatorDefined

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable LTE-NR power sharing, and controls whether the current LTE cell supports LTE-NR power sharing. The current LTE cell and the NR cell can share power resources only if this parameter is set to Open.
item.name: dynPwrShareAbilitySwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to reduce the power of resource elements on the PDCCH. If this parameter is set to Open, the interference from LTE to NR in DSS scenarios is reduced, thereby improving the spectrum efficiency on the NR side.
item.name: pdcchReMutingSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables downlink coverage enhancement of TMM cells. If it is set to 1 (Open), the CRS power increases, enhancing the downlink coverage of TMM cells.
item.name: tMMCRSBoostingSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum increase of CRS power in downlink coverage enhancement of TMM cells. If downlink coverage enhancement of TMM cells is enabled (the ucTMMCRSBoostingSwch (TMM DL Coverage Enhancement Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open)), the CRS power increase is not larger than this parameter value.
item.name: tMMCRSMaxBoostingValue

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable downlink power sharing in TMM scenarios. If this parameter is set to Open, the eNodeB allocates the remaining power of a cell to TM8 and TM9 UEs for downlink transmission, improving the beamforming performance.
item.name: tMMPowerBoostingSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the CRS power reduction policy bitmap of the LTE cells in the time domain. It indicates the locations of CRS power reduction of the LTE cells in the time domain in dynamic spectrum sharing scenarios. It consists of 24 elements that correspond to subframes 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, and 8 of four consecutive frames. Each element can be set to 0 or 1. If an element is set to 0, it indicates that the CRS power of the corresponding subframe is not reduced. If an element is set to 1, it indicates that the CRS power of the corresponding subframe is reduced.
item.name: crsMutingTimeBitmap

item.desc: This parameter sets a CRS power reduction policy for the LTE cells in the frequency domain in dynamic spectrum sharing scenarios. If it is set to 0 (Guaranteed_LTE), it indicates that the spectrum efficiency of the LTE cells is preferentially guaranteed. If it is set to 1 (Guaranteed_NR), it indicates that the spectrum efficiency of the NR cells is preferentially guaranteed.
item.name: crsMutingFreqPolicy

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable CRS power reduction for the RBs that cannot be allocated to the PDSCH. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), for the RBs whose rbForbiddenBitMapDL is 1, the CRS power of the PDSCH can be reduced to decrease the interference to neighbor cells. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), for the RBs whose rbForbiddenBitMapDL is 1, the CRS power of the PDSCH remains unchanged.
item.name: dlForbidRbCrsPunchSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables power sharing in a high-speed railway scenario. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the two RRUs that jointly provide baseband resources can share power. During power sharing, the downlink radio performance of the cell can be improved.
item.name: hstPwrShareSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold proportion of the number of RRC-connected UEs if power sharing is enabled in high-speed railway scenarios. It is one of the conditions for determining whether the power of CPs can be shared. This parameter is valid if the hstPwrShareSwch (Power Sharing in High-Speed Railway Scenarios) parameter is set to 1 (Open). When a high-speed train enters a cell, the power of a CP can be shared if the proportion of the number of RRC-connected UEs on the CP to the total number of RRC-connected UEs in the cell is larger than the parameter value.
item.name: hstPwrShareUeThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of low-speed UEs if power sharing is enabled in high-speed railway scenarios. It is one of the conditions for determining whether the power of cells can be shared. This parameter is valid if the hstPwrShareSwch (Power Sharing in High-Speed Railway Scenarios) parameter is set to 1 (Open). When a high-speed train enters a cell, the power of the cell can be shared if the number of low-speed UEs in the cell is smaller than the parameter value.
item.name: hstPwrShrLowSpdUeThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink SNR offset for power sharing in high-speed railway scenarios. It is used to adjust the downlink SNR of UEs and takes effect when the hstPwrShareSwch (Power Sharing in High-Speed Railway Scenarios) parameter is set to 1 (Open). When high-speed trains enter or leave a cell, the eNodeB adjusts the downlink SNRs of the UEs based on this parameter value to increase the average uplink MCS value of the cell.
item.name: hstPwrShrDlAmcOffset

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables adaptive allocation of downlink power for the UEs at the edge of a cell. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), RBs and MCS indexes are re-allocated to the UEs at the edge of a UE without changing the total power of the cell to improve the TB size, downlink rates of the edge UEs, and user experience of the edge UEs.
item.name: dlPwrAdaptSwch4EdgeUE

item.desc: This parameter sets the MCS index threshold for adaptive downlink power allocation for the UEs at the edge of a cell. It is used to determine whether a UE is an edge UE. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. The first and second elements represent the MCS index thresholds in 64QAM and 56QAM scenarios respectively. In a 64QAM or 256QAM scenario, a UE is considered to be an edge UE if the dlPwrAdaptSwch4EdgeUE (Switch for Adaptive Downlink Power Allocation for Edge UEs) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the MCS index of the UE is smaller than or equal to the corresponding element value of this array parameter.
item.name: dlMcsThr4EdgeUE

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum increase of MCS indexes in adaptive downlink power allocation for the UEs at the edge of a cell. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. The first and second elements represent the maximum increase of MCS indexes in 64QAM and 256QAM scenarios respectively. During adaptive power adjustment in 64QAM or 256QAM scenarios, if the dlPwrAdaptSwch4EdgeUE (Switch for Adaptive Downlink Power Allocation for Edge UEs) parameter is set to 1 (Open), the increase of the MCS indexes cannot exceed the corresponding element value of this array parameter.
item.name: dlMcsAdjThr4EdgeUE

item.desc: This parameter sets the SINR adjustment factor for the UEs at the edge of a cell. It is used to calculate the power adjustment amount for MCS index increase of the edge UEs. It is valid if the dlPwrAdaptSwch4EdgeUE (Switch for Adaptive Downlink Power Allocation for Edge UEs) parameter is set to 1 (Open).
item.name: sINRAdjFactor4EdgeUE

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum muting proportion of LTE cells in DSS scenarios. If LTE CRS muting is enabled, this parameter sets the proportion of muting RBs in subframes 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, or 8 to the LTE bandwidth. A larger parameter value indicates a larger downlink LTE performance loss and greater improvement in downlink NR performance. A smaller parameter value indicates a smaller downlink LTE performance loss and smaller improvement in downlink NR performance.
item.name: dssMutingRbRatio

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables muting optimization in DSS scenarios. In the scenarios where both DSS and LTE CRS muting are enabled, this parameter is used to determine whether resources in subframes 0, 4, 5, or 9 are reserved for NR cells. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), LTE resources in subframes 0, 4, 5, or 9 are reserved for NR cells. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), LTE resources in subframes 0, 4, 5, or 9 are not reserved for NR cells.
item.name: dssMutingOptiSwit

item.desc: This parameter sets the resource mapping indicator of MSG2 messages on the PDCCH. It indicates the CCE aggregation level of the MSG2 messages and the power of the PDCCH. The demodulation performance of the MSG2 DCI can be improved through the increase of the CCE aggregation level of the MSG2 messages and the power of the PDCCH.
item.name: msg2PDCCHIdx

item.desc: This parameter sets the adjustment value of the PDSCH power for sending MSG2 messages. If this parameter is set to a large value, the demodulation success rate of MSG2 messages on the PDSCH can be increased.
item.name: msg2AdjustPwr

item.desc: This parameter sets the low threshold of the PRB usage for downlink coverage enhancement of a cell. It is used to determine whether to perform CRS power boosting on the six RBs in middle positions. If the sSCGCRSBoostingSwch (DL Coverage Enhancement Switch) or tMMCRSBoostingSwch (TMM DL Coverage Enhancement Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the PRB usage of a cell is lower than the parameter value, CRS power boosting is performed on the six RBs in middle positions.
item.name: pRBLowThrd4CRSBoost

item.desc: This parameter sets the high threshold of the PRB usage for downlink coverage enhancement of a cell. It is used to determine whether downlink coverage enhancement can be enabled for the cell. If the sSCGCRSBoostingSwch (DL Coverage Enhancement Switch) or tMMCRSBoostingSwch (TMM DL Coverage Enhancement Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the PRB usage of a cell is higher than the parameter value, downlink coverage enhancement takes effect, that is, the CRS power of the cell cannot increase.
item.name: pRBHighThrd4CRSBoost

item.desc: This parameter sets the compensation coefficients for conservative scheduling of PDCCH inner-loop control in the case of CQI drop. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. Element 0 sets the compensation coefficient of ordinary data services and element 1 sets that of VoLTE services.
item.name: pdcchSagCompensCoef

item.desc: This parameter sets the PDCCH inner-loop AMC CQI expiration timers. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. Element 0 and element 1 respectively set the expiration timer for the ordinary data service and VoLTE service respectively. The corresponding timer is started when the CQI is reported. When the timer expires, conservative scheduling is performed over the control channel for the corresponding UE.
item.name: cQIExpiredTimer4Pdcch

item.desc: This parameter sets the CQI threshold for using conservative power in handover scheduling. If the CQI value of a UE is smaller than the threshold, the PDCCH power and the PDSCH power increase during handover scheduling.
item.name: cqiThr4HoPwrAdj

item.desc: This parameter sets the power adjustment value for handover scheduling. It is used to adjust the power of the PDCCH and PDSCH during handover scheduling.
item.name: hoMsgPowerDelta

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables scheduling optimization in the case of inner-loop control failures of the PDCCH. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), resources are conservatively scheduled on the PDCCH in the case of failures or sudden changes of CQIs, improving the demodulation performance of the PDCCH.
item.name: pdcchFailureOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables power overload protection optimization for the PDSCH. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB protects RRU power from exceeding the power specified by the availableSectorPower (Available sector power) parameter during PDSCH scheduling. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB does not protect the RRUs from overload during PDSCH scheduling.
item.name: ltePdschPwrProtSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables uplink E-CID positioning for eMTC UEs. If it is set to Open, the cell supports uplink E-CID positioning for eMTC UEs. If it is set to Close, the cell does not support uplink E-CID positioning for eMTC UEs.
item.name: eMTCUpLinkEcidPosiSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the positioning mode of uplink E-CID positioning to meet the positioning requirements in different scenarios and ensure successful execution of positioning tasks. If uplink E-CID positioning is enabled and this parameter is set to 0 (Mode0), the eNodeB determines whether the UE capability supports the time difference between information sending and receiving. If not, the positioning tasks fail. If this parameter is set to 1 (Mode1), the eNodeB delivers the tasks for measuring the time difference between information sending and receiving without determining whether the UE capability supports the time difference between information sending and receiving. If this parameter is set to 2 (Mode2), the eNodeB delivers only the RSRP and RSRQ measurement tasks without delivering the tasks for measuring the time difference between information sending and receiving.
item.name: upLinkEcidPosiMode

If the RLC data buffer length is larger than or equal to this threshold, it is considered that data congestion occurs. This parameter is used as one of the conditions for SCell activation.

If the RLC data buffering delay is longer than or equal to this threshold, it is considered that data congestion occurs. This parameter is used as one of the conditions for SCell activation.

item.desc: The Downlink Total PRB Ratio Threshold of SCell for DeActive SCell is one reason of scell deactive, it is valid when CA is configured.
item.name: scellPRBRatioDeActThrDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the MCS threshold for SCell deactivation in CA scenarios. When CA is enabled and this threshold is configured, an SCell is deactivated if the MCS value of the SCell is smaller than this threshold.
item.name: mcs4SCellDeActiveDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the data size in CA scheduling. It is used for the CA function as one of the SCC deactivation conditions. It is configured when the CA function is enabled, and when the data size in CA scheduling is smaller than the configured threshold, the SCC is deactivated.
item.name: caSchdSizeDeActThrDl

item.desc: This parameter is used to open ca scell remove base on CQI function.

If closed, do not carry.When this function conflict with SPID or CLB, using SPID or CLB reselection priorities.
item.name: caReselFreqPrioSwch

item.name: prbThrd4GetLBInfo

item.name: caMeasIDSwch

item.desc: When the switch is opened, the frequency priority higher Scell will be selection and configuration.
item.name: scellSelBaseFreqPriSwch

item.name: caCrossBbuMaxRBNum

item.desc: This parameter is indicate Load Typer condition for selecting scells.
