item.desc: Buffer length threshold for CA UE, when RLC data length is less than this threshold,it is considered not congestioned, and as a condition of Scell deactive.
item.name: scellDeActBufLenThd

item.desc: The Switch of Multiple Timing Advance Function
item.name: mulTASwch

item.desc: If this parameter is set to Open, the eNB configures CA for the UE by selecting the CA combination with the maximum number of uplink CCs from the CA combination with the maximum downlink CCs.
item.name: caULCCSelSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the UL PRB utilization threshold of the SCell configuration. When the The Switch of Scell Based on UpLink PRB(scellSelBaseUlPRBSwch) parameter is enabled, this parameter should be considered. If the UL PRB utilization of a neighbor cell is larger than the threshold, the neighbor cell should not be configured as an SCell. If the UL PRB utilization of a neighbor cell is smaller than or equal to the threshold, the neighbor cell can be configured as an SCell.
item.name: sCellPRBThrdUl

item.desc: When the UL PRB utilization of the PCell is higher than the threshold, the eNB needs to get PRB utilization information of neighbor cells through the X2 interface.
item.name: prbThrd4GetLBInfoUl

item.desc: This parameter sets how to identify a CA UE. If the parameter is set to Base on UE Capability, the system determines whether a UE is a CA UE in accordance with the UE capability. If the parameter is set to Base on SCell Configuration, the system determines whether a UE is a CA UE in accordance with the SCell configuration.
item.name: caUeIdentifyMethod

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of the load balancing function. The load balancing function can increase the probability of a UE participating in SDMA in a collaborative cell. If the switch is turned on, the load balancing function is enabled. If the switch is turned off, the load balancing function is disabled.
item.name: caLoadBalanceSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the SCC beamforming switch. If the switch is turned on, the UEs having no SRS resources and not supporting uplink CA in SCell will be made flow. If the switch is turned off, no flow will be made.
item.name: multiCarrierBFSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the index of the PCell frequency group of the current cell. If it is set to 0, the configuration of the PCell frequency priority is invalid for the current cell. If it is not equal to 0, the cell uses the frequency priority corresponding to the value of the Index of the PCell Frequency Priority Group parameter as the PCell frequency priority.
item.name: pcellFreqPriGrpIndex4Cell

item.desc: Primary carrier frequency priority switch for CA. When the switch is opened, if frequency priority of neighbouring cell is higher, handover first and then add scell.
item.name: pcellFeqPriSwch

item.desc: This parameter is Switch for CA Enhance PCell Anchoring. When the switch is opened, eNB activate CA Enhance PCell Anchoring.
item.name: caEnPccAnchorSwch

item.desc: This parameter is the switch of the CA SPID feature customized by the operator. It is used to enable or disable the CA SPID feature of the eNB customized by the operator in accordance with the actual requirements.
item.name: cASPIDSwch

item.desc: On the premise that the CA SPID feature customized by the operator is enabled, this parameter sets whether to use the default frequency configuration (namely CAFreqList, which is manually configured at the back end). This parameter is configured as required.
item.name: cADefatFreListSwchUl

item.desc: This parameter indicates the default CA SCell profile group index associated with the operator's customized SPIDs.
item.name: refCAProfileListLTE

item.desc: If the proportion of the number of users of the PCell is higher than the threshold, the eNB needs to get the information about the proportion of the number of users of neighbor cells through the X2 interface; otherwise, there is no need to do so.
item.name: uENumThrd4PCCSelGetLBInfo

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the proportion of the number of UEs selected by the PCell. If the proportion of the number of UEs in a neighbor cell is larger than the threshold, UEs cannot perform handover to the neighbor cell by the CA Enhance Anchoring function. If the proportion of the number of UEs in a neighbor cell is smaller than or equal to the threshold, UEs can perform handover to the neighbor cell by the CA Enhance Anchoring function.
item.name: pcellSelUENumRatioThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the DL PRB utilization threshold for PCell selection. If the DL PRB utilization of a neighbor cell is larger than the threshold, UEs cannot perform handover to the neighbor cell by the CA Enhance Anchoring function. If the DL PRB utilization of a neighbor cell is smaller than or equal to the threshold, UEs can perform handover to the neighbor cell by the CA Enhance Anchoring function.
item.name: pcellSelPRBThrdDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the UL PRB utilization threshold for PCell selection. If the UL PRB utilization of a neighbor cell is larger than the threshold, UEs cannot perform handover to the neighbor cell by the CA Enhance Anchoring function. If the UL PRB utilization of a neighbor cell is smaller than or equal to the threshold, UEs can perform handover to the neighbor cell by the CA Enhance Anchoring function.
item.name: pcellSelPRBThrdUl

item.desc: If the UL PRB utilization of the PCell is higher than the threshold, the eNB needs to get PRB utilization information of neighbor cells through the X2 interface; otherwise, there is no need to do so.
item.name: pRBThrd4PCCSelGetLBInfoUl

item.desc: If the PRB utilization of the PCell is higher than the threshold, the eNB needs to get PRB utilization information of neighbor cells through the X2 interface; otherwise, there is no need to do so.
item.name: pRBThrd4PCCSelGetLBInfo

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables service separation between the PCell and SCells. If this parameter is set to Open for a cell, more non-voice downlink data services can be carried by the SCells when the BSRs of the PCell and SCells are allocated for the UEs whose PCell is the cell, thus making full use of the bandwidth of the SCells and saving the bandwidth of the PCell.
item.name: dataSplitSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables CA BSR distribution optimization. CA BSR distribution optimization is an innovation for CA, including user perception enhancement and small-packet scheduling optimization.
item.name: bSROptimizationSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the absolute RSRQ threshold for target neighbor cell decision in the case of event A5 reporting in CA handover scenarios. During handover decision, the system determines whether to hand over the UE to the target cell by comparing the RSRQ of the target cell with this parameter value.
item.name: pCCHOTarCellRsrqThr

item.desc: If this parameter is set to Open, UEs can be handed over to the target SCells that meet both the RSRP and RSRQ thresholds.
item.name: sCCAddBasedRSRPandRSRQSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the absolute RSRQ threshold for target neighbor cell decision in the case of event A4/A6 reporting in CA scenarios. During SCell addition/replacement decision, the system determines whether to add this neighbor cell as an SCell by comparing the RSRQ of the target cell with this parameter value.
item.name: sCCAddTarCellRsrqThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute RSRQ threshold for the SCell decision in the case of event A6 measurement reporting in CA scenarios. During SCell replacement decision, the system determines whether to replace the SCell by comparing the RSRQ of the SCell with this parameter value.
item.name: sCellRsrqThr

item.desc: If this parameter is set to Open, the target cell for CA handover can be only the neighbor cells that meet both the RSRP and RSRQ thresholds.
item.name: cAHOBasedRSRPandRSRQSwch

item.desc: This parameter indicates the factor for data bearers in CA scenarios. The PCC obtains the final data bearer traffic after multiplying by the factor.
item.name: caPccDateBearfactorDl

item.desc: This parameter indicates the TM mode indication for CA MIMO calculation. If it is set to TM9/10, the eNodeB selects the CA band combination only based on the MIMO layer of TM9/10. If it is set to TM3/4, the eNodeB selects the CA band combination only based on the MIMO layer of TM3/4.
item.name: cAMIMOCalTMModInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the ratio threshold of the downlink PRB utilization selected by the PCell for the serving cell. If the ratio of the downlink PRB utilization in the serving cell is smaller than this threshold, PCell anchoring cannot be enabled; that is, CA UEs are not handed over to the neighbor cells with a higher frequency priority.
item.name: pcellSelServCellDLPRBThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the ratio threshold of the uplink PRB utilization selected by the PCell for the serving cell. If the ratio of the uplink PRB utilization in the serving cell is smaller than this threshold, PCell anchoring cannot be enabled; that is, CA UEs are not handed over to the neighbor cells with a higher frequency priority.
item.name: pcellSelServCellULPRBThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the ratio threshold of the number of UEs that are selected by the PCell for the serving cell. If the ratio of the number of users in the serving cell is smaller than this threshold, PCell anchoring cannot be enabled; that is, CA UEs are not handed over to the neighbor cells with a higher frequency priority.
item.name: pcellSelServCellNumRatioThrd

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to filter unavailable neighbor cells with no load. If it is set to Open, PCell anchoring filters the neighbor cells with no load. If it is set to Close, PCell anchoring does not filter the neighbor cells with no load.
item.name: noLBInfoNBRCellNASwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the deletion of measurements A4 for SCell addition in the case of no coverage. If it is set to Open, the measurement A4 for SCell addition for the fixed terminals is deleted when the corresponding timer expires to avoid the enabling of GAP measurement caused by CA inter-frequency measurement.
item.name: caNoCovDelMeaSwitch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables fast SCC addition based on intra-band. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB can add multiple SCCs at a time when the measurement for event A4 or A6 is reported.
item.name: sccFastAdBaseItaBndSwch

item.desc: If this parameter value is set to Open, the MLP priority of the SCell of CA UEs is reduced to the minimum value. Only in this case, there is a chance for the SCell to be schedule when there are remaining resources in the cell where the SCell is located.
item.name: sccLowMlpSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables UE-level AMBR limiting for CA terminals. If it is set to Open, the uplink and downlink rates of all the CA UEs are limited when the PCell triggers AMBR limiting, and only the uplink and downlink rates of the SCells are limited when the SCells trigger AMBR limiting. If it is set to Close, only the uplink and downlink rates of the SCells are limited when the SCells trigger AMBR limiting.
item.name: caUeAmbrLimitSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables CA forbidding based on the AMBR. If it is set to Open, SCells can be configured only for the UEs with the suitable AMBR. If it is set to Close, the CA configuration for UEs is independent of the AMBR.
item.name: cAForbidBasedAMBRSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink AMBR threshold for CA forbidding. If the downlink AMBR of a UE is less than or equal to this threshold, the UE cannot be configured with CA.
item.name: cAForbidDLAMBRThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink AMBR threshold for CA forbidding. If the uplink AMBR of a UE is less than or equal to this threshold, the UE cannot be configured with CA.
item.name: cAForbidULAMBRThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR) threshold based on spectrum coordination. If the SINR of the primary carrier is lower than the threshold, the SINR of the secondary carrier is higher than the threshold, and the SINR delta between the primary and secondary carriers is larger than a certain difference, the channel quality of the secondary carrier is considered to be better than that of the primary carrier.
item.name: sINRThr4SpecCoordUL

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the uplink channel quality deference between the primary carrier and the secondary carrier. If the uplink channel quality deference between the primary carrier and the secondary carrier is larger than this threshold, the channel quality of the secondary carrier is considered to be better than that of the primary carrier.
item.name: deltaSINRThr4SpecCoord

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables CA Spectrum Coordination. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB hands over UEs to the SCells with better UL channel quality.
item.name: caSpecCoordSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to consider the RSRQ of target cells during the handover of CA UEs. If CA UEs fail to be handed over due to poor RSRQ although the RSRP of the target cell meets the handover condition, this parameter is set to Open to guarantee handover performance.
item.name: caUeHOTarCellRsrqSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to consider the RSRQ of target cells during the handover of CA UEs between the PCell and an SCell. In a CA scenario, during the handover between the PCell and an SCell or the handover to a cell whose frequency is the same as the SCell, if CA UEs fail to be handed over due to poor RSRQ although the RSRP of the target cell meets the handover condition, this parameter is set to Open to guarantee handover performance.
item.name: caPccHOSccTarCellRsrqSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the measurement related to CA PCell anchor or CA PCell handover. When sending an EN-DC handover measurement report in an EN-DC scenario, the eNodeB starts the timer. If the EN-DC handover measurement report is not received when the timer expires, this parameter is set to Open to recover the handover measurement related to CA PCell anchor and CA PCell anchor enhancement.
item.name: caPccHOMeasRecoverSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables PCell anchoring based on the number of carriers. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB preferentially selects the frequency that supports the maximum number of carriers based on the band combination supported by the UE capability when selecting the target frequency for PCell frequency priority handover for UEs.
item.name: pccFeqPriSwchBaseCCNum

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to configure SCells for new UEs in a cell. If this parameter is set to Open and the number of UEs in a cell is larger than the specific threshold, no SCell is configured for new UEs in the cell.
item.name: caUeRstrSccCfgUsrNumSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether frequencies are selected in PCell anchoring based on the band combination supported by UE capability. If this parameter is set to Open, the band combination supported by UE capability is considered during frequency selection. If this parameter is set to Close, the band combination supported by UE capability is not considered during frequency selection.
item.name: optimizePccFeqPriSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to configure coordination in PCell anchoring. If it is set to Close, the coordination configuration is not considered in neighbor cell selection. If it is set to Open, the coordination configuration must be considered.
item.name: pccFeqPriJudgCACoordSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the band combination selection strategy for PCell anchoring. If it is set to Bandwidth, the high-bandwidth combination is considered. If it is set to Available PRB Num, the combination with more available PRBs is considered.
item.name: pccFeqPriPRBFactorStgy

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion of downlink subframes in a TDD cell in PCell anchoring. It is recommended that the parameter value be the same as the proportion of downlink subframes corresponding to the current subframe proportion of the TDD cell.
item.name: pccFeqPriTDDDlLossFactor

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the number of UEs to be configured with SCells. If the number of UEs is larger than this threshold, no SCell is configured for new UEs.
item.name: caUeRstrSccCfgUsrNumThrd

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to enable the handover based on optimal CA band combinations. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB searches for the cell where the optimal frequency band combinations for the CA UE belongs and hands over the UE. If it is set to Close, the handover based on the optimal frequency band combinations is not performed.
item.name: caOptBandCombHoSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the reference factor for the eNodeB to search for the optimal frequency band combinations for CA UEs. If it is set to CCNum, the frequency band combination with the largest number of CCs is considered to be the optimal frequency band combination. If it is set to DlBandwidth, the frequency band combination with the largest downlink aggregation bandwidth is considered to be the optimal frequency band combination.
item.name: caOptBandCombHoFactor

item.desc: This parameter determines whether eNodeB de-configures secondary carriers for CA UEs when the VoLTE service takes effect. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB de-configures secondary carriers for CA UEs when the VoLTE service is provided for the UEs. When the VoLTE service is completed, the eNodeB restores the secondary carriers through measurement. If this parameter is set to Close, the eNodeB does not de-configure secondary carriers for CA UEs.
item.name: delCa4VoLTESwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the eNodeB supports the CA with an extended band. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB supports the CA with an extended band. If it is set to Close, the CA with an extended band is not supported.
item.name: extBandCaSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether in-band continuous 2-carrier uplink CA of Band41 based on the SPID. If it is set to Open, the UEs identified based on the SPID can be configured with in-band continuous 2-carrier uplink CA of Band41, while other UEs cannot be configured with in-band continuous 2-carrier uplink CA of Band41. If this parameter is set to Close, all the UEs can be configured with in-band continuous 2-carrier uplink CA of Band41.
item.name: spidSupportUl41cSwch

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting 128 elements and each element corresponds to a SPID. If the SPID of a UE is in this array, the eNodeB can configure contiguous in-band uplink 2CC CA in Band41 for the UE, so that the uplink traffic of the UE increases. This parameter is valid when the SpidSupportUl41cSwch parameter is set to 1 (Open).
item.name: spidSupportUl41c

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of a timer for adding a SCell based on CA UE monitoring. If the Switch of CA UE Monitor parameter is set to Enhanced, this parameter sets the minimum interval between two consecutive attempts of an eNodeB to add a SCell based on the monitored UE status. If the Switch of CA UE Monitor parameter is set to Enhanced, after the eNodeB adds a SCell based on the monitored UE status, the eNodeB starts this timer. The eNodeB cannot add a SCell until the timer expires.
item.name: cAMoniSCellAddIntervTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of a timer for deleting a SCell based on CA UE monitoring. If the Switch of CA UE Monitor parameter is set to Enhanced, this parameter sets the minimum interval between an addition and deletion of a SCell by the eNodeB based on the monitored UE status. If the Switch of CA UE Monitor parameter is set to Enhanced, after the eNodeB adds a SCell based on the monitored UE status, the eNodeB starts this timer. The eNodeB cannot delete a SCell until the timer expires.
item.name: cAMoniSCellRelIntervTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of SCell deactivation duration for deleting a SCell based on CA UE monitoring. If the Switch of CA UE Monitor parameter is set to Enhanced, based on the monitored UE status, the eNodeB can delete only the SCells whose deactivation duration is longer than the parameter value.
item.name: cAMoniSCCRelDeactTimeThr

item.desc: This parameter indicates the directional preference in services for CA UEs. Based on the monitoring results, if a CA UE has requirements for both uplink and downlink services, this parameter can be used for the eNodeB to configure the service directional preference for the UE. This parameter is valid only if the Switch of CA UE Monitor parameter is set to Enhanced.
item.name: cASerDirInd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables CA SCell reconfiguration based on the dominated-service direction. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), CA SCell reconfiguration based on the dominated-service direction does not take effect. If it is set to 1 (UL CA configure base Blind), uplink SCells can be configured only through blind addition when the dominated-service direction of UEs changes to uplink. If this parameter is set to 2 (UL CA configure base Blind and Measurement), uplink SCells can be configured through blind addition or measurement-based addition when the dominated-service direction of UEs changes to uplink. If this parameter is set to 3 (UL CA configure base Perception), uplink SCells with the best user perception can be configured based on the estimated user perception of uplink services when the dominated-service direction of UEs changes to uplink. If this parameter is not set to 0 (Close), the GlobalSwitch. CaMonitorSwch (Switch of CA UE Monitor) parameter must be set to 0 (Close).
item.name: caReCfgBaseServDir

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable the optimization of PUCCH resource allocation through the TPC command for CA UEs in a cell. If this parameter is set to Open, for the case that PUCCH resources are limited in CA scenarios, the PCell not only sends BSRs to the SCell, but also allocates PUCCH resources through the TPC command.
item.name: caPucchTpcAllocOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of subframes that can be consecutively allocated through the TPC command for the PUCCH. It is an array parameter consisting of three elements. This parameter takes effect only if the ucCaPucchTpcAllocOptSwch (CA PUCCH TPC Allocation Optimization) parameter is set to 1 (Open). In the case that PUCCH resources are limited in CA scenarios, the maximum number of subframes that can be allocated to CA UEs in a scenario where the cell load is low, medium, and high corresponds to the first, second, and third element of the parameter respectively.
item.name: contiAllcPucchTpcSfn

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables multi-PLMN CA to control whether the PCell and SCells can be configured to different PLMNs. If it is set to Close, the PCell and SCells must be in the same PLMN. If it is set to Open, the PCell and SCells can be in different PLMNs.
item.name: multiPlmnCASwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the optimization of SCell activation/deactivation in uplink CA. For the uplink CA UEs at middle points or far points, the uplink scheduling traffic of a single carrier may be higher than that of multiple carriers. This function further optimizes single-carrier or multi-carrier scheduling benefits for uplink CA UEs by using an optimized activation/deactivation policy.
item.name: ulCaActDeactOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the period for optimizing the SCell deactivation decision procedure in uplink CA. For uplink CA UEs at middle points or far points, the uplink scheduling traffic of a single carrier may be higher than that of multiple carriers. In this case, to make the uplink CA UEs for which SCells are activated fall back to the single-carrier scheduling procedure, this parameter can be adjusted to allow the deactivation decision procedure to be started sooner. A larger parameter value indicates a longer period to enter the deactivation decision procedure in uplink CA. This parameter takes effect only when the ucUlCaActDeactOptSwch (Switch for Optimizing SCell Activation/Deactivation in UL CA) parameter is set to 1 (Open).
item.name: ulCaDeactJudgPeriodOpt

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the TB size of PCell scheduling for SCell activation in uplink CA. It is one of the SCell activation decision conditions in uplink CA. For the uplink CA UEs at middle points or far points, the uplink scheduling traffic of a single carrier may be higher than that of multiple carriers. In this case, to ensure single-carrier scheduling for the UEs, you can adjust this threshold to make it difficult to activate SCells for UEs or prevent SCells from being activated again soon after being deactivated. If the periodically measured average TB size of PCell scheduling is larger than or equal to the threshold, the activation condition is satisfied. This parameter takes effect only when the ucUlCaActDeactOptSwch (Switch for Optimizing SCell Activation/Deactivation in UL CA) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the UE has large packets that must be transmitted preferentially.
item.name: ulCaPccTbsThr4Act

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the TB size of PCell scheduling for SCell deactivation in uplink CA. It is one of the SCell deactivation decision conditions in uplink CA. For the uplink CA UEs at middle points or far points, the uplink scheduling traffic of a single carrier may be higher than that of multiple carriers. In this case, to ensure single-carrier scheduling for the UEs, you can adjust this threshold to deactivate the SCells of the UEs sooner in uplink CA. If the periodically measured average TB size of PCell scheduling is smaller than the threshold, the deactivation condition is satisfied. This parameter takes effect only when the ucUlCaActDeactOptSwch (Switch for Optimizing SCell Activation/Deactivation in UL CA) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the UE has large packets that must be transmitted preferentially.
item.name: ulCaPccTbsThr4Deact

item.desc: This parameter sets the method for controlling and allocating the uplink power of the PCell and SCells of uplink CA UEs. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB dynamically controls and allocates the uplink power of the PCell and SCells of uplink CA UEs. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB controls and allocates the uplink power of the PCell and SCells of uplink CA UEs by using the maximum carrier-level power reported by the CA UEs.
item.name: ulCaPwrAllocOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the adjustment margin of the SINR threshold of a single RB for SCell deactivation in uplink CA. For the uplink CA UEs at middle points or far points, the uplink scheduling traffic of a single carrier may be higher than that of multiple carriers. In this case, to ensure single-carrier scheduling for the UEs, you can modify this adjustment margin to deactivate the SCells of the UEs sooner in uplink CA. If the SINR of a single RB of the PCell is smaller than the sum of the threshold adjustment margin and the SINR threshold of a single RB for SCell activation in uplink CA, one of the SCell deactivation conditions is met. This parameter takes effect only when the ucUlCaActDeactOptSwch (Switch for Optimizing SCell Activation/Deactivation in UL CA) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the UE has large packets that must be transmitted preferentially.
item.name: ulCaDeactSinrThrDelta

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables blind SCell addition in CA scenarios. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB can blindly add a cell that meets either of the following conditions as an SCell for a UE even though no channel quality information about the cell can be obtained: (1) The cell has the same coverage as the serving cell. (2) The cell has an inclusion relationship with the serving cell. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB adds only the cells whose channel quality meets certain conditions as SCells for UEs.
item.name: caSCellBlindAddSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the local cell can act as only a downlink SCell for CA. If it is set to 1 (Open), this cell can act as only a downlink SCell of the UEs of other cells. In this case, no UE can access this cell and the UEs in other cells cannot be handed over to this cell.
item.name: dLSCellOnlySwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable optimization of the BSR configured for a CA UE with uplink pre-scheduling. In the case that this parameter is set to 1 (Open), if CA UEs with uplink pre-scheduling are configured with virtual BSRs, the system considers the BSR distribution to UEs in the PCell and SCells in adjusting the virtual BSRs configured for the UEs, so that the preset virtual BSRs are not too small and the expectation for pre-scheduling can be met.
item.name: uLCAPreSchdOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to optimize CCE resource guarantee. If it is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB reserves some CCE resources for common scheduling in CA scenarios with non-ideal delays or in downlink CoMP scenarios.
item.name: cCERsvSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to preferentially perform CA capability enquiry of the target cell for handover. It is used to control the priority of CA capability enquiry of the target cell and that of the handover with SCells to the target cell. If the caScellHOSwch (Switch of CA User Handover With Scell) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and this parameter is set to 1 (Open), to perform CA capability enquiry of the target cell for handover, the handover with SCells is not performed so that CA capability enquiry of the target cell for handover can be performed preferentially. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the handover with SCells is performed no matter whether CA capability enquiry of the target cell for handover needs to be performed.
item.name: hodEnqCaCapPriSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the CQI proportion threshold for CQI-based SCell addition prohibition. If the proportion of the CQIs in the current cell is larger than the threshold, no SCell can be added for the UEs in the current cell. If the proportion of the CQIs in the current cell is smaller than or equal to the threshold, SCells can be added for the UEs in the current cell without regard to the CQI-based SCell addition prohibition policy. If this parameter is set to 100, SCells can be added for the UEs in the current cell without regard to the CQI-based SCell addition prohibition policy.
item.name: sCellAddCQIRatioThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the CQI proportion difference threshold for CQI-based SCell addition rollback. If the proportion of the CQIs in the current cell is larger than the sum of the threshold and the value of the sCellAddCQIRatioThrd (CQI Proportion Threshold for SCell Addition Prohibition) parameter, all the SCells of some UEs selected from the current cell are deleted. If the proportion of the CQIs in the current cell is smaller than or equal to the sum of the threshold and the value of the sCellAddCQIRatioThrd parameter, SCells cannot be deleted from the UEs in the current cell without regard to the CQI-based SCell addition rollback policy.
item.name: sCellDelCQIRatioDiffThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to allow uplink SCells to support uplink CoMP. If it is set to 1 (Open), uplink SCells in CA scenarios support uplink CoMP and demodulation can be coordinated among neighbor cells, improving the uplink demodulation capability of the far-point UEs on SCells.
item.name: sccULCoMPSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether a UE can be forcibly involved in uplink or downlink CoMP after being handed over. (1) If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), UEs cannot be forcibly involved in uplink or downlink CoMP after being handed over. (2) If this parameter is set to 1 (Forcibly Enter DLCoMP), UEs can be forcibly involved in downlink CoMP after being handed over. (3) If this parameter is set to 2 (Forcibly Enter ULCoMP), UEs can be forcibly involved in uplink CoMP after being handed over. (4) If this parameter is set to 3 (Forcibly Enter ULDLCoMP), UEs can be forcibly involved in uplink or downlink CoMP after being handed over.
item.name: forceDlUlCoMPSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables uplink CoMP capability improvement optimization. It sets whether to initiate uplink CoMP requests based on the number of UEs scheduled in the uplink. The parameter values are as follows:(1) If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the optimization is disabled. (2) If this parameter is set to 1 (ULCoMP Promoted Gear 1), the optimization is enabled. In this case, if more than four UEs are scheduled in the uplink, no uplink CoMP request is initiated. (3) If this parameter is set to 2 (ULCoMP Promoted Gear 2), the optimization is enabled. In this case, if more than eight UEs are scheduled in the uplink, no uplink CoMP request is initiated. (4) If this parameter is set to 3 (ULCoMP Promoted Gear 3), the optimization is enabled. In this case, if more than twelve UEs are scheduled in the uplink, no uplink CoMP request is initiated.
item.name: coMPUlProGear

item.desc: This parameter sets the optimization mode of ULCoMP Joint Reception (JR). If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), ULCoMP JR optimization is disabled. If this parameter is set to 1 (Maximum 130RB for Separate Demodulation), it indicates that UEs are demodulated one by one and a maximum of 130 RBs can be demodulated. If this parameter is set to 2 (Maximum 150RB for Separate Demodulation), it indicates that UEs are demodulated one by one and a maximum of 150 RBs can be demodulated.
item.name: uLCoMPCopModeOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay for VoLTE UEs. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), an inter-eNodeB uplink CoMP relation is configured, and ULCoMP with a non-ideal delay is enabled, VoLTE UEs can support inter-eNodeB uplink CoMP with a non-ideal delay.
item.name: voLTENideaDlyCoMPSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of HARQ failures for deactivating an uplink SCell of a CA UE. When the consecutive number of times that HARQ failures occur on an uplink SCell of a CA UE exceeds this threshold, the uplink SCell is deactivated.
item.name: sCellULHarqFailCntThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of times that the BLER is abnormal for deactivating uplink SCells of CA UEs. When the consecutive number of times that the BLER of an uplink SCell of a CA UE is abnormal exceeds this threshold, the uplink SCell is deactivated.
item.name: sCellHighBLERCntThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the window length for SCell activation attempt. For a CA UE whose uplink SCell is deactivated due to a HARQ failure, the uplink SCell can be activated again at least after the interval specified by this parameter.
item.name: sCellDecWindow

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink CA strategies for UEs with uplink services. It is an array parameter consisting of 16 elements. Element 0 enables or disables the SCell addition strategy based on uplink frequency priorities. If element 0 is set to 1, it indicates that the eNodeB preferentially selects the cells on the frequencies with higher priorities as the uplink SCells for the UEs with uplink services during the configuration of uplink CA for the UEs. If element 0 is set to 0, it indicates that the addition of uplink SCells is independent of the frequency priorities. Element 1 enables or disables the SCell addition strategy based on uplink load. If element 1 is set to 1, it indicates that the eNodeB preferentially selects the cells with more uplink available RB resources as the uplink SCells for the UEs with uplink services during the configuration of uplink CA for the UEs. If element 1 is set to 0, it indicates that the eNodeB preferentially selects the cells with larger bandwidths as the uplink SCells for the UEs with uplink services during the configuration of uplink CA for the UEs. The remaining array elements are reserved.
item.name: ulCACfgstgy

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of measurement retries for adding an optimal uplink SCell for a UE with uplink services in a CA scenario based on perception estimation. When the number of measurement retries reaches this parameter value, the eNodeB stops adding optimal uplink SCells for a UE based on perception estimation. If this parameter is set to 65535, it indicates that the number of retries is not restricted.
item.name: scellAddRetryNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the relative threshold for the eNodeB to reconfigure uplink SCells for UEs in uplink CA scenarios. When the eNodeB selects optimal uplink SCells for a UE, it can configure a new uplink SCell combination for the UE only when all the following conditions are met: (1) The UE has been configured with an uplink SCell combination. (2) The evaluated uplink perception of the configured uplink SCell combination of the UE is X. (3) The evaluated uplink perception of the new uplink SCell combination is Y. (4) The values of X and Y meet the following condition: Y greater than X x (1 + N/100) (N represents the parameter value).
item.name: scellChgRelThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets CA configuration enhancement strategies. It is an array parameter consisting of 16 elements. Element 0 sets whether the eNodeB disallows to change the uplink SCells during measurement collection based on perception estimation when the eNodeB configures uplink CA parameters based on the perception estimation results. If element 0 is set to 1, it indicates that the eNodeB does not change the uplink SCells for a UE during measurement collection based on perception estimation when the eNodeB configures uplink CA parameters based on the perception estimation result in the case that the UE has been configured with uplink SCells. If element 0 is set to 0, it indicates that the eNodeB allows to configure the cell with the largest bandwidth as an uplink SCell for a UE during measurement collection based on perception estimation when the eNodeB configures uplink CA parameters based on the perception estimation result in the case that the UE has been configured with uplink SCells. Element 1 sets whether to delete the added SCells from a UE when the service direction of the UE changes from uplink to downlink and the eNodeB reconfigures downlink CA for the UE based on the service guarantee priority. If element 1 is set to 1, it indicates that the added SCells are not deleted. If element 1 is set to 0, it indicates that the added SCells are deleted. Element 2 sets whether the eNodeB attempts to add the cells reported in the A5 measurement result of a UE with downlink services as the SCells of the UE during a perception estimation-based measurement when the eNodeB adds SCells based on perception estimation for the UE. If element 2 is set to 1, the eNodeB always attempts to add a reported cell as an SCell for the UE during A5 measurement reporting. If element 2 is set to 0 and the UE is not configured with CA, the eNodeB attempts to add a reported cell as an SCell for the UE during A5 measurement reporting. If the UE is configured with CA, the eNodeB does not attempt to add a reported cell as an SCell for the UE during A5 measurement reporting. The remaining array elements are reserved.
item.name: cACfgEnhanstgy

item.desc: This parameter sets the scale factors of BSR distribution for each carrier in downlink CA scenarios. It is an array parameter consisting of five elements. Elements 0 through 4 respectively set the scale factors of BSRs distributed to the five carriers corresponding to serving cell index 0 through serving cell index 4. The carrier corresponding to serving cell index 0 is the PCell, and the four carriers corresponding to serving cell index 1 through serving cell index 4 are SCells.
item.name: dLCABsrDisRtoFactor

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold proportion of BSRs to be distributed in downlink CA scenarios. During BSR distribution, if the proportion of BSRs that need to be distributed to a carrier is larger than or equal to the threshold, the eNodeB distributes BSRs to the carrier.
item.name: dLCABsrSplitRatioThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold (in bytes) of the data volume for BSR distribution in downlink CA scenarios. If the total data as indicated in the BSRs of all logical channels of a CA UE is greater than or equal to this threshold, the eNodeB distributes the BSRs to each carrier.
item.name: dLCABsrSplitThr

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable the function of perception-based downlink SCell selection. If this parameter is set to Open, the base station configures the carriers used for CA for a UE based on perception if the SCell direction of the UE is set to the downlink direction. If this parameter is set to Close, the function does not take effect.
item.name: percEstDLSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the string type and can be configured as planned.

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the string type and can be configured as planned.
item.name: moId

item.desc: Indicates the RSRP threshold (in dBm) used by the UE for traffic steering to WLAN. Parameter: ThreshServingOffloadWLAN, LowP in TS 36.304.
item.name: thrdRSRPL

item.desc: Indicates the RSRP threshold (in dBm) used by the UE for traffic steering to E-UTRAN. Parameter: ThreshServingOffloadWLAN, HighP in TS 36.304.
item.name: thrdRSRPH

item.desc: Indicates the WLAN channel utilization (BSS load) threshold used by the UE for traffic steering to WLAN. Parameter: ThreshChUtilWLAN, Low in TS 36.304 [4].
item.name: thrdChlUtilizationL

item.desc: Indicates the WLAN channel utilization (BSS load) threshold used by the UE for traffic steering to E-UTRAN. Parameter: ThreshChUtilWLAN, High in TS 36.304.
item.name: thrdChlUtilizationH

item.desc: Indicates the WLAN RSSI threshold used by the UE for traffic steering to E-UTRAN. Parameter: ThreshWLANRSSI, Low in TS 36.304. Value 0 corresponds to -128dBm, 1 corresponds to -127dBm and so on.
item.name: thdWLANRSSIL

item.desc: Indicates the WLAN RSSI threshold used by the UE for traffic steering to WLAN. Parameter: ThreshWLANRSSI, High in TS 36.304. Value 0 corresponds to -128dBm, 1 corresponds to -127dBm and so on.
item.name: thdWLANRSSIH

item.desc: Indicates the timer value during which the rules should be fulfilled before starting traffic steering between E-UTRAN and WLAN. Parameter: TsteeringWLAN in TS 36.304. Only applicable to RAN-assisted WLAN interworking based on access network selection and traffic steering rules.
item.name: trafficSteeringWLAN
