item.name: moId

item.desc: This parameter sets the PRB usage threshold for cell status change from low-load status to high-load status. The threshold is considered when the load of a cell changes from low load to high load. When the PRB usage is larger than the threshold, the cell load status changes from low-load status to high-load status. When the PRB usage is smaller than or equal to the threshold, the cell is in low-load status.
item.name: muPRBThrLowload2HighloadDL

item.desc: This parameter sets the PRB usage threshold for cell status change from high-load status to low-load status. The threshold is considered when the load of a cell changes from high load to low load. When the PRB usage is smaller than the threshold, the cell load status changes from high-load status to low-load status. When the PRB usage is larger than or equal to the threshold, the cell is in high-load status.
item.name: muPRBThrHighload2LowloadDL

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of potential MU-MIMO users when the cell status changes from low-load status to high-load status. The threshold is considered when the load of a cell changes from low load to high load. When the number of potential MU-MIMO users is larger than the threshold, the cell load status changes from low-load status to high-load status. When the number of potential MU-MIMO users is smaller than or equal to the threshold, the cell is in low-load status.
item.name: muUENumThrLowlo2HigloadDL

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of potential MU-MIMO users when the cell status changes from high-load status to low-load status. The threshold is considered when the load of a cell changes from high load to low load. When the number of potential MU-MIMO users is smaller than the threshold, the cell load status changes from high-load status to low-load status. When the number of potential MU-MIMO users is larger than or equal to the threshold, the cell is in high-load status.
item.name: muUENumThrHilo2LowloadDL

item.desc: This parameter sets the upper MCS threshold for TM3/TM8 switchover. If a UE is in TM3 mode, when the dual-stream MCS is higher than the threshold, the UE does not switch to TM8 mode.
item.name: muHighMCSDL

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables spectrum-efficiency algorithm-based downlink MU-MIMUO transmission mode switchover. If it is set to Open, the switchover (from TM8 to TM3 and from TM9 to TM4) is based on the spectrum efficiency comparison algorithm. If it is set to Close, the switchover (from TM8 to TM3 and from TM9 to TM4) is based on the MU pairing ratio algorithm.
item.name: muTMSESwitchDL

item.desc: This parameter indicates the threshold of the downlink MU-MIMO pairing ratio. It is used when the Switch for Transmission Mode Change Based on SE for DL MU-MIMO parameter is set to Close (disabled). If the MU pairing ratio is smaller than or equal to the threshold, the TM8-to-TM3 (TM9-to-TM4) switchover is triggered.
item.name: muPairThrRatioDL

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the number of RBGs of a UE for downlink MU-MIMO pairing. When the number of RBGs of a UE is smaller than the threshold, the UE does not perform MU pairing.
item.name: rbgNumThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the channel correlation factor of a UE for downlink MU-MIMO pairing. When the channel correlation factor is larger than the threshold, the UE does not perform MU pairing.
item.name: ortFactorMUmimoThr

item.desc: This parameter determines the algorithm for the switchover between TM3 and TM8. It is a TM8 MU-MIMO configuration parameter and can improve the UE pairing proportion and system traffic in an MU-MIMO scenario. If it is set to Open, the operator-customized algorithm is used for the switchover between TM3 and TM8; otherwise, the cell load-based algorithm is used for switchover between TM3 and TM8.
item.name: muTM38CustomAlgSwchDL

item.desc: This parameter sets the ID of a special QCI. If it is set to 0, it indicates that no special QCI is configured. If it is set to i (i greater than 0), it indicates that QCIi is configured as a special QCI.
item.name: muSpecialQCIIdentifyDL

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the whole-bandwidth SRS period for special QCIs configured. If the whole-bandwidth SRS period for a UE containing a special QCI is smaller than or equal to the threshold, the UE can perform MU-MIMO pairing. If the whole-bandwidth SRS period for a UE containing a special QCI is larger than the threshold, the UE does not perform MU-MIMO pairing.
item.name: muSRSPrdThrshforSpecQCIDL

item.desc: This parameter is the timer of punishment management for DL MU-MIMO. The larger the parameter value is, the longer the penalty time is, the longer the time during which the UE stays in TM3 mode is, and the more difficult it is for the UE to perform MU-MIMO.
item.name: muPunishmentTimerDl

item.desc: This parameter is the timer of scheduling times in punishment management for DL MU-MIMO. The larger the parameter value is, the larger the number of punishment scheduling times is, the longer the time during which the UE stays in TM3 mode is, and the more difficult it is for the UE to perform MU-MIMO.
item.name: muPunishmentScheCntDl

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the UEs in TM9 mode in the center of the cell participate in MU-MIMO pairing. If the switch is turned on, UEs with RI = 1 or 2 can participate in MU-MIMO pairing as primary users or secondary users, and UEs with RI = 3 or 4 can participate in MU-MIMO pairing as secondary users only. If the switch is turned off, only UEs with RI = 1 or 2 can participate in MU-MIMO pairing as primary users or secondary users, and UEs with RI = 3 or 4 do not participate in MU-MIMO pairing.
item.name: tm9MuSwchforCellCenterUE

item.desc: This parameter sets the MCS threshold for switchover from TM3 to TM9 in a high-load cell.
item.name: highLoadUpperMCSforTM39

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables TM38/TM39 synchronization switchover in MU-MIMO scenarios. If it is set to Open, the UEs that meet the switchover conditions are switched over synchronously, implementing the synchronization of the TM mode among the UEs, increasing the pairing probability, and improving MU-MIMO gains accordingly. Otherwise, the original TM38/TM39 MU-MIMO algorithm applies.
item.name: synSwch4MUMIMO

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables UE correlation-based sorting and scheduling in MU-MIMO scenarios. If it is set to Open, UEs are sorted and scheduled based on UE correlation.
item.name: corrSchSort4MUMIMOSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the TM38/TM39 synchronous switchover timer in MU-MIMO scenarios. When the timer expires, the synchronous switchover algorithm starts running.
item.name: synSwchTimer4MUMIMO

item.desc: Full Distinguished Name
item.name: FDN

item.desc: Date Time
item.name: DATETIME

item.desc: Collection period of measurement task.
item.name: granularityPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the string type and can be configured as planned.
item.name: id

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the string type and can be configured as planned.
item.name: moId

item.desc: This parameter sets ping-pong handover prevention strategies for different functional handovers to prevent the UEs that are functionally handed over to the target cell from being handed over back to the source cell too early due to coverage-based handovers.
item.name: funcHOPreventPingPongStgy

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the strategy of the prevention against the ping-pong effect between functional incoming handover and coverage-based outgoing handover. If it is set to 0 (Close), the ping-pong handover prevention strategy does not take effect when the eNodeB delivers coverage-based measurement information to UEs during functional incoming handover. If it is set to 1 (Open), the report configuration of the prePingPongHOMeasCfg index is used when the eNodeB delivers coverage-based measurement information to UEs during functional incoming handover.
item.name: funcCoverPrePingPongSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the QCI-based prevention against the ping-pong effect between functional handover and coverage-based handover. It is an array parameter consisting of 255 elements, indicating whether to enable ping-pong handover prevention based on QCI1 to QCI255 in turn. If an element is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB can enable the ping-pong handover prevention strategy for the corresponding QCI service. If an element is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB disables the ping-pong handover prevention strategy for the corresponding QCI service. The eNodeB can enable the QCI-based prevention against the ping-pong effect between functional handover and coverage-based handover for a UE only if all the QCI services of the UE are set to 1 (Open).
item.name: perQCIPrePingPongEffSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the ping-pong handover prevention frequency range for the UEs in functional incoming handover, 0 for Prevent PingPong for Source Frequency, 1 for Prevent PingPong for Source Band, and 2 for Prevent PingPong for Source System.
item.name: prePingPongFreqRange

item.desc: This array parameter sets the measurement configurations of coverage-based ping-pong handover prevention for the UEs in functional incoming handover. It consists of two elements. The first element corresponds to a set of intra-RAT measurement configuration items related to the RSRP and the second element corresponds to a set of intra-RAT measurement configuration items related to the RSRQ. If the dualMeasSwitch (Switch of Dual Measurement) parameter is set to 0 (Close), only the first element is valid.
item.name: prePingPongHOMeasCfg

item.desc: Full Distinguished Name
item.name: FDN

item.desc: Date Time
item.name: DATETIME

item.desc: Collection period of measurement task.
item.name: granularityPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: id

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: moId

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables PSCell addition punishment. When it is set to Open, the eNodeB cannot add the target NR cell as a PSCell within the time specified by this timer after receiving an X2 SgNB Addition Reject message.
item.name: pSCellAddPunishSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables EN-DC anchor IMMCI. This parameter enables or disables EN-DC anchor IMMCI. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB tries to let the UE supporting EN-DC camp on the anchor cell through the IMMCI when the UE is released.
item.name: endcAnchorImmciSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the handover with SNs. If it is set to Open, SNs can be configured during handover for the UEs that are handed over from an LTE or NR cell to the local cell.
item.name: endcHOwithSnSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables EN-DC capability-based handover. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB hands over the UEs to the frequencies that support the EN-DC capability.
item.name: hoBasedEndcCapSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables EN-DC anchor-based handover. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB hands over UEs to the neighbor cells that support EN-DC.
item.name: enDcAnchorHoSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the SN addition to different PLMNs. If it is set to Open, the LTE network allows an NR cell of the equivalent PLMN to be configured as the PSCell of UEs. If it is set to Close, the LTE network allows only the NR cell of the same serving PLMN to be configured as the PSCell of UEs.
item.name: interPlmnENDCSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the voice-based EN-DC restriction strategy. If it is set to No Restrict, the addition of SNs is not restricted for the voice services of UEs. If it is set to No Based PCell Channel Quality and the PCell channel quality is bad for the voice services of UEs, no SN can be added. If it is set to No SN, no SN is added for voice services of UEs.
item.name: enDcRestrictStrgBaseVoice

item.desc: This parameter sets identification indexes for EN-DC. An parameter value corresponds to an NR PDCP identification index. If the services of a UE satisfy the requirements corresponding to an index, the UE can be identified to support a certain function. For example, an SN can be added for the UE.
item.name: enDcIdentifyIndex

item.desc: This parameter sets the configuration mode of EN-DC SNs. If it is set to Unconditional, the eNodeB configures SNs for all the NSA UEs. If it is set to CongestionBased or TrafficSpeedBased, the eNodeB configures SNs only for the NSA UEs that need to be configured with SNs.
item.name: enDcSnConfigMod

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink SINR threshold for deleting SNs from EN-DC VoLTE UEs. In an EN-DC VoLTE scenario, if the SINR of the MN is lower than this threshold, the eNodeB deletes the SN from this VoLTE UE.
item.name: delSnSinrThr4Vt

item.desc: This parameter sets the period that is used to determine whether the eNodeB deletes an SN. At the end of the period, the eNodeB compares the SINR or the RTP packet loss rate with the corresponding threshold to determine whether the voice quality is poor. If yes, the eNodeB deletes the SN. If not, the eNodeB does not delete the SN.
item.name: period4DelSn

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to execute EN-DC anchor-based handover immediately for the incoming-handover target users. If it is set to Yes, the eNodeB executes EN-DC anchor-based handover handover immediately for the incoming-handover target users.
item.name: enDcAnchHoWhr4HOinScen

item.desc: This parameter controls the PSCell addition strategy. If it is set to measurement-based strategy, PSCell is added in a measurement-based manner; If it is set to blind and measurement-based strategy, PSCell is added in a blind and measurement-based manner;
item.name: pSCellAddStgyInd

item.desc: This parameter is the ratio of user number threshold for NR service scheduling priority adjustment, and determines whether to adjust the scheduling priority of the NR service together with the 'the ratio of user number hysteresis for NR service scheduling priority adjustment'.
item.name: nrSrvSchedulAdjUserThrd

item.desc: This parameter is the ratio of user number hysteresis for NR service scheduling priority adjustment, and determines whether to adjust the scheduling priority of the NR service together with the 'the ratio of user number threshold for NR service scheduling priority adjustment'.
item.name: nrSrvSchedulAdjUserHys

item.desc: This parameter is the downlink PRB ratio threshold for NR service scheduling priority adjustment, and determines whether to adjust the downlink scheduling priority of the NR service together with the 'the downlink PRB ratio hysteresis for NR service scheduling priority adjustment'.
item.name: nrSrvSchedulAdjPrbThrdDl

item.desc: This parameter is the uplink PRB ratio threshold for NR service scheduling priority adjustment, and determines whether to adjust the uplink scheduling priority of the NR service together with the 'the uplink PRB ratio hysteresis for NR service scheduling priority adjustment'.
item.name: nrSrvSchedulAdjPrbThrdUl

item.desc: This parameter is the downlink PRB ratio hysteresis for NR service scheduling priority adjustment, and determines whether to adjust the downlink scheduling priority of the NR service together with the 'the downlink PRB ratio threshold for NR service scheduling priority adjustment'.
item.name: nrSrvSchedulAdjPrbHysDl

item.desc: This parameter is the uplink PRB ratio hysteresis for NR service scheduling priority adjustment, and determines whether to adjust the uplink scheduling priority of the NR service together with the 'the uplink PRB ratio threshold for NR service scheduling priority adjustment'.
item.name: nrSrvSchedulAdjPrbHysUl

item.desc: This parameter indicates the strategy mode of the EN-DC Anchor Mobility Function. If this parameter is configured to Based Freq And Cel, the EN-DC Anchor Mobility Function choose Base Frequency and Cell strategic mode; otherwise, EN-DC Anchor Mobility Function choose Base Frequency strategic mode.
item.name: endcAnchorStgy

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the SPID function for EN-DC anchor-based IMMCI. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB attempts to reselect the SPID UEs to the neighbor cells that support EN-DC through the IMMCI function when the UEs are released.
item.name: enDcAnchorImmciSpidSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables SPID function for EN-DC anchor-based handover. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB hands over SPID UEs to the neighbor cells that support EN-DC.
item.name: enDcAnchorHoSpidSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to distribute downlink SCG split bearers of NSA UEs to the LTE system. If it is set to Open, the distribution of SCG split bearers to the LTE system is stopped when the cell load reaches a certain threshold. When the cell load is lower than the threshold, the distribution of SCG split bearers to the LTE system is recovered.
item.name: forbidFlowCtrlSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables load-based scheduling priority adjustment. If this parameter is set to Open and the Load-Based Scheduling Priority Adjustment Mode Selection parameter is used together, the experience of LTE users can be improved through the decrease of the scheduling priority of SCG split bearers for the NGBR services of NSA users when the PRB load of the LTE cell is high. The experience of NSA users can also be improved through the decrease of the scheduling priority of the NGBR services of LTE users. In this function, the NSA users refer to those that have the EN-DC capability and are allowed to use EN-DC when they are in the HRL. The LTE users refer to those that do not have the EN-DC capability or are not allowed to use EN-DC when they are in the HRL.
item.name: emlpAdjustBaseLoadSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the load-based scheduling priority adjustment mode. If it is set to 0, the experience of LTE users can be guaranteed through the decrease of the scheduling priority of SCG split bearers for the NGBR services of NSA users. If it is set to 1, the experience of NSA users can be guaranteed through the decrease of the scheduling priority of the NGBR services of LTE users.
item.name: emlpAdjustBaseLoadMode

item.desc: If the number of UEs in a cell is larger than this threshold and the PRB usage of the cell is higher than the value of the Threshold for PRB Usage to Trigger Load-Based Scheduling Priority Adjustment parameter, the scheduling priority of the NGBR services corresponding to LTE UEs is decreased, or the scheduling priority of the SCG split bearers for the NGBR services corresponding to NSA UEs is lowered, depending on the value of the Load-Based Scheduling Priority Adjustment Mode Selection parameter.
item.name: emlpAdjustBaseLoadRrcThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the number of RRC UEs for disabling downlink shunting stop. If the number of RRC UEs in a cell is larger than this threshold, downlink shunting stop is enabled; otherwise, downlink shunting stop is disabled.
item.name: stopFlowCtrlRrcNumThrd

item.desc: If the Load-Based Scheduling Priority Adjustment Mode Selection parameter is set to 0, this parameter is used to configure the level of scheduling priority decrease of SCG split bearers for NGBR services of NSA UEs after load-based scheduling priority adjustment is triggered. If the Load-Based Scheduling Priority Adjustment Mode Selection parameter is set to 1, this parameter is used to configure the level of scheduling priority decrease of NGBR services of LTE UEs after load-based scheduling priority adjustment is triggered.
item.name: emlpAdjustBaseLoadStep

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of split bearers for stopping/recovering shunting.
item.name: flowCtrlSelectErabNum

item.desc: This parameter controls the length of the load decision period.
item.name: flowCtrlJudgePeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the PRB load evaluation period for load-based scheduling priority adjustment. The average PRB usage within the evaluation period is used as the PRB load of a cell. Based on the evaluated PRB load, the policy for NGBR bearer scheduling priority adjustment can be determined.
item.name: emlpAdjustBaseLoadPeriod

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to execute EN-DC anchoring handover for a QCI service. The elements in the array correspond to QCI1 to QCI255 in turn. If an element is set to Yes, the eNodeB executes EN-DC anchoring handover for the corresponding QCI service.
item.name: qCILevelEndcAnchorHo

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of times that an NSA UE retries to execute EN-DC anchoring handover. If the NSA UE fails to be handed over to an anchor cell, the handover procedure can be triggered again based on this parameter value.
item.name: endcAnchorHoMaxRetryNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of times that an NSA UE retries to execute SN addition. If the NSA UE fails to trigger SN addition, the SN addition procedure can be triggered again based on this parameter value.
item.name: sNAddMaxRetryNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for EN-DC anchoring handover retry of NSA UEs. If an NSA UE fails to be handed over to an anchor cell, the handover procedure can be triggered again after the period of time specified by this parameter.
item.name: endcAnchorHoRetryTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for SN addition retry of NSA UEs. If an NSA UE fails to trigger SN addition, the SN addition procedure can be triggered again after the period of time specified by this parameter.
item.name: sNAddRetryTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the priority carried for 2G/3G/4G/5G systems in EN-DC anchoring IMMCI. From left to right, the array subscripts correspond to the NR, E-UTRAN, UTRAN FDD, GERAN, CDMA2000-HRPD, and CDMA2000-1XRTT systems in turn. A larger parameter value indicates a higher IMMCI priority of the corresponding system. The value 0 indicates that the system is not considered. Note: The 4G system priority specified by this parameter is used for non-anchor frequencies only.
item.name: endcAnchIMMCIRATPri

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the SN configuration strategy for the UEs of the specific SPID for EN-DC. If this parameter is set to Open, the eNodeB configures the NR neighbor cells on the specific frequency as the SNs for the UEs of the specific SPID.
item.name: snConfigSpidSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables EN-DC anchor-based handover to a high-priority anchor frequency. If it is set to Open, the NSA UEs in an anchor cell are handed over to a high-priority anchor frequency during an EN-DC anchor-based handover.
item.name: endcAnchToHighPrioSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables EN-DC anchor-based handover to a non-anchor frequency. If it is set to Open, the NSA UEs without any NR frequency available are handed over to a non-anchor frequency during an EN-DC anchor-based handover.
item.name: endcAnchToNonAnchHoSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables EN-DC anchor-based handover to a low-priority anchor frequency. If it is set to Open, the NSA UEs in an anchor cell are handed over to a low-priority anchor frequency during an EN-DC anchor-based handover.
item.name: endcAnchToLowPrioSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the working mode of EN-DC anchor-based handover. If this parameter is set to Handover Based LTE Anchor Coverage, the eNodeB hands over UEs from a non-anchor cell to an anchor neighbor cell that supports EN-DC anchor-based handover. If this parameter is set to Handover Based LTE Anchor and NR Coverage, the eNodeB hands over UEs from a non-anchor cell to an NR-covered anchor neighbor cell that supports EN-DC anchor-based handover.
item.name: endcAnchHoWorkMode

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the downlink load-based shunting disabling function and the load-based scheduling priority adjustment function are performed based on PLMNs. If it is set to Open, the policies are used based on PLMNs. In this case, the PLMN configuration in the Flow Control Based On Load table should be set to a valid value. If this parameter is set to Close, the policies are used without considering the PLMNs. In this case, the PLMN configuration in the Flow Control Based On Load table should be set to a invalid value.
item.name: shuntingOfPlmnSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether NR cell information is carried during an EN-DC anchor-based handover.
item.name: endcAnchHoCarNRCellSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the proportion of the downlink PRB usage of the local cell. It determines whether EN-DC anchor-based handover can be triggered. EN-DC anchor-based handover can be triggered only when the proportion of the downlink PRB usage of the local cell is larger than or equal to this threshold.
item.name: enDcAnchDLPRBThrd4Anch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the proportion of the uplink PRB usage of the local cell. It determines whether EN-DC anchor-based handover can be triggered. EN-DC anchor-based handover can be triggered only when the proportion of the uplink PRB usage of the local cell is larger than or equal to this threshold.
item.name: enDcAnchULPRBThrd4Anch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the proportion of the number of UEs in the local cell. It determines whether EN-DC anchor-based handover can be triggered. EN-DC anchor-based handover can be triggered only when the proportion of the number of UEs in the local cell is larger than or equal to this threshold.
item.name: enDcAnchCURatioThrd4Anch

item.desc: This parameter sets the method for evaluating voice quality. If it is set to 0, the voice quality is evaluated based on the SINR of a single uplink RB. If it is set to 1, the voice quality is evaluated based on the packet loss rate of the uplink and downlink RTPs.
item.name: voiceQualityMethod

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the randomization of the frequencies with the same priority for EN-DC-anchored IMMCI. If it is set to Open, the reselection priorities of the frequencies with the same priority are randomly allocated in the IMMCI delivered during frequency release by the UEs that support EN-DC.
item.name: endcAnchIMMCIFreqRamSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the frequency reselection sub-priorities for EN-DC-anchored IMMCI. If it is set to Open, the reselection sub-priorities of both the LTE and NR frequencies are allocated in the IMMCI delivered during frequency release by the UEs that support EN-DC.
item.name: endcAnchIMMCISubPrioSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the EN-DC anchor policy used for EN-DC-anchored IMMCI identification.
item.name: endcAnchorStgy4IMMCI

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the retry restriction policy of EN-DC anchor-based handover. If this parameter is set to Open, a UE does not retry EN-DC anchor-based handover if a handover preparation failure occurs during an EN-DC anchor-based handover of the UE.
item.name: endcAnchHORetryRstctSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for uplink RTP packet loss rate in SN deletion over a long period. The eNodeB calculates the uplink RTP packet loss rate at each reporting point during a call. If the uplink RTP packet loss rate is higher than or equal to this threshold, it is considered that the uplink call quality is poor.
item.name: delSnUlRtpThr4Call

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for uplink RTP packet loss rate in SN addition over a long period. The eNodeB calculates the uplink RTP packet loss rate at each reporting point during a call. If the uplink RTP packet loss rate is lower than this threshold, it is considered that the uplink call quality is good.
item.name: addSnUlRtpThr4Call

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for downlink RTP packet loss rate in SN deletion over a long period. The eNodeB calculates the downlink RTP packet loss rate on the air interface at each reporting point during a call. If the downlink RTP packet loss rate on the air interface is higher than or equal to this threshold, it is considered that the downlink call quality is poor.
item.name: delSnDlRtpThr4Call

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for downlink RTP packet loss rate in SN addition over a long period. The eNodeB calculates the downlink RTP packet loss rate on the air interface at each reporting point during a call. If the downlink RTP packet loss rate on the air interface is lower than this threshold, it is considered that the downlink call quality is good.
item.name: addSnDlRtpThr4Call

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for uplink RTP packet loss rate in SN deletion within a period. The eNodeB calculates the uplink RTP packet loss rate at each reporting point within a period. If the uplink RTP packet loss rate within a period is higher than or equal to this threshold, it is considered that the uplink quality is poor.
item.name: delSnUlRtpThr4Period

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for uplink RTP packet loss rate in SN addition within a period. The eNodeB calculates the uplink RTP packet loss rate at each reporting point within a period. If the uplink RTP packet loss rate within a period is lower than this threshold, it is considered that the uplink quality is good.
item.name: addSnUlRtpThr4Period

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for downlink RTP packet loss rate in SN deletion within a period. The eNodeB calculates the downlink RTP packet loss rate on the air interface at each reporting point within a period. If the downlink RTP packet loss rate on the air interface within a period is higher than or equal to this threshold, it is considered that the downlink quality is poor.
item.name: delSnDlRtpThr4Period

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for downlink RTP packet loss rate in SN addition within a period. The eNodeB calculates the downlink RTP packet loss rate on the air interface at each reporting point within a period. If the downlink RTP packet loss rate on the air interface within a period is lower than this threshold, it is considered that the downlink quality is good.
item.name: addSnDlRtpThr4Period

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of consecutive times that voice quality is good. When the number of consecutive times that voice quality is good reaches this threshold, it is considered that the voice quality is good.
item.name: num4BetterVoiceQuality

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of consecutive times that voice quality is poor. When the number of consecutive times that voice quality is poor reaches this threshold, it is considered that the voice quality is poor.
item.name: num4WorseVoiceQuality

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink SINR threshold for adding SNs for EN-DC VoLTE UEs. If the SINR of the primary connection is higher than this threshold, the SN of the VoLTE UE is added.
item.name: addSnSinrThr4Vt

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the rate-based threshold. If the enDcSnConfigMod (EN-DC SN Configuration Mode) parameter is set to 2 (TrafficSpeedBased) and this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the measurement event B1 is delivered unconditionally in the initial access, incoming handover, re-establishment, initial SCG setup, or SCG split scenarios; if this parameter is set to 1 (Open), SNs are added based on rates in any scenarios.
item.name: baseRateThresholdSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables SCG failure punishment. If it is set to Open, no SN can be added for a UE if the number of SCG failures of the UE reaches this threshold within a certain period of time.
item.name: sCGFailurePunishSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration for SCG failure detection. If the number of SCG failures of a UE reaches the specified threshold within the period specified by this parameter, no SN can be added for the UE.
item.name: sCGFailureDetectDuration

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of SCG failure detections. If the number of SCG failures of the UE reaches this threshold within the period specified by the detection timer, no SN can be added for a UE.
item.name: sCGFailureDetectTimes

item.desc: This parameter sets the punishment duration for SCG failures. If the number of SCG failures of a UE reaches this threshold within the period specified by the detection timer, the timer starts and no SN can be added for the UE before the timer times out. If this parameter is set to 65535, it indicates that no SN can be added for the UE even when the punishment conditions of SCG failures are satisfied.
item.name: sCGFailurePunishDuration

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of punishment periods for disabling load-based downlink shunting for ping-pong prevention.
item.name: flowCtlPunishPeriodNum

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables LTE AMC optimization in downlink discrete scheduling of split bearers. If it is set to Open, downlink discrete scheduling identification is enabled for split bearers and AMC optimization is enabled for discrete services. If it is set to Close, the identification and optimization functions are disabled.
item.name: dlDscSchAmcOptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for determining discrete scheduling. There are two types of scheduling: discrete scheduling and consecutive scheduling. Within a discrete scheduling detection period, if the number of times that scheduling occurs is less than this parameter value, the scheduling is considered as discrete scheduling.
item.name: dscSchThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for determining consecutive scheduling. There are two types of scheduling: discrete scheduling and consecutive scheduling. Within a discrete scheduling detection period, if the number of times that scheduling occurs is larger than this parameter value, the scheduling is considered as consecutive scheduling.
item.name: conSchThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the detection period for discrete scheduling. Within each detection period, the system counts the number of times that discrete scheduling occurs and determines whether the current scheduling is discrete scheduling by comparing this parameter value with the threshold number of times that discrete scheduling occurs.
item.name: dscSchDetPerd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the reselection from low-priority anchors to high-priority anchors for the EN-DC anchoring IMMCI function. If it is set to Open, after an NSA UE is released from the anchor frequency, the reselection priority in the anchoring IMMCI is determined based on the anchor priority of the serving frequency and that of different frequencies. If it is set to Close, after an NSA UE is released from the anchor frequency, the reselection priority of the serving frequency is set to the highest value and that of other anchor frequencies is sorted by anchor priority.
item.name: highPriAnchImmciSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the priority of the frequencies used for the EN-DC anchoring IMMCI function. When a UE with the EN-DC capacity is released, the dedicated frequency reselection priority in the IMMCI is set based on the frequency priority configured by this parameter and the priority of other different frequencies. A larger parameter value indicates a higher reselection priority of the corresponding frequency. If this parameter is set to 0, it is not necessary to allocate a dedicated reselection priority to the corresponding frequency.
item.name: anchImmciIntraFPri

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables EN-DC anchor-based handover based on UE capability in anchor cells. If EN-DC anchor-based handover is enabled and this parameter is set to Open, the eNodeB triggers EN-DC anchor-based handover for an NSA UE even if the UE capability indicates that the current serving frequency and the configured NR frequency do not support EN-DC. In the selection of target frequencies, the EN-DC capability of the configured NR frequencies needs to be configured.
item.name: endcAnchHoBaseUECapSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the policy for blind adding SNs. If it is set to Blind SN Addition After Handover, the blind addition procedure is triggered for all the NSA UEs after the handover procedure. If it is set to Blind SN Addition in accordance with the measurement code stream during the handover process and the NR measurement results are carried at the source handover side, SNs can be added during the handover; otherwise, SNs cannot be added.
item.name: hOwithSnStgyInBlindScene

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the joint decision for SN addition in an EN-DC scenario. It is an array parameter with three elements. The array elements 1, 2, and 3 represent the joint-decision policies for the measurement events with the trigger quantity being RSRP, RSRQ, and SINR respectively. If an array element is set to Close, it indicates that the joint-decision policy is not enabled for the measurement events of the corresponding trigger quantity. If an array element is set to RSRP and RSRQ Joint Judgement, it indicates that the RSRP+RSRQ joint-decision policy is enabled for the measurement events of the corresponding trigger quantity. If an array element is set to RSRP and SINR Joint Judgement, it indicates that the RSRP+SINR joint-decision policy is enabled for the measurement events of the corresponding trigger quantity.
item.name: endcJointJudgeSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the partition mode of the AMBR of EN-DC UEs. If it is set to No Partition Mode, the UE AMBR at both the MN and SN sides is configured to the original value of the core network. If it is set to Static Partition mode, the UE AMBR is allocated to the MN and the SN based on a static proportion.
item.name: ambrSegmentMode

item.desc: This parameter sets the static partition proportion of the uplink UE AMBR. For EN-DC UEs, this parameter is set to Static Partition mode to calculate the uplink AMBR of the MN side.
item.name: ulAmbrStaticSegmentRatio

item.desc: This parameter sets the static partition proportion of the downlink UE AMBR. For EN-DC UEs, this parameter is set to Static Partition mode to calculate the downlink AMBR of the MN side.
item.name: dlAmbrStaticSegmentRatio

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables EN-DC anchor-based IMMCI related to NR frequency configuration. If it is set to Open, the EN-DC capability of both the target frequency and the configured NR frequency is considered in EN-DC anchor-based IMMCI.
item.name: enDcAnchBasedNRFreqSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables ping-pong prevention for EN-DC anchor-based handover. If it is set to Open, EN-DC anchor-based handover to non-anchor cells or other anchor cells is not triggered again for the UEs that are connected to an anchor cell through incoming EN-DC anchor-based handover.
item.name: anchHoPingPongSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables SN deletion based on uplink channel quality in an EN-DC scenario. If it is set to Open and the uplink SINR value of the LTE cell is smaller than the SINR Threshold on the LTE Side for Poor UL Channel Quality Decision in an EN-DC Scenario parameter configured on the EMS, the eNodeB deletes the SN of the UE. If it is set to Close, the uplink SINR value of the LTE cell is not used for SN deletion.
item.name: enDcSNDelBaseUlSinrSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for SN deletion penalty based on uplink or downlink channel quality. It is used to avoid frequent SN deletion and addition caused by poor uplink or downlink channel quality. When an SN is deleted from the eNodeB due to poor uplink or downlink channel quality of a UE, this timer is started. Before the timer expires, no SN can be added for the UE.
item.name: enDcSnPunishTimerBaseQual

item.desc: This parameter sets the SINR threshold for determining the uplink channel quality of PCells in an EN-DC scenario. It is used for poor channel quality decision on SN deletion based on uplink channel quality. If the uplink SINR of the LTE PCell of a UE is smaller than or equal to this threshold, the eNodeB determines that the uplink channel quality of the LTE cell is poor.
item.name: enDcSNDelULSinrThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of times that the uplink channel quality of the LTE side consecutively becomes poor in an EN-DC scenario. It is used for poor channel quality decision on SN deletion based on uplink channel quality. If the number of times that the uplink SINR on the LTE side of EN-DC UEs is consecutively less than or equal to the SINR Threshold on the LTE Side for Poor UL Channel Quality Decision in an EN-DC Scenario parameter reaches the value of this parameter, the uplink channel quality of the LTE side of the EN-DC UEs is marked as poor.
item.name: ulDataQualPoorNumThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of times that the uplink channel quality of the LTE side consecutively becomes good in an EN-DC scenario. It is used for good channel quality decision on SN deletion based on uplink channel quality. If the number of times that the uplink SINR on the LTE side of EN-DC UEs is consecutively larger than the SINR Threshold on the LTE Side for Poor UL Channel Quality Decision in an EN-DC Scenario parameter reaches the value of this parameter, the uplink channel quality of the LTE side of the EN-DC UEs is marked as good.
item.name: ulExitDataQualPoorNumThrd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the SN configuration policy related to guidance. If it is set to Open, the NR cells with traffic guidance enabled can be added as SNs for the NSA UEs with high-traffic services in the local cell. If it is set to Close, no NR cell with traffic guidance enabled can be added as SNs for the NSA UEs with high-traffic services in the local cell.
item.name: rateNRGuidSnPreSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables EN-DC anchor-based handover between anchor frequencies. If it is set to Open, the NSA UEs connected to an anchor frequency are migrated to other anchor frequencies through the execution of EN-DC anchor-based handover in the coverage scenario where there is no NR frequency that can be configured as SNs available.
item.name: endcAnchToAnchHoSwch

item.desc: This parameter controls whether to forbid the UEs configured with SNs from performing EN-DC anchor-based handover. If it is set to Open, the UEs configured with SNs cannot perform EN-DC anchor-based handover to other frequencies.
item.name: endcAnchForbidSNUESwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the EN-DC anchoring IMMCI function based on NR neighbor configurations. If it is set to Open, to determine whether a serving frequency is an anchor frequency, the EN-DC capability of both the serving frequency and the configured frequencies of the NR neighbor cells needs to be considered when the EN-DC anchoring IMMCI function is used.
item.name: enDcIMMCIBaseNRNbrSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables PLMN-based EN-DC SN selection. When the gNodeB selects an SN for an EN-DC UE, this parameter determines whether the gNodeB preferentially selects the NR cell that supports the serving PLMN of the UE as the SN. If this parameter is set to Open, during the SN selection for an EN-DC UE, the gNodeB preferentially selects the NR cell that supports the serving PLMN of the UE as the SN. If this parameter is set to Close, during the SN selection for an EN-DC UE, the gNodeB does not preferentially select the NR cell that supports the serving PLMN of the UE as the SN.
item.name: basedPLMNSnSelSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines the operations in the case that there is a conflict between the E-RAB modification indication message triggered by the eNodeB in the EN-DC procedure and the related messages triggered by the core network in a procedure. If it is set to Open and there is a conflict between the E-RAB modification indication message triggered by the eNodeB in the EN-DC procedure and the related messages triggered by the core network in a procedure, the eNodeB does not release the UE and can process the messages triggered by the core network in the procedure. If this parameter is set to Close, the E-RAB modification indication message expires and the UE is released.
item.name: eNDCFlowConflitSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to avoid the conflict between the VoLTE service setup procedure and the SN addition procedure in EN-DC scenarios. If this parameter is set to Only for User whose Establishment Cause was emergency or mo-VoiceCall, the eNodeB cannot add SNs within a period for the UEs for which the cause value carried in the RRC Connection Setup Request message is Emergency or mo-VoiceCall. If this parameter is set to For User whose Establishment Cause was emergency mo-VoiceCall or mt-Access, the eNodeB cannot add SNs within a period for the UEs for which the cause value carried in the RRC Connection Setup Request message is Emergency, mo-VoiceCall, or mt-Access. If this parameter is set to Close, the eNodeB can add SNs for UEs properly.
item.name: sNForbid4VolteClashSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for avoiding the conflict between the VoLTE service setup procedure and the SN addition procedure in an NSA scenario. This timer is started when the eNodeB detects that a UE may establish a VoLTE service in an EN-DC scenario. During timer operation, no SN can be configured for the UE.
item.name: sNForbidTimer4VolteClash

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables frequency restriction for EN-DC Type6 UEs. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB uses the dedicated threshold for adding SNs for Type6 UEs. If it is set to Close, the eNodeB uses the common threshold for adding SNs for Type6 UEs.
item.name: endcType6LimitFreSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets a list of RSRQ threshold offsets for adding SNs for Type6 UEs in EN-DC scenarios. Each element of this array parameter corresponds to each value of the NR SSB Frequency parameter in the related NR frequency configuration. Each element indicates, on each NR frequency, the RSRQ threshold offset that needs to be added to the absolute RSRQ threshold for NR measurement of neighbor cells (rSRQNRTrd) for Type6 UEs when the Measurement Configuration Function parameter is set to Measurement Configuration for SN Addition in ENDC. This parameter is valid only when the Switch of Frequency Restriction for EN-DC Type6 UEs parameter is set to Open.
item.name: endcType6SnAddRsrqOff

item.desc: This parameter sets a list of RSRP threshold offsets for adding SNs for Type6 UEs in EN-DC scenarios. Each element of this array parameter corresponds to each value of the NR SSB Frequency parameter in the related NR frequency configuration. Each element indicates, on each NR frequency, the RSRP threshold offset that needs to be added to the absolute RSRP threshold for NR measurement of neighbor cells (rSRPNRTrd) for Type6 UEs when the Measurement Configuration Function parameter is set to Measurement Configuration for SN Addition in ENDC. This parameter is valid only when the Switch of Frequency Restriction for EN-DC Type6 UEs parameter is set to Open.
item.name: endcType6SnAddRsrpOff

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for SN deletion penalty based on the S1-U link quality in an EN-DC scenario. It is used to avoid frequent SN deletion and addition caused by S1-U link failures occurring in NR neighbor cells. When an SN is deleted from the gNodeB due to an S1-U link failure, the eNodeB starts this timer. Before the timer expires, the eNodeB cannot add any SN for the UE.
item.name: enDcSnPunishTimerBaseS1u

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable the SN addition policy function based on frequency priority. When the eNodeB delivers SN addition measurement, the enDcSnAddMeasTimer (Timer for B1 Measurement for EN-DC SN Addition (ms)) is started. If this parameter is set to Open, before the timer expires, the eNodeB executes SN addition only when receiving a measurement report of the NR frequency with the highest priority. After the timer expires, the eNodeB selects the NR cell that reports the highest frequency priority. If this parameter is set to Close, the eNodeB immediately executes SN addition after receiving a measurement report of a frequency with any priority.
item.name: snAddBasedFreqPriSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion threshold of the UEs with a high scheduling proportion during uplink dynamic power sharing in EN-DC scenarios. It is an array consisting of two elements. The first element indicates the threshold for a UE to enter the status of high scheduling proportion. If the proportion of the number of uplink scheduled subframes to the total number of subframes on the share subframes of a UE in an LTE cell is larger than the value of this element, the eNodeB defines the UE as that with a high scheduling proportion. The second element indicates the threshold for a UE to exit the status of high scheduling proportion. If the proportion of the number of uplink scheduled subframes to the total number of subframes on the share subframes of a UE in an LTE cell is smaller than the value of this element, the eNodeB defines the UE as that with a non-high scheduling proportion. For the UEs with a high scheduling proportion, the gNodeB performs full-power correction on the uplink SINR of single RBs in an NR cell, uses the corrected value in uplink perception estimation, and determines the primary path of uplink data splitting and the splitting threshold based on the estimated uplink perception.
item.name: lteHighSchRatioThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval at which the eNodeB reports the LTE power information of the UE to the gNodeB in an EN-DC scenario when uplink dynamic power sharing is enabled. After receiving the LTE power information of the UE, the gNodeB adjusts the uplink SINR for full-power operation of the UE on the NR side, estimates the uplink user perception, and determines a proper primary path of uplink data splitting and the splitting threshold.
item.name: ltePwrInfoRptPeriod

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of 32 elements. Each element of the array corresponds to a cause value for SN release, and indicates whether the ping-pong prevention strategy for SN addition or deletion is enabled when an SN is released due to this cause. The first element corresponds to the cause value Radio Link Failure, and elements 2 to 32 are reserved and not defined in the current version.
item.name: snCfgPrePingPongSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets a ping-pong prevention strategy for SN configuration. If it is set to 0 (Forbidden to configure the ping-pong cell as a PSCell) and the ping-pong effect occurs in SN addition or deletion of a UE, the NR cell where the ping-pong effect occurs cannot be configured as the PSCell of the UE. If it is set to 1 (Forbidden to configure a cell With the ping-pong frequency as a PSCell) and the ping-pong effect occurs in SN addition or deletion of a UE, any NR cell on a frequency where the ping-pong effect occurs cannot be configured as the PSCell of the UE. If it is set to 2 (Forbidden UE to configure SN) and the ping-pong effect occurs in SN addition or deletion of a UE, the UE cannot be configured with an SN.
item.name: snCfgPrePingPongStgy

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of times that the ping-pong effect occurs in SN addition and deletion. It is used to determine whether the following case occurs frequently: An SN is deleted after it is added for a UE. If the snCfgPrePingPongSwch (Switch for Ping-Pong Prevention in SN Configuration) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the number of times that an SN is deleted after being added is larger than the parameter value, it is determined that the ping-pong effect occurs in SN addition and deletion for the UE.
item.name: snCfgPingPongNumThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets a penalty period for ping-pong prevention in SN configuration. If the snCfgPrePingPongSwch (Switch for Ping-Pong Prevention in SN Configuration) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the eNodeB detects that the ping-pong effect occurs in SN addition and deletion for a UE, the timer is started. During the operation of the timer, the eNodeB implements a ping-pong prevention strategy for the UE. The strategy is determined by the snCfgPrePingPongStgy (Ping-Pong Prevention Strategy for SN Configuration) parameter. When the timer expires, the eNodeB stops the ping-pong prevention strategy for the UE.
item.name: snCfgPingPongPunishTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the method for the eNodeB to calculate the flow control rate if SCG split bearers are configured. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the average historical flow control rate is calculated based on the valid BSR duration. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the average historical flow control rate is calculated by using the slide window of the actual rate.
item.name: flowCtrlSchCapRateSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to limit the number of carriers to prevent UEs from overheating based on reported UE assistance information in EN-DC scenarios. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB supports limiting the number of activated SCells on the SN, number of MIMO layers on the SN, BWP used by the PSCells, or EN-DC configurations based on the UE assistance information reported by UEs to prevent the UEs from overheating.
item.name: overHeat4EndcUESwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum interval at which a UE reports the UE Assistance Information (UAI) that carries UE overheating information in an EN-DC scenario. If a UE needs to report two pieces of UAI that carries UE overheating information, the time interval between the two pieces of UAI cannot be shorter than the parameter value.
item.name: overHeatingProhibitTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink SINR threshold of a single RB for neighbor cells in uplink channel quality-based SN addition. It is an array parameter consisting of three elements and is used to evaluate the uplink channel quality of neighbor cells. Element 0 sets the SINR threshold of a single RB for the NR neighbor cells with large TDD antennas. Element 1 sets the SINR threshold of a single RB for the NR neighbor cells with small TDD antennas. Element 2 sets the SINR threshold of a single RB for FDD NR neighbor cells. A neighbor cell can be selected as the target neighbor cell for SN addition only if the snAddBaseUlQualSwch (Switch for Uplink Channel Quality-Based SN Addition) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the uplink SINR of a single RB for the neighbor cell is larger than the corresponding element value.
item.name: snAddNbrSglRbSinrThrdUl

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables uplink channel quality-based SN addition. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB does not add the NR neighbor cells whose uplink channel quality does not meet the specified conditions when adding SNs. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), SN addition based on uplink channel quality does not take effect.
item.name: snAddBaseUlQualSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the configuration index of an EN-DC bearer type for the UEs in the cell. If this parameter is set to 0, it indicates that the cell-level EN-DC bearer type is invalid.
item.name: dCBearerTypeProfileIndex

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for SN deletion penalty based on the X2-U link quality in an EN-DC scenario. It is used to avoid frequent SN deletion and addition caused by packet loss on X2-U links occurring in NR neighbor cells. When an SN deletion message is received from the SN due to packet loss on an X2-U link in an EN-DC scenario and this parameter is set to a non-zero value, the timer is started. Before the timer expires, no NR cell with a low bandwidth can be added as the SN PSCell of the UE. When the timer expires, an NR cell with a low bandwidth can be added as the SN PSCell of the UE. If this parameter is set to 65535, the timer will never expire.
item.name: enDcX2uSnPunishTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to perform EN-DC anchor-based handover based on the EN-DC bearer types of UEs. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. Element 0 sets the anchor-based handover policy for non-anchor cells in EN-DC scenarios. If element 0 is set to 1 (Open), non-anchor cells select only the UEs with SCG or SCG Split bearers to perform anchor-based handover to optimize network resource allocation. If element 0 is set to 0 (Close), non-anchor cells do not consider EN-DC bearer types of UEs during handover. Element 1 sets the anchor-based handover policy for anchor cells in EN-DC scenarios. If element 1 is set to 1 (Open), EN-DC anchor cells hand over only the UEs with SCG or SCG Split bearers to other EN-DC anchor cells and hand over the UEs without SCG or SCG Split bearers to non-anchor cells. If element 1 is set to 0 (Close), EN-DC anchor cells do not consider EN-DC bearer types of UEs during handover.
item.name: endcAnchHoBaseBearSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the string type and can be configured as planned.

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the string type and can be configured as planned.

item.desc: This parameter sets the Mobile Country Code (MCC) in the configuration customized by the operator.

item.desc: This parameter sets the Mobile Network Code (MNC) in the configuration customized by the operator.

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables EN-DC. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB configures 4G-5G DC for the UEs that support NSA scenarios. If it is set to Close, the eNodeB does not configure 4G-5G DC for the UEs that support NSA scenarios.
item.name: enDcSwch1

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the upperLayerIndication field in a broadcast message is configured. If it is set to Open, the broadcast message sent by the eNodeB carries the upperLayerIndication field. If it is set to Close, the broadcast message sent by the eNodeB does not carry the upperLayerIndication field.
item.name: upperLayerIndSwch1

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the string type and can be configured as planned.
item.name: id

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the string type and can be configured as planned.
item.name: moId

item.desc: This parameter sets the QCI corresponding to a service type. The eNodeB can detect service QoS parameters and application parameters through QCIs. The standard QoS Classification Identifiers (QCIs) represent QoS attributes, such as packet scheduling, the delay, and the packet loss rate. The transmission of standard QCI parameters among different NEs in an EPS helps the interconnection of the equipment from different vendors and flexible configuration by operators.
item.name: qCI

item.desc: This parameter sets the PRB load threshold at which the shunting of downlink split bearers is stopped. When the downlink PRB usage of a cell exceeds this threshold, split bearers are periodically selected to stop shunting. Downlink shunting stop is valid only for NGBR bearers.
item.name: flowCtrlStopThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the PRB load threshold at which the shunting of downlink split bearers is recovered. When the downlink PRB usage of a cell is lower than this threshold, split bearers are periodically selected to recover shunting. The parameter value must be lower than the threshold for downlink shunting stop. Downlink shunting stop is valid only for NGBR bearers.
item.name: flowCtrlRecoverThrd

item.desc: If the uplink PRB usage of a cell is higher than this threshold and the number of UEs in the cell is larger than the value of the Threshold for the Number of UEs to Trigger Load-Based Scheduling Priority Adjustment parameter, the uplink scheduling priority of the NGBR service of this LTE UE is decreased, or the uplink scheduling priority of the SCG split bearer for the NGBR service of this NSA UE is lowered, depending on the value of the Load-Based Scheduling Priority Adjustment Mode Selection parameter.
item.name: emlpAdjBaseLoadStarThrdUl

item.desc: If the downlink PRB usage of a cell is higher than this threshold and the number of UEs in the cell is larger than the value of the Threshold for the Number of UEs to Trigger Load-Based Scheduling Priority Adjustment parameter, the downlink scheduling priority of the NGBR service of this LTE UE is decreased, or the downlink scheduling priority of the SCG split bearer for the NGBR service of this NSA UE is lowered, depending on the value of the Load-Based Scheduling Priority Adjustment Mode Selection parameter.
item.name: emlpAdjBaseLoadStarThrdDl

item.desc: If the uplink PRB usage of a cell is lower than this threshold, the scheduling priority of the NGBR service (whose uplink scheduling priority is decreased) corresponding to this item is restored.
item.name: emlpAdjBaseLoadRecThrdUl

item.desc: If the downlink PRB usage of a cell is lower than this threshold, the scheduling priority of the NGBR service (whose downlink scheduling priority is decreased) corresponding to this item is restored.
item.name: emlpAdjBaseLoadRecThrdDl

item.desc: This parameter sets the Mobile Country Code (MCC) in the PLMN ID associated with the customized SPID.
item.name: mcc

item.desc: This parameter sets the Mobile Network Code (MNC) in the PLMN ID associated with the customized SPID.
item.name: mnc

item.desc: This parameter sets the type of users and bearers. If it is set to 0, the experience of NSA users can be guaranteed through the decrease of the scheduling priority of the NGBR bearers for the services of LTE users. If it is set to 1, the scheduling priority of the SCG split bearers for NGBR services of NSA users is decreased and the shunting of the SCG split bearers for the NGBR services of the NSA users stops. If it is set to 2, the scheduling priority of the non-SCG split bearers for NGBR services of NSA users is decreased.
item.name: emlpAdjustBaseLoadMode

item.desc: If the Load-Based Scheduling Priority Adjustment Mode Selection parameter is set to 0, this parameter is used to configure the level of scheduling priority decrease of the SCG split bearers for NGBR services of NSA users after load-based scheduling priority adjustment is triggered. If the Load-Based Scheduling Priority Adjustment Mode Selection parameter is set to 1, this parameter is used to configure the level of scheduling priority decrease of the NGBR services of LTE users after load-based scheduling priority adjustment is triggered.
item.name: emlpAdjustBaseLoadStep

item.desc: Full Distinguished Name
item.name: FDN

item.desc: Date Time
item.name: DATETIME

item.desc: Collection period of measurement task.
item.name: granularityPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: id

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: moId

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the coordination based on specific UEs. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB and a specific UE can identify each other through a private interface to establish a connection. If it is set to Close, the eNodeB and a specific UE cannot identify each other through a private interface to establish a connection.
item.name: specUECoordSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the DRX for the collaboration based on specific UEs. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB configures DRX parameters based on the indications of UEs. If it is set to Close, the eNodeB configures DRX parameters not based on the indications of UEs.
item.name: specUeDRXSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to enable the DRX for coordination based on specific UEs. If the number of bearers for UEs is less than or equal to this threshold, the UEs can enable the DRX for coordination based on specific UEs. If the number of bearers for UEs is larger than this threshold, the UEs cannot enable the DRX for coordination based on specific UEs.
item.name: bearerNumThr4SpecUeDRX

item.desc: This parameter sets the SCC activation policy for Apple UEs. If it is set to 0, the default SCC activation policy is used. If it is set to 1, the accurate SCC activation policy for Apple UEs is used. If it is set to 2, other SCC activation policies are used. This configuration is not recommended.
item.name: appleUEActSccPolicy

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the number of times that MAC CEs requested by the AFT function are transmitted by a UE within a period of time. It is used to provide special guarantees for Apple UEs. It can avoid too large number of AFT MAC CEs transmitted by a UE. When the number of AFT MAC CEs transmitted by a UE exceeds this threshold, the eNodeB sends a notification to the UE to stop the AFT function.
item.name: mACCENumThr4AFT

item.desc: This parameter sets the offset to the high threshold for the total number of cell-level AFT MAC CEs. It is used to provide special guarantees for Apple UEs. When the system load is back to an acceptable level, this parameter can restore the guarantee for the functions of Apple UEs. Within a period of time (10 seconds), if the total number of AFT MAC CEs in a cell is less than the difference between the high threshold for the total number of AFT MAC CEs in the cell and this offset, the baseband board reports a low-threshold flag of the AFT MAC CEs.
item.name: totalMACCENumDelta4AFT

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for the total number of times that MAC CEs requested by the AFT function are transmitted in the cell within a period of time. It is used to provide special guarantees for Apple UEs. It can avoid high system load caused by too large number of AFT MAC CEs. If the number of AFT MAC CEs exceeds this threshold, the MAC layer reports the value to the upper layer for the handling policy.
item.name: totalMACCENumThr4AFT

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: moId

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the detailed configuration of the related parameters of adaptive capacity. If it is set to Open, it indicates that detailed configuration is enabled.
item.name: nCDetailCfgswch

item.desc: This parameter sets the configuration method of the SRS period and time domain resources if the cellCapaLeveInd (Cell Capacity Level Indicator) parameter is set to 4 (adaptive capacity). If this parameter is set to 0 (Fixed SRS Config), the SRS period is a fixed value. If this parameter is set to 1 (Manual SRS Config), the SRS period can be configured on the OMC.
item.name: sRSCfgMethod4AdpCapa

item.desc: This parameter sets the period of time during which SRs are transmitted on extended RBs allocated to the cell if the cellCapaLeveInd (Cell Capacity Level Indicator) parameter is set to 4 (adaptive capacity).
item.name: extSRTrPeriod

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables transmission mode selection for single-port scenarios. The three values in the array correspond to the transmission modes selected for different numbers of RRC-connected UEs. If the number of RRC-connected UEs is less than NormalCapaUeNum(1), the transmission mode is determined by the flagSwiMode parameter. If the number of RRC-connected UEs is larger than or equal to NormalCapaUeNum(1) and smaller than NormalCapaUeNum(2), the transmission mode is determined by the FlagSwiMode4SinglePortNC(1) parameter. If the number of RRC-connected UEs is larger than or equal to NormalCapaUeNum(2) and smaller than NormalCapaUeNum(3), the transmission mode is determined by the FlagSwiMode4SinglePortNC(2) parameter. If the number of RRC-connected UEs is larger than or equal to NormalCapaUeNum(3) and smaller than LargeCapaUeNum, the transmission mode is determined by the FlagSwiMode4SinglePortNC(3) parameter.
item.name: flagSwiMode4SinglePortNC

item.desc: This parameter sets the inner-loop AMC CQI expiration timers for normal capacity with detailed configurations. Elements 0 through 2 of the normalCapaUeNum (Threshold for Normal Capacity in Detailed Configuration) array parameter fall into the following three intervals separately: larger than or equal to element 0 and less than element 1, larger than or equal to element 1 and less than element 2, and larger than or equal to element 2. If the number of RRC-connected UEs in the cell falls into one of the above intervals, the corresponding inner-loop AMC CQI expiration timer is the value of element 0, element 1, or element 2 of this array parameter separately. When the eNodeB receives a CQI reported by a UE, the corresponding timer is started. When the timer expires, the CQI becomes invalid.
item.name: cQIExpiredTimerNC

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables transmission mode selection for multi-port scenarios. The three values in the array correspond to the transmission modes selected for different numbers of RRC-connected UEs. If the number of RRC-connected UEs is less than NormalCapaUeNum(1), the transmission mode is determined by the FlagSwiMode parameter. If the number of RRC-connected UEs is larger than or equal to NormalCapaUeNum(1) and less than NormalCapaUeNum(2), the transmission mode is determined by the FlagSwiMode4MultiPortNC(1) parameter. If the number of RRC-connected UEs is larger than or equal to NormalCapaUeNum(2) and less than NormalCapaUeNum(3), the transmission mode is determined by the FlagSwiMode4MultiPortNC(2) parameter. If the number of RRC-connected UEs is larger than or equal to NormalCapaUeNum(3) and less than LargeCapaUeNum, the transmission mode is determined by the FlagSwiMode4MultiPortNC(3) parameter.
item.name: flagSwiMode4MultiPortNC

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables DRX for NGBR services. If it is set to Close, DRX is not enabled when a UE has an NGBR service. If it is set to Open, DRX can be enabled. If the number of RRC-connected UEs is larger than or equal to awNormalCapaUeNum[0] and smaller than awNormalCapaUeNum[1], the aucNGbrDrxSwitchNC[0] parameter is set to Open. If the number of RRC-connected UEs is larger than or equal to awNormalCapaUeNum[1] and smaller than awNormalCapaUeNum[2], the aucNGbrDrxSwitchNC[1] parameter is set to Open. If the number of RRC-connected UEs is larger than or equal to awNormalCapaUeNum[2] and smaller than wLargeCapaUeNum, the aucNGbrDrxSwitchNC[2] parameter is set to Open.
item.name: nGbrDrxSwitchNC

item.desc: If the nCDetailCfgswch (Switch for Detailed Configuration of the Related Parameters of Adaptive Capacity) parameter is set to 1 (Open), this parameter sets the levels of the number of UEs in detailed configuration. This parameter is an array consisting of three elements, corresponding to the low, medium, and high thresholds for the number of UEs in the case of normal capacity. The normal capacity corresponding to the scenario where the number of RRC-Connected UEs is smaller than the value of the largeCapaUeNum (Threshold Of Larger Capacity) parameter is divided into four levels. If the number of RRC-Connected UEs is smaller than normalCapaUeNum[0], it is considered that the normal capacity level of the current cell is 1. If the number of RRC-Connected UEs is larger than or equal to normalCapaUeNum[0] and smaller than normalCapaUeNum[1], it is considered that the normal capacity level of the current cell is 2. If the number of RRC-Connected UEs is larger than or equal to normalCapaUeNum[1] and smaller than normalCapaUeNum[2], it is considered that the normal capacity level of the current cell is 3. If the number of RRC-Connected UEs is larger than or equal to normalCapaUeNum[2] and smaller than the value of the largeCapaUeNum parameter, it is considered that the normal capacity level of the current cell is 4. If the low, medium, and high thresholds for the number of UEs in the case of normal capacity is equal to the value of the largeCapaUeNum parameter, the detailed configuration does not take effect.
item.name: normalCapaUeNum

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the uplink MIMO function. If the number of RRC-connected UEs is less than normalCapaUeNum(1), the mumimoEnableUl parameter should be set to Open. If the number of RRC-connected UEs is larger than or equal to normalCapaUeNum(1) and less than normalCapaUeNum(2), the ulMUMIMOEnableNC(1) parameter should be set to Open. If the number of RRC-connected UEs is larger than or equal to normalCapaUeNum(2) and less than normalCapaUeNum(3), the ulMUMIMOEnableNC(2) parameter should be set to Open. If the number of RRC-connected UEs is larger than or equal to normalCapaUeNum(3) and less than largeCapaUeNum, the ulMUMIMOEnableNC(3) parameter should be set to Open.
item.name: ulMUMIMOEnableNC

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the enhanced uplink MIMO function. If the number of RRC-connected UEs is less than normalCapaUeNum(1), the muMIMO4MultiUESwchUl parameter should be set to Open. If the number of RRC-connected UEs is larger than or equal to normalCapaUeNum(1) and less than normalCapaUeNum(2), the ulMUMIMO4MultiUESwchNC(1) parameter should be set to Open. If the number of RRC-connected UEs is larger than or equal to normalCapaUeNum(2) and less than normalCapaUeNum(3), the ulMUMIMO4MultiUESwchNC(2) parameter should be set to Open. If the number of RRC-connected UEs is larger than or equal to normalCapaUeNum(3) and less than largeCapaUeNum, the ulMUMIMO4MultiUESwchNC(3) parameter should be set to Open.
item.name: ulMUMIMO4MultiUESwchNC

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: moId

item.desc: MBSFN subframe configuration period. N1 represents 1, n2 represents 2, and so forth.
item.name: rfPeriod4MBSFN

item.desc: TM9 switch for MBSFN sub-frame scheduling. If the switch is turned on, TM9 is scheduled in the MBSFN subframe at the LTE side. If the switch is turned off, the TM9 is not scheduled in the MBSFN subframe at the LTE side.
item.name: tm9SchdSwitch4MBSFN

item.desc: This parameter indicates the switch for the downlink shared resource allocation policy when the NR is preferred. 0: Static; 1: Adaption
item.name: dlRBShareAlgSwitch4NR

item.desc: MBSFN subframe configuration offset. When SFN mod ucRFPeriod4MBSFN = ucRFOffset4MBSFN is met, the radio frame contains MBSFN subframe.
item.name: rfOffset4MBSFN

item.desc: This parameter indicates the switch of MBSFN subframe configuration policy. 0: One frame; 1: Four frames
item.name: sfAlgSwitch4MBSFN

item.desc: MBSFN sub-frame bitmap. According to the protocol, the one frame bitmap occupies 6 bit. 6 bit is arranged in turn. Bit[0] bit[1] bit[2] bit[3] bit[4] and bit[5] indicate subframes #1, #2, #3, #6, #7 and #8 respectively. When they are 1, the corresponding subframes are M subframes; when they are 0, the corresponding subframes are non-M subframes.
item.name: oneRF4MBSFNbitmap

item.desc: MBSFN sub-frame bitmap. According to the protocol, the four frames bitmap occupies 24 bit. It indicates the subframes #1, #2, #3, #6, #7 and #8 of the four radio frames in turn. When it is 1, it indicates that the corresponding subframe is M subframe; when it is 0, it indicates that the corresponding subframe is not M subframe.
item.name: fourRF4MBSFNbitmap

item.desc: This parameter indicates the switch of uplink shared resource allocation policy when NR is preferred. 0 indicates Static, and 1 indicates adaption
item.name: ulRBShareAlgSwitch4NR

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables MBSFN subframe configuration. If it is set to Open, MBSFN subframes are configured on the LTE side. If it is set to Close, MBSFN subframes are configured on the LTE side.
item.name: mBSFNSwitch
