item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: moId

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables MM IN coordination. If it is set to Open, various operation instructions are sent to the eNodeBs of non-MM neighbor cells, depending on the load of MM cells. If it is set to Close, MM IN coordination is disabled.
item.name: tmmINCSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of target neighbor cells for MM IN coordination. If the number of handovers of UEs between an MM cell and a non-MM neighbor cell is larger than the maximum number of handovers to neighbor cells in MM IN coordination within a statistical period, the eNodeB delivers measurements tasks on the frequencies of the first N (this parameter value) non-MM neighbor cells involved in the handovers with the MM cell in descending order of the numbers of handovers.
item.name: tmmINCTarNbrThrd

item.desc: Within each migration period, the eNodeB of non-MM neighbor cells delivers measurement tasks of UE migration from the non-MM neighbor cells to MM cells. This parameter sets the maximum number of UEs to which the eNodeB of non-MM neighbor cells delivers measurement tasks of UE migration within a migration period.
item.name: tmmINCMeasNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of UEs that are migrated from non-MM neighbor cells to an MM cell and are handed over within a migration period when MM IN coordination is enabled.
item.name: tmmINCHONum

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of UEs that meet the measurement report requirements for threshold increase decision when MM IN coordination is enabled. If the number of UEs that meet the measurement report requirements exceeds this threshold, the increase of the measurement threshold is triggered.
item.name: tmmINCUpThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of UEs that meet the measurement report requirements for threshold decrease decision when MM IN coordination is enabled. If the number of UEs that meet the measurement report requirements is smaller than this threshold over three consecutive periods, the decrease of the measurement threshold is triggered. The number of consecutive periods is determined by the number of adaptive decision periods for UE migration measurement in MM IN coordination, 3 by default.
item.name: tmmINCDownThrd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables handover-based UE migration when MM IN coordination is enabled. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB periodically migrates UEs from non-MM neighbor cells to MM cells through handover to improve the performance of the MM cells. If it is set to Close, the eNodeB does not migrate UEs from non-MM neighbor cells to MM cells through handover.
item.name: tmmINCUeMigSwch

item.desc: This parameter is a 32-dimensional byte array with each element representing a QCI service. It is used to control whether to prohibit the migration of the UEs with certain services. If an element corresponding to a QCI service is set to 1, the UEs with the QCI service cannot be migrated. If an element corresponding to a QCI service is set to 0, the UEs with the QCI service can be migrated.
item.name: tmmINCForbidQCI

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for UE migration when MM IN coordination is enabled. It is used to control the migration of UEs in an MM IN coordination scenario. This timer is started when UE migration is enabled in an MM IN coordination scenario. The timer is stopped when UE migration is disabled in an MM IN coordination scenario. After the timer expires, the UEs in a non-MM cell is migrated to an MM cell if the MM cell meets the UE migration conditions.
item.name: tmmINCUeMigPeriod

item.desc: For non-MM cells, the measurement threshold should be adaptively configured based on the measurement reports of the UEs in the non-MM cells and the load of MM cells to select suitable UEs for migration. This parameter sets the number of UE migration periods in MM IN coordination. After this period, the eNodeB adjusts the measurement threshold for UE migration in accordance with the corresponding policy.
item.name: tmmINCUeMigJudgePrdNum

item.desc: This array parameter sets the RSRP thresholds that need to be adjusted for the migration of the UEs with downlink high-traffic services or downlink low-traffic services when MM IN coordination is enabled. It is a three-dimensional array. From the first element of the parameter, the array elements correspond to the low threshold, medium threshold, and high threshold separately. During initial measurement delivery, only the UEs with high-traffic services are selected for measurement delivery. If the number of UEs that report measurement results is large, the measurement threshold is increased. The upper limit of the increase is the high threshold. If the number of UEs that report measurement results is small, the measurement threshold is decreased. The lower limit of the decrease is the low threshold. If the measurement threshold is decreased to the medium threshold, the UEs with low-traffic services are selected for measurement delivery.
item.name: tmmINCMeasAdjRsrpThrd

item.desc: This array parameter sets the RSRQ thresholds that need to be adjusted for the migration of the UEs with downlink high-traffic services or downlink low-traffic services when MM IN coordination is enabled. It is a three-dimensional array. From the first element of the parameter, the array elements correspond to the low threshold, medium threshold, and high threshold separately. During initial measurement delivery, only the UEs with high-traffic services are selected for measurement delivery. If the number of UEs that report measurement results is large, the measurement threshold is increased. The upper limit of the increase is the high threshold. If the number of UEs that report measurement results is small, the measurement threshold is decreased. The lower limit of the decrease is the low threshold. If the measurement threshold is decreased to the medium threshold, the UEs with low-traffic services are selected for measurement delivery.
item.name: tmmINCMeasAdjRsrqThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the measurement penalty timer when MM IN coordination is enabled. If a UE does not report the measurement result after the eNodeB delivers a measurement task to the UE, the eNodeB starts the measurement penalty timer for the UE. Before the timer expires, the eNodeB does not deliver another measurement task to the UE.
item.name: tmmINCMeasPunishTmr

item.desc: This parameter sets the step for RSRP threshold adjustment in RSRP measurement for non-MM cells when MM IN coordination is enabled. It reflects the RSRP threshold fluctuation in each RSRP adjustment.
item.name: tmmINCMeasAdjRsrpStep

item.desc: This parameter sets the step for RSRQ threshold adjustment in RSRQ measurement for non-MM cells when MM IN coordination is enabled. It reflects the RSRQ threshold fluctuation in each RSRQ adjustment.
item.name: tmmINCMeasAdjRsrqStep

item.desc: This parameter sets the priority of intra-frequency measurement when MM IN coordination is enabled. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority. If it is set to 0, no intra-frequency measurement task is delivered.
item.name: tmmINCIntraFreqPriority

item.desc: This parameter determines whether NSA UEs can perform the MM IN coordination function. If it is set to Open, NSA UEs do not perform the MM IN coordination function. If it is set to Close, NSA UEs can perform the MM IN coordination function.
item.name: tmmINCNSAFilterSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables IMMCI-based UE migration for MM cells when MM IN coordination is enabled. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB performs the IMMCI policy of the MM IN coordination function when releasing UEs. If it is set to Close, the eNodeB does not perform the IMMCI policy of the MM IN coordination function when releasing UEs.
item.name: tmmINCImmciSwch

item.desc: This array parameter sets the load status determination condition of TMM cells (the PRB usage in busy hours and idle hours) when TMM IN coordination is enabled. The first array element is the high threshold of PRB usage, and the second element is the low threshold of PRB usage. The high threshold must be higher than or equal to the low threshold.
item.name: tmmINCDlPrbThr

item.desc: This array parameter sets the load status determination condition of very busy cells and busy cells (the number of UEs that are not scheduled) when TMM IN coordination is enabled. The first array element is the high threshold number of not-scheduled UEs of a QoS, and the second is the low threshold number of not-scheduled UEs of a QoS. The high threshold must be higher than or equal to the low threshold. The third array element is the conservative value of the low threshold number of not-scheduled UEs of a QoS, which is used to determine the status of small windows. (The values of the first two array elements are the default values for a bandwidth of 20 MHz. For a bandwidth of 10 MHz, a correction value ucTmmINCDeltaN10M needs to be subtracted from these two values. The third array element is independent of bandwidths)
item.name: tmmINCUnSchdUeThr

item.desc: This array parameter sets the poor-quality UE filtering conditions in TMM IN coordination. The first array element is the threshold of the SDM scheduling proportion of UEs, the second is the threshold of VoLTE service scheduling proportion of UEs, and the third is the threshold of UE removal proportion. The system migrates the UEs that meet all the poor-quality filtering conditions out of TMM cells.
item.name: tmmINCBadUeSchdThr

item.desc: This array parameter sets the length of the big and small time windows (in seconds) when TMM IN coordination is enabled. The first array element is the time length of the big window, which is used to determine the load status of TMM cells. The second array element is the time length of the small window, which is used for filtering poor-quality UEs.
item.name: tmmINCTimeWindow

item.desc: This parameter sets the load status determination condition of the TMM cells that change from the busy state to the very busy state (the threshold number of UEs of a QoS) when TMM IN coordination is enabled. A TMM cell enters very busy state only when the number of UEs of the QoS exceeds this threshold. (The parameter value is the default value for a bandwidth of 20 MHz. For a bandwidth of 10 MHz, a correction value ucTmmINCDeltaN10M needs to be subtracted from the default value. ) When a TMM cell is in very busy state, it identifies poor-quality UEs and migrates them out.
item.name: tmmINCQosUeNumThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the correction value of the very-busy-state determination threshold for 10 MHz cells when TMM IN coordination is enabled. The threshold for 10 MHz cells should subtract this correction value from that for 20 MHz cells.
item.name: tmmINCDeltaN10M

item.desc: This parameter sets the MCS threshold for filtering poor-quality UEs when TMM IN coordination is enabled. A UE is considered to be a poor-quality UE when the MCS value is smaller than this threshold. When a TMM cell is very busy, it migrates poor-quality UEs out.
item.name: tmmINCBadUeMcsThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the RB scheduling proportion threshold for filtering poor-quality UEs when TMM IN coordination is enabled. Within a statistical period, a UE is considered to be a poor-quality UE when the RB scheduling proportion is higher than this threshold. When a TMM cell is very busy, it migrates poor-quality UEs out.
item.name: tmmINCBadUeRBThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval between downlink data quality detection for downlink high-traffic handover. If downlink high-traffic handover is enabled, the eNodeB determines the downlink MCS at this interval.
item.name: sampPeriod4DLData

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times that downlink poor-quality data is collected during downlink high-traffic handover. If downlink high-traffic handover is enabled and the number of times that the downlink MCS of a target UE continuously meets the poor-quality threshold reaches this parameter value, the UE is identified as a poor-quality UE.
item.name: sampTimes4DLWorseQual

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables directed migration for the SA UEs with special SPIDs. If this parameter is set to Open, the eNodeB configures the dedicated target frequency and priority of directed migration for the SA UEs with special SPIDs.
item.name: sADirectMigSpidSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the PS-based handover to NR systems for SPID UEs. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB configures the dedicated target frequency and interoperability type of coverage-based handover to 5G systems for the UEs with special SPIDs.
item.name: nRPSHOSpidSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to trigger service-based handover in E-RAB release scenarios, that is, for the UEs with multiple services, whether to re-trigger service-based handover based on the remaining services after some services of the UEs are released. If this parameter is set to Close, the corresponding policy does not take effect. If this parameter is set to Open, the corresponding policy takes effect.
item.name: hOBaseSrv4ERABRelSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the interference coordination mode of the public network and private networks. It is used to select the type of neighbor cell that is notified of vehicle arrival information. If this parameter is set to Close, neighbor cells are not sorted based on their inter-cell overlapping coverage degree and vehicle arrival information can be sent to intra-frequency and inter-frequency neighbor cells in the public network. If this parameter is set to Intra-frequency, Inter-frequency, or Intra-frequency and Inter-frequency, neighbor cells are sorted based on their inter-cell overlapping coverage degree. If this parameter is set to Intra-frequency, vehicle arrival information is sent only to the intra-frequency neighbor cells in the public network. If this parameter is set to Inter-frequency, vehicle arrival information is sent only to the inter-frequency neighbor cells in the public network. If this parameter is set to Intra-frequency and Inter-frequency, vehicle arrival information can be sent to both the intra-frequency and inter-frequency neighbor cells in the public network.
item.name: hsrICMode

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the reordering based on inter-RAT NR measurement reports. If it is set to Open, for the inter-RAT NR measurement reports with the triggering quantity being RSRP, the eNodeB reorders neighbor cells based on both the SINR and RSRQ measurement results and SINR-based ordering is given a higher priority. For the inter-RAT NR measurement reports with the triggering quantity being RSRQ, the eNodeB reorders neighbor cells based on the SINR measurement results.
item.name: nRMeasReportReorderSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables inter-RAT NR joint-decision for directional SA migration. It is an array parameter. The array elements 1, 2, and 3 control the joint-decision policies for the measurement events with the triggering quantity being RSRP, RSRQ, and SINR respectively. If an array element is set to Close, it indicates that the joint-decision policy is not enabled for the measurement events with the corresponding triggering quantity. If an array element is set to RSRP and RSRQ United Judgment, it indicates that the RSRP+RSRQ joint-decision policy is enabled for the measurement events with the corresponding triggering quantity. If an array element is set to RSRP and SINR United Judgment, it indicates that the RSRP+SINR joint-decision policy is enabled for the measurement events with the corresponding triggering quantity.
item.name: sAMigNRUnitJudgSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables inter-RAT NR joint-decision based on coverage mobility. It is an array parameter. The array elements 1, 2, and 3 control the joint-decision policies for the measurement events with the triggering quantity being RSRP, RSRQ, and SINR respectively. If an array element is set to Close, it indicates that the joint-decision policy is not enabled for the measurement events with the corresponding triggering quantity. If an array element is set to RSRP and RSRQ United Judgment, it indicates that the RSRP+RSRQ joint-decision policy is enabled for the measurement events with the corresponding triggering quantity. If an array element is set to RSRP and SINR United Judgment, it indicates that the RSRP+SINR joint-decision policy is enabled for the measurement events with the corresponding triggering quantity.
item.name: coverNRUnitJudgSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute RSRP threshold for the RSRP decision of target neighbor cells when directional SA migration to inter-RAT NR neighbor cells is enabled and measurement events are reported. It is used to control the triggering of directional SA migration to the inter-RAT neighbor cells with a good RSRP value.
item.name: sAMigNRUnitJudgRSRPThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute RSRQ threshold for the RSRQ decision of target neighbor cells when directional SA migration to inter-RAT NR neighbor cells is enabled and measurement events are reported. It is used to control the triggering of directional SA migration to the inter-RAT NR neighbor cells with a good RSRQ value.
item.name: sAMigNRUnitJudgRSRQThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute SINR threshold for the SINR decision of target neighbor cells when directional SA migration to inter-RAT NR neighbor cells is enabled and measurement events are reported. It is used to control the triggering of directional SA migration to the inter-RAT neighbor cells with a good SINR value.
item.name: sAMigNRUnitJudgSINRThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute SINR threshold for the SINR decision of the serving cell when the coverage-based handover or redirection to inter-RAT NR neighbor cells is enabled and measurement events are reported. It is used to control the triggering of the handover or redirection as soon as possible if the SINR of the serving cell is small.
item.name: srvCellSINRThrd

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the current LTE cell supports DSS. The current LTE cell can share spectrum resources with an NR cell only when this parameter is set to Open.
item.name: dssAbilitySwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to attempt to establish the current LTE cell to be a normal cell if the DSS negotiation of the cell fails. If it is set to Open, the LTE cell that fails the DSS negotiation needs to be established as a normal cell.
item.name: dssNegoFailKeepAliveSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the migration of the UEs that are interfered at the DSS boundary. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB detects and identifies the UEs that are interfered at the DSS boundary and triggers the migration procedure for the interfered UEs.
item.name: dSSBIFMigSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for waiting for the migration measurement of a UE that is interfered at the DSS boundary. After the measurement configuration is delivered, this timer is started to wait for a measurement report. If the UE fails to be migrated when the timer expires, the migration measurement is deleted.
item.name: dSSBIFMigMeasTimer

item.desc: This parameter is an array consisting of 255 elements that determine whether QCI1 through QCI255 services can trigger the strategy for migrating the UEs interfered at the DSS boundary. If an element is set to 1 (Yes), the eNodeB can migrate the UEs that have the corresponding QCI service and are interfered at the DSS boundary. If an element is set to 0 (No), the eNodeB does not migrate the UEs that have the corresponding QCI service and are interfered at the DSS boundary.
item.name: qCILevelDSSBIFMig

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to filter the EN-DC UEs that are interfered at the DSS boundary. If it is set to No, the eNodeB migrates the EN-DC UEs that are interfered at the DSS boundary. If it is set to Yes, the eNodeB cannot migrate the EN-DC UEs that are interfered at the DSS boundary.
item.name: dSSBIFMigFilterEnDcInd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables eDRX for idle LTE UEs. If it is set to Open, the cell can provide a more powerful energy saving strategy for the idle LTE UEs that support eDRX. In this case, the cell supports the calculation of the LTE paging opportunity at an eDRX interval, so that the idle LTE UEs supporting the eDRX function can sleep for a longer period.
item.name: lTEIdleeDRXAllowedSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the inter-RAT ping-pong handover suppression for NR cells. If it is set to Open, the serving cell starts the ping-pong handover suppression timer for the UEs that are handed over to NR cells. Before the timer times out, the UEs cannot be handed over to the source NR cells.
item.name: nRPingPongHoSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the SA adaptation of DSS frequency bands. In an SA scenario, if UEs trigger handover/redirection and dedicated reselection for the frequency bands that do not support DSS, the throughput in the DSS cells is affected. If this parameter is set to Open, UEs are not allowed to trigger handover/redirection and dedicated reselection for the frequency bands that do not support DSS, thus improving the performance of the DSS cells.
item.name: dssBandAdaptSASwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for suppressing inter-RAT NR ping-pong handover. It is used to prevent the ping-pong handover of UEs between LTE and NR cells. When a UE is handed over from an NR cell (cell A) to an LTE cell (cell B), the ping-pong handover suppression timer is started in cell B. Before the timer times out, the UE cannot be handed over to cell B. This parameter takes effect when inter-RAT NR ping-pong handover suppression is enabled.
item.name: nRPingPongHoTimer

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the joint decision policy for functional intra-RAT handover. It is a three-dimensional array and the three elements form a joint decision policy for the following three functions: load balancing-based handover, voice service-based handover of the WCP, and uplink heavy-traffic service-based handover. If an element is set to RSRP Trig, the eNodeB triggers the joint decision policy only for the measurement reports of the function whose triggering variable is RSRP. If an element is set to RSRQ Trig, the eNodeB triggers the joint decision policy only for the measurement reports of the function whose triggering variable is RSRQ. If an element is set to RSRP Trig and RSRQ Trig, the eNodeB triggers the joint decision policy for the measurement reports of the function whose triggering variables are both RSRP and RSRQ.
item.name: intraRFuncHOUnitJudgSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the joint decision policy for functional intra-RAT handover. If it is set to Based Service Cell and Neighbor Cell Measurement Result, the measurement results of both the serving cell and its neighbor cells need to be considered in the joint decision for functional intra-RAT handover. If it is set to Based Neighbor Cell Measurement Result, only the measurement results of neighbor cells need to be considered in the joint decision for functional intra-RAT handover.
item.name: intraRFuncHOUnitJudgStgy

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of joint handover decisions based on the measurement results of the serving cell and its neighbor cells. When receiving a measurement report of the corresponding handover function, the eNodeB records the number of measurement reports. The eNodeB can execute the joint decision policy only when the number of measurement reports is smaller than or equal to the value of this parameter and the current measurement report is not the last one. If this parameter is set to 0xFF (255), it indicates that the maximum number of times that the joint handover decision is executed is infinite, that is, the number of times is not restricted.
item.name: hOUnitJudgExeNumThrd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables frequency-level measurement configuration for directional migration of SA UEs. It is used to determine whether the frequency-level measurement configuration policy takes effect on the directional migration of SA UEs. If it is set to Open, the frequency-level measurement configuration takes effect. If it is set to Close, the original system-level measurement configuration takes effect.
item.name: sADirectMigFMeasCfgSwch

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the antenna calibration mode on the eNodeB side is non-constant-modulus correction or constant-modulus correction. If it is set to 1, non-constant-modulus correction is used. In this case, amplitude calibration is implemented only when the downlink MU or SRS transmission-by-turns function is enabled. If it is set to 0, constant-modulus correction is used. In this case, non-constant-modulus amplitude compensation is not implemented on the BBU side no matter whether the uplink or downlink MU or SRS transmission-by-turns function is enabled on the EMS.
item.name: aCMode

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to suppress the migration of UEs to traffic guidance cells based on the service rates. It is used for traffic guidance. If it is set to Open, LTE cells determine whether to suppress the migration of UEs in different periods to the NR cells with traffic guidance enabled based on the service rates of the UEs. If it is set to Close, LTE cells suppress the migration of all the UEs to the NR cells with traffic guidance enabled regardless of the service rates and periods.
item.name: rateNRGuidIntelPreSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times to consecutively determine downlink rate evaluation periods. It is used to identify the service rate status if traffic guidance and aggregation mode selection are enabled. If the number of consecutive times that the downlink incoming PDCP packet rate of a UE is lower than or equal to the value of the DL PDCP Rate Threshold for UE Migration parameter reaches this parameter value, the UE is regarded as a UE with a low service rate.
item.name: guidUEDLRateEvalPeriNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink PDCP rate threshold for UEs if traffic guidance and aggregation mode selection are enabled. If the downlink PDCP service rate of a UE in consecutive N (number of periods for evaluating the downlink PDCP service rate of a UE) evaluation periods is lower than or equal to this threshold, the UE is regarded as a UE with a low service rate. In this case, it is more difficult for the UEs to be migrated. If the downlink PDCP service rate of a UE in an evaluation period is higher than this threshold, the UE is regarded as a UE whose service rate is not low. In this case, it is easier for the UEs to be migrated.
item.name: guidanceDLPDCPRateThd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the adaptive diagonal loading factor of PUSCH IRC. If it is set to Open, the IRC algorithm uses an adaptive loading factor for the PUSCH. If there is interference in the environment, the demodulation performance of the PUSCH is stable. If there is no interference in the environment, the demodulation performance is close to that when the MRC algorithm is used. If this parameter is set to Close, the IRC algorithm uses a fixed loading factor for the PUSCH.
item.name: iRCAdaptFlag

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum noise floor. If the Adaptive Diagonal Loading Factor Switch of IRC parameter is set to Open, this parameter can be set to the maximum estimated value, depending on the actual noise level of the environment.
item.name: iRCPniminNormal

item.desc: This parameter sets the IOT threshold for the adaptive diagonal loading factor of PUSCH IRC. It is an array with five elements. The five element values of this parameter are in ascending order, dividing the possible IOT values into six ranges. If the Adaptive Diagonal Loading Factor Switch of IRC parameter is set to Open, the corresponding diagonal loading factor can be selected based on the range into which the IoT value falls.
item.name: iRCDiagIOT

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables TA protection for the PUSCH. If it is set to Open, the PUSCH protects the estimated TA value and compensates the TA value. If it is set to Close, the PUSCH uses the original estimated TA value for TA compensation.
item.name: tAProFlag

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold preset for TA value protection. If TA protection is enabled and the absolute value of the difference between the old TA value and the current estimated TA value is smaller than the parameter value, the current estimated TA value is used to compensate for the frequency domain data.
item.name: tAThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the peak-to-average ratio of the power spectrum in the TA time domain. If TA protection is enabled and the calculated peak-to-average ratio of the power spectrum in the TA time domain is higher than the parameter value, the current estimated TA value is used to compensate for the frequency domain data. Otherwise, the old TA value is used to compensate for the frequency domain data.
item.name: thrpapr

item.desc: This parameter sets the TA value protection threshold preset for MSG3 or MSG5 messages. If TA protection is enabled and the absolute value of the current estimated TA value for MSG3 or MSG5 messages is larger than the parameter value, the protection value is used to limit the current estimated TA value.
item.name: tAamp

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the PUSCH can estimate the time domain TA value. If it is set to Open, the PUSCH converts frequency domain data into time domain data, and uses a time domain algorithm to estimate the TA value. If it is set to Close, the PUSCH uses frequency domain data and a frequency domain algorithm to estimate the TA value.
item.name: tATimeEstFlag

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables periodic inter-RAT NR measurement of the MR function. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB can periodically measure the service frequencies of NR neighbor cells and the configured extra NR frequencies by using MR tasks.
item.name: nrPeriodMeasSwitch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables PUSCH 16x16 IRC. If it is set to Open, inverse transformation of 16x16 diagonal matrix on PUSCH 16-antenna data is performed. If it is set to Close, inverse transformation of two 8x8 diagonal matrices on PUSCH 16-antenna data is performed.
item.name: pusch16multi16IRC

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables orthogonal projection of the TMM/FMM PUSCH. If it is set to Open, the orthogonal projection matrix of the PUSCH is calculated to suppress noise. If it is set to Close, the original processing procedure is used.
item.name: prjFlag

item.desc: This parameter sets the pre-compensated TA value for the TMM/FMM PUSCH before filtering. In the calculation of the orthogonal projection matrix for the PUSCH, this parameter is used for TA pre-compensation.
item.name: tAComp

item.desc: This parameter sets the coefficient index of 1-flow and 2-flow NI filters of the TMM/FMM PUSCH. If orthogonal projection of PUSCH is enabled and the number of PUSCH flows is less than or equal to 2, different filter window lengths can be selected based on this parameter value.
item.name: firInd12layer

item.desc: This parameter sets the coefficient index of 3-flow and 4-flow NI filters of the TMM/FMM PUSCH. If orthogonal projection of PUSCH is enabled and the number of PUSCH flows is larger than 2, different filter window lengths can be selected based on this parameter value.
item.name: firInd34layer

item.desc: This parameter sets the IOT threshold of TMM/FMM PUSCH interference projection. If the IOT value of the PUSCH is larger than the threshold, interference projection is enabled. If the IOT value of the PUSCH is smaller than or equal to the threshold, interference projection is disabled.
item.name: thIOT

item.desc: This parameter sets the eigenvalue threshold of the number of TMM/FMM PUSCH interference projections. When the PUSCH eigenvalue is larger than the threshold, the number of interference projections is incremented by one. When the PUSCH eigenvalue is smaller than or equal to the threshold, the number of interference projections remains unchanged.
item.name: thY

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the redirection to NR systems can be triggered for the UEs with QCI1 services. If it is set to 0 (Close), the redirection to NR systems cannot be triggered for the UEs with QCI1 services. If it is set to 1 (Open), the redirection to NR systems can be triggered for the UEs with QCI1 services.
item.name: nRQCI1RedSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the directional handover of high-speed UEs to NR cells. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB allows to trigger handover or redirection of high-speed UEs to only high-speed NR cells. If it is set to Close, the eNodeB allows to trigger handover or redirection of high-speed UEs to high-speed or low-speed NR cells.
item.name: nRDireHOBasedHSpeedSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables PRACH interference suppression. If it is set to Open, the PRACH restricts the amplitude of the interference with RBs. If it is set to Close, the PRACH does not restrict the amplitude of the interference with RBs.
item.name: prachInterfSupresFlg

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of PRACH interference suppression. If the amplitude factor value of PRACH RBs is larger than this threshold, interference with PRACH RBs is not suppressed. If the amplitude factor value of PRACH RBs is smaller than this threshold, interference with PRACH RBs is suppressed.
item.name: prachInterfSupresThr

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables PUCCH 8x8 IRC. If it is set to Open, inverse transformation of 8x8 diagonal matrix on PUCCH 8-antenna data is performed. If it is set to Close, inverse transformation of two 4x4 diagonal matrices on PUCCH 8-antenna data is performed.
item.name: pucch8multi8IRC

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables DCI0Lost detection after PUSCH equalization. If it is set to Open, the optimization algorithm after PUSCH equalization is used to calculate the SINR for DCI0Lost detection. If it is set to Close, the pilot measurement-based algorithm is used to calculate the SINR for DCI0Lost detection.
item.name: aftEqDci0DetSwitch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables HARQ weighted-combination after PUSCH equalization. If it is set to Open, HARQ weighted-combination and then IDFT processing are performed in turn on the data processed through PUSCH equalization. If it is set to Close, IDFT processing is performed on the data processed through PUSCH equalization.
item.name: aftEqHarqWeightingSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable UE migration for energy saving by traffic guidance. If it is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB enables the policy of periodically migrating UEs for energy saving by traffic guidance. If it is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB disables the policy of periodically migrating UEs for energy saving by traffic guidance.
item.name: eCGuidMigSwch

item.desc: This parameter is an array with 96 elements, used for setting the UE migration policies for energy saving by traffic guidance for 96 periods in one day. The 24 hours of one day are divided into 96 15-minute time periods. The elements of the array, starting from the first one, respectively represent the UE migration policies for energy saving by traffic guidance in the 15-minute periods starting from 00:00. If an element of the array is set to a specific Migration Policy Index for Energy Saving by Traffic Guidance in the Traffic Guidance Policy table, the index is associated with a unique set of traffic guidance policy for energy saving. If an element is set to 0, it indicates that the UE migration policy for energy saving by traffic guidance is disabled.
item.name: eCGuidMigStgCfg

item.desc: This parameter determines whether to prevent UEs from moving to the cells where services are unavailable. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB can prevent UEs from moving to the cells where services are unavailable. If it is set to Close, the eNodeB does not prevent UEs from moving to the cells where services are unavailable. In this case, the service continuity of the UEs may be affected.
item.name: preMobToNoServCellSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to suppress ping-pong handover of the VoNR UEs at the cell edge. If it is set to Open and the difference between the measured value that is reported by a UE and supports VoNR neighbor cells and the maximum measured value that does not support VoNR neighbor cells is smaller than the difference threshold of a neighbor cell to suppress ping-pong handover of cell-edge VoNR UEs, the handover or redirection of the UE to the NR neighbor cell is suppressed. If this parameter is set to Close, the handover or redirection of the UE to the NR neighbor cell is not suppressed.
item.name: voNRBoundPreSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the difference threshold of neighbor cells to suppress ping-pong handover of the VoNR UEs at the cell edge. If the Switch for Suppressing Ping-Pong Handover of Cell-Edge VoNR UEs parameter is set to Open and the difference between the measured value that is reported by a UE and supports VoNR neighbor cells and the maximum measured value that does not support VoNR neighbor cells is smaller than this threshold, the handover or redirection of the UE to the NR neighbor cell is suppressed.
item.name: voNRBouPreNboffsetThrd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the IMMCI function based on special UEs. Special UEs refer to those whose capability does not meet a certain condition, for example, the UEs that do not support VoNR. If this parameter is set to Open, after identifying a special UE, the eNodeB delivers a specified dedicated reselection frequency and frequency priority to the UE.
item.name: specUEbasedIMMCISwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the index of the IMMCI configuration policy of the UEs that do not support VoNR. It is used to index the IMMCI configuration policy that is delivered to the UEs that do not support VoNR.
item.name: refIdleMobilityProfileLTE

item.desc: This parameter sets the strategy for selecting target neighbor cells during coverage-based intra-LTE movement and handover. It is valid only for the UEs that support 5G frequencies. If it is set to General Strategy, the eNodeB selects the target neighbor cell for UE handover based on the RSRP or RSRQ value. If this parameter is set to Enhance Strategy, the eNodeB selects the target neighbor cell for UE handover based on the proportion of the number of RRC-connected UEs, RSRP, and RSRQ.
item.name: coverUnitJudgStrategy

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion threshold of the number of UEs in the target cell for coverage-based movement and handover. It is valid only for the UEs that support 5G frequencies. During coverage-based movement and handover, the UE preferentially selects the neighbor cell whose proportion of the number of RRC-connected UEs is smaller than or equal to the parameter value as the target cell for the handover.
item.name: hoTargCellUeNumRatioThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the forbidden NR frequencies for the UEs that do not support VoNR. It is an array parameter consisting of eight elements, each of which indicates an NR frequency. If an element is set to 0, it indicates that no NR frequency is specified by this element. If a UE that does not support VoNR triggers a migration procedure from a 4G cell to a 5G cell, the frequencies specified by this array parameter cannot be used as the target for the migration of the UE.
item.name: ref1EnbAdjFreqNRLTE

item.desc: This parameter sets the list of NR frequencies to which the UEs with VoLTE services cannot be redirected. A maximum of eight frequencies can be configured. If the CellMobilityFDDLTE. NRQCI1RedSwch (Switch of QCI1 Redirection to NR) parameter is set to Open, the frequencies in the frequency list cannot be used as the target frequencies of the UEs with VoLTE services when the UEs trigger redirection to the NR system. If the items in the list are all set to 0, it indicates that no frequency is forbidden to serve as the target frequency for redirection.
item.name: ref2EnbAdjFreqNRLTE

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables SPID functions of service-based handover. It is used to control whether to apply service-based handover policies for SPID UEs. If the hoBaseServiceSwch parameter is set to General Strategy and this parameter is set to Open, the eNodeB applies the service-based handover policies for SPID UEs.
item.name: hOBaseServiceSpidSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the redirection of UEs when the waiting time for service-based handover measurement expires. If this parameter is set to Open, the eNodeB redirects UEs to the target frequency when the service-based measurement waiting timer expires. If this parameter is set to Close, the eNodeB deletes the inter-frequency measurement configurations delivered for the service-based handover.
item.name: hOBaseSrvMeasExpRedSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink PRB usage threshold of target cells for the handover based on uplink big-packet services. If the bigSRVHOWhrConsidNbLoadUL (Whether to Consider Neighbor Cell Load in UL Big Service-Based Handover) parameter is set to Yes, the eNodeB does not select the neighbor cell for which the downlink PRB usage is higher than this parameter value as the target cell when receiving a measurement report for the handover based on uplink big-packet services.
item.name: uLBigSRVHOTarDLPRBThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink PRB usage threshold of target cells for the handover based on downlink big-packet services. The eNodeB does not select the neighbor cell for which the uplink PRB usage is higher than this parameter value as the target cell when receiving a measurement report for the handover based on downlink big-packet services.
item.name: dLBigSRVHOTarULPRBThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the aggregation mode selection function uses the cells with the best coverage. In the scenario where the eNodeB performs aggregation mode selection and multiple cells on the same frequency meet the coverage conditions: If this parameter is set to True, the eNodeB selects only the cell with the best coverage on this frequency as the target cell for aggregation mode selection, reducing the delay caused by cell aggregation mode selection. If this parameter is set to False, the eNodeB selects all the cells that meet the coverage conditions as the target cells for aggregation mode selection.
item.name: aggModeBestCellInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the RSRP difference threshold of neighbor cells for ping-pong handover prevention to avoid intra-frequency NR interference on cell boundaries. It is used to prevent UEs from being handed over between NR cells and LTE cells frequently. This parameter is an array consisting of three elements. Element 0 sets the RSRP difference threshold of outdoor cells or macrocells for ping-pong handover suppression. Element 1 sets the RSRP difference threshold of indoor cells or microcells for ping-pong handover suppression. Element 2 sets the RSRP difference threshold of the neighbor cells supporting SA for ping-pong handover suppression. In the scenario where element 0 of the intraFBdIFPrePingPongInd (Ping-Pong Handover Prevention Policy Indication to Avoid Intra-Frequency Interference on Cell Boundaries) parameter is set to 1 (Yes) and there are both indoor NR neighbor cells and outdoor NR neighbor cells or macro NR neighbor cells and micro NR neighbor cells present in the measurement reports:(1) In the measurement report of a UE, if the difference between the measured RSRP value of an outdoor neighbor cell/macro neighbor cell and that of the strongest-coverage indoor neighbor cell/micro neighbor cell is smaller than the value of element 0 of this parameter, the eNodeB prevent the UE from being migrated to the outdoor neighbor cell/macro neighbor cell. (2) In the measurement report of a UE, if the difference between the measured RSRP value of an indoor neighbor cell/micro neighbor cell and that of the strongest-coverage outdoor neighbor cell/macro neighbor cell is smaller than the value of element 1 of this parameter, the eNodeB prevent the UE from being migrated to the indoor neighbor cell/micro neighbor cell. If the coverageTypePolicy (Cell Coverage Type Identification Policy) parameter is set to 0 (Macro/Micro Cell Coverage Type), this parameter is valid for only macro neighbor cells and micro neighbor cells. If the coverageTypePolicy (Cell Coverage Type Identification Policy) parameter is set to 1 (Indoor/Outdoor Cell Coverage Type), this parameter is valid for only indoor and outdoor neighbor cells. In the scenario where element 2 of the intraFBdIFPrePingPongInd (Ping-Pong Handover Prevention Policy Indication to Avoid Intra-Frequency Interference on Cell Boundaries) parameter is set to 1 (Yes) and there are both NR neighbor cells supporting SA and NR neighbor cells supporting NSA only present in the measurement reports: In the measurement report of a UE, if the difference between the measured RSRP value of a neighbor cell supporting SA and that of the strongest-coverage neighbor cell supporting NSA only is smaller than the value of element 2 of this parameter, the eNodeB prevent the UE from being migrated to the neighbor cell supporting SA.
item.name: intraFBdIFPreNbRSRPDifTd

item.desc: This parameter sets whether a different or inter-RAT SRVCC frequency is preferentially selected when the eNodeB delivers a measurement task by using the voice quality-based migration function. If this parameter is set to 0 (Inter-Frequency at a Higher Priority), the eNodeB puts the measurement IDs of different frequencies ahead of those of inter-RAT SRVCC frequencies when delivering measurement tasks by using the voice quality-based migration function. If this parameter is set to 1 (SRVCC Inter-RAT at a Higher Priority), the eNodeB puts the measurement IDs of inter-RAT SRVCC frequencies ahead of those of different frequencies when delivering measurement tasks by using the voice quality-based migration function.
item.name: voiceQualMeasRatPriStgy

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for preventing ping-pong handover for voice-service UEs. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. The first element is the timer for preventing ping-pong handovers of voice-service UEs between LTE neighbor cells, and the second element is the timer for preventing ping-pong handovers of voice-service UEs between LTE and NR neighbor cells. If a voice-service UE is handed over from cell A to cell B, the ping-pong handover suppression timer of the system corresponding to cell A is started when the ping-pong handover suppression policy takes effect in cell B (that is, the current serving cell). Before the timer expires, the voice-service UE is not allowed to be handed over back to cell A.
item.name: pingPongTmrVoice

item.desc: This parameter determines whether the NoHO indication of LTE and NR neighbor cells is valid for the UEs with voice services. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the NoHO indication of LTE and NR neighbor cells is valid for the UEs with voice services, that is, the handover to the LTE and NR neighbor cells with the NoHO indication is not triggered for the UEs with voice services. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the NoHO indication of LTE and NR neighbor cells is invalid for the UEs with voice services, that is, the handover to the LTE and NR neighbor cells with the NoHO indication can be triggered for the UEs with voice services.
item.name: nbCellNoHOVoiceEffSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the consecutive number of times that a UE is identified as an uplink-dominated or downlink-dominated UE. Suppose that this parameter is set to n. If the uplink traffic of a UE is higher than or equal to the first element of the adwSerDirDeciTraAbsThrd[2] (Absolute Traffic Threshold for Dominated-Service-Direction Identification) parameter consecutive n times and the ratio of the uplink traffic to the downlink traffic is larger than the first element of the aucSerDirDeciTraPropoThrd[2] (Traffic Ratio Threshold for Dominated-Service-Direction Identification) parameter, the UE is identified as an uplink-dominated UE. If the downlink traffic of a UE is higher than or equal to the second element of the adwSerDirDeciTraAbsThrd[2] (Absolute Traffic Threshold for Dominated-Service-Direction Identification) parameter consecutive n times and the ratio of the downlink traffic to the uplink traffic is larger than the second element of the aucSerDirDeciTraPropoThrd[2] (Traffic Ratio Threshold for Dominated-Service-Direction Identification) parameter, the UE is identified as a downlink-dominated UE. If a UE does not meet the conditions for uplink-dominated or downlink-dominated UE identification consecutive n times, it is identified as other UEs.
item.name: serDirDeciContiNumThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the absolute traffic threshold for determining the dominated-service direction. It is an array consisting of two elements and used to identify uplink-dominated or downlink-dominated UEs. If the uplink traffic of a UE is higher than or equal to the first element of this parameter within a statistical period, it indicates that the UE meets one of the conditions of the uplink-dominated direction. If the downlink traffic of a UE is higher than or equal to the second element of this parameter within a statistical period, it indicates that the UE meets one of the conditions of the downlink-dominated direction.
item.name: serDirDeciTraAbsThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the traffic ratio threshold for determining the dominated-service direction. It is an array consisting of two elements and used to identify uplink-dominated or downlink-dominated UEs. If the ratio of the uplink traffic of a UE to the downlink traffic is larger than the first element of this parameter within a statistical period, it indicates that the UE meets one of the conditions of the uplink-dominated direction. If the ratio of the downlink traffic of a UE to the uplink traffic is larger than the second element of this parameter within a statistical period, it indicates that the UE meets one of the conditions of the downlink-dominated direction.
item.name: serDirDeciTraPropoThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets a list of QCIs to prevent UEs that subscribe to these QCI services from periodic measurement. The eNodeB does not deliver periodic measurement tasks to UEs that have subscribed to these QCI services. This parameter is an array parameter consisting of 16 elements. The element value 0 indicates no QCI service, 1 indicates QCI 1, 2 indicates QCI 2, and so on. If a UE has subscribed to at least one QCI service that is included in the list, the eNodeB does not deliver periodic measurement tasks to the UE.
item.name: periodMeasFbdQciInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the inter-frequency measurement duration. When the measurement duration of a delivered inter-frequency measurement information exceeds this threshold, the inter-frequency measurement information is deleted. If this parameter is set to 65535, it indicates that periodic delivery or deletion of inter-frequency measurement information is disabled. In this case, inter-frequency measurement information always exists.
item.name: interFMeasDurationThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the interval before retrying another inter-frequency measurement. When the interval after inter-frequency measurement information is deleted reaches this threshold, inter-frequency measurement information is re-delivered.
item.name: interFMeaRetryWaitTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of inter-frequency measurement retries if data quality-based migration is enabled. When the number of measurement retries reaches this parameter value, the measurement retry procedure stops. If this parameter is set to 65535, it indicates that the number of retries is not restricted.
item.name: interFMeasRetryTimes

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables data quality-based migration. If it is set to 1 (Open), data quality-based migration is enabled. In this case, the UEs with poor user perception in a cell are migrated to the neighbor cells with better user perception. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), data quality-based migration does not take effect. In the current version, data quality-based migration in the uplink only is supported.
item.name: dataQualMigSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the list of the types of UEs to be migrated based on data quality. It is used to determine which types of UEs can be migrated based on data quality. If a UE is marked with the type configured by this parameter, data quality-based migration takes effect for the UE. Data quality-based migration can take effect for not only the UEs of the type configured by this parameter but also the LTE UEs whose main services are uplink services.
item.name: dataQualMigTypeList

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of poor uplink channel quality of EN-DC UEs if data quality-based migration is enabled. It is used to evaluate whether the uplink rate of an EN-DC UE is low. If the sum of the uplink rate of a UE in the MN and that of the UE in the SN is smaller than the threshold, it is considered that the uplink rate of the UE is low. A low uplink rate of an EN-DC UE is one of the conditions for triggering data quality-based migration.
item.name: dataQualMigEndcRateThrdUl

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of poor uplink LTE channel quality if data quality-based migration is enabled. It is used to evaluate whether the uplink rate of an LTE UE or an EN-DC UE in an LTE cell is low. If the uplink rate of an LTE UE or an EN-DC UE in an LTE cell is smaller than the threshold, it is considered that the uplink rate of the UE is low. A low uplink rate of an LTE UE or an EN-DC UE in an LTE cell is one of the conditions for triggering data quality-based migration.
item.name: dataQualMigLteRateThrdUl

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the uplink data blocking rate if data quality-based migration is enabled. It is used to determine whether the uplink data of a UE blocks. If the uplink data blocking rate of an LTE UE or an EN-DC UE in an LTE cell is higher than or equal to the threshold, it is considered that the uplink data of the UE blocks. Uplink data blocking occurring on an LTE UE or an EN-DC UE in an LTE cell is one of the conditions for triggering data quality-based migration.
item.name: dataQualMigLteBlkThrdUl

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of times that a UE is identified as a UE with poor user perception to trigger data quality-based migration. It is an array consisting of two elements and used to determine whether the user perception of a UE is poor. If a UE meets the conditions of poor user perception consecutive m times, data quality-based migration can be triggered for the UE. If the UE does not meet the conditions of poor user perception any longer consecutive n times, data quality-based migration cannot be triggered for the UE. The value of m is configured by the first element of this parameter, and n is configured by the second element of this parameter.
item.name: dataQualMigBadJudNumThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the QCI service list of the UEs for which the data quality-based migration function is disabled. It is used to disable the data quality-based migration function for the UEs with certain types of QCI services. If a UE carries a QCI service configured by this parameter, data quality-based migration does no take effect for the UE. If an array element is set to 1, it indicates that data quality-based migration is disabled for the UEs with the QCI1 service; if an array element is set to 2, it indicates that data quality-based migration is disabled for the UEs with the QCI2 service, and so forth. If an array element is set to 0, it indicates that no QCI service is disabled.
item.name: dataQualMigSerForbidList

item.desc: This parameter sets the migration priority of intra-frequency neighbor cells if data quality-based migration is enabled. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority. If this parameter is set to 0, it indicates that UEs are not migrated to intra-frequency neighbor cells when the data quality-based migration function is enabled.
item.name: dataQualMigIntraFPrio

item.desc: This parameter sets the migration priority of inter-frequency neighbor cells if data quality-based migration is enabled. A larger parameter value indicates a higher priority. If this parameter is set to 0, it indicates that UEs are not migrated to the corresponding inter-frequency neighbor cells when the data quality-based migration function is enabled.
item.name: dataQualMigInterFPrio

item.desc: This parameter sets the relative threshold of user perception of neighbor cells if the data quality-based handover function is enabled. If the difference between the user perception of a neighbor cell and that of the serving cell is larger than the threshold, it is considered that the user perception of the neighbor cell is better than that of the serving cell.
item.name: dataQualMigPerRelThrd

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the inter-frequency measurement retry policy for data quality-based migration. If it is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB periodically delivers and deletes inter-frequency measurement information to prevent user traffic from being affected by inter-frequency measurement gaps over a long period of time. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the policy does not take effect and inter-frequency measurement always exists.
item.name: datQuaInterFMeasRetrySwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the collection of measurement reports of multiple frequencies. It is an array consisting of 16 elements. Element 0 represents the directional-migration function of SA UEs, element 1 represents the SN addition function in EN-DC scenarios, and elements 2 through 15 are reserved. If an element is set to 1 (Open), it indicates that the corresponding function is enabled. In this case, the eNodeB collects the measurement reports of multiple frequencies and selects the optimal frequency to perform related operations in accordance with the corresponding measurement report. If an element is set to 0 (Close), it indicates that the corresponding function is disabled. In this case, when receiving a measurement report of a frequency, the eNodeB performs related operations in accordance with the measurement report.
item.name: mulFreqMeasCollectSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration for collecting the measurement reports of multiple frequencies. When receiving a measurement report of a non-optimal frequency, the eNodeB starts this timer. During the operation of the timer, when the eNodeB receives a measurement report of an optimal frequency, it stops the timer and performs related operations in accordance with the measurement report. If no measurement report of an optimal frequency is received during this period, the eNodeB selects a sub-optimal frequency from the buffered measurement reports after the timer expires.
item.name: mulFreqMeasCollectTimer

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the interoperation function for SA UEs to be migrated to 5G networks. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the following functions can be enabled for UEs: migration from 4G to 5G based on coverage, fast return, directional migration in SA scenarios, and IMMCI-based directional migration in SA scenarios for idle UEs. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the following functions are disabled for UEs: migration from 4G to 5G based on coverage, fast return, directional migration in SA scenarios, and IMMCI-based directional migration in SA scenarios for idle UEs.
item.name: sAInterOperSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of uplink SINR differences between antennas. It is an array consisting of two elements. The first element represents the low threshold of the uplink SINR differences between antennas, and the second element represents the high threshold of the uplink SINR differences between antennas. The two element values determine the SINR difference ranges that can be used to determine whether there are antenna cross-connections between cells.
item.name: ulSinrDeltaThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the QM threshold for UE filtering in cross-connection detection of antennas. If the crossConnChkSwitch (Antenna Cross-Connection Detection Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB selects the UEs that meet the following conditions and determines whether there are cross connections of antennas in the cell based on the SNR values of the UEs:1) The modulation order used by the desired UE is larger than or equal to the value of this parameter.2) The number of RBs used by the desired UE is larger than or equal to the crossConnChkRBThr (Threshold Number of RBs for UE Filtering in Antenna Cross-Connection Detection) parameter.
item.name: crossConnChkQmThr

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables inter-cell antenna cross-connection detection. If it is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB automatically detects whether there are cross connections between the antennas of different cells.
item.name: crossConnChkSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of RBs for UE filtering in cross-connection detection of antennas. If the crossConnChkSwitch (Antenna Cross-Connection Detection Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB selects the UEs that meet the following conditions and determines whether there are cross connections of antennas in the cell based on the SNR values of the UEs:1) The number of RBs used by the desired UE is larger than or equal to this parameter value.2) The modulation order used by the desired UE is larger than or equal to the crossConnChkQmThr (QM Threshold for UE Filtering in Antenna Cross-Connection Detection) parameter.
item.name: crossConnChkRbThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration for periodic inter-cell antenna cross-connection detection. If the ucCrossConnChkSwitch (Antenna Cross-Connection Detection Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB collects statistics on the differences in the SINR values between antennas within the period specified by this parameter to determine whether there are antenna cross-connections in the current cell.
item.name: crossConnChkTimeLen

item.desc: This parameter sets the percentage threshold of the number of samples for cross-connection detection of antennas. Within the duration for cross-connection detection of the antennas, the eNodeB counts the number of samples reported by each antenna. The SINR differences between an antenna and the antenna corresponding to port0 fall into specified ranges. If the proportion of the total number of samples that fall into a specified range to the total number of samples of all the antennas of a cell is larger than or equal to the parameter value, it is considered that there may be cross connections of antennas in the cell. Otherwise, it is considered that there is no antenna cross-connection in the cell.
item.name: crossConnChkSampleThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the percentage threshold for cross-connection detection of antennas. Within a period of antenna cross-connection detection, if the proportion of the number of samples where there may be cross connections of antennas in a cell to the total number of samples is larger than or equal to the parameter value, it is determined that there are cross connections of antennas in the cell.
item.name: crossConnChkResultThr

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to migrate the highway UEs in the overlapping coverage areas between a private high-speed railway network and a public network out of the private high-speed railway network. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), in the overlapping coverage areas between a private high-speed railway network and a public network, highway UEs enter the private high-speed railway network and occupy resources, affecting the experience of high-speed railway users. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), in the overlapping coverage areas between a private high-speed railway network and a public network, highway UEs can be migrated out of the private high-speed railway network, ensuring the experience of high-speed railway users.
item.name: hstUeHoSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of RRC-connected UEs to determine whether a high-speed train enters a private high-speed railway network. It takes effect when the hstUeHoSwitch (Switch for Migrating Highway UEs out of a Private High-Speed Railway Network) parameter is set to 1 (Open). If the number of RRC-connected UEs in a cell of a private high-speed railway network is larger than or equal to this threshold, it is considered that a high-speed train enters the private high-speed railway network.
item.name: hstRrcTrainInThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of RRC-connected UEs to determine whether a high-speed train leaves a private high-speed railway network. It takes effect when the hstUeHoSwitch (Switch for Migrating Highway UEs out of a Private High-Speed Railway Network) parameter is set to 1 (Open). If the number of RRC-connected UEs in a cell of a private high-speed railway network is smaller than or equal to this threshold, it is considered that a high-speed train leaves the private high-speed railway network.
item.name: hstRrcTrainOutThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for determining whether a high-speed train completely leaves a cell of a private high-speed railway network. It takes effect when the hstUeHoSwitch (Switch for Migrating Highway UEs out of a Private High-Speed Railway Network) parameter is set to 1 (Open). When the eNodeB detects that a high-speed train leaves a cell in a private high-speed railway network, this timer is started. When the timer expires, it is considered that the high-speed train completely leaves the cell.
item.name: hstTrainOutTimeThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for determining low-speed UEs in a private high-speed railway network. It is used to prevent high-speed railway UEs from being mistakenly identified as low-speed UEs when a high-speed train leaves a cell of a private high-speed railway network. It takes effect when the hstUeHoSwitch (Switch for Migrating Highway UEs out of a Private High-Speed Railway Network) parameter is set to 1 (Open). When the timer specified by the hstTrainOutTimeThr (Timer for Outgoing Decision of High-Speed Trains) parameter expires, this timer is started if there are high-speed railway UEs or UEs whose speeds have not been determined yet in the cells of a private high-speed railway network. During the operation of the timer, if all the high-speed trains leave the cells of the private high-speed railway network, it is considered that all the UEs in the private high-speed railway network are low-speed UEs. If the eNodeB detects that a train is entering the private high-speed railway network after all the high-speed trains leave the cells of the private high-speed railway network, it determines whether the speed of a UE is low based on the movement speed of the UE. After the timer expires, the eNodeB migrates all the low-speed UEs out of the private high-speed railway network.
item.name: lowSpeedJudgeDelay4Hst

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to evaluate the channel quality of the EN-DC UEs configured with SNs and trigger data quality-based migration for the UEs if data quality-based migration is enabled. If this parameter is set to 1 (Yes), the eNodeB evaluates the channel quality of the EN-DC UEs configured with SNs and triggers data quality-based migration for the UEs. If this parameter is set to 0 (No), the eNodeB does not evaluate the channel quality of the EN-DC UEs configured with SNs or trigger data quality-based migration for the UEs.
item.name: dataQualMigEndcSeleInd

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to perform inter-frequency migration on the UEs expect those with the services of specific general QoS types. When a cell receives a notification that is triggered by the UEs with the services of specific general QoS types and indicates that other UEs (that is, the UEs except those with the services of specific general QoS types) need to be migrated to inter-frequency neighbor cells: If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB migrates other UEs from the serving cell to inter-frequency neighbor cells; if this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB does not migrate other UEs from the serving cell to inter-frequency neighbor cells. The services of specific general QoS types refer to the QoS services corresponding to the elements whose values are 1 in the trigInterFMigQosType (Type of General QoS Service Triggering Inter-Frequency Migration) array parameter.
item.name: qosTypeTrigInterFMigSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables PUSCH Rnn optimization. It is valid when the iRCAdaptFlag (Adaptive Diagonal Loading Factor Switch of IRC) parameter is set to 1. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the demodulation performance of the RBs that are not interfered can be improved.
item.name: rnnNormSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to disable some eNodeB services in the corresponding special scenarios to meet the service management and control requirements in case of emergency such as cyberbullying. It consists of five elements. From left to right, the five elements correspond to the voice service, IP SMS, data service, video service, and CSFB service in turn. If an element is set to 1, it indicates that the corresponding service is disabled. If an element is set to 0, it indicates that the corresponding service is enabled. For example, if this parameter is set to 00000, it indicates that all the five services are enabled. If this parameter is set to 00001, it indicates that the first four services are enabled, and the CSFB service is disabled.
item.name: specialFuncSwchBitmap

item.desc: This parameter sets the frequency priorities of uplink SCells in CA scenarios. It is an array parameter consisting of 16 elements that correspond to the priorities of the uplink SCells on the frequencies specified by the interCarriFreq (Inter-frequency Carrier) parameter respectively. A larger parameter value indicates that the eNodeB can more preferentially add the cells on the corresponding frequency as the uplink SCells of UEs. If an element is set to 0, it indicates that the eNodeB cannot configure the cells on the corresponding frequency as the uplink SCells of UEs.
item.name: scellFreqPriorityUl

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to train the spectrum efficiency prediction model. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the cell collects data and trains the spectrum efficiency prediction model for spectrum efficiency estimation. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the cell does not collect data or train the spectrum efficiency prediction model.
item.name: sEPredSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the period for updating the spectrum efficiency prediction model. It is the sum of the duration for data collection, model training, and model application in a spectrum efficiency prediction of a cell. This parameter is valid when the sEPredSwch (Spectrum Efficiency Prediction Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open).
item.name: sEPredModelUpdatePeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the total data collection duration for predicting the spectrum efficiency of a cell. If the sEPredSwch (Spectrum Efficiency Prediction Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open), this parameter indicates the duration for data collection within a period specified by the sEPredModelUpdatePeriod (Period for Updating the Spectrum Efficiency Prediction Model) parameter.
item.name: sEPredDataCollDuration

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables equivalent-SINR evaluation in initial-primary-path selection for uplink split bearers. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB evaluates the equivalent uplink SINRs of the LTE cells for initial SN addition in EN-DC scenarios so that the gNodeB can reference the SINR values when selecting the initial primary paths of split bearers for uplink data splitting. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB does not evaluate the equivalent uplink SINRs of the LTE cells.
item.name: priPathInfoDeliverSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables coverage-based migration based on user perception. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB triggers a procedure for migrating an uplink-dominated UE to a cell with better uplink user perception than the serving cell after receiving an intra-frequency or inter-frequency measurement report on coverage from the UE. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the uplink user perception of neighbor cells is not referenced when the eNodeB triggers a UE migration procedure after receiving an intra-frequency or inter-frequency measurement report on coverage.
item.name: covMobBasedPerceptSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the type of UE that can be migrated based on user perception through a coverage-based migration procedure. For an NSA UE (that is, the UE configured with an SN), if the UE is marked with the type specified by this parameter and the direction corresponding to this type is uplink, the UE is applicable to the perception-based coverage-based migration policy (that is, the UE is considered to be a target UE of the policy). After receiving the intra-frequency or inter-frequency measurement reports from the target UEs of the perception-based coverage-based migration policy, the eNodeB migrates the UEs to the neighbor cells whose user perception is better than that of the serving cell. If this parameter is set to 0 (Invalid), no NSA UE of the type specified by this parameter is selected as the target UE of the perception-based coverage-based migration policy.
item.name: covMobBasedPerceptMigType

item.desc: This parameter sets the relative threshold of uplink user perception of neighbor cells if the coverage-based migration function is enabled. After receiving an intra-frequency or inter-frequency measurement report on coverage-based migration, the eNodeB triggers a handover procedure only when the difference between the predicted user perception of the neighbor cell and that of the serving cell is larger than or equal to this threshold.
item.name: covNCPerceptRelThrdUl

item.desc: This parameter sets the time interval for a UE to periodically trigger measurement reporting when a measurement event for perception-based coverage-based migration is triggered. For a UE, when an event is triggered, the UE reports measurement results at the interval specified by this parameter.
item.name: covMobBasedPerceRptIntvl

item.desc: This parameter sets a neighbor cell evaluation strategy in aggregation mode selection. If this parameter is set to 0 (based on traffic weight), it indicates that neighbor cells are evaluated based on the cell bandwidth, subframe ratio, and number of MIMO layers in aggregation mode selection. If this parameter is set to 1 (base on perception), it indicates that neighbor cells are evaluated based on channel quality, antenna port, and load information in aggregation mode selection.
item.name: aggreModeSelCombEvaStgy

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable handovers to special neighbor cells based on CGI-based measurement. It is an array parameter consisting of eight elements. Element 0 indicates the CGI measurement-based coverage handover indicator of intra-RAT neighbor cells with confused PCIs, element 1 indicates the CGI measurement-based coverage handover indicator of intra-RAT neighbor cells with unknown PCIs (excluding the neighbor cells with confused PCIs), and other array elements are reserved. If an element is set to 0 (No), the eNodeB triggers a normal procedure of handover or redirection to the corresponding neighbor cells. If an element is set to 1 (Yes), the eNodeB preferentially executes a procedure of CGI measurement-based handover to the corresponding neighbor cells. For the UEs that do not support or cannot trigger CGI measurement-based handover, the eNodeB executes a CGI measurement-based redirection procedure if it is configured with redirection execution.
item.name: specNbCellCGIMeasHOInd

item.desc: This parameter sets a policy for cell coverage type identification. If this parameter is set to 0 (Macro/Micro Cell Coverage Type), the eNodeB identifies a cell as a macro cell or a micro cell. If this parameter is set to 1 (Indoor/Outdoor Cell Coverage Type), the eNodeB identifies a cell as an indoor cell or an outdoor cell.
item.name: coverageTypePolicy

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration for collecting the measurement reports of multiple frequencies in voice quality-based handover. When the eNodeB receives a measurement report on a voice quality-based handover procedure, it starts the timer based on the parameter value. Before the timer expires, the eNodeB caches the received measurement reports. When the timer times out, the eNodeB selects the frequency measurement report with the highest priority from the cached measurement reports to perform a handover procedure. If this parameter is set to 1, 2, or 3, it indicates that the duration for collecting measurement reports is one second, two seconds, or three seconds respectively. If this parameter is set to 0, it indicates that the multi-frequency measurement report collection policy is disabled for voice quality-based handover.
item.name: vTQuaMeasCollectTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of times that a Handover Command message is retransmitted. If no status report corresponding to the Handover Command message is received from the RLC layer of the eNodeB, the RLC layer retransmits the message and the number of times that the message is retransmitted cannot be larger than the parameter value.
item.name: maxRetxThrdForHoCmd

item.desc: This parameter sets whether the coverage-based mobility indication of intra-LTE neighbor cells is valid for VoLTE UEs. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the coverage-based mobility indication of intra-LTE neighbor cells is valid for the VoLTE UEs. In this case, the intra-LTE neighbor cells for which the noSupMobilitySwch (Switch for Not Support Mobility Based Cover) parameter is set to 1 (Open) are not selected as the target cells for coverage-based handover or redirection of the VoLTE UEs. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the coverage-based mobility indication of intra-LTE neighbor cells is invalid for the VoLTE UEs. In this case, the intra-LTE neighbor cells for which the noSupMobilitySwch (Switch for Not Support Mobility Based Cover) parameter is set to 1 (Open) can be selected as the target cells for coverage-based handover and redirection of the VoLTE UEs.
item.name: nbCellCovMobVoiceEffSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the period for counting the number of times that a UE is handed over between the local cell and a neighbor cell.
