It is used to determine the relation between the local cell and its neighbor cells. Within the period specified by this parameter, if the number of times that a UE is handed over between the local cell and a neighbor cell is larger than the threshold specified by the dwCellAssRelNbrHoNumThrd (Threshold Number of Times That a UE Is Handed Over Between the Local Cell and an Associated Neighbor Cell) parameter, the eNodeB determines that the neighbor cell is a closely associated neighbor cell of the local cell. If the number of times that a UE is handed over between the local cell and a neighbor cell is smaller than the threshold specified by the dwCellAssRelNbrHoNumThrd parameter, the eNodeB determines that the neighbor cell is not a closely associated neighbor cell of the local cell.
item.name: cellAssRelHoNumColPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of times that a UE is handed over between the local cell and a neighbor cell. It is used to determine the relation between the local cell and its neighbor cells. Within the period specified by the dwCellAssRelHoNumColPeriod (Period for Counting the Number of Times That a UE Is Handed Over Between the Local Cell and an Associated Neighbor Cell) parameter, if the number of times that a UE is handed over between the local cell and a neighbor cell is larger than this threshold, the eNodeB determines that the neighbor cell is a closely associated neighbor cell of the local cell. If the number of times that a UE is handed over between the local cell and a neighbor cell is smaller than this threshold, the eNodeB determines that the neighbor cell is a not a closely associated neighbor cell of the local cell.
item.name: cellAssRelNbrHoNumThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of intra-frequency neighbor cells that can perform inter-frequency migration triggered by UEs with general-QoS services. If the qoSTypTrigIntraFNbMigSwch (Switch for Intra-Frequency Neighbor Cell Notification In Inter-Frequency Migration Triggered by UEs with General-QoS Services) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and there are guaranteed UEs in the local cell, the eNodeB instructs the local cell and its intra-frequency neighbor cells to perform inter-frequency migration to migrate non-guaranteed UEs when performing inter-frequency migration. Assume that this parameter is set to N and the number of intra-frequency neighbor cells closely associated with the local cell is set to M. If M is larger than N, the eNodeB notifies N intra-frequency neighbor cells where a large number of handovers occur. If M is smaller than or equal to N, the eNodeB notifies M intra-frequency neighbor cells.
item.name: qoSTypeTrigMigIntraFNbNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for ping-pong handover prevention if inter-frequency migration triggered by UEs with general-QoS services is enabled. When a UE is migrated to the local cell, this timer is started. Before the timer expires, the eNodeB does not migrate the UE back to the source cell. If this parameter is set to 0, the timer is not started.
item.name: qosTypTrgMigPrePPTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for migrating UEs if inter-frequency migration triggered by UEs with general-QoS services is enabled. When inter-frequency migration triggered by UEs with general-QoS services takes effect, the eNodeB starts this timer and performs inter-frequency migration. When the timer expires, the eNodeB stops migrating UEs.
item.name: qosTypTrgMigTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for triggering NSA UE migration with a delay if inter-frequency migration triggered by UEs with general-QoS services is enabled. If inter-frequency migration triggered by UEs with general-QoS services takes effect, this timer is started when a UE supporting inter-frequency migration is connected to the local cell. The UE cannot be migrated while the timer is running. When the timer expires, the UE can be migrated.
item.name: nsaUeMigDelayTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for triggering LTE UE migration with a delay if inter-frequency migration triggered by UEs with general-QoS services is enabled. If inter-frequency migration triggered by UEs with general-QoS services takes effect, this timer is started when a UE not supporting inter-frequency migration is connected to the local cell. The UE cannot be migrated while the timer is running. When the timer expires, the UE can be migrated.
item.name: lteUeMigDelayTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the UEs that have general-QoS services and need to be guaranteed during inter-frequency migration triggered by the UEs with general-QoS services. It is an array parameter consisting of seven elements. Elements 0 through 6 set whether to guarantee the UEs with the services of general-QoS type 1 to type 7. If an element is set to 1, it indicates that the UEs with this type of service are guaranteed and cannot be migrated to inter-frequency neighbor cells. If an element is set to 0, it indicates that the UEs with this type of service are not guaranteed and may be migrated to inter-frequency neighbor cells.
item.name: interFMigFbdQosType

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of UEs migrated to different frequencies within the period of the inter-frequency migration triggered by the UEs with general-QoS services. Within the period specified by the (Period of Inter-Frequency Migration Triggered by UEs with General-QoS Services) parameter, the number of UEs to be migrated cannot exceed the parameter value.
item.name: qosTypeTrigPeriodMigUeNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the period (in seconds) of the inter-frequency migration triggered by the UEs with general-QoS services. Within the period specified by this parameter, the number of UEs migrated by the eNodeB cannot exceed the value specified by the ucQosTypeTrigPeriodMigUeNum (Maximum Number of UEs in Inter-Frequency Migration Triggered by UEs with General-QoS Services) parameter.
item.name: qosTypeTrigMigPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to suppress ping-pong handover if UE migration based on boundary intra-frequency NR interference is enabled. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. Element 0 sets whether to suppress ping-pong handover to avoid interference on the boundaries between indoor and outdoor neighbor cells or macro neighbor cells and micro neighbor cells. Element 1 sets whether to suppress ping-pong handover to avoid interference on the boundaries between SA cells and NSA cells. If element 0 is set to 1 (Yes), the migration of UEs to inter-RAT target NR cells is suppressed based on the values of elements 0 and 1 of the intraFBdIFPreNbRSRPDifTd (RSRP Difference Threshold for Ping-Pong Handover Prevention to Avoid Intra-Frequency Interference on Cell Boundaries) parameter. Otherwise, the eNodeB does not restrict the migration of UEs to inter-RAT target NR cells. If the coverageTypePolicy (Cell Coverage Type Identification Policy) parameter is set to 0 (Macro/Micro Cell Coverage Type), the target cells are macro neighbor cells or micro neighbor cells. If the coverageTypePolicy (Cell Coverage Type Identification Policy) parameter is set to 1 (Indoor/Outdoor Cell Coverage Type), the target cells are indoor neighbor cells or outdoor neighbor cells. If element 1 is set to 1 (Yes), the migration of UEs to inter-RAT NR neighbor cells that support SA scenarios is suppressed based on the value of element 2 of the intraFBdIFPreNbRSRPDifTd (RSRP Difference Threshold for Ping-Pong Handover Prevention to Avoid Intra-Frequency Interference on Cell Boundaries) parameter. Otherwise, the eNodeB does not restrict the migration of UEs to inter-RAT NR neighbor cells that support SA scenarios.
item.name: intraFBdIFPrePPInd

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum number of CA UEs with general-QoS services for the serving cell to trigger the SCells to perform inter-frequency migration. If the QosTypCaUeTrgSCellMigSwch (Switch for SCell Notification in Inter-Frequency Migration Triggered by CA UEs with General-QoS Services) parameter is set to 1 (Open), inter-frequency migration triggered by CA UEs with general-QoS services is being performed in the PCell, and this parameter is set to N, a maximum of N CA UEs with general-QoS services can trigger inter-frequency migration in the associated SCells.
item.name: qosTypSCellMigGrtCaUeNum

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable SCell notification if inter-frequency migration triggered by CA UEs with general-QoS services is enabled. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open) and there are CA UEs that use the current cell as the PCell and have the services of specific general-QoS types, the eNodeB instructs the SCells of such CA UEs to perform inter-frequency migration. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB does not instruct the SCells of the CA UEs with the services of specific general-QoS types to perform inter-frequency migration.
item.name: qosTypCaUeTrgSCellMigSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables intra-frequency neighbor cell detection for the UEs with general-QoS services. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the UEs with general-QoS services detect whether there are intra-frequency neighbor cells nearby. If there are intra-frequency neighbor cells, the eNodeB identifies them as interfering neighbor cell. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the UEs with general-QoS services do not detect whether there are intra-frequency neighbor cells nearby.
item.name: typUeDetectIntraFNbrSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable cell notification if inter-frequency migration triggered by UEs with general-QoS services is enabled. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open) and there are guaranteed UEs in the local cell, the eNodeB instructs the local cell and the intra-frequency neighbor cells closely associated with the local cell to perform inter-frequency migration to migrate non-guaranteed UEs when performing inter-frequency migration. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB does not instruct the local cell or its intra-frequency neighbor cells to perform inter-frequency migration.
item.name: qosTypeNotifyCellMigSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to validate an operator-defined EPLMN. It is an array consisting of five elements. Element 0 sets whether to validate an operator-defined EPLMN for the GERAN. If it is set to 1 (Open), the gNodeB can select the serving PLMN, EPLMN specified by the core network, or operator-defined EPLMN to trigger a handover or redirection to the GERAN for a UE with a Handover Restriction List (HRL). If this element is set to 0 (Close), the gNodeB selects only the serving PLMN or the EPLMN specified by the core network to trigger a handover or redirection to the GERAN. The other elements are reserved.
item.name: custEPLMNSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the Mobile Country Codes (MCCs) of equivalent PLMNs customized by the operator. It is an array parameter consisting of six elements. Elements 0 through 5 set the MCCs of PLMN1 through PLMN6 respectively. A PLMN is jointly determined by a Mobile Network Code (MNC) and an MCC.
item.name: custEquivalentMcc

item.desc: This parameter sets the Mobile Network Codes (MNCs) of equivalent PLMNs customized by the operator. It is an array parameter consisting of six elements. Elements 0 through 5 set the MNCs of PLMN1 through PLMN6 respectively. A PLMN is jointly determined by an MNC and a Mobile Country Code (MCC).
item.name: custEquivalentMnc

item.desc: This parameter sets the timer for intra-frequency neighbor cells that are detected by the UEs with general-QoS services to migrate the UEs to inter-frequency neighbor cells. In the case that the typUeDetectIntraFNbrSwch (Switch for Intra-Frequency Neighbor Cell Detection by UEs with General-QoS Services) parameter is set to 1 (Open), when a UE with general-QoS services detects that there is an intra-frequency neighbor cell nearby, the eNodeB instructs the intra-frequency neighbor cell to migrate the UE to an inter-frequency neighbor cell and starts this timer. When the timer expires, the eNodeB instructs the intra-frequency neighbor cell to stop UE migration.
item.name: typUeDetIntraFNbrTimer

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables RLC mode compatibility for VoLTE UEs. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), during an inter-eNodeB handover or re-establishment procedure, full configuration is used in the first reconfiguration message of the handover or re-establishment and the RLC mode of the QCI1 service carried by the target eNodeB takes effect in the case that the RLC mode of the QCI1 service carried by the source eNodeB is AM and that carried by the target eNodeB is UM.
item.name: voLTERlcModeComSwch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables uplink subframe shutdown. If it is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB checks whether to shut down some uplink scheduling subframes in the cell based on the PRB usage to increase the uplink throughput of the cell.
item.name: ulForbidSfnSchdSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the period during which uplink subframe shutdown is triggered and then stopped. It is valid if the ulForbidSfnSchdSwitch (Uplink Subframe Shutdown Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open).
item.name: ulForbidSfnSchdPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of uplink subframes that need to be shut down in a frame.
item.name: ulForbidSfnNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the high proportion threshold for uplink subframe shutdown. It is used to check whether the cell exits uplink subframe shutdown. If the ulForbidSfnSchdSwitch (Uplink Subframe Shutdown Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the uplink PRB usage of the cell where subframe shutdown is triggered is higher than the threshold within the period specified by the ulForbidSfnSchdSwitch (Period for Uplink Subframe Shutdown) parameter, the cell exits uplink subframe shutdown in the next period.
item.name: uLForbidSfnHighRatioThr

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables initial VoLTE service admission control in service-based handover. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB allows to admit the QCI1 and QCI2 services carried in the initial context setup messages. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB forbids admitting the QCI1 or QCI2 services carried in the initial context setup messages.
item.name: initialVoiceAdmtSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable uplink subframe shutdown for the UEs with special services. It is used to control whether the scheduling of the UEs with some special services is forbidden if the ulForbidSfnSchdSwitch parameter is set to 1 (Open). It is an array parameter consisting of eight elements. Element 0 sets whether to forbid scheduling the VoLTE UEs with SR, SRB, or BSR services. Element 1 sets whether to forbid scheduling the UEs with ping-layer services. Elements 2 through 7 set whether to forbid scheduling the UEs with type1 through type6 general-QoS services. If the ulForbidSfnSchdSwitch parameter is set to 1 (Open) and an element is set to 1, the UEs with the corresponding service cannot be scheduled. If an element is set to 0, the UEs with the corresponding service can be scheduled properly.
item.name: uLFlagForDiffServices

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to filter CA UEs in the case that handover triggered by big-packet UEs is enabled. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. Element 0 sets whether to filter CA UEs in the case that handover triggered by uplink big-packet UEs is enabled. Element 1 sets whether to filter CA UEs in the case that handover triggered by downlink big-packet UEs is enabled. If an element is set to 1 (Open), CA UEs are filtered in the case that the corresponding function is enabled, that is, the corresponding function is disabled for CA UEs. If an element is set to 0 (Close), CA UEs are not filtered in the case that the corresponding function is enabled, that is, the corresponding function is enabled for CA UEs. CA UEs refer to the UEs configured with CA SCells.
item.name: bigSrvHOFilterCASwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the dynamic traffic proportion for uplink subframe shutdown. A larger parameter value indicates that uplink subframe shutdown is more likely to be triggered.
item.name: uLForbidSfnDynratio

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables SINR measurement enhancement. It is used to improve the accuracy of SINR measurement in the scenarios with low SINR values or interference. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), SINR values can be measured more accurately.
item.name: sinrEnhSwitch

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables DCI0Lost detection for the PUSCH based on SINR measurement enhancement. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB detects whether DCI0Lost occurs based on SINR measurement enhancement. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the pilot measurement-based algorithm is used to calculate the SINR for DCI0Lost detection.
item.name: sinrEnhDci0DetSwitch

item.desc: If SINR measurement enhancement is enabled, this parameter sets whether to check the validity of an intra-frequency neighbor cell. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the impact of all the intra-frequency neighbor cells needs to be considered during SINR calculation enhancement (that is, improvement in the accuracy of SINR value calculation). If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), only the impact of intra-frequency neighbor cells with the same PCI Mod3 value needs to be considered during SINR calculation enhancement.
item.name: eqSinrInvalidMod3Switch

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of intra-frequency neighbor cells that needs to be considered for SINR measurement enhancement. It is used to improve the accuracy of SINR measurement.If this parameter is set to 0, the impact of intra-frequency neighbor cells is not considered during SINR measurement enhancement. If this parameter is set to a non-zero value N (ranging from 1 through 10), the impact of the N intra-frequency neighbor cells on the SINR measurement result of the local cell needs to be considered during SINR measurement enhancement.
item.name: infCellNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the speed threshold of UEs when DCI0Lost occurs in the case that SINR detection enhancement is enabled. It is used to control whether UEs at different speeds can trigger this function.
item.name: sinrEnhDci0DetSpeedThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold adjustment coefficient for DCI0Lost detection in the case that SINR detection enhancement is enabled. It is used to improve the accuracy of DCI0Lost detection.
item.name: sinrEnhDci0DetAlpha

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to hand over UEs back to NR cells based on aggregation mode selection. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB hands over a UE back to an NR cell a period after the gNodeB hands over the UE from the NR cell to an LTE cell based on NR aggregation mode selection. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the function does not take effect.
item.name: aggreModeBackNrSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the SINR threshold coefficient of soft combining based on SINR measurement enhancement for the UEs in overlapping areas in CoMP scenarios. It is used to improve the accuracy of soft combining for PUSCH demodulation.
item.name: sinrEnhCombSinrThr

item.desc: For the UEs in overlapping areas in CoMP scenarios, this parameter sets whether to enable soft combining for PUSCH demodulation by using the SINR values whose calculation accuracy is enhanced (that is, SINR measurement enhancement). If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), soft combining is performed for PUSCH demodulation based on SINR measurement enhancement to improve the accuracy of soft combining for the UEs in overlapping areas. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the SINR values whose calculation accuracy is not enhanced are used in soft combining for PUSCH demodulation.
item.name: sinrEnhCombSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the SINR threshold coefficient of soft combining based on SINR measurement enhancement in CoMP scenarios. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. Element 0 and element 1 set the MCS thresholds of the UEs with the capability level of 64QAM and 256QAM respectively. If the capability level of a UE is 64QAM or 256QAM and the MCS value of the UE is larger than the corresponding MCS threshold, the RB-level SINR values (SINR values varying with RBs) whose calculation accuracy is enhanced (SINR measurement enhancement) are used for soft combining. Otherwise, the average SINR value (average of the SINR values of RBs) whose calculation accuracy is enhanced is used for soft combining.
item.name: sinrEnhCombMcsThr

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to migrate RedCap UEs to NR cells. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements and is used to configure the handover and redirection policies of the eNodeB for RedCap UEs. It is an array parameter consisting of two elements. Element 0 sets whether the eNodeB can hand over RedCap UEs to NR cells. If this element is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB can hand over RedCap UEs to NR cells. If this element is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB cannot hand over RedCap UEs to NR cells. Element 1 sets whether the eNodeB can redirect RedCap UEs to NR cells. If this element is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB can redirect RedCap UEs to NR cells. If this element is set to 0 (Close), the eNodeB cannot redirect RedCap UEs to NR cells.
item.name: redCapUeNRCtrSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the CA UE filtering policy in the case that UE location-based migration is enabled. If this parameter is set to 1 (Filter users with CA capabilities), the UE location-based migration function is disabled for the UEs with CA capabilities. If this parameter is set to 2 (Filter added CA users), the UE location-based migration function is disabled for the UEs configured with SCells.
item.name: migBasePosiFilterCAStgy

item.desc: This parameter sets the frequency filtering policy based on CA capabilities in the case that UE location-based migration is enabled. If this parameter is set to 1 (Filter frequency not support CA), the UEs whose serving frequencies support CA are not migrated to the frequencies that do not support CA. If this parameter is set to 2 (Filter frequency not support CA and lower CA capabilities), the UEs whose serving frequencies support CA are not migrated to the target frequencies that do not support CA and where the number of downlink combined CA carriers is smaller than or equal to that of the serving frequency. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the policy is disabled.
item.name: posiMigFltFreqBasedCACap

item.desc: This parameter sets a service type filtering list for UE location-based migration. It is an array parameter consisting of six elements. Each element sets a service type of UEs for which the UE location-based migration function does not take effect. The value 0 indicates that there is no corresponding service type. If the service type of a UE is in the list specified by this parameter, the UE location-based migration function is disabled for the UE.
item.name: migBaseUEPosiFltType

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enhance the Msg5 decoding capability of UEs. If the swchDAdjCqiMode (BITA Decoding Capability Switch) parameter is set to Open and this parameter is set to Open, the system enhances the Msg5 decoding capability of UEs to improve the success rate of receiving Msg 5 messages.
item.name: msg5UeEnhanSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of times that continuously transmitted uplink large BSRs are marked in the case that TTIB transmission is enabled. It is used to control the TTIB transmission deactivation policy. When the number of large BSRs continuously sent by a UE in the uplink reaches or exceeds this threshold, the system triggers the TTIB transmission deactivation function to reduce the power consumption of the UE and optimize the use of radio resources.
item.name: ulContinueBigNumThr4Ttib

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for determining large-BSR UEs based on the proportion of large BSRs of UEs. It is used to identify large-BSR UEs. If the proportion of large BSRs reported by a UE in a statistical window exceeds the threshold, the UE is identified as an uplink large-BSR UE.
item.name: ulBigBsrRatioThr4Ttib

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold for determining the UEs with large BSRs if the TTIB transmission function is enabled. It is used to effectively identify the UEs with a requirement for large data volume during TTIB transmission. If the LCG3 BSR value of a UE exceeds this threshold, the system identifies the UE as a UE with large BSRs. If this parameter is set to 0, it indicates that the large-BSR identification function is disabled during TTIB transmission.
item.name: ulBigBsrThr4Ttib

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables uplink baseband equalization optimization. If this parameter is set to 1 (Open), the baseband processing board enables the equalization optimization algorithm to increase uplink traffic. If this parameter is set to 0 (Close), the baseband processing board disables the equalization optimization algorithm.
item.name: equOptSwitch

item.desc: Full Distinguished Name
item.name: FDN

item.desc: Date Time
item.name: DATETIME

item.desc: Collection period of measurement task.
item.name: granularityPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the string type and can be configured as planned.
item.name: id

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the string type and can be configured as planned.
item.name: moId

item.desc: This parameter sets the index of a PLMN group in a network sharing scenario.
item.name: pLMNGroupIndex

item.desc: This parameter sets the Mobile Country Codes (MCCs) of the PLMNs in a PLMN group in network sharing scenarios of operators. It is an array parameter consisting of a maximum of six elements. All the PLMNs specified by this array parameter share the bandwidth resources allocated by the eNodeB.
item.name: mcclist

item.desc: This parameter sets the Mobile Network Codes (MNCs) of the PLMNs in a PLMN group in network sharing scenarios of operators. It is an array parameter consisting of a maximum of six elements. All the PLMNs specified by this array parameter share the bandwidth resources allocated by the eNodeB.
item.name: mnclist

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion of bandwidth resources that can be used by the PLMNs in the current PLMN group in a network sharing scenario.
item.name: ratioOperatorGroupn

item.desc: Full Distinguished Name
item.name: FDN

item.desc: Date Time
item.name: DATETIME

item.desc: Collection period of measurement task.
item.name: granularityPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: id

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the container type and is fixedly set to 1.
item.name: moId

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables load-based spectrum orchestration for cells. If it is set to Open, the eNodeB migrates UEs from a spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell to a basic-coverage cell if all the following conditions are met within consecutive sOrchTrigJudgeNum (Number of Times for Determining Load Conditions for UE Migration from a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell) periods: (1) The load of the spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell is low. (2) The load of the spectrum-orchestrated NR cell is high. (3) The load of the basic-coverage cell is low.
item.name: loadBasedSOrchSwch

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion threshold of the number of UEs that can be migrated from a spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell to the current basic-coverage cell. The current basic-coverage cell can serve as a low-load candidate target cell for UE migration only when all the following conditions are met: (1) The proportion of the number of UEs in the cell group consisting of the spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell and the basic-coverage cell is smaller than the parameter value. (2) The downlink PRB usage is lower than sOrchLTETgtDLPRBThrd (Load Decision Threshold of the DL PRB Usage in a Spectrum-Orchestrated Target LTE Cell). (3) The uplink PRB usage is lower than sOrchLTETgtULPRBThrd (Load Decision Threshold of the UL PRB Usage in a Spectrum-Orchestrated Target LTE Cell).
item.name: sOrchLTETgtUENumRtThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink PRB usage threshold of the current basic-coverage cell. It is used to determine whether the current basic-coverage cell can be selected as the target for UE migration from a spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell. The current basic-coverage cell can serve as a low-load candidate target cell for UE migration only when all the following conditions are met: (1) The proportion of the number of UEs in the cell group consisting of the spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell and the basic-coverage cell is smaller than sOrchLTETgtUENumRtThrd (Load Decision Threshold for the Proportion of the Number of UEs in a Spectrum-Orchestrated Target LTE Cell). (2) The downlink PRB usage is lower than sOrchLTETgtDLPRBThrd (Load Decision Threshold of the DL PRB Usage in a Spectrum-Orchestrated Target LTE Cell). (3) The uplink PRB usage is lower than the parameter value.
item.name: sOrchLTETgtULPRBThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink PRB usage threshold of the current basic-coverage cell. It is used to determine whether the current basic-coverage cell can be selected as the target for UE migration from a spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell. The current basic-coverage cell can serve as a low-load candidate target cell for UE migration only when all the following conditions are met: (1) The proportion of the number of UEs in the cell group consisting of the spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell and the basic-coverage cell is smaller than sOrchLTETgtUENumRtThrd (Load Decision Threshold for the Proportion of the Number of UEs in a Spectrum-Orchestrated Target LTE Cell). (2) The downlink PRB usage is lower than the parameter value. (3) The uplink PRB usage is lower than sOrchLTETgtULPRBThrd (Load Decision Threshold of the UL PRB Usage in a Spectrum-Orchestrated Target LTE Cell).
item.name: sOrchLTETgtDLPRBThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the lower proportion threshold of the number of UEs in a spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell to trigger UE migration. The migration of UEs to a basic-coverage cell with low load or no load can be triggered only when all the following conditions are met within consecutive sOrchTrigJudgeNum (Number of Times for Determining Load Conditions for UE Migration from a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell) periods: (1) The proportion of the number of UEs in the spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell is smaller than the parameter value. (2) The downlink PRB usage is lower than sOrchLTEDLPRBLowThrd (Lower Threshold of the DL PRB Usage for Triggering UE Migration from a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell). (3) The uplink PRB usage is lower than sOrchLTEULPRBLowThrd (Lower Threshold of the UL PRB Usage for Triggering UE Migration from a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell). (4) The load of the spectrum-orchestrated NR cell is high.
item.name: sOrchLTEUENumRtLowThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the lower threshold of the uplink PRB usage for triggering UE migration from a spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell. The migration of UEs to a basic-coverage cell with low load or no load can be triggered only when all the following conditions are met within consecutive sOrchTrigJudgeNum (Number of Times for Determining Load Conditions for UE Migration from a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell) periods: (1) The proportion of the number of UEs in the spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell is smaller than sOrchLTEUENumRtLowThrd (Lower Proportion Threshold of the Number of UEs in a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell to Trigger UE Migration). (2) The downlink PRB usage is lower than sOrchLTEDLPRBLowThrd (Lower Threshold of the DL PRB Usage for Triggering UE Migration from a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell). (3) The uplink PRB usage is lower than the parameter value. (4) The load of the spectrum-orchestrated NR cell is high.
item.name: sOrchLTEULPRBLowThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the lower threshold of the downlink PRB usage for triggering UE migration from a spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell. The migration of UEs to a basic-coverage cell with low load or no load can be triggered only when all the following conditions are met within consecutive sOrchTrigJudgeNum (Number of Times for Determining Load Conditions for UE Migration from a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell) periods: (1) The proportion of the number of UEs in the spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell is smaller than sOrchLTEUENumRtLowThrd (Lower Proportion Threshold of the Number of UEs in a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell to Trigger UE Migration). (2) The downlink PRB usage is lower than the parameter value. (3) The uplink PRB usage is lower than sOrchLTEULPRBLowThrd (Lower Threshold of the UL PRB Usage for Triggering UE Migration from a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell). (4) The load of the spectrum-orchestrated NR cell is high.
item.name: sOrchLTEDLPRBLowThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion threshold of the number of UEs in a spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell to trigger UE migration. The migration of UEs to a low-load basic-coverage cell can be triggered only when all the following conditions are met within consecutive sOrchTrigJudgeNum (Number of Times for Determining Load Conditions for UE Migration from a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell) periods: (1) The proportion of the number of UEs in the spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell is smaller than the parameter value. (2) The downlink PRB usage is lower than sOrchLTEDLPRBThrd (DL PRB Usage Threshold for Triggering UE Migration from a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell). (3) The uplink PRB usage is lower than sOrchLTEULPRBThrd (UL PRB Usage Threshold for Triggering UE Migration from a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell). (4) The load of the spectrum-orchestrated NR cell is high.
item.name: sOrchLTEUENumRtThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the uplink PRB usage for triggering UE migration from a spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell. The migration of UEs to a low-load basic-coverage cell can be triggered only when all the following conditions are met within consecutive sOrchTrigJudgeNum (Number of Times for Determining Load Conditions for UE Migration from a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell) periods: (1) The proportion of the number of UEs in the spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell is smaller than sOrchLTEUENumRtThrd (Proportion Threshold of the Number of UEs in a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell to Trigger UE Migration). (2) The downlink PRB usage is lower than sOrchLTEDLPRBThrd (DL PRB Usage Threshold for Triggering UE Migration from a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell). (3) The uplink PRB usage is lower than the parameter value. (4) The load of the spectrum-orchestrated NR cell is high.
item.name: sOrchLTEULPRBThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the downlink PRB usage for triggering UE migration from a spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell. The migration of UEs to a low-load basic-coverage cell can be triggered only when all the following conditions are met within consecutive sOrchTrigJudgeNum (Number of Times for Determining Load Conditions for UE Migration from a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell) periods: (1) The proportion of the number of UEs in the spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell is smaller than sOrchLTEUENumRtThrd (Proportion Threshold of the Number of UEs in a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell to Trigger UE Migration). (2) The downlink PRB usage is lower than the parameter value. (3) The uplink PRB usage is lower than sOrchLTEULPRBThrd (UL PRB Usage Threshold for Triggering UE Migration from a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell). (4) The load of the spectrum-orchestrated NR cell is high.
item.name: sOrchLTEDLPRBThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion threshold of the number of UEs in a spectrum-orchestrated NR cell. It is used for determining whether the load of the spectrum-orchestrated NR cell is high. It is considered that the load of a spectrum-orchestrated NR cell is high if all the following conditions are met: (1) The proportion of the number of UEs in the spectrum-orchestrated NR cell is larger than or equal to the parameter value. (2) The downlink PRB usage is higher than or equal to sOrchNRDLPRBThrd (Load Decision Threshold of the DL PRB Usage in a Spectrum-Orchestrated NR Cell). (3) The uplink PRB usage is higher than or equal to sOrchNRULPRBThrd (Load Decision Threshold of the UL PRB Usage in a Spectrum-Orchestrated NR Cell).
item.name: sOrchNRUENumRtThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the uplink PRB usage in a spectrum-orchestrated NR cell. It is used for determining whether the load of the spectrum-orchestrated NR cell is high. It is considered that the load of a spectrum-orchestrated NR cell is high if all the following conditions are met: (1) The proportion of the number of UEs in the spectrum-orchestrated NR cell is larger than or equal to sOrchNRUENumRtThrd (Load Decision Threshold for the Proportion of the Number of UEs in a Spectrum-Orchestrated NR Cell). (2) The downlink PRB usage is higher than or equal to sOrchNRDLPRBThrd (Load Decision Threshold of the DL PRB Usage in a Spectrum-Orchestrated NR Cell). (3) The uplink PRB usage is higher than or equal to the parameter value.
item.name: sOrchNRULPRBThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the downlink PRB usage in a spectrum-orchestrated NR cell. It is used for determining whether the load of the spectrum-orchestrated NR cell is high. It is considered that the load of a spectrum-orchestrated NR cell is high if all the following conditions are met: (1) The proportion of the number of UEs in the spectrum-orchestrated NR cell is larger than or equal to sOrchNRUENumRtThrd (Load Decision Threshold for the Proportion of the Number of UEs in a Spectrum-Orchestrated NR Cell). (2) The downlink PRB usage is higher than or equal to the parameter value. (3) The uplink PRB usage is higher than or equal to sOrchNRULPRBThrd (Load Decision Threshold of the UL PRB Usage in a Spectrum-Orchestrated NR Cell).
item.name: sOrchNRDLPRBThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion threshold of the number of UEs in a basic-coverage cell for waking up a spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell. If one of the following conditions is met within consecutive sOrchWUPJudgeNum (Number of Times for Waking Up a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell) periods, the spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell is waken up: (1) The proportion of the number of UEs in the basic-coverage cell is larger than or equal to the parameter value. (2) The downlink PRB usage is higher than or equal to sOrchLTEWUPDLPRBThrd (Load Decision Threshold of the DL PRB Usage for Waking Up a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell). (3) The uplink PRB usage is higher than or equal to sOrchLTEWUPULPRBThrd (Load Decision Threshold of the UL PRB Usage for Waking Up a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell).
item.name: sOrchLTEWUPRRCRtThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the uplink PRB usage threshold of a basic-coverage cell for waking up a spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell. If one of the following conditions is met within consecutive sOrchWUPJudgeNum (Number of Times for Waking Up a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell) periods, the spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell is waken up: (1) The proportion of the number of UEs in the basic-coverage cell is larger than or equal to sOrchLTEWUPRRCRtThrd (Proportion Threshold of the Number of UEs for Waking Up a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell). (2) The downlink PRB usage is higher than or equal to sOrchLTEWUPDLPRBThrd (Load Decision Threshold of the DL PRB Usage for Waking Up a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell). (3) The uplink PRB usage is higher than or equal to the parameter value.
item.name: sOrchLTEWUPULPRBThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the downlink PRB usage threshold of a basic-coverage cell for waking up a spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell. If one of the following conditions is met within consecutive sOrchWUPJudgeNum (Number of Times for Waking Up a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell) periods, the spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell is waken up: (1) The proportion of the number of UEs in the basic-coverage cell is larger than or equal to sOrchLTEWUPRRCRtThrd (Proportion Threshold of the Number of UEs for Waking Up a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell). (2) The downlink PRB usage is higher than or equal to the parameter value. (3) The uplink PRB usage is higher than or equal to sOrchLTEWUPULPRBThrd (Load Decision Threshold of the UL PRB Usage for Waking Up a Spectrum-Orchestrated LTE Cell).
item.name: sOrchLTEWUPDLPRBThrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times that the triggering of UE migration from a spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell is determined. The migration of a UE from a spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell to a basic-coverage cell can be triggered only when all the following conditions are met within consecutive N (specified by this parameter) decision periods of UE migration triggering: (1) The load of the spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell is low. (2) The load of the spectrum-orchestrated NR cell is high. (3) There is a basic-coverage cell that can be used as the candidate target cell.
item.name: sOrchTrigJudgeNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times that the wakeup of a spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell is determined. It is used to wake up the spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell if the load of the basic-coverage cell is high within consecutive N (specified by this parameter) wakeup decision periods.
item.name: sOrchWUPJudgeNum

item.desc: This parameter sets how to migrate the UEs from a spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell. If this parameter is set to Based Measurement, a UE is handed over preferentially based on the measurement report or is blindly redirected after the timer for the spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell to wait for the measurement report from the UE (specOrchLTEMeasWaitTimer) expires when the UE is to be migrated from the spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell to a basic-coverage cell. If this parameter is set to Blind Redirection, blind redirection is performed when a UE is migrated from a spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell to a basic-coverage cell.
item.name: specOrchLTEMigMethod

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration of the timer for a spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell to wait for the measurement result reported by a UE after the cell delivers a migration measurement task to the UE. If the spectrum-orchestrated LTE cell receives a measurement report from the UE during this period, the UE is handed over from this cell to a basic-coverage cell. If the spectrum-orchestrated LTE does not receive the measurement report from the UE after the timer expires, the UE is blindly redirected from this cell to a basic-coverage cell.
item.name: specOrchLTEMeasWaitTimer

item.desc: This parameter sets the priorities of the target inter-frequency spectrum-orchestrated LTE cells for UE migration. It is an array, and the array elements indicate the priorities of the elements in the interCarriFreq array parameter in turn. A larger array element of this parameter indicates that the priority of the corresponding frequency is higher and the frequency is more preferentially selected as the target frequency for UE migration. If the value of an element is 0, it indicates that the corresponding frequency is not selected as the target frequency for UE migration.
item.name: specOrchTgtInterFPri

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration for determining coordination in cluster orchestration. Within the duration specified by this parameter, the eNodeB determines whether to perform coordination in cluster orchestration in each decision-making period (15 minutes).If the following three conditions are met in each decision-making period, coordination can be performed for the LTE cell cluster:1. The load of the LTE cell in the cluster center is low.2. The load of the NR cell that shares a carrier with the LTE cell in the cluster center is high.3. The load of all LTE cells at the cluster edge is low.In all decision-making periods, if the number of periods in which the load of the LTE cell in the cluster center is high is greater than or equal to M, or if the number of periods in which the load of any LTE cell at the cluster edge is high is greater than or equal to M, coordination is not performed for the LTE cell cluster. The value of M is calculated through the formula: M = Max{1,X}. Where, X equals the value of cluOrchNotCooDeciNumTrd (Threshold of the Ratio of Number of Times That Coordination Is Not Performed in Cluster Orchestration) multiplied by the number of decision-making periods.Within the duration specified by this parameter, if neither the conditions for executing cluster coordination nor the conditions for not executing coordination are met, the LTE cell in the cluster center and those at the cluster edge remain in their original status.
item.name: cluOrchCooDeciDur

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of maximum number of LTE cells at cluster edge in cluster orchestration. A cluster consists of an LTE cell in the cluster center and LTE cells at the cluster edge. The number of cells at the edge of a cluster cannot exceed the value of this parameter.
item.name: cluOrchEdgeCellMaxNumTrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the degree of coverage overlapping with intra-frequency neighbor cells in cluster orchestration. It is used to determine an LTE cell that is at the cluster edge. If the degree of coverage overlapping between an LTE cell in the cluster center and an intra-frequency neighbor cell is larger than or equal to the value of this parameter, the neighbor cell is defined as an LTE cell at the cluster edge.
item.name: cluOrchIntraNOverLapTrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of PRB usage for LTE frequency-domain resource extension in cluster orchestration. When the eNodeB performs cluster orchestration, if an LTE cell in the cluster center or an LTE cell at the cluster edge meets either of the following conditions, the load of the LTE cell is high:(1) The ratio of the number of UEs in the cell is larger than the value of the cluOrchLTEFDExtenUETrd (Threshold of UE Ratio for LTE Frequency-Domain Resource Extension in Cluster Orchestration) parameter.(2) The downlink PRB usage of the cell is larger than the value of this parameter.
item.name: cluOrchLTEFDExtenPRBTrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of UE ratio for LTE frequency-domain resource extension in cluster orchestration. When the eNodeB performs cluster orchestration, if the LTE cell in the cluster center or an LTE cell at the cluster edge meets either of the following conditions, the load of the LTE cell is high:1. The ratio of the number of UEs in the cell is larger than the value of this parameter.2. The downlink PRB usage of the cell is larger than the value of the cluOrchLTEFDExtenPRBTrd (Threshold of PRB Usage for LTE Frequency-Domain Resource Extension in Cluster Orchestration) parameter.
item.name: cluOrchLTEFDExtenUETrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of PRB usage for LTE frequency-domain resource shrinkage in cluster orchestration. When the eNodeB performs cluster orchestration, if the LTE cell in the cluster center or an LTE cell at the cluster edge meets both of the following conditions, the load of the LTE cell is low:1. The ratio of the number of UEs in the cell is smaller than the value of the cluOrchLTEFDShrinkUETrd (Threshold of UE Ratio for LTE Frequency-Domain Resource Shrinkage in Cluster Orchestration) parameter.2. The downlink PRB usage of the cell is lower than the value of this parameter.
item.name: cluOrchLTEFDShrinkPRBTrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of UE ratio for LTE frequency-domain resource shrinkage in cluster orchestration. When the eNodeB performs cluster orchestration, if the LTE cell in the cluster center or an LTE cell at the cluster edge meets both of the following conditions, the load of the LTE cell is low:1. The ratio of the number of UEs in the cell is smaller than the value of this parameter.2. The downlink PRB usage of the cell is lower than the value of the cluOrchLTEFDShrinkPRBTrd (Threshold of PRB Usage for LTE Frequency-Domain Resource Shrinkage in Cluster Orchestration) parameter.
item.name: cluOrchLTEFDShrinkUETrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of the ratio of number of times that coordination is not performed in cluster orchestration. In all decision-making periods (each of which is 15 minutes) in the duration set by the cluOrchCooDeciDur (Duration for Determining Coordination in Cluster Orchestration) parameter, if the number of periods in which the load of the LTE cell in the cluster center is high is greater than or equal to M, or if the number of periods in which the load of any LTE cell at the cluster edge is high is greater than or equal to M, coordination is not performed for the LTE cell cluster. The value of M is calculated through the formula: M = Max{1, number of decision-making periods multiplied by the value of this parameter}
item.name: cluOrchNotCooDeciNumTrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of PRB usage for NR frequency-domain resource extension in cluster orchestration. When the eNodeB performs cluster orchestration, if the NR cell that shares a carrier with an LTE cell in the cluster center meets both of the following conditions, the load of the NR cell is high:(1) The ratio of the number of UEs in the cell is larger than or equal to the value of the cluOrchNRFDExtenUETrd (Threshold of UE Ratio for NR Frequency-Domain Resource Extension in Cluster Orchestration) parameter.(2) The PRB usage of the cell is larger than the value of this parameter.
item.name: cluOrchNRFDExtenPRBTrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold of UE ration for LTE frequency-domain resource extension in cluster orchestration. When the eNodeB performs cluster orchestration, if the NR cell that shares a carrier with an LTE cell in the cluster center meets both of the following conditions, the load of the NR cell is high:(1) The ratio of the number of UEs in the NR cell is larger than or equal to the value of this parameter.(2) The PRB usage of the NR cell is larger than or equal to the value of the cluOrchNRFDExtenPRBTrd (Threshold of PRB Usage for NR Frequency-Domain Resource Extension in Cluster Orchestration) parameter.
item.name: cluOrchNRFDExtenUETrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the proportion of the RBs with CRS power reduction. If the resourceAdjSwitch (Resource Adjustment Policy Switch) parameter is set to 1 (Cluster Frequency Division) and the related conditions are met, some LTE spectrum resources are allocated to NR cells. In this case, the proportion of the number of RBs with CRS power reduction in the LTE bandwidths to the total number of RBs in the LTE bandwidths is the value of this parameter.
item.name: cRSPowerDecRatio

item.desc: This parameter sets a resource adjustment policy for LTE and NR cells. If it is set to set to 1 (Cluster Frequency Division), the cluster-level frequency division function takes effect. In this case, the eNodeB determines the resources that can be scheduled for the LTE and NR cells in accordance with the negotiation result between the local cell and neighbor cells, reducing the interference from intra-frequency LTE neighbor cells and improving the performance of NR cells.
item.name: resourceAdjSwitch

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the string type and can be configured as planned.
item.name: id

item.desc: This parameter sets the unique ID of the managed object. It is of the string type and can be configured as planned.
item.name: moId

item.desc: This parameter sets the BSR threshold for identifying the UEs with uplink large-BSR services. In the uplink BSRs received by a UE, if the percentage that the BSR values are larger than this parameter value is higher than the value of the Percentage of UL Big-Service BSRs Meeting the Threshold parameter (bsrStfHighThrPct), the UE is identified as an uplink UE with large-BSR services.
item.name: bSRThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration for identifying the UEs with the uplink large-BSR services in the scenarios where the UE power is limited. In the uplink BSRs received by a UE in the statistical period specified by this parameter, if the percentage that the BSR values are larger than the bSRThr (Big Service BSR Threshold) parameter is higher than the value of the bsrStfHighThrPct (Percentage of UL Big-Service BSRs Meeting the Threshold) parameter, the UE is identified as that with uplink large-BSR services.
item.name: bSRCtnMntPrd4PwrLmt

item.desc: This parameter sets the duration for identifying the UEs with the uplink large-BSR services in the scenarios where the UE power is not limited. In the uplink BSRs received by a UE in the statistical period specified by this parameter, if the percentage that the BSR values are larger than the bSRThr (Big Service BSR Threshold) parameter is higher than the value of the bsrStfHighThrPct (Percentage of UL Big-Service BSRs Meeting the Threshold) parameter, the UE is identified as that with uplink large-BSR services.
item.name: bSRCtnMntPrd4NoPwrLmt

item.desc: This parameter sets the percentage threshold for identifying the UEs with uplink large-BSR services. In the uplink BSRs received by a UE, if the percentage that the BSR values are larger than the value of the bSRThr (Big Service BSR Threshold) parameter is higher than this parameter value, the UE is identified as an uplink UE with large-BSR services.
item.name: bSRStfHighThrPct

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval for identifying the UEs with uplink large-BSR services. If the Switch of Handover Based UL Service parameter (handOverBasedULSRVSwch) is set to Open, the eNodeB starts to identify the UEs with uplink large-BSR services at the interval configured by this parameter, and hands over the identified UEs with uplink large-BSR services to the target frequency.
item.name: uLSvcIdfyPrd

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of UEs to be handed over in a period for identifying the UEs with uplink large-BSR services. In each handover period of the UEs with uplink large-BSR services, the number of UEs that are selected to be handed over from the current serving cell cannot exceed the parameter value.
item.name: uLSvcIdfyNum

item.desc: This parameter sets the threshold number of UEs to be handed over based on uplink large-BSR services. The eNodeB hands over the UEs with uplink large-BSR services to the target frequency only when the Switch of Handover Based UL Service (handOverBasedULSRVSwch) parameter is set to Open and the number of the UEs connected to the current serving cell is larger than the parameter value.
item.name: uLSRVHOUENum

item.desc: This parameter sets the period during which the validity of downlink large-BSR UEs is checked. If the service data volume of a UE reaches the value specified by the dLBigBsrFlowThr (Data Volume Threshold for Identifying DL Large-BSR Services) parameter within the period specified by this parameter, the UE is identified as a large-BSR UE. The eNodeB provides general-QoS guarantee for the identified large-BSR services to improve the user experience of large-BSR UEs. A smaller parameter value indicates a higher service rate that large-BSR UEs can reach.
item.name: dLBigBsrValidationTime

item.desc: This parameter sets the interval for detecting downlink large-BSR services (that is, the downlink services with a large BSR size). If the dLBigBsrSwitch (Switch for DL Large-BSR Service Identification) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and the interval for two service packets of a UE to arrive at the eNodeB is larger than or equal to the parameter value, the UE is not identified as a large-BSR UE. If the UE has been identified as a large-BSR UE, it is marked as a common UE and no general-QoS guarantee is provided for the UE.
item.name: dLBigBsrPeriod

item.desc: This parameter sets the data volume threshold for the identification of downlink large-BSR services (that is, the downlink services with a large BSR size). If the service data volume of a UE reaches the value specified by this parameter within the period specified by the dLBigBsrValidationTime (Validity Check Time of Large-BSR UEs) parameter, the UE may be identified as a large-BSR UE. The eNodeB provides general-QoS guarantee for large-BSR services, improving the user experience of large-BSR UEs.
item.name: dLBigBsrFlowThr

item.desc: This parameter sets the general-QoS type of identified downlink large-BSR services. The values 1 through 7 correspond to general-QoS type 1 through general-QoS type 7 respectively.
item.name: dLBigBsrType

item.desc: This parameter enables or disables the identification of downlink large-BSR services (that is, the downlink services with a large BSR size). If this parameter to 1 (Open), the eNodeB detects the data volume of UEs, identifies downlink large-BSR services, and provides general-QoS guarantee for such services of the UEs, improving the user experience of the UEs.
item.name: dLBigBsrSwitch

item.desc: If uplink large-BSR service-based handover is enabled, this parameter sets a list of QCIs of uplink large-BSR services of the UEs for which the policy for identifying poor channel quality does not take effect. It is an array parameter consisting of 64 elements. Each element sets a QCI of uplink large-BSR services of the UEs for which the policy for identifying poor channel quality does not take effect. The value 0 indicates that there is no corresponding service QCI. If uplink large-BSR service-based handover is valid for poor-quality UEs only, for the UEs with the service QCIs configured by this parameter, uplink large-BSR service-based handover can take effect no matter whether the channel quality of the UEs is good or poor.
item.name: ulBigSrvHOWrsQualFltQCI

item.desc: If uplink large-BSR service-based handover is enabled, this parameter sets a list of types of uplink large-BSR services of the UEs for which the policy for identifying poor channel quality does not take effect. It is an array parameter consisting of six elements. Each element sets a type of uplink large-BSR services of the UEs for which the policy for identifying poor channel quality does not take effect. The value 0 indicates that there is no corresponding service type. If uplink large-BSR service-based handover is valid for poor-quality UEs only, for the UEs with the service types configured by this parameter, uplink large-BSR service-based handover can take effect no matter whether the channel quality of the UEs is good or poor.
item.name: ulBigSrvHOWrsQualFltType

item.desc: This parameter sets the Mobile Country Code (MCC) of the operator. A PLMN is jointly determined by a Mobile Network Code (MNC) and an MCC. If the qciRbPartitionSwch (Switch of Resource Allocation for Specific QCI Services) parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB manages network resources for specific QCI services in the PLMN.
item.name: mcc

item.desc: This parameter sets the Mobile Network Code (MNC) of the operator. A PLMN is jointly determined by an MNC and a Mobile Country Code (MCC). If the qciRbPartitionSwch (Switch of Resource Allocation for Specific QCI Services) parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB manages network resources for specific QCI services in the PLMN.
item.name: mnc

item.desc: This parameter sets the QCI service group index that is used for the PLMN-based and QCI-based resource grouping policy. If the qciRbPartitionSwch (Switch of Resource Allocation for Specific QCI Services) parameter is set to 1 (Open), the eNodeB allocates network resources to the QCI service group that is specified by this parameter.
item.name: qCIGroupIdx

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum ratio of uplink QCI-level network resources in a configured PLMN. It is used to calculate the maximum available resources for specific QCI services in a specific PLMN.
item.name: ulQciMaxRBRatio

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum ratio of uplink QCI-level network resources in a configured PLMN. It is used to calculate the minimum available resources for specific QCI services in a specific PLMN when the traffic of the services is high.
item.name: ulQciMinRBRatio

item.desc: This parameter sets a list of QCIs corresponding to the services in a QCI service group used for the PLMN-based and QCI-based resource grouping policy. It is an array parameter consisting of 16 elements. Each element indicates a QCI corresponding to a service in a specific QCI service group. If the qciRbPartitionSwch (Switch of Resource Allocation for Specific QCI Services) parameter is set to 1 (Open), all the valid services corresponding to the QCIs in this list are used as a QCI service group involved in network resource allocation. If the qCINum (Number of QCIs in a QCI Service Group) parameter is set to n, the first n elements in the list are valid elements, and the value of a valid element is not a valid QCI, this element is regarded as an invalid element.
item.name: qCIQueue

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of valid QCIs corresponding to the services in a QCI service group used for the PLMN-based and QCI-based resource grouping policy. If the qciRbPartitionSwch (Switch of Resource Allocation for Specific QCI Services) parameter is set to 1 (Open) and this parameter is set to n, only the first n elements in the QCI list specified by the qCIQueue (List of QCIs in a QCI Service Group) parameter are valid and the remaining elements are invalid.
item.name: qCINum

item.desc: This parameter sets the minimum ratio of downlink QCI-level network resources in a configured PLMN. It is used to calculate the minimum available resources for specific QCI services in a specific PLMN when the traffic of the services is high.
item.name: dlQciMinRBRatio

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum ratio of downlink QCI-level network resources in a configured PLMN. It is used to calculate the maximum available resources for specific QCI services in a specific PLMN.

item.desc: This parameter indicates NB-IoT downlink subframe configuration over 10ms for inband or standalone/guardband. The first/leftmost bit corresponds to the subframe #0 of the radio frame satisfying SFN mod x = 0, where x is the size of the bit string divided by 10. item.desc: Upon detecting radio link problems, the UE shall start T310_UE. Upon receiving N311 _UE consecutive in-sync indications from lower layers, upon triggering the handover procedure and upon initiating the connection re-establishment procedure. If security is not activated: go to RRC_IDLE else: initiate the connection re-establishment procedure.

item.desc: The parameter indicates the time length for UE switch to idle upon initiating the RRC connection re-establishment procedure. Upon initiating the RRC connection re-establishment procedure, UE starts this timer. When selection of a suitable E-UTRA cell or a cell using another RAT, UE stops this timer. When timer is expired, UE switches to IDLE.
item.name: t311_Ue

item.desc: The parameter indicates Timer for UE to wait for RRC connection response. UE will start T300 after sending RRC CONNECTION REQUEST message. The T300 will be stopped before it expires if :1. UE received RRCConnectionSetup or RRCConnectionReject;2. cell re-selection occurred; 3. UE NAS layer terminated RRC connection establishment procedure;When T300 expires, UE will:1.reset MAC2.release the MAC configuration 3.re-establish RLC for all RBs that are established, and inform upper layers about the failure of establish the RRC connection.
item.name: t300

item.desc: The parameter indicates Timer for UE to wait for RRC connection re-establishment response. UE shall start T301 after RRCConnectionReestabilshmentRequest message is transmitted.When UE receives the RRCConnectionReestablishment or RRCConnectionReestablishmentReject message, UE shall stop this timer.When Timer is expired, UE switches to IDLE.

item.name: qhyst

item.name: snonintrasearch

item.name: intraQrxLevMin

item.name: sIntraSearch

item.name: cellSelQqualMin

item.desc: Specifies the minimum required quality level in the cell in dB.
item.name: intraFreqQqualMin

item.desc: This parameter is the delta minimum receive level for cell selection. If this parameter is configured invalid,the parameter is absent in SIB1, actual value Qrxlevmin = q-RxLevMin * 2 [dBm]. If delta-RxLevMin is included, actual value Qrxlevmin = (q-RxLevMin + delta-RxLevMin) * 2 [dBm].This field is optionally present, when q-RxLevMin is set to the minimum value. Otherwise the field is not present.
item.name: selDeltaRxLevMin

item.desc: This parameter specifies the minimum receive level offset for enhanced coverage authorization for cell selection.If this parameter is configured invalid, the field is absent, the value of 0 dB shall be used by UE.
item.name: selCEAuzOffset

item.desc: This parameter is the delta minimum receive level for intra-frequency cell selection. If this parameter is configured invalid,the parameter is absent in SIB3, actual value Qrxlevmin = q-RxLevMin * 2 [dBm]. If delta-RxLevMin is included, actual value Qrxlevmin = (q-RxLevMin + delta-RxLevMin) * 2 [dBm].This field is optionally present, when q-RxLevMin is set to the minimum value. Otherwise the field is not present.
item.name: intraDeltaRxLevMin

item.desc: This parameter sets the bitmap for disabling downlink HARQ feedback in an NTN cell. It consists of 2 bits. Each bit from left to right sets whether to disable downlink HARQ feedback for HARQ process 0 through HARQ process 1. If a bit is set to 1, HARQ feedback is disabled for the corresponding HARQ process. If a bit is set to 0, HARQ feedback is enabled for the corresponding HARQ process.
item.name: dlHarqFeedbackDisabledBitmap

item.desc: This parameter sets the bitmap for setting the uplink HARQ mode in an NTN cell. It consists of 2 bits. Each bit from left to right sets the HARQ mode for HARQ process 0 through HARQ process 1. If a bit is set to 0, the HARQ mode of the corresponding HARQ process is HARQmodeB. This mode does not support uplink HARQ retransmission. If a bit is set to 1, the HARQ mode of the corresponding HARQ process is HARQmodeA. This mode supports uplink HARQ retransmission.
item.name: ulHARQModeBitmap

item.desc: This paramter is the switch for downlink HARQ mode.When it sets to Open, DL HARQ mode is configured according to the bitmap for setting the downlink HARQ mode in an NTN cell. Otherwise DL HARQ mode is configured to HARQ enabled.

item.desc: This paramter is the switch for uplink HARQ modeB. When it sets to Open, UL HARQ mode is configured according to the bitmap for setting the uplink HARQ mode in an NTN cell. Otherwise UL HARQ mode is configured to modeA
item.name: ulHarqModeBSwitch

item.desc: The parameter is QCI in SAE Bearer Info. eNB can find service's QoS parameters and application's parameters with QCI.QoS class identifier (QCI): A scalar that is used as a reference to a specific packet forwarding behaviour (e.g. packet loss rate, packet delay budget) to be provided to a SDF. This may be implemented in the access network by the QCI referencing node specific parameters that control packet forwarding treatment (e.g. scheduling weights, admission thresholds, queue management thresholds, link layer protocol configuration, etc.), that have been pre-configured by the operator at a specific node(s) (e.g. eNodeB).
item.name: qCI

item.desc: The parameter is packet delay budget(PDB). The Packet Delay Budget (PDB) denotes the time that a packet may be delayed between the UE and the PDN GW. For a certain QCI the value of the PDB is the same in uplink and downlink. The purpose of the PDB is to support the configuration of scheduling and link layer functions (e.g. the setting of scheduling priority weights and HARQ target operating points). The PDB shall be interpreted as a maximum delay with a confidence level of 98 percent.
item.name: srvPacketDelay

item.desc: The parameter is packet loss rate. The Packet Loss Rate (PLR) defines an upper bound for the rate of SDUs (e.g. IP packets) that have been processed by the sender of a link layer protocol (e.g. RLC in E-UTRAN) but that are not successfully delivered by the corresponding receiver to the upper layer (e.g. PDCP in E-UTRAN). Thus, the PLR defines an upper bound for a rate of non congestion related packet losses. The purpose of the PLR is to allow for appropriate link layer protocol configurations (e.g. RLC and HARQ in E-UTRAN). For a certain QCI the value of the PLR is the same in uplink and downlink.
item.name: srvPacketLoss

item.desc: The parameter is name of example service, corresponding to QCI.
item.name: srvClassName

item.desc: The parameter is priority. Every QCI (GBR and Non-GBR) is associated with a Priority level. Priority level 1 is the highest Priority level. The Priority levels shall be used to differentiate between SDF aggregates of the same UE, and it shall also be used to differentiate between SDF aggregates from different UEs. Via its QCI an SDF aggregate is associated with a Priority level and a PDB.
item.name: srvPrior

item.name: sequenNumLenth

item.desc: This parameter sets the load evaluation mode for carrier shutdown. If it is set to Non Load Evaluation, deep sleeping is triggered at the specified time. If it is set to Evaluation ES Cell, carrier shutdown is triggered as long as the load of the energy-saving cell meets the load condition. If it is set to Evaluation ES Cell and Coverage Cell, carrier shutdown can be triggered only when both the load of the energy-saving cell and the cell providing coverage meets the load condition.
item.name: carrierEsLBEvaluateMod

item.desc: The parameter is the Cell Shutdown workday start time of energy saving configured by Network Planning and Optimization operators or operator,workdays refer to Sunday to Thursday.The two values of the parameter corresponds to the hour and minuter respectively.
item.name: workdayStarTimeES

item.desc: The parameter is the Cell Shutdown workday end time of energy saving configured by Network Planning and Optimization operators or operator,workdays refer to Sunday to Thursday.The two values of the parameter corresponds to the hour and minuter respectively.
item.name: workdayEndTimeES

item.desc: The parameter is the Cell Shutdown weekend star year of energy saving configured by Network Planning and Optimization operators or operator, weekends refer to friday and saturday.The two values of the parameter corresponds to the hour and minuter respectively.
item.name: weekendStarTimeES

item.desc: The parameter is the Cell Shutdown Weekend end time of energy saving configured by Network Planning and Optimization operators or operator, weekends refer to friday and saturday.The two values of the parameter corresponds to the hour and minuter respectively.
item.name: weekendEndTimeES

item.name: staticPeriodES

item.desc: The parameter sets the shortest time of energy saving (unit: hours).

item.name: trdLoadESUp

item.desc: The Max Tolerance Load Threshold Downlink of Energy Saving Cell while Switching off.
item.name: trdLoadESDown

item.desc: This parameter indicates the maximum uplink load tolerable for a compensation cell when an energy saving cell is shut down. The energy saving cell cannot be shut down if the sum of the uplink load on the compensation cell and the energy saving cell is higher than this threshold.
item.name: resPRBUp

item.desc: This parameter indicates the maximum downlink load tolerable for a compensation cell when an energy saving cell is shut down. The energy saving cell cannot be shut down if the sum of the downlink load on the compensation cell and the energy saving cell is higher than this threshold.
item.name: resPRBDown

item.desc: This parameter indicates the time window for observing the load on a cell after the cell is switched off.
item.name: switchoffTimeWindow

item.desc: This parameter sets the hysteresis for an energy saving cell to re-enter energy saving status after being awakened.
item.name: intervalESTimerLen

item.desc: Threshold Tolerance of the Number of RRC_CONNECTED UEs for Carrier Shutdown in Intra-RAT ES Cells.
item.name: numTrdTotalUE

item.desc: This parameter sets whether to enable the RF shutdown function for energy saving.
item.name: rfShutdownSwitch

item.desc: The parameter sets the time window of switching off for channel off.
item.name: rfShutdownDelayTime

item.desc: This parameter indicates the maximum downlink load tolerance in the case of channel shutdown. The channel cannot be shut down if the downlink load on the cell is higher than this threshold.
item.name: trdLoadOffChanESDown

item.desc: This parameter indicates the maximum downlink load tolerance in the case of channel switch-on. The channel is switched on if the downlink load on the cell is higher than this threshold.
item.name: trdLoadOnChanESDown

item.desc: This parameter sets the maximum tolerable number of UEs in RRC_CONNECTED status when the channel is shut down. When the number of UEs in RRC_CONNECTED status is lower than the threshold, the channel is allowed to be shut down; otherwise, the channel is not allowed to be shut down.
item.name: trdNumUEOffChanES

item.desc: This parameter indicates the number of UEs in RRC_CONNECTED status when a channel is shut down. If the number of UEs in RRC_CONNECTED status is larger than or equal to this threshold, channel shutdown is not allowed; otherwise, carrier shutdown is allowed.
item.name: trdNumUEOnChanES

item.desc: This parameter sets the number of times that the energy saving cell continuously checks the energy saving conditions.
item.name: detectNumber

item.desc: The parameter sets the load check period used to awaken a channel after the channel is shut down.
item.name: rFSDWakeupTimerLen

item.desc: This parameter sets the shortest time of duration (unit: minutes) allowed after the channel is turned on.
item.name: allowedTimeChanES

item.desc: This parameter sets the channel-off starting time on workdays for energy saving. In most cases, it is configured by network planning and optimization personnel or operators, workdays refer to sunday to thursday. awChanlOffWorkdayStarTimeES[0]: starting time (hour) of the energy-saving time period on awChanlOffWorkdayStarTimeES[1]: starting time (minute) of the energy-saving time period on workdays.
item.name: chanlOffWorkdayStarTimeES

item.desc: This parameter sets the channel-off ending time on workdays for energy saving. In most cases, it is configured by network planning and optimization personnel or operators, workdays refer to sunday to thursday. awChanlOffWorkdayEndTimeES[0]: ending time (hour) of the energy-saving time period on awChanlOffWorkdayEndTimeES[1]: ending time (minute) of the energy-saving time period on workdays.
item.name: chanlOffWorkdayEndTimeES

item.desc: This parameter indicates the start time of channel off for energy saving at weekends configured by network planning and optimization engineers, weekends refer to friday and saturday. The two values represent hour and minute respectively.
item.name: chanlOffWeekendStarTimeES

item.desc: This parameter sets the channel-off ending time on weekends for energy saving. In most cases, it is configured by network planning and optimization personnel or operators, weekends refer to friday and saturday. awChanlOffWeekendEndTimeES[0]: ending time (hour) of the energy-saving time period on awChanlOffWeekendEndTimeES[1]: ending time (minute) of the energy-saving time period on weekends.
item.name: chanlOffWeekendEndTimeES

item.desc: This parameter indicates the number of detected PRBs in the case of channel-on. If the number of detected PRBs in the case of channel-off is larger than or equal to this configured value, the channel is woken up.
item.name: rFWakeupTimeWinNumPrb

item.desc: This parameter indicates the number of detected UEs in RRC_CONNECTED state in the case of channel-on. If the number of detected UEs in RRC_CONNECTED state in the case of channel-off is larger than or equal to this configured value, the channel is woken up.

item.desc: This parameter sets the home country code of an eNodeB. If the EN-DC X2 interface is a shared interface, this parameter is set to the PLMN of the logical primary site (the primary PLMN of the physical base station). If the EN-DC X2 interface is an independent interface, this parameter is set to the PLMN of the corresponding logical base station. For example, if the logical base station belongs to China Telecom, this parameter is set to the PLMN of China Telecom; if the logical base station belongs to China Unicom, this parameter is set to the PLMN of China Unicom.
item.name: mcc

item.desc: This parameter sets the home network code of an eNodeB. If the EN-DC X2 interface is a shared interface, this parameter is set to the PLMN of the logical primary site (the primary PLMN of the physical base station). If the EN-DC X2 interface is an independent interface, this parameter is set to the PLMN of the corresponding logical base station. For example, if the logical base station belongs to China Telecom, this parameter is set to the PLMN of China Telecom; if the logical base station belongs to China Unicom, this parameter is set to the PLMN of China Unicom.
item.name: mnc

item.desc: This parameter sets the PLMN of the logical secondary site on a physical site. The logical secondary site shares the same association with the logical primary site. If dedicated carrier sharing for global services is enabled, this parameter is set to the PLMN of the logical secondary site if the EN-DC X2 interface is a shared interface. For example, if the primary PLMN of the base station belongs to China Telecom, this parameter is set to the PLMN of China Unicom and vice versa. If the EN-DC X2 interface is an independent interface, this parameter is not used.
item.name: additionalMccList

item.desc: This parameter sets the PLMN of the logical secondary site on a physical site. The logical secondary site shares the same association with the logical primary site. If dedicated carrier sharing for global services is enabled, this parameter is set to the PLMN of the logical secondary site if the EN-DC X2 interface is a shared interface. For example, if the primary PLMN of the base station belongs to China Telecom, this parameter is set to the PLMN of China Unicom and vice versa. If the EN-DC X2 interface is an independent interface, this parameter is not used.
